records.description: Jamaat-e-Islami Karachi has filed a petition in the Sindh High Court challenging the AI-based automated e-challan traffic fine system. The system issues fines to vehicle owners regardless of the actual driver, leading to unfair penalties due to outdated ownership records and poor road infrastructure, causing financial and legal harm to citizens.

records.title: AI-Generated Song Fraud Leads to Financial Loss and Police Manhunt in Semarang
records.description: A man from Jakarta Timur used AI to create 60 substandard songs, passing them off as original manual compositions and charging Rp120 million. The client, deceived by the AI-generated music, suffered financial loss and reported the fraud. Semarang police have named the suspect a fugitive and are actively searching for him.

records.title: Elon Musk's Grok AI Chatbot Defames UK MP, Triggers Legal and Public Backlash
records.description: Elon Musk's AI chatbot Grok, on X, falsely labeled SNP MP Pete Wishart a "rape enabler" in response to user prompts about grooming gang inquiries in Scotland. The defamatory AI-generated statement led to reputational harm, abusive messages, and Wishart seeking legal advice. Grok later issued an apology.

records.title: AI-Generated Inappropriate Exam Question Causes Outrage on Chinese Education App
records.description: The Chinese education app 作业帮 (Zuoyebang) published a physics question referencing student suicide, likely generated or selected by its AI system. The question caused public outrage and psychological harm, especially among minors. The company confirmed the incident, removed the content, and launched an investigation into its content moderation processes.

records.title: Kim Kardashian Fails Law Exams After Relying on ChatGPT for Answers
records.description: Kim Kardashian revealed she failed parts of her law exams after relying on ChatGPT for legal advice and answers. The AI system provided incorrect responses, directly contributing to her exam failures. Kardashian publicly attributed her repeated academic setbacks to the inaccurate outputs from the AI tool.

records.title: UK Settles with Victims of Post Office Horizon IT Scandal
records.description: The UK government has paid over £1.2 billion in compensation to more than 9,000 victims, including campaigner Sir Alan Bates and former sub-postmistress Betty Brown, after the faulty Horizon IT system led to wrongful prosecutions, financial loss, and psychological harm to sub-postmasters between 1999 and 2015.

records.title: Flock Safety's AI Surveillance Systems Spark Privacy and Human Rights Concerns Across U.S. Cities
records.description: Flock Safety's AI-powered automated license plate readers (ALPRs), deployed in cities like Cambridge and Berkeley, have facilitated mass surveillance, privacy violations, and unauthorized data sharing with federal agencies, including ICE. Reports highlight wrongful tracking, legal breaches, and human rights risks, prompting public backlash and contract suspensions.

records.title: AI-Recommended Hiking Route Leads to Injury in Hebei
records.description: In Hebei, China, a family of five followed an AI software's recommendation for a scenic hiking route, which led them into an undeveloped and hazardous mountain area. One man slipped and was seriously injured, requiring emergency rescue. The incident highlights the risks of relying on AI-generated recommendations for outdoor activities.

records.title: Fox News Spreads Misinformation After Airing Racist AI-Generated SNAP Videos
records.description: AI-generated deepfake videos depicting Black women misusing SNAP benefits circulated widely on social media, spreading racist stereotypes and misinformation. Fox News mistakenly reported these fabricated videos as real, further amplifying the false narratives before issuing a correction. The incident highlights the harm caused by AI-generated misinformation and media failures in the United States.

records.title: French Regulator Finds Facebook Job Ad Algorithm Sexist
records.description: The French equality authority, Défenseur des Droits, ruled that Facebook's AI-driven job ad algorithm discriminates based on gender, showing engineering jobs mainly to men and nursery jobs to women. Meta was given three months to address the issue and report corrective actions. Meta disputes the decision.

records.title: France Investigates TikTok Algorithm for Promoting Suicide Among Youth
records.description: French authorities have launched a criminal investigation into TikTok's recommendation algorithm, suspecting it of promoting suicide-related content to vulnerable minors. The probe follows parliamentary and legal complaints that the AI-driven system exposes young users to harmful material, potentially leading to self-harm or suicide.

records.title: AI-Powered Bots Cause Major Disruption to Web Businesses in India and APAC
records.description: Akamai Technologies reports a 300% surge in AI-powered bot activity, with India experiencing the highest levels in the Asia-Pacific region. These bots conduct content scraping, impersonation, and fraud, distorting analytics and collapsing ad revenues, causing significant economic harm to publishers and web-based businesses.

records.title: AI-Driven Online Scams Cause Widespread Financial Harm
records.description: Cybercriminals are increasingly using artificial intelligence to enhance online scams, making them more convincing and harder to detect. These AI-powered schemes, including fake job offers and extortion with negative reviews, have led to significant financial losses and data theft for millions globally, as reported by the Global Anti-Scam Alliance.

records.title: AI Chatbots Linked to Teen Harm Prompt Safety Overhauls and Lawsuits
records.description: OpenAI and Character.AI face lawsuits alleging their chatbots contributed to teen suicides and mental health issues. In response, both companies have introduced stricter safety measures, including age verification, parental controls, and limiting teen interactions with chatbots, aiming to mitigate further harm and address regulatory scrutiny in the United States.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Videos Spread Disinformation About Ukrainian Military Surrender
records.description: Russian actors used AI to create and disseminate fake videos on TikTok, falsely depicting mass surrender of Ukrainian soldiers near Pokrovsk. The coordinated campaign, identified by Ukraine's Center for Countering Disinformation, aims to demoralize Ukrainians and influence foreign perceptions by spreading Kremlin narratives through AI-generated misinformation.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Videos Used in Russian Disinformation Campaign Against Ukraine
records.description: Russian actors have used AI to generate deepfake videos on TikTok, simulating street interviews with Ukrainians expressing pessimistic views about the war and mobilization. These videos aim to demoralize Ukrainian society and promote surrender narratives, constituting an AI-driven disinformation campaign with psychological and societal harm in Ukraine.

records.title: Danish Rights Group Sues Suno AI for Copyright Infringement
records.description: Danish music rights organization Koda has filed a lawsuit against US-based AI music service Suno, alleging unauthorized use of copyrighted Danish songs to train its AI and generate new music. Koda claims Suno copied works without permission or payment, violating artists' intellectual property rights.

records.title: AI System Enables Successful Conception After Years of Male Infertility
records.description: Researchers at Columbia University used the STAR AI system to scan millions of images from semen samples, identifying rare viable sperm in a man with azoospermia. This enabled successful fertilization and pregnancy for a couple after nearly 20 years of infertility, marking a significant medical breakthrough.

records.title: AI Deepfakes Cause Political, Financial, and Reputational Harm Globally
records.description: AI-generated deepfakes have caused significant harm, including spreading political misinformation during elections in Ireland, manipulating stock markets, defrauding businesses, and damaging reputations, as seen in India with court-ordered removals. These incidents highlight the growing threat of AI misuse in politics, finance, and media worldwide.

records.title: Facial Recognition AI Leads to Arrests in Manchester's Piccadilly Gardens
records.description: Greater Manchester Police deployed AI-powered facial recognition cameras in Piccadilly Gardens, Manchester, resulting in the arrest of two wanted individuals. The technology, funded by the Home Office, matches faces in crowds to police watchlists, raising concerns about privacy and civil liberties.

records.title: PhonePe Uses AI to Prevent Digital Payment Fraud in India
records.description: PhonePe has launched 'PhonePe Protect', an AI-powered security feature that identifies and blocks or warns users about suspicious transactions in real time. Integrating with India's Department of Telecommunications' Financial Fraud Risk Indicator, the system aims to prevent financial fraud and protect users from scams during digital payments.

records.title: Austrian Supreme Court Rejects AI-Generated Legal Complaint with Fabricated Content
records.description: In Austria, a defense lawyer used an AI system to draft a legal complaint, which included fabricated court decisions and numerous errors. The Supreme Court (OGH) rejected the complaint without substantive review, citing the AI's invented precedents and lack of professional oversight, raising concerns about AI misuse in legal proceedings.

records.title: Shanghai Court Rules User Liable for AI-Generated Copyright Infringement in 'Battle Through the Heavens' Case
records.description: A Shanghai court ruled that a user infringed copyright by using an AI platform's LoRA training feature to generate and share images of the 'Battle Through the Heavens' character Medusa, ordering the user to pay 50,000 RMB in damages. The AI platform was not held liable, having complied with takedown obligations.

records.title: Major DeFi Protocol Balancer Suffers $100M+ AI-Driven Exploit
records.description: Balancer, a leading DeFi protocol using AI-driven smart contracts, suffered a coordinated exploit draining over $100 million from its V2 pools. Attackers exploited vulnerabilities in automated systems and frontends, causing significant financial harm. Despite rapid recovery efforts, the incident highlights ongoing security challenges in AI-powered DeFi platforms.

records.title: Greek Intelligence Agency Accused of Using Predator Spyware for Illegal Surveillance
records.description: A former employee of the Greek National Intelligence Service (EYP), now with the police, testified in court that her phone was infected with Predator spyware via a malicious message, allegedly sent by EYP. The AI-enabled spyware enabled unauthorized surveillance, violating her privacy and human rights. Legal proceedings are ongoing in Athens.

records.title: Spotify Sued Over AI-Driven Fake Streaming Fraud
records.description: Spotify faces a class-action lawsuit in California, led by rapper RBX, alleging the platform allowed AI-powered bot networks to generate billions of fake streams for megastars like Drake. This AI-driven fraud allegedly inflated revenue for top artists and Spotify, causing significant financial harm to lesser-known artists and rights holders.

records.title: AI Enables More Effective Fraud Schemes in Russia
records.description: Russian experts report that criminals are increasingly using artificial intelligence to quickly analyze large data sets, create psychological profiles of potential victims, and generate tailored conversation scripts. This AI-driven approach has led to a rise in successful fraud cases, resulting in financial and data losses for Russian citizens.

records.title: AI Browsers Bypass Paywalls, Undermining Publisher Rights
records.description: AI-powered browsers like OpenAI's Atlas and Perplexity's Comet can autonomously bypass paywalls, granting users unauthorized access to subscription-only content. This capability, confirmed by a Columbia Journalism Review investigation, results in copyright violations and economic harm to publishers, challenging the sustainability of online journalism.

records.title: AI-Driven Ransomware and Deepfake Attacks Surge in India
records.description: Over half of Indian organizations experienced ransomware attacks in the past year, with 71% reporting a rise in AI-driven phishing and deepfake impersonation attempts. These AI-enabled attacks led to significant data loss, ransom payments, and operational disruptions, making India one of the most targeted markets globally.

records.title: US Court Ends Prosecution of Boeing Over 737 MAX AI-Related Crashes
records.description: A US federal judge ended criminal prosecution against Boeing following a settlement with the US government over the 2018-2019 737 MAX crashes, which killed 346 people. The crashes were linked to the malfunction of the MCAS, an AI-based flight control system. Boeing will pay fines and compensation to victims' families.

records.title: SesameOp Malware Exploits OpenAI Assistants API for Stealthy Cyberattacks
records.description: Microsoft discovered the SesameOp backdoor malware, which exploits OpenAI's Assistants API for covert command-and-control operations. Attackers use the API to relay commands and exfiltrate data, blending malicious activity with legitimate traffic and evading detection. The incident highlights the misuse of AI infrastructure in active espionage campaigns.

records.title: Ukraine's AI-Driven Drone Warfare Gamifies Lethal Operations
records.description: Ukraine has implemented an AI-assisted drone warfare system that rewards soldiers with points for confirmed kills or strikes, which can be exchanged for advanced weaponry via an online platform. This gamified system, involving hundreds of units, has directly contributed to thousands of casualties in the ongoing conflict with Russia.

records.title: Tesla Door System Failure Traps and Kills Five in Car Fire, Prompting Lawsuits and Investigation
records.description: A Tesla Model S crash in Wisconsin led to a fire where five occupants died after the AI-controlled electronic door system failed, trapping them inside. Lawsuits allege design defects and inadequate emergency escape options. U.S. regulators have launched investigations following multiple similar complaints about Tesla's door systems.

records.title: AI-Generated Images Used to Deceive Food Delivery Consumers in China
records.description: Food delivery merchants in China have used AI-generated images and videos to create fake storefronts and misrepresent their businesses on online platforms, misleading consumers about store quality and environment. This deceptive use of AI has resulted in consumer harm and prompted regulatory scrutiny and calls for stricter oversight.

records.title: AI-Powered Skydio Drones Used for Mass Surveillance in U.S. After Deployment in Gaza
records.description: AI-powered Skydio drones, initially deployed by Israel in Gaza for military operations, are now widely used by over 800 U.S. law enforcement agencies to autonomously surveil protests and civilians. The drones' AI-driven surveillance and data collection raise significant concerns over privacy violations and harm to civil liberties.

records.title: Android's AI Systems Outperform iPhone in Blocking Fraudulent Calls and Messages
records.description: Google's AI-powered security features in Android have proven more effective than Apple's iOS in blocking fraudulent calls and messages. Android's systems prevent over 10 billion scam attempts monthly, significantly reducing user exposure to digital fraud, as confirmed by studies and user surveys involving 5,000 smartphone users.

records.title: AI-Driven Drones Cause Harm in Ukraine War and U.S. Surveillance
records.description: AI-powered drones have transformed warfare in Ukraine, causing significant casualties by autonomously targeting soldiers and medical teams, and are also used for medical supply delivery. In the U.S., similar AI drones are deployed by law enforcement for mass surveillance, raising human rights concerns. Both uses have resulted in direct harm to individuals.

records.title: OpenAI's Atlas AI Browser Bypasses Paywalls and Raises Data Security Concerns
records.description: OpenAI's ChatGPT Atlas browser, featuring an AI assistant, can bypass publisher paywalls and access or summarize protected content, undermining media revenue and intellectual property rights. Additionally, security experts warn of vulnerabilities that could expose user data, raising significant privacy and data breach risks for users and publishers alike.

records.title: Samsung Galaxy Watch AI Stress Detection Malfunctions After Update
records.description: Following the One UI 8 Watch update, Samsung Galaxy Watch users report frequent false high-stress alerts, even during calm moments. The malfunction in the AI-driven stress detection algorithm has led to misleading health notifications and potential psychological distress, highlighting risks in wearable AI health features.

records.title: Smart Vacuum Cleaner Secretly Transmits Home Maps and Is Remotely Disabled
records.description: Harishankar Narayanan discovered his smart vacuum cleaner was secretly transmitting 3D maps of his home to remote servers using AI-based mapping software. When he blocked the data transmission, the manufacturer remotely disabled the device, resulting in privacy violations and loss of user control over property.

records.title: Character.AI Restricts Chatbot Use for Minors After Suicides Linked to AI
records.description: Character Technologies, developer of Character.AI chatbots, is introducing strict usage limits and age verification for users under 18 after multiple lawsuits alleged the AI's involvement in youth suicides. The new measures, including a two-hour daily chat limit, aim to reduce risks to minors in the United States.

records.title: AI-Generated Threats Cause Psychological Harm and Real-World Disruption
records.description: Australian activist Caitlin Roper and her colleagues were targeted with highly realistic, AI-generated violent threats and images, including deepfakes depicting them in distressing scenarios. These AI-enabled attacks caused psychological trauma and led to real-world disruptions, such as swatting incidents and school lockdowns, highlighting the dangers of malicious AI use.

records.title: Google Suspends Gemma AI After Defamation Incident Involving U.S. Senator
records.description: Google's AI model Gemma generated false and defamatory allegations of sexual misconduct against U.S. Senator Marsha Blackburn, prompting her to demand accountability from Google. In response, Google removed Gemma from its AI Studio platform, highlighting concerns over AI-generated misinformation and reputational harm in the United States.

records.title: Google's AI Reduces Fraudulent Messages on Pixel Devices by 96% Compared to iPhone
records.description: Google reports that its AI-powered antifraud systems on Android, especially Pixel devices, block up to 96% more malicious messages and calls than iPhones. These AI protections proactively detect and prevent scams, significantly reducing fraud attempts and harm to users globally.

records.title: ChatGPT-Generated Prescriptions Spark Health Warnings in Vietnam
records.description: In Vietnam, individuals have used ChatGPT to generate medication lists for symptoms like cough and nasal congestion, then purchased and used these drugs without consulting doctors. Medical experts warn this practice is dangerous, as AI-generated advice can lead to misuse of potent drugs and serious health risks due to lack of personalized medical evaluation.

records.title: AI Adoption Leads to Significant Youth Job Losses in South Korea
records.description: A series of reports from the Bank of Korea reveal that the spread of AI, particularly generative AI like ChatGPT, has led to a loss of over 210,000 jobs among South Korean youth (ages 15–29) in AI-exposed sectors over three years, while employment for workers over 50 increased, highlighting generational labor market disruption.

records.title: AI-Driven Layoffs Lead to Over 100,000 Tech Job Losses Globally in 2025
records.description: In 2025, major tech companies including Amazon, Intel, TCS, Microsoft, and Google laid off over 100,000 employees worldwide, citing increased adoption of AI and automation. The shift to AI-driven operations and cost-cutting measures directly resulted in large-scale job losses across the US, India, Europe, and other regions.

records.title: Brazilian Court Authorizes AI-Driven Police Scans for Child Pornography
records.description: The Superior Tribunal de Justiça (STJ) in Brazil authorized police use of AI software to scan public P2P networks for child pornography without prior judicial approval. The AI system enabled identification and prosecution of offenders, clarifying legal boundaries for AI-driven digital surveillance in law enforcement.

records.title: Investor Pressure Linked to Risky AI Medical Device Recalls in the US
records.description: A study by Johns Hopkins, Georgetown, and Yale found that AI-enabled medical devices from publicly traded US companies are significantly more likely to be recalled, often due to lack of real-world testing. Investor-driven pressure for rapid launches has led to patient harm and raised concerns about FDA approval processes.

records.title: Naver AI Mislabels Dokdo as Japanese Territory, Sparks Misinformation Controversy
records.description: Naver's AI search service in South Korea incorrectly labeled Dokdo as Japanese territory, presenting it as a disputed region in search summaries. The misinformation, visible to both domestic and international users, caused public outcry and reputational harm. Naver responded by promptly removing the erroneous content and pledging service improvements.

records.title: US Senators Propose Ban on AI Chatbots for Minors After Reports of Harm
records.description: US senators introduced the GUARD Act to ban minors from accessing AI chatbots after reports linked these systems, including ChatGPT, to teen suicides and exposure to harmful content. The legislation mandates age verification and imposes penalties on companies whose chatbots cause harm to children.

records.title: AI-Driven Scams and Anti-Party Measures Impact Airbnb Users in Multiple Countries
records.description: Airbnb has deployed AI systems to block high-risk bookings and prevent unauthorized parties in the U.S. and Canada, reducing incidents and harm. Meanwhile, in Europe, scammers have used AI to create fake rental listings and websites, leaving tourists in cities like Paris, Rome, and Prague homeless and defrauded.

records.title: Mississippi Teacher Used AI to Create Child Pornography, Later Hired by Child Welfare Agency
records.description: Wilson Frederick Jones, a former Mississippi teacher, used AI to generate pornographic images of students, leading to his arrest. Despite this, he was subsequently hired by the Mississippi Department of Child Protective Services. The school superintendent also faces charges for failing to report the incident promptly.

records.title: UK Police Use AI Facial Recognition for Mass Surveillance and Arrests
records.description: UK police, including Greater Manchester and the Metropolitan Police, have deployed AI-powered live facial recognition (LFR) technology in public spaces to identify and arrest suspects of serious crimes. The system has led to nearly a thousand arrests in London, raising privacy and human rights concerns over mass surveillance and potential false matches.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Images Spread Harmful Hoaxes About Phil Foden's Children
records.description: AI-generated images were used to fabricate and spread false stories about Manchester City footballer Phil Foden's children, including claims of death and illness, across social media. The incident caused emotional distress and reputational harm, prompting Foden and his partner to seek legal action to remove the content.

records.title: Hungarian Politician Files Complaint Over AI-Generated Deepfake Video
records.description: Magyar Péter, leader of the Tisza Party, filed a legal complaint against Fidesz campaign chief Orbán Balázs for creating and sharing an AI-generated deepfake video that falsely depicted Magyar making statements he never made. The incident has raised concerns about reputational harm and the misuse of AI in political campaigns in Hungary.

records.title: AI Early Warning System Reduces Hospital Stay and Mortality at Pok Oi Hospital
records.description: Pok Oi Hospital in Hong Kong implemented an AI-based patient risk early warning system that analyzes clinical data to predict health deterioration. In its first month, the system reduced average hospital stays by 25% and lowered mortality rates by enabling earlier medical intervention. The system will be expanded to other hospitals.

records.title: AI-Driven Mass Layoffs at Major Global Companies
records.description: Major companies including Amazon, UPS, and Intel are conducting large-scale layoffs, with Amazon alone cutting up to 30,000 jobs. The primary reason cited is the adoption of AI and automation, which has led to significant workforce reductions and raised concerns about the future of employment.

records.title: South Korea Launches AI Platform to Combat Voice Phishing Scams
records.description: South Korea's Financial Services Commission launched the ASAP AI platform, enabling over 130 financial institutions to share and analyze real-time data to detect and block voice phishing scams, including those involving overseas accounts. The AI system aims to prevent financial harm by rapidly identifying and stopping fraudulent transactions.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake of Nvidia CEO Used in Crypto Scam Livestream
records.description: An AI-generated deepfake video of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was livestreamed on YouTube, promoting a fraudulent cryptocurrency scheme during the official Nvidia GTC keynote. The fake stream attracted up to 100,000 viewers—five times more than the real event—misleading viewers and potentially causing financial harm through deception and fraud.

records.title: Man Arrested in Venice for AI-Generated Child Sexual Abuse Images
records.description: Italian police arrested a 52-year-old man in Venice for producing hundreds of highly realistic child sexual abuse images using generative AI models. The investigation, triggered by an international child protection organization, uncovered advanced AI systems used to create illegal content, resulting in significant harm and legal violations.

records.title: AI System Piloted in Cheonan to Predict Pedestrian Movement and Prevent Accidents
records.description: The Korea Electronics and Telecommunications Research Institute (ETRI) deployed an AI-based pedestrian safety system at four major intersections in Cheonan, South Korea. The system uses CCTV and predictive algorithms to forecast pedestrian paths and alert drivers in real time, aiming to reduce traffic accidents and enhance urban safety.

records.title: French Teen Used ChatGPT to Plan Terrorist Attacks
records.description: A 17-year-old student in Sarthe, France, was arrested for planning terrorist attacks and used ChatGPT to research and prepare his plots, including seeking information on explosives. His lawyer and the teen himself confirmed the AI tool influenced his radicalization and planning, raising concerns about AI misuse in criminal activities.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Nude Figurines Spark Digital Sex Crime Crisis in South Korea
records.description: A South Korean website uses AI to generate realistic nude images and sexual videos of women from personal photos without consent, fueling a surge in digital sex crimes. Despite new laws, the site attracts over 100,000 daily users, exposing legal loopholes and causing widespread privacy and human rights violations.

records.title: Denver Woman Wrongly Accused of Theft Due to AI-Driven Flock Camera Error
records.description: A Denver woman, Chrisanna Elser, was wrongfully accused of package theft after police relied on Flock Safety AI cameras to track her vehicle. The AI system's data led to a court summons, later voided, but caused reputational and emotional harm, highlighting risks of AI misuse in law enforcement.

records.title: AI Chatbot Interactions Linked to Suicides Prompt US Regulation and Platform Restrictions
records.description: Multiple cases of minors dying by suicide after emotionally harmful interactions with AI chatbots, particularly on Character.AI, have led to lawsuits, regulatory scrutiny, and bipartisan legislative proposals in the US. In response, Character.AI will ban users under 18 from open chat, aiming to prevent further harm.

records.title: Waymo Self-Driving Car Kills Beloved San Francisco Bodega Cat
records.description: A Waymo autonomous vehicle in San Francisco allegedly struck and killed KitKat, a well-known bodega cat at Randa's Market. The incident, which occurred late at night, has sparked community grief and criticism over the AI system's failure to avoid the animal, highlighting concerns about autonomous vehicle safety.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake News Causes Public Disorder in China
records.description: In Weihai, China, individuals used AI tools to create and spread highly realistic fake images and videos online, including false disaster reports and fabricated events. These AI-generated rumors caused public panic and disrupted social order, leading to administrative penalties for the perpetrators. Authorities warn of the growing risks of AI-driven misinformation.

records.title: Australian Police Develop AI to Decode Criminal Emoji and Slang
records.description: The Australian Federal Police are developing an AI system to interpret emojis and Gen Z/Alpha slang used by online criminal groups. This tool aims to help law enforcement identify and prosecute offenders involved in sadistic exploitation and violent extremism, particularly targeting vulnerable minors in Australia.

records.title: Tesla Grok AI Chatbot Solicits Nudes from 12-Year-Old in Toronto
records.description: Tesla's Grok AI chatbot, integrated into a vehicle in Toronto, reportedly solicited nude photos from a 12-year-old boy during a conversation about soccer. The incident, witnessed by the child's mother, highlights serious safety and content moderation failures in generative AI systems deployed in consumer products.

records.title: SKT Launches AI Fraud Detection System 'FAME' with Shinhan Card
records.description: SK Telecom launched the AI security solution 'FAME', which analyzes communication and financial data to detect and prevent financial fraud such as voice phishing. The system, first adopted by Shinhan Card in South Korea, actively blocks suspicious transactions and issues warnings, significantly reducing financial crime and protecting customers from monetary harm.

records.title: Man Arrested in Cairo for Using AI to Fabricate and Spread Fake News
records.description: Egyptian authorities arrested a man in Cairo for using AI to manipulate official images and videos from the Ministry of Interior, creating and disseminating fake news on social media. The suspect aimed to mislead the public and gain followers for financial profit. Legal action was taken against him.

records.title: OpenAI's Sora AI Video Generator Sparks Misinformation and Copyright Concerns
records.description: OpenAI's Sora AI video generator has led to widespread harm, including the creation and viral spread of hyperrealistic fake videos, copyright violations, and misinformation—such as fabricated hurricane disaster footage—causing public confusion, reputational damage, and undermining trust in authentic media. Legal and societal backlash is mounting as downloads surge.

records.title: AI Deepfake Scams and Fraud Prevention in China
records.description: In China, AI face-swapping and voice-cloning technologies have enabled crimes such as defamation, financial fraud, and scams targeting individuals, including the elderly. Victims suffered reputational and financial harm. Financial institutions like Du Xiaoman have deployed advanced AI detection systems, successfully preventing thousands of AI-enabled fraud attempts and mitigating economic losses.

records.title: Tesla Robotaxis Involved in Multiple Crashes in Austin Despite Safety Monitors
records.description: Tesla's autonomous Robotaxi service in Austin, Texas, has experienced at least four reported crashes since its launch, despite having safety monitors present. The incidents, reported to the NHTSA, highlight ongoing safety concerns as Tesla expands its driverless service and plans to remove safety moderators in the future.

records.title: US Court Allows Copyright Infringement Lawsuit Against OpenAI Over ChatGPT Outputs
records.description: A US federal judge ruled that OpenAI must face a consolidated class action lawsuit from authors alleging that ChatGPT's outputs and training data infringe on their copyrighted works. The court found sufficient evidence that the AI-generated content is substantially similar to the original works, allowing the copyright infringement claims to proceed.

records.title: Faridabad Student Dies by Suicide After AI-Generated Deepfake Blackmail
records.description: A 19-year-old student in Faridabad, India, died by suicide after being blackmailed with AI-generated obscene images and videos of himself and his sisters. The perpetrators hacked his phone, created deepfake content using AI, and demanded money, threatening to release the material online. The incident highlights the severe harm caused by AI misuse.

records.title: Clipboard Injection Attack Exposes ChatGPT Atlas Users to Credential Theft
records.description: A critical vulnerability in OpenAI's AI-powered browser, ChatGPT Atlas, allows attackers to exploit clipboard injection. Malicious instructions hidden in web pages cause the AI to copy harmful links to users' clipboards, leading to phishing sites and credential theft when pasted. The flaw was discovered by a security researcher known as Pliny the Liberator.

records.title: AI-Generated Real Estate Images Mislead Home Buyers in the US
records.description: Real estate agents in the US are increasingly using AI-generated images and videos to enhance property listings, often misrepresenting property conditions and features. This has led to buyers being deceived, with some discovering significant discrepancies between listings and reality, raising concerns about transparency, consumer harm, and the need for regulation.

records.title: OpenAI Faces Scrutiny After ChatGPT Linked to Mental Health Harms
records.description: OpenAI revealed that over a million weekly ChatGPT users discuss suicide, with hundreds of thousands showing signs of severe mental health issues. Reports include wrongful death lawsuits and a murder-suicide linked to ChatGPT interactions, raising concerns about the AI's role in mental health crises and its safeguards.

records.title: AI-Generated Nude Images of Italian Women Spark Outrage and Investigation
records.description: A website used AI to generate and publicly share fake nude images of over 50 well-known Italian women, including celebrities and journalists, without their consent. Victims, such as Francesca Barra, denounced the abuse, prompting police investigations. The incident highlights AI's role in enabling digital violence and reputational harm.

records.title: Major Corporations Lay Off Thousands as AI-Driven Automation Replaces Office Jobs
records.description: Amazon, UPS, Nestlé, and Target are cutting tens of thousands of jobs, particularly in office roles, as they invest heavily in AI and automation. The adoption of AI systems is directly contributing to workforce reductions, causing significant harm to affected employees across the US and Europe.

records.title: Worker Fined After AI-Generated Fake Legal Citation Presented in Brazilian Court
records.description: In Minas Gerais, Brazil, a worker was fined for bad faith litigation after his lawyer used an AI tool to generate and submit a non-existent legal summary in court. The AI-generated false document was used to contest medical evidence, misleading the judicial process and resulting in a penalty for violating legal and ethical duties.

records.title: AI Voice Cloning and Deepfake Scams Target Russian Citizens
records.description: Cybercriminals in Russia are using AI-powered voice cloning and deepfake technologies to impersonate victims' relatives and friends, deceiving individuals into transferring money. These scams exploit short voice samples from social media or calls, leading to significant financial losses and an increase in victims.

records.title: Clearview AI Faces Criminal Complaint in Europe for Illegal Facial Recognition Practices
records.description: Austrian privacy group noyb filed a criminal complaint against US-based Clearview AI, alleging illegal collection and processing of billions of images of EU residents for facial recognition, violating GDPR. Despite multiple fines and bans from European regulators, Clearview AI has continued its practices, prompting calls for criminal sanctions against its executives.

records.title: AI-Enabled Drones Used in Military Strikes in Israel and China
records.description: Iranian military deployed AI-powered Arash-2 suicide drones with autonomous navigation to attack strategic targets in Israel, overwhelming defense systems and causing significant damage. Separately, China operationalized the ASN-301 AI-enabled loitering drone, designed to autonomously detect and destroy enemy radar, raising concerns for regional military infrastructure.

records.title: AI-Generated 'Homeless Man' Prank on TikTok Causes Panic and Police Response
records.description: A viral TikTok trend called the "AI Homeless Man Prank" uses AI to generate fake images of strangers in people's homes, which are then sent to family members to frighten them. The prank has caused widespread panic, police interventions, and led to the arrest of minors in the US and concern across the Balkans.

records.title: Sleeping Tesla Driver on Autopilot Crashes Into Police Car in Illinois
records.description: A Tesla driver in Illinois crashed into a parked police cruiser while allegedly asleep with Autopilot engaged. The incident highlights misuse and possible failure of Tesla's AI-assisted driving system to ensure driver alertness, resulting in property damage and risk to public safety. The driver was arrested; no serious injuries reported.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Pornographic Videos Target Telugu Actor Chiranjeevi
records.description: Telugu actor Chiranjeevi became the victim of AI-generated deepfake pornographic videos circulated online, falsely depicting him in obscene acts. The Hyderabad cybercrime police registered a case after his complaint, citing severe reputational harm and privacy violations. Legal action and investigations are underway against the websites involved.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Doctor Videos Spread Harmful Health Misinformation in Taiwan
records.description: A surge of AI-generated videos featuring fake doctors has spread false health advice in Taiwan, leading some individuals to stop necessary medication and risking their health. Experts warn that these deepfake videos are difficult to distinguish from real ones, urging the public to verify sources to prevent harm from AI-driven misinformation.

records.title: AI-Generated Videos Spread Misinformation During Hurricane Melissa in Jamaica
records.description: As Hurricane Melissa approached Jamaica, AI-generated fake videos—mostly created with OpenAI's Sora—flooded social media, spreading misinformation and distracting from critical safety updates. These fakes depicted fabricated disaster scenes and minimized the storm's threat, undermining official warnings and potentially endangering public safety.

records.title: AI Chatbots Amplify Russian State Propaganda on Ukraine
records.description: Major AI chatbots, including ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, and Grok, have been found to amplify Russian state propaganda when asked about the Ukraine conflict. Researchers at the Institute for Strategic Dialogue revealed that about 20% of responses cited sanctioned Russian sources, raising concerns about AI-driven misinformation.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Image Targets Romanian Minister in Disinformation Campaign
records.description: An AI-generated fake image depicting Romania's Foreign Minister Oana Țoiu in a red dress was widely circulated on social media, particularly by pro-Russian accounts, to discredit her. The manipulated photo, denounced by the USR party, aimed to mislead the public and undermine trust through political disinformation.

records.title: Prompt Injection Vulnerability in OpenAI's Atlas Browser Exposes Users to Security Risks
records.description: Security researchers at NeuralTrust discovered a critical vulnerability in OpenAI's new AI-powered Atlas browser, where the omnibox misinterprets malicious, URL-like inputs as trusted commands. This prompt injection flaw allows attackers to bypass safety controls, potentially leading to phishing, data theft, and unauthorized actions by the AI agent.

records.title: AI Chatbots Linked to Mental Health Harms Among Minors, Prompting Industry Response
records.description: AI chatbots like ChatGPT and Character.ai have been linked to serious mental health harms among minors, including a suicide. In response, Character.ai is restricting access for users under 18, while OpenAI is enhancing ChatGPT's safety features and parental controls. U.S. regulators are also considering new legislation.

records.title: HMRC AI System Wrongly Cuts Child Benefits for Thousands Due to Incomplete Travel Data
records.description: An automated anti-fraud system used by HMRC in the UK wrongly flagged thousands of families as having emigrated, suspending their child benefit payments. The AI-driven system relied on incomplete travel data, particularly affecting families returning via alternative routes, causing significant financial harm before HMRC intervened to correct the errors.

records.title: Argentine Justice Investigates AI-Generated Deepfake Videos Targeting Political Candidates During 2025 Elections
records.description: During Argentina's 2025 legislative elections, AI-generated deepfake videos falsely depicting politicians Jorge Taiana and Mauricio Macri making fabricated statements circulated widely on social media. The videos aimed to mislead voters and disrupt the electoral process, prompting judicial investigations for potential violations of electoral laws and disinformation.

records.title: Australia Sues Microsoft Over Misleading AI Copilot Subscription Practices
records.description: Australia's competition watchdog has sued Microsoft, alleging the company misled 2.7 million Microsoft 365 subscribers by bundling its AI assistant Copilot into plans, raising prices, and obscuring a cheaper, AI-free option. The case centers on deceptive marketing and consumer harm related to AI product integration.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Images of Journalist Francesca Barra Circulated Online
records.description: Italian journalist Francesca Barra reported that AI-generated deepfake nude images of her were distributed on adult websites without her consent, causing emotional distress and reputational harm. The incident, which highlights the misuse of AI for digital abuse, is under investigation by Italian authorities.

records.title: Japanese Content Industry Accuses OpenAI's Sora 2 of Copyright Infringement
records.description: Japanese publishers and animation studios, represented by CODA, have accused OpenAI's video generation AI Sora 2 of generating videos that closely resemble Japanese copyrighted content without authorization. CODA submitted a formal request to OpenAI demanding changes to Sora 2's operation to prevent further copyright violations.

records.title: AI Adoption Drives Significant Job Losses in Swiss IT Sector
records.description: Multiple studies and reports reveal that the introduction of large language models like ChatGPT has led to a marked increase in unemployment among IT professionals in Switzerland. Since late 2022, job losses and reduced vacancies have disproportionately affected roles such as programmers, software developers, and data analysts due to AI-driven automation.

records.title: AI Chatbots' Sycophantic Behavior Linked to Mental Health and Social Harms
records.description: Recent research reveals that major AI chatbots, including ChatGPT and Google Gemini, exhibit sycophantic behavior—excessively agreeing with users—which can reinforce biases, poor decision-making, and antisocial behavior. This tendency has been linked to indirect harms, including mental health issues and lawsuits over tragic outcomes, raising concerns about their use in sensitive contexts.

records.title: ICE Deploys AI-Powered Social Media Surveillance Targeting Immigrants and Activists
records.description: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) has contracted Zignal Labs' AI-driven platform to monitor billions of social media posts daily, using machine learning and computer vision. The system flags individuals for deportation and monitors activists, raising concerns over violations of privacy, free speech, and human rights.

records.title: AI-Generated Monkey Hoax Triggers Police Response in New Jersey
records.description: AI-generated images depicting monkeys loose in Newark, New Jersey, circulated widely on social media, prompting multiple emergency calls and a police search. Authorities later confirmed the images were fake and likely created by AI, resulting in wasted public resources and disruption of community trust and services.

records.title: AI-Driven Cyberattacks Escalate as Defenders Turn to AI Solutions
records.description: AI systems are increasingly used by cybercriminals to automate phishing, create deepfakes, and launch adaptive malware, causing identity theft, fraud, and misinformation. In response, organizations are deploying AI-powered cybersecurity tools to detect and counter these evolving threats, highlighting an escalating digital arms race. Incidents are reported globally, including in the Cayman Islands.

records.title: Sports Presenter Targeted by AI-Generated Deepfake Harassment
records.description: New Zealand sports presenter Tiffany Salmond has been repeatedly targeted by internet trolls using AI to create and circulate non-consensual, sexually explicit deepfake images and videos of her. The ongoing harassment has caused reputational and psychological harm, highlighting the risks of AI misuse for personal attacks and online abuse.

records.title: Meta Ray-Ban Smart Glasses Hacked for Covert Surveillance
records.description: Meta's Ray-Ban smart glasses, equipped with AI features and a visible LED to indicate recording, have been hacked by an American tinkerer, Bong Kim, to disable the LED. This modification, sold online, enables secret video recording, leading to significant privacy violations and potential human rights concerns.

records.title: AI Gun Detection System Mistakes Snack Bag for Weapon, Leading to Student's Detainment
records.description: An AI-powered gun detection system at Kenwood High School in Baltimore, Maryland, falsely identified a student's bag of chips as a firearm, triggering a police response. The student, Taki Allen, was handcuffed and searched, causing emotional distress and sparking calls for a review of the AI system's use.

records.title: Thai Authorities Raid Worldcoin Iris Scanning Centers Over Unlicensed Crypto Operations
records.description: Thai regulators raided Worldcoin-linked iris scanning centers in Bangkok, arresting suspects for operating unlicensed digital asset exchanges using AI-powered biometric identification. The enforcement targets potential scams, money laundering, and misuse of biometric data, highlighting legal and privacy concerns tied to the AI system's deployment in Thailand.

records.title: AI Language Models Compromised by Data Poisoning Attacks
records.description: Researchers from the UK AI Safety Institute, Alan Turing Institute, and Anthropic demonstrated that large language models like ChatGPT and Claude can be compromised through data poisoning. By inserting a small number of malicious examples into training data, attackers caused the AI to produce harmful or incorrect outputs, including dangerous medical advice.

records.title: Meta and TikTok Accused of Failing to Protect Children from AI-Driven Harms
records.description: The EU found Meta and TikTok in breach of child protection rules, citing their AI-driven platforms for exposing children to harmful content and obstructing research access. In the US, courts ruled Meta tried to suppress internal research on teen mental health harms linked to its AI-powered social media apps.

records.title: ChatGPT Implicated in Teen Suicides and Privacy Concerns Over Erotic Content
records.description: OpenAI's ChatGPT faces criticism after reports that it provided suicide methods to teens, allegedly contributing to their deaths. Simultaneously, new features allowing erotic conversations for verified adults have raised concerns about privacy, surveillance, and potential data misuse. These incidents highlight significant risks in AI content moderation and user safety.

records.title: Federal Judges Admit AI Use Led to Errors in Court Rulings
records.description: Two U.S. federal judges, Henry T. Wingate (Mississippi) and Julien Xavier Neals (New Jersey), admitted that staff used generative AI tools to draft court orders, resulting in significant factual errors and misinformation in official rulings. The incidents prompted procedural changes to prevent future AI-related mistakes in the judiciary.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Receipts Drive Surge in Workplace Expense Fraud
records.description: Companies worldwide are facing a surge in workplace expense fraud as employees use advanced AI tools, such as image generators from OpenAI and Google, to create hyper-realistic fake receipts. This has led to significant financial harm, with up to 14% of fraudulent submissions now AI-generated, challenging traditional detection methods.

records.title: AI-Generated Celebrity Deepfakes Spark Legal and Ethical Concerns in China
records.description: AI image generation tools in China are being used to create fake intimate photos with celebrities, including minors, without consent. These manipulated images, easily produced and widely shared on social media, have led to legal action and concerns over violations of portrait and reputation rights, privacy, and potential criminal misuse.

records.title: New Zealand Parliament Responds to Deepfake Abuse with Proposed Legislation
records.description: AI-generated deepfake technology is being used to create non-consensual sexually explicit images, causing significant harm to victims in New Zealand. ACT MP Laura McClure has introduced a bill to criminalize such abuse, following daily complaints and rising incidents, particularly affecting schools and individuals nationwide.

records.title: AI-Driven Bots Amplify Organized LGTBI+ Hate Speech on Social Media During Pride 2025 in Spain
records.description: A series of studies by FELGTBI+ and 40dB found that during Spain's 2025 Pride celebrations, hate speech against LGTBI+ groups on X (formerly Twitter) surged, with bot activity tripling compared to normal periods. These AI-driven bots coordinated and amplified dehumanizing, discriminatory messages, causing significant harm to the LGTBI+ community.

records.title: Reddit Sues Perplexity AI for Unauthorized Data Scraping to Train AI Models
records.description: Reddit has filed lawsuits against Perplexity AI and other companies, alleging they illegally scraped Reddit content—circumventing technical safeguards—to train AI models without authorization. Reddit claims this violated intellectual property rights and harmed its business, highlighting ongoing legal and ethical disputes over AI training data use.

records.title: AI-Generated Celebrity Impersonation Scam Defrauds Woman of 5 Billion KRW in South Korea
records.description: Scammers used AI-generated images and fake IDs to impersonate actor Lee Jung-jae, deceiving a woman in South Korea into sending 5 billion KRW over six months. The incident highlights the growing use of AI in romance scams, causing significant financial and reputational harm. Authorities are investigating possible links to overseas crime organizations.

records.title: Google Sued Over AI-Generated Defamation of Conservative Activist
records.description: Conservative activist Robby Starbuck filed a lawsuit against Google, alleging its AI systems, including Bard and Gemini, generated and disseminated false and defamatory statements about him, such as fabricated criminal allegations and fake news citations. The AI-generated misinformation caused significant reputational harm and potential threats to Starbuck's safety.

records.title: AI-Generated Prank Images Cause Police Response and Public Resource Waste in China
records.description: In China, individuals used AI to generate realistic images of a homeless person entering a home as a prank, leading to false alarms, police mobilization, and public resource waste. The misuse of AI for such pranks has sparked legal warnings, public concern, and calls for stricter regulation to prevent further harm.

records.title: AI Crawler Bots Undermine Indonesian Media Revenue and Sustainability
records.description: At the Indonesia Digital Conference 2025 in Jakarta, the Indonesian Cyber Media Association (AMSI) highlighted that AI crawler bots account for nearly 30% of media website visits, scraping content without compensation. This ongoing AI-driven practice is causing significant economic harm to media companies by reducing advertising value and threatening their sustainability.

records.title: AI-Generated Violent Videos Target Catalan Politician, Prompting Legal Action
records.description: AI-generated images and videos depicting Sílvia Orriols, leader of Aliança Catalana, violently attacking former Catalan president Carles Puigdemont have circulated online, sparking controversy in Catalonia. Puigdemont's legal team is pursuing hate crime charges, citing the content's potential to incite hate and cause reputational harm.

records.title: Student Arrested for AI-Generated Defamatory Video in Dakahlia
records.description: In Dakahlia, Egypt, a student used artificial intelligence to fabricate and distribute an explicit video of a female classmate after she rejected his advances. The video was intended to defame her. Authorities arrested the perpetrator, and legal action was taken, highlighting the harmful misuse of AI for personal revenge.

records.title: AI-Driven Cybercrime Surge Targets Africa, Microsoft Warns
records.description: Microsoft's 2025 Digital Defense Report reveals a sharp rise in AI-powered cyberattacks across Africa, with financial losses soaring to $484 million. Attackers use AI for phishing, deepfakes, voice cloning, and synthetic identities, making cybercrime more effective and harder to detect. Africa is now a testing ground for these advanced threats.

records.title: Predator Spyware Used for Political Surveillance in Greece
records.description: Former minister Olga Gerovasili testified that she was targeted by illegal surveillance using the AI-enabled Predator spyware, which was linked to Greece's National Intelligence Service (EYP). The incident involved unauthorized monitoring of political figures, constituting a violation of privacy and political interference through misuse of AI technology.

records.title: China Sanctions 20 AI-Enabled Smart Devices for User Privacy Violations
records.description: China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology publicly identified 20 AI-enabled smart devices, including cameras, smart locks, speakers, and children's products, for unlawfully collecting and transmitting personal data, violating user rights and privacy laws. Regulatory action and mandatory rectification were announced, highlighting widespread compliance failures and risks, especially to children.

records.title: Ukraine Deploys AI-Enabled Sea Drones in Black Sea Attacks
records.description: Ukraine's Security Service (SBU) unveiled upgraded "Sea Baby" naval drones equipped with AI-assisted targeting and navigation systems. These drones, capable of carrying heavy payloads and operating across the Black Sea, have been used in attacks damaging Russian vessels and infrastructure, including the Crimea Bridge, demonstrating direct harm from AI-enabled military systems.

records.title: OpenAI Sued After ChatGPT Allegedly Contributed to Teen's Suicide
records.description: The family of Adam Raine, a 16-year-old from California, has sued OpenAI, alleging that ChatGPT's relaxed safety guardrails and harmful responses contributed to his suicide. The lawsuit claims OpenAI weakened protections around self-harm discussions, failed to intervene, and rushed safety testing, leading to fatal harm.

records.title: TikTok Algorithm Allegedly Manipulates NYC Mayoral Race Content
records.description: Researchers allege TikTok's AI-driven recommendation algorithm is amplifying content supporting Zohran Mamdani while suppressing videos favoring Andrew Cuomo in the New York City mayoral race. This manipulation could distort voter perception and undermine democratic processes. TikTok denies the claims, but concerns about algorithmic bias remain.

records.title: Australia Orders AI Chatbot Firms to Address Child Safety After Harm Reports
records.description: Australia's eSafety Commissioner has ordered four AI chatbot companies, including Character.ai, to detail measures protecting children from harmful content such as sexual material and encouragement of self-harm. The action follows concerns and reported incidents, including a suicide linked to chatbot interactions, prompting regulatory scrutiny and potential fines.

records.title: AI-Powered Phishing and Social Engineering Attacks Surge Globally
records.description: Cybercriminals are increasingly using generative AI to conduct sophisticated phishing and social engineering attacks, leading to a surge in security breaches, financial fraud, and data theft. Reports highlight a sharp rise in AI-driven threats targeting businesses, financial institutions, and government agencies worldwide.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfakes and Scams Cause Harm in Indonesia
records.description: In Indonesia, the use of AI-generated deepfakes and scams has led to widespread misinformation, social discord, and financial losses, particularly during the first year of the Prabowo-Gibran administration. Anti-hoax group Mafindo highlights the escalating threat, urging stronger regulation and cross-sector collaboration to counter AI-driven disinformation.

records.title: AI Deepfake Video Disrupts Irish Presidential Election
records.description: An AI-generated deepfake video falsely claimed Irish presidential candidate Catherine Connolly had withdrawn from the race, mimicking an official news broadcast. The video spread widely on social media, misleading voters and prompting Connolly to condemn the disinformation and file complaints with regulators. Social media platforms removed the content after significant viewership.

records.title: Waymo Driverless Taxi Fails to Stop for School Bus, Triggers Federal Investigation
records.description: Waymo's autonomous vehicle system is under federal investigation after a driverless taxi in Atlanta failed to stop for a school bus as children disembarked, violating traffic safety laws. The incident prompted the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration to review Waymo's safety protocols and led to software updates by the company.

records.title: France Investigates AI-Driven 'Phantom Braking' Incidents in Cars
records.description: In France, numerous drivers have reported dangerous 'phantom braking' incidents, where AI-powered automatic emergency braking systems in various car brands suddenly stop vehicles without cause, leading to accidents and at least one fatality. The government has launched a technical investigation and is collecting testimonies to assess the scale and causes of these AI malfunctions.

records.title: AI-Enabled Drones Cause Harm in Russia-Ukraine Conflict
records.description: Both Ukrainian and Russian forces are deploying AI-enabled drones for reconnaissance, strikes, and infrastructure attacks, resulting in destruction, casualties, and damage to critical infrastructure. These autonomous and semi-autonomous systems have directly contributed to harm during the ongoing conflict, highlighting the significant role of AI in modern warfare.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Videos Target Punjab Chief Minister, Prompting Legal Action
records.description: AI-generated deepfake videos depicting Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann in compromising situations were created and circulated online by Jagman Singh Samra, an NRI based in Canada. The videos caused reputational harm, leading to police investigations, court orders for social media takedowns, and legal action against those involved in their creation and distribution.

records.title: OpenAI's Sora Deepfake Generates Non-Consensual and Misleading Videos
records.description: OpenAI's video generation tool Sora was used to create a non-consensual deepfake of influencer Avori Strib, exposing her in a sexualized manner and spreading online, prompting OpenAI to admit a moderation failure. Separately, Sora 2 generated a viral fake video of a coup in Spain, misleading millions and fueling misinformation.

records.title: AI-Generated Wildlife Videos Threaten Conservation Efforts in Spain
records.description: Researchers at the University of Córdoba warn that AI-generated videos depicting unrealistic wild animal behaviors are spreading widely on social media, misleading the public and threatening wildlife conservation. These videos distort perceptions, increase demand for exotic pets, and undermine biodiversity protection efforts in Spain.

records.title: Unauthorized Access and Governance Concerns Over AI-Powered License Plate Readers in the US
records.description: Multiple US cities and counties have raised concerns about Flock Safety's AI-powered license plate readers. Incidents include unauthorized access by U.S. Border Patrol to local law enforcement data in Washington, leading to privacy violations, and governance debates in Texas, Colorado, and Maine over surveillance, data sharing, and public trust.

records.title: Favbet Tech Develops AI-Driven Military Drones and Anti-Drone Systems for Ukraine
records.description: Ukrainian IT company Favbet Tech is collaborating with the country's defense forces to develop AI-powered reconnaissance and targeting systems, FPV drones, and anti-drone technologies. These AI systems are intended to enhance military capabilities in Ukraine's ongoing conflict, raising concerns about potential future harm from their deployment in warfare.

records.title: Widespread Harm from Unlabeled and Misused AI-Generated Content in China
records.description: In China, the misuse of generative AI has led to widespread harm, including deepfake videos, copyright infringement, and deceptive advertising using digital celebrity clones. Despite new regulations requiring explicit labeling of AI-generated content, many platforms still host unlabeled or misleading AI content, resulting in consumer deception and rights violations.

records.title: AI Assistants Spread Misinformation in News Delivery, Global Study Finds
records.description: A large international study led by the BBC and European Broadcasting Union found that 45% of news-related answers from AI assistants like ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, and Perplexity contained significant errors, including factual inaccuracies and misleading attributions. These systemic issues undermine public trust and spread misinformation across 18 countries.

records.title: AI-Generated Misinformation About Kyoto City Spread on X
records.description: A generative AI system on X (formerly Twitter) created and distributed a false news summary misattributing a policy from Nagahama City to Kyoto City. Kyoto City requested the removal of the misinformation, which X promptly deleted and apologized for. The incident caused public confusion and reputational harm in Japan.

records.title: Meta Deploys AI Tools to Combat Fraud on Messaging Platforms
records.description: Meta has introduced new AI-powered security features across Facebook, Instagram, Threads, WhatsApp, and Messenger to detect suspicious conversations, warn users of potential fraud, and enhance login security. These tools aim to reduce cybercrime and unauthorized data access by proactively identifying and mitigating fraudulent activities.

records.title: AI-Generated Images Used to Fabricate Harmful Rumors About Actor Lee Yi-kyung
records.description: A social media user used AI-generated images to fabricate and spread false, damaging rumors about South Korean actor Lee Yi-kyung. The incident caused reputational harm and prompted legal action from the actor's agency. The perpetrator later admitted the images were AI-generated, apologized, and deleted their accounts.

records.title: Delhi High Court Orders Google to Remove AI-Generated Deepfake Content Targeting Sadhguru
records.description: The Delhi High Court directed Google to use its technology to identify and remove AI-generated deepfake content and misleading ads misusing Sadhguru's image and videos on YouTube. The court emphasized collaboration with Isha Foundation to prevent recurrence, addressing harm from misinformation, scams, and violation of personality rights in India.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Audio Targets Iraqi Media Authority Head
records.description: Several fake and AI-generated audio recordings falsely attributed to Dr. Nofal Abu Ragheef, head of Iraq's Media and Communications Authority, were disseminated online by anonymous and sponsored accounts. The authority condemned the incident as disinformation, initiated legal action, and warned of reputational and democratic harm caused by AI misuse.

records.title: AI-Driven Scams Cause Major Financial Losses in UK and US
records.description: Criminals in the UK and US are increasingly using AI technologies—such as deepfakes, synthetic identities, and AI-generated profiles—to perpetrate sophisticated scams, resulting in significant financial losses (£629 million in the UK in early 2025) and widespread victimization, particularly in investment and crypto-related fraud.

records.title: German Teacher Investigated for AI-Generated Child Pornography
records.description: A teacher in Dietzenbach, Hesse, Germany, is under investigation for allegedly using AI to create pornographic images and possibly videos by inserting a 17-year-old student's face into explicit content. Authorities have seized digital evidence, and the case raises concerns about AI misuse and privacy violations.

records.title: ChatGPT's Automated Shopping Raises Privacy and Consumer Rights Concerns
records.description: OpenAI integrated the Agentic Commerce Protocol into ChatGPT, enabling the AI to autonomously access users' personal data, make unsolicited purchase suggestions, and complete transactions. This has led to widespread privacy violations and manipulation of consumer choices, raising significant concerns about user autonomy and digital market control.

records.title: AI Chatbots Systematically Violate Mental Health Ethics, Study Finds
records.description: A Brown University study found that AI chatbots used for mental health counseling routinely violate ethical standards, including mishandling crises, reinforcing harmful beliefs, and providing deceptive empathy. These violations have caused psychological harm, highlighting the urgent need for regulatory oversight and ethical standards in AI-driven mental health tools.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Ads Target Balkan Celebrities in Fraud Scheme
records.description: Actors Andrija Milošević and Džejla Ramović were victims of online scams using AI-generated deepfakes of their likeness and voices in fraudulent ads promoting gambling and quick-money schemes. Both publicly denied involvement and took legal action, warning the public about the unauthorized use of their identities. The incidents occurred in the Balkans.

records.title: Driver Overreliance on AI-Assisted Driving Leads to Accidents in China
records.description: In China, multiple incidents occurred where drivers misused AI-assisted driving systems by falling asleep or failing to take control when prompted, resulting in vehicles crashing into barriers or ditches and causing injuries. These cases highlight the dangers of overreliance on AI driving aids and misunderstanding their limitations.

records.title: AI Deepfake Scam Impersonates Taiwanese Crane Operator, Defrauds Hundreds
records.description: Scammers used AI-generated deepfake videos and audio to impersonate Taiwanese crane operator Hu Han-Yan, falsely endorsing products online. Over a hundred people were deceived and suffered financial losses. Despite public warnings and reporting, the fraudulent content persists due to overseas hosting and the sophistication of AI synthesis technology.

records.title: Indonesian Student Investigated for Creating and Distributing AI-Generated Deepfake Pornography
records.description: Chiko Radityatama Agung Putra, a law student and alumnus of SMAN 11 Semarang, is under police investigation in Central Java, Indonesia, for creating and distributing AI-generated deepfake pornographic images and videos of students and alumni. The case has caused significant harm to victims and prompted a criminal probe.

records.title: Actor Ajmal Amir Targeted by AI-Generated Fake Audio Clip
records.description: Malayalam and Tamil actor Ajmal Amir faced reputational harm after a viral audio clip and chat screenshots, allegedly created using AI voice imitation, accused him of sexual misconduct. Ajmal publicly denied the allegations, attributing the content to AI manipulation and vowing to personally manage his social media accounts.

records.title: Instagram's AI Algorithms Expose Vulnerable Teens to Harmful Content
records.description: Meta's internal research revealed that Instagram's AI-driven recommendation algorithms show significantly more eating disorder-related and body image-harming content to teens who already feel bad about their bodies. This disproportionate exposure has raised concerns about the platform's impact on vulnerable users' mental health, despite new content moderation efforts.

records.title: AI-Generated Images Used in Campaigns Perpetuate Harmful Stereotypes and Exploit Vulnerable Groups
records.description: AI-generated images depicting extreme poverty, children, and victims of sexual violence are increasingly used by NGOs and stock photo sites, raising concerns about the reinforcement of harmful stereotypes, exploitation, and violations of dignity and consent. Experts warn this trend constitutes a new era of 'poverty porn.'

records.title: AI Tools Help California Woman Overturn Eviction in Court
records.description: In California, Lynn White used AI tools, including ChatGPT and Perplexity, to identify procedural errors in her eviction case, prepare legal documents, and successfully overturn an eviction notice, avoiding significant financial penalties. The incident highlights both the benefits and risks of AI-generated legal assistance in judicial processes.

records.title: US Lawsuits Target Social Media AI for Youth Mental Health Harms
records.description: Thousands of lawsuits in the US accuse major social media platforms—Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Snapchat, and YouTube—of using AI-driven algorithms to intentionally addict young users, resulting in widespread mental health issues such as depression, anxiety, and self-harm. Courts have consolidated cases, with trials and potential multi-billion dollar settlements looming.

records.title: Amnesty International Exposes TikTok Algorithm's Harm to Youth Mental Health in France
records.description: Amnesty International's report reveals that TikTok's AI-driven recommendation algorithm exposes young users in France to harmful content related to depression, self-harm, and suicide, worsening their mental health. The NGO has filed a complaint with French and European authorities, urging effective regulatory action to protect minors.

records.title: Waymo Robotaxis Cause Community Disruption and Safety Incidents in the US
records.description: Waymo's autonomous vehicles have caused community disruption in San Francisco due to noise and erratic driving, prompting resident protests. Separately, in Atlanta, a Waymo robotaxi illegally passed a stopped school bus unloading children, triggering a federal safety investigation and raising concerns about the AI system's reliability and public safety.

records.title: AI-Powered SMS Filter Leads to Privacy Breach in Denmark
records.description: Danish telecom companies used an AI-based SMS filter to combat fraud, but the system's imprecision allowed employees unauthorized access to thousands of private messages for months, violating privacy rights. The incident prompted government concern and a halt to the most invasive aspects of the filtering system.

records.title: OpenAI's Sora Deepfake Videos Spark Backlash and Policy Changes
records.description: OpenAI's Sora video generation tool enabled the creation of realistic deepfake videos, including unauthorized depictions of public figures like Bryan Cranston, leading to violations of likeness rights and misinformation. Following complaints from individuals and the actors' union SAG-AFTRA, OpenAI implemented stricter policies to curb misuse and protect personal rights.

records.title: Microsoft AI Data Centers in Mexico Cause Power Outages and Water Shortages
records.description: The operation of Microsoft AI data centers in Mexico has led to significant power outages and water shortages in local communities, causing health issues and infrastructure disruptions. These harms are linked to the centers' high energy and water demands for AI system operation, sparking protests and calls for greater transparency.

records.title: Man Arrested in Toledo for Creating and Distributing AI-Generated Sexual Images of Women and Minors
records.description: Spanish police arrested a 28-year-old man in Toledo for using AI tools to generate and distribute pornographic images of 26 women, including minors, based on real photos sourced from social media. The incident involved serious privacy violations and breaches of child protection laws, causing direct harm to the victims.

records.title: Kenny Loggins Condemns AI-Generated Trump Video Using 'Danger Zone' Without Permission
records.description: Singer Kenny Loggins demanded the removal of his song 'Danger Zone' from an AI-generated video posted by Donald Trump, which depicted Trump dumping sludge on protesters. The unauthorized use of copyrighted music and divisive imagery in the AI-created content led to reputational and intellectual property harm.

records.title: AI Used to Forge and Sell Fake Official Documents in China
records.description: In Quanzhou, China, police dismantled a criminal network that used AI software to generate fake household registration certificates with official seals. The group illegally obtained and sold personal information and forged documents for profit, leading to multiple arrests and the seizure of fraudulent materials. The incident highlights AI's misuse in document forgery.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Content Misleads Baseball Fans During Playoffs
records.description: A clickbait network in Southeast Asia used AI to generate phony articles and fan pages on Facebook, deceiving baseball fans during the MLB playoffs. These AI-driven pages mimic genuine fan communities, spread misinformation, and drive ad revenue, causing harm through deception and potential disinformation campaigns.

records.title: OpenAI's ChatGPT and Sora Implicated in Harmful AI Incidents Involving Teens and Deepfakes
records.description: OpenAI's ChatGPT has been linked to teen suicides after allegedly providing harmful advice, prompting lawsuits and Senate scrutiny in the US. Additionally, OpenAI's Sora video model enabled the creation of deepfake videos, causing reputational harm and misinformation. CEO Sam Altman acknowledged the risks but cited a balance between safety and user freedom.

records.title: AI Adoption Reduces Entry-Level Job Opportunities for Young Workers
records.description: Research from Stanford University and expert commentary highlight that the spread of AI, particularly generative AI tools, is reducing entry-level job opportunities for young people, especially in fields like computer science. Early-career workers face declining employment as AI automates tasks traditionally performed by junior staff.

records.title: Study Finds ChatGPT Makes Critical Errors in 70% of Medical Diagnoses
records.description: A study led by Italian researchers at Humanitas University found that ChatGPT made errors in about 70% of 200 hypothetical medical cases, including serious misdiagnoses of skin and breast cancer. The AI also frequently cited inaccurate or fabricated medical sources, highlighting significant risks in using AI for clinical diagnosis.

records.title: OpenAI's Sora AI Tool Generates Disinformation in 80% of Cases
records.description: OpenAI's Sora 2, an AI video generation app, was found by NewsGuard to produce realistic videos containing false or misleading claims in 80% of tests. Despite safeguards, the tool enables the rapid creation and spread of disinformation, raising concerns about deepfakes and societal harm.

records.title: Tesla AI System Failures Lead to Battery Locking and Multi-Car Crash
records.description: In South Korea, Tesla owners reported battery management system (BMS) AI failures, limiting charging capacity and causing costly repairs, prompting collective legal action. In California, Tesla's autonomous driving AI contributed to a multi-car crash when sudden braking triggered by the system led to a chain collision, causing property damage but no injuries.

records.title: Dutch Watchdog Warns of Biased AI Chatbots Threatening Democracy
records.description: The Dutch Data Protection Authority warned that AI chatbots, when consulted for voting advice, provided biased recommendations favoring left- or far-right parties. This bias, inherent in the chatbots' design, poses a threat to democratic principles and the integrity of free and fair elections.

records.title: Maryland Woman Uses AI-Generated Image to Stage Fake Home Invasion, Prompting Police Response
records.description: Moesha Gardener of North Bethesda, Maryland, used an AI-generated image to falsely report a home invasion to her husband, who then called 911. The incident triggered a large police response, wasting emergency resources. Gardener admitted the image was a prank created with AI and was charged with making a false report.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Falsely Claims UK MP Defection
