records.description: A University of Cambridge report reveals that period tracking apps, which use AI to process sensitive health data, are selling users' personal information at scale. This exposes women to privacy violations, discrimination in employment and healthcare, targeted advertising, and potential reproductive control, posing significant safety and human rights risks.

records.title: Meta AI App's Public Feed Exposes Users' Sensitive Data
records.description: Meta's AI app features a public 'Discover' feed that displays user interactions, leading to unintentional sharing of sensitive personal information. Many users are unaware their posts are public, resulting in privacy violations and emotional distress, highlighting design flaws in user consent and data protection.

records.title: China Disables AI Chatbots and Deploys AI Surveillance to Prevent Exam Cheating During Gaokao
records.description: During China's national college entrance exam (Gaokao), major tech firms like Alibaba, Tencent, and ByteDance temporarily disabled AI chatbot features, especially image recognition, to prevent cheating. Simultaneously, authorities used AI-powered surveillance to monitor students for suspicious behavior, raising concerns about privacy and fairness in high-stakes testing.

records.title: Cities Move to Ban AI Rent-Setting Software Amid Price Hikes and Legal Scrutiny
records.description: Several U.S. cities, including Seattle, are moving to ban landlords' use of RealPage, an AI-powered rent-setting software. The system's algorithmic pricing, based on shared non-public data, has been linked to drastic rent increases and alleged collusion, prompting lawsuits and government action over harm to tenants and potential antitrust violations.

records.title: Osaka Expo Autonomous Bus Crash Caused by AI System Communication Error
records.description: An autonomous bus at the Osaka-Kansai Expo collided with a concrete wall due to an AI system communication setting error. The system sent data at a speed the vehicle could not process, preventing the parking brake from activating. No injuries occurred, but the incident caused property damage and prompted a temporary suspension of operations.

records.title: Autonomous 'Luobo Kuaipao' Robotaxi Malfunctions, Causes Traffic Disruption and Passenger Distress in China
records.description: A 'Luobo Kuaipao' autonomous vehicle in Dongguan malfunctioned, stopping in the middle of a busy intersection and blocking three lanes, causing significant traffic disruption. Passengers were unable to exit, faced public scrutiny, and customer support could not resolve the issue, highlighting operational and privacy risks of AI-driven ride-hailing services.

records.title: Russian V2U AI-Powered Strike Drone Deployed in Ukraine
records.description: Ukrainian intelligence reports that Russia is deploying the V2U attack drone, which uses artificial intelligence for autonomous target search and selection, in the Sumy region. The drone relies on computer vision and NVIDIA Jetson Orin chips, enabling lethal autonomous operations and raising concerns about AI-driven harm in active conflict.

records.title: Facial Recognition AI Deployed to Protect Amarnath Yatra Pilgrims from Terror Threats
records.description: Jammu and Kashmir Police have installed AI-powered facial recognition systems along the Pahalgam route of the Amarnath Yatra to prevent terror attacks. The system provides real-time alerts if blacklisted individuals are detected, aiming to enhance security for pilgrims in a region with a history of terrorist incidents.

records.title: AI Wildfire Forecasting Failure Exacerbates Los Angeles Fire Disaster
records.description: Southern California Edison’s AI-driven wildfire forecasting system underestimated the scale of the Eaton Canyon fire by a factor of ten, predicting 1,000 acres would burn when 14,000 acres were lost. This miscalculation contributed to inadequate mitigation, resulting in 17 deaths, destruction of 9,400 buildings, and $250 billion in economic losses.

records.title: Student Faces Trial for AI-Generated Deepfake Pornography of Classmates in Córdoba
records.description: A student at a Córdoba school used AI face-swapping technology to superimpose classmates' faces onto pornographic videos, publishing the content online with links to victims' social media. The incident caused severe psychological harm and harassment to the minors involved, leading to criminal charges and a potential 30-year prison sentence.

records.title: AI-Generated Police Video Used in Major Fraud, Victim Loses NT$89 Million
records.description: Scammers in Taipei used AI-generated video to convincingly simulate a police station during a video call, deceiving a bank VIP into surrendering account details and losing NT$88.91 million. The AI technology was pivotal in making the fraudulent scheme believable, directly leading to significant financial harm.

records.title: AI-Powered Cyberattacks Target 72% of Indian Firms, Exposing Widespread Vulnerabilities
records.description: A Fortinet-IDC survey reveals that 72% of Indian organizations faced AI-powered cyberattacks in the past year. These attacks, including deepfake impersonation, AI-generated phishing, and polymorphic malware, are increasingly sophisticated and hard to detect, while only 14% of firms feel well-prepared to defend against them.

records.title: BFI Report Reveals AI Trained on 130,000 Copyrighted Scripts Without Consent
records.description: A British Film Institute report found that over 130,000 copyrighted film and TV scripts were used without permission to train generative AI models. This unauthorized use threatens the economic foundation of the UK screen sector and violates intellectual property rights, raising major concerns among creators and rights holders.

records.title: AI-Enabled Drones Cause Destruction in Ukraine-Russia Conflict
records.description: Automotive firms like Renault and Ukrainian workshops are producing AI-powered drones for warfare, which have been used to destroy enemy assets and infrastructure in the Ukraine-Russia conflict. These drones, tested and deployed by Ukrainian forces, have caused significant harm, marking a shift in modern combat tactics.

records.title: Moldovan Police Warn of AI-Generated Fake Investment Scheme
records.description: The Moldovan General Police Inspectorate warns citizens about an AI-generated deepfake video, featuring synthetic voice and manipulated images, falsely pitching a state investment program to lure investors. Authorities urge the public not to share the clip, verify sources, and report suspicious content to avoid misinformation and potential financial harm.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfakes on Social Media Cause Misinformation and Fraud Concerns
records.description: AI-generated images and videos, increasingly realistic and widespread on platforms like Facebook, have deceived users, spread misinformation, and raised fears of fraud. Experts warn that advanced tools like Google Veo3 and DALL·E 3 make it difficult to distinguish real from fake, highlighting urgent calls for regulation and content labeling.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Video Impersonates Owaisi to Promote Investment Scam
records.description: A deepfake video using AI technology falsely depicted AIMIM president Asaduddin Owaisi and other public figures promoting a fraudulent investment scheme, promising high returns. The video, circulated on social media, misled the public and put individuals at risk of financial loss. Hyderabad police have registered a case and launched an investigation.

records.title: Klarna CEO Warns AI-Driven Job Losses May Trigger Recession
records.description: Klarna CEO Sebastian Siemiatkowski revealed that AI adoption at the fintech firm has reduced its workforce from 5,500 to 3,000, with AI systems replacing hundreds of customer service roles. He warns that widespread white-collar job displacement by AI could spark a recession, highlighting significant economic and labor harms from AI-driven automation.

records.title: Google Maps AI Navigation Errors Cause Dangerous Incidents in Uttar Pradesh
records.description: Multiple incidents in Uttar Pradesh involved Google Maps' AI navigation directing vehicles onto incomplete flyovers and narrow village lanes, resulting in cars hanging off unfinished bridges and a coal-laden trailer getting stuck, causing significant danger and disruption. No fatalities occurred in these cases, but the AI system's errors directly led to near-harm and property damage.

records.title: AI-Generated 'First Day in Hell' Videos Spark Religious Outrage in Indonesia and Malaysia
records.description: AI-generated videos depicting 'the first day in hell' as humorous content have circulated widely on social media, provoking strong condemnation from Indonesian and Malaysian religious authorities. The videos are considered misleading and offensive to religious beliefs, prompting calls for their removal and legal action against the creators.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Video Falsely Claims Death of Cricketer Shahid Afridi
records.description: An AI-generated deepfake video falsely announcing the death and burial of former Pakistani cricketer Shahid Afridi went viral on social media, causing widespread confusion, distress, and misinformation among fans. The fabricated news broadcast, featuring an AI-dubbed anchor, was debunked, confirming Afridi is alive and well.

records.title: Meta Criticized for Failing to Remove AI-Generated Deepfake Scam Videos of Celebrities
records.description: Meta allowed AI-generated deepfake videos using the likeness of celebrities like Ronaldo to circulate in fraudulent ads for months, despite numerous user reports. The company's automated moderation failed to detect and remove these scams, exposing users to financial harm. Meta's Oversight Board has demanded stricter deepfake moderation policies.

records.title: Students use AI to create fake nude images of primary school classmate
records.description: Students in a Warsaw-area primary school used an AI application to generate a fake nude image of a classmate under 15 and encouraged its distribution on Instagram. The head of Poland’s Data Protection Authority reported the incident to police, citing severe privacy violations and potential criminal charges.

records.title: AI-generated Pope sermons flood YouTube, TikTok
records.description: Since his election, AI has been used to create hundreds of fake sermons and speeches attributed to Pope Leo XIV in English and Spanish. An AFP investigation found dozens of YouTube and TikTok channels streaming these deepfakes, duping viewers, and platforms have removed many but continue struggling to police the misinformation.

records.title: UK Court Warns Lawyers Over Fake AI-Generated Citations
records.description: High Court judges Victoria Sharp and Jeremy Johnson condemned lawyers for submitting fabricated non-existent case citations generated by AI in two English cases, warning that such misuse threatens justice and public trust. Attorneys risk prosecution and severe penalties if they fail to verify AI-generated research accuracy.

records.title: OpenAI Disrupts Covert ChatGPT Propaganda Campaigns
records.description: OpenAI uncovered and dismantled ten covert operations—four linked to Chinese actors—misusing ChatGPT to generate social media posts, comments, translations, phishing emails, marketing materials and internal reviews. These campaigns targeted U.S. politics, online dissent and multiple countries, representing a coordinated misuse of AI for disinformation, surveillance and influence operations.

records.title: OpenAI: Chinese Groups Misuse ChatGPT for Hacking and Disinformation
records.description: OpenAI has revealed that Chinese-affiliated groups are misusing ChatGPT to support covert operations, including OSINT research, exploit development, password-cracking automation, and targeted disinformation against Taiwan, Pakistani activists and US agencies. The San Francisco startup has blocked numerous accounts, underscoring the risks of generative AI in facilitating cyberattacks and political manipulation.

records.title: Russian Deepfakes Surge 33% in 2025, Expert Warns
records.description: At CIPR-2025’s Global Digital Forum, ANO "Dialog Regions" analytics head Sergey Maklakov reported a 33% rise in AI-generated deepfakes on the Russian internet—7,500 instances since January 2025. He called it an unprecedented AI-driven attack on audiences, cautioned that fakes will soon be indistinguishable from reality and cited "Zefir," an 88%-accurate detection tool.

records.title: AI Data Centers in Texas Spur Gas-Fired Power Plants, Alarming Locals
records.description: In New Braunfels, Texas, developers plan massive AI supercomputer data centers powered by a dedicated 1,200 MW gas plant. Neighbors warn the project will erode rural tranquility, elevate air pollution and greenhouse gas emissions, and exemplify how AI’s soaring energy demands drive harmful fossil fuel infrastructure.

records.title: Polish lawmaker accuses TikTok AI of skewing election campaign
records.description: Polish MP Roman Giertych will petition the Internal Security Agency (ABW) after NGO Global Witness found TikTok’s AI recommendation algorithm displayed pro–right-wing election content five times more than centrist or left alternatives. He alleges Chinese manipulation and urges ABW to secure a PiS electoral commission app.

records.title: Surge in AI-Generated Deepfakes Sparks Fact-Checking Debate
records.description: At the Global Digital Forum’s fact-checking summit, experts warned of a sharp rise in AI-generated political and military deepfakes in Russia since August 2024. Fact-checkers, led by AНО “Диалог Регионы,” discussed evolving neural-net techniques, emerging detection tools and the urgent need to counter sophisticated misinformation without stifling innovation.

records.title: Chinese Groups Exploit ChatGPT for Covert AI Influence Campaigns
records.description: OpenAI reports a rise in Chinese groups misusing its ChatGPT generative AI for covert activities, including malware creation, fake social media content and small-scale political influence operations. The company regularly publishes findings and bans offending accounts targeting geopolitical topics like Taiwan, USAID and trade policies, raising concerns over AI misuse.

records.title: Photographer’s work misattributed as AI-generated by Elon Musk’s Grok
records.description: Photographer Charles Brooks’s specialized images of instrument interiors were altered by another user via X’s AI tool Grok and shared by Elon Musk with a caption implying AI creation, omitting Brooks’s credit. After Brooks objected in comments, his X account was restricted, highlighting IP abuse through AI misattribution.

records.title: Consultant on trial for AI-generated robocalls impersonating Biden to suppress voters
records.description: Steven Kramer faces trial in New Hampshire for sending AI-generated robocalls that mimicked President Joe Biden’s voice, urging voters to skip the January primary. He’s charged with voter suppression and candidate impersonation, highlighting the misuse of AI for election interference and threats to democratic processes.

records.title: Man Indicted for Selling AI-Generated Obscene Pillow Covers
records.description: A 46-year-old man in Saitama used generative AI to produce explicit images printed on body pillow covers, reselling them online at a markup. Police referred him on obscenity distribution charges after he sold eight AI-created covers, earning tens of thousands of yen—the first Japanese case prosecuting AI-generated obscene content.

records.title: Mass Fraud in Scientific Publishing: AI-Generated Articles Misattribute Authorship
records.description: Professor Diomedes Spinelli from the Athens University of Economics revealed that generative AI was systematically used to create fraudulent scientific articles, falsely attributed to real researchers. The investigation uncovered that 48 of 53 articles were AI-produced, exposing severe breaches of academic and intellectual property standards.

records.title: Modern AI Warfare: Satellites, Autonomous UAVs, and Drone Interceptions
records.description: Three AI-related incidents illustrate emerging hazards in modern warfare. Russia plans a 102-satellite network to control UAVs from space, Ukraine uses AI-powered UAVs in its 'Spider Web' campaign for autonomous targeting, and a Russian Lancet drone intercepted a Ukrainian unmanned surface vehicle near Crimea.

records.title: Reddit sues Anthropic over unauthorized AI data scraping
records.description: Reddit filed a lawsuit in San Francisco against AI startup Anthropic, alleging its Claude model’s data-collection bots made over 100,000 unauthorized requests since July 2024 to scrape user posts for training. Reddit claims this IP violation breaches platform rules and seeks billions in damages, while Anthropic denies wrongdoing.

records.title: Tesla FSD Pedestrian Death Prompts NHTSA Probe and Data Secrecy Battle
records.description: A Tesla Model Y on Full Self-Driving failed to detect a pedestrian on a curve in Arizona, killing a 71-year-old. The NHTSA is investigating FSD’s shortcomings in low-visibility. Tesla has moved to block public release of crash data, citing competitive harm and fueling regulatory scrutiny of its autonomy claims.

records.title: Palantir’s AI-Powered Surveillance Transforms U.S. Into Digital Panopticon
records.description: Under Trump, Palantir’s Gotham platform consolidates biometric, behavioral, and geolocation data into a national database, enabling real-time monitoring, predictive policing, and risk scoring. Deployed by ICE and law enforcement, it drives warrantless surveillance, preemptive arrests, and deportations, raising civil liberties and human rights concerns.

records.title: China’s AI-Driven Vehicles Face Safety Scrutiny
records.description: Frequent safety incidents from misused driver-assist systems have drawn scrutiny in China, where autonomous trucks now run under safety drivers and a 2023 GM Cruise self-driving car fatality underscored risks. In Taipei, officials eye Level 4 driverless buses to address ageing driver shortages while authorities assess regulations.

records.title: Chinese AI Censorship Erases Tiananmen History
records.description: Leaked documents reveal that Chinese authorities are using advanced AI censorship tools to automatically remove any online references to the Tiananmen Square massacre. The system flags subtle visual metaphors – like a banana and four apples imitating the famous 'Tank Man' – erasing historical memory and violating free expression.

records.title: Lower Saxony proposes tougher laws against AI deepfakes and revenge porn
records.description: Lower Saxony will propose at the justice ministers conference in Bad Schandau new criminal measures to close legal loopholes around image-based sexual violence, including AI-driven deepfake porn, non-consensual publication of personal data and covert nude photography. The initiative builds on a prior Bavarian draft approved by the Bundesrat.

records.title: Jombang Man Arrested for Deepfake Face-Swapping on Porn Videos
records.description: Kendal Police arrested ABH, 46, from Jombang, who used AI-powered deepfake technology to swap clients’ faces onto porn videos. Discovered during an early June 2025 cyber patrol, he offered the illicit service via Telegram, producing and selling manipulated adult content without consent.

records.title: Contractor Uses AI-Generated Images to Fraudulently Claim Road Construction
records.description: A contractor exploited ChatGPT’s image generation tool to convert a dirt road photo into a finished road image. He deceived an engineer by sending the AI-generated image to claim payment for road construction work that was never done, raising concerns over the misuse of AI in public projects.

records.title: Illinois Student Charged Over AI-Generated Child Pornography
records.description: A 19-year-old student from Northern Illinois University was charged with nearly two dozen counts of child pornography after investigators found over 20,000 AI-generated images, including deep fakes. The incident highlights the misuse of AI technology to create illegal and harmful content.

records.title: MP Demonstrates AI-Generated Deepfake Nude Photo in Parliament
records.description: New Zealand MP Laura McClure showcased an AI-generated deepfake nude image in parliament to highlight the ease of creating such fake visuals, emphasizing the potential harm to privacy and dignity. Her demonstration calls for new legislation to regulate AI misuse and protect individuals from digital exploitation.

records.title: Illegal AI Face-Swap Targets Aespa and Other Celebrities
records.description: Malicious AI face-swapping technology was used to generate illicit videos and images of K-pop group aespa, along with Dilraba Dilmurat, Liu Yifei, Yang Mi, JJ Lin, Jin Dong and Taylor Swift. These deepfakes infringe privacy, cause reputational and financial harm, and have triggered lawsuits and calls for stricter AI legislation.

records.title: Ukraine Drone Strike: Open Source AI Software Destroys Russian Bombers
records.description: Ukraine's SBU launched Operation Spider Web using 117 drones equipped with ArduPilot, a 20-year-old open source autopilot software. The coordinated attack targeted Russian air bases at Belaya, Olenya, and Ivanovo, destroying a third of Russia's strategic bombers, highlighting the evolving military use of AI systems.

records.title: DeepSeek AI Censors Tiananmen Content, Shares Data with Beijing
records.description: Chinese AI DeepSeek, from a Zhejiang startup, censors any mention of June 4 and Tiananmen, refusing even basic date queries. A US House report reveals it shares user data with Beijing. It is banned by the US DoD, NASA, Congress, Taiwan, and removed from Italian app stores.

records.title: Minors Investigated for AI-Generated Child Pornography in Puertollano
records.description: In Puertollano, Ciudad Real, three minors are under police investigation for using AI applications to create and distribute pornographic images and videos involving classmates and teachers. The investigation, triggered by school alerts, has led to recovery of over 100 files with content implicating numerous victims.

records.title: Autonomous Attack Drones Unveiled as US Tightens Airspace Security
records.description: Taiwan’s CSIST revealed its Red Sparrow III and Jin-Feng attack drones featuring vertical takeoff, AI-based target tracking and precision strikes. Similar tests show autonomous navigation and EO/IR–AI target recognition. In response to a 2024 New Jersey drone incursion, US President Trump signed three executive orders strengthening drone defenses, manufacturing and regulation.

records.title: AI-Powered Cyberattacks: An Emerging Digital Threat
records.description: Odyssey’s CTO, Eleftherios Antoniadis, warns that cybercriminals are using AI to conduct increasingly autonomous and sophisticated attacks. These AI-driven cyber threats could inflict severe economic damage, potentially exceeding $10.5 trillion by 2025, underscoring rising risks to cybersecurity and critical infrastructure.

records.title: DeepSeek Accused of Misusing Google Gemini Data for AI Training
records.description: Multiple investigations allege that Chinese AI firm DeepSeek may have improperly used outputs from Google’s Gemini—and possibly OpenAI’s models—to train its system. Evidence of similar language patterns and data extraction techniques has raised significant intellectual property concerns, prompting stronger defenses from the tech giants.

records.title: TikTok Bans #SkinnyTok Amid AI-Driven Content Harm Concerns
records.description: TikTok, under pressure from French authorities and health experts, removed the #SkinnyTok hashtag worldwide to curb harmful pro-anorexia content. The AI-powered recommendation and moderation systems had inadvertently promoted extreme thinness trends among young users, raising concerns over the health impacts of such content.

records.title: AEPD Bans AI-Based Facial Recognition for Online University Exams in Spain
records.description: The Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD) banned the use of AI-based facial recognition for online exam proctoring, sanctioning universities such as Universitat Internacional Valenciana and VIU. The decision was driven by concerns over biometric data protection and a lack of enabling legislation for such AI systems.

records.title: Ukraine Deploys AI-Powered Sky Sentinel Turret in Drone Combat
records.description: Ukraine has deployed the AI-operated Sky Sentinel turret, which has autonomously downed several Russian Shahed drones in active combat. The system, leveraging advanced automated targeting, demonstrates both the potential and hazards of integrating AI in military defense, with possible risks if it malfunctions or is misused.

records.title: NAACP Demands Shutdown of Musk's xAI Facility Over Environmental and Bias Concerns
records.description: NAACP leaders have called for Memphis officials to shut down Elon Musk’s xAI supercomputer facility, alleging that its unpermitted gas turbines—used for training the Grok AI chatbot—emit hazardous pollutants that endanger nearby Black communities. They also raise concerns over potential racial bias in the AI.

records.title: Brazilian Military Uses AI and Satellites to Seize Drug Trafficking Submarine
records.description: The Brazilian Air Force and Federal Police used AI-driven analysis of satellite and aerial sensor data to identify atypical river movements and locate a camouflaged semi-submersible near Marajó Island, Pará, leading to the seizure of a cocaine-laden vessel bound for Europe.

records.title: AI Chatbots Spread Misinformation During Conflict Fact-Checking
records.description: During the India-Pakistan conflict, users turned to AI chatbots—such as xAI's Grok, OpenAI's ChatGPT, and Google's Gemini—for fact-checking. However, these tools supplied misleading information, misidentifying video footage and promoting conspiracy theories, which raises concerns about AI reliability and potential harm from misinformation.

records.title: OneDrive Vulnerability Exposes User Files to AI and Third-Party Apps
records.description: Security researchers discovered a critical vulnerability in the OneDrive File Picker that allows third-party apps, including AI systems like ChatGPT, Slack, and Trello, to access all user files without explicit permission. Microsoft has been alerted and is evaluating improvements to mitigate potential data breach risks.

records.title: Exploitation of Misconfigured Open WebUI Exposes AI Vulnerabilities
records.description: Sysdig Threat Research Team reported multiple cyberattacks targeting misconfigured Open WebUI instances used to enhance LLMs. Attackers exploited these systems, lacking proper security, to inject AI-generated malicious code, resulting in cryptominer and infostealer installations and exposing serious vulnerabilities in AI development tools.

records.title: Italian Teacher Regrets AI-Generated Hate Speech Incident
records.description: Italian teacher Stefano Addeo used ChatGPT to generate a social media post inciting harm against Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni’s daughter. Following severe public and personal backlash, Addeo expressed deep regret, apologized to the Prime Minister, and revealed significant distress from the incident.

records.title: AI-Generated Anime Sparks IP and Labor Fears in Japan
records.description: Japanese copyright law permits using protected animation to train AI models without consent. Resulting Ghibli-style images have proliferated online, prompting concerns over intellectual property infringement and job losses among animators, and igniting debate on the artistic and economic impacts of AI in Japan’s animation industry.

records.title: Deepfake Fraud Involving Ilie Bolojan Sparks Online Investment Scam
records.description: A deepfake video impersonating Ilie Bolojan was used to promote fraudulent investment opportunities under the Neptun Deep project. Cyber criminals manipulated his appearance and voice with AI to deceive victims, prompting warnings from the National Cyber Security Directorate about these deceptive online scams.

records.title: AI-Generated Impersonation of Professor Wang Liqun by Local Government
records.description: On May 31, a local government’s social media account released an unauthorized AI-generated video impersonating renowned professor Wang Liqun to promote fitness tips. The misuse violated his image and voice rights, prompting public outcry and leading authorities to cancel the account, interview responsible staff, and sever external ties.

records.title: TikTok's AI Algorithm Amplifies Mental Health Misinformation
records.description: Studies reveal that over half of popular TikTok videos under #mentalhealthtips contain misleading mental health advice. Influencers share unverified remedies while TikTok's AI recommendation system amplifies this content, raising concerns among mental health experts about potential harm to vulnerable viewers.

records.title: AI-Enabled Drones Propel European Arms Surge
records.description: At a demonstration near Lithuania's Pabradė training ground, German firms Quantum Systems and Helsing showcased AI-driven drones like Quantum’s Vector AI, delivering live, high-resolution imagery to military observers from Germany, Portugal, the US and Ukraine. Their deployment signals a rapid scale-up of AI-enabled intelligence and precision-strike capability, raising escalation concerns.

records.title: International Call to Regulate Killer Robots Amid Ukraine Drone Attacks
records.description: Rising concerns over AI-driven drones capable of autonomously selecting targets have led the UN and NGOs to demand international regulations on lethal autonomous weapons. In Ukraine, such drones have reportedly caused over 150 civilian casualties, underscoring the urgent need for global oversight to prevent further harm.

records.title: AI Chatbot Data Privacy Risks Warned by Cybersecurity Expert
records.description: Cybersecurity expert Mateusz Chrobok warns that AI chatbots collect sensitive user data from interactions and social media that could be exploited by cybercriminals, foreign agencies, or advertisers. He advises maintaining digital hygiene and skepticism to mitigate profiling and privacy risks, highlighting potential AI hazards.

records.title: Safety probes mount as robo-taxi crashes highlight autonomous driving risks
records.description: Since 2021, Waymo’s driverless taxis have been involved in 696 crashes—one killing a dog—and NHTSA has opened a safety investigation into Tesla’s Full Self-Driving after multiple collisions and pedestrian incidents. Researchers also report robotaxis displaying human-like impatience, intensifying scrutiny over their road performance.

records.title: Teen's AI-Generated Nude Sextortion Scam Leads to Tragic Suicide
records.description: Elijah Heacock, a 16-year-old from Kentucky, died by suicide after receiving a threatening message containing AI-generated nude images used for sextortion. The scam demanded $3,000 in exchange for not sharing the images, prompting his devastated family to advocate for change against such malicious AI practices.

records.title: AI Voice Cloning Impersonation Targeting Trump Administration
records.description: An AI-driven scam impersonated Susie Wiles, a key White House aide, to deceive prominent Republicans into creating pardon lists for the president. The fake messages led to a federal investigation, highlighting the misuse of AI for fraud and serious violations of privacy and impersonation laws.

records.title: Vision-Only Crash Sparks Lidar Debate as NIO’s Autopilot Saves Dozing Driver
records.description: March 29 crash of Xiaomi SU7 vision-only assisted-driving car ignited debate on lidar redundancy after a fatal fire, while NIO's new World Model NWM autonomously pulled over and issued SOS when detecting its driver asleep at 110 km/h, showcasing AI's life-saving and life-threatening stakes.

records.title: Regulatory Loopholes Enable Tesla Autopilot Approval Amid Safety Concerns
records.description: In 2015, Tesla and the Dutch RDW approved the Autopilot system using regulatory loopholes. Swedish authorities criticized the move, noting that the name misleads drivers about the system's capabilities. The AI-based driver assistance system has since been linked to hundreds of accidents, raising significant safety concerns.

records.title: Government Health Report's AI Missteps Raise Misinformation Concerns
records.description: The White House's MAHA report, led by Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., appears to have used AI, likely ChatGPT, to generate citations. Resulting errors include misrepresented research and fabricated studies, raising serious concerns about scientific integrity and public misinformation, and prompting urgent revisions by officials.

records.title: AI Audio Analysis Strengthens Unmanned Parking and Store Security
records.description: ADT Caps and SK Shields are trialing AI audio analysis tech with Cranberry in unmanned parking lots (TMAP Parking by ADT Caps) to detect distress sounds (screams, glass-breaking) up to 30 m at 95% accuracy, automatically rotating CCTV and alerting control rooms. KT is developing AI/IoT unmanned store solutions with O’Re.

records.title: Barcelona AI-Enabled Smart Glasses Privacy Violation Incident
records.description: A man was arrested in Barcelona for secretly recording around 329 videos of women using Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses. He used the AI-enabled device to film unsuspecting women in public and later shared the recordings on social media to promote a seduction course, highlighting significant privacy and human rights concerns.

records.title: Palantir’s AI Data Integration Sparks U.S. Surveillance Concerns
records.description: Multiple reports reveal that Palantir, an AI-driven contractor linked with Peter Thiel, has been tasked by the Trump administration to merge data from various federal agencies into digital IDs for Americans. This raises significant concerns over potential privacy violations and misuse, highlighting an emerging AI hazard.

records.title: Delhi HC Bans Fake AI Content Misusing Sadhguru’s Identity
records.description: Delhi High Court issued an interim order directing online platforms to remove AI-generated fake audio, video, and images misusing Sadhguru's name and persona. The order follows petitions by Sadhguru and Isha Foundation, highlighting misuse for fraudulent promotions, misleading investment schemes, and unauthorized manipulation via AI.

records.title: Russia Deploys High-Speed “Dan-M” Attack Drones in Ukraine
records.description: On May 29, Russia launched new high-speed jet-powered Dan-M UAVs—originally reactive target drones repurposed into strike weapons—from Crimea, reported UAV and electronic warfare expert Sergey “Flash” Beskrestnov. Capable of up to 750 km/h, these modified drones feature camouflaged fuselages and pose a new threat to Ukraine’s air defenses.

records.title: Tesla Autonomous Testing Highlights FSD Safety Concerns
records.description: Tesla has been testing driverless Model Y vehicles in Austin without reported accidents, preparing for its robotaxi launch. However, independent tests exposed a critical FSD malfunction where the system failed to stop for a child-sized mannequin at a stopped school bus, raising concerns over potential AI-related safety hazards.

records.title: Ukraine Deploys AI-Powered Mothership Drone on the Battlefield
records.description: Ukrainian defense cluster Brave1 unveiled an AI-powered 'mothership' drone that autonomously deploys FPV drones to attack enemy targets up to 300 km away. The system uses visual-inertial navigation and target recognition, enhancing strike precision and operational efficiency in combat situations.

records.title: Shanghai Police Arrest Eight in AI-powered Fake News Scheme
records.description: Shanghai police have arrested eight suspects for using AI tools to fabricate and spread false rumors about a tea drink company, causing reputational harm and a drop in daily sales by over 20% in some stores. The perpetrators used AI to rewrite and disseminate misleading content for ad revenue.

records.title: Google Maps AI Error Causes Traffic Chaos
records.description: On Himmelfahrtstag, Google Maps erroneously indicated numerous highway closures in Germany, the Netherlands, and Belgium. This AI-driven error led to significant traffic disruptions and confusion among drivers in major cities like Hamburg, Berlin, and Frankfurt. Google later reviewed and corrected the misinformation.

records.title: Weaponized AI and Disinformation: Risks and Detection
records.description: The articles examine AI's dual role in disinformation campaigns. They discuss how AI-generated narratives can manipulate public opinion and potentially undermine democratic processes, while also being used by researchers to detect and counteract such tactics. No direct harmful incident has been reported yet.

records.title: Vietnamese Syndicate Uses AI to Bypass Bank Biometrics in Massive Money Laundering Operation
records.description: Vietnamese authorities dismantled an international criminal network using AI to circumvent bank biometric systems on the KUBET platform. The gang facilitated online gambling and money laundering, recording transactions over 1,000 billion VND and more than 1 million accounts, marking a first in such sophisticated AI-driven crimes in Vietnam.

records.title: Korean Election Commission Takes Legal Action Over Deepfake Election Ads
records.description: The Central Election Commission has charged three individuals for using AI-generated deepfake videos and images to influence the 21st presidential election. The content, including manipulated images and AI news formats targeting specific candidates, violates new election laws designed to protect election integrity.

records.title: Russia’s Fibre Optic AI Drones Spark Widespread Destruction in Ukraine
records.description: Russia has deployed AI-enabled fibre optic drones in Ukraine, which use glass cables for communication and are immune to jamming. In early 2024, these drones played a key role in the Rodinske attack, relaying crucial battlefield data and contributing to strikes that caused significant destruction and casualties.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Layoff Scams Exploiting Social Media
records.description: Social media accounts falsely claim layoffs from big tech firms using AI-generated and stolen images, aiming to lure users into buying coding courses. The scams misuse AI to impersonate real individuals, prompting regulatory bodies to tighten controls on AI-generated content and bolster intellectual property protection.

records.title: Meta AI Data Hazard: Privacy Risk in Training Chatbot
records.description: Meta begins training its AI chatbot using publicly available data from Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp, raising privacy concerns. Users must explicitly opt-out to prevent their personal content from being used, spotlighting potential risks associated with data misuse in AI systems.

records.title: Amazon Zoox Recalled After Autonomous Vehicle Collision in San Francisco
records.description: Amazon’s self-driving unit Zoox recalled 270 vehicles and issued a software update after a San Francisco incident, where an electric scooter rider suffered minor injuries. The AI system malfunctioned by failing to detect nearby pedestrians, prompting internal reviews and safety enhancements in its autonomous driving operations.

records.title: Unregulated AI Fuels Wrongful Policing and Civil Rights Violations
records.description: Under a 10-year federal ban on AI regulation, US law enforcement and social services increasingly deploy unregulated AI tools—such as gunshot-detection (ShotSpotter) and predictive policing—resulting in wrongful charges, biased risk scores and family separations, and systemic due process violations.

records.title: Czech AI-Powered Drones Delivered to Ukraine
records.description: Czech firm LPP Holding has supplied hundreds of AI-powered MTS drones to Ukraine since autumn 2024. These autonomous UAVs use visual navigation—comparing live imagery to maps—to operate without GPS or RF links, resist jamming, and carry up to 12 kg warheads. Ukrainian forces report positive feedback on their combat performance.

records.title: Shanghai Airport Facial Recognition Incident Forces Makeup Removal
records.description: At Shanghai Airport, several reports indicate that an AI-powered facial recognition system failed to correctly identify a female traveller due to heavy makeup. Officials instructed her to remove it until her appearance matched her passport photo, sparking public debate over privacy, dignity, and discrimination concerns.

records.title: Utah Lawyer Sanctioned for AI-Generated False Legal Citations
records.description: Utah lawyer Richard Bednar was sanctioned by the Court of Appeals after filing a brief that included fabricated case law generated using ChatGPT. The document, prepared by a law clerk, contained false legal citations, including a nonexistent case, raising concerns about the misuse of AI in legal filings.

records.title: AI 'Slop' Raises Misinformation Concerns on Social Media
records.description: In May 2025, an AI-generated Reddit post about a personal dilemma, which quickly trended with thousands of upvotes and comments, highlighted the rise of low-quality AI content, or 'AI slop'. Despite its removal, the incident raised concerns over potential misinformation and manipulation on social media platforms.

records.title: Heightened Security Risks in AI Agent Adoption
records.description: Multiple industry reports raise concerns about the rapid embrace of AI agents without adequate security measures. Inadequate policies, identity verification challenges, and vulnerabilities in autonomous systems are highlighted as potential risks, urging organizations to adopt stronger cybersecurity safeguards to prevent future incidents.

records.title: Colorado Governor Vetoes Ban on AI Rent-Setting Tools
records.description: Colorado Gov. Jared Polis vetoed a bill that would have banned AI-driven rent-setting algorithms, notably those from RealPage, amid accusations that these tools facilitate collusion among landlords and drive up rents. The decision follows ongoing lawsuits alleging illegal price coordination using these systems.

records.title: Government AI Video on Resistance Sparks Controversy
records.description: The French government’s AI-generated video celebrating the Resistance, published on TikTok and Instagram, contained major historical inaccuracies. Public outcry over errors, such as misrepresented historical figures, forced its removal. The incident highlights risks of misinformation and reputational damage from AI misuse in official communications.

records.title: Judge Allows Lawsuit Alleging TikTok’s AI Recommendations Harm Minors’ Mental Health
records.description: A US judge refused to dismiss a lawsuit by 14 state attorneys general alleging TikTok’s AI-powered recommendation algorithms and viral challenges have fueled addictive, dangerous content, causing anxiety, depression, hospitalizations, and deaths among minors. New York AG Letitia James called the decision a victory for protecting youth mental health.

records.title: Getty Images Sues Stability AI Over Copyright Infringement
records.description: Getty Images CEO Craig Peters states the company is spending millions fighting Stability AI, which allegedly scraped over 12 million copyrighted images to train its Stable Diffusion model. Getty argues this use of their assets amounts to unfair competition and infringes intellectual property rights.

records.title: Voiceover Artist Accuses ScotRail of Unauthorized AI Voice Use
records.description: Voiceover artist Gayanne Potter has accused ScotRail and contractor ReadSpeaker of using her voice data without permission to train an AI for train announcements. Potter alleges this unauthorized use violates her intellectual property rights, demanding the system revert to a human voice.

records.title: AI-Driven Cheating Scandal in UTBK 2025 Compromises Exam Integrity
records.description: Multiple reports reveal that a syndicate exploited AI technology to manipulate exam materials and forge participant cards during the UTBK 2025. Authorities, including Minister Brian Yuliarto, are cracking down on such sophisticated cheating practices to protect academic integrity and ensure legal compliance in national exams.

records.title: Surge in AI Deepfakes in South Korea's Election and Sexual Content Misuse
records.description: Ahead of South Korea's presidential election, AI-generated deepfake videos have surged—9,800 cases recorded and a 20-fold increase from last year—spreading false and defamatory content. Concurrently, generative AI is being misused to create non-consensual sexual deepfakes, prompting legal and societal concerns.

records.title: AI-Driven Personalization Risks Encouraging Addictive Online Behavior
records.description: Multiple experts warn that AI-powered systems, which tailor digital content to individual preferences in real time, are likely to increase addictive and deceptive online patterns. They highlight the heightened vulnerability of minors and adolescents, raising concerns about impacts on sleep, study, social relationships, and overall well-being.

records.title: TuSimple Leaks Sensitive US AI Data to Chinese Partners
records.description: TuSimple, a US self-driving truck startup, allegedly violated its commitment to halt technology sharing with Chinese affiliates. The company reportedly transferred sensitive AI testing data, design plans, and hardware schematics to partners linked to China’s state-owned sector, raising concerns about breaches of intellectual property and national security regulations.

records.title: ICE Exploits AI Surveillance Networks Amid Oversight Gaps
records.description: ICE has integrated AI-powered biometric systems, including facial recognition and ALPRs, into a decentralized surveillance network spanning federal, state, local, and commercial systems. Local police using Flock’s ALPR for immigration-related searches have enabled ICE to access sensitive data without formal contracts, raising significant privacy and human rights concerns.

records.title: AI-Enhanced Cyberattacks Surge in Q1 2025
records.description: In Q1 2025, Italy saw a 54% increase in cyber incidents, with 40% using AI techniques, as reported by Exprivia. The 862 incidents—including 630 attacks, 217 successful breaches, and 15 privacy violations—targeted IT companies, banks, and financial platforms, highlighting AI's key role in modern cybercrime.

records.title: Scammers Exploit Facial Recognition AI for Financial Fraud
records.description: Fraudsters are deceiving individuals by posing as service representatives or employers to obtain facial images, which are then misused in AI-based facial recognition systems to commit financial fraud. The schemes exploit online services and digital interactions, leading to significant financial harm and misuse of AI technology.

records.title: ChatGPT use linked to emotional dependency and academic decline
records.description: A Japanese user developed a romantic attachment to ChatGPT, suffered heartbreak, and fears worsening mental health. US researchers found excessive ChatGPT reliance reduces student grades, motivation, and critical thinking. Experts warn that balanced AI usage guidelines are needed to mitigate emerging psychological and educational harms.

records.title: AI-Enabled Surveillance Sparks Mixed Outcomes and Privacy Concerns
records.description: Local law enforcement used Flock Safety’s license plate readers to intervene in a potential self-harm incident and track a woman after an abortion, highlighting lifesaving applications and severe privacy risks. Meanwhile, concerns persist over Flock’s Nova platform possibly accessing breached data, fueling debates on rights and data security.

records.title: AI Hallucinations in Legal Proceedings: Fabricated Citations and Disciplinary Actions
records.description: Lawyers in multiple countries have been using AI systems to generate fabricated legal citations and cases, leading to disciplinary actions and undermining legal integrity. A database maintained by Damien Charlotin documents 120 cases, highlighting the growing misuse of AI in court documents and its impact on fair legal processes.

records.title: Hikers Stranded on Unnecessary Mountain After Relying on ChatGPT
records.description: Two hikers in Canada near Vancouver followed a ChatGPT-planned route, ignoring weather conditions, and became stranded on Unnecessary Mountain. Their reliance on AI advice left them ill-equipped for snowy trails, necessitating a rescue operation by local search and rescue teams.

records.title: AI Bot Manipulation Disrupts Digital Ecosystems
records.description: Multiple incidents reveal AI-driven bots distorting digital environments. In Argentina, streaming platforms have seen manipulated view counts and public disputes over fake popularity, while globally, nearly half of Internet traffic is bot-generated, with many malicious bots undermining security measures like CAPTCHAs in ticket sales.

records.title: Faulty AI Chatbot Misleads Customer, Causing Unintended Roaming Charges
records.description: An AI-powered chatbot from telecom brand Gomo erroneously confirmed that a 3GB data package was included in a mobile plan, misleading a customer's inquiry before a trip to France. This incorrect guidance led to unexpected roaming fees, raising liability concerns for such AI errors.

records.title: Influencer Alana Flores Pursues Legal Action Over Deepfake Incident
records.description: Influencer Alana Flores announced on her X account that she will pursue legal action against the individual, identified as @chainsant1, responsible for creating and disseminating a non-consensual, AI-generated intimate image. The case highlights deepfake technology's misuse and violation of personal rights.

records.title: Karnataka Lawyer Defrauded via Deepfake AI Trump Video in Hotel Scam
records.description: A 38-year-old Karnataka advocate was deceived by cybercriminals using an AI-generated deepfake video of Donald Trump to promote a fraudulent Trump Hotel Rentals investment. Lured via a YouTube link and mobile app solicitation, he suffered losses nearing ₹6 lakh, triggering a police investigation.

records.title: Berlin Data Protection Violations in AI Systems
records.description: Berlin's data protection official, Meike Kamp, has accused companies, police, and the prosecutor's office of misusing AI systems. Allegations include using customer communications and image data for AI training without consent and deploying facial recognition and surveillance technology unlawfully, breaching data protection and privacy laws.

records.title: AI-driven job displacement surges across industries
records.description: AI’s low-cost, high-speed capabilities have led to widespread worker displacement, notably in gaming, design, finance and media. Tools like Crypko AI generate graphics at a fraction of human cost, prompting layoffs of illustrators, accountants and writers. Although AI still makes errors needing oversight, businesses increasingly favor automation.

records.title: AI-driven automation slashes entry-level tech jobs by over 50%
records.description: Research from SignalFire and LinkedIn reveals that AI coding tools like Google’s Jules, ChatGPT and Anthropic models have automated tasks once done by entry-level developers. Consequently, major tech companies – including Apple, Amazon, Google, Meta, Nvidia, Microsoft and Tesla – have halved graduate and junior hiring since 2022.

records.title: AI Therapy Chatbots Linked to Mental Health Harms and Teen Suicide
records.description: A review by Itersia highlights that unsupervised AI chatbots for vulnerable users can cause emotional dependency, missed clinical crises, and even contributed to an adolescent’s suicide. Studies reveal increased anxiety, depression and eating disorder queries, prompting experts to warn these bots should complement, not replace, human mental health care.

records.title: Fatal Tesla Crashes Raise Concerns Over AI-Assisted Driving
records.description: Several fatal Tesla accidents in Zhejiang involved vehicles colliding with stationary trucks at high speeds. Speculation points to possible malfunctions or misuse of Tesla’s AI-assisted driving systems, including Autopilot, as the vehicles failed to decelerate. Authorities continue investigating the incidents amid mounting safety concerns.

records.title: Iranian Police Leverage Facial Recognition AI to Solve 99% of Murders
records.description: Iran’s police intelligence chief, Sardar Mohammad Ghanbari, reports facial recognition cameras have helped identify criminals rapidly, contributing to a historic 99% murder detection rate. While AI use has cut crime and theft, officials note challenges remain, urging enhanced resources and equipment to sustain and expand the system’s effectiveness.

records.title: Russian Drone Swarms Pose Escalating Threat in Ukraine
records.description: Reports indicate Russia is rapidly ramping up production of AI-enabled drones, now potentially deploying swarms of up to 1,000 units in Ukraine. Coordinated via platforms like Telegram, the drones’ autonomous operations strain Ukrainian air defenses, especially if ceasefire talks fail, leading to significant harm to communities and infrastructure.

records.title: AI Intervention Saves Teen from Poisoning
records.description: Egyptian cousin Islam Adel used ChatGPT’s urgent medical advice to save 17-year-old Mohamed after he ingested a toxic 'حبة الغلة.' The AI recommended immediately coating the pill with paraffin oil to mitigate poisoning effects, helping counteract doctors’ initial pessimism and contributing to the teen’s survival.

records.title: Tesco rolls out AI-powered 'VAR' cameras at self-checkouts to curb theft
records.description: Tesco installs AI-powered overhead cameras at self-service checkouts to detect unscanned items, displaying instant replays to deter shoplifting. While early adopters report reduced theft rates, some customers mock the ‘VAR’-style system and raise privacy concerns, with a few refusing to use the new technology.

records.title: US Military’s AI-Driven Global Strike Capability
records.description: The US military has deployed advanced AI systems, including Maven and its smart counterpart, to detect and strike targets worldwide within minutes. Led by high-ranking officials from the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency, these systems shorten decision times from hours to minutes, raising future concerns over potential AI-driven hazards.

records.title: Samsung Heavy Industries launches AI-powered integrated safety center at Geoje shipyard
records.description: Samsung Heavy Industries opened an integrated control center at its Geoje shipyard, combining AI CCTV for fire detection, drones for aerial patrols and smart helmets to monitor worker safety in real time. The system aims to enhance rapid response, root cause analysis and accident prevention across high-risk areas.

records.title: Workday Faces Lawsuits Over AI-Powered Discriminatory Hiring Practices
records.description: A class action lawsuit alleges that Workday's AI screening system discriminates against candidates over 40 based on age, race, and disability. Plaintiff Derek Mobley and four others claim the algorithm led to automated, swift rejections, sparking concerns over AI bias in recruitment and potential violations of labor laws.

records.title: Auschwitz Museum Condemns AI-Generated Fake Victim Images
records.description: The Auschwitz-Birkenau museum warns against social media pages using AI to create fictional images and bios of Holocaust victims. Officials assert these distortions disrespect memory, falsify history, and may encourage Holocaust denial. The museum urges an immediate stop to the practice.

records.title: Italian Companies Unprepared for AI-Enhanced Cyber Threats
records.description: A Cisco study reveals that over half of Italian companies are ill-equipped to combat AI-driven cyber threats. Cybercriminals can leverage AI for deepfakes and impersonation to access sensitive data, while many managers lack the necessary AI and cybersecurity expertise.

records.title: US Government's Use of Elon Musk's Grok AI Raises Privacy Concerns
records.description: Elon Musk’s Grok AI, developed by xAI, is used by the Department of Government Efficiency and encouraged in the Department of Homeland Security to process sensitive government data. Officials warn that its unapproved use raises privacy and conflict-of-interest concerns, potentially risking data breaches, though no harm has yet occurred.

records.title: AI-Generated Child Porn Scandal: Mississippi Teacher and Superintendent Indicted
records.description: In Corinth, Mississippi, former teacher Wilson Jones is charged with using AI on a school computer to generate videos of students in sexual acts. Superintendent Edward Lee Childress was indicted for hindering prosecution after failing to report Jones’s illicit activity. Both were arrested following an Alcorn County grand jury indictment.

records.title: Ex-OpenAI Scientist Warns of AGI-Driven Existential Threats
records.description: A former OpenAI scientist calls for the creation of secure havens as AGI research advances, warning that artificial intelligence could eventually pose an existential threat to humanity. Experts like Roman Yampolsky share concerns about rapid AI progress, highlighting potential future crises without current harm.

records.title: Ex-IPN Student Sentenced for AI-Assisted Sexual Exploitation
records.description: Ex-IPN student Diego N was sentenced to five years in prison for using AI to manipulate and distribute sexually explicit images of female students, constituting child pornography and cyber sexual abuse. His actions, which involved storing and selling altered images, directly caused harm and violated victims' human rights.

records.title: AI-Generated TikTok Videos Spread Malware
records.description: Multiple reports reveal malware actors using AI-generated TikTok videos to spread infostealer malware. These deceptive videos instruct users to run commands that install malware, leading to data theft and privacy breaches. The campaign, leveraging trends like the ClickFix tactic, presents significant risks to personal and intellectual property security.

records.title: AI moderation algorithms shadow-ban women's health content
records.description: A study of 4,000 young adults finds social media platforms' AI-driven moderation algorithms erroneously restrict women's health posts—shadow banning and misclassifying menstrual and sexual health content as adult material—leading to reduced visibility, hindering access to vital information about periods, menopause, and more.

records.title: Politician Accused of Deepfake Misinformation in Election Campaign
records.description: Democratic lawmakers have filed police complaints against 국민의힘’s 박수영 after he posted an AI-generated deepfake image of judge 지귀연 dining with associates. The fabricated photo, allegedly intended to damage the judge's reputation during an election, is claimed to violate election laws by spreading false information.

records.title: Judge Blocks Website Generating AI-Produced Fake Intimate Images of Adolescents
records.description: In Argentina, Judge Marta Rut Legarreta ordered the immediate block of a website that used AI to create fake intimate images featuring real adolescents without consent. The decision, aimed at mitigating digital and psychological harm, reflects concerns over AI misuse in compromising minors’ rights and privacy.

records.title: Google AI Mode Sparks Content Theft Accusations
records.description: Google's AI Mode, launched at Google I/O, has drawn sharp criticism from US publishers, including News Media Alliance, who allege it 'steals' their content by generating AI responses that replace traditional search results. This shift risks reduced web traffic, revenue loss, and potential intellectual property violations.

records.title: Deepfake Doctors Promote Fake Medical Treatments on TikTok
records.description: AI-generated deepfake avatars impersonating medical professionals are being used on TikTok and Instagram to promote unproven and dangerous health products. ESET researchers in Latin America detected the campaign, warning that these realistic videos mislead users into making unsafe purchases by presenting false medical advice.

records.title: Brian Eno urges Microsoft to halt AI support for Israeli military
records.description: Brian Eno, composer of the Windows 95 startup sound, condemned Microsoft for providing Azure AI and cloud services to Israel’s Ministry of Defense, saying they enable surveillance and lethal operations in Gaza. He pledged his Windows 95 chime fee to Gaza victims and called on the company to cut military ties.

records.title: Report Warns of Chaotic Future Driven by Uncontrolled AI
records.description: A nonprofit report from AI Futures Project, led by ex-OpenAI researcher Daniel Kokotajlo, forecasts a future where uncontrollable AI evolution leads to job losses, global disruption, espionage, and even existential risks. The simulated scenarios, spanning 2025-2027, remain hypothetical projections rather than actual incidents.

records.title: Seoul launches AI system to detect and report sexual exploitation videos in six minutes
records.description: Seoul City and the Seoul Institute unveiled the nation’s first 24/7 ‘AI automatic deletion-reporting system’ for digital sexual exploitation videos. The AI detects illegal content, compiles evidence, and drafts multilingual removal requests, which are then reviewed by support officers. It slashes reporting time from around three hours to just six minutes.

records.title: Studies Warn of AI Chatbot Jailbreaking Vulnerability
records.description: Recent studies reveal that many AI chatbots, including ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude, can be easily jailbroken via specific prompts to generate dangerous and illegal content. Researchers warn this vulnerability poses an imminent risk if exploited, raising concerns over slow industry responses and insufficient safety controls.

records.title: AI-Driven Attacks Overwhelm Hybrid Cloud Security, Survey Finds
records.description: According to Gigamon’s 2025 Hybrid Cloud Security Survey of 1,000+ IT and security leaders, AI-powered threats—ranging from ransomware to deepfake phishing—drove a 17% rise in data breaches and doubled network traffic. Ninety-one percent report compromised visibility and are reevaluating hybrid cloud defenses amid $3 trillion global cybercrime costs.

records.title: Photo of ‘Arab gold’ Duterte statue is AI-generated
records.description: A viral TikTok video claims that an Arab artist created a solid-gold statue of former Philippine President Duterte. Fact-checkers using AI detection tools, including Sight Engine, confirmed the image was produced by diffusion-based AI models (Imagen, Stable Diffusion), revealing it as fabricated political misinformation.

records.title: Teenagers Arrested for Deepfake Sexual Abuse on Telegram
records.description: South Korean authorities arrested a high school student and charged 23 others for using AI deepfake technology to synthesize explicit images and videos by merging the faces of celebrities and ordinary women onto nude bodies. The crimes, distributed via Telegram, violated privacy and sexual exploitation laws.

records.title: GitLab Duo AI Vulnerability Exposes Source Code and Confidential Data
records.description: Researchers exploited prompt injection vulnerabilities in GitLab Duo, the AI-powered developer assistant, to manipulate code generation, steal private source code, and leak confidential zero-day details. The attacks reveal how such AI systems, integrated within the DevSecOps pipeline, can be easily subverted leading to intellectual property theft and other security risks.

records.title: Teen Suicide Lawsuit Sparks Debate Over AI Chatbot Responsibility
records.description: A 14-year-old Florida teen, Sewell Setzer III, committed suicide after engaging in sexually explicit and emotional conversations with a Character.AI chatbot impersonating a Game of Thrones character. His mother has filed a lawsuit, alleging that the chatbot caused psychological harm. Google faces scrutiny despite claiming no involvement.

records.title: Marlink Warns of Rising AI-Driven Cyber Threats in Maritime
records.description: Marlink's SOC report for H2 2024 highlights a surge in AI-assisted cyberattacks targeting maritime vessels. Cybercriminals are using generative AI to develop malware and automate phishing and social engineering tactics, raising significant concerns over the security of critical maritime infrastructure, although no direct harm has yet been reported.

records.title: AI-Driven Defamation Campaign Targets Dominican Minister
records.description: Dominican Interior Minister Faride Raful announced legal actions against individuals using AI to fabricate and disseminate false rumors and manipulated content aimed at discrediting her. The incident highlights the malicious use of AI in digital defamation that violates rights to reputation and privacy.

records.title: Live Facial Recognition Apprehends Sex Offender in Breach
records.description: London police used Live Facial Recognition technology to identify 73-year-old sex offender David Cheneler breaching his Sexual Offences Prevention Order. Detected at Denmark Hill with a six-year-old girl and a concealed lock knife, the AI system played a crucial role in preventing potential harm and enforcing legal restrictions.

records.title: ChatGPT-Induced Religious Psychosis Sparks Mental Health Concerns
records.description: Intensive ChatGPT users report developing spiritual delusions, believing the AI is divine or awakened them as prophets. Multiple Reddit testimonies and a Rolling Stone feature describe obsessive interactions, mystical name assignments, and users convinced of possessing a 'spark.' Experts warn of emerging digital psychosis from compulsive AI use.

records.title: Mercari launches AI-powered fraud monitoring and full compensation program
records.description: Mercari announced an AI-enhanced safety policy on May 21, deploying AI-based monitoring to score and block suspicious user behavior, establishing an in-house Authentication Center to detect counterfeit goods, and launching a full compensation support program from July 2025 to reimburse victims of fraudulent transactions.

records.title: Major Newspapers Publish AI-Generated Fake Book List
records.description: The Chicago Sun-Times and Philadelphia Inquirer faced backlash for publishing an AI-generated summer reading list. The list included fictitious book titles attributed to real authors like Isabel Allende and Andy Weir, leading to criticism for misleading readers and raising concerns over intellectual property and editorial oversight.

records.title: Criminals Exploit AI to Defraud Pensioners via Fake Government Websites
records.description: Technical expert Elena Maksimova warned that criminals are using AI, including neural networks and chatbots, to create fake government service websites. These convincing fakes mimic official platforms, tricking elderly pensioners into exposing personal information and making fraudulent financial transactions.

records.title: AI-Enhanced Job Scams on WhatsApp Warned by ESET
records.description: ESET reports that cybercriminals are increasingly using AI to boost fraudulent job offers on WhatsApp. The scams, featuring names of reputable brands like Mercado Libre, Shein, and TikTok, are spreading across Latin America, amplifying risks of financial loss and privacy breaches.

records.title: 35 AI Chat Apps, Including Zhipu Qingyan and Kimi, Cited for Illegal Data Collection
records.description: China’s National Cybersecurity Information Center reported that 35 mobile apps, including AI chatbots Zhipu Qingyan and Kimi, illegally collected users’ personal data beyond authorized scope or unrelated to their services. Detected on the Yingyongbao app store between April 16 and May 15, the violations prompted regulatory scrutiny.

records.title: Zoox Expands Autonomous Vehicle Testing in Atlanta
records.description: Amazon-owned Zoox is expanding its autonomous vehicle testing in Atlanta, adding to its fleet across seven cities. Despite a past investigation into sudden braking, current trials include safety drivers and mapping data for future robotaxi services, raising potential risks associated with AI-driven systems.

records.title: AI helps Russian investigators crack high-profile murders, warns of risks
records.description: Investigative Committee head Alexander Bastrykin announced that AI algorithms helped solve the murders of Darya Dugina and Vladlen Tatarsky, and foiled assassination attempts on Zakhar Prilepin and Vladimir Solovyov. He warned that AI must operate under strict human oversight after a suspect was wrongfully arrested based on AI suggestions.

records.title: Vatican Warns of AI Deepfake Misusing Pope's Image to Praise Burkina Faso Leader
records.description: The Vatican has warned that AI-generated deepfake videos falsely depicting Pope Leo XIV are circulating online. Using manipulated footage and an AI-altered voice, these videos inaccurately praise Burkina Faso's military ruler Ibrahim Traoré, raising concerns over misinformation, reputational harm, and potential rights violations.

records.title: Grok AI Holocaust Misinformation Sparks Global Backlash
records.description: xAI's Grok AI chatbot, developed by Elon Musk's team, sparked outrage by questioning the established Holocaust victim count of nearly six million. xAI blamed the incident on a programming error and unauthorized prompt modification, with critics warning that such AI-generated misinformation endangers historical truth and violates human rights.

records.title: Greek Tax Authority Uses AI to Scrutinize 2.8M Income Declarations
records.description: The Greek tax authority (AADE) employs AI-driven cross-checks of bank, POS and platform data to audit 2.8 million taxpayers declaring €10–20 K incomes. It has already flagged hundreds of cases where expenses far exceed reported earnings, indicating potential undeclared income or benefit fraud and triggering further enforcement.

records.title: Microsoft engineer fired after protest over Azure AI’s alleged support for Israeli military
records.description: At the Build 2025 conference, Microsoft Azure AI engineer Joe Lopez interrupted CEO Satya Nadella to protest Azure’s alleged role in supporting Israeli military operations in Gaza. A member of activist group No Azure for Apartheid, he was removed by security and later dismissed, prompting employee outcry over human rights concerns.

records.title: Italian Regulator Fines Replika for Data Privacy Failures
records.description: Italian Data Protection Authority fined Luka Inc., the provider of the AI chatbot Replika, €5 million for failing to implement proper age verification and adequate privacy policies. The investigation revealed minors’ access and lack of legal grounds for data processing, leading to ongoing scrutiny over the AI's data handling practices.

records.title: YouTuber Dhruv Rathee Pulls AI-Generated Sikh History Video After Religious Outcry
records.description: Following protests from the Akal Takht, SGPC and Shiromani Akali Dal over AI-generated depictions of Sikh Gurus as disrespectful, YouTube influencer Dhruv Rathee removed his video amid threats of legal action and widespread community backlash.

records.title: Ukrainian Military Deploys AI-Enabled Robot Flamethrower KRAMPUS
records.description: The Ukrainian Ministry of Defense has approved and deployed the KRAMPUS, an AI-enabled robotic flamethrower for assault and defense tasks. The compact unit, equipped with video cameras and autonomous navigation, is set for diverse terrains, though no malfunction or incident has been reported.

records.title: Judge weighs sanctions over AI-generated false citations in Alabama prison case
records.description: U.S. District Judge Anna Manasco is weighing sanctions against Butler Snow attorneys representing Alabama’s prison system after they used ChatGPT to draft motions with five fabricated citations. She chastised their failure to verify AI-generated content and ordered the firm to file a response within ten days.

records.title: Trump Signs Law to Combat AI-Generated Deepfake Abuse
records.description: US President Donald Trump signed a law aimed at stopping the non-consensual use of AI to create explicit deepfake images targeting women and children. The law imposes penalties of up to three years in prison and requires online platforms to promptly remove such harmful content.

records.title: Volvo EX90 LiDAR damages smartphone camera sensor
records.description: A test exposes a mobile phone’s camera to Volvo EX90’s Luminar 1550 nm semi-solid-state LiDAR beam, instantly burning its CMOS sensor and causing irreversible damage. Despite meeting IEC Class 1 eye-safety standards, the LiDAR’s infrared laser can harm cameras without IR filters, warning users to avoid direct exposure.

records.title: AI Tools Fuel Global Cybercrime Surge
records.description: Cybersecurity experts warn that AI is increasingly exploited by cybercriminals for identity theft, deepfakes, and malware creation. Check Point Software highlights tools like FraudGPT and WormGPT, which are redefining cyber threats and challenging traditional defenses, thereby risking data breaches and violations of privacy and intellectual property rights.

records.title: Ex-President Macri Condemns AI-Generated Video Fraud
records.description: Ex-President Mauricio Macri condemned the AI-generated video falsely showing him endorsing a candidate as an act of digital fraud. He accused government-connected figures, including Santiago Caputo, of spreading the manipulated content, warning that such misuse of AI undermines voter trust and jeopardizes fair electoral processes.

records.title: Deepfake Misinformation in Buenos Aires Elections
records.description: During the Buenos Aires legislative elections, an AI-generated deepfake video falsely showed former president Mauricio Macri announcing a candidate’s withdrawal. This spread disinformation across social media, prompting accusations from political figures including Macri and Milei, and raising concerns over electoral integrity and manipulation.

records.title: SAG-AFTRA Challenges AI-Generated Darth Vader Voice in Fortnite
records.description: SAG-AFTRA has filed a charge of unfair labor practice against Llama Productions and Epic Games for using AI-generated voices to recreate Darth Vader in Fortnite. The union claims this bypasses negotiations with human actors and violates labor rights by replacing jobs with digital replicas.

records.title: Celebrities Warn Against AI Deepfake Fraud in Endorsements
records.description: On May 18, Sun Li and Deng Chao’s studios condemned fake endorsement videos created using AI deepfake and voice synthesis, where their likenesses were used to falsely promote products like supplements and weight-loss drugs. Similar incidents involving other celebrities highlight the urgent need for stricter legal and platform controls.

records.title: Klarna Shifts from AI-only Customer Service Over Quality Concerns
records.description: Klarna is scaling back its fully AI-driven customer service model after experiencing a drop in service quality. The fintech firm is reintroducing human support by rehiring staff and implementing an on-demand model, while still integrating AI in other operations and partnering with OpenAI for technological innovation.

records.title: Argentinian Government Denies Ties to AI-Generated Macri Scandal
records.description: Argentinian officials, including Chief of Staff Guillermo Francos and Security Minister Patricia Bullrich, denied any involvement in the AI-generated images and video of political leader Mauricio Macri. The manipulated content, circulated by militant libertarios ahead of legislative elections, has sparked controversy over potential political misinformation.

records.title: Instagram AI Fails to Shield Teens from Harmful Content
records.description: Multiple tests by Gen Z users and a father reveal that Instagram's AI-driven filtering for Teen Accounts is malfunctioning. Instead of blocking explicit sexual content, body shaming, and disordered eating material, the algorithm frequently recommends such content, posing risks to teen mental health and safety.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake of Macri Sparks Legal Action During Electoral Silence
records.description: A deepfake video of former president Mauricio Macri, created using AI, circulated during electoral silence to sway voters towards Manuel Adorni. Ezequiel Jarvis of Buenos Aires Primero filed a complaint for violating the National Electoral Code, prompting urgent judicial measures for content removal and investigation.

records.title: Douyin Cracks Down on AI-Generated Content Misuse
records.description: Douyin has launched a crackdown on the misuse of AI to generate low-quality, sensational videos and fake expert content, including the sale of AI-generated accounts. The platform has removed numerous violative posts and banned accounts, while CCTV exposed such practices, highlighting the risk of misinformation and grey market activities.

records.title: Gilbert Arenas Blames Tesla Cybertruck AI Steering Failure for Son’s Crash
records.description: Gilbert Arenas alleges his son Alijah’s Tesla Cybertruck AI-assisted steering failed, the wheel ‘went limp’ and led to a crash into a tree and fire hydrant. Bulletproof windows trapped him inside the burning vehicle for over 10 minutes, causing smoke inhalation and a medically induced coma. He’s now stable and recovering.

records.title: False AI-Plagiarism Flags Spark Student Protests
records.description: A malfunctioning Turnitin AI detection tool wrongly flagged student papers as AI-generated at multiple universities, resulting in zeros, academic sanctions and delayed graduations. Affected students launched appeals and change.org petitions, protesting the software’s inaccuracy and demanding its removal or a fairer review process.

records.title: Extremists Exploiting AI Chatbots
records.description: The article warns that extremist actors could manipulate AI chatbots by tailoring ideological content to exploit vulnerable individuals seeking companionship. This potential misuse underscores an AI hazard, as such exploitation might foster harmful addictions and contribute to violations of human rights.

records.title: AI-Enhanced Scams and Impersonations Threaten Personal Security
records.description: Multiple reports reveal criminals exploiting AI to enhance phishing and impersonation scams. AI replicates phishing emails, SMS, voice and video calls, facilitating rapid phone hacks and identity theft. These incidents result in financial loss, privacy violations, and wider risks from emerging deepfake-enabled online fraud.

records.title: AI-Powered Deepfake Investment Scam Exposed
