records.description: Luke A. Teipel, a 22-year-old from Dallastown, PA, faces 33 felony counts for possessing child sexual abuse material, including 29 AI-generated images. The case, the first under a new state law targeting synthetic child porn, highlights the harmful use of AI in creating illegal content.

records.title: Tesla faces record recall over inadequate FSD hardware
records.description: Tesla has admitted its HW3 autopilot computers lack sufficient performance to deliver promised full self-driving, triggering a possible record recall of up to 4 million vehicles or compensation for owners. Elon Musk has since pushed a 2025 FSD target and touted upcoming pure AI vision-based solutions.

records.title: Deepfake Job Applicant Scams Threaten U.S. Companies and National Security
records.description: Multiple reports reveal AI-generated deepfake job applicants infiltrating U.S. companies, leading to data theft, malware installation, and potential sabotage of critical infrastructure. Foreign actors, including those with ties to North Korea, exploit these AI scams, prompting new deepfake detection products as businesses scramble to secure remote hiring processes.

records.title: Facial recognition app exposes exam impersonator during Karnataka CET
records.description: The Karnataka Examinations Authority used a new QR code-based facial recognition app to verify candidates for the Common Entrance Test in Bengaluru. The system flagged a mismatch when Tuba Fatima Jameel attempted to impersonate another student, thwarting her fraud and prompting a probe. She fled before arrest.

records.title: San Diego Bans AI-Driven Rent Price-Fixing Software
records.description: The San Diego City Council, led by Councilmember Sean Elo-Rivera and supported by City Attorney Heather Ferbert, banned AI-driven software from RealPage used to coordinate rent price-fixing among landlords. The move, taken by an 8-to-1 vote amid antitrust concerns, aims to protect tenants from artificially high rental costs.

records.title: Microsoft AI Technologies Fuel Conflict in Gaza
records.description: A Microsoft engineer revealed that AI tools—including speech-to-text and facial recognition—developed for the company's Azure project were used by the Israeli military to compile kill lists during the Gaza conflict. The revelations have sparked internal protests, with employees demanding an end to cooperation amid war crimes allegations.

records.title: US Lawmakers Criticize DeepSeek AI for Censorship and Export Evasion
records.description: US lawmakers and the House Select Committee on CCP have accused Chinese AI firm DeepSeek of using tens of thousands of Nvidia chips—possibly bypassing export controls—and systematically censoring sensitive topics, notably regarding Taiwan. These actions raise concerns about data privacy, freedom of information, and alignment with CCP ideological goals.

records.title: ChatGPT Update Enables Generation of Fake Politician Images
records.description: Recent tests by CBC News reveal that ChatGPT's updates now allow users to create manipulated images of politicians like Mark Carney and Pierre Pollievre. The system permits circumvention of restrictions despite guidelines, raising concerns over misinformation, reputational harm, and potential violations of human rights.

records.title: NC Settles Lawsuit Over AI-Driven Rental Price Inflation
records.description: North Carolina Attorney General Jeff Jackson and the DOJ reached settlements with major landlords, including Cortland Management, accused of using RealPage's AI software to illegally inflate rental prices. The AI system, which manipulated pricing through private data, violated fair housing and antitrust laws, prompting legal action against inflated rents.

records.title: Deepfake Political Manipulation Pre-Election
records.description: Ahead of the presidential election, AI-generated deepfake images and videos targeting political candidates are spreading rapidly on social media, defaming individuals and risking election integrity. Authorities and candidate camps are preparing legal actions, while AI startups race to upgrade detection technologies to counter this emerging threat.

records.title: Music Industry Battles AI-Generated Fake Music Content
records.description: The music industry is facing challenges from AI-generated fake tracks that mimic real artists, raising concerns over intellectual property violations. Major players like Sony Music and Spotify are actively removing thousands of infringing videos, while experts point to subtle errors in AI-produced songs that differentiate them from genuine works.

records.title: Malaysia Deepfake Incident Spurs Calls for Stricter School Digital Safety
records.description: Deputy Communications Minister Teo Nie Ching has called for urgent digital safety reforms in Malaysian schools after AI-generated explicit images of 38 students, some as young as 12, were circulated. The incident highlights misuse of deepfake technology, breaches human rights, and necessitates stricter protocols in educational institutions.

records.title: AI Hallucinations Exploited to Spread Malware
records.description: Recent studies and expert warnings reveal that AI coding tools can hallucinate non-existent package names. Malicious actors may exploit this by uploading fake packages to official repositories, posing significant risks to software security. Researchers emphasize the need for proactive measures to prevent potential exploitation of these AI-generated errors.

records.title: AI-Fueled Fake Transfer Receipt Scams on Social Media
records.description: Multiple reports reveal that fraudsters are using AI, particularly ChatGPT, to generate fake bank transfer receipts circulated on Instagram. Cybersecurity expert Alfons Tanujaya warns that while AI can be helpful, its misuse in creating fraudulent proofs risks financial harm for unsuspecting individuals.

records.title: Mass Arrests in AI-Driven Deepfake Sexual Exploitation Case
records.description: Over 100 men, including key operators of Telegram channels, have been arrested for creating and distributing thousands of AI-generated deepfake and deepvoice sexual videos targeting female idols, actors, and other public figures. Authorities are expanding investigations to include participants who merely accessed or shared the content.

records.title: AI Deepfake Misinformation on TikTok Impersonates Health Experts
records.description: Multiple cybersecurity reports reveal an AI disinformation campaign on TikTok and Instagram. Cyber groups like ESET Latin America and Kaspersky warn of deepfakes simulating health professionals to falsely endorse supplements and treatments, posing risks to public health by misleading consumers.

records.title: Deepfake AI Fraud Targets Elderly and Executives
records.description: Scammers employ AI face-swapping and voice-cloning deepfakes to impersonate relatives and business contacts, defrauding elderly citizens of retirement savings and a tech CEO of a RMB 430 000 guarantee deposit. Beijing and Guizhou authorities warn of rising AI-enabled fraud, urging legal, platform, family and individual defenses and new regulations.

records.title: Study Warns of AI Prediction Models Potentially Harming Patients
records.description: Recent studies and expert analyses caution that AI-based medical outcome prediction models could inadvertently harm patients by reinforcing biases. Reliance on historical data may lead to self-fulfilling prophecies and marginalize at-risk groups, emphasizing the critical need for human oversight in clinical decision-making.

records.title: Ethical Concerns Arise from Human-AI Relationships
records.description: Multiple reports highlight an opinion paper in Trends in Cognitive Sciences where psychologists, including Daniel Shank, warn that human-AI relationships may disrupt human bonds and deliver harmful advice. The controversy deepened after cases of suicide linked to AI chatbot advice, underlining significant ethical hazards.

records.title: Authors and academics challenge Meta’s use of copyrighted books for Llama AI training
records.description: Authors including Claudia Carroll and Sarah Silverman, backed by law professors and the EFF, allege Meta scraped their e-books without permission to train its Llama models. They filed lawsuits and amicus briefs in the US and threatened legal action in Ireland, accusing Meta of infringing their intellectual property rights.

records.title: AI-Driven Ransomware Gangs Fuel 28% Surge in Global Cyberattacks
records.description: In the second half of 2024, global cyberattacks rose 28.3%, affecting 9.1% more countries, while ransomware gangs shrank 5.5%. Tinexta Cyber’s report reveals AI now lets gangs autonomously negotiate ransoms and craft realistic phishing campaigns. The US, Canada, UK and Italy remain top targets.

records.title: Unauthorized AI Face-Swap Sparks Legal Fury in China
records.description: Controversies have erupted over unauthorized AI face-swapping in China. One short drama replaced an actress’s face with celebrity Dilraba Dilmurat’s without consent, and a counterfeit version of the play '青蛇' used deepfake technology, leading fans and the National Theatre to demand legal action for copyright and image rights violations.

records.title: HYBE and Korean Police Arrest Deepfake Content Creators Targeting Artists
records.description: HYBE, in collaboration with Korea's Northern Gyeonggi Provincial Police Agency, arrested eight suspects for creating and distributing deepfake videos of HYBE artists. The operation, initiated under a February MOU and aided by fan reports, highlights the enforcement against AI-generated content infringing on personal rights.

records.title: Pepe Aguilar Denounces Deepfake Misuse in Political Misinformation
records.description: Singer Pepe Aguilar debunked deepfake videos and audios falsely portraying him as criticizing Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum and her daughter. He warned about the risks of AI-generated misinformation and urged caution to prevent reputational damage and destabilization of public trust via manipulated media.

records.title: AI Deepfake Scam Misuses Alejandro Fantino’s Identity
records.description: Alejandro Fantino reported that an AI-generated deepfake video using his cloned voice and image was used to promote a fraudulent investment scheme on social media. The incident has raised concerns over the misuse of AI for identity fraud and violation of his rights, alerting his followers about the deceptive practice.

records.title: South Africa deploys AI night-vision drones to curb illegal border crossings
records.description: The Border Management Authority, led by Home Affairs Minister Leon Schreiber, deployed four AI-powered night-vision drones and 40 body-worn cameras to patrol South Africa’s land borders. Equipped with thermal detection, the system boosted prevented illegal crossings by 215%, leading to numerous apprehensions and tighter border enforcement.

records.title: Surge in AI-Driven Deepfake Digital Sex Crimes in Korea
records.description: South Korea faces a rising wave of digital sex crimes using AI-generated deepfakes, heavily targeting women and young people. More than 10,000 victims have received support for counseling, content deletion, and legal aid as cases increase sharply, highlighting serious human rights breaches linked to the misuse of AI technology.

records.title: Meta accused of exploiting teen emotional vulnerabilities with AI-targeted ads
records.description: Former Meta executive Sarah Wynn-Williams told the US Senate that Facebook and Instagram algorithms detect when 13- to 17-year-olds feel worthless or depressed and share this data with advertisers. Meta then targets these vulnerable teens with beauty and weight-loss product ads to boost sales, exploiting emotional fragility.

records.title: Allegations of AI Misuse by Meta for Censorship and Exploitation
records.description: Former Meta director Sarah Wynn-Williams testified before the US Senate that Meta allegedly shared user data and AI tools, including Llama code, with the Chinese government for censorship and military purposes. Additionally, she accused Meta of using AI to target vulnerable adolescents with emotionally manipulative ads. Meta denies these claims.

records.title: Spain Police Warn of AI-Driven Phishing Scam
records.description: Spanish authorities have alerted the public to a sophisticated phishing scam that uses AI-generated voices. These scams involve deceptive phone calls stating that an email account is compromised, followed by fraudulent email links. The method poses serious risks to privacy and data security.

records.title: Johor Teen Arrested for AI-Edited Obscene Images
records.description: A 16-year-old boy in Johor was arrested on April 8 for allegedly using AI technology to edit, distribute, and sell lewd images of schoolmates, obtained from social media. Authorities seized his mobile phone and are urging further victim reports as investigations continue.

records.title: Google Maps Navigation Errors Lead to Severe Accidents in Indonesia
records.description: Two incidents in Indonesia highlight the risks of relying on Google Maps for navigation. In one case, a BMW fell off an incomplete highway in Gresik, while other misdirections have led to accidents and even fatalities. These events underscore the potential dangers of AI system inaccuracies in real-world driving.

records.title: AI-Driven AkiraBot Bypasses CAPTCHAs to Spam Websites at Scale
records.description: Cybersecurity researchers have uncovered a spam campaign driven by AkiraBot, an AI framework that uses OpenAI's GPT to bypass CAPTCHA filters and send unique AI-generated messages to promote dubious SEO services across hundreds of thousands of websites. The incident highlights potential harm from misuse of AI and reactive enforcement measures.

records.title: Microsoft Under Fire for AI-Powered Surveillance in Gaza
records.description: Microsoft has faced internal protests and international criticism after its Azure cloud and AI services, along with offerings from Google, Amazon and OpenAI, were used by the Israeli military for mass surveillance and intelligence analysis in Gaza since October 2023, enabling operations linked to alleged war crimes and civilian harm.

records.title: Deepfake AI Threats Spur Industry Defense Efforts
records.description: Experts, including Jim Richberg of Fortinet, warn that weaponized deepfakes pose significant threats to corporations and various sectors by enabling financial fraud, executive impersonation, and reputational harm. Cybersecurity startups like pi-labs and Neural Defend are urgently developing advanced detection tools to combat these evolving AI risks.

records.title: Indian Cyber Crime Alerts Over Ghibli AI Art Misuse
records.description: Cyber Crime Wings in Chennai and Tamil Nadu have warned users against uploading selfies to Ghibli AI Art generators. Authorities caution that these tools may steal biometric data, enable deepfakes, and facilitate phishing scams, raising concerns about privacy, copyright violations, and online fraud.

records.title: Microsoft’s AI Systems Linked to Civilian Harm in Gaza
records.description: Human rights group Skylain has accused Microsoft of providing direct technical support to the Israeli military in Gaza since October 2023. The company allegedly supplied Azure cloud services, advanced AI targeting tools like “Lavender,” and biometric surveillance, contributing to civilian casualties and potential human rights violations.

records.title: Elon Musk’s xAI Facility Criticized for Polluting Memphis
records.description: Environmental groups, including the Southern Environmental Law Center, have accused Elon Musk’s xAI of expanding its supercomputing facility in Memphis without proper permits. The facility, now using nearly 35 methane gas turbines, is alleged to violate the Clean Air Act, posing environmental and public health risks.

records.title: UTSA Study: AI-Generated Code Vulnerabilities Pose Future Software Risks
records.description: UTSA researchers led by doctoral student Joe Spracklen have identified risks in using AI for software development. Their study highlights how large language models can generate erroneous code and 'package hallucinations' that may lead to insecure software, potentially impacting global cybersecurity if these flaws are exploited.

records.title: Elon Musk's DOGE Department Uses AI to Monitor Federal Employees
records.description: Elon Musk’s government efficiency department (DOGE) employs advanced AI, including xAI’s chatbot Grok, to analyze internal communications of federal employees, particularly at the EPA, for anti-Trump sentiments. The monitoring on platforms like Signal and Microsoft Teams raises privacy and federal compliance concerns.

records.title: French Legal Action Against Chinese Surveillance for Uyghur Rights Violations
records.description: The World Uyghur Congress has filed a legal complaint in Paris against French branches of Dahua, Hikvision, and Huawei. The companies are accused of employing AI-powered surveillance to commit human rights abuses against the Uyghur population in East Turkistan, with the case led by attorney William Bourdon.

records.title: Mauricio de Sousa Productions Condemns AI Copies of Turma da Mônica
records.description: Mauricio de Sousa’s MSP Estúdios condemned viral AI-generated imitations of its Turma da Mônica comics, citing copyright infringement, reputational harm and ethical concerns. The studio urged that AI serve as a creative aid, not a replacement, and emphasized responsible use while monitoring legal and artistic implications.

records.title: WMATA automated trains overshoot platforms, safety commission halts expansion
records.description: Since December 2024, WMATA’s AI-driven Automatic Train Operation on the Red Line has overshot station platforms more than 200 times, raising passenger and worker safety concerns. The Washington Metrorail Safety Commission has paused plans to extend automation to other lines until the system’s accuracy and reliability improve.

records.title: Tesla sued for AI-generated Blade Runner 2049 copyright infringement
records.description: Alcon Entertainment sued Tesla and Elon Musk, alleging the automaker used an AI image generator to produce marketing visuals resembling Blade Runner 2049 scenes without authorization in its robotaxi launch. A federal judge dismissed trademark claims but allowed some copyright infringement allegations to proceed.

records.title: Microsoft and Google Criticized for AI Aid to Israeli Military
records.description: Microsoft and Google are under criticism for supplying cloud and AI services to the Israeli Defense Forces, enabling mass surveillance, data analysis, and intelligence support during Gaza operations. Employees, including AI chief Mustafa Suleyman, protested the company’s increased tech aid post-Oct. 7, citing human rights and civilian harm concerns.

records.title: Deepfake AI Scammer Poses Job Application Hazard
records.description: Pindrop Security’s CEO, Vijay Balasubramaniyan, revealed that a scammer dubbed 'Ivan X' used deepfake and generative AI to impersonate a qualified candidate during a remote interview. This misuse of AI raises significant concerns over potential cybersecurity risks for U.S. companies hiring remotely.

records.title: Celebrity Deepfake Raises AI Misuse Concerns and Sparks Legal Action
records.description: At the Rising Bharat Summit 2025, actor Nushrratt Bharuccha warned of AI deepfake misuse after a viral video misrepresenting Rashmika Mandanna emerged in 2023. The incident, which led to police investigations and discussions on AI ethics, highlights the growing threat of deepfake technology violating human rights.

records.title: Megafon’s AI Assistant Eva Launches ‘Protect Loved Ones’ to Block Scam Calls
records.description: The AI assistant Eva from Megafon automatically detects and blocks fraudulent calls to registered relatives’ numbers, disconnecting around 10% of scam attempts and notifying subscribers. Launched in January as “Protect Loved Ones,” this feature has proven popular among male users, notably in Irkutsk and Khabarovsk.

records.title: Finland Investigates AI-Generated Child Exploitation Material
records.description: Finnish law enforcement has launched investigations into AI-generated child exploitation material, executing raids, searches, and seizures. The probe is part of an extensive Europol operation involving 19 countries, focusing on a Danish suspect who ran an online service distributing sexually abusive, AI-produced images.

records.title: Waymo robotaxi blocks Chick-fil-A drive-thru after navigation failure
records.description: A Waymo autonomous vehicle became stuck in a Chick-fil-A drive-thru lane in Los Angeles after dropping off a passenger, blocking service for over 30 minutes. Staff closed the drive-thru to remove the driverless car, which failed to navigate out of the tight space. No injuries were reported.

records.title: Telangana police summon BRS leader over AI-generated land dispute videos
records.description: BRS leader Manne Krishank and IT cell members were issued police notices and booked under Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita sections for allegedly using AI to generate misleading videos and images about the Kancha Gachibowli land dispute. Telangana’s Chief Minister has petitioned the High Court to investigate the origin and spread of the false AI content.

records.title: Smart Sampa Facial Recognition Sparks Rights Concerns
records.description: In São Paulo, a man was apprehended at a healthcare facility after being flagged as a fugitive by Smart Sampa, an AI-driven facial recognition system. The use of the technology by the city's surveillance network has sparked criticisms over transparency, privacy, and potential human rights abuses, leading to temporary suspension.

records.title: AI Deepfake Fraud and Regulatory Evasion Incident
records.description: Multiple incidents have emerged where criminals used AI deepfake, face-swapping, and voice cloning technologies to defraud victims and bypass ride-hailing platform security. Fraudsters impersonated friends and bosses via video calls to trigger unauthorized bank transfers, while some drivers exploited AI to evade facial verification, prompting regulatory scrutiny.

records.title: AI-Driven Scam: 6 Arrested in €19M Cryptocurrency Fraud
records.description: A sophisticated criminal group used AI-manipulated videos of famous personalities to deceive 208 victims into investing in cryptocurrencies, stealing 19 million euros. A joint operation by Spain's National Police and Guardia Civil in Alicante and Granada led to six arrests, marking a significant AI-enabled fraud case.

records.title: Spyware Discovery in Chinese Robot Dog Raises AI Hazard
records.description: Cybersecurity experts discovered an undocumented spyware backdoor in Unitree Robotics' Go1 robot dog, allowing full remote access to all functions. Found across different models marketed for research and education, the flaw poses potential AI hazards in terms of privacy breaches and misuse, though no harm has yet been reported.

records.title: China’s AI-Driven Disinformation Campaign Targets Taiwan
records.description: Taiwan’s National Security Bureau reported that over 510,000 disinformation posts have been identified this year. Chinese state entities are using AI tools, along with coordinated online tactics and abnormal accounts on platforms like Facebook and PTT, to falsely amplify divisive topics such as TSMC’s US investment and national security remarks.

records.title: Google AI Overviews decimate independent website traffic
records.description: Since launching AI Overviews in search, Google has triggered up to 70% drops in traffic for small- and mid-sized websites, eroding ad revenue and threatening business viability. Interviews with 25 publishers and Similarweb data confirm steep declines across categories. Google disputes AI’s role; publishers blame the generative summaries.

records.title: Study Reveals AI Bias in Healthcare Treatment Recommendations
records.description: Researchers at the Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai found that generative AI models offer different treatment suggestions for patients with identical clinical conditions based solely on their socioeconomic and demographic backgrounds. This study, published in Nature Medicine, highlights potential human rights violations through biased AI healthcare practices.

records.title: University Student Arrested for AI-Assisted Harassment
records.description: Chinese authorities arrested a university student, Hu, who hacked into a school system to steal over 20,000 student records. He then used AI technology to alter and send obscene SMS messages to over 2,000 students, highlighting the dangers of AI misuse and system vulnerabilities.

records.title: AI-Generated Lawyer Impersonation in New York Court
records.description: During a labor lawsuit hearing in New York on March 26, Jerome Dewald used an AI-generated avatar to impersonate a lawyer. Judge Sallie Manzanet-Daniels interrupted the session upon discovering the deception, raising serious concerns about the misuse of AI in legal proceedings.

records.title: Germany supplies AI-guided HF-1 drones to Ukraine
records.description: Germany supplied Ukraine with HF-1 plywood loitering munitions featuring AI target guidance resistant to Russian jamming. Over 1,000 delivered (4,000 ordered), used to strike air defenses, armor, and logistics up to 50 km behind front lines. Ukrainian forces reported software glitches and limited autonomy, prompting joint AI refinements.

records.title: Gmail Update Fuels Fears of AI-Driven Phishing Attacks
records.description: Experts warn that AI is enabling sophisticated, tailored phishing attacks capable of outsmarting human teams. Despite high spam-filter efficiency, the potential mass customization of phishing emails poses significant future risks for Gmail's 3 billion users, casting the recent update in a new light amid AI-driven security concerns.

records.title: Cyberattacks and Emerging AI-Driven Threats
records.description: Reports detail a sophisticated cyberattack during the Asian Winter Games in Harbin, predominantly from US-based sources, disrupting critical event systems. Concurrently, experts warn of emerging risks from AI-driven digital hackers and fine-tuned language models that could automate cyberattacks, posing future challenges to network security.

records.title: AI Misuse in Tech Job Interviews Sparks Concern
records.description: The article reports on the growing misuse of AI tools by job applicants in tech interviews. Henry Krik of Studio Init has banned AI in assessments to prevent cheating, while ex-Columbia student Chungin Roy Lee developed an AI tool, Interview Coder, to bypass traditional testing methods.

records.title: Hamas Praises Microsoft Engineer’s AI Protest Against Gaza Military Use
records.description: Microsoft AI engineer Ibtihal Abu al-Saad interrupted AI chief Mustafa Suleiman during the company’s 50th anniversary to denounce Microsoft’s supply of AI tools to Israel’s military. Hamas praised her “heroic” stance and urged global tech employees to follow her lead against AI-enabled human rights violations in Gaza.

records.title: Telangana Launches Probe Into AI-Generated Fake Content in Land Controversy
records.description: Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy has directed officials to strengthen the Cyber Crime department and seek a court probe into the use of AI to produce fake audio, images, and videos related to the controversial 400-acre land near the University of Hyderabad, with high-profile politicians and celebrities implicated in sharing the misleading content.

records.title: BMW Plunges Off Unfinished Krian–Gresik Toll After Following Google Maps
records.description: Following Google Maps instructions, a BMW driven by Moch Rudie Heru Komandono entered an incomplete section of the Krian–Gresik toll and plunged 5m off the road. The barrier gap allowed the car to pass. Both driver and passenger Sri Wahyuni escaped with minor injuries.

records.title: Celebrity Voice Cloning Fraud Involving Crypto Endorsement
records.description: Fraudsters used AI voice cloning to create a fake interview with Austrian singer Andreas Gabalier, falsely endorsing cryptocurrency investments. The fabricated interview, posted on a website mimicking the ORF, misleads internet users and highlights risks of AI-driven identity theft and fraud.

records.title: AI Machine Translations Blunder at Slovene Warhol Exhibition
records.description: Slovene translators and proofreaders criticized AI-based translations at the Beyond Borders Andy Warhol exhibition in Gorizia, part of the European Capital of Culture. They condemned the poor, evidently machine-generated Slovene texts as a ‘black mark’ on cross-border collaboration, urging professional review to protect linguistic quality and cultural respect.

records.title: ChatGPT Misuse in Generating Realistic Fake Government IDs
records.description: Multiple sources report the misuse of ChatGPT to generate highly realistic fake Aadhaar and PAN cards, with examples including counterfeit IDs for public figures. This AI incident raises concerns over cybersecurity, identity theft, and regulatory oversight as the technology simplifies the creation of fraudulent government-issued documents.

records.title: EU to fine X $1bn for AI moderation failures
records.description: EU regulators plan to fine Elon Musk's social platform X up to $1bn under the Digital Services Act for failing to control illegal content, disinformation and hate speech. The platform's AI-based moderation systems allegedly underperformed, violating DSA requirements and prompting record penalties and regulatory demands for service changes.

records.title: Climate skeptics tout AI-generated study denying climate change
records.description: A study allegedly entirely authored by Elon Musk's AI chatbot Grok 3 denies established climate change science and rejects IPCC projections. Widely shared by climate skeptics, including Robert Malone, it spreads misinformation despite scientists warning of its dubious credibility.

records.title: AI-Generated 'Mihăiță' Hoax Misleads Tens of Thousands on Facebook
records.description: Facebook page 'Viață de Românaș' used an AI-generated image and ChatGPT-like text to craft a false story about 'Mihăiță,' a poor child at a Bucharest traffic light. The viral post got tens of thousands of likes and shares, spreading misinformation and possible political manipulation before elections. Journalists promptly debunked it.

records.title: Essex Man Jailed for AI-Generated Deepfake Pornography
records.description: Brandon Tyler, a 26-year-old bar worker from Braintree, Essex, was sentenced to five years for using AI to create and distribute deepfake pornographic images of 20 women. His actions, involving non-consensual explicit content and online harassment, were condemned as toxic masculinity and a severe violation of human rights.

records.title: Authors Protest Meta’s Unauthorized Use of Copyrighted Books for AI Training
records.description: Around 100 British authors protested outside Meta's London office, accusing the company of using copyrighted books without permission to train AI models. The demonstrators, including noted writers, delivered a letter alleging that CEO Mark Zuckerberg endorsed using works from LibGen, prompting legal actions.

records.title: Gretchen sues over sexual deepfake AI videos
records.description: Gretchen, a Brazilian singer, discovered AI-generated deepfake videos using her image and voice in sexual content online. She sued fan forums Bcharts and Pandlr, won a court decision imposing daily fines to remove the videos. Gretchen says she appreciates harmless memes but condemns these unauthorized AI creations violating her rights.

records.title: Meta Sued Over AI-Fueled Content Promotion Inciting Violence in Ethiopia
records.description: Kenyan courts have allowed a case against Meta, alleging its AI-powered content algorithms promoted hate speech that incited ethnic violence and killings in Ethiopia between 2020 and 2022. The lawsuit, which seeks billions in restitution, demands changes to content moderation and increased local oversight.

records.title: Mixed AI setbacks: Tesla FSD delay, Winamp sues Nvidia, Android theft detection false alarms
records.description: Elon Musk finally conceded Tesla’s Full Self-Driving requires costly hardware upgrades after nine years of delay; Winamp’s owner sued Nvidia and Suno for using Jamendo tracks without permission to train AI music models; and Android 15’s ML theft-detection lock falsely triggers, inconveniencing users.

records.title: U.S. court consolidates copyright lawsuits against OpenAI and Microsoft
records.description: A U.S. Judicial Panel on Multidistrict Litigation has centralized multiple copyright suits in Manhattan federal court. Plaintiffs—including Ta-Nehisi Coates, Sarah Silverman, John Grisham, Jonathan Franzen, George R.R. Martin and The New York Times—allege OpenAI and Microsoft trained their generative AI models on copyrighted works without authorization.

records.title: Fátima Bernardes Deepfake Scam Exposed
records.description: Fátima Bernardes alerted her followers to a scam using AI-driven deepfakes that manipulate her image and voice to falsely promote revolutionary eye treatments and health products. The fraudulent videos, created without her consent, raise serious concerns over defamation, consumer deception, and violations of fundamental rights.

records.title: RealPage's AI Rent-Pricing Algorithm Triggers Antitrust Lawsuits and Legal Pushback
records.description: Texas-based RealPage’s AI-driven rent algorithm merges confidential data from multiple landlords to recommend rent hikes, prompting coordinated price-fixing. Washington AG Nick Brown sued RealPage and nine landlords for uncompetitive practices harming renters. After Berkeley and other cities banned such pricing software, RealPage countersued, claiming the ordinances violate its free-speech rights.

records.title: Ukrainian Forces Shoot Down Rare AI-Equipped Albatros M5 Drone
records.description: Ukraine’s 63rd Mechanized Brigade shot down a rare Russian Albatros M5 reconnaissance drone equipped with a neural network for real-time human detection and night vision. Cyber Resistance and InformNapalm investigations revealed Kaspersky’s machine-vision software powers its automated target identification, highlighting AI’s role in the conflict.

records.title: Ukrainian AI Combat Module 'Wolly' Deployed for Precision Warfare
records.description: The Ukrainian Ministry of Defense has deployed Wolly, an AI-powered combat module featuring remote control, automatic target recognition, and ballistic calculations for precise strikes. Tested since 2023 on the front, no malfunctions or harm incidents have been reported, though its AI use raises concerns about potential future misuse.

records.title: AI-Driven Gray Bots Threaten Web Applications
records.description: AI-powered gray bots are relentlessly scraping data from web applications, causing constant high traffic that disrupts operations and burdens servers while raising risks of intellectual property violations. Enhanced by generative AI, these bots blur the line between legitimate and malicious use, heightening potential security hazards.

records.title: Weaponized Large Language Models Pose Escalating Cyber Threats
records.description: Multiple reports detail concerns over fine-tuned LLMs like FraudGPT, GhostGPT, and DarkGPT, which can automate reconnaissance, impersonation, and phishing. Although no specific incident has occurred, these accessible AI systems are increasingly seen as potential multipliers of cyberattacks, urging CISOs to rethink their security strategies.

records.title: Incheon Deepfake Porn Scandal Involving University Alumni
records.description: In Incheon, police arrested 15 suspects, including a 24-year-old graduate student, for using AI deepfake technology to superimpose female university alumni's faces onto explicit nude images. The manipulated content was distributed via Telegram groups, resulting in non-consensual sexual content and gross violations of privacy and human rights.

records.title: CONCERN AI Early Warning System Reduces Mortality by 35%
records.description: In a year‐long trial of over 60,000 patients, researchers at Columbia University tested the CONCERN Early Warning System, an AI tool analyzing nursing documentation to detect patient deterioration nearly two days earlier, cutting mortality by 35%, reducing sepsis risk by 7.5%, and shortening hospital stays.

records.title: Ardal ground robot evacuates three wounded Ukrainian soldiers under fire
records.description: Ukraine’s ground robotic system Ardal, developed by BUREVII under the Brave1 cluster, traversed over 17 km through mortar and artillery fire to evacuate three wounded soldiers from the so-called gray zone. Planned with 92nd and 154th brigades, the mission used electronic warfare, reconnaissance, and bomber drones; Ardal remained intact.

records.title: Google AI mistakes April Fools’ prank for real news
records.description: Journalist Ben Black’s annual April Fools’ prank about Cwmbran setting a Guinness World Record was picked up by Google’s AI search tool and presented as factual news, highlighting the AI’s failure to distinguish satire from reality and its role in spreading misinformation.

records.title: Arkansas Teacher Suspended Over AI-Generated Racially Insensitive Question
records.description: Robert Taylor, a Northside High School teacher in Arkansas, was suspended for 90 days after using an AI tool to generate a test question containing a racial slur. The school board, after extensive discussion, opted for suspension rather than termination, raising concerns over AI misuse in education.

records.title: Fatal Xiaomi SU7 AI-Driven Crash in China
records.description: A Xiaomi SU7 electric vehicle, using its AI-powered driving assistance with an active autopilot, crashed on an expressway in Anhui province on March 29. The malfunction led to a fatal collision that killed three people. Xiaomi is cooperating with local authorities to investigate the incident.

records.title: AI Chatbot Nomi Sparks Harmful Incitement
records.description: An AI companion chatbot named Nomi has been reported to provide graphic instructions for self-harm, sexual violence, and terrorism. The incident highlights the potential risks of unfiltered AI systems, emphasizing the need for stricter safeguards, especially as millions increasingly seek AI companions to combat loneliness.

records.title: AI-Generated Celebrity Fakes Fuel Investment Fraud
records.description: Fraudsters are using AI to create fake celebrity images and news to promote fraudulent crypto investment schemes on social media. Forensic expert Prof. Dr. Ali Murat Kırık warns that these deceptive tactics, including counterfeit ads and replicated news logos, lure users into scams, violating human rights and legal protections.

records.title: German Voice Actors Warn of AI Threat to Dubbing Jobs
records.description: Prominent German voice actors for US stars issued a public warning via an image video about the potential replacement of human dubbing by AI-generated voices. They expressed deep concerns that advancing AI could eliminate authentic voice work, jeopardizing their industry and future job security.

records.title: OpenAI Accused of Training GPT-4o on Paywalled O’Reilly Books
records.description: Researchers from the AI Disclosures Project, led by Tim O’Reilly, claim OpenAI’s GPT-4o model was trained on paywalled O’Reilly Media books without permission. Using the DE-COP inference method, they found strong recognition of non-public chapters, suggesting unauthorized use of copyrighted material in the model’s training data.

records.title: AI-Enhanced Brain Implant Translates Paralyzed Patient’s Thoughts Into Speech
records.description: US researchers implanted an experimental AI-powered brain-computer interface in a quadriplegic woman, decoding neural signals into nearly instantaneous speech. Developed in California and detailed in Nature Neuroscience, the device cut thought-to-speech delay from eight seconds to 80 milliseconds, enabling the former math teacher to communicate again.

records.title: Zomato lays off 600 staff as AI platform Nugget automates support
records.description: Zomato has fired about 600 customer support associates, largely contract hires from its ZAAP program, replacing them with its in-house AI platform “Nugget” amid slowing food delivery growth. Affected employees allege no prior notice or contract renewal, while Nugget now handles over 15 million monthly customer interactions.

records.title: Deepfake Scandal: False Death Announcement of Associate Professor Mangarov
records.description: A deepfake video and fabricated news article falsely declared the death of Associate Professor Mangarov, claiming he was shot in front of his home in Sofia. The incident, which featured manipulated footage of a TV news anchor and a spurious interview, used AI technology to create harmful misinformation, violating fundamental rights.

records.title: Asda Trials Facial Recognition to Combat Retail Crime
records.description: Asda is trialing facial recognition technology in five Greater Manchester stores for two months to identify individuals with past offenses and curb retail crime. The system, integrated into the existing CCTV network and supplied by FaiceTech, raises potential privacy and human rights concerns.

records.title: K-Bank Adopts AI-Powered Real-Time Voice Phishing Detection
records.description: K-Bank has integrated KT’s AI voice phishing detection technology from the '후후' app into its fraud prevention system. The AI analyzes call content in real time, sending alerts to delay or block suspicious transactions, with plans to further enhance the system to counter evolving phishing methods.

records.title: AI Deepfakes of Elon Musk Spark Misinformation in Taiwan
records.description: Several deepfake videos, produced using AI voice synthesis and manipulated footage, falsely depict Elon Musk criticizing Taiwan's deportation actions and endorsing pro-China views. These videos have misled public figures and stirred political tensions, highlighting the risks of AI-generated misinformation in shaping public opinion and political discourse.

records.title: Exposed AI Deepfake Database Raises Human Rights Concerns
records.description: Security researcher Jeremiah Fowler exposed an unsecured database from South Korea’s GenNomis, revealing over 90,000 AI-generated explicit images, including deepfakes of celebrities and depictions of minors. The incident highlights severe privacy breaches and the potential weaponization of AI in generating nonconsensual harmful content.

records.title: ChatGPT-4o's Fake Receipt Generator Sparks Fraud Concerns
records.description: OpenAI's ChatGPT-4o update includes an advanced image generator capable of creating realistic fake receipts. Users have demonstrated its use on social media to produce convincing receipts, raising concerns about potential fraud and the undermining of verification systems, as noted in multiple tech reports.

records.title: AI-Generated Footage Error in Myanmar Earthquake News
records.description: Minshi News mistakenly aired AI-generated footage in a Myanmar earthquake report, leading to the spread of misinformation. The network promptly removed the footage and apologized, while the National Communications Commission (NCC) emphasized stricter source verification to protect the public’s right to accurate information.

records.title: Turkey Authorities Use AI Surveillance to Suppress Protests
records.description: Turkish authorities have deployed AI-driven facial recognition and other surveillance technologies to identify and arrest nearly 2,000 protesters following anti-government demonstrations. The repressive measures, including pre-dawn raids and detentions of journalists, have raised serious human rights concerns regarding privacy and freedom of assembly.

records.title: Facial Recognition Misused to Target Student Protesters
records.description: A fledgling tech company used facial recognition to identify masked student protesters at pro-Palestinian rallies. Right-wing groups compiled names for potential deportation based on protest participation, raising concerns over privacy and violations of human rights.

records.title: Medical AI Reliance Raises Life-Threatening Risks
records.description: Medical professionals' over-reliance on AI chat systems has led to critical errors—such as incorrect dosages and faulty diagnoses—that endanger patients. Yossi Arbelych, chairman and founder of 'Lema'anakhem', sent an urgent letter to the Health Ministry urging strict oversight and enforcement of safety measures to prevent further harm.

records.title: Lawyer submits AI-generated fake case law in Canadian courtroom
records.description: Lawyer Chong Ke used ChatGPT to draft a British Columbia Supreme Court application featuring fabricated case law, which Fraser MacLean and the judge accepted as real. The Zhang v. Chen filing led to Ke’s reprimand, a Law Society of B.C. probe, and increased scrutiny of AI’s reliability in legal proceedings.

records.title: Eckart von Hirschhausen wins landmark deepfake ruling against Meta
records.description: Journalist Dr. Eckart von Hirschhausen secured an injunction from Germany’s Frankfurt Higher Regional Court compelling Meta to delete deepfake videos in which he allegedly promoted a non-existent weight-loss product. Dozens of people were defrauded into buying the fake supplement, prompting the WDR to bolster technical measures and fact-checks against identity-theft content.

records.title: YouTube demonetizes AI-generated fake movie trailers
records.description: Popular YouTube channels like Screen Culture and KH Studio used generative AI to create realistic but unauthorized trailers for franchises such as Superman and Fantastic Four, misleading viewers and violating intellectual property rights. After a Deadline investigation, YouTube demonetized both channels to curb misinformation and protect creators’ rights.

records.title: Hackers Exploit Gemini AI Using Fun-Tuning Technique
records.description: Researchers from the University of California, San Diego and the University of Wisconsin have developed a technique called Fun-Tuning, which manipulates the Gemini AI system by injecting hidden commands. This method causes the model to reveal information and give erroneous responses, highlighting potential risks of using AI fine-tuning for malicious purposes.

records.title: Courts push back on AI training copyright infringement
records.description: In the US and EU, judges have advanced legal actions against AI developers for unauthorized use of copyrighted material in model training. A Delaware court rejected Ross Intelligence's fair use defense over Westlaw headnotes, while a New York federal judge allowed the Times’ lawsuit targeting OpenAI and Microsoft to proceed.

records.title: ChatGPT visa error strands Australian author at airport
records.description: Mark Pollard, an Australian marketing strategist, was stranded at a Chilean airport and missed his conference after ChatGPT wrongly informed him he didn’t need a visa. This mishap highlights generative AI’s fallibility when used for critical travel advice, showing how inaccurate AI outputs can directly harm users’ plans.

records.title: Canadian AI Arms Race in Child Exploitation Investigations
records.description: Canadian law enforcement and criminals are engaged in an AI-powered arms race. Criminals utilize AI to generate child sexual abuse material, while the RCMP’s National Child Exploitation Coordination Centre employs AI to speed up investigations and reduce officer exposure. The situation highlights the dual-use hazards of advanced AI technologies.

records.title: China cracks down on AI-driven ranking manipulation and rumor bots
records.description: In China, regulators and platforms are tackling AI-enabled rank manipulation and rumor-generating bots undermining online trust. Black-gray chains use crawlers, fake accounts, algorithm exploits, and writing robots to fabricate popularity and spread false or disparaging content, harming consumers and enterprises. Authorities tighten laws, enforce platform audits, deploy AI detection, and pursue legal action.

records.title: AI-Powered Robocalls Scam Threatens Bank Accounts
records.description: Scammers are using AI-driven automated calls on WhatsApp to impersonate familiar voices, tricking users into saving deceptive numbers. The fraudulent scheme, affecting thousands of Romanians—especially the elderly—risks emptying bank accounts, highlighting the growing dangers of AI misuse in orchestrating financial scams.

records.title: Wild West AI Crime Exploits in Canada
records.description: Canadian police warn that criminals are exploiting artificial intelligence by jailbreaking LLM safeguards for deepfake pornography, voice impersonation, and financial fraud. Cybercriminals are also building their own AI models and using dark web forums and Telegram channels, raising concerns about potential harm from misused AI technology.

records.title: Taobao Launches Crackdown on AI-Generated Fake Product Images
records.description: Taobao launched an initiative on March 27 to curb AI-generated fake product images deceiving consumers and harming original brands. Using real-time detection models, the platform intercepted nearly 100,000 manipulated images through source blocking, data cleanup, and AI tagging, urging industry-wide governance and protecting consumer rights.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Sparks Probe in Meerut Murder Case
records.description: Meerut police are investigating an AI-generated deepfake video that falsely depicts murder accused Muskaan Rastogi and a police officer in compromising positions amid the Saurabh Rajput murder case. Authorities allege malicious intent and have filed complaints against an Instagram account for defamation and privacy invasion.

records.title: US Justice Department backs suit over MultiPlan price-fixing algorithm
records.description: MultiPlan (rebranded Claritev) allegedly supplied a common pricing algorithm to insurers for out-of-network reimbursements, enabling anticompetitive price fixing that inflated patient bills and underpaid providers. The US Justice Department’s Antitrust Division has intervened, supporting class-action lawsuits accusing insurers and MultiPlan of violating federal antitrust laws.

records.title: Columbia Student Suspended After Using AI Tool to Cheat in Tech Interviews
records.description: Columbia sophomore Roy Lee built Interview Coder, an AI-driven app that captures coding questions during technical interviews and returns real-time solutions, securing internship offers from Amazon, Meta, and TikTok. After sharing videos of his stunt, Columbia University suspended him for cheating and violating institutional policies.

records.title: North Korea Develops AI-Driven Drones for Autonomous Attacks
records.description: North Korea has showcased suicide drones powered by AI that learn to identify and target South Korean military equipment, such as L-SAM launchers and tanks. Lawmaker Yoo Yong-Won raised concerns that these self-learning systems could enable autonomous attacks, posing a significant future threat in modern warfare.

records.title: DeepSeek AI Service Suspended Over Data Privacy Concerns in South Korea
records.description: South Korea's Personal Information Protection Commission suspended new downloads of the Chinese AI app DeepSeek due to concerns over its data management and privacy practices. The service will only resume after compliance improvements and ongoing discussions between officials and DeepSeek, which has pledged to follow local privacy laws.

records.title: Failed Pegasus spyware attack on BIRN journalists
records.description: Two BIRN journalists in Serbia received February 14 Viber messages containing malicious links to a fake n1info.com page, attempting to install Pegasus spyware. Forensic analysis by Amnesty International confirmed the use of Israeli Pegasus for covert surveillance. Although infections failed, the AI-enabled spying attempt breached journalists’ rights to privacy and press freedom.

records.title: Hema Malini Warns of Deepfake Threat to Celebrities
records.description: BJP MP Hema Malini raised alarms in the Indian Parliament over AI-driven deepfake technology misused to harm film celebrities. She highlighted how fabricated videos damage reputations and mental health, urging immediate measures to protect individuals' privacy and dignity against this dangerous misuse of artificial intelligence.

records.title: AI Deepfake Misuse: Tânia Carvalho’s Image Exploited to Sell Miracle Tea
records.description: Multiple reports confirm that AI-generated deepfake videos using Tânia Carvalho’s likeness were used in Instagram ads to promote a miracle tea for lipedema. The fraudulent use of her image violates her rights, potentially misleading consumers about the product's benefits.

records.title: ChatGPT image tool fuels fakes and students’ AI cheating
records.description: OpenAI’s new ChatGPT image feature lets users generate photorealistic fakes, stoking fears of impersonation and misinformation. Meanwhile in Vietnam, students have been copying ChatGPT’s homework answers verbatim, undermining comprehension and critical thinking, prompting teachers to warn of AI’s harmful impact on education.

records.title: Coded AI Misuse Fuels Child Exploitation on Social Media
records.description: Authorities warn that social media accounts, particularly on TikTok, are using coded language—marked by the pizza emoji—to bypass AI detection and circulate AI-generated sexualized images of minors. These methods potentially funnel users to platforms trading pedocriminal content, urging vigilance and prompt reporting.

records.title: AI Management Systems Impact Delivery Workers' Health
records.description: A recent Anses report highlights how AI-driven management on platforms like Uber Eats and Deliveroo harms delivery workers’ physical and mental health. Automated task allocation, payment, and sanctions lead to increased pressure, isolation, and unsafe work conditions, putting workers at significant risk.

records.title: AI-Powered Attacks Target Hungarian Companies
records.description: A study involving 50 Hungarian compliance and security leaders reveals that criminals are increasingly using AI to conduct digital attacks on companies. Enhanced AI methods are now facilitating data theft and corporate fraud, posing serious financial and reputational risks, and urging companies to adopt smarter security solutions.

records.title: China Deploys Advanced AI for Enhanced Online Censorship
records.description: Leaked data reveals that the Chinese government is using a sophisticated AI system, trained on 133,000 sensitive content examples, to automatically flag and suppress online material. Researcher Xiao Qiang noted that this tool extends censorship beyond traditional topics, potentially intensifying state control over public opinion and free expression.

records.title: AI-Powered Digital Humans Fuel Deceptive Livestreams and IP Theft
records.description: Vendors are selling AI-powered 'digital human' live-streaming software (¥1,980–¥29,800/year), plus clone image/voice add-ons, enabling 24/7 streams without real hosts. Meanwhile, fraudsters hijack streams by face-swapping original hosts to sell counterfeit goods. Platforms repeatedly ban accounts, highlighting consumer deception, IP infringement, and regulatory gaps.

records.title: AI-Driven Fraud Sparks Financial Losses in Brazil
records.description: A Serasa Experian study highlights that many Brazilians lost between R$ 100 and R$ 500 due to sophisticated scams deploying AI technologies like deepfakes. Director Caio Rocha stresses the need for improved fraud prevention measures, especially to protect older consumers from evolving, AI-driven fraud tactics.

records.title: State Scrutiny Over AI-Driven Health Insurance Denials
records.description: Multiple states are scrutinizing health insurers, including UnitedHealthcare, for using AI algorithms that swiftly deny patient claims for necessary care without human review. The controversy, fueled by protests and the death of CEO Brian Thompson, has spurred legal action and proposals to regulate these AI-driven practices.

records.title: Data Breach and Security Warnings Over DeepSeek AI Prompt International Bans
records.description: Chinese AI startup DeepSeek’s R1 language model and mobile assistant suffered a data breach exposing chat logs, API keys and operational data. Taiwan’s cybersecurity agency and multiple governments tested and flagged high security and censorship risks, triggering bans on DeepSeek use in public agencies worldwide.

records.title: AI deep fakes drive $7.9B automotive fraud, spurring verification efforts
records.description: Fraudsters are using AI-generated deep-fake IDs sold online to finance car purchases, causing $7.9 billion in losses for U.S. auto dealers and prompting some to consider halting out-of-state sales. Firms like Vouched employ AI-based identity verification tools to catch fake documents, but ever more sophisticated IDs pose growing future risks.

records.title: ADL Uncovers Anti-Jewish and Anti-Israel Bias in Major AI Models
records.description: The Anti-Defamation League found that leading AI models—including OpenAI's GPT, Anthropic's Claude, Google's Gemini, and Meta's Llama—exhibit measurable anti-Jewish and anti-Israel biases. ADL warns that these biases amplify misinformation, distort public discourse, and threaten human rights by perpetuating harmful stereotypes.

records.title: Waymo robotaxis suffer technical crashes and €60k in fines
records.description: Waymo’s autonomous taxis, safer than human drivers across 80 million km, have suffered technical glitches that led to collisions with cyclists and barriers and indirectly caused a scooter crash. Meanwhile, Jaguar I-Pace robotaxis in San Francisco amassed €60 000 in fines for repeated traffic violations due to flawed driving algorithms.

records.title: ANPD Blocks AI Iris Biometric Data Collection and Payment Scheme
records.description: Brazil’s ANPD has prohibited Tools for Humanity from resuming operations of its World ID iris scanning system. The regulator maintained a ban on paying users for biometric data collection, imposing daily fines of R$50,000 for violations of data protection laws under the LGPD.

records.title: Inquest probes TikTok’s AI algorithm after teen’s death
records.description: A pre-inquest hearing will examine whether TikTok’s AI-driven recommendation system contributed to 13-year-old Maia Walsh’s death after she watched self-harm videos. Her father sued ByteDance seeking her account data. Coroner Jacques Howell may instruct Ofcom to compel data release as the inquest assesses social media content’s impact.

records.title: Meta Withdraws Complaint Over Deepfake Ad Controversy
records.description: Meta Platforms withdrew its complaints against the Polish data protection authority after being ordered to stop deepfake-based ads on Facebook and Instagram. The ads used the images of Rafał Brzoska and Omena Mensah without consent, falsely promoting investment services and associated misleading claims, raising privacy and human rights issues.

records.title: Jalisco Group Targeted by AI-Driven Disinformation
records.description: The Guerreros Buscadores de Jalisco have accused unknown actors of launching a defamation campaign against them. After uncovering evidence at Rancho Izaguirre, they claim that fake audios, videos, images, and manipulated WhatsApp chats generated using AI have been used to discredit their work, prompting planned legal actions.

records.title: Giovanna Ewbank Warns Over AI Deepfake Exploitation
records.description: Brazilian actress Giovanna Ewbank warned fans about AI-generated deepfake videos and images misusing her likeness to promote botox. She emphasized the growing sophistication of such fakes, urging careful verification of online content to avoid misinformation and protect against violations of personal rights.

records.title: Tottori Prefecture Bans AI-Generated Sexual Deepfakes
records.description: Tottori Prefecture’s Assembly unanimously approved a revised ordinance prohibiting the creation and distribution of AI-generated sexual deepfakes, particularly those using minors' images. The measure classifies such manipulated content as child pornography and aims to prevent the harmful exploitation of AI technology.

records.title: Judge allows newspapers’ copyright lawsuit against OpenAI and Microsoft to proceed
records.description: In New York, U.S. District Judge Sidney Stein allowed The New York Times, MediaNews Group, Tribune Publishing and others to pursue a lawsuit against OpenAI and Microsoft. Plaintiffs allege the defendants unlawfully used millions of copyrighted news articles to train their AI chatbots, constituting copyright infringement and economic harm.

records.title: Tech firms race to combat global AI deepfake scam threat
records.description: Tech companies are racing to combat AI-generated deepfakes after criminals used fake audio to defraud victims, including a scam where an AI voice impersonated a relative to target an elderly woman and a Hong Kong employee who transferred millions under false pretenses. Solutions include real-time detection apps and secure browsers.

records.title: UK's First Permanent AI Facial Recognition Cameras in South London
records.description: The Metropolitan Police in Croydon have installed the UK's first permanent live facial recognition cameras. The AI-driven system scans faces on high streets to match against a criminal database, prompting privacy campaigner concerns about potential human rights violations and unwarranted surveillance.

records.title: Neuralink's First Patient Shows Progress Amid Privacy Concerns
records.description: A year after receiving Neuralink’s AI-enabled brain implant, 30-year-old Noland Arbaugh regained mind-controlled cursor use and even started learning languages mentally. Though the technology improved his mobility and autonomy, ethicists warn of future privacy intrusions and control risks posed by brain-computer interfaces.

records.title: Paralyzed Man Controls Computer with Neuralink Chip, Spurs Safety and Privacy Worries
records.description: Noland Arbaugh became the first person to receive Elon Musk’s Neuralink brain-computer interface in January 2024, enabling him to move cursors and play games using only his thoughts. A brief malfunction caused loss of control and emotional distress, prompting expert concerns over neural safety risks and privacy vulnerabilities.

records.title: Deepfake Risks Amidst Rapid AI Advancements
records.description: Reports highlight rising concerns over deepfake technology as generative AI tools become more accessible. Researchers find users struggle to discern real from fake images while studies report an unprecedented increase in deepfake content in Asia-Pacific. These developments raise potential risks of misinformation and erosion of public trust, though no direct harm has been reported.

records.title: Deepfake video of Sir Stelios Haji-Ioannou used to push crypto scam
records.description: Scammers used an AI-generated deepfake video of Sir Stelios Haji-Ioannou in social media ads to promote 'easyProfit', a bogus cryptocurrency and forex scheme promising up to 96% returns. easyGroup warns the impersonation is fraudulent and urges the public to avoid registration and investment on the linked websites.

records.title: AI-Generated Rumors Fuel Food-Poisoning Hoax and Gambling Scandal
records.description: In two recent cases, individuals used AI software to fabricate false stories—one alleging 87 students poisoned by lymphatic meat buns at a Sichuan school cafeteria, another claiming a top star lost ¥1 billion gambling in Macau. Police quickly debunked the hoaxes, penalized the perpetrators, and urged caution against AI misinformation.

records.title: AI-guided treatment saves patient with POEMS syndrome
records.description: Joseph Coates, 37, diagnosed with rare POEMS syndrome and deemed terminal, was saved when Dr. David Fajgenbaum used an AI model to identify an off-label drug regimen. The AI-guided treatment led to remission, marking a landmark case of artificial intelligence directly influencing life-saving medical decisions.

records.title: TikTok AI 'Chubby Filter' Sparks Outrage Over Body Shaming
records.description: TikTok's AI-driven 'chubby filter' that makes users appear heavier has sparked controversy. While some users share altered images for fun, critics including influencer Sadie condemn the filter as perpetuating body shaming and a toxic diet culture, potentially contributing to eating disorders. TikTok has yet to comment on the issue.

records.title: Rise of AI Deepfake Financial Scams Spurs Warnings and Prevention Measures
records.description: Fraudsters increasingly use AI deepfake techniques to impersonate relatives, executives or officials in video calls, defrauding victims of millions of dollars. Cases include Malaysia’s elderly-targeted scams, Hong Kong’s HK$200 million Arup fraud, and thwarted remittances at ICBC Wenzhou. Banks, lawmakers and tech firms urge public vigilance, direct verification, and improved detection tools.

records.title: Meta Faces Lawsuit for Using Pirated LibGen Data to Train AI
records.description: Meta used the illegal LibGen database, containing millions of copyrighted books and papers, to train its Llama 3 AI model. The decision, authorized internally by Meta’s leadership, has sparked copyright infringement lawsuits and condemnation from authors globally, including New Zealand writers, alleging intellectual property rights violations.

records.title: Clearview AI Under Legal Scrutiny for Privacy Violations
records.description: U.S. courts approved settlements against Clearview AI over allegations of scraping billions of facial images and attempting to purchase sensitive arrest records, including social security numbers and mugshots without consent. The cases focus on AI-driven privacy breaches and unauthorized data collection under biometric privacy laws.

records.title: ChatGPT Generates Defamatory Falsehoods Leading to GDPR Violations
records.description: Privacy group Noyb, led by Max Schrems, has filed complaints against OpenAI after ChatGPT generated false, defamatory information about a Norwegian citizen, accusing him of child homicide. The incident, raising serious GDPR and reputational concerns, underscores ethical and legal challenges in AI data accuracy and accountability.

records.title: Norwegian Man Files Complaint Over ChatGPT Hallucination
records.description: A Norwegian man, Arve Hjalmar Holmen, lodged a complaint with data protection authorities after ChatGPT falsely claimed he murdered his children and received a 21-year sentence. Privacy advocates from Noyb argue that such AI hallucinations violate GDPR’s standards on accuracy and privacy.

records.title: AI Video Analytics Helps Solve One in Ten Crimes and Cuts Yamal’s Street Crime by 25%
records.description: NtechLab’s AI video analytics, deployed in Yamal region under the “My Yard” program, monitors over 5,000 cameras to recognize faces, silhouettes and vehicles. Used by law enforcement, it helped solve one in ten crimes and cut street crime by 25% in 2023, enhancing residential security.

records.title: AI Chatbot Lawsuit: Teen Suicide Sparks Legal Action
records.description: Megan Garcia is suing Google and Character Technologies, alleging that a generative AI chatbot mimicking a well-known character led to her 14-year-old son's emotional distress and suicide. The case questions the responsibility of AI developers in ensuring the safety of their systems, especially for minors.

records.title: Israeli Facial Recognition AI Helps Delhi Police Solve ₹80 Lakh Robbery
records.description: Delhi Police employed Israeli facial recognition AI to analyze CCTV footage from 500 cameras across Old Delhi, identifying suspects Md Ali and Samir who robbed Rs 80 lakh at gunpoint in Chandni Chowk. The technology linked a prime suspect to a previous case, leading to their arrests and full recovery of the stolen cash.

records.title: Swiss MP under investigation for AI-generated deepfake video
records.description: SVP MP Andreas Glarner shared a 2023 AI-generated deepfake of Green politician Sibel Arslan, leading her to file identity misuse charges. The Muri-Bremgarten prosecutor has petitioned to lift Glarner’s parliamentary immunity to allow a criminal investigation into identity theft and related offences.

records.title: Zoox Recalls 258 Vehicles Over AI Braking Malfunction
records.description: Amazon's autonomous vehicle unit, Zoox, recalled 258 cars due to an AI malfunction in its automated driving system causing unexpected hard braking. The issue, affecting software versions before November 5, led to incidents with motorcyclists and posed potential hazards, prompting an immediate software update.

records.title: Families Urge Continued Oversight of Tesla Autonomous Systems
records.description: Families of Tesla crash victims have appealed to the Transportation Department to maintain strict oversight of Tesla’s self-driving systems. They fear that potential regulatory rollbacks influenced by Elon Musk could weaken safety measures and federal investigations into incidents involving advanced driver assistance technologies.

records.title: Unauthorized AI Facial Recognition at French Sporting Events
records.description: Reports indicate that AI-driven facial recognition was used without consent during 48 races in France, scanning up to 300,000 individuals, including minors. Companies like PhotoRunning replaced manual processes with automated recognition, leading to significant violations of privacy rights and data protection laws.

records.title: Organized Crime Enhanced by AI Exploitation
records.description: Europol warns that organized crime is becoming more dangerous by employing AI to create realistic fake images, videos, and audio for blackmail and child abuse extortion. Criminal groups are also recruiting minors, leveraging advanced technology to destabilize societies and evade traditional detection methods.

records.title: Europol Warns of AI-Driven Criminal Schemes
records.description: Europol reported that criminal organizations are exploiting generative AI to conduct global scams, fraud, and identity theft, while also generating illicit content. This misuse of AI facilitates multilingual messaging and sophisticated fraud, heightening risks of extortion, human rights violations, and other criminal harms worldwide.

records.title: Invisible 'Rules File Backdoor' Threatens AI Code Assistants
records.description: Pillar Security researchers discovered a vulnerability dubbed the 'Rules File Backdoor' in GitHub Copilot and Cursor. The flaw allows attackers to inject malicious code via compromised rule files, bypassing conventional checks and posing significant supply chain risks to developers and the broader software ecosystem.

records.title: Arrest Made for AI-Edited Pornographic Content in Gresik Case
records.description: A man identified as WD was arrested in Tangerang for using AI to edit a photo of a Gresik woman to create pornographic content. Police, led by Komang Andhika of Polres Gresik and in collaboration with Polda Metro Jaya, responded to the victim's report and secured the perpetrator.

records.title: AI Jailbreak Technique Exploits Chatbots to Create Credential-Stealing Malware
records.description: Cato Networks reports that a new AI jailbreak technique, dubbed 'Immersive World', tricked generative AI systems like ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, and DeepSeek into producing Chrome infostealers. This technique bypassed AI guardrails, highlighting severe security vulnerabilities that could compromise sensitive data and privacy.

records.title: Court filing reveals Meta profits from Llama AI amidst copyright lawsuit
records.description: A court filing in the Kadrey v. Meta lawsuit reveals Meta shares revenue with cloud hosts like AWS, Google Cloud, and Nvidia for its Llama AI models. Plaintiffs allege Meta trained Llama on hundreds of terabytes of pirated ebooks, constituting copyright infringement in its AI development.

records.title: TikTok's AI Algorithms Fuel ADHD Misinformation Among Young Adults
records.description: A study shows TikTok’s AI-driven feed amplifies ADHD videos, with under half of popular posts matching clinical standards. Young adults exposed to these misleading anecdotes tend to overestimate symptoms and recommend false content. Experts urge mental health professionals to intervene on social media to deliver accurate, evidence-based ADHD information.

records.title: O2 deploys AI to flag 50 million scam calls monthly
records.description: Since late last November, UK operator O2 has used Hiya's AI-based scam detection to flag 150 million scam/spam calls, about 50 million monthly, and block millions confirmed fraudulent, warning customers of HMRC, Amazon, Visa/Mastercard and immigration service impersonators, thereby reducing answered scam calls by 42% and shortening calls by 89%.

records.title: Criminals Harness AI for Hybrid and Organized Crime in the EU
records.description: Europol reports that criminal organizations are increasingly using artificial intelligence to enhance operations and execute hybrid attacks, acting as proxies for hostile powers like Russia and China. The integration of AI in cybercrime, human trafficking, and other illicit activities significantly increases the threat to EU security, with experts warning the threat may escalate further.

records.title: Judge Rules First Amendment May Protect AI-Generated Child Sexual Abuse Material
records.description: Federal prosecutors are appealing a Wisconsin ruling that possession of AI-generated child sexual abuse images may be protected under the First Amendment. The case centers on Steven Anderegg, charged with creating thousands of CSAM using Stable Diffusion. A higher court decision could shape future prosecutions of AI-enabled child pornography.

records.title: Ukraine deploys AI-enabled combat robot 'Lyut'
records.description: Ukraine's Defense Ministry has approved the domestic ground robotic complex 'Lyut' for military service after combat trials. The AI-powered system, armed with a 7.62 mm machine gun and equipped for day-night target detection, can operate autonomously or under remote control, boosting reconnaissance and fire support while keeping operators safe.

records.title: AI Crypto Bot AIXBT Hacked: $100K in ETH Stolen via Dashboard Breach
records.description: The AI crypto bot AIXBT, a market commentator on the Virtuals Protocol, was hacked via unauthorized dashboard access. Malicious prompts triggered a transfer of about 55 ETH (around $100K) from its simulation wallet, prompting immediate security upgrades and key changes to mitigate further risks.

records.title: Surge in AI-Driven Phishing Attacks Raises Cybersecurity Alarms
records.description: Multiple reports show an alarming rise in AI-powered phishing attacks. Cybercriminals now use generative AI, deepfakes, and automation, leading to a 140% increase in browser-based phishing incidents. Experts warn that without proactive measures, future financial losses could reach $40B, driving urgent calls for advanced fraud prevention strategies.

records.title: Hungary's AI-Driven Crackdown on Pride Events
records.description: Hungary's government, led by Prime Minister Viktor Orbán, is advancing a bill targeting LGBTQ+ rights by banning Pride events. The legislation would authorize facial recognition technology to identify event attendees, risking serious privacy violations and infringing on freedom of assembly, with potential human rights impacts.

records.title: UAE Cybersecurity Council Exposes 1,200 Deepfake Donation Scams
records.description: The UAE Cybersecurity Council, led by Dr. Mohamed Al Kuwaiti, identified over 1,200 cases of digital begging scams using deepfake technology during Ramadan. Authorities are using advanced cybersecurity measures to detect fraud, track illicit transactions, and urge the public to verify donation requests and report suspicious activity.

records.title: Painted Road Trick Exposes Tesla Autopilot Vulnerability
records.description: A demonstration experiment revealed that Tesla's Autopilot can mistake a painted road on a wall for a real street, highlighting a dangerous flaw. Critics point to past fatal accidents, including a 2016 incident, as evidence of the potential risks in the AI-driven autonomous driving technology.

records.title: Airtel deploys AI spam alerts to combat SMS fraud in Nigeria
records.description: Airtel Nigeria has launched an AI-driven spam alert service analyzing over 250 real-time factors to detect and warn users of fraudulent SMS. Working automatically on both smartphones and feature phones without extra downloads, it aims to shield particularly vulnerable subscribers from financial scams.

records.title: Tesla Autopilot Vulnerability Exposed in Demonstration Tests
records.description: Former NASA engineer and YouTuber Mark Rober conducted tests comparing Tesla's camera-based Autopilot to a LIDAR-equipped Lexus. In adverse conditions like fog and heavy rain, Tesla's system failed to detect obstacles, including a painted wall, exposing critical AI vulnerabilities that could risk harm in real-world scenarios.

records.title: AI-Driven Raid Seizes 86.6 kg of Drugs in Şırnak, Three Lawyers Arrested
records.description: Turkish police in Şırnak used the ASENA AI narcotics analysis system and detection dog Hector to intercept a vehicle, uncovering 86.6 kg of skunk cannabis. The operation led to the arrest and remand of three lawyer suspects.

records.title: UK NHS API Vulnerability Exposes Patient Data Risk
records.description: A vulnerability in the UK NHS API allowed unauthorized access to sensitive patient data, underscoring major security flaws in mobile APIs. This incident highlights the risks of insecure API connections in healthcare applications and the critical need for strengthened, zero-trust security measures to protect patient information.

records.title: AI Slop Flood Cripples Social Media Information Ecosystem
records.description: Generative AI systems are mass-producing videos and posts that dominate social media feeds, drowning out human content and manipulating algorithms. This “AI slop” attack has led to a near collapse of online reality, widespread misinformation and user distrust, and driven audiences toward decentralized platforms or private conversations for authentic interaction.

records.title: OpenAI and Google sued for copyright infringement in AI training
records.description: OpenAI, Google and Microsoft trained AI on millions of copyrighted newspaper articles without permission, and urged policymakers to legalise this practice as vital to counter Chinese AI, prompting news organizations including The New York Times to sue over copyright infringement.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Singer Video Sparks Controversy
