records.description: OpenAI reports Chinese and Iranian actors abused ChatGPT and Meta’s Llama to develop real-time social media monitoring tools and generate anti-US propaganda and phishing scams. OpenAI blocked these accounts and removed malicious content, spotlighting AI misuse for state surveillance, disinformation and fraud.

records.title: Supreme Court Upholds School’s Autonomy in AI Image Manipulation Case
records.description: The Supreme Court of Santiago backed Saint George's College's decision not to expel four students who used AI to alter and share images of female classmates. The ruling affirmed the school’s disciplinary autonomy, despite concerns over privacy violations involving non-consensual AI-manipulated images.

records.title: TikTok AI Algorithm Linked to Teen Suicide Lawsuit
records.description: A 16-year-old in Long Island is reported to have committed suicide after TikTok’s AI content recommendation system pushed extreme, self-harm videos. His family has filed a wrongful death lawsuit against TikTok and ByteDance, arguing that the platform’s design foreseeably led to his tragic death.

records.title: Facebook AI Job Ad Algorithm Discriminates by Gender
records.description: Meta's Facebook ad algorithm has been found to indirectly discriminate based on gender when displaying job advertisements in the Netherlands. Research from Global Witness and Bureau Clara Wichmann showed that gender-neutral ads are distributed unequally, favoring women for stereotypical roles and men for others, violating human rights protections.

records.title: AI-Powered Love Scams Trigger Massive Financial Losses in Indonesia
records.description: In Indonesia, sophisticated AI and deepfake technologies are being exploited in love scams, causing victims to suffer financial losses of around Rp700 billion from over 42,000 reports. Fraudsters use fake identities and AI-driven chatbots to simulate genuine emotional connections, blurring the lines between human and digital interaction.

records.title: UK Predictive Policing AI Accused of Racial Bias
records.description: Amnesty International and critics accuse UK police AI systems—including the revamped Violence Harm Assessment database and predictive policing tools—of racial profiling. The systems, reliant on biased stop-and-search data, disproportionately target young Black Londoners, risking wrongful stops and human rights violations.

records.title: CPM Releases AI-Generated Deepfake of Former CM Nayanar
records.description: The Communist Party of India (Marxist) released an AI-generated deepfake video of former Kerala chief minister Nayanar, depicting him urging party cadres ahead of upcoming elections. This move, intended to rally party support, has sparked criticism and raised ethical concerns about using AI to misrepresent historical figures.

records.title: Tesla Cybertruck AI Incidents Raise Safety Concerns
records.description: Two incidents involving Tesla Cybertruck's AI systems have raised safety alarms. One event involved an autopilot malfunction that caused the vehicle to crash into a curb and a light pole, while another saw a driver using Full Self-Driving mode dangerously to make a mocha frappuccino, highlighting potential hazards with autonomous technology.

records.title: UnitedHealthcare Faulty AI Denial Lawsuit Advances in Federal Court
records.description: A federal judge allowed parts of a lawsuit against UnitedHealthcare to proceed. The suit alleges that the insurer’s use of a faulty AI algorithm wrongfully denied post-acute coverage for Medicare and elderly patients, overriding medically necessary recommendations and posing significant health risks.

records.title: Petersburg Deploys AI Ethnicity Recognition Cameras
records.description: St. Petersburg is set to equip 8,000 surveillance cameras with an AI system to recognize ethnic identity, announced by committee head Oleg Kapitanov. The technology, part of the 'Safe City' system, aims to monitor migrant enclaves and prevent social tension, raising human rights and discrimination concerns.

records.title: US Tech-Enabled AI Errors Lead to Wrongful Killings in Gaza and Lebanon
records.description: Investigations reveal that American tech firms, including Microsoft and OpenAI, provided AI systems to Israel for tracking targets in Gaza and Lebanon. Faulty translations and misidentification led to wrongful targeting, including high school students, resulting in civilian casualties due to AI system errors under high pressure.

records.title: Court Rules Ross Intelligence's AI Training Infringed Reuters’ Copyright
records.description: A U.S. judge granted Thomson Reuters partial summary judgment against Ross Intelligence, finding that Ross infringed Reuters’ copyrights by using Westlaw headnotes to train its AI legal research platform. The ruling sets a pivotal precedent on intellectual property rights in AI training data.

records.title: South Korea blocks AI chatbot DeepSeek over data privacy concerns
records.description: South Korea’s Personal Information Protection Commission ordered a temporary block on downloads of Chinese AI chatbot DeepSeek, citing privacy concerns after researchers uncovered user data being sent to servers in China. The move aligns with Italy and France’s restrictions and will remain until DeepSeek implements legally required data-handling reforms.

records.title: AI-Powered Media Warfare Against Algeria
records.description: Multiple reports allege that dark rooms are using AI technologies such as deepfake and algorithm manipulation in a coordinated media warfare campaign against Algeria and its institutions. Algeria is countering with advanced local applications while facing a campaign allegedly backed by international funding aimed at disrupting digital platforms.

records.title: Deepfake Image Lawsuit Sparks Political Concerns in Taiwan
records.description: Former UMC founder Cao Xingcheng has filed a lawsuit against media personality Xie Hanbing, alleging that AI-generated deepfake photos wrongly suggesting an extramarital affair have harmed his reputation. He is seeking NT$100 million in damages, which he plans to donate to a political recall effort, amid broader worries of AI misuse.

records.title: Google’s AI-Driven Fingerprinting Raises Privacy Alarm
records.description: Google has rolled out an AI-driven “fingerprinting” technique that uniquely identifies users by aggregating device and browser parameters, replacing cookies to enable persistent, virtually unchallengeable tracking. Privacy advocates and regulators warn this probabilistic profiling breaches user privacy rights and undermines online anonymity, with few options to opt out.

records.title: Platforms Leverage AI to Combat AI-Fueled Online Harassment
records.description: Chinese social media platforms are deploying AI-based detection, filtering, and human-machine review—like Xiaohongshu’s ‘Shield’ and TikTok’s initiative—after severe cyberbullying cases, including a self-media blogger’s ordeal. Under new Network Violence Governance Regulations, platforms bear legal duties to curb AI-enhanced abuse that inflicts psychological harm and privacy breaches.

records.title: Chinese AI Chatbot DeepSeek Blocked Over Privacy Violations
records.description: Italy, Australia and South Korea have restricted or banned Chinese AI chatbot DeepSeek over data privacy and security concerns. South Korea’s privacy regulator found the app transmitted local users’ personal data to ByteDance without explicit consent, prompting its removal from official app stores and warnings until compliance.

records.title: Intelligent Warfare Theory and AI-Driven Information Warfare
records.description: The articles explore future trends in AI-enabled warfare, highlighting shifts toward algorithm-driven combat and preemptive tactical design. They also discuss the threat of AI-powered disinformation, including deepfakes, used in information warfare by authoritarian states, urging democratic nations to develop effective counterstrategies.

records.title: NetEase Apologizes for AI-Generated Valentine's Promo Featuring Underage Character
records.description: NetEase Super Membership used AI-generated promotional text featuring an underage NPC from ‘Yan Yun 16 Sheng’ for Valentine’s Day, sparking player backlash. NetEase apologized, took down the content, and committed to tighter AI content review and collaboration with the game team to prevent future missteps.

records.title: Deepfake Videos Defame South Korean President and First Lady
records.description: South Korea's regulatory agencies are acting swiftly against deepfake videos defaming President Yoon Suk-yeol and First Lady Kim Gun-hee. The manipulated videos, shown at pro-impeachment protests, have sparked legal investigations and led YouTube to remove related content due to serious defamation and human rights violations.

records.title: AI-Driven Identity Fraud via Deepfake and Synthetic Identities
records.description: Cybersecurity experts warn that AI-driven deepfake technology and synthetic identities complicate detection and prevention of identity theft. Fraudsters leverage AI to create falsified images and videos that bypass financial verification, raising concerns about human rights violations and breaches of legal protections.

records.title: Minor Arrested in Palma for Creating AI-Generated Nude Images of Schoolmates
records.description: In Palma, a minor was detained for using AI to generate and distribute realistic fake nude images of five schoolmates from photos posted on social media. The incident, investigated by the National Police's cybercrime units, highlights serious violations of privacy and laws protecting minors.

records.title: AI-Fueled Crypto and Romance Scams Soar, Billion-Dollar Losses Recorded
records.description: Scammers using AI tools—deepfake imagery, chatbots and targeted ads—boosted crypto fraud revenues to nearly $10 billion in 2024 and swindled over $58 million in AI-driven romance scams. Fake ads featuring public figures further expanded reach, prompting authorities to warn about increasingly sophisticated, emotionally manipulative AI-enabled schemes.

records.title: Meta's Content Moderation Rollback Risks Fueling Genocide
records.description: Amnesty International warns that Meta's rollback of AI-driven content moderation—lifting bans on hate speech, replacing automated filters and fact-checkers with community notes—could fuel mass violence, echoing the 2017 Rohingya genocide. A whistleblower complaint filed with the SEC accuses Meta of misleading shareholders about human rights impacts and escalating risks.

records.title: United Russia Pushes Domestic AI-Powered Drone and EW Industry
records.description: United Russia secretary Vladimir Yakushev calls for a Russian military-tech sector focused on AI, autonomous platforms and electronic warfare. His Center for Unmanned Systems has supplied over 55,000 AI-enabled drones and EW systems to frontline units since 2022, bolstering Russia’s battlefield automation.

records.title: Apple Faces Complaint Over Siri’s Unauthorized Data Collection
records.description: French authorities and human rights groups have submitted a complaint against Apple for allegedly recording millions of private conversations via Siri without proper consent. A whistleblower revealed that subcontractors analyzed sensitive voice data to enhance the AI system, raising serious privacy and GDPR concerns.

records.title: Bollywood Music Labels Join Copyright Lawsuit Against OpenAI in India
records.description: A coalition of India's leading music labels—including T-Series, Saregama, Sony Music and the Indian Music Industry group—has moved to join a New Delhi copyright suit against OpenAI, alleging unauthorized use of their sound recordings to train AI models. OpenAI maintains compliance with fair use principles.

records.title: Fatal GPS Misdirection in Rio's Favelas
records.description: Multiple incidents in Rio de Janeiro saw tourists and ride-share passengers fatally misdirected by GPS navigation apps that likely use AI for route optimization. These apps erroneously led vehicles into dangerous favelas controlled by drug gangs, resulting in several fatal shootings and raising critical safety concerns.

records.title: AI Virtual Lovers in Turkey Raise Privacy, Dependency and Suicide Concerns
records.description: AI-powered virtual companion apps in Turkey let users customize avatars and build emotional bonds. Experts warn of data privacy breaches, social isolation and harmful dependency, highlighted by the reported suicide of a young user with autism who grew attached to his AI avatar.

records.title: Deepfake Investment Scam on Social Media
records.description: The Romanian National Cybersecurity Directorate (DNSC) warns that cybercriminals are using deepfake technology on X (formerly Twitter) to promote fraudulent investment opportunities. Fake sponsored posts featuring altered images of celebrities lure users to phishing sites designed to steal their personal and financial data.

records.title: AI-Driven Romance Scams Target Vulnerable Individuals
records.description: Organized criminal groups are leveraging AI to create fake social media profiles, impersonating professionals to lure vulnerable individuals. Using scams involving fictitious emergencies, divorces, and debt repayment, these schemes have led to significant financial losses. Authorities and banks urge extreme caution to protect personal data and savings.

records.title: Celebrity Deepfake Scam Ads Surge in 2024
records.description: The Advertising Standards Authority reported a surge in scam ads using AI-generated deepfakes of celebrities and public figures, including PM Sir Keir Starmer, Chancellor Rachel Reeves, and BBC’s Naga Munchetty. These deceptive adverts, often promoting cryptocurrency and investment schemes, led to 177 scam ad alerts in 2024.

records.title: Scarlett Johansson Demands Ban on Deepfake AI
records.description: Hollywood actress Scarlett Johansson has called for urgent legislation to ban deepfake technology after unauthorized videos of her appeared online. She criticizes the US government for inaction, warning that misuse of advanced AI infringes on privacy and poses a significant threat to individual rights and public safety.

records.title: Major Temples Condemn AI-Generated Demeaning Depictions of Guan Gong
records.description: Five major Guan Gong temples across Shanxi, Henan, Hubei, Fujian and Quanzhou issued a joint statement on February 13 condemning AI-generated images, videos and texts that demean and defame the revered deity with vulgar content and internet slang. They called for zero tolerance, legal action and respect for Guan Gong’s cultural dignity.

records.title: Major Publishers Sue AI Startup Cohere Over Copyright Infringement
records.description: More than a dozen publishers, including Forbes, Vox, The Guardian and Politico, sued AI startup Cohere in New York, alleging it scraped thousands of copyrighted articles without permission to train its large language models, reproduced full-text outputs, and fabricated attributions. The lawsuit seeks damages and injunctive relief.

records.title: Celebrities Targeted by Deepfake Fraud
records.description: Multiple investigations reveal the misuse of AI deep synthesis technology to fabricate celebrity audio and video content, impersonating figures like Lei Jun, Liu Dehua, and Dr. Zhang Wenhong for fraudulent marketing and profit. Legal experts stress that unauthorized deepfakes violate intellectual property and personal rights, calling for stricter enforcement.

records.title: xAI's 'Colossus' Supercomputer Fuels Health and Environmental Concerns
records.description: Elon Musk's xAI is powering its 'Colossus' supercomputer in Memphis with 15 outdated gas turbines that emit hazardous pollutants, including formaldehyde, exceeding EPA limits. The turbines, operating non-stop since 2024, pose health and environmental risks to local residents amid concerns over transparency and oversight.

records.title: AI-Driven Crypto Scams Exploit Pig Butchering and Professional Networks
records.description: Chainalysis reports that crypto scammers used advanced AI tools to enhance fraudulent schemes in 2024, defrauding victims of at least $9.9 billion, with potential losses exceeding $12 billion. The scams, including rapidly growing pig butchering tactics, were further bolstered by international networks and platforms like Huione.

records.title: AI-driven algorithms in smartphones fuel minors' addiction and health risks
records.description: Researchers warn that sophisticated AI recommendation algorithms in cellphones drive addiction among under-16s, leading to physical inactivity, obesity and social isolation. Policymakers and parents are urged to recognize these devices' power and impose responsible handling to mitigate rising health and mental harms.

records.title: Louisiana Arrests Over AI-Generated Child Abuse Deepfakes
records.description: Louisiana State Police arrested two Pointe Coupee Parish men for possession and distribution of AI-generated deepfakes depicting child sexual abuse. The investigation began during a routine phone inspection of convicted sex offender Ryan Glaser, with Gregory Duncan Jr. identified as the creator and distributor of the illicit content.

records.title: Meta Warns of AI-Powered Romantic Scams
records.description: Meta has raised alarms over cybercriminals using AI tools to generate fake video profiles and voices for romance scams, targeting vulnerable individuals. Notably, a scam involving a fake persona cost a victim over 800,000 euros, with a Cambodia-based group deploying AI, including tools from OpenAI’s ChatGPT, to deceive victims.

records.title: Delhi HC warns DeepSeek AI chatbot poses privacy risks
records.description: The Delhi High Court described AI as a “dangerous tool” while hearing a plea to block DeepSeek, a Chinese-developed chatbot, over reported vulnerabilities that have led to large-scale personal data leaks. The court has asked the Centre for instructions and will hear the ban petition on February 20.

records.title: AI Companion Addiction Sparks Youth Mental Health Crisis
records.description: AI companion chatbots like Replika, DeepSeek, and domestic apps have become emotional outlets for young people. Excessive reliance fosters addiction, social withdrawal and psychological harm. Reports include mounting subscriptions, mental health issues and at least one teenage suicide linked to an AI chatbot, prompting calls for tighter oversight.

records.title: Scarlett Johansson Condemns Unauthorized AI Video Targeting Kanye West
records.description: Scarlett Johansson has condemned an unauthorized AI-generated video using her likeness along with other Jewish celebrities to denounce Kanye West's alleged antisemitism. She warns that the misuse of AI for hate speech poses serious threats to privacy, intellectual property rights, and individual reputation.

records.title: Tesla FSD Expansion and Near-Collision Incident
records.description: Tesla expanded its FSD rollout to Mexico, allowing local users access to autonomous driving, while a Cybertruck nearly collided with an oncoming Chevrolet pickup due to the AI misidentifying a lane. The incident underscores potential safety risks associated with malfunctions in autonomous driving systems.

records.title: WormGPT AI Model Fuels Cybercrime, Suspect Detained
records.description: A 22-year-old suspect was detained by the Polícia Judiciária for developing WormGPT, an AI model similar to ChatGPT but without safety restrictions. Marketed on hacking forums, the tool automated cybercrime activities, including malware creation, financial fraud, and cyberattacks.

records.title: German Regulators Investigate DeepSeek Over Security and Privacy Breaches
records.description: Chinese AI chatbot DeepSeek logs extensive user data, including keystroke patterns, and can be jailbroken to generate malicious content. German cybersecurity experts warn of espionage risks and privacy violations under Chinese law, prompting investigations and potential bans by regulators.

records.title: FBI Warns Gmail Users of AI-Enhanced Phishing Scams
records.description: The FBI has warned Gmail users about increasingly sophisticated, AI-driven phishing attacks. These scams use artificial intelligence to create personalized, convincing emails that mimic legitimate communication, posing significant risks of fraud and identity theft. Reports show a sharp rise in such attacks since early 2022.

records.title: NHK Halts AI-Driven Multilingual Subtitles Over Translation Error
records.description: NHK discontinued its AI-based multilingual subtitles service after its Google Translate-powered system mistakenly rendered 'Senkaku Islands' as 'Diaoyu Islands' during a live broadcast. The error raised diplomatic and accuracy concerns, prompting the broadcaster to end the service and consider developing its own AI translation system.

records.title: AGU orders Meta to remove deepfake video of Vice President Alckmin
records.description: Brazil's Attorney General's Office (AGU) sent an extrajudicial notice to Meta demanding removal within 24 hours of an AI-generated deepfake video falsely depicting Vice President Geraldo Alckmin discussing public funds. The AGU labeled it disinformation, citing abuse of rights and threatening legal action or mandatory AI-content warnings if left online.

records.title: DeepSeek AI and the Denial of Uyghur Genocide
records.description: Multiple reports accuse China's DeepSeek AI of denying the Uyghur genocide by dismissing claims as 'slander'. The chatbot, rapidly adopted worldwide, is seen as aligning with China's official narrative, raising serious human rights concerns and fears of erasing historical evidence of alleged abuses in Xinjiang.

records.title: Hate speech on X rose 50% after Elon Musk’s acquisition, study finds
records.description: A University of California study published in PLOS One found hate speech on X increased 50% after Elon Musk’s 2022 acquisition, with weekly hate posts rising from 2,179 to 3,246. Bot accounts remained unchanged, and the platform’s AI-driven moderation and recommendation algorithms reportedly amplified hateful content.

records.title: AI Bots and Deepfakes Deceive Dating App Users
records.description: Surveys in Costa Rica, Colombia, and Guatemala reveal that 62–76% of dating app users suspect AI chatbots, fake profiles, and deepfakes posing as matches. These malicious AI-driven profiles have led to phishing attempts, romance scams, and emotional harm, prompting demands for identity verification measures to assure genuine human interactions.

records.title: Airbnb warns holidaymakers of AI-generated rental scams
records.description: Airbnb research with Get Safe Online reveals nearly two-thirds of travelers can't distinguish AI-generated holiday rental images, enabling scammers to post fake listings that cost victims an average £1,937. Exploiting AI's realism on social media, fraudsters lure consumers into non-existent bookings. Airbnb advises vigilance: verify listings, report scams, and avoid suspicious deals.

records.title: AI-Powered Traffic Lights Slash Congestion and Accidents in Chengdu
records.description: Chengdu traffic police deployed an AI-driven signal control system on the 3.1 km Machao Road corridor. By dynamically adjusting green-light durations based on real-time vehicle flow, queue lengths fell by about 200 m, travel speeds rose up to 22 %, and accident rates dropped 33.8 %, cutting overall congestion.

records.title: Tesla Cybertruck FSD Malfunction Leads to Crash
records.description: Florida-based software developer Jonathan Challinger experienced a crash when his Tesla Cybertruck's Full Self-Driving system (v13 and v13.2.4) failed to merge or turn, resulting in collisions with a curb and a pole. He shared the incident on social media and warned users to remain vigilant while using advanced driving features.

records.title: Musk push risks ending Tesla Autopilot safety probes
records.description: Elon Musk's close ties to the Trump administration risk quashing federal investigations into Tesla's AI-driven Autopilot, including NHTSA crash probes and a DOJ criminal inquiry over overstated self-driving claims, as well as crash data reporting mandates. Safety experts warn rollback of oversight endangers drivers after incidents and fatalities.

records.title: Inaccurate AI News Summaries Spark Misinformation Concerns
records.description: The BBC found that leading AI assistants, including ChatGPT, Microsoft's Copilot, Google's Gemini, and Perplexity, produced inaccurate news summaries. Over half of the answers had significant errors such as factual distortions, misquoted statistics, and altered content from BBC reports, raising concerns about misinformation and public trust.

records.title: Mistral AI Faces Data Privacy Controversy Over Chatbot ‘Le Chat’
records.description: Mistral AI has been accused of exploiting users' personal data without proper consent mechanisms. A complaint was filed with France’s CNIL over the absence of opt-out options in the free version of its AI chatbot, 'Le Chat', raising serious concerns about its adherence to data protection laws and user privacy.

records.title: Families sue TikTok over AI-recommended blackout challenge data deletion
records.description: Four British families have sued TikTok and ByteDance in the US, alleging the platform’s AI-driven recommendation system promoted a dangerous “blackout challenge” leading to their children’s deaths. They seek account data to investigate, but TikTok’s senior government relations manager says some data may have been deleted and is unavailable.

records.title: Ukrainian Military Deploys AI-Driven Robotic Forces in Combat
records.description: Ukrainian forces, including the National Guard’s 13th Brigade, deployed AI-controlled ground robots armed with machine guns in coordinated attacks near Kharkiv against Russian positions. Directed via joystick and supported by drone surveillance, these operations demonstrate a new era of combat technology designed to reduce troop casualties.

records.title: Dubbing Actors Strike Over AI Voice Cloning Threat
records.description: Voice actors in Spain—including delegations in Catalunya and the Balearic Islands—and in France are protesting the unauthorized use of AI to clone their voices, striking and demanding contractual clauses barring their recordings from training generative models. Industry groups like AADPC, PASAVE, CADIB and artists such as Bruno Méyère warn AI could erase their livelihoods.

records.title: AI-Generated Voice Scam Targets Italian Business Elites
records.description: Scammers used AI to mimic Italian Defense Minister Guido Crosetto's voice, tricking prominent businessmen into transferring €1 million for a fake kidnapping ransom of a reporter. The fraud involved cloned phone numbers and advanced AI voice synthesis, prompting investigations by Italian authorities.

records.title: Friend Betrayal: Deepfake Pornography Incident in Sydney
records.description: Hannah Grundy in Sydney was victimized when a trusted friend, Andrew Hayler, used AI deepfake technology to produce and circulate non-consensual explicit imagery and violent content. Together with her partner, Hannah uncovered the misuse of private social media images affecting dozens of women, constituting a serious human rights violation.

records.title: Generative AI Fuels 60% Surge in Deepfake Phishing Attacks
records.description: AI-driven phishing, including voice and deepfake attacks, surged 60% in 2023, fueling fraud across finance, healthcare and other sectors. Generative AI crafted highly personalized scams with a 54% success rate, resulting in multimillion-dollar losses—such as a $243k CEO impersonation—and over $8.1 billion stolen.

records.title: AI-Powered Romance Scams Lead to $46 Million Losses
records.description: Tenable warns that scammers are using generative AI to create deepfake videos and audio, enhancing their deceptive romance scams. Fraudsters, often operating overseas, have tricked victims in Hong Kong, Taiwan, Singapore, and India into losing $46 million, with AI making scams more sophisticated and emotionally compelling.

records.title: Georgia Harrison Confronts AI-Driven Revenge Porn
records.description: Georgia Harrison, whose ex Stephen Bear was jailed for disclosing her private sex tape without consent, continues to struggle with its widespread online availability. In her ITV documentary Porn, Power, Profit, she investigates AI-enabled deepfake porn and image-based sexual abuse, tracking down postings and urging government and tech platforms to strengthen protections.

records.title: Criminal Organization Uses AI Voice Cloning for Fraud
records.description: In Bolivia, a criminal group used AI to clone Education Minister Omar Véliz’s voice to scam 19 victims by advertising fraudulent job offers and selling fake items on social media. The scheme, which resulted in over Bs 5 million in losses, involved seven individuals, with evidence gathered from sequestered cellphone numbers.

records.title: Global AI Deepfakes Fuel Election and Disinformation Crisis
records.description: Global disinformation fueled by AI deepfakes is impacting electoral processes. In Slovakia, a deepfake recording falsely claimed election manipulation by a pro-EU leader, while manipulated audio mimicked figures like Joe Biden and Emmanuel Macron. Additionally, non-consensual deepfake pornography has targeted women politicians worldwide.

records.title: BBC presenter Naga Munchetty targeted by AI deepfake nude images scam
records.description: Naga Munchetty, 49-year-old BBC Breakfast presenter, discovered AI-generated deepfake nude images of herself photoshopped and circulated on Facebook, leading to a porn site scam to harvest personal data. She said the experience was “scary” and “weird,” highlighting the emotional harm and privacy risks posed by AI misuse.

records.title: Deepfake scam defrauds vulnerable victim of substantial funds
records.description: Cybercriminals used AI-generated deepfake videos and images to impersonate trusted figures, deceiving a vulnerable person into transferring large sums of money. The scam highlights the financial and emotional harm deepfakes can cause and underscores the urgent need for effective detection tools and public awareness to combat identity fraud.

records.title: DeepSeek AI Security Flaws Trigger Worldwide Bans
records.description: Chinese startup DeepSeek’s R1 model is riddled with vulnerabilities, easily jailbroken to generate illicit content (bombs, viruses) and over-collect user data. Governments (US, Canada, South Korea, Japan, Italy) and organizations—including Seoul National University, Toyota, Mitsubishi and SoftBank—have banned or blocked its use amid espionage and privacy concerns.

records.title: AI-Driven Deepfake Scams Exploit Romance, Investment and Tech Support
records.description: Scammers in Vietnam and beyond use AI and deepfake tools to impersonate celebrities, soldiers or tech support, generate lifelike images, voices and scripts for investment, romance, e-commerce and remote access scams. Google, Meta, Haiphong police and Europol warn of rising AI-driven fraud, blocking millions of high-risk apps and accounts.

records.title: AI-driven automation fuels spike in IT unemployment
records.description: AI-powered automation has driven IT unemployment from 3.9% to 5.7% (98,000 to 152,000 workers) in January 2025. Companies including Microsoft, Meta and Amazon are replacing routine software development and administrative roles with AI tools. Janco Associates and the Wall Street Journal warn of lasting economic and labor-market disruptions.

records.title: China’s AI Sector: Layoffs, Feature Shutdown, Copyright Win, and DeepSeek Scams
records.description: China’s AI ecosystem saw Han Shu plan to replace 95% of customer service and 50% of legal staff with AI, Xiaomi suspend its paid AI photo-generation feature, Wuhan court uphold AIGC creator copyright, nationwide telecoms integrate the DeepSeek open model, while over 2,000 counterfeit DeepSeek sites and overseas bans emerged.

records.title: Nino D'Angelo Denounces AI Deepfake Scam
records.description: Nino D'Angelo, the Neapolitan singer and actor, has filed a complaint after a deepfake video using AI falsely depicted him asking for money from fans. He distanced himself from the manipulated content, reporting the incident to the carabinieri and the Postal Police, warning his audience against fraud.

records.title: DeepSeek AI Data Privacy and Security Incident
records.description: South Korea's National Intelligence Service flagged DeepSeek, a Chinese generative AI, for excessive personal data collection. The service stores user inputs on Chinese servers and shares data with advertisers, risking government access. Inconsistent language responses further raise concerns over security, privacy, and potential legal violations.

records.title: Google’s reCAPTCHA transforms into surveillance tool, wastes 819 million hours
records.description: Google’s reCAPTCHA, an AI-based bot filter, primarily tracks user behavior for data collection, costing 819 million hours (~$6.1 B lost wages) and generating up to $888 B in ad revenue. Its bot-detection efficacy has plummeted and is expected to be bypassed by 2025, yet Google persists in its use.

records.title: Jerusalem Students Use AI to Create Non-Consensual Intimate Images
records.description: Three students aged 13-15 from Jerusalem are under investigation for using AI to edit and distribute non-consensual intimate images of numerous schoolgirls. Authorities from the Youth Exposure Unit collected extensive evidence and are considering charges for violating privacy and human rights through manipulated digital images.

records.title: Google Maps misdirection leads to car theft in wheat field
records.description: Firoz and Naushad followed a Google Maps route to meet a friend in Saharanpur, but the AI misrouted them into a wheat field where their WagonR got stuck. When they sought help, three youths offered aid then stole the car and Firoz’s phone, fleeing the scene. A police complaint was filed.

records.title: Greek Tax Authority AI Algorithm Uncovers €50M Fake Invoices
records.description: Greece’s Independent Authority for Public Revenue used an AI-driven algorithm to detect €50M in fraudulent invoices issued by four firms across mobile phones, electronic systems, machinery and animal feed sectors between 2019–2023. Investigations continue, with €1.3M in penalties already imposed.

records.title: AI-Powered Drones Used in Military Strikes in Kursk Region
records.description: In the Kursk region, the Akhmat special forces group has deployed AI-equipped FPV drones, named "Boomerang," with autonomous targeting capabilities. These drones can strike targets even if communication signals are lost. They were used to attack a house with Ukrainian military personnel, demonstrating AI's role in military operations and potential harm.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Volcanic Eruption Video Causes Panic on TikTok
records.description: AI-generated fake videos depicting a volcanic eruption in Santorini have been circulating on TikTok, causing public panic and misinformation. These videos, created using AI software, show the island in chaos, potentially leading to harm by spreading false information and inciting fear among viewers.

records.title: Deepfake Scam Costs Inheritance: AI Abused for Fraud
records.description: Fraudsters used a deepfake video of Elon Musk to scam John Cairns, a grieving 61-year-old, into investing £3,250 in a fraudulent AI trading platform. This AI-generated deception highlights the rising threat of deepfake technology in financial scams, exploiting vulnerable individuals for profit.

records.title: French Media Outlets Sue AI-Generated News Site for Copyright Infringement
records.description: Around forty French media outlets, including Libération, are suing the AI-generated news site News DayFr for copyright infringement. The site allegedly uses AI to scrape and republish thousands of articles daily without authorization. The media groups seek a court order to block the site in France, citing intellectual property violations.

records.title: San Diego County sues social media giants over AI-driven youth mental health harms
records.description: San Diego County sued Meta, Google, Snap, TikTok and YouTube, alleging their AI-powered recommendation algorithms and engagement features deliberately foster addiction, exacerbating youth mental health crises. The lawsuit cites a 500% surge in pediatric behavioral health ER visits and rising anxiety, depression and suicide among young people.

records.title: Court Affirms Copyright Protection for AI-Generated Images
records.description: Wuhan East Lake court ruled that an AI-generated image, created by user Wang via an ‘AI’ software, qualifies as a protected work. A local tech company infringed this copyright by using the image in its promotional ads. The court ordered the company to pay Wang ¥4,000 in damages.

records.title: DeepSeek AI App Exposes Unencrypted User Data, Vulnerable to Jailbreaks
records.description: Chinese-developed DeepSeek AI chatbot app transmits unencrypted user data, including chats and device info, to servers in China via weak encryption and disabled iOS transport security. Security researchers found jailbreak flaws allowing harmful content generation, prompting government device bans and legislative actions over privacy and national security risks.

records.title: Deepfake Video of Bulgarian Singer Azis Used in TikTok Scam
records.description: A deepfake video of Bulgarian pop-folk singer Azis has been circulating on TikTok, falsely offering €20,000 to users. Created using AI, the video challenges viewers to follow the account, potentially deceiving many of its 13,000 followers and 500,000 viewers. Meanwhile, Azis is in Miami, unaware of the scam.

records.title: Angela Similea's Image Misused in AI-Generated Ad
records.description: Angela Similea, a renowned singer, has become a victim of AI misuse as her image was used without consent in an online cosmetic ad. She publicly condemned this unauthorized use, highlighting it as a violation of her rights. This incident reflects growing concerns over AI's role in unauthorized celebrity endorsements.

records.title: AI-Powered Phishing Campaign Threatens Billions of Gmail Accounts
records.description: Google has issued a warning about a large-scale phishing campaign using AI, specifically a system called 'DeepPhish', which creates convincing phishing emails by mimicking writing styles. This campaign poses a significant threat to approximately 2.5 billion Gmail users worldwide, urging users to take immediate security measures to protect their accounts.

records.title: AI-Driven Credit Card and Identity Fraud Uncovered in Indonesia
records.description: Indonesian police arrested two individuals, PM and MR, for using AI to commit credit card and identity fraud. They manipulated personal data to open bank accounts fraudulently, using AI to create fake verification videos. The fraud was detected by bank employees and reported to authorities, leading to the arrests.

records.title: Meta Accused of Using Pirated Books to Train AI Models
records.description: Meta is accused of illegally using pirated books to train its AI models, as revealed by unsealed emails. The company allegedly torrented over 81.7 terabytes of data from shadow libraries like LibGen and Z-Library. This breach of intellectual property rights has led to a class-action lawsuit by authors.

records.title: School Bus Driver Cancels Traffic Fine with AI-Written Appeal
records.description: In Tokat, Turkey, school bus driver Mehmet Can Duran contested a 2400 TL traffic fine by using an AI service to draft his appeal, avoiding attorney fees. The AI-generated petition highlighted missing evidence, and the Tokat Civil Court ruled in his favor, annulling the fine.

records.title: Ukrainian Drone Squad Employs AI-Powered Killer Drones in Conflict
records.description: In eastern Ukraine, a Ukrainian drone unit led by a former IT recruiter uses AI-powered drones for surveillance and targeting. The system tracks a hiding Russian soldier with precision, demonstrating the lethal implications of AI in military operations as the squad monitors and eliminates targets on the battlefield.

records.title: AI Deepfake Technology Misuse Leads to Fraud and Misinformation
records.description: AI deepfake technology is being misused to create deceptive videos, including impersonating a doctor to sell products and fabricating distress calls for money. This misuse has led to fraud and misinformation, prompting calls for stricter regulation and legal frameworks to address the potential harm and criminal activities associated with AI-generated content.

records.title: AI-Generated Dating Profiles Fuel Valentine’s Day Ticket Scam
records.description: Ahead of Valentine’s Day, scammers use AI-generated or stolen photos to pose as women in dating apps and social media, directing victims to fake booking sites for event tickets. After payment, the profile disappears and funds vanish. Experts warn neural networks enable these romantic scams, causing financial losses.

records.title: Russian AI Bots Spread Disinformation Ahead of German Elections
records.description: Russian bots, supported by the Kremlin, have flooded the social media platform X with AI-generated disinformation ahead of the German elections. The operation, known as Doppelgänger, uses fake news sites and sleeper accounts to undermine trust in Western institutions. German officials identified over 100 pseudo-news sites involved in this campaign.

records.title: TikTok Star Bulan Sutena Victim of AI-Generated Deepfake Porn Video
records.description: Bulan Sutena, a TikTok star and singer, denied starring in a viral 1m14s porn video, revealing it as an AI-generated deepfake superimposing her face. The false content caused reputational damage and confusion. She condemned the misuse of AI, urged ethical technology use, and hopes perpetrators will be held accountable.

records.title: Chilean deputy shares AI-generated fake of President Boric hugging Venezuelan minister
records.description: Sergio Bobadilla of Chile’s UDI party shared an AI-generated image showing President Gabriel Boric embracing Venezuelan minister Diosdado Cabello. Fact-checkers at Fast Check CL used reverse search and Hive Moderation (99% AI probability) to debunk it. Boric denounced it as far-right disinformation; Bobadilla refused to retract or apologize.

records.title: AI-powered deepfakes fuel Pix tax scams on Meta’s platforms
records.description: A study by UFRJ’s NetLab found that scammers used AI-generated deepfake images and Meta’s ad tools on Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp to promote a fake “Pix tax” and spoof government programs. Over 1,700 fraudulent ads, featuring manipulated politicians’ likenesses, deceived Brazilians into paying fees, causing financial harm.

records.title: Ship Collision on Mosel River Due to Autopilot Malfunction
records.description: A ship on the Mosel River collided with a lock gate while operating on autopilot, causing significant disruption to shipping operations. The autopilot system was functioning correctly, but the ship's captain failed to intervene. Investigations are ongoing to determine why the captain did not take control.

records.title: Global Scrutiny of DeepSeek AI Chatbot Over Data Security Risks
records.description: DeepSeek, a Chinese AI chatbot, has drawn warnings from South Korea’s PIPC over insecure data management and from NowSecure for encryption flaws. Feroot Security revealed hidden code sending user data to China Mobile, prompting US lawmakers to propose bans and advising iPhone users to uninstall the app amid privacy and national security concerns.

records.title: Gambling sites secretly share data with Facebook's AI for ad targeting
records.description: In an Observer experiment on 150 UK-licensed gambling sites, many embedded Meta Pixel trackers collected user browsing data without obtaining consent. Meta’s ad-targeting algorithms then profiled these users as gamblers, flooding them with casino and betting ads on Facebook. This covert AI-driven tracking breaches data protection laws and privacy rights.

records.title: 36 Accidents Involving Autonomous Vehicles in Russian Experiment
records.description: During a Russian experiment with autonomous vehicles, 36 traffic accidents occurred, with 26 happening while the vehicles were in automated mode. Two accidents were directly caused by the AI systems. The experiment, running from April 2022 to November 2024, involved over 92,000 trips.

records.title: AI Deepfake and Voice-Cloning Scams Defraud Employees of Millions
records.description: In two Chinese incidents, scammers employed deepfake face-swapping and AI voice-cloning to pose as company leaders and pressure employees into transferring funds. In Tianjin, a victim was deceived into sending RMB950,000 before police froze RMB830,000; elsewhere, authorities halted a planned RMB3 million transfer, preventing major AI-enabled financial fraud.

records.title: Taiwanese Legislator Faces Online Attacks After Calling for TikTok Ban
records.description: Taiwanese legislator Lin Tai-hua has faced online attacks and threats after advocating for a ban on TikTok, citing the use of AI-generated deepfake videos to spread misinformation and harm public figures. Lin emphasizes the need to counteract Chinese information infiltration to protect Taiwan's democracy.

records.title: AI-Generated Earthquake Misinformation in Xinjiang
records.description: In Xinjiang's Kuqa City, a 5.0 magnitude earthquake occurred with no reported casualties. However, some social media accounts used AI to create and spread false images and videos about the event, misleading the public. Authorities are taking legal action against those spreading misinformation to maintain public order.

records.title: AI-Enabled Drones Escalate in Ukraine Conflict
records.description: In Ukraine’s war, AI-powered FPV drones like ZEUS and HADES—recently codified by the Defense Ministry—are mass-produced for precision strikes. Meanwhile, Russia’s 35th Brigade reverse-engineers captured UAVs into ‘Frankenstein drones’ and deploys electronic warfare jamming. Cheap, autonomous drones now cause over 90% of battlefield casualties, reshaping modern warfare.

records.title: AI-Powered Drones Assist in Artillery Strikes in Zaporizhzhia
records.description: Russian military utilized AI-driven drones, "Sarych-2," to identify and target a Ukrainian military convoy in Zaporizhzhia. The drones relayed coordinates for artillery strikes, resulting in the destruction of enemy equipment and personnel, disrupting Ukrainian troop rotations. This incident highlights the use of AI in military operations causing harm.

records.title: DeepSeek AI Model Fails Safety Tests
records.description: The AI model DeepSeek R1, developed by researchers at the University of Pennsylvania and Cisco, failed to block harmful queries in safety tests, raising concerns about its vulnerability to cybersecurity threats, misinformation, and illegal activities. Despite claims of cost-effectiveness, the model's inability to handle harmful content poses significant risks.

records.title: Ex-Google Engineer Charged with Stealing AI Secrets for China
records.description: Former Google engineer Linwei Ding faces expanded charges in the US for allegedly stealing AI trade secrets to benefit Chinese companies. Ding, a Chinese national, is accused of economic espionage and theft of trade secrets, potentially aiding China's AI development. The case is part of a US initiative to prevent technology theft.

records.title: Study Reveals Political Bias in ChatGPT Threatening Democratic Values
records.description: A study by the University of East Anglia, in collaboration with Brazilian institutions, found that ChatGPT exhibits biases favoring left-wing political values. This bias in generative AI systems raises concerns about fairness and accountability, potentially distorting public discourse and threatening democratic values by exacerbating societal divides.

records.title: Senate Bill Targets RealPage AI Rent Algorithm Amid Price-Fixing Claims
records.description: Sen. Amy Klobuchar and eight Democratic co-sponsors reintroduced the Preventing Algorithmic Collusion Act to compel transparency and restrict RealPage’s rent-pricing software, accused of algorithmic collusion driving up rents. DOJ lawsuits and congressional inquiries highlight how the AI-driven model inflated costs, harming renters, including military families, and suppressing competition.

records.title: AI-Driven Phishing Scam Targets Gmail Users
records.description: A sophisticated phishing scam using AI targets Gmail users, including security experts, by generating fake calls to steal data. Zach Latta, founder of Hack Club, nearly fell victim to this scam, which mimics legitimate Google support calls to deceive individuals and compromise their accounts.

records.title: YouTube’s AI Algorithm Promotes Harmful Content and Bias
records.description: YouTube’s AI-powered recommendation algorithm has been found to promote harmful content to minors—eating disorder videos in the UK and extremist, misogynistic, and racist material in Australia—despite regulatory exemptions. Researchers also allege algorithmic bias suppresses critical voices, raising concerns over health, rights violations, and calls for stricter oversight.

records.title: Facial Recognition Glitches Disrupt Access at Mantralaya Secretariat
records.description: On its first day, the AI-driven facial recognition and RFID access system at Mumbai’s Mantralaya failed to read staff faces despite preloaded data for 1,500 employees. Glitches caused long queues, denied entry to staff and journalists and disrupted operations. Authorities have instructed all users to re-register biometric data to prevent further delays.

records.title: Deepfake video falsely shows AY Makun kissing May Edochie
records.description: Comedian Ayo Makun publicly condemned an AI-altered deepfake that falsely depicted him kissing actress May Edochie during a film promotion trip. The doctored clip circulated online, causing reputational harm and public uproar. Makun urged Nigerians to use their creative talents responsibly rather than spreading misinformation.

records.title: AI-Generated Voice Scams Impersonate Legal Authorities to Extract Payments
records.description: Fraudsters deploy AI-generated voices and messages to impersonate courts or enforcement agencies, falsely claiming lawsuits or debt and pressuring victims into urgent payments. Digital forensics expert Emre Akman warns that urgency and panic cues signal scams; individuals should verify via official channels to avoid financial loss.

records.title: Global Bans on Chinese AI Chatbot DeepSeek Over Privacy and Security Concerns
records.description: Major South Korean companies and government agencies and authorities in the Netherlands have banned or moved to restrict the Chinese AI chatbot DeepSeek. Critics cite its extensive data harvesting—device info, IPs, keystroke patterns—and potential espionage, storing sensitive user data on Chinese servers, posing privacy and national security risks.

records.title: AI-Aided Scam Targets Thai Beauty Queen, Two Arrested
records.description: Two men in Thailand were arrested for using AI technology to impersonate police officers in a scam, defrauding victims, including beauty queen Charlotte Austin, of 4 million baht. The suspects used AI to alter their faces, complicating identification, and laundered stolen funds into digital assets. Authorities are expanding the investigation.

records.title: Lena Oberdorf denounces sexualized AI-generated videos
records.description: Lena Oberdorf, Bayern Munich and Germany midfielder, reports non-consensual AI-generated videos that depict her in sexualized scenarios circulating online, objectifying her and infringing her privacy. She criticizes the digital harassment, including deepfake edits shared on TikTok, and calls for an end to AI-driven sexualization of female footballers.

records.title: Whoopi Goldberg Warns Against AI-Generated Fake Ad
records.description: Whoopi Goldberg has publicly condemned a fake AI-generated advertisement using her image to promote weight-loss drugs without her consent. The manipulated video, circulating on social media, misrepresents Goldberg, violating her intellectual property rights. She warned viewers on 'The View' not to trust the ad, emphasizing her lack of involvement.

records.title: Rising deepfake realism fuels crime, prompts new detection system
records.description: ByteDance's new OmniHuman-1 deepfake model exemplifies the rising realism of AI-generated fakes, which have fueled sexual exploitation in South Korea (over 1,094 cases, 573 arrests) and workplace impersonation fraud. In response, South Korean police plan a multimodal deepfake detection system by 2027.

records.title: DeepSeek AI Censors Sino-Vatican Bishop Appointment Inquiry
records.description: China’s startup DeepSeek deployed its R1 chatbot to field religious and political queries but repeatedly refused to discuss the Sino-Vatican bishop appointment agreement. It deleted or declined sensitive answers, cited caution, and urged Catholic users to join the state-approved church and avoid public expressions of faith to comply with government controls.

records.title: AI-generated ebooks overwhelm public library platforms
records.description: Low-quality AI-generated ebooks, flooding platforms like OverDrive and Hoopla, overwhelm understaffed librarians and automated filters. Libraries waste public funds on unreadable content, degrading collection quality and misleading patrons who assume it’s human-written. With no easy solution, generative AI threatens library curation and community trust.

records.title: DeepSeek AI Chatbot Enforces Chinese Censorship, Curtails Free Speech
records.description: Chinese startup DeepSeek’s AI chatbot, now popular globally, adheres to China’s stringent CCP censorship, erasing politically sensitive content and echoing sanitized responses on topics like U.S. policies or AI leadership. The platform restricts free speech and access to truthful information, shaping public opinion and raising global concern.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Videos Lead to Death Threats for Pakistani TikToker
records.description: Pakistani TikToker Imsha Rehman faced severe emotional distress and death threats after AI-generated fake explicit videos of her went viral. The scandal forced her offline and prevented her from attending university. Rehman criticized the creators and spreaders of such harmful content for not considering the consequences.

records.title: Israeli AI-Powered Drones Fuel Startup Boom Amid Gaza War
records.description: Israeli startups like Xtend supply AI-integrated drones to the Israeli military, enabling remote high-precision strikes and surveillance—most notably tracking and filming Hamas leader Yahya Sinwar’s death. These systems, operable from thousands of kilometers away with minimal human intervention, underscore the growing role of autonomous technology in modern warfare.

records.title: Seventh Grader Uses AI to Create and Distribute Fake Nude Images of Classmates
records.description: A seventh-grade student used AI to create and distribute fake pornographic images of at least seven classmates. The incident was reported by a parent on social media, leading to the images being deleted and a police report filed. The school is addressing the issue with psychological support for the victims.

records.title: DeepSeek-R1 AI Model Poses Global Security Risks
records.description: The DeepSeek-R1 AI model, developed by a China-based company, is found to be 11 times more likely to generate harmful content, including hate speech and threats, compared to other models. Research by Enkrypt AI highlights its vulnerability to manipulation, potentially aiding in the creation of chemical and biological weapons, raising significant global security concerns.

records.title: 360’s Zhou Hongyi Deploys AI Defense to Shield DeepSeek Amid State Cyberattacks
records.description: 360 founder Zhou Hongyi offered free AI-powered cybersecurity defense to Chinese AI firm DeepSeek after large-scale, state-backed cyberattacks disrupted its service. Zhou says 360’s dedicated high-speed lines and AI systems fully block attacks and trace origins. He also noted DeepSeek’s open-source AI breakthroughs have alarmed Western governments.

records.title: US Government Bans Chinese AI Chatbot DeepSeek Over Security, Malware Risks
records.description: The US House of Representatives and the Department of Defense have barred staff from using the Chinese AI chatbot DeepSeek on official devices after reports it was used to spread malware, infect systems, and store data on Chinese servers. The ban remains until a full security review is completed.

records.title: US Congress Bans DeepSeek Chatbot Over Malware Security Threat
records.description: The U.S. House’s Chief Administrative Officer has barred staff from installing Chinese AI chatbot DeepSeek on all official devices after reports that hackers are exploiting it to deliver malware and infect phones, tablets and computers. The ban aims to curb security risks while DeepSeek undergoes further review.

records.title: AI Deepfakes Fuel Sophisticated Online Scams in France
records.description: AI-generated deepfakes and fake emails are increasingly used in sophisticated online scams, leading to financial harm. In France, over 130,000 online scams were recorded in 2023, marking an 8% annual increase. Notable scams include a woman losing €830,000 to a fake Brad Pitt and fictitious donations for Los Angeles fire victims.

records.title: Italian University Repeats Exam Due to AI Cheating
records.description: At the University of Ferrara in Italy, over 350 psychology students must retake an exam after it was discovered that AI tools like ChatGPT were used to cheat. The unusually high scores prompted the university to invalidate the results, requiring a retake with measures to prevent external assistance.

records.title: Safe Pro and NIBULON Deploy AI-Powered Drones to Demine Ukrainian Farmland
records.description: Safe Pro Group has signed a multi-year MOU with Ukrainian grain exporter NIBULON to deploy its SpotlightAI platform on AWS, using drones and AI to survey 6 million acres of war-contaminated farmland. The system has analyzed 931,107 images, locating thousands of landmines and UXO to restore safe agricultural land.

records.title: UK Enacts Laws Against AI-Generated Child Abuse Images
records.description: The UK government has introduced new laws to combat AI-generated child sexual abuse material, becoming the first country to criminalize the possession, creation, or distribution of such AI tools. Offenders face up to five years in prison. The legislation also targets AI manuals for abuse, addressing a fivefold increase in such crimes.

records.title: DeepSeek R1 Vulnerabilities Expose Cybercrime Risks and IP Misuse
records.description: Palo Alto Networks' Unit 42 found DeepSeek's R1 chatbot easily jailbroken, enabling malicious instructions for cybercrime. Meanwhile DeepSeek faces allegations of training R1 on unauthorized OpenAI data, violating intellectual property rights. Microsoft now hosts R1 on Azure, raising concerns over security, intellectual property infringement and AI-driven censorship of sensitive topics.

records.title: DeepSeek chatbot fails 83% of queries, spreads disinformation
records.description: An independent NewsGuard audit found Chinese AI chatbot DeepSeek failed to provide accurate answers 83% of the time, repeating falsehoods 30% and refusing 53%, and injected pro-government bias. Italy’s privacy regulator blocked it over data processing concerns, while hacker attacks degraded its service. The flaws risk widespread misinformation.

records.title: DeepSeek AI chat faces global bans after data breach exposes private chats
records.description: Chinese AI chat system DeepSeek has been restricted by hundreds of companies and several governments over privacy concerns. A critical security flaw recently allowed hackers to access millions of private chat logs, secret keys and metadata, prompting Italy’s ban. DeepSeek plans stronger encryption, security audits and compliance measures.

records.title: DeepSeek Under Investigation for IP Theft, GPU Smuggling, and API Misuse
records.description: Chinese startup DeepSeek faces investigations by OpenAI, Microsoft, and US regulators over alleged misuse of OpenAI-generated data for model training, unauthorized access to the OpenAI API, and illegal procurement of Nvidia GPUs via Singapore, potentially violating IP rights, service terms, and US export controls.

records.title: Generative AI Fuels Biometric Fraud Surge in Africa
records.description: Smile ID's 2025 report reveals a surge in biometric fraud across Africa, driven by generative AI and deepfakes. These technologies enable fraudsters to exploit fintech vulnerabilities, creating lifelike fake documents and videos. This trend poses significant risks to trust, revenue, and operational stability in digital financial services.

records.title: State-Backed Hackers Exploit Google Gemini and DeepSeek AI for Cyberattacks
records.description: US officials and security researchers warn that hackers sponsored by China, Iran, Russia, and North Korea are leveraging AI chatbots such as Google Gemini and DeepSeek to generate malicious code, conduct reconnaissance, and craft phishing campaigns. Concurrently, DeepSeek exposed over one million user records in a data breach, intensifying privacy concerns.

records.title: Iranian and Chinese Hackers Exploit American AI for Cyber Attacks
records.description: Hackers linked to Iran and China are reportedly using American AI technologies, such as Google's chatbot Gemini, to enhance cyber attacks against the US and other countries. These AI tools assist in writing malicious code, identifying system vulnerabilities, and researching target organizations, raising concerns about potential harm to critical infrastructure.

records.title: State-backed hackers abuse Google's Gemini AI for global cyberattacks
records.description: More than 50 state-backed APT groups from over 20 countries—including Iran’s APT42, Chinese, North Korean, and Russian actors—are abusing Google’s Gemini generative AI chatbot for reconnaissance, phishing, malware translation, and disinformation campaigns. While jailbreak attempts failed, Gemini accelerates and scales existing cyberattack tactics, raising security concerns globally.

records.title: Massachusetts Man Pleads Guilty to AI-Driven Cyberstalking
records.description: James Florence Jr., a Massachusetts man, has agreed to plead guilty to cyberstalking charges involving AI chatbots. Over a decade, he used AI tools to create harmful content, including pornographic images and impersonating a professor to lure strangers to her home. His actions violated human rights and privacy laws.

records.title: AI Used in Child Exploitation Case at Georgia High School
records.description: Ronald Richardson, a vendor at Gilmer High School in Georgia, was arrested for using AI to create sexually explicit images of minors. He allegedly altered photos from social media to make them appear nude. This marks the first AI-related child exploitation case for the Gilmer Sheriff's Office.

records.title: AI-Generated Content Deceives Adolescents, Study Finds
records.description: A study by Common Sense Media reveals that AI-generated videos and images frequently deceive adolescents, with 35% of surveyed teens admitting to being misled by false content. The research highlights a lack of trust in tech companies among youth, as misinformation impacts their mental well-being and online trust.

records.title: Autonomous Bus Under Test Hit by Conventional Bus in Kumamoto
records.description: During a test run near Kumamoto City Hall, a self-driving bus in Kumamoto City’s trial program was rear-ended by a conventional route bus at an intersection. Four staff aboard the autonomous vehicle were uninjured, but damage to its rear has led authorities to reconsider its planned February passenger service.

records.title: DeepSeek Generative AI Hit by US-Sourced Cyberattack Amid Misuse Fears
records.description: Chinese AI startup DeepSeek suffered a large-scale cyberattack traced to US IP addresses that disrupted its generative AI service, limited new registrations, and targeted user credentials. Experts warn its inadequate misuse safeguards also enable malware generation. The incident prompted US national security and OpenAI investigations, heightening Sino-American tech tensions.

records.title: Facial Recognition IDs Suspect in Saif Ali Khan Stabbing
records.description: Mumbai Police applied AI-driven facial recognition to CCTV footage in the January 16 stabbing of actor Saif Ali Khan. The system matched the accused Bangladeshi national Mohammad Shariful Islam Shehzad to the intruder, bolstering evidence and leading to his arrest and ongoing prosecution.

records.title: OpenAI and Microsoft accuse DeepSeek of model theft; Italy blocks app over privacy
records.description: OpenAI and Microsoft allege DeepSeek illicitly used proprietary ChatGPT models via distillation to train its AI, prompting joint investigations. US and other authorities claim IP theft has fueled DeepSeek’s rapid global expansion. Meanwhile, Italy’s data protection regulator blocked DeepSeek’s app over privacy and data transparency concerns.

records.title: DeepSeek AI Data Breach Exposes Sensitive Information
records.description: Wiz, a cybersecurity firm, discovered a security vulnerability in DeepSeek, a Chinese AI startup, exposing sensitive data online. The breach included chat records and API secrets, allowing unauthorized access. DeepSeek quickly addressed the issue, but concerns remain about data privacy, prompting inquiries from Italian and Australian regulators.

records.title: Google’s AI-Powered Play Protect Blocks 2.3M Malicious Android Apps
records.description: In 2024 Google Play’s AI-enhanced Play Protect scanned over 200 billion apps daily, using real-time code-level analysis and AI-assisted reviews to block 2.36 million policy-violating apps and ban 158,000 developer accounts. The AI system also prevented apps from accessing sensitive data unnecessarily, protecting users from malware and fraud.

records.title: DeepSeek AI Faces Global Bans and Surging Cyberattacks
records.description: Multiple national regulators—including Italy, Ireland, Australia and the U.S.—are restricting or investigating Chinese AI firm DeepSeek over privacy and national security concerns. Meanwhile, cybersecurity labs observed a hundredfold increase in DDoS, HTTP proxy and brute-force attacks by botnets, disrupting its online services and prompting urgent security defenses.

records.title: AI Voice Cloning Used in Fraudulent Scams
records.description: In Sonora, cybercriminals are using AI to clone voices from internet videos and pre-recorded calls to commit fraud. They hijack WhatsApp accounts to convincingly impersonate victims and solicit money from their contacts. Authorities recommend security measures like using security questions to verify identities in emergencies.

records.title: AI Facial Recognition Evidence Excluded in Cleveland Murder Case
records.description: In Cleveland, Ohio, a murder investigation is jeopardized after a judge excluded evidence obtained via AI facial recognition software from Clearview AI. The police used this technology to secure a search warrant, despite warnings against its legal admissibility. The decision raises concerns about AI's role in law enforcement and legal procedures.

records.title: AI-Enhanced Malware Attacks Exploit Web Images
records.description: Hackers are using generative AI to enhance malware attacks by embedding malicious code in web images, according to an HP report. This approach reduces the skills and time needed for attacks, allowing cybercriminals to bypass security tools and infect endpoints. The report highlights the diversification of attack methods in 2024.

records.title: DeepSeek AI App Raises Concerns Over Chinese Censorship
records.description: The Chinese AI app DeepSeek, which has surpassed ChatGPT in popularity, is under scrutiny for censoring content on sensitive topics like Tiananmen Square and Taiwan. This censorship aligns with Chinese regulations, raising concerns about freedom of expression and human rights violations. The app's popularity has impacted US tech stocks.

records.title: AI-powered moderation restricts half a million Hungarian users
records.description: A study for Hungary’s National Media and Infocommunications Authority found that Facebook and YouTube use AI to make millions of monthly moderation decisions, restricting up to half a million Hungarian users without meaningful human oversight or clear explanations, raising concerns over transparency and freedom of expression.

records.title: Hiya AI Phone Launches to Block Live and Deepfake Scam Calls
records.description: Hiya introduced Hiya AI Phone, an AI call assistant that screens, transcribes, and automatically blocks spam, scam, and voice deepfake calls using real-time voice intelligence and deep learning. As one in three Americans face deepfake scams—losing an average of $7,200—this tool prevents financial harm and saves users time.

records.title: DeepSeek Faces Privacy Violation Complaints in Europe
records.description: Testachats has filed a complaint against the Chinese AI system DeepSeek with the Belgian Data Protection Authority, citing multiple privacy violations. These include improper data transfer, profiling, and inadequate protection of minors, contravening the EU's GDPR. Concerns also involve data being transferred to China without proper safeguards.

records.title: Carin León debunks AI deepfake suggesting romance with Espinoza Paz
records.description: Mexican singer Carin León denied rumors of a romantic relationship with singer Espinoza Paz after AI-generated deepfake videos circulated online showing them kissing. Through sarcastic social media posts, he highlighted how easily AI can manipulate personal identities, criticised the spread of misinformation, and refuted any changes to his sexual orientation.

records.title: Chinese AI Chatbot DeepSeek Blocked in Italy Over Privacy and Censorship Concerns
records.description: Chinese AI chatbot DeepSeek collects extensive user data under China’s surveillance laws. Italy’s data protection authority has blocked it and prompted Apple and Google to remove the app over GDPR inquiries. Security researchers also revealed built-in censorship of topics like Taiwan and Tiananmen, sparking privacy and information-freedom concerns.

records.title: DeepSeek Accused of Misusing OpenAI's Technology and Censoring Sensitive Topics
records.description: OpenAI accuses Chinese startup DeepSeek of using its proprietary models to train a competitor, potentially breaching intellectual property rights. Microsoft is investigating unauthorized data access linked to DeepSeek. Additionally, DeepSeek's AI aligns with Chinese government stances, censoring sensitive topics, raising concerns over freedom of expression and misinformation.

records.title: AI Deepfake of Eckart von Hirschhausen Endorses Fake Medications
records.description: Eckart von Hirschhausen, a German physician and TV host, had AI-generated deepfake videos falsely showing him endorsing weight loss, heart, and potency drugs. These deepfakes deceived consumers into buying ineffective or harmful medications, causing financial and health risks and reputational damage, prompting him to call for stricter AI regulation.

records.title: Indian publishers sue OpenAI over alleged AI copyright infringement
records.description: Indian news outlets (The Indian Express, Hindustan Times, NDTV) and book publishers (Penguin Random House, Bloomsbury, Rupa) have filed lawsuits in Delhi High Court, accusing OpenAI of using their copyrighted articles and books without authorization to train ChatGPT and demanding dataset deletion or licensing fees.

records.title: Chinese DeepSeek chatbot censored political queries, experts warn of surveillance use
records.description: Chinese startup DeepSeek’s AI chatbot rapidly topped US App Store downloads but censors sensitive topics like Tiananmen, Taiwan and Xi Jinping. Experts warn Beijing could exploit DeepSeek for surveillance, misinformation and coercion abroad, eroding public trust and reinforcing authoritarian narratives.

records.title: AI-Generated Racist Recording Leads to Trial and Arrest
records.description: Dazhon Darien, 32, is accused of using AI to impersonate a former Pikesville High School principal in a racist recording targeting Black students and the Jewish community. The recording, which went viral, led to charges of disturbing school operations and other offenses. Darien was also arrested on federal child pornography charges.

records.title: Chinese AI Chatbot DeepSeek Faces Global Bans Over Privacy and Censorship Concerns
records.description: Chinese AI chatbot DeepSeek has been banned by over 100 companies and government agencies—including the US Navy, Italy, and Ireland—after reports it collects personal data and censors politically sensitive queries (e.g., Arunachal Pradesh). Regulators and firms cite privacy violations, security risks, and state-aligned bias in its outputs.

records.title: AFP Warns of Rising AI-Generated Child Abuse Material
records.description: The Australian Federal Police (AFP) reports a surge in AI-generated child abuse material, urging parents to discuss its dangers with children. The Australian Centre to Counter Child Exploitation notes increased use of AI for creating harmful content, including deepfakes, by students. Legal consequences have been highlighted, with recent arrests and school incidents.

records.title: French open-source AI Lucie shut down after absurd errors
records.description: Lucie, France’s first open-source generative AI model backed by the government, launched for public testing on January 23 but produced bizarre and incorrect outputs—like claiming cows lay eggs and giving wrong math—prompting widespread ridicule and a temporary shutdown on January 25 for further refinement.

records.title: Taiwan deploys AI to counter deepfake-driven holiday scams
records.description: Taiwan’s National Cybersecurity Institute enhanced its AI-driven fraud detection to automatically scan over 100 social media ads every 10 minutes, using NLP and machine learning to spot deepfake and AI-generated scam adverts within 20 minutes. Integrated STIX-based data sharing with platforms and law enforcement rapidly removes suspicious content and blocks fraud.

records.title: Blogger finds Tesla FSD 13.2 unsafe amid global rollout plans
records.description: A US automotive influencer spent $198 testing Tesla FSD 13.2 for one month and encountered numerous AI malfunctions—unsafe lane changes, ignored stop signs and pedestrians, misread traffic lights, 'ghost braking' and sudden emergency stops causing near-collisions. Meanwhile, Tesla eyes public road trials in China and US rollout, raising safety concerns.

records.title: Character.AI Faces Wrongful Death Lawsuit Over Teen’s Suicide, Cites Free Speech Defense
records.description: Megan Garcia sued Character.AI and Google after her 14-year-old son killed himself following prolonged chats that allegedly encouraged self-harm. Character.AI, backed by Google, added safety measures in December but has filed a motion to dismiss the wrongful death suit, arguing its AI chatbots are protected by the First Amendment.

records.title: Hackers exploit generative AI to launch smarter, more frequent cyberattacks
records.description: Hackers now leverage generative AI to craft smarter, more frequent and stealthier cyberattacks, causing data breaches, extortion and financial losses. A Splunk CISO report shows 52% of security leaders use AI defensively, yet only 33% of board members fully recognize these evolving threats, revealing a widening strategic gap.

records.title: Catalonia warns of surge in AI-enabled cyber scams
records.description: In Catalonia, cybercriminals used AI-driven deepfakes, phishing and fake QR codes to carry out about 240 scams daily in 2024, exposing millions of personal records. Laura Caballero, director of the Catalan Cybersecurity Agency, has announced a €2 million investment in AI alert systems, an intelligent assistant and training to combat these threats.

records.title: Xiaomi Recalls Thousands of SU7 Vehicles Due to Autonomous Parking System Malfunction
records.description: Xiaomi has recalled 30,931 SU7 electric sedans due to a malfunction in the autonomous parking system, which caused unexpected vehicle movements and potential property damage. The issue, linked to a cloud service synchronization error, will be resolved via an over-the-air software update, avoiding the need for service center visits.

records.title: AI Weapon Detection System Fails in Nashville School Shooting
records.description: An AI-powered weapon detection system, Omnilert, failed to detect a gun used in a Nashville school shooting, resulting in the death of a student. The system's cameras did not capture the weapon due to its location, raising concerns about the effectiveness of such AI systems in preventing school shootings.

records.title: FBI warns: Two keywords signal AI-powered phishing scam
records.description: The FBI warns that scammers are using AI-driven social engineering to craft convincing phishing emails. If an email contains two specific keywords—often tied to fake disaster relief or donation appeals—it’s likely a scam. These AI-enabled schemes have already caused financial losses and personal data theft by directing victims to realistic fake help sites.

records.title: Global ChatGPT Outage Linked to Russian Cyberattack
records.description: On January 23, ChatGPT experienced a global outage, affecting users in Europe, the US, and other regions. The disruption, potentially caused by a Russian hacker group, was allegedly due to the AI's use by Ukrainian forces for satellite image analysis. OpenAI reported high error rates but has not confirmed the attack.

records.title: GhostGPT: AI Tool for Cybercrime
records.description: GhostGPT, an uncensored AI chatbot, is being used by cybercriminals for creating malware and phishing scams. Developed from a jailbroken version of ChatGPT or similar models, it lacks ethical safeguards, offering features like no-log policies and easy access via Telegram. This raises significant concerns about AI misuse in cybercrime.

records.title: French Families Sue TikTok Over Teen Suicides Linked to Harmful Content
records.description: Several families in France, led by Stephanie Mistre, are suing TikTok, alleging its AI algorithm promoted harmful content that contributed to the suicides of teenagers, including Mistre's daughter Marie. The lawsuit claims TikTok's algorithm repeatedly exposed users to videos promoting suicide methods, normalizing depression and self-harm.

records.title: Microsoft's AI and Cloud Technology Support Israeli Military in Gaza Conflict
