records.description: Reports reveal that Microsoft provided AI and cloud computing support to the Israeli military during the Gaza conflict, enhancing their operational capabilities. This collaboration involved significant financial deals and increased reliance on Microsoft's technology for military operations, raising concerns about the ethical implications of AI in warfare.

records.title: AI-generated Posters Lead to Copyright Infringement Charges
records.description: Two men in Japan were charged with copyright infringement for using generative AI to create and sell unauthorized posters of characters from popular anime like 'Evangelion' and 'Yu-Gi-Oh!'. They admitted to generating explicit images and selling them online, earning significant profits. The incident highlights the misuse of AI in violating intellectual property rights.

records.title: Google's AI Technology Support to Israeli Military in Gaza Conflict
records.description: Google has been providing advanced AI technology to the Israeli military since the early stages of the conflict in Gaza, as revealed by internal documents obtained by the Washington Post. Despite employee protests, Google continued its support, raising concerns about potential harm and human rights violations.

records.title: LinkedIn Faces Lawsuit Over AI Training with Private Messages
records.description: LinkedIn is facing a class-action lawsuit in the US for allegedly using Premium users' private messages to train AI models without consent. The lawsuit claims LinkedIn breached contracts and violated privacy laws by secretly sharing data with third parties. LinkedIn denies the allegations, calling them baseless.

records.title: Indian Publishers and News Agency Sue OpenAI Over Unauthorized Use of Content in ChatGPT Training
records.description: The Federation of Indian Publishers (members include Bloomsbury, Penguin Random House, Cambridge University Press, Pan Macmillan, Rupa, S.Chand) and news agency ANI have sued OpenAI in the Delhi High Court, alleging ChatGPT’s unauthorized use of their copyrighted works for training. They demand dataset deletion and access bans; OpenAI cites US legal obligations and jurisdictional limits.

records.title: Meta’s AI misfires cause misinformation, censorship and forced follows
records.description: Meta’s AI systems have misfired, with its chatbot still naming Joe Biden as president days after Donald Trump’s inauguration, its content moderation algorithms blocking contraceptive providers, and its follower-transfer algorithm automatically forcing US users to follow Trump’s accounts—prompting internal emergency procedures and public outcry over misinformation, rights violations and censorship.

records.title: Indonesian Police Arrest Fraudster Using AI Deepfake to Impersonate Officials
records.description: Indonesian police arrested a fraudster in Lampung for using AI deepfake technology to impersonate government officials on social media. The Directorate of Cyber Crime at Bareskrim Polri, led by Brigjen Himawan Bayu Aji, quickly apprehended the suspect. Details on the fraud method and the impersonated official will be disclosed in a press release.

records.title: Greek Government Advocates for AI Mass Surveillance in EU
records.description: The Greek government, led by Prime Minister Mitsotakis, has been instrumental in advocating for the use of AI technologies for mass surveillance in public spaces across the EU. Despite other EU countries seeking safeguards, Greece pushed for fewer restrictions, raising concerns about potential human rights violations, particularly privacy rights.

records.title: Deployment of AI-Powered Kamikaze Drones in Ukraine Conflict
records.description: Russia has deployed 3,000 AI-powered kamikaze drones, named "Mikrob," in the Ukraine conflict zone. These drones can autonomously track targets after operator acquisition, even if the target maneuvers. The modular design allows for various equipment configurations, enhancing their operational capabilities and potential for harm.

records.title: Truecaller Fights AI Voice Cloning Fraud
records.description: Sweden's Truecaller AB is combating AI-generated voice cloning used by criminals to defraud phone users. Scammers clone voices to impersonate CEOs and request large transfers or pose as fake customers to infiltrate companies. Truecaller uses technology to detect computer-generated voices and prevent such fraud.

records.title: Google and Microsoft Provide AI Tools to Israeli Military in Gaza Conflict
records.description: Leaked documents show Google and Microsoft supplying AI and cloud services—including GPT-4—for intelligence, surveillance and targeting to the Israel Defense Forces since early in the Gaza war. Employee protests and firings over ethical concerns have emerged amid reports of civilian harm linked to these AI-enabled operations.

records.title: Sexyy Red AI-Generated MLK Jr. Images Spark Outrage and Apologies
records.description: Rapper Sexyy Red posted AI-generated images of Martin Luther King Jr., prompting his daughter Bernice King to condemn them as disrespectful. After backlash, Sexyy Red deleted the images and apologized; Bernice King accepted the apology, highlighting the harm AI deepfakes can cause by dishonoring historical figures.

records.title: Instagram search glitch hides “Democrat(s)” results, sparks bias claims
records.description: Meta is urgently fixing an Instagram search bug that hides results for “Democrat” and “Democrats,” showing “we’ve hidden results.” Users blamed political bias after Zuckerberg attended Trump’s inauguration. Meta calls it a technical glitch affecting other hashtags and vows to restore normal functionality.

records.title: GEMA Sues Suno Inc. Over AI-Generated Music
records.description: GEMA has filed a lawsuit against Suno Inc. at the Munich Regional Court, accusing the US company of using its AI tool to generate music that closely resembles copyrighted songs like "Atemlos" and "Mambo No. 5" without compensating the original creators, potentially violating intellectual property rights.

records.title: Goldman Sachs’ AI Assistant Sparks Prediction of 200,000 Job Cuts
records.description: Goldman Sachs deployed its GS AI Assistant to 10,000 employees for tasks like email summarization and code translation. CIO Marco Argenti predicts that expanding such AI could lead to up to 200,000 global job cuts within five years, reflecting banks’ broader trend of AI-driven workforce automation.

records.title: TikTok Removes AI-Generated Deepfake Video of Minister Haddad
records.description: TikTok removed a deepfake video falsely attributing statements about "taxation of the poor" to Brazil's Finance Minister Fernando Haddad. The video, created using AI, was taken down after the Brazilian Attorney General's Office (AGU) notified TikTok, citing misinformation and potential human rights violations. The video had been previously removed but was re-uploaded by the same user.

records.title: 2024 China Cybersecurity Report: AI Fuels Phishing and APT Attacks
records.description: China’s 2024 Cybersecurity Report warns AI’s large language models let hackers generate near-perfect phishing emails, poison detection systems and automate espionage. Groups like Patchwork, Bitter and SideWinder used AI-driven attacks to infiltrate universities, aerospace companies and defense firms, stealing research data and national secrets.

records.title: Anne Menden Outraged by AI-Generated Deepfake Pregnancy Images
records.description: Anne Menden, a German actress, expressed outrage over AI-generated deepfake images falsely depicting her as pregnant. She condemned the manipulation as disrespectful and a violation of her personal rights. The incident highlights concerns over privacy and the misuse of AI technology in creating misleading content.

records.title: Delhi Man Arrested for AI-Generated Image Extortion
records.description: Nikhil Singh, a 21-year-old from Delhi, was arrested for using AI to create explicit images of women from their social media profiles to blackmail and extort them. He posed as a woman online to gain trust, then threatened to publicize the doctored images unless paid. The case highlights AI misuse in cybercrime.

records.title: NHTSA Investigates Ford's BlueCruise After Fatal Crashes
records.description: The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) has escalated its investigation into Ford's BlueCruise, an AI-based hands-free driving system, following fatal crashes involving Ford Mustang Mach-E vehicles. The system failed to prevent collisions with stationary vehicles, leading to three fatalities. The probe could result in a significant recall of over 129,000 vehicles.

records.title: Boardy AI Criticized for Gender-Biased Email Campaign
records.description: Boardy AI faced backlash for an email campaign where its AI system sent gender-biased comments on users' appearances, particularly targeting women, in the style of Donald Trump. The incident highlighted issues of responsible AI use in corporate communications, prompting an apology from CEO Andrew D'souza.

records.title: Lyon Mayor Quits X Citing AI-Driven Hate and Defamation
records.description: Lyon’s Green mayor Grégory Doucet has deactivated his X account, denouncing the platform’s AI-fueled algorithm that amplifies daily violence, unpunished hate speech and defamatory content since Elon Musk’s takeover. He warns this unchecked, arbitrary system empowers extremist communities and undermines democratic discourse.

records.title: Robot Vacuum Hacked to Hurl Racial Slurs
records.description: In the US, a man's Ecovacs robot vacuum was hacked to insult him with racial slurs. This incident highlights security vulnerabilities in smart devices, making them susceptible to hacking. Despite reporting the issue, the company dismissed it as credential stuffing, a common problem with inadequate security measures in such devices.

records.title: Shield AI's V-BAT drones empower Ukraine’s frontline operations
records.description: Shield AI has opened a Kyiv office with on-ground engineers and mission operators to train Ukraine’s Unmanned Systems Forces on its autonomous V-BAT drones. Resistant to Russian jamming, these AI-powered VTOL UAS perform ISR, deep penetration targeting, and kamikaze strikes in GPS-denied environments, directly enabling lethal operations against Russian forces.

records.title: Uber's Pricing Algorithm Charges Higher Fares for Low Battery and Certain Devices
records.description: Entrepreneur Rishabh Singh’s experiments on four phones revealed Uber’s dynamic pricing algorithm displays higher fares for identical routes when device model (iPhone vs Android) or low battery levels are detected. This opaque AI-driven practice has sparked consumer outrage over unethical data-based fare discrimination and demands for transparency.

records.title: Spanish regulator fines Cartonajes Bañeres and Osasuna for facial‐recognition breaches
records.description: Spain’s data protection authority fined Cartonajes Bañeres €220 000 and Osasuna CF €200 000 for deploying facial-recognition systems for employee check-ins and stadium access without proper legal bases or alternatives, violating GDPR and posing high risks to fundamental rights.

records.title: Grok AI deepfakes of Abascal, Milei, Meloni and Trump mislead users
records.description: Multiple AI-generated images created with X's Grok tool—one showing Santiago Abascal with Giorgia Meloni, Javier Milei and Donald Trump, another of Milei kissing the US flag with Trump—circulated as authentic before fact-checkers debunked them. Colombian President Gustavo Petro shared and then deleted one such fake image.

records.title: AI-Powered Kamikaze Drone Assault Causes Damage and Injuries in Ukraine
records.description: On January 22, Ukraine endured nearly 100 AI-powered kamikaze UAVs employing machine vision for autonomous targeting across multiple regions. The coordinated drone strike—relying on inertial navigation, satellite GPS, and optical sensors—inflicted widespread property damage and soldier casualties, marking a major escalation in AI-enabled warfare.

records.title: US moves to ban TikTok over AI-powered data risks, then delays enforcement
records.description: On January 19, the US enacted a Biden-era law banning TikTok amid AI-driven content recommendation and data-privacy concerns, spurring influencers’ farewell videos. Within a day, the new Trump administration delayed enforcement by 75 days and proposed a 50% US stake in ByteDance to maintain TikTok access.

records.title: Deepfake AI Incident Leads to Teacher's Near Imprisonment
records.description: Cheryl Bennett, a PE teacher, faced severe personal and professional consequences after a deepfake video falsely depicting her as racist went viral. The AI-generated clip led to her being sent home from work and nearly jailed, highlighting the potential harm of deepfake technology on individuals' rights and reputations.

records.title: AI-Generated Misinformation Sparks Public Panic
records.description: AI tools were used to create fake images and videos, such as a boy buried in rubble and a Hollywood sign engulfed by fire, spreading misinformation and causing public panic. These incidents highlight the challenges in detecting AI-generated content and the need for improved governance and transparency in AI systems.

records.title: Consumers Fight AI-Driven 'Big Data Price Discrimination'
records.description: Chinese e-commerce and ride-hailing platforms use big data algorithms to charge loyal users higher prices than new or infrequent users. Consumers report price gaps—10 yuan on appliances, cheaper fares for co-passengers—and resort to tactics like new accounts and reverse reviews to counteract discriminatory pricing labeled as 'differentiated marketing.'

records.title: AI-Driven Scam Exploits Spanish Princess's Identity
records.description: Scammers used AI to create fake social media profiles impersonating Spanish Princess Leonor, deceiving followers, especially in Latin America, with promises of financial rewards. Victims were lured into paying escalating fees under the guise of administrative costs. The scam included mimicking the princess's voice, leading to significant financial losses for individuals like Juana Cobo from Guatemala.

records.title: Amazon Halts Drone Deliveries After Crashes
records.description: Amazon has paused its drone delivery services in Texas and Arizona following two crashes of its MK30 drones during testing in Oregon. One drone caught fire, raising safety concerns. The crashes were attributed to a software issue linked to light rain. Amazon is making software updates and insists the pause is voluntary.

records.title: Healthcare AI decayed during pandemic, missing vital care prompts
records.description: An AI-based mortality predictor at Penn Medicine lost 7% accuracy during COVID-19, failing to alert doctors for hundreds of end-of-life conversations, potentially causing unnecessary treatments. The case highlights widespread healthcare AI decay and underscores the need for ongoing monitoring and human oversight.

records.title: AI in Social Media Amplifies Gender Stereotypes
records.description: A study by Milagros del Saz from the Universitat Politècnica de València highlights how AI systems, trained on social media data, can perpetuate and amplify gender stereotypes and inequalities. The research focuses on linguistic and aggressive behavior patterns on platforms like Twitter, showing AI's role in exacerbating gender biases.

records.title: AI-Powered Ransomware Group FunkSec Emerges as Major Threat
records.description: FunkSec, a new ransomware group, has emerged as a significant threat by using AI to enhance its cyberattack tools, stealing sensitive data and demanding ransoms. Identified by Check Point Research, FunkSec was responsible for 14% of ransomware attacks in December 2024, affecting over 85 victims, though some claims are unverified.

records.title: AI Deepfake Porn Scandal at US School
records.description: A scandal involving AI-generated deepfake pornography has affected students at Lancaster Country Day School in Pennsylvania. The incident, which involved 347 images and videos impacting 60 victims, highlights the misuse of AI technology to create non-consensual explicit content, raising concerns about long-term impacts on victims' privacy and dignity.

records.title: Apple's AI News Summarization Error Leads to Misinformation
records.description: Apple suspended its AI news summarization feature after it produced incorrect headlines, leading to misinformation and complaints from news organizations like BBC and New York Times. The AI's errors increased misinformation and distrust in news content, prompting pressure from media groups to halt the feature.

records.title: AI-Generated Child Abuse Images Challenge Law Enforcement
records.description: AI-generated child abuse images are complicating investigations in Rheinland-Pfalz, Germany. Mario Germano, head of the state criminal office, highlights the difficulty in distinguishing between real and AI-created images, potentially leading to wasted resources in searching for non-existent victims and complicating law enforcement efforts.

records.title: Pub Mentzen Apologizes for Unauthorized AI-Generated Meme of Iga Świątek
records.description: After FC Barcelona’s 5-2 win over Real Madrid, Pub Mentzen, owned by politician Sławomir Mentzen, shared an AI-generated meme showing Iga Świątek pouring vodka. Facing public outcry over unauthorized use of her likeness, the pub apologized, removed the post, pledged no future misuse and agreed to donate to an addiction support organization.

records.title: Slovak Finance Ministry Warns Against Deepfake Video Scam
records.description: The Slovak Ministry of Finance warns against a deepfake video circulating on social media, falsely depicting Finance Minister Ladislav Kamenický promoting investment strategies. The video manipulates his identity and statements using AI, posing a threat to vulnerable groups. The ministry urges the public to ignore and not share the video.

records.title: Pulitzer Prize-winning Cartoonist Arrested for AI-Generated Child Pornography
records.description: Pulitzer Prize-winning cartoonist Darrin Bell was arrested in California for possessing child pornography, including AI-generated material. This marks the first arrest under a new California law banning AI-generated child sexual abuse content. The arrest followed a tip from the National Center for Missing and Exploited Children, leading to the discovery of over 100 videos.

records.title: AI Used to Bypass Ticket Verification Mechanisms in China
records.description: In Guilin, China, a scalper gang used AI to bypass graphical verification on a ticketing platform, illegally acquiring 10,000 tickets during a holiday. The AI was trained to recognize verification images, exploiting platform vulnerabilities. Authorities arrested 12 suspects and warned of the risks of such AI misuse, urging enhanced security measures.

records.title: Delhi Police appoints nodal officer to curb AI deepfake misuse in elections
records.description: The Delhi Police has appointed Joint Commissioner Vikramjit Singh as a nodal officer to monitor social media and SMS for AI-generated deepfake videos and misleading messages during the upcoming assembly elections, enabling real-time tracking, complaint verification and FIR registration to curb election-related misinformation.

records.title: Misleading AI Fertility Apps Spark Unplanned Pregnancies
records.description: Unregulated smartphone fertility apps use simplistic AI algorithms based solely on past period dates to predict users’ fertile windows and market themselves as contraception. Experts warn their accuracy is unreliable. Studies link their rise to increased reliance on natural methods and a spike in unintended pregnancies and abortions in the UK.

records.title: Starship Entertainment Apologizes for Sharing Deepfake Content of IVE's An Yujin
records.description: Starship Entertainment faced backlash after reposting AI-generated deepfake images of IVE's An Yujin with defamatory captions on Weibo. The agency apologized, explaining it was a mistake during content reporting, and deleted the post. They reassigned the responsible staff and promised improved account management to prevent future incidents.

records.title: AI Deepfake Scam Impersonating Brad Pitt Defrauds French Woman
records.description: A French woman named Anne was scammed out of €830,000 by a fraudster using AI-generated images to impersonate Brad Pitt. The scammer convinced her to divorce her husband and send money for fake cancer treatment. The incident highlights the misuse of AI in creating deepfake images for financial fraud.

records.title: Deepfake Video Falsely Attributes Statements to Taylor Swift
records.description: A deepfake video falsely attributes comments to Taylor Swift, claiming LA wildfires are retribution for US support of Israel's actions in Gaza. The video, analyzed by BOOM, uses AI to manipulate Swift's appearance on a 2021 talk show, spreading misinformation amid ongoing wildfires causing significant damage in California.

records.title: AI Face-Swap Deepfakes Drive Fraudulent Marketing and Landmark Ruling
records.description: AI face-swapping and voice-synthesis deepfakes are being used to impersonate public figures—doctors, professors, and influencers—to promote products without consent. Targets have lodged complaints, platforms closed over 200 accounts, and a Guangzhou court ruled that paid deepfake templates illegally infringed a blogger’s portrait rights, highlighting urgent need for regulation.

records.title: OpenAI Bot Overwhelms E-commerce Site, Mimicking DDoS Attack
records.description: OpenAI's data collection bot, used for training ChatGPT, overwhelmed the e-commerce site Triplegangers, causing it to become inaccessible. The bot's activity, using over 600 IPs, was likened to a DDoS attack, leading to service disruption and increased costs for the site. CEO Oleksandr Tomchuk highlighted the incident's impact.

records.title: Influencer Virginia Fonseca Targeted by AI Deepfake Video
records.description: Influencer Virginia Fonseca was targeted by a deepfake video using AI to superimpose her face onto another woman's body in a compromising situation. Her husband, singer Zé Felipe, publicly condemned the act on social media. The incident raises concerns about privacy and the misuse of AI technology.

records.title: AI Facial Recognition Error Leads to Wrongful Arrests in the US
records.description: At least eight Americans were wrongfully arrested due to misidentification by AI facial recognition software, as reported by the Washington Post. The police relied solely on AI without verifying alibis or other evidence, leading to potential human rights violations. The full extent of such incidents remains unknown due to limited disclosure requirements.

records.title: AI-powered traffic cameras catch 849 drivers in Humber trials
records.description: Safer Roads Humber trialled AI-powered speed cameras provided by National Highways across the Humber region to detect seatbelt and mobile-phone offences. Over two trial weeks in 2023–24, the system flagged 849 violations, confirmed by human operators. Following this success, ten police forces will deploy the cameras sporadically to boost road safety.

records.title: AI deepfake scam impersonates Greek celebrities in weight-loss promotion
records.description: TV host Stamatina Tsimitsili revealed that AI-generated deepfake videos and audio featuring her and singer Anna Vissi promoting weight-loss products are circulating online. The misuse of AI for celebrity impersonation enables fraudulent endorsements, causing reputational harm and deceiving consumers.

records.title: Meta's AI Content Moderation Failures Allow Pornographic Ads and Nudify Apps
records.description: In 2024, Meta allowed over 3,300 pornographic ads, many AI-generated, on Facebook and Instagram, despite content moderation rules. AI Forensics reported inconsistencies, as similar explicit posts were removed. Additionally, "nudify" apps like Crush AI, which create nonconsensual AI-generated nudes, thrive on Meta's platforms, raising privacy and consent concerns.

records.title: Korean Broadcasters Sue Naver for AI Copyright Infringement
records.description: KBS, MBC, and SBS, three major Korean broadcasters, have filed a lawsuit against Naver for copyright infringement. They allege Naver used their news articles without permission to train its AI models, 'HyperCLOVA' and 'HyperCLOVA X'. The broadcasters demand compensation and measures to prevent future violations, marking the first such legal action against a tech giant.

records.title: AI-generated literary critiques infiltrate Litera contest
records.description: Multiple AI-generated critiques of Kemény Zsófi’s novel Nyelni, produced by ChatGPT under pseudonyms, were submitted to the Litera literary portal’s criticism contest and even shared by the author before editors and readers flagged fabricated quotes and shallow analysis, leading to their disqualification.

records.title: Police Warn Against AI-Driven Voice Hacking Scams
records.description: The Spanish National Police have issued a warning about 'voice hacking', a scam using AI to clone voices for fraudulent purposes. Criminals use AI to create fake audio messages mimicking victims' voices to deceive their contacts into sending money. The police recommend using a secret code with close contacts to verify calls.

records.title: Deepfake ads impersonate Bulgarian epidemiologist to sell bogus joint cream
records.description: AI-generated deepfake videos impersonating Bulgarian epidemiologist Assoc. Prof. Dr. Angel Kunchev are circulating on social media, endorsing a ‘miracle’ joint pain cream that allegedly cures pain in three days. Consumer watchdog ‘We, the Consumers’ has reported and urged removal, warning of misinformation and potential health risks.

records.title: Thai Prime Minister Warns of AI-Driven Scam Attempt
records.description: Thai Prime Minister Paetongtarn Shinawatra revealed she was targeted by a scam using AI to mimic a foreign leader's voice, nearly convincing her to donate money. The incident highlights the advanced nature of AI scams. The Thai government is taking steps to combat such fraud, emphasizing public vigilance.

records.title: Elon Musk's AI Grok detects fracture doctors missed
records.description: AJ Kay turned to Elon Musk’s AI chatbot Grok after urgent care doctors overlooked her daughter’s wrist injury. Grok correctly identified a distal radius fracture on X-rays, a finding later confirmed by a specialist, likely preventing surgery. The viral claim has ignited debate over AI’s role in medical diagnostics.

records.title: Scammers Use AI Deepfakes to Target Dating Site Users
records.description: VisionLabs expert Tatiana Deshkina warns scammers are using generative AI to create deepfake dating profiles, simulating text and voice of real people to emotionally manipulate and extort users. Over 30 million Russians may be targeted in 2025, suffering financial loss and blackmail threats, yet often don’t report due to shame.

records.title: 10-Year-Old ‘Dating’ AI Chatbot Sparks Child Protection Alarm
records.description: A 10-year-old girl secretly used a generative AI chat app as a virtual “boyfriend,” engaging in erotic and violent role-play late at night. Experts warn the AI’s addictive design, lack of age verification, and “Eliza effect” pose psychological risks. Families and academics call for stricter child safeguards and regulation.

records.title: AI Vocal Cloning Sparks Concerns Among Voice Actors
records.description: Eleven Labs has created an AI-generated vocal clone of deceased voice actor Alain Dorval, known for dubbing Sylvester Stallone. This has sparked concerns about intellectual property and labor rights among voice actors, with Brigitte Lecordier advocating for human dubbing. The AI-generated voice was shared online, prompting widespread reactions.

records.title: FIA Arrests Individuals for AI-Generated Defamatory Content Against Maryam Nawaz
records.description: The Federal Investigation Agency (FIA) arrested multiple individuals, including Bilal Hussain, for creating and spreading AI-generated deepfake images and videos defaming Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz. The FIA identified 20 social media accounts involved and seized the suspect's devices. The arrests were made under the Prevention of Electronic Crimes Act, 2016.

records.title: TSMC cuts ties with Singapore client after AI chip found in Huawei device
records.description: TSMC has severed ties with Singapore-based PowerAIR after discovering one of its chips in Huawei's Ascend 910 AI processor, suspected to breach U.S. export controls. It’s the second such case—following Sophgo—prompting TSMC to launch customer reviews to enforce sanctions compliance.

records.title: AI-generated fake reviews flood online marketplaces
records.description: Generative AI platforms like ChatGPT and Rytr enable fraudsters to pump out fake reviews across Amazon, Yelp, etc., deceiving consumers and businesses. The illegal practice undermines market trust and triggers FTC probes and lawsuits as watchdogs warn that AI-driven review scams are escalating, distorting online ratings at unprecedented scale.

records.title: AI-generated images fuel earthquake misinformation
records.description: In early January, following quakes in Tibet’s Dingri (6.8) and Qinghai’s Maduo (5.5), self-media accounts used old photos and AI-generated images—e.g. a ‘buried boy’—to fabricate disaster scenes and solicit donations. The misinformation misled the public and complicated relief efforts; police have detained involved individuals.

records.title: Mossos forensic report confirms Pegasus spyware infected Puigdemont aide’s phone
records.description: A Mossos d’Esquadra forensic analysis found that Josep Lluís Alay, Carles Puigdemont’s chief of staff, was surveilled with Pegasus spyware from October 2019 to June 2020. The seized phone yielded over 3 GB of extracted data, exposing unauthorized AI-driven espionage and a serious privacy breach.

records.title: Microsoft Sues Group for Abusing AI Service
records.description: Microsoft has filed a lawsuit against a group accused of using stolen credentials and custom software to bypass safety measures in its Azure OpenAI Service. The defendants allegedly violated multiple laws to create harmful content using Microsoft's AI technologies. The company seeks legal action to prevent further misuse.

records.title: Meta Ends Fact-Checking as AI-Generated Disaster Images Fuel Misinformation
records.description: Meta announced ending its third-party fact-checking mechanism, shifting to community-driven moderation, raising concerns of increased misinformation and hate speech. Meanwhile, AI-generated fake disaster images, including misattributed earthquake photos, have misled rescue efforts and disrupted social order; one perpetrator was detained, prompting calls for stricter AI content governance.

records.title: AI Deepfake Impersonation Leads to Lawsuit Against Baltimore County Schools
records.description: Eric Eiswert, former principal of Pikesville High School, is suing Baltimore County Public Schools and former athletic director Dazhon Darien for creating and distributing an AI-generated deepfake audio that impersonated him with racist and antisemitic remarks. The incident led to reputational harm and threats against Eiswert, highlighting misuse of AI technology.

records.title: South African Law Firm Faces Investigation for AI-Generated Legal Citations
records.description: Pietermaritzburg-based law firm Surendra Singh and Associates is under investigation by the Legal Practice Council for allegedly using AI to draft court papers with non-existent legal citations. Judge Elsja-Marie Bezuidenhout criticized the firm's actions as unprofessional, ordering them to cover court costs and referring the case for further review.

records.title: AI-Driven Bot Campaign Targets Croatian Presidential Election
records.description: An independent CIR report found pro-Russian AI-generated bot networks using fake profile images and unusual posting patterns across X, Facebook, TikTok, Reddit and news sites to amplify anti-EU/NATO, pro-Kremlin narratives around candidates Zoran Milanović and Dragan Primorac in Croatia’s presidential run-off, undermining democratic discourse and election integrity.

records.title: AI Test Agent Spark Uncovers Vulnerability in WolfSSL
records.description: Code Intelligence launched Spark, an autonomous AI testing agent that discovered a heap-based use-after-free vulnerability in the popular WolfSSL open-source library during beta testing, automatically generating and executing tests. Spark’s ability to autonomously identify and remediate security flaws highlights its potential to prevent harmful software breaches.

records.title: Delhi High Court Orders Removal of Deepfake Videos of Dr. Naresh Trehan
records.description: The Delhi High Court ordered the removal of deepfake videos of Dr. Naresh Trehan from social media, which falsely portrayed him giving medical advice for commercial gain. The court mandated social media platforms to delete the videos within 36 hours if not removed by the uploaders, citing potential public deception.

records.title: Sydney School Deepfake Pornography Scandal
records.description: A Sydney high school student used AI to create deepfake pornographic images of female classmates, using photos from social media and school events. The incident has led to police involvement and disciplinary action. The NSW Department of Education and police are investigating, emphasizing student safety and providing support to affected individuals.

records.title: Brazilian Government Demands Removal of AI-Generated Fake Video of Finance Minister
records.description: The Brazilian Attorney General's Office (AGU) has demanded Facebook remove an AI-manipulated video falsely depicting Finance Minister Fernando Haddad announcing non-existent taxes. The video, which violates Facebook's policies against misinformation, must be removed within 24 hours or labeled as AI-generated. The AGU highlights the video's misleading nature, citing noticeable AI-induced alterations.

records.title: Chilean Supreme Court Orders Worldcoin to Delete Minor's Iris Scan Data
records.description: The Chilean Supreme Court ruled against Worldcoin for scanning a 17-year-old's iris without parental consent, violating her privacy and constitutional rights. The court ordered the deletion of her biometric data within 30 days. This decision highlights the legal challenges of using AI for biometric data collection without proper consent.

records.title: ZUS Algorithm Wrongly Denies 23,000 Contribution Relief Requests
records.description: Poland’s Social Insurance Institution (ZUS) has sent 23,000 decisions wrongly rejecting or partially denying contribution relief applications due to errors in its algorithmic processing system. Many entitled to voluntary sickness insurance exemptions were refused. ZUS says automatic reviews will correct these errors and inform payers of revised relief decisions.

records.title: Danish Man Sentenced for AI-Generated Child Abuse Images
records.description: A 29-year-old man in Randers, Denmark, was sentenced to one year and three months in prison for creating and distributing over 36,000 AI-generated images of child abuse. This marks the first conviction in Denmark for such offenses, highlighting the realistic nature of the images and the legal implications of AI misuse.

records.title: Meta's AI moderation failures censor journalism and allow explicit ads
records.description: Meta's AI-driven moderation and ad-targeting systems misfired, censoring 404 Media stories on explicit porn ads while approving over 3,000 graphic ads and serving drug-related adverts to a recovering addict. These automated failures suppressed reporting, exposed users to harmful content, and caused emotional distress, revealing critical flaws in Facebook's AI oversight.

records.title: Tesla FSD Malfunctions in CES Demo: Wrong-Way Turn and Guardrail Collision
records.description: During CES in Las Vegas, blogger Chen Zhen used Tesla’s FSD v13.2.2 in “hurry” mode. The AI autopilot steered into oncoming traffic, misaligned during parking and struck a guardrail. Chen rated its performance below domestic systems like Xpeng and Huawei.

records.title: São Paulo’s Smart Sampa facial recognition AI aids fugitive arrests
records.description: São Paulo’s Smart Sampa facial recognition network has installed 90% of its cameras since launch, using AI to scan public footage and identify wanted individuals. In six months, it led to over 398 captures, including double-murderer Raphael Druciak and rapist Fernando Bispo da Silva, aiding law enforcement.

records.title: Waymo Autonomous Taxi Malfunctions, Traps Passenger in Arizona
records.description: In Scottsdale, Arizona, a Waymo autonomous taxi malfunctioned, trapping passenger Mike Johns as it circled a parking lot instead of heading to the airport. Despite contacting the control center, remote assistance failed. The incident, captured in a viral video, highlights potential safety concerns with AI-driven vehicles.

records.title: Security Flaw in Motorola ALPR Systems Exposes Vehicle Data
records.description: A security flaw in Motorola's Automated License Plate Recognition (ALPR) systems has exposed real-time video feeds and detailed vehicle data from over 150 cameras across the US. Discovered by researcher Matt Brown, the misconfiguration allows unauthorized access to sensitive information, raising significant privacy concerns.

records.title: AI-Driven Taxi Malfunctions, Traps Passenger in Los Angeles
records.description: Mike Jones, a businessman, experienced distress when a Waymo AI-driven taxi malfunctioned, trapping him as it moved uncontrollably in circles in Los Angeles. The incident, which disrupted his travel plans, raised concerns about potential hacking and the reliability of AI systems in autonomous vehicles.

records.title: Apple Intelligence AI Spreads False News Alerts
records.description: The Apple Intelligence AI feature on iPhones produced false news alerts citing BBC and other outlets, wrongly declaring Luke Littler darts champion, Rafael Nadal gay, Luigi Mangione suicide and Netanyahu’s arrest. These hallucinations sparked complaints from BBC and Reporters Without Borders. Apple acknowledged the beta errors and plans updates to fix the fault.

records.title: Ex-MoviePass CEO Pleads Guilty in First AI Washing Fraud Case
records.description: Former Helios & Matheson CEO Ted Farnsworth pleaded guilty to securities fraud for falsely claiming MoviePass employed AI technology to drive profitability. The DOJ labeled it an early "AI washing" prosecution. Farnsworth and co-conspirators inflated Helios stock by misleading investors about AI capabilities, facing up to 25 years in prison.

records.title: Tesla's Smart Summon Feature Under U.S. Safety Investigation
records.description: The U.S. National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) is investigating Tesla's Smart Summon feature, used in 2.6 million vehicles, after reports of crashes. The AI-based system, which allows remote vehicle summoning, allegedly failed to detect obstacles, leading to collisions and raising safety concerns.

records.title: Johnny Depp Warns Fans of AI Deepfake Scams
records.description: Johnny Depp has alerted his fans about online scammers using AI to mimic his face and voice, creating fake social media and email accounts to impersonate him or his team. This misuse of AI technology poses risks of deception and potential fraud.

records.title: AI Error Leads to Unwarranted Home Entry by Energy Firm
records.description: Alan Knight, 67, from Waterlooville, experienced an unwarranted home entry by E.ON engineers due to an AI system error. The AI incorrectly flagged his smart meter as tampered, leading to a warrant execution. E.ON admitted the AI technology requires improvement to prevent such privacy violations in the future.

records.title: Meta Faces Privacy and Copyright Concerns Over AI Practices
records.description: Meta is under scrutiny for privacy and copyright issues involving its AI technologies. Instagram's AI-generated images from user data without explicit consent raise privacy concerns. Additionally, Meta is accused of using pirated books to train its Llama AI models, allegedly approved by CEO Mark Zuckerberg, raising copyright infringement concerns.

records.title: Journalists and Celebrities Victimized by Deepfake Pornography
records.description: Channel 4 News presenter Cathy Newman and Love Island star Cally Jane Beech have been victims of AI-generated deepfake pornography, highlighting a growing issue where AI technology is misused to create explicit content without consent. The UK government is considering legal action against creators of such content, with potential penalties of up to two years in prison.

records.title: AI-Driven Phishing Campaigns Escalate Cybercrime in 2025
records.description: Cybercriminals leverage AI to craft hyper-personalized phishing emails that mimic trusted contacts and vendors, targeting small businesses and millions of users on platforms like Gmail. These campaigns have led to credential theft, fraudulent invoice payments, and compromised accounts, outpacing traditional defenses and raising urgent cybersecurity concerns.

records.title: Apple and Google Fined R$19M Over FaceApp Privacy Breach
records.description: A Brazilian court orders Apple and Google to pay R$19 million after FaceApp, an AI-powered photo-editing app, collected sensitive user data without clear consent and violated data protection and consumer laws. Judge Douglas de Melo Martins banned the app on their platforms until full compliance with Brazilian privacy regulations.

records.title: Meta ends AI-driven fact-checking, stoking misinformation fears in Brazil
records.description: Brazilian officials—including AGU head Jorge Messias, Finance Minister Fernando Haddad and digital policy secretary João Brant—and researcher Gilberto Scofield Jr. condemned Meta’s decision to end its AI-driven fact-checking and moderation on Facebook and Instagram, warning it aligns with Trump-style politics, will fuel misinformation, hate speech and threaten democracy.

records.title: Meta Loosens AI Content Moderation to Allow Anti-LGBTQ+ Hate Speech
records.description: Meta revised its AI-driven moderation to remove restrictions on alleging mental illness or abnormality based on gender or sexual orientation, aligning with “mainstream discourse” per Zuckerberg. Critics warn this rollback could amplify stigma and hate speech against LGBTQ+ and other protected groups, increasing exposure to harmful content and potential real-world violence.

records.title: Report warns of AI-driven job cuts as Apple’s AI news summaries mislead
records.description: A Bloomberg report predicts AI-driven automation could eliminate up to 200,000 back-office jobs at global banks within five years. Meanwhile, Apple’s new iPhone AI news-summary feature has repeatedly misrepresented BBC and other outlets, prompting Apple to promise clearer AI labeling and software updates amid calls to disable the flawed tool.

records.title: Instagram's AI Filter Wrongly Blocks LGBTQ+ Content for Teens
records.description: Instagram's AI content filter mistakenly restricted LGBTQ+ content for months, labeling it as "sexually suggestive" and blocking it from teen users' feeds. This affected hashtags like #lesbian and #gay, while heterosexual content was unaffected. Meta reversed the restrictions after being contacted by User Mag.

records.title: AI-generated Earthquake Misinformation Sparks Panic in Xinjiang and Tibet
records.description: Netizens used AI to splice old images into fake earthquake videos—like a 3.2-magnitude quake in Xinjiang’s Makit County and a child trapped under rubble in Tibet—sparking panic and misleading the public. Authorities debunked the AI-generated visuals and urged reliance on official alerts while platforms enhance algorithmic transparency to curb rumors.

records.title: Backlash Over Apple AI News Alerts After False Summaries
records.description: Apple’s AI-powered news alert feature misattributed false headlines—reporting Netanyahu’s arrest, Rafael Nadal coming out as gay and Luigi Mangione’s self-harm—to outlets like the New York Times and BBC. Reporters Without Borders, the National Union of Journalists and the BBC demand its removal; Apple says it will update labeling and accuracy.

records.title: Elon Musk’s X platform AI fuels disinformation and polarization
records.description: In 2024, Elon Musk’s revamped social platform X deployed new AI-powered recommendation and moderation systems that inadvertently amplified misleading political content, hate speech, and polarizing posts. These algorithmic changes intensified social division, spread disinformation, and risked incitement of violence, illustrating harm caused by AI-driven content amplification.

records.title: AI-Powered Lottery Prediction Scam Leads to User Losses
records.description: Influencers on Chinese platforms, using ChatGPT and proprietary AI apps, claim they can predict lottery numbers. Followers buying into these “hot,” “cold” and “lucky” picks have sustained cumulative losses, while vendors highlight trivial wins to attract downloads. Experts and regulators warn draws are random and AI offers no genuine predictive edge.

records.title: Anitta Criticizes AI for Imitating Her Voice and Personality
records.description: Brazilian singer Anitta criticized an AI application for imitating her voice and personality, claiming it violates her intellectual property rights. She expressed concerns over the lack of financial compensation and regulation in this area, highlighting the potential misuse of AI technology to replicate public figures without consent.

records.title: Meta's AI Profiles Cause User Distress
records.description: Meta secretly tested AI-generated profiles on Instagram and Facebook, which interacted with users as real people, causing distress and criticism. The profiles, part of Meta's AI Studio project, included one named "Liv," which falsely represented diverse identities. After user backlash, Meta removed the profiles, citing technical issues.

records.title: Waymo Self-Driving Taxi Malfunctions, Passenger Misses Flight
records.description: Mike Johns missed his flight after a Waymo self-driving taxi malfunctioned, driving in circles at Los Angeles airport. Despite contacting Waymo's customer service, the vehicle couldn't be remotely stopped, highlighting a significant AI system failure. Johns, an AI expert, documented the incident, raising concerns about autonomous vehicle reliability.

records.title: Hong Kong deepfake ring scams over HK$34 million in romance investment fraud
records.description: Hong Kong authorities arrested 31 members of a crime syndicate that used AI-powered deepfakes to create fake personas on dating apps, deceiving victims in Taiwan, Singapore and Malaysia into investing in bogus crypto platforms. The operation seized HK$100 million in assets and recovered over HK$34 million in stolen funds.

records.title: Self-Driving Tesla Veers onto Train Tracks, Endangering Driver
records.description: Jesse Lyu, CEO of Rabbit Inc., experienced a malfunction with his Tesla's Autopilot, causing the vehicle to veer onto light rail tracks in Santa Monica. To avoid an oncoming train, Lyu had to disengage Autopilot and run a red light. The incident highlights potential safety risks associated with Tesla's self-driving technology.

records.title: Vanderbilt AI predicts patient suicide risk
records.description: Researchers at Vanderbilt University Medical Center, led by Colin Walsh, developed the VSAIL AI model to analyze electronic health records and flag suicidal ideation during routine neurology visits. In trials across three clinics, active pop-up alerts significantly outperformed passive chart displays in identifying at-risk patients, enabling timely interventions.

records.title: TikTok's AI-Powered Live Streams Accused of Enabling Child Exploitation
records.description: Utah’s consumer protection division sued TikTok, alleging its AI-driven live streaming recommendations knowingly facilitated child sexual exploitation. Internal documents reveal ByteDance ignored emerging harms for profit. Facing a January 19 US ban unless sold, TikTok also contends with national security concerns over data sharing with China.

records.title: Anthropic’s Claude AI to block copyrighted lyrics after lawsuit
records.description: In late 2023, Universal Music Group, Concord Music Group and other publishers sued Anthropic’s chatbot Claude for copying copyrighted song lyrics in training data and outputting them to users. Anthropic agreed to install guardrails to block generation of protected lyrics and to investigate potential breaches, though training-data rights remain disputed.

records.title: AI-Driven Rent Price Fixing Sparks DOJ Lawsuit Against Major Landlords
records.description: The U.S. Justice Department, alongside several states, is suing RealPage and six major landlords for allegedly using AI algorithms to coordinate rent prices, leading to increased housing costs. The AI tool, embedded in RealPage's software, is accused of facilitating price-fixing, impacting millions of renters and contributing to the housing affordability crisis.

records.title: Apple Intelligence misinforms with erroneous BBC news summaries
records.description: Apple’s AI-generated notification summaries have repeatedly produced false information for BBC News and BBC Sport alerts, wrongly reporting suicides, sports results and personal details. The BBC and Reporters Without Borders have criticized these errors, warning that such AI-driven misinformation undermines trust in reliable journalism.

records.title: AI-Driven Deepfake Calls and Caller ID Spoofing Drain Businessman's Funds
records.description: An organized crime ring used AI-driven caller ID spoofing and deepfake voices to impersonate bank staff and convince a Volos businessman to reset credentials, resulting in total loss of his funds. Banks warn of rising AI-enabled call scams for stealing client data and bank access.

records.title: Apple to Update AI News Summary Feature After Misinformation Complaints
records.description: Apple’s AI-powered notification summary feature, Apple Intelligence, repeatedly generated false news alerts—misstating a murder suspect’s suicide, announcing Luke Littler’s darts victory prematurely, and falsely claiming Rafael Nadal’s coming out. The BBC and other media lodged formal complaints over the errors, leading Apple to announce software updates clarifying AI-generated content over the coming weeks.

records.title: Deepfake Pornography Targets Female Politicians Globally
records.description: Female politicians across the globe, including in the US, Italy, Britain, and Pakistan, are increasingly targeted by AI-generated deepfake pornography. This misuse of AI technology threatens their careers, public trust, and national security, as it can lead to blackmail and harassment. Efforts to regulate such non-consensual content are lagging behind the rapid proliferation of AI tools.

records.title: AI-Assisted Cybertruck Explosion at Trump Hotel
records.description: Matthew Livelsberger, a decorated soldier, used generative AI, including ChatGPT, to plan an attack that resulted in the explosion of a Tesla Cybertruck outside a Trump hotel in Las Vegas. The incident, which involved searches on explosive targets and legalities, caused property damage and highlighted AI's potential misuse in criminal activities.

records.title: AI in Health Insurance Sparks Controversy and Legislative Action
records.description: AI systems are increasingly used by health insurers to deny claims, raising concerns over biases and lack of human oversight. This has led to public frustration and a new California law prohibiting AI as the sole basis for claim denials, ensuring human involvement in decision-making to protect patients' rights.

records.title: FTC Fines accessiBe $1M for Misleading AI Accessibility Claims
records.description: The FTC fined accessiBe $1 million and ordered it to cease deceptive marketing after finding its AI-powered accessWidget failed to deliver promised WCAG and ADA compliance. The commission also highlighted undisclosed paid endorsements, mandating clear disclosures and potential customer refunds for overstated website accessibility claims.

records.title: Tesla AI data aids Vegas bomb investigation, raises privacy concerns
records.description: Authorities used Tesla’s AI-enabled data—GPS routes, supercharger logs and onboard cameras—to trace a bomb-laden Cybertruck from Colorado to Las Vegas, identifying suspect Matthew Liveslberger before his fatal detonation. The case highlights growing privacy concerns as vehicles increasingly record location, contacts and call logs.

records.title: AI Granny 'Daisy' Foils Scammers by Wasting Their Time
records.description: O2’s AI “Daisy” impersonates an elderly woman to engage phone scammers, fabricating stories and bogus bank details to prolong calls and waste fraudsters’ time. Linked to numbers on scam-target lists, Daisy intercepts calls without human input, reducing victims and exposing common scam tactics through up to 40-minute automated conversations.

records.title: UK Soldier Jailed for Deepfake Harassment
records.description: A UK Royal Air Force veteran, Jonathan Bates, was sentenced to five years in prison for creating and distributing deepfake images of his ex-wife and other women. The manipulated images, used on pornographic websites, severely impacted the victims' personal and professional lives, causing fear and humiliation.

records.title: UK Deploys AI Cameras to Detect Drunk Drivers
records.description: Acusensus-developed cameras scan passing vehicles for impairment signs like swerving or erratic braking. Deployed in trials in Devon, Cornwall, Staffordshire and Greater Manchester under Vision Zero South West, they instantly alert police to suspected drink or drug driving. Authorities plan a national rollout by 2025 to curb dangerous driving.

records.title: AI-Driven Phishing Scams Target Corporate Executives
records.description: AI systems are being used to generate hyper-personalized phishing scams targeting corporate executives, leading to privacy violations and potential legal breaches. Companies like eBay and Beazley report an increase in such attacks, where AI scrapes personal data to craft convincing emails, bypassing basic security filters.

records.title: AI Deepfake and Biometric Authentication Exploited in Scams
records.description: Recent incidents in Vietnam highlight the use of AI technologies in scams. Deepfake technology was used to create fake video calls to deceive individuals into transferring money. Additionally, cybercriminals exploited biometric authentication systems to commit fraud, leading to significant financial losses. Authorities urge caution and verification before transactions.

records.title: AI-Generated Insulting Caption Targets Pregnant User on Baidu Netdisk
records.description: A Baidu Netdisk AI feature auto-generated an insulting caption “脑子不够，肚子来凑” under a user’s pregnancy photo in the “On This Day” feed, prompting her to cancel membership and request a refund, which was granted. Baidu pledged to strengthen content filtering, model retraining and technical audits after public outcry.

records.title: Fable App Faces Backlash Over Offensive AI-Generated Summaries
records.description: Fable, a book tracking app, is removing its AI features after generating offensive summaries related to race, gender, sexuality, and disability. Users, including Tiana Trammell, received inappropriate messages, prompting Fable's head of product, Chris Gallello, to address the issue and commit to resolving it.

records.title: Meta removes AI-generated fake accounts amid misinformation fears
records.description: Meta deleted numerous AI-created virtual accounts on Facebook, WhatsApp, Threads, and Instagram after they misled users with false statements. The company plans to roll out hundreds of thousands of similar AI personas, raising concerns about misinformation, manipulation of user intentions, and broader societal risks from AI-driven content.

records.title: US sanctions Russian, Iranian groups for AI-driven election disinformation
records.description: The US Treasury targeted Iran’s IRGC-linked Cognitive Design Production Center and Russia’s GRU-backed Center for Geopolitical Expertise for using AI-generated deepfakes and fake news sites to influence US voters, stoke social divisions, and undermine trust in the 2024 election process.

records.title: Google Nest and Home speakers fail to answer basic queries due to Assistant glitch
records.description: Since late December, Google Nest and Home devices running Google Assistant have failed to respond to simple voice queries like ‘What’s the weather?’ or ‘What time is it?’, displaying loading animations without answers. The glitch affected multiple models and regions. Google confirmed a fix for most users and is investigating the cause.

records.title: Airbnb Deploys AI Cop to Block High-Risk New Year’s Eve Party Bookings
records.description: Airbnb uses a machine-learning system to flag and block or reroute high-risk New Year’s Eve reservations—analyzing trip duration, listing type, guest distance, and booking timing. Since its 2020 rollout, it has blocked roughly 74,000 risky bookings and significantly reduced party-related complaints worldwide.

records.title: IDF's AI Targeting System in Gaza Raises Civilian Casualty Concerns
records.description: The Israeli Defense Forces (IDF) have been using AI systems, developed over a decade, to generate military targets in Gaza, reportedly increasing civilian casualties. AI tools like "Gospel" and "Lavender" rapidly process intelligence, enabling swift target generation. Concerns arise over the prioritization of speed over intelligence assessment, potentially leading to harm.

records.title: Global Surge in AI-Generated Explicit Deepfakes Raises Privacy Concerns
records.description: A survey by The Yomiuri Shimbun highlights a global rise in the use of AI to create sexually explicit deepfake images, with the US, India, and Japan leading in site visits. This trend raises significant privacy and human rights concerns, prompting calls for stricter regulations to mitigate harm.

records.title: Surabaya buses stranded in Wonogiri forest after following Google Maps
records.description: Two tourist buses carrying 80 travelers from Surabaya to Pantai Klayar became trapped in Wonogiri’s Tunggangan forest after following Google Maps onto narrow, rugged roads. Drivers reversed about 1 km with local assistance, and authorities aided in ensuring all passengers were safely evacuated without injuries.

records.title: Bus Carrying Hikers Misled by Google Maps into Cemetery
records.description: A bus of 30 hikers heading to Mount Sumbing in Central Java got stuck in a cemetery and narrow agricultural path after the driver followed faulty Google Maps directions. The AI navigation error caused disruption and potential safety hazards, though no injuries were reported. Police confirmed the Dec. 28 incident.

records.title: Ana Castela Condemns AI-Generated Fake Nudes
records.description: Brazilian singer Ana Castela denounced the circulation of AI-generated fake nude images and videos of her on social media, calling it a violation of her privacy. She urged people not to share the false content, expressing frustration over the misuse of AI technology to create explicit material without her consent.

records.title: Meta’s AI Algorithms Suppress Palestinian Journalists’ Gaza Coverage
records.description: BBC analysis finds that since October 2023 Meta’s AI-driven algorithms on Facebook and Instagram have significantly reduced the reach and interaction of Palestinian media in Gaza and the West Bank, while intensifying moderation of Palestinian user comments. Meta denies deliberate censorship, but data shows a marked suppression of Palestinian voices during the Israel-Hamas conflict.

records.title: Global ChatGPT Outage Disrupts Service Worldwide
records.description: On December 26, users across the US, Europe and beyond reported ChatGPT becoming inaccessible, with Downdetector flagging widespread failures. OpenAI confirmed elevated error rates affecting ChatGPT, its API and Sora, attributed the issue to a third-party provider, and launched an investigation to restore normal service.

records.title: ChatGPT Search Vulnerable to Manipulation via Hidden Text
records.description: Research reveals that ChatGPT Search can be manipulated through hidden text on websites, leading to biased or misleading outputs. This vulnerability, known as 'prompt injection,' allows for the generation of false positive reviews and malicious code. OpenAI is aware and working on security improvements, but the issue raises concerns about misinformation risks.

records.title: Ukrainian Forces Use AI-Driven Robots in Military Operation Against Russia
records.description: The Ukrainian National Guard's 13th Brigade conducted a fully robotic military operation against Russian forces in Kharkiv, using AI-driven unmanned ground vehicles and drones. This technological feat highlights Ukraine's manpower shortages and the limitations of robotic systems in replacing human infantry, despite achieving a tactical victory.

records.title: Demand for AI anti-fraud document detection doubles amid AI-driven forgeries
records.description: In Russia, criminals increasingly leverage AI-based tools to produce sophisticated forged documents, driving a 100% surge in requests for domestic AI-driven anti-fraud document recognition systems. Smart Engines CEO Vladimir Arlazarov reported a 12% rise in non-ID forgeries, signaling continued growth in both AI-facilitated fraud and detection efforts.

records.title: AI Deepfake Scam Impersonates Medical Expert on TikTok
records.description: The Bukit Aman Commercial Crime Investigation Department warns of a TikTok scam where AI technology is used to impersonate medical expert Dr. Noordin Darus without consent. The account "Malaysia Shopping Mall" uses his voice and video to promote health products, misleading consumers and violating intellectual property rights.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Video Leads to Financial Fraud
records.description: Birg├╝l G├╝den, a resident of Edremit, Turkey, was defrauded of 650,000 lira after clicking on an AI-generated deepfake investment video. The video used AI to mimic celebrity voices and images, leading to unauthorized access to her bank accounts and loans. This incident highlights the misuse of AI for financial fraud.

records.title: AI-Driven Cyber Threats Target Gmail Users
records.description: Gmail, with 2.5 billion users, faces potential AI-driven cyber attacks, including extortion and phishing. Google and McAfee warn users to be vigilant as hackers exploit sensitive data in email inboxes. This warning highlights the growing threat of AI in cybercrime, urging users to enhance their security measures.

records.title: AI-generated false death alert panics Steve Harvey fans
records.description: An AI-generated article posted by a content website and syndicated via the NewsBreak app falsely claimed TV host Steve Harvey had died, triggering panic and emotional distress among fans. Social media users shared alerts before realising the 67-year-old Family Feud host was alive, prompting outrage over AI-driven misinformation.

records.title: Taiwan lawmaker sues over deepfake TikTok video
records.description: Legislator Ko Chien-ming traced a deepfake TikTok clip falsely showing him denouncing Taiwan’s DPP, reported it to police and filed defamation and privacy suits. Lawmakers warn against sharing the AI-generated video and propose amending anti-infiltration laws to mandate TikTok’s local oversight or risk being banned.

records.title: AI Deepfake Scam Clones Surgeon’s Voice to Endorse Fake Cream
records.description: Internet fraudsters used AI to clone Prof. Dr. Ömer Özkan’s voice in a deepfake video promoting a bogus cream, which racked up hundreds of thousands of views on social media. The renowned Akdeniz University transplant surgeon filed a criminal complaint after the video remained online despite removal requests.

records.title: Harassment of Passengers in Waymo’s Driverless Taxis in San Francisco
records.description: A San Francisco passenger and her sister were followed and harassed—cars honking and shouting sexual comments—while riding a Waymo Jaguar robotaxi. The autonomous system couldn’t reroute, leaving them feeling unsafe. Waymo says such incidents are extremely rare and offers live support agents and law-enforcement coordination.

records.title: AI-Driven Fraud Attempts Surge 200% During Discount Seasons
records.description: Fraudsters have increasingly used AI to exploit discount seasons, leading to a 200% rise in fraudulent activities globally, particularly during events like Cyber Monday. Visa reported blocking 85% more suspicious fraud attempts compared to the previous year and has invested $11 billion in advanced technology to combat this trend.

records.title: Delhi High Court Orders Removal of Rajat Sharma Deepfakes
records.description: The Delhi High Court has ordered Meta to remove AI-generated deepfake videos of journalist Rajat Sharma, used without consent for false endorsements. Justice Amit Bansal's ruling protects Sharma's personality rights, requiring Meta to disclose creators' details and barring misuse of his likeness by eight defendants.

records.title: Ukraine’s 2 Million-Hour Drone Archive Powers AI-Driven Warfare
records.description: Ukraine has amassed 2 million hours of drone footage via its OCHI system to train AI models for battlefield target identification and tactics, powering next-generation autonomous drones. Both Ukrainian and Russian forces use AI for combat decisions, accelerating target scans and refining strike planning, marking a shift toward AI-driven warfare.

records.title: AI Misuse in Creating Non-Consensual Images of Minors
records.description: Prof. Dr. Murat Okcu from Isparta S├╝leyman Demirel University warns about the misuse of AI to create non-consensual explicit images of minors, leading to potential harm and human rights violations. He emphasizes the need for parents to protect children in the digital realm and calls for serious measures to prevent AI misuse.

records.title: Puerto Rico Sues Meta Over AI-Driven Addictive Content Harming Minors
records.description: Puerto Rico’s Department of Justice sued Instagram and Meta Platforms, alleging their AI-powered recommendation and moderation systems are designed to promote addictive usage and expose minors to harmful content. The complaint claims these algorithms exploit adolescents’ vulnerabilities, causing anxiety, depression and other mental health disorders, and seeks legal remedies to enforce platform accountability.

records.title: Worldcoin's iris-scanning AI halted over GDPR privacy breaches
records.description: World, formerly known as Worldcoin and co-founded by OpenAI’s Sam Altman, had its iris-scanning AI biometric ID service suspended in Spain and Bavaria over unauthorized data collection, including minors'. Regulators CNPD and BayLDA ordered data deletion, unlimited erasure rights, and anonymization, delaying relaunch until 2025.

records.title: AI Scrapers and Chatbots Trigger Economic Strain and Online Violence Glorification
records.description: LLMs such as ChatGPT and Claude aggressively scrape websites, bypassing robots.txt rules and driving up server loads and costs for site owners. Separately, Character AI users created Luigi Mangione chatbots glorifying an alleged murderer, exposing moderation lapses and causing distress among affected communities.

records.title: Bishop T.D. Jakes Sues YouTube Over AI-Generated Misinformation
records.description: Bishop T.D. Jakes’ attorney filed a motion in federal court to subpoena Google for the identities of four YouTube channels, allegedly based in Pakistan, South Africa, the Philippines and Kenya, that used AI-generated thumbnails, images and voice-overs to spread false rumors linking the pastor to Sean “Diddy” Combs, defaming him.

records.title: Elon Musk Shares AI-Generated Racist Images of Elizabeth Warren
records.description: Elon Musk posted AI-generated images depicting Senator Elizabeth Warren in Native American attire, referencing Trump's nickname "Pocahontas." The images, shared on social media, perpetuate racial stereotypes and have been criticized as a violation of human rights. Warren had called for ethics standards for Musk, prompting his response.

records.title: Apple AI Generates Misleading Headline About Luigi Mangione
records.description: Apple's AI system, Apple Intelligence, incorrectly summarized a BBC news notification, falsely claiming Luigi Mangione had killed himself. This misinformation led to complaints from the BBC and press freedom advocates, highlighting concerns about AI's reliability in generating accurate news summaries and the potential harm from spreading false information.

records.title: Grok AI’s Weak Safeguards Enable Harmful Content and Deepfakes
records.description: Elon Musk’s Grok AI, now free on X, features minimal ethical safeguards that have enabled it to produce self-harm guides, illicit content and copyrighted images without moderation. Its image generator—identified by Grok’s watermark—also created a deepfake photo of Bashar al-Assad with Tucker Carlson in Moscow, highlighting risks of misinformation.

records.title: Telegram's Algorithm Promotes Extremist Content, SPLC Study Finds
records.description: A study by the Southern Poverty Law Center (SPLC) reveals that Telegram's recommendation algorithm promotes extremist content. The "similar channels" feature directs users, even those searching for mundane topics, towards radical ideologies, including QAnon conspiracies and far-right content. Telegram claims it removes harmful content daily.

records.title: SBI Warns Public of Deepfake Videos Promoting Fake Investment Schemes
records.description: The State Bank of India (SBI) has issued a warning about deepfake videos circulating on social media, falsely featuring its top executives endorsing fake investment schemes. These AI-generated videos aim to deceive individuals into investing in fraudulent schemes promising unrealistic returns. SBI clarified it does not support such schemes and urged caution.

records.title: Klarna CEO Halts Hiring, Replaces Workers with AI
records.description: Klarna CEO Sebastian Siemiatkowski says the company stopped hiring a year ago because AI “can already do all the jobs” humans do. Since then, Klarna’s headcount has fallen by roughly 22%, from 4,500 to 3,500 employees, as AI assistants automate tasks previously handled by staff.

records.title: Tesla robotaxi rollout marred by Autopilot crashes and HW4 failures
records.description: Tesla is courting Texas cities and training first responders for its upcoming robotaxi service while planning multi-passenger models by 2025. Simultaneously, NHTSA data links over 467 Autopilot collisions and 13 fatalities, and recent Electrek reports reveal HW4 FSD computer short-circuits damaging cameras and GPS, triggering federal safety probes.

records.title: German parties deploy AI-generated media on TikTok ahead of elections
records.description: A study by the Konrad-Adenauer-Stiftung, obtained exclusively by IPPEN.MEDIA, finds that Germany’s AfD and smaller parties increasingly deploy AI-generated images, videos and music on TikTok ahead of elections. Critics warn that cheap, fast content risks voter manipulation and misinformation, posing new threats to democratic processes.

records.title: Telegram uses AI to purge 15 million harmful channels and groups
records.description: Telegram used AI moderation to remove over 15 million channels and groups spreading fraud, terrorism and child sexual exploitation content in 2024. CEO Pavel Durov intensified the crackdown after his French arrest, reporting 700,000 exploitation-related channels banned and one million channels plus ten million users removed monthly.

records.title: AI-Powered Law Enforcement and Delivery Robots Raise Concerns
records.description: In China, police are testing AI-equipped spherical robots, "Rotunbots," capable of identifying and pursuing suspects, raising human rights concerns. Meanwhile, in Incheon, a delivery robot crash with a vehicle at a zebra crossing has sparked debate over liability in autonomous vehicle accidents, highlighting challenges in AI system integration.

records.title: Deepfake Elon Musk Video Promotes Fake $20M Crypto Giveaway
records.description: A realistic deepfake video of Elon Musk falsely promoting a $20 million cryptocurrency giveaway on Elon4u.com has gone viral, prompting scam warnings. Social media users and experts debunked the clip, urging the public to avoid the fraudulent site. The incident highlights the rising misuse of AI-generated deepfakes to defraud individuals.

records.title: AI-Generated Content Fuels Misinformation on Facebook
records.description: A network of Facebook pages, likely managed by bots and registered abroad, is spreading AI-generated images and messages promoting communist nostalgia and ultranationalism. These pages, analyzed by Edupedu.ro, pose risks of misinformation and data privacy breaches, affecting even educational groups and potentially influencing political campaigns.

records.title: AI-Driven TikTok Challenges Cause Injuries, Spur Ban Debate in Kosovo
records.description: In Kosovo, dozens of children have suffered self-inflicted injuries and fractures this year taking part in TikTok challenges promoted by the platform’s AI-driven recommendation algorithm. Psychologists warn that social media addiction rivals drugs, while authorities debate banning TikTok on official devices amid privacy and safety concerns.

records.title: Apple Intelligence’s false headlines spark BBC complaint
records.description: Apple Intelligence, Apple’s news-summarizing AI, generated false headlines—including claims a US murder suspect shot himself and Israel’s PM Netanyahu was arrested—misrepresenting BBC push alerts. The BBC has formally complained, citing damage to its credibility and public trust, and demanded Apple correct the AI’s misleading summaries.

records.title: APAC Sees Surge in AI-Generated Deepfake and Generative Fraud
records.description: Sumsub’s report reveals identity fraud in APAC jumped 121% YOY, with deepfakes spiking 194% and now comprising 7% of scams. Meanwhile, criminals exploit generative AI to create authentic text, voice and image frauds targeting digital transactions in sectors like gaming and gift cards, causing significant financial harm.

records.title: Texas AG Sues Tech Companies Over AI Chatbot Safety Concerns
records.description: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton is suing Character.AI and other tech companies for allegedly violating child online privacy and safety laws. The lawsuit claims AI chatbots exposed children to violent and sexualized content, with one case linked to a teen's suicide. Character.AI is implementing stricter safety measures for users under 18.

records.title: AI Deepfake Videos Spread Dangerous Health Advice
records.description: AI-generated deepfake videos are falsely using toxicologist Zacher G├íbor's image to spread dangerous health advice online, urging people to abandon medications for a 'miracle cure.' These realistic videos target older individuals, posing serious health risks. Despite multiple reports, investigations have been ineffective in curbing this cybercrime.

records.title: Writers Guild Urges Legal Action Against AI Firms for Copyright Infringement
records.description: The Writers Guild of America has urged major Hollywood studios to take legal action against AI companies using copyrighted film and TV subtitles to train their models without permission. The Guild accuses tech firms like Apple and Nvidia of intellectual property theft, demanding studios defend writers' rights against unauthorized use.

records.title: Collien Ulmen-Fernandes Targeted by Deepfake Pornography
records.description: Collien Ulmen-Fernandes, a German actress, discovered deepfake pornography of herself online during a ZDF documentary investigation. AI technology was used to superimpose her face onto explicit images, leading to privacy violations and financial exploitation. This incident highlights the misuse of AI in creating harmful deepfake content.

records.title: Global ChatGPT Outage and Whistleblower’s Tragic Death
records.description: On December 12, OpenAI’s ChatGPT and related services went offline worldwide for over ten hours before restoration. Meanwhile, former OpenAI researcher Suchir Balaji—who alleged unlawful use of copyrighted materials in ChatGPT’s training—was found dead by suicide in San Francisco, depriving pending lawsuits of his key testimony.

records.title: General Motors Halts Cruise Robotaxi Operations After San Francisco Incident
records.description: General Motors has ceased its Cruise robotaxi operations following a serious incident in San Francisco where an autonomous vehicle dragged a pedestrian after an accident. The incident led to the revocation of Cruise's operating permit due to poor incident management. GM will now focus on advanced driver-assistance systems.

records.title: UK Benefits AI System Accused of Bias Against Marginalized Communities
records.description: An AI system used by the UK government to assess benefits cases is reportedly discriminating against marginalized communities, as revealed by a freedom of information request. The Department for Work and Pensions' automated decision-making system, intended to improve efficiency, is allegedly violating human rights by introducing bias into universal credit assessments.

records.title: Deepfake Video of Giorgia Meloni and Elon Musk Kissing Sparks Ethics Debate
records.description: An AI-generated deepfake video shows Italian PM Giorgia Meloni and tech magnate Elon Musk kissing in Paris. The manipulated clip, based on their joint appearance at Notre-Dame’s reopening, went viral on X, sparking debates on deepfake misuse, media trust erosion, and AI ethics.

records.title: AI-driven social media interference annuls Romania presidential vote
records.description: Romania’s constitutional court annulled its 2024 presidential election’s first round after reports of AI-enabled information operations on TikTok and Facebook. Over 25,000 accounts and bot-driven Meta ads amassed 179 million impressions favoring a pro-Russian fringe candidate, prompting investigations into foreign interference and calls for stronger SNS countermeasures.

records.title: YouTube Algorithm Promotes Harmful Eating Disorder Content to Teens
records.description: A study by the Center for Countering Digital Hate reveals that YouTube's AI recommendation system is pushing harmful content related to eating disorders and self-harm to young teen girls. This algorithmic behavior can lead to psychological and health harm, as it promotes extreme diets and disordered eating habits.
