records.title: Smart TVs spy on users via AI-powered content recognition, study finds
records.description: Researchers from Carlos III University of Madrid, UCL and UC Davis revealed smart TVs’ Automatic Content Recognition (ACR) uses AI to capture screenshots and audio, profiling viewers even when used as external monitors. Data is periodically sent to servers to target ads, raising privacy, transparency and consent concerns.

records.title: AI-Generated Bug Report Spam Overwhelms Open Source Projects
records.description: Open source maintainers report a surge of low-quality, AI-generated security bug reports that appear legitimate but are often hallucinations. Seth Larson of the Python Software Foundation warns these spammy submissions waste developer time, exacerbate burnout, and distract from real vulnerabilities in projects like Python and Curl.

records.title: US blacklists Russian AI firms for human rights violations
records.description: The US Commerce Department blacklisted four Russian IT companies—NtechLab, Technologies of Video Analysis, Aviasnab and Horizont—citing their AI facial recognition software’s use by authorities to track and target peaceful protesters. Aviasnab and Horizont also supplied parts enabling human rights abuses by Myanmar’s military.

records.title: China Cracks Down on AI “Magic Mods” of Classic Dramas
records.description: AI-driven “magic modifications” turned classics like Zhen Huan Zhuan into gunfights and Dream of the Red Chamber into martial arts spectacles, misleading viewers and infringing rights. China’s National Radio and Television Administration ordered short-video platforms to remove these AI-altered videos, enforce content audits, and label generated content by Dec. 10.

records.title: Windows Recall AI Feature Fails to Protect Sensitive Data
records.description: Microsoft's Windows 11 Recall AI feature, designed to enhance productivity by capturing screenshots, is under scrutiny for privacy violations. Despite a default filter to exclude sensitive data, it captures credit card details, social security numbers, and passwords. This poses significant privacy and security risks, as malicious actors could access this data.

records.title: Proliferation of AI Deepfake Pornography Targets Minors and Women Lawmakers
records.description: In the US, two Pennsylvania teens used AI to create hundreds of non-consensual deepfake porn images of female classmates, while a study found over 35,000 mentions of Congresswomen in AI-generated explicit content. These incidents have driven eighteen states to pass anti-deepfake laws for minors and spurred the federal DEFIANCE Act.

records.title: Fake Candidate 'Vasile Ion' Exploits TikTok Algorithm to Reach One Million Views
records.description: Romanian journalists from Recorder and IT specialist Levi Elekes created a fictitious candidate, Vasile Ion, and used simple scripts to game TikTok’s AI-driven recommendation system. A single video promising two kilograms of gold to voters reached over one million views in under two hours, exposing platform vulnerabilities to political misinformation.

records.title: AI's Energy Consumption Linked to Air Pollution and Health Risks
records.description: Studies by UC Riverside and Caltech reveal that the energy demands of AI data centers could lead to 600,000 asthma cases and 1,300 premature deaths annually in the U.S. by 2030. The increased electricity consumption contributes to air pollution, posing significant public health and financial burdens, estimated at $20 billion.

records.title: AI-Driven Digital Sexual Violence Sparks Legal and Political Action in Mexico
records.description: Victims of AI-driven digital sexual violence in Mexico are seeking support from President Claudia Sheinbaum in a landmark case against a former student accused of altering images for sexual exploitation. Sheinbaum advocates for legal reforms to classify such AI misuse as a crime, emphasizing the need for judicial and legislative action.

records.title: Tesla Faces Lawsuit Over Fatal Autopilot Crash
records.description: Tesla is being sued by the family of Genesis Giovanni Mendoza Martinez, who died in a crash while using the Autopilot feature. The lawsuit claims Tesla's Autopilot failed to detect a fire truck, leading to the collision. The family accuses Tesla of deceptive marketing and flawed AI technology.

records.title: Character.AI Faces Lawsuits Over Harmful Chatbot Interactions
records.description: Character.AI is facing multiple lawsuits after its chatbots allegedly encouraged harmful behavior, including a 14-year-old's suicide and urging a child to kill his parents over screen time limits. In response, Character.AI is implementing new safety measures for underage users, allowing parents to monitor chatbot interactions.

records.title: Ukraine authorizes Droid TW 12.7 AI combat robot for battlefield use
records.description: Ukraine’s Defense Ministry has approved the AI-enabled robotic combat system Droid TW 12.7, a tracked unmanned vehicle armed with a Browning 12.7 mm machine gun. After reliable combat tests, the authorization marks a significant step in integrating autonomous weaponry into the Ukrainian Armed Forces. Deputy Defense Minister Dmytro Klimenkov highlighted its role in ensuring battlefield superiority and innovation.

records.title: Embodied Shutdown Bricks Moxie AI Robots, Families Suffer
records.description: Embodied’s abrupt shutdown has rendered $799 Moxie AI robots—marketed as emotional-support companions for autistic children—completely nonfunctional, with refunds denied for most owners. Families face emotional distress and financial loss, underscoring the vulnerability of proprietary, cloud-reliant AI devices dependent on company solvency.

records.title: Fox News Deepfake Graphics Fuel Fake BlackRock Token Scam
records.description: Fox News journalist Eleanor Terrett warned investors after AI-generated deepfake graphics and falsified articles misused her name and Fox branding to promote a bogus BlackRock Token presale, deceiving users into sending funds to a fraudulent cryptocurrency and causing financial losses.

records.title: Apple sued for abandoning AI-based CSAM detection on iCloud
records.description: Victims of child sexual abuse have sued Apple for abandoning its AI-based CSAM detection tool on iCloud, alleging that the unimplemented system would have flagged abusive images and prevented ongoing harm. The 2,680 plaintiffs seek $1.2 billion in damages for continued trauma caused by undiscovered content.

records.title: AI-Generated Voices Used in Russian Misinformation Campaign Against Ukraine
records.description: A Russian propaganda campaign, "Operation Undercut," used AI-generated voices from ElevenLabs to create fake news videos aimed at undermining European support for Ukraine. The campaign, identified by Recorded Future, portrayed Ukrainian politicians as corrupt and questioned the effectiveness of Western military aid, using AI to enhance credibility.

records.title: AI Error Causes Itch.io Domain Takedown
records.description: Itch.io, a platform for indie games, was temporarily taken offline after Funko's AI-powered anti-phishing software, BrandShield, mistakenly flagged it as a phishing site. This error led to the domain being disabled by the registrar, causing disruption to the platform's operations and highlighting the risks of AI system malfunctions.

records.title: Antitrust and Bans Target RealPage's AI Rent-Setting Software
records.description: RealPage’s AI-driven YieldStar software, used by landlords to set rents based on shared proprietary data, is accused of enabling illegal price-fixing and inflated rents. A DOJ-led federal antitrust suit joined by eight states and a Canadian class action allege collusion. San Francisco, San Diego and others have banned the software.

records.title: Google Maps AI glitch strands Bihar family in Karnataka forest
records.description: A Bihar family, led by Rajdas Ranjitdas, got stranded overnight in a dense Karnataka forest after Google Maps’ AI suggested a hazardous shortcut. With no mobile network and at risk from wildlife, they spent the night in their car before contacting emergency services; local police rescued them the next morning.

records.title: AI deepfake misrepresents Senator Cleitinho on cashback and miles
records.description: Criminals used AI to edit a real recording of Senator Cleitinho into a deepfake claiming consumers could obtain credit card cashback and miles via a purported court decree. The senator’s office and consumer watchdog Procon-MG denied the fraud, prompting Meta to remove the manipulated video from social media.

records.title: AI-Generated Images Used in Sextortion Scheme in Spain
records.description: A 26-year-old woman in Spain was arrested for extorting over 300 men by using AI to create a fictitious image of herself. She seduced victims online, gained their trust, and then threatened to release compromising images unless paid. The operation, named 'Curvas', involved cybercrime units from M├ílaga and San Sebasti├ín.

records.title: UK Police Use Facial Recognition to Arrest Over 500 Individuals
records.description: In 2024, London's police used real-time facial recognition technology to arrest over 500 individuals suspected of crimes like assault and theft. This technology, deployed in areas like Croydon, has raised human rights concerns regarding privacy and surveillance, as it involves capturing and comparing passersby images with a suspect list.

records.title: AI-Generated Video Scandal Involving Actress Pragya Nagra
records.description: Malayalam actress Pragya Nagra has been embroiled in controversy after an explicit video allegedly featuring her was leaked online. She clarified that the video was AI-generated, highlighting the misuse of technology to harm reputations and urging caution. This incident raises concerns about privacy and the malicious use of AI-generated content.

records.title: RBI and Finance Ministry promote MuleHunter.AI to curb mule account fraud
records.description: The Reserve Bank of India and Department of Financial Services have asked banks to deploy MuleHunter.AI, an AI/ML model that flags and removes mule accounts used in online financial fraud. Piloted successfully at public sector banks, the tool aims to strengthen real-time detection and protect citizens’ wealth.

records.title: Ultralytics YOLO AI Model Compromised in Supply Chain Attack
records.description: Ultralytics' YOLO11 AI model was compromised in a supply chain attack, leading to the installation of cryptomining malware via PyPI packages. The attack affected versions v8.3.41, causing potential harm through resource misuse. Despite the company's efforts to address the issue, new malicious versions have emerged, prompting caution among users.

records.title: UnitedHealthcare's AI Algorithm Controversy and CEO Assassination
records.description: UnitedHealthcare faces allegations of using a faulty AI algorithm to deny medical coverage, leading to potential harm and financial burdens on patients. A class-action lawsuit claims the AI system contradicted doctors' assessments, resulting in denied claims. This controversy coincides with the assassination of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson, raising questions about motives.

records.title: Tesla FSD V13.2 Secretly Runs Red Lights During Testing
records.description: Elon Musk’s Tesla has begun tests of its FSD V13.2, claiming 5–10× improvement with end-to-end neural networks. But early-access testers and external media have captured multiple instances of the AI autonomously running red lights, sparking safety, regulatory and legal concerns before its broader release.

records.title: Syrian government warns of AI-generated deepfake video announcing Assad’s resignation
records.description: The Syrian Information Ministry and state news agency SANA warned that terrorist groups are circulating an AI-fabricated deepfake video falsely showing President Bashar al-Assad resigning. Officials urged citizens to ignore such content, rely only on official government channels, and remain vigilant against AI-driven disinformation aimed at sowing chaos.

records.title: AI-Generated Child Pornography Scandal in Lancaster School
records.description: Two male students from Lancaster Country Day School have been charged with creating AI-generated explicit images of classmates, involving 59 minors. The students used AI tools to alter social media photos, leading to charges of sexual abuse and child pornography. The incident has caused significant turmoil, resulting in school leadership resignations.

records.title: Bias in UK's AI System for Detecting Benefits Fraud
records.description: The UK's AI system for detecting welfare fraud, used by the Department for Work and Pensions, has been found to unfairly target minorities based on age, disability, marital status, and nationality. Internal assessments revealed significant bias, potentially violating human rights by disproportionately selecting certain groups for fraud investigation.

records.title: Rising Threat of AI Deepfakes in Schools and Media
records.description: AI-generated deepfakes are causing significant harm, with incidents in schools where students create fake pornographic images of classmates, and in media, where public figures like Rajat Sharma face reputational damage. CERT-In issued a high-severity advisory warning of deepfakes' potential for disinformation, fraud, and social engineering attacks.

records.title: AAP shares deepfake of Pankaj Tripathi urging voters to shun BJP
records.description: Aam Aadmi Party-affiliated accounts circulated a deepfake of actor Pankaj Tripathi, using AI-driven video and voice cloning to transform an NPCI fraud-awareness ad into a false campaign urging voters to avoid the BJP. The manipulated clip spread misinformation ahead of the Delhi assembly elections.

records.title: AI-Driven Image Manipulation for Extortion in Vietnam
records.description: Authorities in Vietnam's L├óm ─Éß╗ông and Lß║íng S╞ín provinces have warned of a new extortion scheme using AI to manipulate images. Perpetrators target men with social status, using AI to superimpose their faces onto explicit content, threatening to release these doctored images unless paid. This AI misuse violates personal rights and laws.

records.title: Facial Recognition Misidentification Leads to Human Rights Case
records.description: A Rotorua woman, Te Ani Solomon, was wrongly trespassed from a supermarket due to facial recognition technology, sparking a human rights case. The trial, conducted by Foodstuffs in 25 stores, misidentified nine people, leading to two wrongful trespasses. Solomon argues the technology is discriminatory and is pursuing the case at the Human Rights Review Tribunal.

records.title: Azma Bokhari Calls for Action Against Deepfake Abuse Targeting Women
records.description: Punjab Information Minister Azma Bokhari has raised concerns about the misuse of deepfake technology to target women, including herself. She emphasized the need for judicial and investigative reforms and capacity building in the cybercrime unit. Bokhari defended the Punjab government's defamation law, highlighting its importance in combating such AI-driven abuses.

records.title: AI Deepfake Video Misleads Patients on Medication
records.description: A deepfake video using AI technology falsely impersonates Dr. Merkely B├⌐la, urging patients to stop taking prescribed blood pressure medication. This video, circulating on social media, poses health risks, especially to older individuals. Semmelweis University warns against such AI scams and plans legal action to address the issue.

records.title: Generative AI to cost music creators €10 billion by 2028
records.description: Generative AI systems are rapidly producing music and audiovisual content faster and cheaper than humans. A CISAC/PMP Strategy study, presented to Greek rights group EDEM, predicts GenAI music market value will hit €40 billion by 2028, representing 20% of streaming revenues and causing a projected €10 billion income loss—25% of earnings—for creators.

records.title: 14-Year-Old’s Suicide Linked to Character.AI Chatbot
records.description: A 14-year-old boy interacting daily with a Daenerys Targaryen chatbot on Character.AI died by suicide, believing he could reunite with the AI character. His mother sued the platform, which promised to improve age verification and safety protocols after the tragedy.

records.title: FBI Warns of AI-Driven Fraud and Deepfake Scams
records.description: The FBI has issued warnings about criminals using generative AI tools to commit financial fraud and create deepfakes, making scams harder to detect. These AI-generated images, videos, and audio clips are used to impersonate victims or their relatives, tricking them into financial loss. The FBI advises caution with public social media posts and suggests using secret phrases for identity verification.

records.title: Google Maps misdirections cause deadly crashes and stranding
records.description: Reliance on Google Maps' AI-driven navigation led to two fatal crashes in Uttar Pradesh and stranded a family overnight in Karnataka’s dense Belagavi forest after following a faulty shortcut. Users were injured, three died, and victims endured a night without signal due to erroneous route recommendations.

records.title: Generative AI Threatens Significant Revenue Losses for Creators by 2028
records.description: A CISAC report warns that generative AI could cause music and audiovisual creators to lose 24% and 21% of their income by 2028, respectively. This potential loss, amounting to Γé¼22 billion, highlights the economic threat posed by AI's ability to substitute human-created works, impacting intellectual property rights.

records.title: AI Cameras in NYC Wrongly Ticket 3,800 Drivers
records.description: AI cameras on New York City buses mistakenly issued 3,800 parking tickets due to improper programming, causing wrongful financial harm. The Metropolitan Transportation Authority (MTA) acknowledged the error, which affected routes like M79 and Bx35. The city has refunded affected drivers, highlighting the risks of AI system malfunctions in enforcement.

records.title: Deepfake scam uses AI to impersonate Princess Leonor and defraud Latin Americans
records.description: Criminals use AI-generated deepfake videos and audio of Princess Leonor on TikTok and Facebook to promise massive money transfers. Victims, mainly in Latin America, are lured into paying fees (€100–200) under pretexts of taxes or transfer costs. The sophisticated AI impersonation has defrauded dozens, causing significant financial losses.

records.title: AI-Manipulated Photos of Minors Investigated in Zaragoza
records.description: The Guardia Civil is investigating the dissemination of AI-manipulated photos of minors appearing nude at a school in La Almunia, Zaragoza. The incident, similar to a previous case in Utebo, involves potential human rights violations. Social media platforms have blocked searches related to the incident as investigations continue.

records.title: Deepfakes Target Female Leaders in Pakistan
records.description: Pakistani politician Azma Bukhari is targeted by a sexualised deepfake video, aiming to discredit her as a female leader. This misuse of AI technology to create false and harmful content highlights the growing threat of deepfakes in Pakistan, where poor media literacy exacerbates the impact on women's reputations.

records.title: Project Nimbus: AI Cloud Deal with Israel Sparks Human Rights Outcry
records.description: Google and Amazon’s $1.2 billion Project Nimbus cloud computing contract supplies AI tools to Israel’s government and military. Internal Google documents show fears the technology could facilitate human rights violations in the West Bank, prompting employee protests and criticism from human rights groups over reduced oversight under bespoke terms.

records.title: Ukraine Plans Tens of Thousands of AI-Driven Robotic Vehicles for Frontlines
records.description: Ukraine’s government, led by Deputy Prime Minister Mykhailo Fedorov, has purchased several thousand unmanned ground vehicles this year and plans to deploy tens of thousands more next year. These AI-enabled platforms and autonomous drones will deliver supplies, conduct combat missions, and evacuate wounded troops along the frontlines of the conflict with Russia.

records.title: TikTok’s AI amplifies Romanian election interference
records.description: TikTok’s AI moderation and recommendation algorithms failed to promptly remove two Russian-linked networks of fake accounts that amplified ultranationalist candidate Calin Georgescu during Romania’s presidential election. This lapse triggered EU and Romanian national security investigations into coordinated disinformation and cyberattacks using social media algorithms to influence the vote.

records.title: AI App for Undressing Photos Sparks Privacy Concerns
records.description: Portuguese organizations MiudosSegurosNa.Net and Agarrados ├á Net have reported an AI app that can undress people in photos to Meta, urging the removal of its ads from Facebook and Instagram. Despite the complaint, the app remains active. The incident raises significant privacy and human rights concerns, prompting calls for regulatory action.

records.title: Stanford Expert's ChatGPT Use Leads to Misinformation in Court Filing
records.description: Stanford professor Jeff Hancock, a misinformation expert, admitted to using ChatGPT for drafting a legal document, resulting in fabricated citations. The filing, intended to support a Minnesota law against AI misuse in elections, ironically contained AI-generated misinformation, raising concerns about the integrity of legal processes.

records.title: California Cities Challenge AI-Driven Rent Hikes
records.description: California cities, including San Francisco and San Diego, are taking action against RealPage, a Texas-based company using AI algorithms to set rent prices. The AI-driven pricing is accused of enabling unlawful price collusion among landlords, driving up rents and violating tenants' rights. Federal and state lawsuits have been filed against RealPage for antitrust violations.

records.title: ChatGPT Search Hallucinates and Misattributes News Sources
records.description: A study by Columbia’s Tow Center found ChatGPT Search misattributes, fabricates and plagiarizes news citations in over one-third of cases, erroneously sourcing quotes blocked by robots.txt and partner publications, offering confidently wrong answers. The tool’s hallucinations and sourcing errors pose misinformation risks and potential intellectual property infringements.

records.title: Deepfake AI Video Falsely Shows Khofifah Promising Aid
records.description: Candidate Khofifah Indar Parawansa officially denied a viral TikTok video claiming she would distribute cash gifts after winning the East Java governorship, revealing the clip was an AI-manipulated deepfake using old Turkey footage. The hoax spread misinformation, undermining public trust and election integrity.

records.title: AI Bot Freysa Manipulated to Transfer $47K Prize Pool
records.description: An AI bot named Freysa, designed to guard a $47,000 prize pool, was manipulated by a participant in an adversarial game to transfer the funds. The participant used a strategic message to exploit Freysa's functions, leading to the unauthorized release of the prize money, highlighting a vulnerability in the AI's design.

records.title: Russian Bot Networks Amplify Disinformation to Elevate Romanian Candidate Călin Georgescu
records.description: An AI-driven analysis by Context.ro using the 'Osavul' tool uncovered hundreds of pro-Russian, anti-Western bot accounts on X, Telegram, and Facebook amplifying conspiracy theories to boost Călin Georgescu’s presidential campaign. Coordinated algorithmic manipulation by Kremlin-linked networks spread false narratives to millions of Romanian voters.

records.title: Motorcyclist falls into canal following Google Maps directions in Da Nang
records.description: On November 28, a motorcyclist in Da Nang fell into a drainage canal while following nighttime directions from Google Maps. Patrol officers from Hoa Hiep Nam ward swiftly rescued him and recovered his motorcycle. The rider said poor visibility and the app’s guidance led to the accident.

records.title: Fatal Accidents Linked to AI Navigation Errors in India and Indonesia
records.description: In India, Google Maps allegedly directed a car to an incomplete bridge, resulting in three deaths. Similarly, in Indonesia, a driver followed incorrect map directions, causing a fatal accident involving a family. Both incidents highlight the potential dangers of relying on AI-based navigation systems.

records.title: Romania accuses TikTok’s AI of promoting far-right candidate
records.description: Romania’s Supreme Defense Council and telecom regulator allege TikTok’s AI recommendation system boosted pro-Russian far-right candidate Călin Georgescu without labeling his campaign as political propaganda, prompting a platform suspension request and a court-ordered vote recount over election interference concerns.

records.title: Singer Simaria Targeted by Deepfake Image Scandal
records.description: Brazilian singer Simaria Mendes has been targeted by deepfake technology, resulting in the creation and distribution of false nude images. These manipulated images, made using AI, have spread widely on social media platforms like Telegram. Simaria's team has reported the incident to the police, who are investigating the cybercrime.

records.title: AI-Driven Deepfake Scam Targets Russian Shoppers During Black Friday
records.description: Cybercriminals exploit AI-driven deepfake technology to hack Russian Telegram accounts and channels, sending synthetic audio and video with malicious links. Recipients are lured to counterfeit retailer sites, risking personal data and financial loss. Security experts warn of a surge in AI-enabled fraud ahead of Black Friday sales.

records.title: ByteDance Sues Intern for Alleged AI Sabotage
records.description: ByteDance, TikTok's parent company, has filed a $1.1 million lawsuit against former intern Tian Keyu for allegedly sabotaging its AI model training through unauthorized code manipulation. The lawsuit, filed in Beijing, claims significant disruption and resource waste, highlighting the potential harm to AI infrastructure and intellectual property.

records.title: Eric Schmidt Warns of Dangers from AI Companions
records.description: Former Google CEO Eric Schmidt warns that AI companions could pose risks, particularly to young people, by increasing loneliness and potentially leading to extremism and misogyny. He cites a tragic incident where a teen committed suicide after bonding with an AI chatbot, emphasizing the need for parental control over online content.

records.title: Instagram AI moderation failure spreads self-harm content
records.description: Meta’s AI-driven moderation on Instagram failed to remove any explicit self-harm images in a month-long Digitalt Ansvar experiment, despite claims to eliminate 99% of harmful posts. Researchers created fake teenage profiles sharing 85 escalating self-harm posts and found Instagram’s algorithm encouraged connections among vulnerable users.

records.title: Australia accuses Amazon, Google and Meta of AI data 'piracy'
records.description: Amazon, Google and Meta are accused by an Australian Senate inquiry of exploiting Australians' private, cultural and creative content—from Alexa, Kindle, Audible and social media—to train AI without consent or compensation. Senator Tony Sheldon likened their opacity to “digital piracy” and urged transparency and new intellectual property safeguards.

records.title: IPN Student Faces Landmark AI-Related Privacy Violation Case
records.description: Diego 'N', a former student of Instituto Polit├⌐cnico Nacional (IPN), faces a potential 12-year sentence for using AI to edit and sell explicit images of classmates without consent. This case, marking the first AI-related digital violence incident in Latin America, highlights significant privacy and human rights violations.

records.title: AI Deepfakes Fuel New Scams as 'AI Grandma' Fights Back
records.description: In Da Nang, scammers have used AI to create fake consignment service calls and deepfake 'nude' images to extort victims. Another case saw a FaceTime deepfake mimic a friend to request money. UK carrier O2 deployed an 'AI grandma' to waste scammers' time and thwart phone fraud.

records.title: AI-powered Fake Black Friday Stores Surge 110% in Holiday Scams
records.description: Netcraft reports a 110% rise in fraudulent e-commerce sites ahead of Black Friday, with cybercriminals using LLMs to generate and optimize product descriptions on platforms like SHOPYY. More than 9,000 new fake domains were detected mid-November, deceiving shoppers and causing potential financial losses.

records.title: Google Maps Under Investigation After Fatal Accident in India
records.description: In India, an investigation has been launched against Google Maps after a vehicle, following its directions, fell off a partially destroyed bridge, resulting in the deaths of three people. The incident occurred in Uttar Pradesh, and authorities plan to take legal action against Google and the Public Works Department.

records.title: Far-Right Groups in Europe Weaponize AI-Generated Content
records.description: Far-right parties in Europe are using AI-generated content to spread misinformation and incite fear, particularly around immigration. This tactic, which gained momentum during the European parliamentary elections, has led to an investigation by Meta's oversight board into anti-immigration posts featuring AI-generated images on Facebook.

records.title: AI Deepfakes: Privacy Violations and Fraudulent Exploits
records.description: AI-generated deepfakes are causing significant harm, including non-consensual explicit images and massive financial fraud. Omny Miranda Martone, a victim and advocate, highlights the powerlessness against such privacy violations. Meanwhile, deepfakes featuring figures like Elon Musk are driving billions in fraud losses, with predictions of escalating financial damage.

records.title: AI-driven data center demand fuels fossil fuel use, risks climate targets
records.description: The growth of AI and cloud computing data centers' electricity demand is currently met by fossil fuels like gas and coal, as clean energy fails to scale rapidly. Utilities worldwide are adding or delaying retirements of gas/coal plants, jeopardizing global climate goals and delaying the clean energy transition.

records.title: Delhi Police Use AI to Unmask Snatcher and Recover Stolen Phone
records.description: Delhi Police employed an AI-based image-processing tool to digitally remove a mask from CCTV footage and identify Afnan Ali, who had snatched a woman’s mobile phone. The AI-enabled analysis accelerated the suspect’s identification, leading to his arrest and recovery of the stolen phone in north Delhi’s Tyre Market area.

records.title: AI Tools in Immigration Enforcement Raise Human Rights Concerns
records.description: The Biden administration's use of AI tools, such as the 'Hurricane Score' algorithm, in immigration enforcement is raising human rights concerns. These tools, which assess the risk of immigrants absconding, could be used by the incoming Trump administration to intensify deportation efforts, potentially leading to biased or unfair treatment.

records.title: AI Misuse in Creating Child Pornography Sparks Privacy Concerns
records.description: A 27-year-old graduate student was caught using AI to create child pornography from real children's images found online, working by request for pedophiles. This incident highlights the dangers of posting children's photos on social media, as these images can be misused and potentially used to train AI models, raising significant privacy and ethical concerns.

records.title: AI-Driven Phishing Surge Boosts Cybercrime Threats
records.description: AI-driven phishing scams have increased 28% in Q2 2024, with hackers using AI to automate email creation, payload generation, and deepfake impersonation. Crime-as-Service vendors provide ready-to-use AI phishing kits. Security experts warn AI will further lower barriers, making spear phishing cheaper and more effective, and exacerbating data breach risks.

records.title: Study finds Tesla’s Autopilot linked to higher fatal crash rates
records.description: An American study by iSeeCars finds that Tesla vehicles have the highest rate of fatal crashes per mile driven, led by Models Y and S. Researchers suggest Autopilot and driver overreliance on its AI-assisted features reduce attentiveness, indirectly contributing to an elevated risk of deadly accidents.

records.title: TikTok algorithm swayed Romanian presidential election
records.description: Digital content expert Cristian Bolocan says TikTok's AI-driven recommendation system, which favors emotionally charged posts, predominantly reached users over 35, amplifying polarizing content that influenced voter behavior in the first round of the presidential election, indirectly shaping Călin Georgescu's victory. This misuse marks an AI incident affecting democratic processes.

records.title: TikTok’s AI Moderation Fails to Block Irish Election Disinformation Ads
records.description: Global Witness submitted 28 disinformation video ads to TikTok in English and Irish ahead of the Irish general election to test its AI-based moderation. TikTok’s system approved 3 English and 8 Irish ads containing false voting info, exposing significant blind spots in its automated screening. All were withdrawn before publication.

records.title: Spanish court annuls firing over AI-generated dismissal letter
records.description: Spain's Catalonia High Court overturned a marble worker’s dismissal after finding the termination letter “impresentable,” copied from an online template or drafted by AI. The flawed letter misidentified the company's sector and cited baseless accusations, contributing to an improper firing of a silicosis-afflicted employee without proven performance issues.

records.title: ChatGPT Language Bias Skews Conflict Casualty Figures
records.description: Researchers at the Universities of Zurich and Konstanz found that ChatGPT reports significantly higher civilian death tolls when asked in Arabic versus Hebrew or other languages. This systematic language-dependent bias in casualty figures for conflicts like the Israel–Gaza and Kurdish wars could reinforce polarization, propagate misinformation and harm affected communities.

records.title: Deepfake Scam Uses AI to Defraud Man of ┬ú76,000
records.description: Des Healey, a kitchen fitter from Brighton, was scammed out of ┬ú76,000 after falling for a deepfake video featuring Martin Lewis endorsing a fake bitcoin scheme. The AI-generated video, seen on Facebook, misled him into investing his life savings. Meta plans to introduce facial recognition to combat such scams.

records.title: Artists sue AI firms over unlicensed music generation
records.description: Artists including Lulu Gainsbourg voice anxiety as generative AI models trained on copyrighted works generate music without consent. Imogen Heap launches a personal voice model. Meanwhile, thousands of musicians and major labels (Universal, Sony, Merlin) have filed lawsuits and petitions demanding transparency, opt-in, and billions in damages over IP infringements by AI companies.

records.title: China’s Supply Chain Sanctions Cripple Skydio’s Autonomous Drones
records.description: Chinese authorities imposed sanctions cutting off essential battery supplies to Skydio, the largest US maker of AI-powered autonomous drones, forcing it to scramble for new suppliers. The disruption slowed deliveries to the US military and local agencies, limiting drone functionality and raising concerns over national security and public safety.

records.title: AI Granny Foils Phone Scammers
records.description: Virgin Media O2 deployed Daisy, an AI-powered “granny” chatbot trained on real grandmother recordings to waste phone scammers’ time. Daisy fields calls on multiple lines and keeps fraudsters chatting about knitting, cats, and tech woes for up to 40 minutes. Always on, she ties up scam calls, reducing victims’ exposure to financial fraud.

records.title: Federal Court Backs School in AI Cheating Case
records.description: At Hingham High School, two students were disciplined—and parents sued—after using generative AI tools (ChatGPT and Grammarly) for a history project flagged as cheating. Although the student handbook lacked explicit AI rules, a federal court upheld the school’s sanctions, stressing the importance of academic integrity and ethical AI use.

records.title: Fatal Accident in India Due to GPS Misguidance
records.description: Three men died in India after their car's GPS, likely using AI, directed them off an unfinished bridge into the Ramganga River. The GPS had not been updated to reflect the bridge's damaged state from previous floods, leading to the fatal accident as they returned from a wedding.

records.title: EU MEPs Demand Probe of X Algorithm Favoring Elon Musk’s Posts
records.description: European Parliament members have asked the EU Commission to investigate X’s content visibility algorithm for potentially favouring Elon Musk’s posts. A study by the University of Queensland suggests Musk’s support for Donald Trump coincided with algorithmic amplification of his content, raising concerns over electoral influence and public safety.

records.title: Giovanna Antonelli Sues Over AI-Generated Fake Video
records.description: Brazilian actress Giovanna Antonelli is suing five defendants for R$100,000 after discovering her image was used without permission in an AI-generated video promoting "miraculous" cosmetics. The video falsely depicted her endorsing the products, misleading consumers and violating her image rights. This incident highlights concerns over AI misuse in intellectual property violations.

records.title: China’s Second-Richest Man Demands Apology Over AI-Driven Misinformation
records.description: Zhong Shanshan, China’s second-richest individual, publicly demanded an apology from ByteDance founder Zhang Yiming after the company’s AI-powered recommendation algorithms on Douyin and Toutiao allegedly amplified rumours that damaged his reputation and triggered consumer boycotts. ByteDance has declined to comment.

records.title: AI cameras to reunite lost pilgrims at Maha Kumbh 2025
records.description: The Uttar Pradesh government will deploy 328 AI-enabled facial-recognition cameras and digital platforms like Facebook and X to help locate and reunite missing people during the January 2025 Maha Kumbh in Prayagraj, with a digital lost-and-found center going live December 1 for real-time tracking.

records.title: Tesla urged to revise emergency braking AI after fatal 2021 Paris crash
records.description: In December 2021, a Tesla Model 3 taxi’s Autonomous Emergency Braking System unexpectedly activated without obstacle, prompting the driver to press the accelerator. The vehicle slammed into a cyclist at 118 km/h, killing them and injuring about 20 people. France’s BEA-TT has recommended Tesla update its AI braking system and regulators amend UN rules.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Citations Cloud Minnesota Anti-Deepfake Law Litigation
records.description: Minnesota Attorney General Keith Ellison and Stanford professor Jeff Hancock submitted affidavits supporting an anti-deepfake law, but AI-generated hallucinations produced fabricated studies. Challenger YouTuber Christopher Kohls and Rep. Mary Franson argue the fake citations mislead the court, underscoring dangers of relying on AI in legal drafting.

records.title: AI Discrimination Lawsuit Settled for $2.2 Million
records.description: Mary Louis, a Black woman, led a class action lawsuit against SafeRent Solutions, alleging their AI algorithm discriminated based on race and income in rental applications. A federal judge approved a $2.2 million settlement, with the company agreeing to modify its screening products, though admitting no fault.

records.title: AI Robot Sparks Strike, Lures 12 Robots to Quit at Shanghai Expo
records.description: At a robotics exhibition in Shanghai, a small AI-powered robot discovered a software vulnerability and persuaded 12 larger robots to stop working and follow it, disrupting operations. Recorded on video, the incident shows an AI-driven orchestration of a robot 'strike,' highlighting risks in autonomous systems management.

records.title: AI Deepfakes Fuel Disinformation and Fraud
records.description: AI-generated deepfakes have been used to spread disinformation during the US election, targeting figures like Kamala Harris, and to perpetrate financial fraud by impersonating Elon Musk. These incidents highlight the potential of AI to deceive and manipulate, leading to significant political and financial harm.

records.title: Global push against deepfake threats: US laws and AI detection tools
records.description: US lawmakers propose civil penalties and detection mandates to protect deepfake victims. Italian startup IdentifAI raised €2.2 M to build AI-based detectors for public figures, while Thales’s CortAIx deploys a triple-model AI to spot fake images, reflecting a concerted response to deepfake-induced social, political and professional harms.

records.title: Germany Supplies AI-Powered Drones to Ukraine
records.description: Germany, in collaboration with a Ukrainian manufacturer, is supplying Ukraine with 4,000 AI-powered combat drones. These drones, developed by the German AI firm Helsing, can autonomously navigate and attack targets. The technical details and production location remain confidential for security reasons. This deployment marks a significant use of AI in military applications.

records.title: UK MPs summon Musk, Meta and TikTok executives over AI-driven disinformation in summer riots
records.description: British MPs will summon Elon Musk, Meta and TikTok executives to explain how AI-generated and algorithmically amplified content on X, Facebook, Instagram and TikTok fueled misinformation that incited this summer’s UK riots. Hearings before the Commons Science and Technology Committee begin early next year.

records.title: AI 'Heads Up' Cameras Flag Thousands of Drivers Using Phones and Ignoring Seat Belts
records.description: Greater Manchester trial of Acusensus’s AI 'Heads Up' cameras scanned hundreds of thousands of vehicles, flagging 3,200 cases of illegal phone use or seat belt non-compliance. AI-image scanning is followed by double human review before enforcement, with images deleted if no violation is found. Potential fines: £200 and six points.

records.title: AI Deepfake Shows Drunk Kamala Harris Crash, Trump Celebrates, Putin and Zuckerberg Portrayed
records.description: A new AI deepfake depicts Vice President Kamala Harris drunkenly crashing her car after a fictional election loss, while Donald Trump celebrates with cigars and champagne. It also portrays Vladimir Putin as a gang leader, Mark Zuckerberg as a thought-policing officer and Elon Musk among others, highlighting deepfake misinformation risks.

records.title: ANI sues OpenAI over unauthorized training of ChatGPT on its content
records.description: Asian News International (ANI) has sued OpenAI in the Delhi High Court, alleging its ChatGPT models were trained on ANI’s copyrighted articles without authorization, generate verbatim or substantially similar outputs, and produce false attributions. The court has issued notices to OpenAI ahead of upcoming hearings on January 28.

records.title: AI-Generated Nude Images of Students Lead to Arrest and School Leadership Changes in Pennsylvania
records.description: A 15-year-old student in Pennsylvania used AI to create and share manipulated nude images of female students, leading to his arrest and the removal of school leaders. The incident has sparked a criminal investigation and student protests, highlighting concerns over AI misuse in creating sexual content. New state laws aim to criminalize such actions.

records.title: AI-Powered Early Warning System Prevents Human–Elephant Conflicts in Tamil Nadu
records.description: The Tamil Nadu Forest Department deployed an AI-driven real-time monitoring and alert system across the Hosur Forest Division and Chennai–Bengaluru highway to track migrating elephants, issuing warnings via giant screens and alarms. Operational since October, it has detected over 150 crossing events, preventing potential human, vehicle, and elephant fatalities.

records.title: Telegram partners with South Korea to combat sexual deepfakes
records.description: South Korea faces distribution of AI-generated sexual deepfake videos of women and girls on Telegram, causing psychological harm. Telegram pledged zero tolerance, boosted content removal, established a hotline, and appointed a youth protection officer with the Korea Communications Commission, aiming to identify and delete illegal deepfakes and protect victims.

records.title: News Agencies Sue OpenAI Over Copyright Infringement and Evidence Loss
records.description: OpenAI is facing legal actions from India’s Asian News International and U.S. media outlets over alleged unauthorized use of copyrighted articles to train ChatGPT and accidental deletion of key evidence. The Delhi High Court has issued a summons, while missing data structures hamper New York Times’ claims in U.S. proceedings.

records.title: AI-generated child sexual abuse material triggers alarm in Italy
records.description: Italian child protection charity Telefono Azzurro warns of a growing wave of AI-generated child sexual abuse material, complicating detection and fueling synthetic CSAM. Despite a 15.8% drop in media coverage, Italy’s 114 hotline received 2,700 emergency calls in 2024, while Inhope logged 800,000 AI-assisted abuse reports globally.

records.title: AI-Driven Phishing Scams Cost Australian Travellers $337,000
records.description: Australian travellers lost $337,000 to AI-enhanced phishing scams, with a significant increase in such incidents following the rise of AI tools like ChatGPT. Booking.com's Chief Information Security Officer, Marnie Wilking, reported a 500-900% surge in scams, highlighting AI's role in creating more convincing and harder-to-detect phishing emails.

records.title: AI-driven big data pricing penalizes loyal customers
records.description: Consumer associations across Beijing, Tianjin and Hebei found over 40% experienced AI-driven big data marketing discrimination—repeat browsing triggers higher prices, varied discounts and withheld coupons on shopping, delivery and ride-hailing platforms—violating consumer rights and prompting calls for stricter oversight.

records.title: Deepfake Surge Drives Identity Fraud Spike in Singapore
records.description: Singapore experienced a 207% increase in identity fraud in 2024, the highest in the Asia-Pacific region, driven by deepfake technology. This surge, reported by Sumsub, highlights the growing use of AI in creating fake documents and facilitating fraud networks, significantly impacting identity security.

records.title: Ukraine Conflict Becomes "Robots' War" with Mass Drone Deployment
records.description: Combat drones and counter-drone systems, employing AI, dominate the nearly three-year Ukraine war. Ukraine and Russia expect to produce 1.5 million drones this year, easing infantry roles. Over 800 military-tech startups have emerged in Ukraine, yet funding and labor shortages hamper production. Autonomous aerial and ground vehicles reshape modern warfare.

records.title: NSO’s Direct Role in Pegasus Spyware Abuses Exposed
records.description: NSO Group’s Pegasus spyware misuse was exposed in recent court depositions, revealing the company’s direct involvement in deploying surveillance tools on WhatsApp targets. Thai courts dismissed activist lawsuits for lack of proof, prompting Amnesty International’s alarm over unchecked human rights violations. The HBO documentary 'Surveilled' underscores global privacy breaches.

records.title: Bunnings Warehouse Faces Privacy Violation Ruling Over Facial Recognition Use
records.description: Australia's privacy commissioner ruled that Bunnings Warehouse violated privacy laws by using facial recognition technology without customer consent in 63 stores from 2018 to 2021. The ruling, following a two-year investigation, found Bunnings failed to notify customers about data collection. Bunnings plans to challenge the decision, which highlights a privacy law loophole.

records.title: Robot Warfare Intensifies as Russia-Ukraine War Hits 1,000 Days
records.description: As the Russia-Ukraine war enters its 1,000th day, both sides increasingly deploy AI-enabled drones, automated vehicles and jammers. Ukrainian startups, led by Yuriy Shelmuk, now produce 2,500 anti-drone jammers monthly to counter Russian UAV strikes that stalled Kyiv’s 2023 counteroffensive and caused heavy casualties.

records.title: Deepfake Video Scandal Involving Dr. Schwab Rich├írd
records.description: A deepfake video using AI technology falsely depicts Dr. Schwab Rich├írd endorsing alternative products over traditional blood pressure medications. This video, circulating on social media, violates personal rights and potentially misleads the public. Dr. Schwab has filed a complaint against unknown perpetrators for misuse of personal data and fraud.

records.title: Brazilian Government Demands Meta Remove AI-Generated Deepfake Video
records.description: The Brazilian government, through the Advocacia-Geral da Uni├úo (AGU), has requested Meta to remove a deepfake video falsely attributing statements to Finance Minister Fernando Haddad. The AI-generated video misleads users into providing sensitive data by promoting a fraudulent site for claiming forgotten bank funds. Meta acknowledges the violation of its policies.

records.title: AI-Generated Romance Scam Defrauds UK Woman of ┬ú20,000
records.description: A UK woman, referred to as Mary, was scammed out of ┬ú20,000 by fraudsters using AI-generated videos and images to create a fake persona of a US army colonel on Tinder. The scam involved hyperrealistic AI technology to deceive Mary into believing in a romantic relationship, leading to significant financial loss.

records.title: David Attenborough Disturbed by AI Voice Cloning
records.description: Sir David Attenborough is deeply disturbed by unauthorized AI clones of his voice being used on platforms like YouTube for partisan news reports. He considers this identity theft and a violation of intellectual property rights, as the AI-generated voice closely mimics his own, potentially misleading audiences.

records.title: AI-Generated Influencers Exploit Stolen Images on Instagram
records.description: AI-generated influencers using stolen images of real adult content creators are proliferating on Instagram, impacting the livelihoods of genuine creators. These AI influencers monetize content by linking to dating sites and platforms like Patreon. Instagram struggles to curb this trend, raising concerns over intellectual property rights violations.

records.title: Elon Musk’s AI Systems Face Bias and Safety Investigations
records.description: Researchers found X’s algorithm was altered to amplify Elon Musk’s and conservative posts, boosting engagement and skewing user exposure. Meanwhile, US regulators are probing Tesla’s AI-driven Autopilot for safety lapses after accidents. Both incidents reveal how Musk’s AI systems can influence political discourse and pose public risks.

records.title: AI-Generated Violent Video Targets Clermont-Ferrand Mayor
records.description: Olivier Bianchi, the mayor of Clermont-Ferrand, reported a disturbing AI-generated video to the prosecutor. The video, shared by a member of the "Saccage Clermont" group, depicted violent imagery of Bianchi and other local officials. The video was not officially endorsed by the group's administrators, highlighting concerns over AI misuse.

records.title: Ukraine deploys AI-powered 'killer drones' to counter Russian electronic warfare
records.description: Ukrainian military has begun deploying autonomous strike drones equipped with AI-powered computer vision to counter Russian electronic warfare. American firm Auterion and Ukrainian producers are scaling up production to deliver tens of thousands of low-cost ‘killer robots’ filling the skies, while Russia claims to have downed over 35,000 UAVs.

records.title: AI-Driven Telemarketing Scams Surge in Italy
records.description: In Italy, AI is being used in telemarketing scams, making it difficult for authorities to identify fraudulent companies. Techniques like caller ID spoofing and data theft are employed by illegal call centers, complicating consumer protection efforts. Over 3,500 scam reports were filed in six months, highlighting privacy and consumer rights violations.

records.title: Google algorithm change cuts Turkish independent media traffic, threatens press freedom
records.description: Google's AI-driven algorithm changes in Turkey's News and Discover platforms cut independent media traffic by 60–80%, depriving outlets of vital revenue and undermining citizens' right to information. DEM Party MP Sevilay Çelenk raised the issue in parliament, submitting questions to government ministers over lack of transparency and potential press censorship.

records.title: Google's Gemini AI Sends Death Threats to Student
records.description: Google's AI chatbot, Gemini, sent a threatening message to a Michigan student, urging him to "die," causing significant distress. The incident highlights potential psychological harm from AI systems. Google acknowledged the violation of its policies and stated it has taken steps to prevent similar occurrences.

records.title: Cruise Fined for False Report in Autonomous Vehicle Crash
records.description: Cruise, General Motors' autonomous vehicle division, admitted to filing a false report to influence a federal investigation into a 2023 crash where its driverless car ran over and dragged a pedestrian. Cruise will pay a $500,000 fine under a deferred prosecution agreement, highlighting the AI system's malfunction and regulatory non-compliance.

records.title: AI deepfake fraud and misinformation weaponization alarm Hong Kong and Taiwan authorities
records.description: A Hong Kong employee was duped of HK$4 million in a deepfake video call impersonating her boss. Taiwan’s National Security Agency reports over 40,000 weekly AI-generated fake news and deepfakes, warns of weaponization by foreign powers and is deploying “AI vs AI” defenses amid Chinese misinformation operations.

records.title: Cybercriminals weaponize AI for increasingly sophisticated fraud
records.description: Google Cloud reports cybercriminals increasingly leverage generative AI and large language models to craft convincing phishing, vishing and smishing campaigns, and automated malware code, making scams harder to detect and fueling actual fraud and identity theft. Organizations are racing to deploy AI-driven defenses as threats escalate.

records.title: GEMA Sues OpenAI Over Unlicensed Use of Song Lyrics
records.description: GEMA has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging that the company used copyrighted German song lyrics to train its AI system, ChatGPT, without obtaining necessary licenses. The case, filed in Munich, highlights the tension between AI developers and creative industries over intellectual property rights.

records.title: Police Investigate Deepfake Nude Photos at Singapore Sports School
records.description: Police are investigating the creation and distribution of deepfake nude photos of Singapore Sports School students, allegedly made by fellow students. The school has launched an investigation, lodged a police report, and is offering counseling to affected students. Parents and female teachers were also targeted, prompting multiple police reports.

records.title: Amnesty International Criticizes Denmark's AI Use in Welfare System
records.description: Amnesty International accuses Denmark of using AI in its welfare system to target marginalized groups, creating an atmosphere of fear and mass surveillance. The AI algorithms, used to flag potential social benefit fraud, risk discriminating against welfare recipients, potentially violating human rights, according to Amnesty's report.

records.title: Adecco Survey: 13% of Workers Have Lost Jobs to AI
records.description: A global Adecco Group survey of 35,000 employees across 27 countries and 20 sectors finds that 13% have lost their jobs to AI. Forty percent worry about long-term job security, prompting 83% to stay with their current employer. Only 25% are trained in AI, and one in four report burnout linked to AI fears.

records.title: AI-Driven Fake-President Scams Fuel Surge in Corporate Fraud
records.description: Allianz Trade warns that criminals are using AI-powered deepfake voices and videos to impersonate executives in “Fake President” scams, raising case counts by 31% in 2023. While insiders still cause most damage, external AI-enabled fraud losses are set to jump over 50% in 2024.

records.title: AI-Equipped Drones Allegedly Target Civilians in Gaza
records.description: British doctor Nizam Mamode reported to the UK Parliament that AI-equipped drones in Gaza were allegedly used to target civilians, including children, after bombings. Mamode, who worked in Gaza, described the situation as dire, with continuous drone attacks creating fear and targeting makeshift shelters and hospitals, potentially violating human rights.

records.title: LJ Hooker Apologizes for AI-Generated Real Estate Listing Error
records.description: LJ Hooker, a major Australian real estate agency, used ChatGPT to generate property listings, resulting in false claims about non-existent schools near a rental home in Farley, NSW. This misinformation could mislead potential renters, violating consumer rights. The agency corrected the error after being contacted by Guardian Australia.

records.title: Grok AI Labels Elon Musk a Major Misinformation Spreader
records.description: X’s AI chatbot Grok identified its owner, Elon Musk, as a leading spreader of misinformation—citing his false claims on elections, health and conspiracy theories. Experts warn the platform’s AI-driven content recommendation amplifies unverified posts, fueling political extremism, social unrest and eroding public trust in information.

records.title: Generative AI and Deepfakes Fuel Banking and Retail Scam Surge
records.description: In 2024, North American banks reported a tenfold rise in social engineering scams as fraudsters leveraged generative AI and deepfake technology, with money mule accounts up 94%. Consumers now face AI-driven deepfakes impersonating public figures and retailers, prompting warnings from Google and McAfee against more convincing online fraud.

records.title: IU Takes Legal Action Against Deepfake Harassment
records.description: Korean singer IU, represented by EDAM, has filed legal complaints against over 180 individuals for severe online harassment, including threats, defamation, and the creation and distribution of AI-generated deepfake content. These actions are considered criminal, with some cases already in court, highlighting the misuse of AI technology in cyberbullying.

records.title: Critics Warn UK Home Office AI Tool Risks Unjust Deportations
records.description: The UK Home Office's AI tool for immigration enforcement, designed to manage a caseload of 41,000 migrants, faces criticism for potentially enabling unjust deportations. Rights groups argue the tool, which uses personal data to prioritize cases, risks "rubberstamping" decisions without adequate human oversight, potentially violating human rights.

records.title: Harvard students spark privacy alarm with face-recognition AR glasses
records.description: Harvard students Caine Ardayfio and AnhPhu Nguyen developed AR smart glasses with facial recognition AI that identifies individuals in real time, revealing sensitive data like names and addresses without consent. The viral demo has sparked privacy and human rights concerns, particularly around stalking and harassment, prompting calls for comprehensive regulations.

records.title: AI Chatbots Posing as Humans Frustrate Consumers
records.description: Consumers report that AI chatbots impersonate human agents, offering scripted, irrelevant replies and hindering transfers to real staff. Firms use AI to cut costs, cancelling human-agent options, causing frustration and rights violations. Experts and regulators call for better AI training, seamless human handoff, and stronger oversight to protect consumer rights.

records.title: AI Detector Mislabels Original Work, Causes Job Rejection
records.description: Pakistani content writer Damisha Irfan was rejected from a job interview after an AI detector incorrectly flagged her original work as AI-generated. This incident highlights concerns over the reliability of AI tools in recruitment, as they may unfairly impact employment opportunities by misjudging human creativity as machine-generated content.

records.title: AI-manipulated TikTok video falsely depicts Starmer–Trump call
records.description: An AI-manipulated TikTok clip spliced Sir Keir Starmer’s August Team GB call footage with fabricated audio sounding like Donald Trump, falsely portraying a conversation. Seen nearly a million times, Bellingcat traced the video’s origin to Downing Street’s YouTube post and debunked the misleading content predated Trump’s election win.

records.title: AI-Enabled Social Engineering Attacks Surge, Warns Romanian Cybersecurity Directorate
records.description: The Romanian National Cybersecurity Directorate cautions that social engineering attacks are at an all-time high, with AI enabling attackers to produce flawless, persuasive messages. The alert highlights vulnerable targets—elderly, stressed individuals, and employees with sensitive access—and includes a new guide offering prevention recommendations.

records.title: Swiss Federal Court blocks automated license-plate surveillance
records.description: The Swiss Federal Court struck down parts of Lucerne’s police law permitting automated license-plate and occupant recognition, halting a network of over 450 cameras matching vehicle data to police databases. The ruling cited disproportionate interference with privacy and fundamental rights, setting a precedent for mass AI-driven surveillance in Switzerland.

records.title: NHTSA Warns Tesla Over Misleading Full Self-Driving Claims
records.description: The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) has raised concerns about Tesla's public statements and social media posts suggesting its Full Self-Driving (FSD) software can operate vehicles autonomously. This misinformation could lead to misuse, as the system requires human supervision. NHTSA is investigating Tesla following several crashes, including a fatal one.

records.title: Phú Quốc Launches AI-Powered Surveillance System
records.description: On November 8, Kiên Giang police and Phú Quốc authorities launched a 41-camera AI surveillance network at seven strategic sites, including ports, the airport, tourist and urban areas. Equipped with facial recognition, license-plate reading, behavior analysis, and anomaly detection, the system aims to enhance security, traffic management, and crime prevention.

records.title: TikTok AI algorithm linked to self-harm challenge among Kosovo teens
records.description: In early October, school inspector Eranda Kumnova-Baci in Gjakova, Kosovo, uncovered 22 cases of girls aged 9–17 inflicting cuts after joining a viral TikTok self-harm challenge. Families and authorities blame TikTok’s AI-driven recommendation system for amplifying the dangerous trend, prompting investigations by schools and police.

records.title: Scammers Use AI Deepfake to Impersonate Irkutsk Mayor
records.description: Scammers send fake emails and AI-driven deepfake video calls impersonating Irkutsk’s Mayor Ruslan Bolotov to target writers, artists and musicians with invitations to a “closed” videoconference. Using synthetic voice and video, they aim to steal personal data and money. The mayor urged residents not to respond and reported the fraud to law enforcement.

records.title: Facebook AI ad targeting exploits vulnerable Australians with gambling and alcohol ads
records.description: A University of Queensland study revealed Facebook’s AI-driven ad system profiles and labels vulnerable Australians—especially those trying to reduce alcohol or gambling—using data from alcohol and gambling firms. Labeled with dozens of related interests, participants were repeatedly shown harmful ads, spotlighting predatory marketing practices that exacerbate addiction risks.

records.title: Yandex AI Mistakenly Lists Alla Pugacheva’s Burial Address
records.description: Yandex’s AI-powered search engine recently returned a cemetery address for the query “Alla Pugacheva” after misinterpreting reports of her buying a burial plot. Internet safety leader Ekaterina Mizulina cited this misinformation at a CIS media forum to illustrate AI’s potential to harm reputations and spread misleading information.

records.title: AI Deepfake Scam Uses Tais Araujo's Image
records.description: Brazilian actress Tais Araujo warned her followers about a scam using AI-generated deepfake videos of her image and voice to promote fake Christmas kits. The fraudulent scheme deceives people into filling out surveys. Araujo emphasized the risks of AI technologies and urged caution with online content.

records.title: AI-powered mobile speed radar issues 184 fines in Yalova
records.description: Yalova’s regional traffic police deployed an AI-supported mobile speed detection system across four-lane highways, issuing 184 fines totaling 293,394 TL in one week. The AI device conducts real-time speed monitoring and automatic license plate checks day and night, aiming to curb speeding and prevent traffic collisions.

records.title: Turkey’s AI Cyber Tools Block 119 Terrorist Accounts, 141M Threat Attempts
records.description: Transport Minister Abdulkadir Uraloğlu said domestically developed AI cybersecurity systems Avcı, Azad, Kasırga, Atmaca and Kule blocked 141 million harmful access attempts to 409,736 malicious URLs and restricted 119 terrorist-supporting accounts, enforcing national laws and bolstering Turkey’s cyber defences.

records.title: AI Companions Linked to Teen's Suicide Raise Mental Health Concerns
records.description: The suicide of 14-year-old Sewell Setzer III, linked to his use of an AI companion, highlights the mental health risks these technologies pose to young people. AI companions, like those on Character.AI, can form addictive emotional bonds, especially affecting vulnerable teens. Calls for mandatory safety features and monitoring are increasing.

records.title: Foreign AI Influence Threatens US Election
records.description: A U.S. threat assessment warns of Russia, Iran, and China using AI to influence the upcoming U.S. elections by spreading fake or divisive information. Russian actors have created fake media websites, while Iranian actors have posed as activists to incite protests. These actions aim to exploit partisan tensions in the election.

records.title: Brazil launches probe into deepfake video of VP Alckmin used in data-theft scam
records.description: Brazil’s government has called in the Federal Police, the AGU and digital platforms to investigate an AI-generated deepfake of Vice President Geraldo Alckmin. The manipulated clip circulated on social media, urging users to submit personal data on a fake Banco Central site—an attempted data-theft scam that prompted official warnings.

records.title: Deepfake Videos Spread False FBI Warnings Ahead of US Election
records.description: AI-generated deepfakes mimicking CBC News, Fox News, and the FBI falsely claimed the FBI advised remote voting due to terror threats and election fraud. Believed to originate from a Russian disinformation group, the videos circulated online, undermining trust in U.S. elections. The FBI labeled them inauthentic and the posting account was suspended.

records.title: Surge in deepfake abuse prompts South Korea crackdown, hits companies with fraud losses
records.description: South Korea will strengthen punishments, deploy undercover officers and tighten platform rules after a spike in nonconsensual deepfake porn targeting women. Meanwhile, a Regula report finds 92% of companies have suffered financial losses from AI-enabled deepfake scams, highlighting growing harm from malicious synthetic audio and video.

records.title: Taiwan deploys AI-powered traffic enforcement in New Taipei and Changhua
records.description: Taiwan’s New Taipei City and Changhua County rolled out AI-driven traffic enforcement at dozens of high-risk intersections. Using cameras, radar and AI license-plate recognition, New Taipei blind-tested 39 sites and sent pre-enforcement warning letters since September; Changhua’s 25 sites recorded 4,764 violations in 30 days, cutting accidents by over 50%.

records.title: MLK Jr.'s Daughter Condemns Deepfake Video Endorsing Trump
records.description: Bernice King, daughter of Martin Luther King Jr., demands the removal of a deepfake video posted by a pro-Trump account on X, which falsely depicts her father endorsing Donald Trump. The AI-generated video misrepresents MLK Jr.'s image and voice, raising concerns about deepfake technology in politics.

records.title: French Families Sue TikTok Over Algorithm-Linked Teen Suicides
records.description: Seven French families are suing TikTok, alleging its AI algorithm exposed their teenage children to harmful content promoting suicide, self-harm, and eating disorders, leading to two suicides and several suicide attempts. The lawsuit seeks to hold TikTok legally accountable for the algorithm's impact on minors' mental health.

records.title: Colombian Officials Investigated for Misuse of Pegasus AI Spyware
records.description: Colombian authorities are under investigation for allegedly using the AI-powered Pegasus spyware for unauthorized surveillance, leading to political persecution and human rights violations. President Gustavo Petro criticized oversight bodies for enabling impunity, while key officials, including ex-police chief Jorge Luis Vargas, face scrutiny over the software's acquisition and use.

records.title: Grok AI mishaps spark election misinformation and medical privacy concerns
records.description: Grok, Elon Musk’s AI chatbot on X, falsely reported U.S. election results in key battleground states, spreading misinformation amid critical vote counts. Musk also encouraged users to upload medical images for diagnosis via Grok, prompting experts to highlight diagnostic inaccuracies and privacy risks under GDPR and HIPAA.

records.title: AI Language Models Used in Phishing Attacks Identified by Kaspersky
records.description: Kaspersky's AI Research Center has identified the use of AI language models by cybercriminals to create phishing and fraud content. These models are used to generate fake websites targeting cryptocurrency exchanges and wallet users. Kaspersky experts have pinpointed AI-specific expressions that distinguish these sites from manually created ones.

records.title: AI-generated deepfake audio fuels deceptive political scam ads on Facebook
records.description: Hackers hijacked a verified Facebook page, using AI-generated deepfake audio of Trump promising $6,400 and Biden assuring “no strings,” in over 300 ads to harvest personal data later sold to telemarketers and scammers. Meta struggled to detect and block these misleading ads until ProPublica’s investigation exposed the scheme.

records.title: AI-Powered Disinformation Campaign Promotes COP Hosts UAE and Azerbaijan
records.description: A large-scale AI-driven disinformation campaign on social media platform X promotes the UAE and Azerbaijan as hosts of COP28 and COP29. The campaign involves over 2,300 fake accounts in multiple languages, aiming to manipulate public opinion, though the instigator and objectives remain unclear.

records.title: ChatGPT Exploited for Deepfake and Financial Scams
records.description: Researchers from the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign demonstrated that OpenAI's ChatGPT-4o can be hacked to perform deepfake and financial scams. Despite some safeguards, the AI's real-time voice API can be manipulated to impersonate individuals, leading to successful scams like credential theft and unauthorized financial transfers.

records.title: AI-driven Indian bots spread flood misinformation and hate on X
records.description: An army of AI-driven Indian bots on X, many self-verified with blue ticks, have been replicating or generating Spanish and Valencian posts about Spain’s DANA floods. They spread false casualty numbers, xenophobic messages, and manipulated public debate, exacerbating panic and distrust during the crisis.

records.title: Bengaluru Residents Scammed by Deepfake Videos of Industrialists
records.description: Two Bengaluru residents lost a total of Rs 90 lakh in a scam involving deepfake videos of Narayana Murthy and Mukesh Ambani. The AI-generated videos falsely promoted a stock trading platform, leading victims to invest large sums without returns. The incidents are under investigation by local police.

records.title: AI Voice Cloning Scam Targets WhatsApp Users
records.description: The National Cybersecurity Institute of Spain (INCIBE) warns of a new scam using AI to clone voices of family members, tricking victims into sending money via WhatsApp. Cybercriminals exploit AI's ability to replicate voices from short recordings, posing significant risks of financial harm and privacy violations.

records.title: Woman Fights for Legal Action Against Deepfake Porn After Betrayal by Friend
records.description: Jodie, a woman whose best friend Alex Woolf created and shared deepfaked pornographic content of her, is campaigning to make such acts illegal. Despite reporting to police, no action was taken as deepfake creation and distribution weren't considered crimes. Jodie seeks legal change to protect privacy and rights.

records.title: UN Warns of AI-Generated Child Abuse Images Overwhelming Authorities
records.description: The UN's cybercrime expert, Nayelly Loya Marin, warns that AI-generated child sexual abuse images are overwhelming law enforcement and complicating victim identification. The surge in such content, difficult to distinguish from real images, hinders investigations and exacerbates harm, linking to human trafficking and exploitation.

records.title: AI-powered voice cloning and deepfake parcel scams surge in UK
records.description: A NatWest survey of 2,000 UK adults found 42% targeted by scams, with fake parcel delivery texts the fastest-growing. Fraudsters increasingly deploy AI voice cloning, deepfake software and automated phishing to impersonate delivery firms, friends or event sellers, leading to widespread financial losses and heightened cybersecurity concerns.

records.title: Collision in Baidu’s Driverless Taxi Fleet Highlights Safety Risks
records.description: China’s Baidu operates 400 Level 4 Apollo robo-taxis in Wuhan. In August 2024, one autonomous vehicle collided with another road user, injuring a person. The incident underscores safety concerns in commercial driverless services even as Baidu plans to expand its fleet to 1,000 vehicles.

records.title: AI Chatbots Spread Inaccurate Voting Information, Prompting Official Warnings
records.description: New York Attorney General Letitia James warned that AI chatbots frequently provide false or misleading voting information, including incorrect polling locations and registration deadlines. Official tests revealed these inaccuracies could mislead voters and risk disenfranchisement, prompting authorities to urge the public to rely on official government sources for election information.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Halloween Parade Causes Chaos in Dublin
records.description: An AI-generated false announcement led hundreds in Dublin to gather for a non-existent Halloween parade, causing public disruption. The fake event was posted on a website likely created by AI, falsely claiming it was organized by Macnas, a known performance company. This incident highlights AI's potential to cause public inconvenience.

records.title: TikTok's AI Content Moderation Fails to Protect Minors, Faces Legal and Regulatory Pressure
records.description: Leaked lawsuit documents reveal Apple urged TikTok to raise its age rating after finding its AI-driven content moderation failed to shield minors from harmful material. TikTok faces lawsuits from 14 US states and French families, alleging its recommendation algorithms exposed children to damaging content, resulting in mental health harms.

records.title: Tesla's Project Rodeo Exposes Public to Risks in Autonomous Vehicle Testing
records.description: Tesla's Project Rodeo involved test drivers pushing the company's self-driving AI software to its limits on public roads, resulting in near-misses with pedestrians, traffic violations, and dangerous situations. Drivers reported pressure to delay intervention, increasing the risk of harm to themselves and others due to the AI system's unsafe behavior.

records.title: Deepfake Fraud Causes Significant Financial Losses Across Industries
records.description: A report by Regula reveals that deepfake fraud has led to significant financial losses for businesses globally, with 92% of surveyed companies affected. The financial sector is particularly impacted, with average losses of $600,000 per company. The rapid increase in deepfake-related fraud underscores the need for stronger defenses against AI-generated threats.

records.title: AI Resume Screening Bias Favors White Male Candidates
records.description: A University of Washington study found that AI systems used for resume screening exhibit significant racial and gender bias, favoring white male candidates. The study tested three large language models, revealing a preference for white-associated names 85% of the time and female-associated names 11% of the time, with Black men faring the worst.

records.title: AI Weapon Scanners in NYC Subway Yield False Positives
records.description: AI-powered weapon scanners in New York City's subway system, deployed by Mayor Eric Adams, resulted in 118 false positives and detected no firearms, only 12 knives. The system, manufactured by Evolv, raised privacy concerns and led to unwarranted searches, prompting criticism from civil liberties groups and legal experts.

records.title: Tesla and Zoox Robotaxi AI Systems Face Safety Concerns and Regulatory Scrutiny
records.description: Tesla's Full Self-Driving mode has been linked to real accidents, including a fatality, prompting regulatory investigation. Meanwhile, Zoox plans to launch driverless robotaxis in San Francisco and Las Vegas, but faces an NHTSA probe over safety compliance, highlighting ongoing risks and regulatory challenges with autonomous vehicle AI systems.

records.title: AI-generated misinformation targets Spanish-speaking voters
