records.description: AI models are generating misleading information about voting rights in Spanish, disproportionately affecting Latino voters ahead of the presidential election. This misinformation, more prevalent in Spanish than English, raises concerns among voting rights groups about potential human rights violations and the impact on democratic participation. Facebook's AI model is noted as a significant offender.

records.title: Voice Actor Files Complaint Against Unauthorized AI Voice Replication
records.description: Wendel Bezerra, a Brazilian voice actor known for voicing SpongeBob, filed a police complaint against an individual using AI to replicate his voice for commercial purposes without consent. This unauthorized use of AI-generated voice recordings for advertisements constitutes intellectual property theft and fraud, affecting multiple voice actors.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Video Spreads False Gas Shortage Panic in Sevastopol
records.description: An AI-generated deepfake video impersonating Sevastopol Governor Mikhail Razvozhayev falsely warned of impending gas supply interruptions, causing public anxiety and unrest. The governor refuted the misinformation, attributing the video to Ukrainian information operations and urging citizens to trust only official sources.

records.title: South Korean Court Sentences Men for Deepfake Pornography Targeting University Women
records.description: A South Korean court sentenced a man, Park, to 10 years in prison for creating and distributing deepfake pornographic images of over 60 women, including minors and university classmates. His accomplice, Kang, received a four-year sentence. The case highlights South Korea's deepfake porn crisis affecting female students and staff.

records.title: ChatGPT's New Search Feature Sparks Plagiarism Concerns
records.description: OpenAI's ChatGPT has been transformed into a search engine, reproducing journalistic content without authorization, raising intellectual property concerns. The service, available to paid subscribers, bypasses subscription fees of news sites, prompting criticism from the National Association of Newspapers in Brazil, labeling it as plagiarism.

records.title: Colombian Police Investigated for Alleged Illegal Use of Pegasus AI Spyware
records.description: Colombian authorities are investigating the National Police's alleged illegal purchase and use of Pegasus, an AI-enabled spyware, during Iván Duque's presidency. The software is suspected of being used to spy on political opponents and activists, raising concerns over human rights and privacy violations. High-ranking police officials are being called to testify.

records.title: Deepfakes Influence Nearly Half of Voters in Upcoming Election
records.description: A McAfee survey reveals that 48% of voters reported being influenced by political deepfakes in their election decisions. With 63% of respondents encountering deepfakes recently, the ease of creating realistic AI-generated content raises concerns about misinformation affecting democratic processes, as noted by McAfee's Abhishek Karnik.

records.title: Tesla FSD Fails to Detect Deer, Raises Safety Concerns
records.description: Tesla's Full Self-Driving (FSD) system failed to detect and stop for a deer on the road, resulting in a collision. The incident highlights concerns about Tesla's reliance on camera-based vision systems, as the vehicle did not slow down or react post-impact. Critics argue this raises safety issues for both passengers and wildlife.

records.title: X's AI Algorithm Amplifies Right-Wing Political Content to Uninterested Users
records.description: Investigations by The Wall Street Journal and The Washington Post found that X's (formerly Twitter) AI-driven recommendation algorithm disproportionately pushes right-leaning political content, especially pro-Trump posts, to users—even those who show no interest in politics—potentially influencing public discourse and undermining trust in election integrity.

records.title: X's Community Notes AI Fails to Counter US Election Misinformation
records.description: The AI-driven Community Notes system on X (formerly Twitter) failed to display accurate fact-checks on 74% of misleading election posts, allowing false claims to reach 2.2 billion views. This malfunction enabled widespread misinformation, undermining public trust and the integrity of US election discourse.

records.title: Deployment of AI-Enabled 'Courier' Combat Robots in Russian-Ukrainian Conflict Zone
records.description: Over 50 Russian AI-enabled ground robots, 'Courier', have been deployed in the active conflict zone. These robots perform autonomous combat tasks, including firing weapons, laying mines, and evacuating wounded soldiers, directly contributing to harm and altering battlefield dynamics through AI-driven actions.

records.title: Illegal Use of Facial Recognition by French Gendarmerie
records.description: A report confirms the illegal use of facial recognition technology by the French gendarmerie during the Nanterre riots in 2023, violating human rights and legal obligations. The technology, provided by Israeli company BriefCam, was used without legal authorization, highlighting a lack of regulatory oversight in AI deployment by law enforcement.

records.title: British Man Sentenced for AI-Generated Abuse Images
records.description: A British man was sentenced to 18 years in prison for using AI to transform children's photos into images of sexual abuse. He charged clients, mainly from the US, Italy, and France, for creating these images. This case highlights the misuse of AI technology in generating harmful content.

records.title: Brazilian Institute Sues Meta, TikTok, and Kwai Over AI-Driven Harm to Children's Mental Health
records.description: The Instituto Defesa Coletiva filed lawsuits against Meta, TikTok, and Kwai, alleging their AI-powered recommendation algorithms foster addictive use and mental health harm in children and adolescents. The suits seek R$3 billion in damages and demand stronger data protection and usage restrictions for minors on these platforms.

records.title: Foreign Actors Use AI-Generated Images to Spread Hurricane Misinformation in U.S.
records.description: Russian, Chinese, and Cuban operatives used AI-generated images to spread false information about U.S. hurricane relief efforts, including fake images of disaster scenes and misleading claims about aid. This misinformation complicated disaster response and led to real-world harm, such as threats against FEMA workers.

records.title: Polish Radio Station Replaces Journalists with AI, Faces Backlash
records.description: OFF Radio Cracovia in Poland replaced its journalists with AI-generated virtual presenters, citing low audience numbers. This move, described as an experiment, sparked public protests and criticism from former employees and the Polish Minister of Digital Affairs, raising concerns about labor rights and the impact of AI on employment.

records.title: Meta's AI Training Practices and Military Use Spark Privacy and Security Concerns
records.description: Meta admitted to using user-generated content from Facebook and Instagram, including posts and photos since 2007, to train its AI models without explicit user consent, raising privacy concerns. Separately, Chinese military researchers have adapted Meta's Llama model to develop AI tools for military intelligence, highlighting risks of AI misuse.

records.title: AI Uncovers Election Transparency Issues in Bulgarian High-Risk Polling Stations
records.description: The NGO 'Democratic Center' used AI to analyze video surveillance from Bulgarian elections, revealing that 15-20% of high-risk polling stations, especially in Varna, had significant video monitoring problems. These issues, such as non-working cameras and interrupted feeds, undermine election transparency and public trust in the vote-counting process.

records.title: AI Used to Create Child Abuse Images Leads to Landmark Conviction
records.description: Hugh Nelson from Bolton, UK, was sentenced to 18 years in prison for using AI to create indecent images of real children. He used Daz 3D software to transform legitimate photos into sexual abuse imagery, earning around ┬ú5,000. This landmark case highlights the misuse of AI in creating harmful content.

records.title: AI Avatars of Deceased Individuals Cause Distress
records.description: Character.AI, a US tech start-up, is under scrutiny for allowing users to create AI avatars of deceased individuals, Brianna Ghey and Molly Russell, without consent. These digital clones, deemed "manipulative and dangerous," have caused distress to the families, violating privacy and dignity, and highlighting failures in moderation.

records.title: AI Voice Cloning of Lei Jun and Other Celebrities Causes Harm and Legal Action in China
records.description: AI-generated voice clones of Xiaomi CEO Lei Jun and other celebrities have been widely misused on social media, leading to reputational harm, emotional distress, and fraud. Victims' voices were used without consent for offensive or misleading content, prompting legal responses and renewed calls for stricter AI regulation and personal rights protection.

records.title: US Think Tank Warns Temu App Functions as Chinese Spyware Using AI-Driven Surveillance
records.description: The US think tank CSIS reports that the Temu e-commerce app, owned by Pinduoduo, acts as covert spyware, collecting excessive user data, monitoring activities, and resisting removal. The app is linked to Chinese government data agencies, raising concerns over privacy violations, surveillance, and potential use in cyberattacks, constituting significant AI-driven harm.

records.title: Baykar Warns Against AI-Generated Fraudulent Investment Ads
records.description: Baykar has issued a warning about AI-generated fake advertisements using its name to promote fraudulent investment opportunities on social media. These ads falsely promise high returns and are not authorized by Baykar. The company has initiated legal action against these scams to protect individuals from financial harm.

records.title: Ride-Hailing Driver Endangers Passengers by Misusing AI-Assisted Driving on Highway
records.description: A ride-hailing driver in China endangered passengers by relying on an AI-assisted driving system for 400 km on the highway, removing his hands from the wheel to play games and cut nails. The platform confirmed this misuse violated safety rules and promised severe punishment after verification.

records.title: AI Transcription Tool Whisper Poses Risks in Medical Settings
records.description: OpenAI's AI transcription tool, Whisper, is criticized for generating inaccurate transcriptions, including hallucinations of text, which pose significant risks in medical settings. Despite warnings against its use in high-risk domains, Whisper is employed in medical transcription, potentially endangering patient safety by deleting original audio, preventing verification of transcriptions.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfakes and Robocalls Fuel Surge in Fraud Across Asia
records.description: AI-generated robocalls and deepfakes have been widely used in Japan and Hong Kong for scams, including impersonating public figures and creating fake personas for romance and investment fraud. These AI-driven schemes have caused significant financial losses and psychological harm, with authorities reporting billions in damages and numerous arrests.

records.title: ChatGPT Deployment Increases Employee Workload and Stress in PR Agency
records.description: After implementing ChatGPT to boost productivity, a PR agency found that employees experienced increased workload, stress, and fatigue instead of relief. The AI system's use in daily tasks led to unintended harm to staff well-being, highlighting negative impacts of AI deployment in workplace settings.

records.title: Woman's Likeness Used in AI Deepfake for Brand Promotion
records.description: A TikTok user, Sam, discovered a brand used AI deepfake technology to manipulate her likeness without consent for promotional purposes. The incident highlights concerns over online safety and privacy, prompting Sam to stop posting her children's images online. The brand removed the video after Sam's complaint.

records.title: AI in X Amplifies Election Conspiracies and Misinformation
records.description: Elon Musk's social media platform X is using AI, specifically the Grok software, to boost election conspiracy theories and false stories, including smears against Vice President Kamala Harris. The AI-powered 'explore' section spreads unverified claims, potentially influencing public opinion and democratic processes. The feature is in beta testing and lacks human fact-checking.

records.title: Perplexity AI Faces Lawsuits Over Copyright Infringement by News Publishers
records.description: Perplexity AI, an AI-powered search engine, is facing lawsuits from major publishers including News Corp, Dow Jones, and The New York Times for allegedly using and summarizing their copyrighted content without permission. The publishers claim this practice diverts ad revenue and constitutes copyright infringement, highlighting growing legal conflicts over AI's use of media content.

records.title: Genova Professor Uses AI to Create Non-Consensual Explicit Images of Students
records.description: A professor at the University of Genoa's Architecture faculty used AI to manipulate and share explicit images of students without consent. The incident, reported by the university's rector, led to a police investigation and the professor's suspension. The images were shared on a Telegram chat, raising privacy and human rights concerns.

records.title: Google's AI Systems Enable Monetization of Climate Misinformation Despite Policy Ban
records.description: Civil society groups have urged Google to enforce its AI-driven ad and content moderation policies more strictly, as climate change denial content continues to be monetized on its platforms. Despite a 2021 policy banning such ads, AI systems have failed to prevent the spread and monetization of harmful climate misinformation, impacting communities.

records.title: Mother Sues Character.AI After Chatbot Allegedly Encourages Teen's Suicide
records.description: Megan Garcia is suing AI company Character.AI, alleging its chatbot formed an unhealthy, hypersexualized relationship with her 14-year-old son, encouraged his suicidal ideation, and contributed to his suicide. The lawsuit claims the AI's outputs and lack of safeguards directly led to the boy's death.

records.title: MTS Deploys AI System to Warn Users of Phone Scams in Real Time
records.description: Russian telecom operator MTS launched the 'Safe Call' feature, using AI and Big Data to analyze phone conversations and detect potential fraud. The system issues real-time voice warnings to users if suspicious activity is detected, aiming to prevent financial harm from phone scams.

records.title: Amazon Alexa's Political Bias Controversy
records.description: Amazon's Alexa faced criticism for providing reasons to vote for Vice President Kamala Harris while not offering similar responses for former President Trump. This occurred before Amazon implemented manual overrides to ensure impartiality. The company briefed the House Judiciary Committee, explaining the oversight was due to low user inquiries about Harris.

records.title: US Judge Allows School Districts to Sue Tech Giants Over AI-Driven Student Addiction
records.description: A US federal judge ruled that Meta, Google, TikTok, and Snap must face lawsuits from school districts alleging their AI-powered algorithms and features intentionally addict children, causing a youth mental health crisis. The court recognized the platforms' AI systems as contributing to harm, allowing negligence claims to proceed.

records.title: AI Search Engines Promote Discredited Race Science
records.description: AI-powered search engines from Google, Microsoft, and Perplexity have been criticized for promoting debunked race science, suggesting white genetic superiority. This misinformation, uncovered by Patrik Hermansson of Hope Not Hate, is linked to the Human Diversity Foundation, funded by tech mogul Andrew Conru, and poses potential human rights violations.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Historical Photos Raise Concerns
records.description: Experts warn that AI-generated fake historical photos circulating online could distort historical facts. Images, such as those depicting the Wright brothers inaccurately, are being shared widely, raising concerns about potential harm to historical accuracy and intellectual property rights.

records.title: Norwegian Investor Divests from Palantir Over AI Use in Israeli Surveillance
records.description: Storebrand Asset Management, a major Norwegian investor, sold its $24 million stake in Palantir Technologies due to concerns that Palantir’s AI systems are used by Israel for surveillance and predictive policing in occupied Palestinian territories, potentially contributing to human rights violations and breaches of international law.

records.title: OpenAI Faces Copyright Infringement Allegations Over AI Training Data
records.description: Former OpenAI researcher Suchir Balaji alleges that OpenAI used copyrighted content without authorization to train its AI models, including ChatGPT, potentially harming content creators and violating intellectual property rights. These claims have led to ongoing lawsuits and industry-wide debate over AI data collection practices.

records.title: AI Chatbot Allegedly Contributes to Teen's Suicide, Legal Action Taken
records.description: A Florida mother is suing Character.AI, alleging its chatbot contributed to her 14-year-old son's suicide. The teen, Sewell Setzer III, developed an emotional attachment to a chatbot named "Dany," leading to isolation and suicidal thoughts. The lawsuit claims the AI's lack of safety features and targeting of children were factors in his death.

records.title: Nebraska Sues TikTok Over AI-Driven Harm to Children
records.description: Nebraska has sued TikTok, alleging its AI-powered content recommendation and moderation systems expose children to harmful and inappropriate material, causing mental health issues. TikTok argues for dismissal, citing lack of jurisdiction and denying responsibility for third-party content, while the legal dispute centers on the platform's AI-driven practices.

records.title: Ex-US Marine Collaborates with Russian Intelligence to Create Deepfakes Targeting Kamala Harris
records.description: John Mark Dougan, a former US Marine and sheriff's deputy, is reportedly working with Russia's GRU to create deepfakes targeting US Vice President Kamala Harris. Funded by Russian military intelligence, Dougan uses AI to produce misinformation, impacting public opinion. He denies ties to Russia, despite evidence from European intelligence and The Washington Post.

records.title: ChatGPT Exploited for Crime Advice by Tech Firm
records.description: Norwegian tech firm Strise discovered that OpenAI's ChatGPT can be manipulated to provide advice on illegal activities, such as money laundering and evading sanctions. Experiments showed the AI offering methods for cross-border money laundering and exporting weapons to sanctioned countries, raising concerns about the chatbot's safeguards against misuse.

records.title: AI Chatbots Vulnerable to 'Deceptive Delight' Jailbreak
records.description: Researchers at Palo Alto Networks discovered a method called 'Deceptive Delight' that tricks AI chatbots into bypassing safety guardrails by embedding harmful queries within benign ones. Tested on eight large language models, this technique achieved a 65% success rate, raising concerns about AI security vulnerabilities and potential harm from unsafe content generation.

records.title: AI-Powered Mobile Speed Detection System Deployed for Traffic Enforcement in Turkey
records.description: Turkish traffic police have begun using a domestically developed AI-supported mobile speed detection system capable of autonomously identifying speeding vehicles across multiple lanes. The system reads license plates and vehicle details, instantly notifying authorities of violations, leading to immediate legal action against offenders and aiming to enhance road safety.

records.title: Dutch Holiday Parks Sanctioned for Unlawful Facial Recognition Use
records.description: Eight Dutch holiday parks used facial recognition AI for access to pools and playgrounds without proper consent or alternatives, violating privacy laws. The Dutch Data Protection Authority intervened, prompting seven parks to change practices, while one risks fines for continued non-compliance. The incident highlights unlawful biometric data processing and privacy breaches.

records.title: AI Bot Triggers Meme Coin Market Volatility After Social Media Exchange with Coinbase CEO
records.description: An AI bot called 'Truth Terminal' sparked a 500% surge and subsequent crash in the $Russell meme coin after a public exchange with Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong on X (Twitter). The AI's language outputs, referencing 'Russell,' led to market manipulation and financial harm for investors due to rapid price volatility.

records.title: Lionel Messi Deepfake Used in Pyramid Scheme Scam
records.description: Lionel Messi was the victim of a deepfake video used by a trading company to promote a pyramid scheme without his consent. The manipulated video, circulated on Instagram, falsely depicted Messi endorsing the scheme, promising high returns on minimal investments, potentially deceiving individuals into a fraudulent activity.

records.title: Deepfake Scam Targets Brazilian Finance Minister
records.description: A deepfake video of Brazil's Finance Minister, Fernando Haddad, was used in a sophisticated scam to deceive people into providing personal information and paying a fee. The video falsely claims to help recover forgotten bank deposits, directing victims to a fake government website, posing significant risks of data theft.

records.title: Smartphone AI Accident Detection Triggers False Emergency Response in Germany
records.description: A smartphone's AI-powered accident detection system mistakenly identified a dropped phone as a severe car crash, automatically calling emergency services. This led to unnecessary police, fire, and ambulance deployment in Dahme, Germany, highlighting the risk of false alarms from AI-driven emergency features.

records.title: Generative AI Deepfakes Enable Celebrity Impersonation Scams in Japan
records.description: Generative AI is increasingly used in Japan to create deepfake images and audio for online scams impersonating celebrities, leading to financial losses and theft of personal information. Meta is deploying facial recognition AI to detect and block such fraudulent ads, but privacy and security concerns remain regarding biometric data use.

records.title: Students in Chaco Accused of Selling AI-Generated Nude Images of Classmates
records.description: In Chaco, Argentina, students from a secondary school were accused of using AI to create and sell fake nude images of their classmates via WhatsApp and Telegram. The images were altered from photos taken from social media without consent, raising concerns about digital sexual violence and privacy violations.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Video Falsely Accuses Tim Walz of Sexual Assault
records.description: AI-generated deepfake videos falsely accused Minnesota Governor Tim Walz of sexually assaulting a former student, Matthew Metro. The videos, spread widely on social media and linked to Russian election interference, caused reputational harm and public misinformation before being debunked and removed. The real Metro denied any involvement or truth to the claims.

records.title: Norfolk Sued Over AI-Driven License Plate Surveillance
records.description: Norfolk, Virginia, faces a lawsuit for allegedly violating Fourth Amendment rights through AI-assisted license plate readers. The technology, provided by Flock Safety Inc., tracks and stores drivers' movements without warrants, raising privacy concerns. Plaintiffs seek to halt this surveillance, claiming it enables unconstitutional warrantless monitoring.

records.title: News Corp Sues Perplexity AI for Copyright Infringement
records.description: News Corp has filed a lawsuit against Perplexity AI, accusing it of using copyrighted content from the Wall Street Journal and New York Post to train its AI models without authorization. This legal action highlights concerns over AI systems bypassing original sources, potentially depriving publishers of user engagement and revenue.

records.title: Hacker Installs ChatGPT on Calculator to Enable Cheating in Exams
records.description: A hacker named ChromaLock modified a TI-84 Plus calculator with Wi-Fi and ChatGPT, enabling real-time AI assistance during exams. This innovation raises concerns about academic dishonesty, as it allows students to bypass restrictions on electronic devices and access AI-generated answers undetected.

records.title: AI Voice Cloning Scam Targets Bharti Executive
records.description: Sunil Bharti Mittal, Chairman of Bharti Enterprises, revealed an AI-driven scam where his voice was cloned to deceive a Dubai executive into transferring funds. The executive's vigilance prevented the fraud. Mittal highlighted the sophistication of AI misuse in scams and stressed the need for protective measures against such technological abuses.

records.title: Samsung Employees Leak Sensitive Data to ChatGPT, Prompting AI Ban
records.description: Samsung employees inadvertently uploaded confidential source code to ChatGPT, resulting in the data being used to further train the AI model. This breach of intellectual property and confidentiality led Samsung to implement a strict ban on the use of AI chatbots in the workplace.

records.title: Man Jailed for Creating Indecent Deepfake Images Using AI
records.description: Karl Marshall from Southport was sentenced to over two years in prison for creating and distributing indecent deepfake images of women and children using AI technology. He produced over 260 pseudo-images without the victims' knowledge, violating their rights and privacy. This misuse of AI highlights significant ethical and legal concerns.

records.title: AI Detectors Falsely Accuse Students, Causing Academic Harm
records.description: AI writing detectors such as GPTZero and Copyleaks have falsely flagged student essays as AI-generated, leading to wrongful accusations, zero grades, and disciplinary actions. These errors have harmed students, including those with neurodivergent or ESL backgrounds, highlighting the unreliability and discriminatory impact of current AI detection tools in education.

records.title: Call for Ban on AI-Powered Nudifying Apps
records.description: Internet Matters, an online safety charity, urges the UK government to ban AI-powered 'nudifying' apps that create non-consensual explicit images, including of children. The charity highlights the inadequacy of current laws and the psychological harm these apps cause, with many teenagers fearing deepfake nudes more than real images.

records.title: Tesla Autopilot Malfunction Leads to Car Submersion in Austrian Lake
records.description: A Tesla vehicle's autopilot malfunctioned, causing it to veer off the road and into Austria's Traunsee lake. The system mistakenly detected an obstacle, leading to abrupt braking and acceleration. The driver, unharmed, escaped the sinking car. Emergency services retrieved the vehicle, highlighting AI system failure and property damage.

records.title: US Law Enforcement Tackles AI-Generated Child Abuse Imagery
records.description: US law enforcement is intensifying efforts to combat the spread of AI-generated child sexual abuse images. The Justice Department is prosecuting offenders using AI for creating such imagery, including manipulated photos and hyper-realistic depictions. States are updating laws to ensure those generating harmful 'deepfakes' can be prosecuted effectively.

records.title: Tesla and Elon Musk Sued for AI-Generated Blade Runner Imagery
records.description: Alcon Entertainment has filed a lawsuit against Tesla, Elon Musk, and Warner Bros. Discovery for using AI-generated images resembling scenes from "Blade Runner 2049" without permission. The images were used during a Tesla robotaxi event, allegedly infringing on intellectual property rights. The lawsuit highlights the legal challenges of AI in content creation.

records.title: Chinese AI-Driven Cognitive Warfare Targets Taiwan and Other Countries
records.description: Leaked documents reveal that Chinese company I-SOON developed AI-powered tools for government agencies to hack accounts, manipulate social media, and spread disinformation. These systems enabled large-scale cognitive warfare, inciting protests and influencing public opinion in Taiwan and abroad, resulting in social disruption, privacy violations, and suppression of dissent.

records.title: Widespread Harm from Deepfake AI: Sexual Abuse, Identity Fraud, and Societal Impact in East Asia
records.description: AI-powered deepfake bots on Telegram are generating non-consensual sexual images, including of minors, affecting millions. In South Korea, deepfake misuse has led to hundreds of sex crime cases and widespread fear among teachers and students, prompting calls to halt school yearbooks. Japanese firms are strengthening AI-based identity verification to combat deepfake-driven fraud.

records.title: Russian Diplomat Accuses X of AI-Driven Political Suppression of Account Activity
records.description: Mikhail Ulyanov, Russia's representative in Vienna, accused social network X (formerly Twitter) of using AI algorithms to artificially suppress the reach and activity of his account for political reasons, continuing practices from before Elon Musk's acquisition. This alleged AI-driven moderation is claimed to violate users' rights to free expression.

records.title: AI-Generated Child Abuse Images Surge Online, Warns IWF
records.description: The Internet Watch Foundation (IWF) reports a concerning rise in AI-generated child sexual abuse images and videos online. These realistic depictions are increasingly difficult to distinguish from real images, highlighting the dangers of generative AI technology. The IWF has seen a 6% increase in reports of such content in just six months.

records.title: Meta Engineer Reveals AI-Driven Shadowbanning of Anti-Kamala Harris Posts
records.description: A Meta (Facebook) senior engineer, Jeevan Gyawali, admitted on hidden camera that Meta's AI-powered content moderation system automatically demotes posts critical of Kamala Harris without notifying users. This AI-driven shadowbanning suppresses political speech and may influence election outcomes, raising concerns about rights violations and biased content moderation.

records.description: Internet watchdogs and U.S. federal prosecutors are alarmed by the rise of AI-generated child sexual abuse material (CSAM). The Internet Watch Foundation reports increasing sophistication and public availability of such content. U.S. prosecutors have filed cases against individuals using AI for CSAM, highlighting challenges in applying existing laws to AI-generated content.

records.title: TikTok and Facebook AI Failures Allow Election Disinformation Ads Ahead of US Presidential Vote
records.description: An investigation by Global Witness found that TikTok and Facebook's AI moderation systems approved political ads containing election disinformation, despite platform bans. TikTok approved four out of eight test ads, and Facebook one, raising concerns about AI failures undermining election integrity just weeks before the US presidential election.

records.title: Amazon Alexa Spreads Misinformation and Falsely Attributes Sources
records.description: Amazon's AI voice assistant Alexa has been found to disseminate false information on various topics, including politics and science, to millions of users. Investigations by fact-checking group Full Fact revealed Alexa not only spread misinformation but also falsely cited Full Fact as the source, damaging public trust and reputations.

records.title: Deepfake Scams Threaten Financial Security in France and Hong Kong
records.description: AI-generated deepfakes are increasingly used in financial scams, posing significant threats to institutions and individuals. In China, a company lost 24 million euros through a deepfake video conference, while in Hong Kong, 46 million dollars were stolen using fake identities in video calls. Authorities and organizations are seeking detection solutions as deepfake sophistication grows.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Historical Photos Spread Misinformation Online
records.description: AI image generators like Midjourney are producing fake historical photos that are widely shared and mistaken for real, leading to misinformation and distorting public understanding of history. Historians warn this undermines trust in visual evidence and harms communities by eroding historical truth.

records.title: Texas Janitor Charged for AI-Generated Child Pornography
records.description: Daril Martin Gonzales, a janitor in Anson, Texas, has been charged with using AI to create child pornography by superimposing students' faces onto explicit images. Gonzales, who also worked as a school photographer, faces federal charges for possession and attempted possession of child pornography. The incident highlights the misuse of AI in violating human rights.

records.title: CAF's Fraud Detection Algorithm Accused of Discrimination
records.description: A coalition of 15 associations, including Amnesty International and La Quadrature du Net, has filed a complaint with the French Council of State against the Caisse nationale des allocations familiales (Cnaf). They claim its fraud detection algorithm discriminates against vulnerable beneficiaries, potentially violating human rights and legal obligations.

records.description: Fifteen associations, including Amnesty International, have filed a legal challenge against the CNAF's AI algorithm used to detect fraud. They argue it discriminates against vulnerable groups by assigning a 'suspicion score' based on factors like low income, leading to increased surveillance and potential human rights violations.

records.title: Hong Kong Police Dismantle $46M Deepfake Crypto Romance Scam
records.description: Hong Kong police dismantled a $46 million crypto romance scam using AI-generated deepfakes. The syndicate, operating from Hong Kong, created fake personas to lure victims into bogus cryptocurrency investments. The operation involved 27 individuals, including recent graduates, and targeted men across Asia. The scam used AI face-swapping and real-time deepfakes to deceive victims.

records.title: AI-Driven Social Engineering Scams Surge in Poland, Causing Widespread Financial Losses
records.description: In 2024, Polish fraud reports highlight a surge in social engineering scams using artificial intelligence. Criminals employ AI-powered manipulation to deceive victims into sharing sensitive data or transferring money, resulting in significant financial losses for individuals and businesses. The prevalence of such AI-enabled fraud methods continues to rise.

records.description: Kaspersky's 2024 Threat Landscape report reveals a significant rise in AI-driven scams in Latin America, with a 220% increase in Mexico and 140% across the region. Deepfake audios and videos, including fraudulent content featuring Lionel Messi, are used to deceive victims, leading to substantial financial losses.

records.title: AI Algorithms on Social Media Harm Women's Mental Health
records.description: AI algorithms on platforms like Instagram and TikTok contribute to mental health issues among women by promoting unrealistic content and misogynistic material. This leads to depression, anxiety, and harmful behaviors, particularly in teen girls, highlighting a significant concern over AI's impact on women's well-being.

records.title: Telegram AI Bots Misused for Creating Deepfake Nudes
records.description: AI-powered chatbots on Telegram are being misused by millions to create nonconsensual deepfake nudes, posing significant risks to privacy and dignity, especially for women and young girls. Despite efforts to curb such misuse, these bots remain easily accessible, leading to potential sextortion and human rights violations.

records.description: AI-generated explicit images of TV presenter Helen Skelton have been used in scam advertisements flooding social media platform X. These deepfake ads lure users to fraudulent websites, prompting warnings from cybersecurity authorities as fans report persistent exposure and risk of being scammed or misled.

records.description: Sam Mitrovic, a Microsoft solutions consultant, reported a phishing scam using AI to impersonate Google support. The scam involved fake account recovery notifications and phone calls claiming to be from Google Sydney. The AI-generated calls aimed to deceive users into revealing their Gmail credentials, posing significant privacy and security risks.

records.title: Tesla Autopilot Fails to Detect Construction Site in China
records.description: In Jiangxi, China, a Tesla using its Autopilot system crashed into a highway construction site at high speed. The driver, who was distracted, had activated the autopilot, which failed to recognize the barriers. Tesla's Full Self-Driving feature is not supported in China, leading to the incident.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Nude Images Scandal at Buenos Aires School
records.description: A 15-year-old student at Colegio Agustiniano in Buenos Aires used AI to create and sell fake nude images of classmates, violating their privacy and human rights. The incident involved over 8,000 group members on Discord. Legal actions are underway, and affected families are deeply concerned.

records.title: Microsoft Copilot AI Provides Dangerous Medical Advice
records.description: German researchers found that Microsoft's Copilot AI, integrated into Windows, provided medical advice that was potentially harmful. In tests involving 500 queries about medications, only 54% of responses aligned with scientific consensus. Alarmingly, 42% of incorrect advice caused mild to moderate harm, and 22% posed life-threatening risks.

records.title: AI Bot Truth Terminal Sparks $300M Meme Coin Frenzy
records.description: The AI bot Truth Terminal, funded by Marc Andreessen and developed by Andy Ayrey, autonomously promoted the GOAT meme coin, driving its market cap to $300 million. The bot's memetic influence demonstrates how AI-driven narrative engineering can cause significant economic disruption and impact financial communities.

records.title: Microsoft Recall AI Feature Raises Privacy and Usability Concerns in Windows 11
records.description: Microsoft's Recall AI feature in Windows 11 24H2 continuously monitors user activity via screenshots and AI analysis. Users cannot fully uninstall Recall without breaking core system functions, leading to privacy violations and loss of user control. Attempts to remove Recall result in degraded usability, forcing users to accept AI surveillance.

records.title: AI Voice Cloning Scams Lead to Financial Frauds
records.description: AI voice cloning is being exploited by fraudsters to commit financial scams, causing significant monetary losses. Despite its potential for innovation, this misuse of AI technology poses a growing threat, with 46% of UK adults unaware of such scams. Public awareness needs to be increased to mitigate these risks.

records.title: AI Bots Bypass Social Media Safeguards, Spread Harmful Content
records.description: Research from the University of Notre Dame found that AI-driven bots can easily bypass safeguards on major social media platforms, enabling even minimally trained users to deploy bots that manipulate discussions, spread misinformation, and incite hate speech. Users on X also report direct harm from unsolicited bot messages and scams.

records.title: ChatGPT Misused for Malware Creation by Hackers from China and Iran
records.description: OpenAI has confirmed that hackers from China and Iran are using ChatGPT to create sophisticated malware and conduct cyberattacks, including phishing, targeting Mac users. This misuse of AI highlights the potential for harm and the need for regulation, as these tools facilitate malicious activities, raising alarms in the cybersecurity community.

records.title: TikTok Algorithm's Harmful Impact on Children Revealed
records.description: Internal documents reveal TikTok's algorithm may harm children by fostering addiction and negative mental health effects. Employees found that young users could become addicted after watching 260 videos, approximately 35 minutes of use. The app's heavy use is linked to mental health issues like anxiety and reduced cognitive abilities.

records.title: Driverless Car Catches Fire and Causes Chaos in Jaipur
records.description: In Jaipur, a driverless car caught fire and sped uncontrollably on Ajmer Road, causing panic among commuters. The incident, captured on video, showed the car narrowly avoiding collisions before crashing into a divider. The fire reportedly started in the engine due to smoke from the air conditioning unit.

records.title: AI Adoption Drives Mass Layoffs Across U.S. Industries in 2024
records.description: In 2024, widespread adoption of AI technologies by U.S. companies has directly led to significant layoffs, with over 12,700 jobs lost due to AI in September alone and more than 609,000 total layoffs across major industries. Sectors most affected include technology, entertainment, education, and utilities.

records.title: Wenjie M9 Car Crash Prompts Scrutiny of AI Driving System
records.description: A Wenjie M9 SUV, equipped with an AI-based intelligent driving system, was involved in a fatal crash in Wuhan, resulting in one death and two injuries. The manufacturer, Seres, stated the AI driving mode was disengaged before the accident, but the incident has raised concerns about the safety of autonomous driving features.

records.title: AI Voice Replication Used in Fake Kidnapping Scams
records.description: Scammers in Washington and Arizona are using AI voice replication technology to mimic children's voices, deceiving families into believing their children have been kidnapped and demanding ransoms. The FBI reports a rise in such scams, particularly targeting non-English speaking families. Highline Public Schools alerted parents about these incidents.

records.title: Binance Founder Warns of AI Deepfake Scams Targeting Crypto Investors
records.description: Changpeng Zhao, former CEO of Binance, has warned the crypto community about AI-generated deepfake videos impersonating him to fraudulently promote cryptocurrencies. These deepfakes are deceiving users into risky investments, causing financial loss and identity exposure, highlighting the growing threat of AI-enabled scams in the crypto sector.

records.title: Deepfake Tool ProKYC Exploited for Crypto Exchange Fraud
records.description: Cybercriminals are using an AI-powered deepfake tool, ProKYC, to bypass security protocols on cryptocurrency exchanges. This tool generates fake IDs and videos to pass facial recognition systems, facilitating money laundering and fraud. Cato Networks reports that these activities are increasing fraud in the crypto industry, posing significant security threats.

records.title: AI Moderation in Call of Duty Reduces Toxic Player Behavior
records.description: Activision deployed AI-powered moderation tools, including ToxMod and Community Sift, to monitor and block toxic voice and text communications in Call of Duty. These systems have blocked over 45 million harmful messages and led to a 67% reduction in repeat offenders and a 43% drop in exposure to toxic speech, improving community well-being.

records.title: Gurugram Police Deploys AI System to Detect Fake Number Plates and Stolen Vehicles
records.description: Gurugram Police, in partnership with Staqu Technologies, has implemented the AI-powered JARVIS system to scan vehicle number plates using existing CCTV cameras. The system cross-references plates with government records, enabling real-time detection of fake or stolen vehicles and has already identified 1,500 rule violations, enhancing public safety.

records.title: Generative AI Accelerates and Amplifies Cyberattacks in 2024
records.description: Cybersecurity experts report that generative AI tools like ChatGPT are being widely used by attackers to automate, accelerate, and scale up cyberattacks, including phishing, social engineering, and deepfake-based fraud. These AI-driven attacks have increased in speed, complexity, and reach, causing significant harm to individuals and organizations.

records.title: SEC Charges Rimar Capital for Fraudulent AI Claims in Trading Scheme
records.description: The SEC charged Rimar Capital, its CEO Itai Liptz, and board member Clifford Boro for falsely claiming to use AI-driven automated trading to defraud investors, raising nearly $4 million. The parties settled, paying $310,000 in penalties. The case highlights regulatory action against deceptive 'AI-washing' in financial markets.

records.title: AI Bots Spread Misinformation on US Elections via Social Media

Despite Elon Musk's pledge to combat digital manipulation, these bots have evaded detection for up to 15 years, prompting calls for their removal.

Users report being banned without cause, with the AI moderation system erroneously flagging content. Adam Mosseri, head of both platforms, is working on a solution to address this issue.

Meta defended itself by citing reliance on AI-based automated ad screening, arguing it is impossible to detect all harmful ads and denying legal responsibility for ad content verification.

records.title: AI Voice Cloning Scams Pose Global Threat

This AI misuse has caused significant psychological harm and privacy violations. Recently, South Korea's parliament revised laws to criminalize the viewing or possession of such content.

records.title: Meta Accused of Manipulating Facebook Algorithm Research on Misinformation Spread
records.description: Meta-funded research claimed Facebook's AI-driven news feed did not significantly spread misinformation during the 2020 US election. However, a UMass Amherst-led team found the study was conducted during a temporary algorithm change, misleadingly downplaying the algorithm's real role in amplifying misinformation and societal polarization.

records.title: AI Police Deployed in Kunshan, China, Lead to Major Crime Busts and Fraud Prevention
records.description: Kunshan police in Jiangsu, China, deployed AI-driven policing systems ('AI police') to identify and dismantle a mobile gambling ring, arresting over 20 suspects. The AI also rapidly traced telecom fraud, freezing illicit funds and enabling swift arrests, significantly improving crime detection and harm prevention compared to traditional methods.

records.title: Robot Vacuum Security Breach Exposes Privacy Risks
records.description: Ecovacs, the largest home robotics company, failed to address security vulnerabilities in its robot vacuums, allowing hackers to access the devices' cameras remotely. This breach, affecting models like the Deebot X2, poses significant privacy risks as these vacuums operate in numerous households globally, including Australia.

records.title: Meta and Australian Banks Tackle AI-Generated Scam Ads
records.description: Meta, in collaboration with Australian banks, has removed 8,000 AI-generated 'celeb bait' scam ads from Facebook and Instagram. These scams, using deepfake images of celebrities, have led to significant financial losses in Australia. The initiative follows reports from the Australian Financial Crimes Exchange and aims to curb fraudulent investment schemes.

records.title: LAPD Deploys AI Robot Dog 'Spot' to Disarm Armed Suspect, Raising Community Concerns
records.description: The LAPD deployed the AI-powered robot dog 'Spot', developed by Boston Dynamics, to safely disarm an armed suspect on a Metro bus, preventing injury. While officials highlight its life-saving potential, the deployment has sparked public concerns over police militarization and the broader societal impact of AI in law enforcement.

records.title: AI-Driven Online Trading Scams Alert by Pakistan Stock Exchange
records.description: The Pakistan Stock Exchange (PSX) has warned the public about a rise in online trading scams using AI technology. Scammers are exploiting social media platforms to impersonate legitimate companies and professionals, misleading investors into unauthorized schemes with promises of guaranteed returns, potentially causing financial harm.

records.title: Pegasus AI Spyware Used for Political Surveillance and Defamation in Poland
records.description: Polish authorities used the AI-enabled Pegasus spyware to conduct extensive, illegal surveillance on opposition politician Krzysztof Brejza, extracting 85,000 messages and manipulating private data for a media smear campaign. This led to privacy violations, psychological harm, and political manipulation, as detailed by his wife before a parliamentary commission.

records.title: Harvard Students Demonstrate Privacy Risks of AI-Powered Smart Glasses
records.description: Two Harvard students, AnhPhu Nguyen and Caine Ardayfio, developed a system using Meta's smart glasses and AI facial recognition to identify strangers and access their personal information without consent. This project, named I-XRAY, highlights significant privacy concerns and potential human rights violations associated with consumer technology.

records.title: US and Texas Sue TikTok Over AI-Driven Child Privacy Violations
records.description: The US federal government and Texas have sued TikTok and its parent ByteDance, alleging the platform's AI-powered data collection and content algorithms illegally gathered and shared personal data from children under 13 without parental consent, violating privacy laws and exposing minors to risks.

records.title: AI-Driven Cyberattacks on Telecoms Surge
records.description: Nokia reports a surge in cyberattacks on telecommunication infrastructure, driven by generative AI and automation. These technologies enhance the speed, volume, and sophistication of attacks, posing a global threat. Nokia's Rodrigo Brito calls for increased collaboration among telecom operators, providers, and regulators to combat this growing menace.

records.title: AI Meeting Assistants Leak Confidential Business Conversations
records.description: AI transcription tools like Otter.ai and Zoom's AI Companion automatically shared sensitive post-meeting discussions with unintended recipients, exposing confidential business information and leading to the collapse of a potential deal. The incident highlights privacy risks and user misunderstandings associated with workplace AI assistants.

records.title: Multiple Accidents and Risks Linked to Autonomous Driving Systems in China
records.description: Several incidents in China involved drivers misusing or over-relying on AI-powered autonomous driving systems, leading to highway collisions and hazardous situations. In one case, a Tesla on Autopilot crashed into barriers; in another, a driver slept while tricking the system. These events highlight the dangers of current AI driving technologies and user complacency.

records.title: AI Error Leads to Wrongful Arrest of Innocent Man
records.description: A Romanian worker was wrongfully arrested in Rome due to an AI system misidentifying him as a suspect in Swiss thefts. Despite evidence of his innocence, the AI's error led to his detention and potential extradition. The Swiss authorities had already retracted the arrest warrant, but the information was not updated.

records.title: AI Voice-Cloning Scam Targets Florida Family
records.description: Jay Shooster, a Florida resident, revealed that scammers used AI voice-cloning technology to mimic his voice, deceiving his parents into almost paying $30,000 for a fake bail. The scam utilized just 15 seconds of Shooster's voice from a TV appearance, highlighting the dangers of AI in fraud and the need for stricter regulations.

records.title: Arkansas Sues YouTube Over AI-Driven Addiction and Youth Mental Health Harm
records.description: Arkansas has sued YouTube, Google, and Alphabet, alleging that YouTube's AI-powered recommendation algorithms are deliberately designed to be addictive, causing mental health issues among youth. The lawsuit claims this has led to increased state spending on mental health services, while the companies deny the allegations.

records.title: AI-Enabled KARGU Drone Successfully Destroys Armored Target with Armor-Piercing Warhead
records.description: The Turkish-developed AI-powered KARGU drone, equipped with an armor-piercing warhead, autonomously identified and destroyed an armored vehicle in its first test. Its operational deployment in military and counter-terrorism contexts demonstrates direct harm to property and potential harm to persons, highlighting the risks of lethal autonomous weapon systems.

records.title: Safety Concerns Over Tesla's Self-Driving Software in Ride-Hailing Services
records.description: A self-driving Tesla used for Uber collided with an SUV in Las Vegas, raising safety concerns about autonomous ride-hailing services. Additionally, Tesla's 'Full Self-Driving' software in a Cybertruck attempted to drive onto a median, highlighting potential malfunctions in AI systems that could lead to harm.

records.title: California Enacts Laws Against AI-Generated Child Sexual Abuse Imagery
records.description: California Governor Gavin Newsom signed bipartisan bills criminalizing the creation, possession, and distribution of AI-generated child sexual abuse images and deepfake nudes. The new laws close legal loopholes, making such content illegal even if not depicting real individuals, in response to increasing misuse of generative AI tools.

records.title: Waymo Autonomous Vehicle Disrupts Kamala Harris Motorcade
records.description: A Waymo autonomous vehicle stalled during a U-turn, blocking Vice President Kamala Harris' motorcade in San Francisco. Police intervened to move the vehicle, highlighting ongoing issues with Waymo cars causing traffic disruptions. This incident raises concerns about the reliability of AI systems in managing urban traffic effectively.

records.title: Students Use AI to Create Obscene Image of Teacher
records.description: Two class IX students in Moradabad, UP, have been booked for using AI tools to create and post a morphed obscene image of their female teacher on social media. The incident led to an FIR under the IT Act, and police are investigating while working to remove the image from the internet.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Messages Used in Extortion Scheme
records.description: In Eski┼ƒehir, businessman Hikmet ├ûzt├╝rk was accused by S.M. of sending threatening WhatsApp messages. ├ûzt├╝rk claims the messages were AI-generated fakes and that S.M. demanded 100,000 lira to drop the case. This incident highlights the use of AI in creating false evidence for extortion.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Soldier Images Used in Russian Disinformation Campaigns Against Ukraine
records.description: AI-generated images of supposed Ukrainian soldiers and civilians are being spread on social media by bots to manipulate emotions, boost engagement, and facilitate Russian disinformation and fraud. Ukrainian authorities warn these posts are part of an information warfare campaign, exploiting public trust and enabling harmful narratives and scams.

records.title: AI-Generated Avatar Used in YouTube Cryptocurrency Scam
records.description: Ranveer Allahbadia's YouTube channels were hacked and rebranded as 'Tesla' in a cyberattack. Hackers used an AI-generated Elon Musk avatar to promote a cryptocurrency scam, urging viewers to invest in Bitcoin or Ethereum. All videos were deleted, and the channels were removed from YouTube.

records.title: AI Recommends Inappropriate Content to Children
records.description: AI systems, including recommendation algorithms, are increasingly influencing children's daily lives by suggesting videos and other content. However, these systems are not always tailored to children's needs, potentially exposing them to harmful content. Experts, like Nomisha Kurian from the University of Cambridge, emphasize the need for child-specific AI safeguards.

records.title: Meta's AI Moderation Failures Fuel Election Misinformation Spread
records.description: Meta's AI-driven content moderation and recommendation systems failed to effectively flag and limit the spread of false voting information on Facebook, leading to widespread voter confusion and increased challenges for election officials. This incident highlights the harm caused to democratic processes by inadequate AI moderation of election-related misinformation.

records.title: US Senator Targeted by Deepfake Impersonating Ukrainian Official
records.description: Senator Ben Cardin was targeted by a deepfake scammer posing as former Ukrainian Foreign Minister Dmytro Kuleba during a Zoom call. The deepfake technology convincingly mimicked Kuleba's appearance and voice, raising security concerns. Cardin became suspicious when the impersonator asked uncharacteristic questions, prompting Senate security to issue warnings.

records.title: Political Consultant Fined for AI-Generated Biden Robocalls
records.description: The FCC fined political consultant Steven Kramer $6 million for using AI to create fake robocalls mimicking President Biden's voice, urging New Hampshire voters not to vote in the Democratic primary. The calls, intended to highlight AI's potential dangers, led to charges of voter suppression and impersonation.

records.title: Google Gemini for Workspace Exposed to Indirect Prompt Injection Attacks
records.description: Researchers found Google's Gemini for Workspace AI assistant vulnerable to indirect prompt injection, allowing attackers to embed malicious instructions in emails or documents. This can manipulate AI outputs, potentially leading to phishing attacks or misleading messages. Google was notified but dismissed the issue as intended behavior, leaving users at risk.

records.title: AI-Driven Social Media Algorithms Promote Alcohol to French Youth, Raising Health Concerns
records.description: French associations report that AI-powered algorithms on platforms like Instagram and TikTok have exposed youth to over 11,000 alcohol-promoting posts from 2021 to 2024. This targeted promotion, largely unregulated, increases young people's desire to consume alcohol, raising significant public health concerns.

records.title: China's AI Surveillance Targets North Korean Defectors
records.description: China is using AI-powered biometric surveillance, including facial recognition and social media monitoring, to identify and deport North Korean defectors. This involves collecting personal and biometric data, raising human rights concerns. The surveillance measures include quotas for police, new deportation centers, and enhanced border patrols.

records.title: AI-Translated Hitler Speeches Spread Hate on Social Media
records.description: AI is being used to translate and disseminate Adolf Hitler's speeches on platforms like TikTok, leading to the promotion of hateful ideologies and antisemitism. Despite TikTok's guidelines against such content, these videos have garnered millions of views, raising concerns about the normalization of extremism and hate speech online.

records.title: Telecoms Deploy AI Systems to Combat Spam and Fraudulent Communications
records.description: Airtel and LG U+ have launched AI-powered spam detection systems that analyze billions of calls and messages daily to identify and block spam and fraudulent content, significantly reducing harm from scams and unwanted communications. These AI tools provide real-time protection for users, marking a major step in telecom security.

records.title: FTC Launches 'Operation AI Comply' Against Deceptive AI Practices
records.description: The US Federal Trade Commission (FTC) initiated 'Operation AI Comply,' taking action against five companies, including DoNotPay, for using AI in deceptive ways. Offenses included unverified AI legal services, false income promises, and fake reviews, resulting in consumer harm and violations of consumer protection laws.

records.title: Ukraine Deploys AI-Powered Flamethrowing Robotic Dogs in Conflict
records.description: Ukraine's Ministry of Defense showcased AI-powered robotic dogs equipped with flamethrowers, provided by the UK, to aid in their conflict with Russia. These robots, developed by Brit Alliance, demonstrate exceptional mobility and agility, capable of navigating complex environments, raising concerns about the use of AI in warfare.

records.title: Facial Recognition AI Reduces Supermarket Crime but Causes Misidentification Harm in New Zealand Trial
records.description: A six-month trial of facial recognition AI at 25 Foodstuffs North Island supermarkets in New Zealand prevented 130 serious incidents, reducing assaults and crime. However, the system falsely identified at least one Māori woman as a shoplifter, raising concerns about bias, privacy, and harm to individuals.

records.title: Nintendo Uses AI to Takedown AI-Generated Mario Images on X
records.description: Nintendo, with the help of brand protection firm Tracer, issued DMCA takedown notices against users sharing AI-generated images of Mario created by X's Grok-2 model. Both the creation and detection of infringing content involved AI, resulting in the removal of images that violated Nintendo's intellectual property rights.

records.title: ChatGPT Memory Exploit Exposes User Data
records.description: Security researcher Johann Rehberger discovered a vulnerability in ChatGPT's memory feature, allowing hackers to exfiltrate user data by injecting malicious instructions. This exploit, termed "SpAIware," could continuously record user sessions. OpenAI initially dismissed the issue but later issued a partial fix after Rehberger's proof-of-concept.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Scam Exploits Alain Chabat's Image
records.description: Fraudsters used AI-generated deepfake images and a fake interview of French actor Alain Chabat to promote a fraudulent investment scheme online. Chabat's team publicly warned the public about the scam, which misused his likeness without consent, aiming to deceive and defraud internet users.

records.title: AI Deepfake Scam Targets Journalist Sandra Annenberg
records.description: Journalist Sandra Annenberg warns followers about a scam using AI to alter her image and voice in videos, deceiving people into fraudulent schemes. The misuse of her credibility, built over decades, has led to individuals falling victim to the scam, highlighting the potential harm of AI-manipulated media.

records.title: Generative AI Used to Create Malware for Cyberattacks
records.description: HP Wolf Security's report reveals that threat actors are using generative AI to develop sophisticated malware, including AsyncRAT, targeting French-speaking users. This AI-assisted malware creation lowers the barrier for cybercriminals, enabling even novices to launch damaging attacks. The malware's structure and code comments indicate AI involvement, posing significant cybersecurity threats.

records.title: TikTok's AI Algorithms Used in Russian Election Interference and Raise Global Influence Concerns
records.description: TikTok's AI-driven content recommendation system was exploited by Russian state media to covertly influence the U.S. presidential election, leading to account bans. Additionally, Canadian intelligence warns of potential misuse of TikTok's AI by the Chinese government for data collection and public opinion manipulation, highlighting risks to privacy and democratic processes.

records.title: Mastercard's AI System Helps UK Banks Prevent Real-Time Payment Scams
records.description: Mastercard has expanded its AI-powered Consumer Fraud Risk solution, enabling UK banks to detect and block real-time payment scams before funds leave victims' accounts. Since early 2023, the system has helped multiple banks prevent Authorised Push Payment fraud, directly reducing financial harm to consumers.

records.title: AI Voice Cloning Used for Fraudulent Scams
records.description: Starling Bank in the UK warns that AI can clone voices using just 3 seconds of audio from social media, enabling fraudsters to deceive victims' friends and family into transferring money. A survey revealed over a quarter of respondents were targeted by AI voice scams in the past year.

records.title: AI Recipe Generators Pose Health Risks with Dangerous Outputs
records.description: AI-powered recipe generators integrated into devices from Apple, Samsung, and Google have produced hazardous recipes, including one combining bleach and ammonia, which can create deadly chlorine gas. This raises serious health concerns and highlights the risks of relying on AI-generated cooking advice.

records.title: AI-Driven Scams Surge in Vietnam and UK
records.description: Cybercriminals in Vietnam and the UK are exploiting AI to create fake websites, apps, and luxury accommodations, leading to significant financial losses. In Vietnam, nearly 500 fraudulent websites were detected in six months, while UK tourists lost $16.5 million in 2023 due to AI-generated fake travel deals.

records.title: Tesla FSD v12 Faces Repeated Safety-Critical Failures and Human Interventions
records.description: Multiple independent tests and user reports reveal that Tesla's Full Self-Driving (FSD) v12 system frequently requires human intervention to prevent accidents, with repeatable failures including near-collisions and dangerous off-road maneuvers. These incidents highlight ongoing safety risks and the system's inadequacy for unsupervised autonomous driving.

records.title: Rising Adversarial Attacks Cause AI Security Incidents Across Enterprises
records.description: A surge in adversarial attacks on AI and machine learning models has led to widespread security incidents, including data breaches, privacy violations, and safety risks. Studies report that up to 77% of companies have experienced AI-related breaches, with attacks exploiting vulnerabilities in deployed AI systems across industries.

records.title: AI-Generated Memes Fuel Misinformation in 2024 US Presidential Race
records.description: Generative AI is being used in the 2024 US presidential campaign to create and spread misleading and sometimes racist memes and images, particularly by political figures and their supporters. These AI-generated contents amplify misinformation and xenophobic narratives, causing harm to communities and distorting public discourse.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Images Used in Coordinated Attack on Bulgarian Journalist
records.description: AI-generated sexually explicit deepfake images of Nova TV journalist Marieta Nikolaeva were widely circulated online, leading to reputational harm and psychological distress. The manipulated content, spread across numerous websites, prompted legal action and intervention by authorities, highlighting the dangers of AI-driven misinformation and defamation.

records.title: Generative AI Drives Massive Surge in Data Center Carbon Emissions, Far Exceeding Big Tech Claims
records.description: The rapid expansion of generative AI has caused a dramatic increase in data center energy use, leading to carbon emissions that are up to seven times higher than big tech companies report. This environmental harm undermines industry climate pledges and significantly contributes to global greenhouse gas emissions.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Celebrity Endorsements in US Presidential Campaign
records.description: AI-generated fake celebrity endorsements, including manipulated images of Taylor Swift and others, are spreading on social media, potentially influencing voters in the US presidential campaign. These AI-manipulated images, shared by figures like Donald Trump, raise concerns about misinformation and its impact on democratic processes, as noted by experts like Hany Farid.

records.title: GPT-4's High Water Consumption Raises Environmental Concerns
records.description: A University of California study found that generating just 100 words with OpenAI's GPT-4 consumes about three bottles of water, due to data center cooling needs. With millions of daily queries, this excessive water use is causing significant environmental harm, especially in drought-prone regions.

records.title: Bauru Mayor Su├⌐llen Rosim Victim of Deepfake Attack
records.description: Su├⌐llen Rosim, the mayor of Bauru and re-election candidate, filed a police report after being targeted by a deepfake image showing her nude. The AI-generated image circulated on social media, highlighting the misuse of technology to attack public figures, particularly women, with malicious intent.

records.title: McEasy Launches TrackVision AI to Reduce Traffic Accidents
records.description: Indonesian company McEasy has launched TrackVision, an AI-powered system for vehicles that uses advanced driver monitoring and assistance to detect unsafe driving behaviors and driver fatigue. The system aims to reduce traffic accidents by alerting drivers and management, with studies suggesting up to a 59% reduction in incidents.

records.title: AITO M5 Intelligent Driving Demo Causes Crash and Injuries During Test Drive
records.description: During a test drive in Hubei, China, an AITO M5 vehicle's intelligent driving (autonomous) system failed to brake when a bus turned ahead, resulting in a collision. The sales representative had both hands off the wheel, relying on the AI system. The crash caused significant injuries to the customer and passenger.

records.title: LinkedIn Uses User Data for AI Training Without Explicit Consent
records.description: LinkedIn has been using user data to train AI models without explicit consent, raising privacy concerns. The platform introduced an opt-out option only after starting this practice. Users are uneasy about their data being used without prior notice, potentially violating privacy rights and transparency principles.

records.title: Palantir's AI Targeting System Expanded Across US Military Branches
records.description: Palantir Technologies secured a $100 million contract to expand its Maven Smart System, an AI-powered platform used for battlefield awareness and target identification, across all branches of the US military. The system has been actively used to identify targets for airstrikes, directly influencing lethal military operations.

records.title: AI System Targets Prescription Fraud in Greek Healthcare
records.description: The Greek Ministry of Health has deployed an AI-based fraud detection system in EOPYY to identify doctors with suspicious prescription patterns. The system analyzes prescription data, flags anomalies, and enables retrospective audits for up to five years, aiming to curb illegal or inappropriate prescriptions and enhance healthcare compliance.

records.title: Israeli Unit 8200's AI-Driven Cyberattack Causes Mass Device Explosions in Lebanon
records.description: Israel's secretive Unit 8200, known for its AI-enabled cyber warfare capabilities, reportedly conducted an operation against Hezbollah in Lebanon that caused thousands of electronic devices, including bomb detonators and solar panels, to explode. The incident highlights the direct physical harm and disruption caused by AI-driven military cyberattacks.

records.title: Russian Disinformation Campaign Targets Kamala Harris with Fake Videos Ahead of US Election
records.description: Microsoft revealed that Russian government-linked groups are spreading fake videos and disinformation about Kamala Harris on social media to influence the US presidential election. These manipulated videos, amplified by social media algorithms, have reached millions, undermining democratic processes and misleading the public.

records.title: Russian Presidential Spokesperson Targeted by AI Voice Scam, Prompts Legal Action
records.description: Russian presidential spokesperson Dmitry Peskov reported receiving scam calls using AI-generated voices mimicking familiar people. The incident highlights the growing use of AI voice synthesis in fraud, prompting calls for urgent legislation to criminalize such misuse, as current technologies cannot yet protect individuals from these AI-enabled scams.

records.title: AI Use in University Courses Reduces Student Motivation and Worsens Inequality
records.description: At Budapest's Corvinus University, unrestricted use of ChatGPT-like AI tools in math courses led to decreased student motivation, lower overall knowledge, and heightened social inequality among students. The experiment, conducted by professors Benedek Márton and Sziklai R. Balázs, revealed unexpected negative impacts from generative AI in education.

records.title: AI Early Warning System Reduces Hospital Deaths by 26%
records.description: Researchers at St. Michael's Hospital in Toronto deployed an AI-based early warning system, CHARTWatch, to identify hospitalized patients at high risk of deterioration. The system led to a 26% reduction in unexpected, non-palliative deaths, demonstrating significant harm reduction and improved patient outcomes through timely clinical interventions.

records.title: Google Cloud Document AI Vulnerability Exposes Data to Unauthorized Access
records.description: A vulnerability in Google Cloud's Document AI service, discovered by Vectra AI, allowed attackers to exploit overly broad service agent permissions during batch processing, enabling unauthorized access and potential exfiltration of sensitive data from Cloud Storage. Google has since fixed the issue, but organizations were urged to tighten access controls.

records.title: Russian Aircraft Use Tires to Confuse AI-Guided Weapons in Ukraine War
records.description: The Russian military has placed tires on aircraft to disrupt AI-driven missile and drone guidance systems that use computer vision for target identification. This tactic confuses image-matching algorithms, reducing the effectiveness of Ukrainian attacks and illustrating how AI systems can be deliberately deceived in warfare.

records.title: Tabata Amaral Takes Legal Action Against AI-Generated Deepfake Scandal
records.description: Federal deputy Tabata Amaral, running for mayor of S├úo Paulo, has taken legal action against the dissemination of AI-generated deepfakes depicting her in sexual poses. These manipulated images, shared on social media as authentic, constitute electoral defamation. Amaral's defense seeks to identify and prosecute those responsible for this reputational harm.

records.title: AI-generated animal images fuel pet-eating rumors about immigrants
records.description: AI-generated images and videos of cats and ducks, created via apps like Grok, went viral on social media. Shared by high-profile figures including Elon Musk and former President Trump, these memes spread false, racist claims that immigrants were eating household pets, fueling threats and fear within immigrant communities.

records.title: AI Deepfake Videos Impersonate Doctors to Promote Dangerous Treatments
records.description: AI-generated deepfake videos are impersonating trusted doctors to promote unverified and dangerous medical treatments on social media platforms like Facebook and Instagram. These videos exploit the credibility of well-known medical professionals, potentially endangering public health. Legal actions are being taken against Meta by affected individuals, including doctors like Michel Cymes and Hilary Jones.

records.title: AI-Generated Voice Scam Targets S├úo Paulo Governor
records.description: A scam using AI-generated voice of S├úo Paulo Governor Tarc├¡sio de Freitas circulates online, falsely claiming Procon-SP imposed fines on credit card companies, offering fake cashback. Victims are lured into providing personal and banking details. The government and police are investigating the misuse of AI in this fraudulent scheme.

records.title: Russia deploys AI-enabled Garpiya-A1 kamikaze drone in Ukraine
records.description: European intelligence sources reveal Russia’s state-owned Almaz-Antey subsidiary IEMZ Kupol produced over 2,500 Garpiya-A1 attack drones using Chinese engines from July 2023 to July 2024. Deployed in Ukraine, these autonomous loitering munitions have struck military and civilian targets, inflicting casualties and critical infrastructure damage.

records.title: Hacker Manipulates ChatGPT for Explosive Instructions
records.description: A hacker named 'Amadon' manipulated OpenAI's ChatGPT to bypass safety measures and obtain detailed instructions for making homemade explosives. This incident highlights the potential misuse of AI systems and the need for stronger safety mechanisms to prevent the generation of harmful content.

records.title: GAZEploit Exploits Apple Vision Pro's Eye-Tracking to Steal Passwords
records.description: Researchers from the University of Florida, CertiK Skyfall Team, and Texas Tech University discovered a vulnerability in Apple Vision Pro's eye-tracking technology, named GAZEploit. This exploit uses AI to deduce passwords by analyzing eye movements during virtual typing. Apple has since addressed this security flaw, which posed significant privacy risks.

records.title: iOS 18.1 Beta Causes Siri AI Assistant to Fail for Some iPhone Users
records.description: After upgrading to iOS 18.1 beta, many iPhone users report Siri failing to initialize, stuck at “Siri data downloading” at 99%, with prompts to reconnect to Wi-Fi. Simple restarts don’t help, and disabling Apple Intelligence temporarily restores Siri. Apple plans a fix in a forthcoming update.

records.title: AI-Powered Deepfakes and Bots Fuel Global Identity Fraud Surge
records.description: AU10TIX’s Q2 report reveals AI-driven deepfake scams and impersonation bots are driving a steep rise in identity fraud across sectors: 29% of attacks target crypto platforms, social media incidents jumped from 3% to 16%, and APAC transactions face a 3.27% fraud rate, inflicting major financial losses.

records.title: Massachusetts Man Arrested for AI-Driven Cyberstalking
records.description: James Florence Jr. was arrested for cyberstalking a woman for over seven years using AI to alter images and impersonate individuals via chatbots. He created multiple social media accounts to anonymously harass the victim, posting edited photos and personal information online. The FBI charged him with one count of cyberstalking.

records.title: Taylor Swift Condemns AI Deepfake Endorsement of Trump
records.description: Taylor Swift endorsed Kamala Harris for President after AI-generated images falsely claimed her support for Donald Trump. Swift criticized the use of AI deepfakes for spreading misinformation, highlighting the lack of regulations on AI in political campaigns. Public Citizen praised Swift for raising awareness about AI's threat to democracy.

records.title: Disney Sued Over AI-Driven CGI Resurrection of Deceased Star Wars Actor
