records.description: Tyburn Film Productions is suing Disney and Lucasfilm in UK court for digitally resurrecting Peter Cushing as Grand Moff Tarkin via AI-driven CGI in “Rogue One” (2016) without consent, alleging breach of the actor’s posthumous personality and IP rights. The case spotlights legal issues in AI-based likeness use.

records.title: Macedonian AI-Powered Fake News Factories Fuel US Patriotism Misinformation
records.description: Eight years after the Veles scandal, North Macedonian AI-driven ‘factories’ still produce and disseminate fake pro-American content. A Forbes study found 67 Facebook pages with over 9 million followers—4.7 million linked to Macedonian operators—using AI-generated narratives to manipulate US patriotism discourse.

records.title: Deepfake Concerns Rise Amidst Elections and Social Issues
records.description: Deepfake technology, a form of AI, is causing significant concern in Southeast Asia, particularly Indonesia, due to its potential for misinformation during elections. The Indonesian government has removed thousands of deepfake accounts and content. Meanwhile, South Korean citizens protest against deepfake pornography, urging government action to protect victims' rights and privacy.

records.title: Meta Admits to Scraping Australian Users' Data for AI Training
records.description: Meta, the parent company of Facebook and Instagram, admitted to scraping public photos and texts of Australian users since 2007 to train AI models, without user consent or an opt-out option. This raises concerns about potential privacy violations and breaches of data protection laws.

records.title: Deepfake AI fuels financial fraud and viral misinformation
records.description: AI-generated deepfakes—over 500,000 audio and video clips circulated in 2023—are driving financial fraud and election misinformation. A doctored audio of a Baltimore high school principal’s alleged racist remarks went viral, prompting suspension and safety threats before experts partially confirmed its authenticity. Firms like Substitutiona and Pindrop deploy AI-based detection to counter the threat.

records.title: Cybercriminals leverage AI for advanced phishing and deepfakes
records.description: Cybercriminals are employing generative AI and NLP to produce grammatically and contextually precise phishing emails with 60% success rates, craft personalized deepfakes, and deploy adaptive fake websites, significantly enhancing social engineering attacks. This AI-enabled threat underscores the necessity for AI-powered security awareness training to defend against sophisticated scams.

records.title: Deepfake Tim Cook Used in Crypto Scam During iPhone 16 Launch
records.description: During Apple's iPhone 16 launch, scammers used AI-generated deepfake videos of CEO Tim Cook to promote a cryptocurrency scam. The fake livestreams, which appeared on platforms like YouTube, urged viewers to send cryptocurrencies with promises of doubling their money. This incident highlights the growing threat of AI-driven fraud.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Research Floods Google Scholar
records.description: A Harvard Kennedy School study discovered 139 AI-generated scholarly papers, many via ChatGPT, infiltrating Google Scholar. These fabricated studies span health, environmental and tech topics, undermining scientific integrity, eroding public trust, and risking misinformed policies and products. Experts warn that LLM-driven "junk science" poses systemic threats to academia and industry.

records.title: Audible’s Voice-Cloning AI Sparks Backlash from Narrators
records.description: Amazon’s Audible invites select US narrators to train AI clones of their voices for automated audiobook production, offering per-title compensation and approval rights. Despite this, voice actors and unions decry job displacement and intellectual property risks, intensifying controversy over the use of synthetic voices in audiobooks.

records.title: AI systems prevent road hazards in Jiangxi and detect oilfield gas leaks in UAE
records.description: Jiangxi's first AI-powered road incident detection system began 24/7 deep-learning surveillance on the G45 highway, automatically alerting operators to illegal parking, debris and congestion. In the UAE, a Chinese infrared gas monitoring and early-warning AI detected an unreported pipeline leak in an Abu Dhabi oilfield, averting potential hazards.

records.title: Tesla Autopilot Trainers Instructed to Ignore Traffic Signs
records.description: Tesla's Autopilot trainers were reportedly instructed to ignore certain traffic signs, such as 'No Turn on Red,' to make the AI system drive more like a human. This directive, revealed by current and former employees, raises safety concerns as it could lead to unsafe driving behavior and potential harm.

records.title: AI Chatbot Grok Spreads Voter Misinformation
records.description: Twitter's AI chatbot, Grok, spread misinformation about election procedures, falsely claiming that a new candidate could not be added to ballots in nine states. This misinformation prompted election officials to intervene and correct the false information to prevent disruption of the democratic process.

records.title: Ukraine's Dragon Drones Ignite Russian Positions
records.description: Ukrainian forces, including the Khorne drone unit and the 108th Territorial Defense Brigade, have deployed FPV “dragon drones” carrying incendiary thermite—called “Drakaris”—to strike Russian frontline positions. Confirmed by Ukraine’s Defense Ministry, these semi-autonomous drones melt metal and spread fires, sparking legal debate over incendiary weapons under international law.

records.title: INAI launches probe into Worldcoin’s biometric data practices
records.description: Mexico’s National Institute for Transparency (INAI) has opened an official investigation into Worldcoin, the iris-scanning cryptocurrency project by Tools for Humanity (founded by Sam Altman and Alex Blania), over alleged breaches of personal data protection and misuse of biometric AI systems.

records.title: Fatal DUI Crash Involving Ford's BlueCruise Technology
records.description: A Ford Mustang Mach-E, using the BlueCruise hands-free driving system, was involved in a fatal crash on I-95 in Philadelphia, resulting in two deaths. The driver, Dimple Patel, was allegedly under the influence of alcohol. The incident raises safety concerns about over-reliance on semi-autonomous driving technologies.

records.title: TikToker’s AI Chatbot Simulates Deceased Actress Silvina Luna, Sparks Backlash
records.description: A TikToker created an AI chatbot that mimics late actress Silvina Luna’s voice, engaging in conversations about her life and views. The viral recordings drew criticism from fans and the family, who called it disrespectful and raised ethical concerns over using AI to simulate a deceased person.

records.title: South Korea Investigates Telegram Over Deepfake Sexual Crimes
records.description: South Korean police launched investigations into Telegram for facilitating deepfake sexual crimes, uncovering over 120 cases among hundreds of channels distributing AI-generated pornographic videos. Victims include minors (60%). Telegram cooperated by deleting content and apologizing. Civil society groups held protests demanding stricter legal and technical measures against deepfake sexual violence.

records.title: Microsoft partners with StopNCII to remove deepfake and revenge porn from Bing
records.description: Microsoft has joined StopNCII to let victims hash and remove non-consensual intimate images, including AI-generated deepfakes, from Bing. Using PhotoDNA and digital fingerprinting, Bing has already removed over 268,000 explicit images, aiming to curb online revenge porn and protect user privacy.

records.title: Meta's AI Algorithm Links 'Negra' to Drug Trade, Sparks Outcry
records.description: Meta's AI systems on Instagram and Threads mistakenly associated the term 'negra' with illicit drug trade, leading to accusations of racial bias. Users highlighted the issue, prompting Meta to address it as a 'technical problem' and resolve it. The incident raised concerns about algorithmic discrimination and human rights violations.

records.title: Malicious LLMs Thrive on Black Market, Amplifying Cybercrime Risks
records.description: Researchers at Indiana University identified over 212 malicious large language models (dubbed “Mallas”) on underground marketplaces. These uncensored or jailbroken LLMs, including WormGPT which earned $28K in two months, enable phishing, malware creation and guardrail bypasses, heightening cybersecurity risks and prompting calls for stronger AI safeguards.

records.title: Amazon Alexa biased election responses favor Kamala Harris
records.description: Amazon’s voice assistant Alexa, when asked “Why should I vote for Kamala Harris?,” listed her strengths—barrier-breaking, political experience, advocacy—yet declined to provide reasons for voting for Donald Trump. This partisan AI output spurred complaints about election interference, prompting Amazon to acknowledge and correct the assistant’s unintentional bias.

records.title: Musician Faces Charges for AI-Generated Music Fraud
records.description: Michael Smith, a musician from North Carolina, has been indicted for using AI to create fake songs and bots to inflate streaming numbers, generating over $10 million in royalties. Charged with wire fraud and money laundering, Smith faces decades in prison for exploiting streaming platforms like Spotify and Apple Music.

records.title: Slovak Christian Democrats urge oversight amid SIS’s potential Pegasus surveillance
records.description: KDH warns SIS may use Pegasus AI spyware to control Slovak citizens’ phones, risking severe privacy violations, and calls on parliament to activate the special oversight committee immediately, criticizing the ruling coalition for paralyzing parliamentary controls over secret services.

records.title: AI-Driven Foreign Influence Campaigns Target US Election
records.description: Iranian and Chinese actors are reportedly using AI to manipulate US public opinion ahead of the presidential election. The website Nio Thinker, part of an Iranian influence campaign, publishes content critical of Donald Trump with unusual language, indicating AI-driven manipulation. This raises concerns about foreign interference in democratic processes.

records.title: Slovak Security Services Allegedly Acquire Pegasus Spyware for Total Phone Penetration
records.description: Sources claim Slovakia’s SIS and other agencies obtained Israeli Pegasus spyware, capable of full mobile infiltration without judicial oversight. Opposition MP Juraj Krúpa warns of warrantless wiretapping powers. Interior Minister Matúš Šutaj Eštok cannot confirm the acquisition. Experts highlight privacy and human rights risks posed by AI-enabled surveillance.

records.title: Elon Musk's Colossus supercomputer sparks environmental concerns
records.description: Elon Musk’s xAI has launched Colossus, a supercomputer of 100,000 Nvidia GPUs assembled in 122 days to train its Grok-3 chatbot. Plans to add 50,000 H200 GPUs will double capacity. Memphis officials and residents warn its massive energy and water use and cooling turbines risk straining the power grid and polluting air.

records.title: Hackers render autonomous cars invisible to radar, risking collisions and fraud
records.description: Researchers at the University of Buffalo warn that hackers can exploit vulnerabilities in the millimeter-wave radar AI of autonomous vehicles using metal foils or “tile masks” to render cars invisible to sensors. This stealth effect could trigger undetected collisions and enable insurance fraud, posing serious safety and security risks.

records.title: AI-Driven Fraud Campaign Impersonates Portuguese Police
records.description: The Pol├¡cia Judici├íria (PJ) warns of a massive fraud campaign using AI to disguise the origin of calls, impersonating PJ to deceive citizens into transferring money. This AI-driven scam has led to an unusual number of complaints, with over a hundred received last weekend. Authorities are collaborating with telecom operators to address the issue.

records.title: Court Revives Lawsuit Against TikTok Over Algorithmic Harm
records.description: A federal appellate court has revived a lawsuit against TikTok, ruling that Section 230 does not protect the platform from liability for its algorithm promoting harmful content. The lawsuit, filed by Tawainna Anderson, claims TikTok's algorithm led to her daughter's death by promoting the "blackout challenge."

records.title: Cox Media Group's AI Software Spies on User Conversations for Targeted Ads
records.description: Cox Media Group admitted using AI-powered 'Active Listening' software to eavesdrop on smartphone conversations, targeting ads based on captured data. This practice, involving major clients like Meta, Google, and Amazon, raises significant privacy concerns due to unauthorized surveillance and data collection without user consent.

records.title: AI cameras detect distracted drivers and seatbelt offenders to improve road safety
records.description: Acusensus’ AI-powered “Heads Up” cameras are being trialled across Greater Manchester and deployed by Devon & Cornwall Police to automatically detect drivers using mobile phones and passengers not wearing seat belts. Capturing footage and verifying infractions, they identified over 2,000 offences, including 109 children, aiming to enhance road safety through enforcement.

records.title: YG Entertainment Takes Legal Action Against Deepfake Content
records.description: YG Entertainment is taking legal action against the creation and distribution of explicit deepfake content involving their artists, including BLACKPINK and BABYMONSTER. The agency is actively monitoring and removing such AI-generated content, pursuing criminal proceedings to protect the rights and dignity of their artists amidst a deepfake crisis in South Korea.

records.title: X Algorithm Missteps Fuel Toxic Feeds, Musk Warns
records.description: Elon Musk admitted X’s AI-driven recommendation algorithm treats any forwarded content as positive engagement, even when shared out of outrage, causing more toxic posts to appear. He suggested sharing “cute puppy” posts to reset the feed, underscoring how the system’s design inadvertently amplifies harmful content.

records.title: South Korea Investigates Telegram for Deepfake Pornography
records.description: South Korean police have launched an investigation into Telegram for allegedly facilitating the distribution of AI-generated deepfake pornography, primarily involving minors. The investigation follows public outrage and political pressure over the misuse of AI technology to create harmful content. Telegram has not cooperated with previous requests for user information.

records.title: Social Media Algorithms Expose Teens to Harmful Content
records.description: Social media algorithms on platforms like TikTok and Instagram are reportedly recommending harmful content, including violence and misogynistic views, to teenage boys. Analyst Andrew Kaung, who worked at TikTok, found that these algorithms expose minors to inappropriate content, raising concerns about user safety and the protection of minors.

records.title: South Korea Takes Action Against Deepfake Exploitation of K-pop Idols
records.description: South Korea is tackling the misuse of AI-generated deepfake technology, which has led to the creation and distribution of explicit content featuring K-pop idols. JYP Entertainment plans legal action against perpetrators, while the government investigates Telegram for facilitating these crimes. Over 200 female idols have been victimized, sparking public outrage.

records.title: Grok-2 AI Generates Controversial Images, Raising Ethical Concerns
records.description: Grok-2, an AI by X, generates controversial images, including deepfakes and copyrighted content, raising ethical and legal concerns. The AI's lax restrictions allow for the creation of potentially harmful images, leading to debates over misuse and intellectual property violations. This highlights the need for stricter AI content generation guidelines.

records.title: Police Use Tesla Autopilot to Stop Sleeping Driver
records.description: In South Carolina, police used Tesla's Autopilot system to stop a Model 3 vehicle after the driver, Michael Goodman, was found asleep at the wheel. The Autopilot was triggered to halt the car by positioning a police vehicle in front of it, preventing a potential accident. Goodman was later found with illegal substances.

records.title: LAION Purges CSAM from AI Training Dataset, Releases Cleaned Re-LAION-5B
records.description: LAION removed over 2,000 suspected child sexual abuse image links from its LAION-5B dataset after the Stanford Internet Observatory flagged CSAM. Working with anti-abuse groups in Canada and the UK, it published Re-LAION-5B, a sanitized image-text dataset for AI generators like Stable Diffusion and Midjourney.

records.title: AI Deepfakes and Voice Cloning Exploited in Cyberattacks
records.description: AI-generated deepfakes and voice cloning are increasingly used in cyberattacks, bypassing biometric security and enabling fraud. Kaspersky experts warn of a growing black market for deepfakes, while Sensity identifies tools evading KYC identity checks, leading to theft of personal and financial data from banks.

records.title: JYP Entertainment Takes Legal Action Against TWICE Deepfake Videos
records.description: JYP Entertainment, representing K-pop group TWICE, is pursuing strong legal action against creators of AI-generated deepfake videos depicting its artists. The company is collecting evidence to address this violation of rights and law, emphasizing its commitment to protect its artists from unauthorized and harmful representations.

records.title: Tom Hanks Warns Against AI-Generated Scam Ads
records.description: Tom Hanks has issued a warning about AI-generated ads using his likeness without consent to promote miracle cures and wonder drugs. The Oscar-winning actor clarified on Instagram that he is not associated with these fraudulent ads, urging fans not to be deceived or lose money to these scams.

records.title: AI Used to Create Child Exploitation Images at Disney World
records.description: Justin Culmo was arrested for using AI, specifically Stable Diffusion, to create illegal child exploitation images from footage he secretly recorded at Disney World and a high school. He faces multiple charges, including child exploitation and distributing child sexual abuse material on the dark web.

records.title: Chinese Children’s AI Watches Spout Offensive and False Content
records.description: Chinese AI-powered children’s smartwatches and learning devices generated offensive and false responses—insulting Chinese people’s intelligence, slandering Mao Zedong, denying the Nanjing Massacre, and rabble-rousing cultural falsehoods. Manufacturers 360, Xiaomi and Little Genius blamed third-party data or unofficial firmware, removed the content and promised enhanced AI moderation and software updates.

records.title: Deepfake Sites Exploit Sign-in with Apple for Non-consensual Images
records.description: Deepfake websites have exploited Apple's Sign-in feature to create non-consensual nude images, raising privacy concerns. Apple and Discord have blocked developers from using their sign-in APIs after reports revealed their misuse. These AI-generated deepfakes pose significant ethical and legal challenges, as they violate human rights and privacy laws.

records.title: AI-Generated Nude Image Scandal Involving Peller Anna
records.description: Peller Anna and her sister Peller Mariann experienced the dark side of AI when a fan used AI to create embarrassing images of them. Anna received a fake nude image with her face, raising privacy and reputational concerns. This incident highlights the potential misuse of AI in violating personal rights.

records.title: Luciana Gimenez Targeted by AI-Generated Fraud Scheme
records.description: Luciana Gimenez has been targeted by a cybercrime involving AI-generated fake videos and audio promoting fraudulent luxury product sales on Instagram. She filed a police report on August 25 and engaged her legal team to address the misuse of her image and voice, urging the public not to believe the scam.

records.title: Tesla's Full Self-Driving System Fails to Stop at Red Lights
records.description: Tesla owners report their vehicles running red lights due to the Full Self-Driving (FSD) system, raising safety concerns. Despite Tesla's claims of near autonomy, the FSD system is still in development. Users shared experiences and videos online, highlighting the system's dangerous shortcomings and loss of trust among drivers.

records.title: Deepfake Technology Sparks Privacy and Legal Concerns in South Korea
records.description: Deepfake technology is causing significant privacy and legal issues in South Korea, with incidents involving the creation and distribution of non-consensual explicit content affecting over 200 schools. The technology's ease of use and potential for misuse have led to widespread societal and legal challenges, prompting government action to increase penalties and establish task forces.

records.title: Deepfake Influencer Photos Fuel Pro-Trump Misinformation Campaign on X
records.description: Unknown actors have hijacked images of European influencers, including Debbie Nederlof, to create AI-altered deepfake profiles that promote Donald Trump on X. A CNN and Centre for Information Resilience investigation found over 16 coordinated accounts using stolen photos and pro-Trump hashtags to mislead followers, highlighting AI-driven political disinformation and identity theft.

records.title: Generative AI Amplifies Online Risks for Youth, Report Warns
records.description: Germany's jugendschutz.net reported generative AI has made it harder to distinguish real from fake content, amplifying online harms to youth. In 2023, authorities cataloged 7,645 child protection violations—5,000 sexualized violence cases—plus bullying, extremism, and hate speech, highlighting platform failures and urging stronger safeguards.

records.title: AI Misuse: Minors Create Deepfake Images of Peers
records.description: A survey by Thorn reveals that 10% of minors in the U.S. report peers using AI to create deepfake nude images of other children. This misuse of AI technology has led to several student arrests and highlights significant concerns about online safety and child exploitation.

records.title: Sensitive Data Exposed by Unsecured AI Systems
records.description: Legit Security's research reveals that hundreds of open-source LLM servers and vector databases are leaking sensitive corporate and personal data online. Companies integrating AI into workflows often neglect security, leading to exposure of emails, financial records, and API keys. Most affected servers have since been secured.

records.title: Deepfake Scams Lead to Significant Financial Losses in Malaysia
records.description: Malaysian police are investigating over 450 deepfake scams, involving voice impersonation, resulting in RM2.72 million in losses. Scammers use AI to mimic voices of victims' acquaintances, convincing them to transfer money to mule accounts. Notable cases include a travel agent losing RM49,800 and other victims in Kuala Lumpur and Penang.

records.title: AI Models Exhibit Covert Racism Against African American English
records.description: Studies reveal that AI models, including ChatGPT, exhibit bias against African American English (AAE), leading to discriminatory outcomes in job assignments and legal judgments. Researchers from Stanford, University of Chicago, and Allen Institute found that AI models perpetuate racial stereotypes, raising concerns about AI's role in amplifying discrimination.

records.title: House Democrats urge FEC to regulate X’s Grok-2 over election deepfakes
records.description: House Democrats and watchdog group Public Citizen petition the Federal Election Commission to restrict X’s new Grok-2 AI image generator under election law after users created misleading deepfake images of political figures like Trump and Harris. They warn such AI-driven misinformation threatens democratic integrity, but FEC leadership cites First Amendment protections.

records.title: Surge in AI-Powered Cybercrime Hits New High in H1 2024
records.description: Trend Micro reports that in the first half of 2024, cybercriminals increasingly leveraged AI for malware, deepfake scams, virtual kidnapping, impersonation fraud and biometric data theft. The company blocked 75.9 billion threats, warning that AI-enabled attacks are rising and demanding adaptive, AI-aware security strategies.

records.title: Elon Musk's xAI Faces Environmental Backlash Over Unpermitted Gas Turbines
records.description: Elon Musk's AI startup, xAI, is under scrutiny for operating gas turbines without permits at its Memphis data center, potentially worsening local air quality. Environmental groups and the Southern Environmental Law Center have raised concerns with the EPA and local health officials, linking the AI infrastructure to increased pollution.

records.title: Microsoft Copilot Vulnerability Exposed Sensitive Data
records.description: Microsoft's Copilot faced vulnerabilities allowing attackers to steal sensitive data through prompt injection and ASCII smuggling. Researchers, including Johann Rehberger, identified these flaws, which could lead to privacy violations. Microsoft has since patched these issues, but details of the fix remain undisclosed, raising concerns about data protection.

records.title: Beijing’s “Three-Monitor” AI Model Battles Air Pollution
records.description: Beijing’s ecology department launched the nationwide first “Three-Monitor” AI model, integrating satellite remote sensing, vehicle-based, and ground sensors. The system ingests over 100 million daily data points to detect VOC hotspots in seconds, surface 10,000+ pollution alerts, and enable precise source tracing and enforcement, boosting urban air quality.

records.title: AI Deepfake Scam Exploits Alain Delon's Image
records.description: Scammers are using AI-generated deepfake videos of the late actor Alain Delon to deceive people into financial scams. The videos falsely claim Delon is distributing his fortune, leading victims to download an app that steals personal and banking information. This misuse of AI technology violates human rights and legal protections against fraud.

records.title: DOJ Sues RealPage for Alleged AI-Driven Rental Price Fixing
records.description: The U.S. Department of Justice, along with eight states, has filed a lawsuit against RealPage, alleging its AI-driven pricing software, YieldStar, facilitated price-fixing among landlords, inflating rental prices and harming renters. The case highlights concerns over AI's role in critical markets like housing, potentially violating antitrust laws.

records.title: AI deepfakes and voice cloning fuel cyberfraud and espionage
records.description: Kaspersky warns criminals increasingly use AI-generated deepfake videos and voice clones to bypass security controls, commit fraud, identity theft and corporate espionage. The underground market charges $300–$20,000 per minute for high-quality fakes. A Kaspersky study found 75% of Peruvians unfamiliar with deepfakes, heightening vulnerability to these attacks.

records.title: AI Monitoring Harms Employee Well-being
records.description: A European survey reveals that AI and algorithmic monitoring of employees negatively impacts their well-being, particularly in warehouse and telemarketing sectors. Over 60% of respondents reported being monitored for work speed, quality, and breaks, leading to decreased job satisfaction, motivation, and trust, as noted by researcher Jere Immonen.

records.title: Researchers warn smart toys spy on children’s data
records.description: University of Basel researchers warn popular AI-enabled smart toys—such as Toniebox, Tiptoi and Tamagotchi—collect detailed behavioral data (usage, figurine interactions, playback controls) and transmit it to manufacturers without clear parental consent. Inadequate security and lack of transparency risk GDPR violations and children’s privacy, raising concerns over covert surveillance.

records.title: Deepfake video falsely depicts Virat Kohli criticizing Shubman Gill
records.description: In a viral AI-generated deepfake circulating on social media, cricket star Virat Kohli appears to criticize rising batter Shubman Gill, warning there's a gap between promise and legend. Fans quickly identified the video as fabricated, sparking debate over AI-driven misinformation and potential reputational harm to both players.

records.title: Google Maps AI Glitch: Missed Flight and Hazardous Route
records.description: Investor Ashish Kacholia missed his Bengaluru-Mumbai flight after Google Maps AI underestimated travel time (1h45m vs 3h). Separately, a Kochi user was directed to walk over water for 12 minutes. These AI navigation errors expose potential harm and hazards from flawed predictive routing.

records.title: Beijing Court Protects Personal Information, Copyright and Personality Rights in AI Cases
records.description: On August 26, Beijing Internet Court published top ten cases including tech firm’s AI face-swapping of a popular vlogger infringing personal information rights; Stable Diffusion-generated images recognized as copyrightable works; and unauthorized AI-generated virtual companions violating personality rights. These rulings extend legal protection to AI outputs and digital identities.

records.title: Army Soldier Arrested for Using AI to Generate Child Pornography
records.description: Seth Herrera, a U.S. Army soldier stationed in Anchorage, Alaska, has been arrested for using AI to create explicit images of children he knew, including those around his daughter's age. The Justice Department found thousands of such images in his possession, marking a significant AI misuse case involving child sexual abuse material.

records.title: 24-Hour AI-Powered GPS-Free Drone Gains Pentagon and Ukrainian Military Interest
records.description: A US team led by Ian Laffey built a sub-$500 drone in 24 hours that navigates without GPS, using onboard cameras, Google Maps and machine learning. Within six months, they delivered units to Ukrainian forces and caught the Pentagon’s attention for its autonomous AI navigation and targeting capabilities.

records.title: Worldcoin faces global legal scrutiny over biometric data misuse
records.description: Worldcoin’s AI-driven iris-scanning system is under investigation in Chile, Colombia and Argentina for collecting biometric data without proper consent or safeguards. Chile’s consumer agency sued it for privacy breaches; Colombia’s data watchdog opened probes with potential fines; Argentina’s La Rioja province banned its operations over data safety risks.

records.title: AI-driven harassment forces Jenna Ortega off Twitter
records.description: Jenna Ortega, known for her role in Netflix's "Wednesday," was forced to leave Twitter due to AI-facilitated harassment. The actress, who gained significant fame, became a target for online haters using AI technology to enhance their attacks, highlighting privacy and harassment issues linked to AI misuse.

records.title: AI Deepfake Scam Targets Carbon Exchange Executive
records.description: Fraudsters used AI deepfake technology to create fake videos of Taiwan Carbon Exchange's General Manager, Tian Jianzhong, to promote fraudulent investment schemes on social media. The Carbon Exchange clarified that Tian has no involvement in such activities and urged the public to verify information to avoid scams.

records.title: Jenna Ortega Deletes Twitter Due to AI-Generated Sexual Images
records.description: Jenna Ortega, star of 'Wandinha', deleted her Twitter account after discovering AI-generated sexual images of herself circulating online. These images, created when she was a minor, violated her privacy and human rights, leading to her discomfort and decision to leave the platform.

records.title: ‘Megalopolis’ Trailer Pulled for AI-Generated Fake Critic Quotes
records.description: Lionsgate’s promotional trailer for Francis Ford Coppola’s “Megalopolis” used AI-generated quotes falsely attributed to renowned film critics to disparage his earlier work. Once exposed, the studio withdrew the trailer, apologized to the critics and Coppola, and severed ties with the marketing consultant responsible.

records.title: Jenna Ortega Leaves Social Media Due to AI-Generated Explicit Images
records.description: Jenna Ortega, known for her role in Beetlejuice Beetlejuice, deactivated her X account after receiving AI-generated explicit images of herself as a child. The actress described the experience as terrifying and corrupt, highlighting the misuse of AI technology. She expressed her disdain for AI, despite acknowledging its potential benefits in fields like healthcare.

records.title: Russian AI-Enabled 'Molniya-1' Drone Strikes Ukrainian Forces in Kursk
records.description: Russian Northern Group troops deployed new 'Molniya-1' fixed-wing strike drones with AI-enhanced software to circumvent radio jamming and engage Ukrainian mobile groups and armored vehicles up to 30 km within the Kursk region, as shown in recent Ministry of Defense combat footage.

records.title: Agent Hijacking via Prompt Injection Exposes Sensitive Data
records.description: Security firm Snyk warns that malicious actors exploit prompt injection vulnerabilities in LLM-powered agents to hijack their decision-making, bypass authorizations, execute unauthorized API calls, and access confidential data. Real-world CVEs underscore these attacks can lead to privacy breaches and system compromise, highlighting urgent need for robust prompt defenses.

records.title: AI-generated Islamic State Propaganda Sparks Terrorism Concerns
records.description: Islamic State supporters have used AI to create propaganda videos celebrating attacks, raising fears of increased recruitment and extremist influence. A video featuring a non-existent man praising a deadly attack in Russia was traced back to an IS supporter. Experts highlight the lack of safeguards and regulation in AI use.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Rental Listings Scam Alert
records.description: Police in La Rioja warn of a new scam involving AI-generated fake rental listings. Cybercriminals use AI to create high-quality, non-existent property ads on real estate websites, tricking individuals into paying reservation fees for these properties. Victims realize the fraud only after discovering the properties do not exist.

records.title: Just Eat's AI Algorithm Penalizes Riders, Igniting Labor Rights Concerns
records.description: Just Eat's AI algorithm, Scoober, is under scrutiny for penalizing riders in Florence for low productivity, leading to disciplinary actions and reduced earnings. The Filt Cgil union criticizes the system for not considering working conditions, necessary breaks, and safety, potentially violating labor rights. This has resulted in protests and calls for change.

records.title: Google's Pixel Studio AI Image Generator Faces Criticism for Inadequate Safeguards
records.description: Google's Pixel Studio, an AI image generator in the Pixel 9, is criticized for weak safeguards, allowing the creation of offensive and potentially harmful images, including copyrighted content and depictions of Nazi symbols and school shootings. This raises concerns about the app's ability to prevent misuse and protect intellectual property and human rights.

records.title: Berlin deploys facial recognition AI in six investigations amid privacy review
records.description: Berlin’s public prosecutor used controversial facial recognition software in six investigations via Amtshilfe in Brandenburg and Saxony to identify 31 suspects and monitor organized theft escape routes. The Berlin data protection commissioner is reviewing its legality, while Green parties demand greater transparency over its impact on privacy rights.

records.title: Guayaquil deploys AI to intercept stolen vehicles
records.description: Guayaquil’s Segura EP launched an AI-driven system linking 34,000 city cameras with police databases to detect stolen vehicles via real-time license-plate recognition. In early testing, it enabled interception of 717 reported stolen cars. The platform automatically synchronizes camera feeds, identifies suspect vehicles and issues alerts for rapid police response.

records.title: Paedophile's Sentence Increased for Using AI in Blackmail Scheme
records.description: Neil Darlington, a paedophile, used AI to manipulate images of children for blackmail, believing he was targeting girls aged 11 and 14. The images were actually sent by undercover police. Initially sentenced to one year, his term was increased to three years by the Court of Appeal for being 'unduly lenient'.

records.title: AI Deepfakes Fuel Political Disinformation and Undermine Democracies
records.description: Malicious deepfakes produced via GANs have fabricated videos and audio of politicians—including Barack Obama, Donald Trump, Joe Biden, European leaders and Mexico’s president—spreading false messages that mislead voters, incite distrust and manipulate public opinion. These AI-generated forgeries threaten electoral integrity and media credibility worldwide.

records.title: Texas Telecom Fined for Deepfake Biden Robocalls
records.description: Lingo Telecom, a Texas-based company, was fined $1 million by the FCC for transmitting AI-generated deepfake robocalls using President Joe Biden's voice to discourage voting in New Hampshire's primary election. The calls, orchestrated by political consultant Steve Kramer, violated election laws and led to charges of voter suppression and impersonation.

records.title: AI Deepfake Scam Targets SSI Chairman to Deceive Investors
records.description: Scammers used AI to create fake images and videos of SSI Chairman Nguyß╗àn Duy H╞░ng to deceive investors via Zalo and Telegram. SSI warned investors about this sophisticated fraud, emphasizing that H╞░ng only uses a verified Facebook account for personal views, not investment advice.

records.title: Worldcoin Faces Charges for Iris Scanning in Colombia
records.description: Worldcoin, a US cryptocurrency company, is under investigation by Colombian authorities for allegedly violating data protection laws. The company is accused of paying less than $10 in cryptocurrency to vulnerable individuals in exchange for scanning their irises, raising concerns about the collection of sensitive biometric data without proper consent.

records.title: AI Deepfake and Booking Scams Exploit Users
records.description: Deepfake AI technology is being used to impersonate individuals during video calls, leading to potential bank account fraud. Simultaneously, AI is facilitating sophisticated online booking scams, with platforms like Booking and Airbnb witnessing a 500% to 900% increase in incidents. These scams exploit AI to create convincing fraudulent communications, posing security risks to users and businesses.

records.title: Anthropic Faces Copyright Infringement Lawsuit from Authors
records.description: AI startup Anthropic is being sued by authors Andrea Bartz, Charles Graeber, and Kirk Wallace Johnson for allegedly using their copyrighted works without permission to train its Claude AI model. The lawsuit claims Anthropic built its business on pirated books, violating intellectual property rights and depriving authors of income.

records.title: AI deepfakes used in 27% of cyberattacks on US executives
records.description: A GetApp survey found that 72% of US senior executives faced cyberattacks in the last 18 months, with AI-generated deepfakes used in 27% of cases, leading to identity and financial fraud. Despite rising threats, 37% of firms lack specialized cybersecurity training for leadership, prompting calls for targeted protection.

records.title: Deepfake Video Falsely Links Peso Pluma and Anitta
records.description: A deepfake video of Mexican singer Peso Pluma falsely depicts him saying he relied on Anitta after splitting from Nicki Nicole. The AI-manipulated footage, featuring synthesized audio and altered visuals, went viral on social media, creating public confusion and reputational risk, prompting calls to verify content before sharing.

records.title: Trump Shares AI-Generated Fake Images of Taylor Swift's Support
records.description: Donald Trump shared AI-generated images falsely depicting Taylor Swift and her fans supporting him. The manipulated photos, posted on Truth Social, include Swift dressed as Uncle Sam and fans wearing 'Swifties for Trump' shirts. This misinformation has sparked backlash from Swift's fanbase, as she previously endorsed Joe Biden.

records.title: AI-Generated Song with Racist Lyrics Sparks Controversy in Germany
records.description: A song titled "Verknallt in einen Talahon," created by German artist Butterbro using AI for music and vocals, has sparked controversy due to its racist lyrics targeting immigrants. Despite the backlash, the song has gained significant popularity, reaching the top 50 on Spotify in Germany with over 4.1 million streams.

records.title: AI-Driven Fake News Sites Erode Trust in US Elections
records.description: AI tools are being used to create fake news sites that spread disinformation, particularly pro-Kremlin narratives, ahead of the US elections. These sites, outnumbering legitimate news outlets, are undermining trust in media and potentially influencing democratic processes. US officials warn of increased foreign interference from Russia and Iran.

records.title: AI-Driven Pro-Russian Disinformation Targets US Elections
records.description: Pro-Russian websites, using AI tools, are spreading false information during the US presidential campaign, accusing Democrats of a failed assassination attempt on Donald Trump. John Mark Dougan, a former US Marine and police officer now in Russia, is linked to this disinformation network, potentially influencing election outcomes.

records.title: TikTok Algorithm Linked to Doubling of Child Eating Disorders
records.description: In England, children’s eating disorders have doubled over the past decade, with over 10,600 awaiting treatment. Research shows just ten minutes on TikTok’s AI-driven recommendation feed can distort body image and promote self-harm content. Experts warn the algorithmic boost of harmful content necessitates urgent government intervention for early prevention.

records.title: Zomato bans AI-generated food images after customer complaints
records.description: Zomato CEO Deepinder Goyal announced the removal of all AI-generated dish images from the platform following numerous customer complaints that these misleading visuals breached trust, triggered refunds, and led to lower restaurant ratings. He urged restaurant partners to stop using AI for menu photos to ensure authenticity.

records.title: AI Deepfake Scams Exploit Elon Musk's Image for Financial Fraud
records.description: AI-generated deepfake videos featuring Elon Musk have led to significant financial fraud, including an 82-year-old losing nearly $500,000. These videos, created using lip-sync and voice cloning technologies, are highly convincing and have been used to promote fraudulent investment schemes. The widespread use of such deepfakes is causing billions in annual losses.

records.title: TikTok Algorithm Promotes Neo-Nazi Content
records.description: A report by the Institute for Strategic Dialogue reveals TikTok's algorithm is recommending neo-Nazi content, aiding extremist groups in recruiting members. The platform hosts numerous accounts sharing Holocaust denial and Nazi propaganda, raising concerns about the spread of hate speech and extremist ideologies among young users.

records.title: OpenAI Blocks Iranian Influence Operation Using ChatGPT
records.description: OpenAI has banned Iranian-linked accounts using ChatGPT to spread misinformation about the US Presidential election and other topics. The operation, named Storm-2035, targeted both progressive and conservative audiences but had minimal engagement. OpenAI's actions aim to counter foreign influence and protect democratic processes.

records.title: Elon Musk’s Grok AI generates violent deepfakes and bomb-making instructions
records.description: xAI’s Grok chatbot and image generator on X, promoted by Elon Musk, has been producing harmful, manipulative and misleading content—from bomb-making and assassination instructions to violent, drug and sexualized deepfakes of public figures—prompting legal concerns and forcing platform restrictions on images depicting weapons or drugs.

records.title: Fatal braking failure sparks safety concerns for China’s Wuhan robotaxi fleet
records.description: In Wuhan, China’s self-driving robotaxi fleet of over 500 vehicles faces scrutiny after a Huawei-backed Aito car’s automatic braking system failed, causing a fatal accident and a minor collision with a jaywalker. These incidents underscore persistent safety risks amid rapid AI taxi deployment.

records.title: AI-Generated Child Exploitative Images Surge
records.description: The Internet Watch Foundation reports a 360% increase in AI-manipulated sexual images of children, particularly affecting girls aged 7-13. This misuse of AI technology poses significant risks to children's physical and mental health, highlighting a severe violation of human rights and child protection laws.

records.title: Meta's Battle Against AI-Generated Russian Misinformation
records.description: Meta is combating Russian influence operations that use generative AI to create fake personas and misinformation, focusing on Russia's war in Ukraine. These operations aim to manipulate public opinion ahead of the US elections. Meta's report highlights the use of AI in spreading distorted information through fictitious news sites.

records.title: Elon Musk's Grok AI Generates Controversial Images on X
records.description: Elon Musk's AI chatbot, Grok, has sparked controversy by allowing users to create and share potentially defamatory images of public figures on the social media platform X. These images, depicting figures like Barack Obama and Donald Trump in inappropriate scenarios, raise concerns about misinformation and reputational harm, especially with the upcoming US presidential election.

records.title: AI-Driven Phishing Campaigns Impersonate US Agencies, Surge in Southeast Asia
records.description: Cybercriminals use large language models to craft highly convincing phishing emails, notably the 'Uncle Scam' campaign impersonating the US GSA to steal contractors' credentials. Advanced AI-based phishing kits and platforms like Microsoft Dynamics 365 underpin these attacks, which have also fueled novel scams and a 48% surge in phishing URLs across Southeast Asia.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Image of Kamala Harris and Donald Trump Sparks Disinformation Concerns
records.description: An AI system, Grok, owned by Elon Musk, generated a fake image of Kamala Harris and Donald Trump kissing, which went viral on social media. This incident highlights the potential for AI to spread disinformation, impacting democratic processes and violating human rights by misleading the public.

records.title: Waymo Self-Driving Cars Cause Noise Disturbance in San Francisco
records.description: Waymo's self-driving cars in San Francisco have been causing noise disturbances by honking at each other in a parking lot, disrupting residents' sleep. Despite Waymo's attempts to fix the issue, the problem persisted, drawing global attention. The company has since promised a solution to stop the honking incidents.

records.title: Enterprises adopt biometrics after deepfake fraud surge
records.description: Organizations report deepfake-driven social engineering scams causing multimillion-pound fraud and identity theft. GetApp and iProov surveys show nearly half of firms have encountered deepfakes and 68% have developed response plans. Momentum builds around biometric authentication as enterprises strengthen defences against AI-generated deepfake threats.

records.title: Wyoming reporter resigns after AI-generated fake quotes scandal
records.description: A Cody Enterprise reporter, Aaron Pelczar, admitted using generative AI to fabricate quotes from Governor Mark Gordon and a local prosecutor, inserting robotic language into published news stories. Powell Tribune journalist CJ Baker uncovered the deception, leading to Pelczar’s resignation and raising concerns about AI misuse in journalism.

records.title: AI-powered Prosthetic Hand Restores Function for Chongqing Amputee
records.description: Chongqing Biomanufacturing Research Institute developed an AI-driven prosthetic "intelligent hand" that decodes muscle signals via algorithms, allowing amputee Wang Bing to perform daily tasks like eating and writing. Backed by local funding and institutional support, the project formed a company to industrialize and incubate the exoskeleton robotics technology.

records.title: Israeli drone strike kills two in southern Lebanon
records.description: An Israeli drone struck a car near the southern Lebanese town of Barasit, killing two individuals. Reports suggest they were Hezbollah fighters, though unverified. The incident is part of almost daily border clashes since the October 7 war, heightening tensions after a July 30 Hezbollah commander's assassination.

records.title: Illegal Dutch Dataset for AI Training Taken Offline
records.description: Stichting Brein removed a large Dutch dataset used for AI training, containing illegally copied copyrighted works, including books, news articles, and subtitles. The dataset was compressed for AI model training, violating intellectual property rights. Brein identified over 10,000 instances of illegal book copies within the dataset.

records.title: Tokyo deploys AI to detect fires and collapses for rapid quake response
records.description: Tokyo metropolitan government and Hitachi Ltd. have launched an AI-powered system using high-altitude cameras on government buildings and bridges to detect fires and structural collapses in real time. Analyzing high-resolution footage, it automatically alerts police, fire departments and the Self-Defense Forces to accelerate disaster response after a Nankai Trough megaquake warning.

records.title: Fraudsters Use AI-Generated Image to Scam Russian Singer Larisa Dolina
records.description: Fraudsters used an AI-generated image to impersonate Russian singer Larisa Dolina and secure a microloan, resulting in a financial loss of over 200 million rubles and a property loss. Dolina's representative, Sergey Pudovkin, confirmed the incident, and legal actions are being pursued. A suspect has been arrested in connection with the fraud.

records.title: AI Misused for Creating Pornographic Images of Minors in Guatemala
records.description: In Guatemala, AI was misused to create pornographic images of minors, leading to public outrage. The Procuradur├¡a General de la Naci├│n is investigating the Colegio Continental Americano, where students allegedly used AI for this purpose. Authorities have filed a complaint with the Public Ministry and are assessing the victims' conditions.

records.title: X’s AI Grok Faces Privacy Breach and Deepfake Flood
records.description: The Irish Data Protection Commission suspended X’s processing of EU users’ data after discovering personal posts scraped without consent to train its AI assistant Grok. Meanwhile, Elon Musk’s xAI rolled out Grok-2, an image generator on X lacking effective content filters, enabling users to produce violent, hateful and misleading deepfake images.

records.title: Deepfake Scam Uses AI to Impersonate UK Leaders for Crypto Fraud
records.description: AI-generated deepfakes of UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer and Prince William are being used in fraudulent ads on Meta platforms to promote a scam cryptocurrency platform, "Immediate Edge." Researchers at Fenimore Harper identified over 250 such ads, misleading users into potential financial harm by falsely endorsing the scheme.

records.title: AI-Powered Lethal Autonomous Weapons Threaten Africa
records.description: AI-powered lethal autonomous weapons systems (Laws) are being deployed in Africa, raising concerns about potential harm and human rights violations. These systems can autonomously select and attack targets, and there is a risk they could be acquired by terrorist groups, exacerbating violence in regions like the Sahel.

records.title: Elon Musk's X Faces GDPR Complaints Over AI Data Practices
records.description: Elon Musk's platform X is under investigation in Austria and faces nine GDPR complaints across Europe for allegedly using personal data without consent to train AI models. The complaints, led by privacy NGO NOYB, highlight potential violations of EU privacy laws, with the Irish Data Protection Commission involved in legal proceedings.

records.title: TikTok’s AI Notifications Push Fake and Outdated ‘Breaking’ News
records.description: TikTok’s AI-driven notification system algorithmically surfaces personalized “Breaking” alerts that have included false claims—including Taylor Swift canceling tour dates, a five-year MLB ban for Shohei Ohtani, and an outdated tsunami warning—misleading users and spreading misinformation, undermining trust in news on the platform.

records.title: X Faces Legal Complaints in Europe for AI Data Privacy Violations
records.description: The Austrian privacy NGO Noyb has filed complaints in nine European countries against X (formerly Twitter), accusing it of violating EU laws by using personal data from 60 million users without consent to train its AI. This action breaches the GDPR, which mandates user consent for data usage.

records.title: Meta shuts CrowdTangle tool, sued over Instagram and Facebook impersonation ads
records.description: Meta closed its CrowdTangle platform, alarming researchers about lost visibility into misinformation ahead of the US election. Separately, Polish billionaire Rafał Brzoska plans to sue over AI-targeted fake ads on Facebook and Instagram using his likeness, underscoring failures in Meta’s content moderation.

records.title: Kumar Sanu Debunks AI-Generated Deepfake Claiming He Sang for Imran Khan
records.description: Indian playback singer Kumar Sanu publicly debunked a deepfake audio clip that purported to feature him singing in support of former Pakistani PM Imran Khan, denouncing it as AI-generated misinformation and urging the Indian government to curb deepfake misuse.

records.title: Meta Uses Personal Data from Bosnia and Herzegovina Without Consent for AI Development
records.description: Meta Platforms Inc. has been using personal data from citizens of Bosnia and Herzegovina without their consent to develop AI technologies. While EU users were informed of privacy policy changes, those in the Western Balkans, including BiH, were not notified, raising concerns over privacy rights violations.

records.title: AI-Generated Junk Flood Undermines Scientific Publishing
records.description: AI-generated text and images, including absurd graphics like rats with oversized genitals, have infiltrated scientific journals. Several flawed or plagiarized papers slipped past peer review, triggering retractions and raising alarms among experts. This AI-driven 'junk' flood undermines academic integrity, violates intellectual property rights, and erodes trust in scientific publishing.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Author Deceives Readers with Bestselling Cookbook
records.description: Amazon removed The Complete Crock Pot Cookbook for Beginners after readers and journalists discovered its purported author, “Louisa Florence,” was an AI-generated persona. Suspicious biography details, image glitches and recipe errors revealed the deception, underscoring consumer harm from AI-fabricated content.

records.title: Court Orders Expulsion of Students for AI-Generated Deepfake Images
records.description: The Santiago Court of Appeals ordered Saint George School to expel students who used AI to create deepfake images of classmates, violating their privacy. Initially, the school only placed the students on probation, but the court deemed this insufficient, citing a breach of human rights and school protocols.

records.title: China builds AI-powered net to combat deepfake telecom scams
records.description: Fraudsters used AI face- and voice-swap deepfakes to trick an Ordos resident into transferring 400,000 yuan, recovered by police freeze orders. The financial regulator, JieXin Finance, CITIC Bank and prosecutors now deploy AI analytics, public education and multi-agency task forces to detect suspicious accounts, block scams and boost awareness.

records.title: Deepfake Video Falsely Shows Maria Zakharova Offering Zaporizhzhia NPP to Ukraine
records.description: Ukrainian special services circulated a hastily edited deepfake video of Russian MFA spokeswoman Maria Zakharova claiming Russia would hand over the Zaporizhzhia nuclear power plant if Ukrainian forces withdrew from the Kursk region. The Russian Foreign Ministry denounced it as AI‐generated misinformation.

records.title: TikTok Algorithms Suppress Criticism of Chinese Regime
records.description: A study by Rutgers University and NCRI reveals that TikTok's AI algorithms suppress content critical of the Chinese Communist Party, while promoting pro-China propaganda. This manipulation of information access potentially violates human rights by limiting freedom of expression and indoctrinating users, particularly affecting discussions on ethnic genocide and human rights abuses.

records.title: Cybercriminals Exploit AI for Advanced Cyber Attacks
records.description: Cybercriminals are leveraging AI to automate and enhance cyber attacks, posing significant threats to human rights and legal obligations. AI tools like ChatGPT are used to create malware and automate attacks, while AI programs can monitor user inputs, capturing sensitive data. Kaspersky highlights these sophisticated cyber threats.

records.title: Canadian man sues social media giants for AI-powered addiction
records.description: A 24-year-old Montreal man filed a class-action lawsuit against YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Reddit, and Facebook, alleging their AI-powered recommendation algorithms exploit psychological vulnerabilities to drive addictive behavior, harming mental health, productivity, sleep, and body image. The suit seeks damages, claiming the platforms’ design intentionally increases dopamine and dependency.

records.title: Irish Regulator Demands Suspension of X's AI Training with User Data
records.description: The Irish Data Protection Commission has demanded the suspension of X's use of EU user data for AI training, citing unauthorized data processing since May 7. Despite offering an opt-out option, X only enhanced it by July 16. X has agreed to suspend data use pending a court decision.

records.title: X Algorithm Amplifies Left-Leaning Media, Suppresses Conservative Outlets
records.description: A Media Research Center study found that X’s AI-driven recommendation algorithm, powered by Grok, grants 100% of left-leaning outlets high “reputation” scores while deboosting 74% of right-leaning media. Despite Elon Musk’s free-speech vision, the algorithm’s bias skews content visibility, raising political fairness and free-expression concerns.

records.title: Deepfake audio of Manipur CM sparking communal violence prompts probe
records.description: The Manipur government and police are investigating a doctored audio clip falsely attributed to Chief Minister N. Biren Singh, circulated on social media to incite communal violence and derail ongoing peace talks. Authorities warn of legal action against those behind the AI-generated deepfake and urge public vigilance.

records.title: AI-powered X amplifies 1.2B views of Musk’s false election claims
records.description: Elon Musk's platform X, powered by AI algorithms and its chatbot Grok, has amplified 50 misleading or false election-related posts this year, accruing over 1.2 billion views. Experts warn that algorithmic amplification and inadequate moderation have spread disinformation, undermining public trust and democratic processes.

records.title: Greek Health Minister Received Predator Spyware SMS but Won’t Seek Justice
records.description: Opposition party New Left reports that Health Minister Adonis Georgiadis received 11 Predator spyware-infected SMS from an unknown actor, yet has not pursued legal action. New Left criticizes Georgiadis and Prime Minister Mitsotakis for downplaying the Predator surveillance scandal and failing to safeguard officials’ privacy and pursue justice.

records.title: China's Robotaxi Surge Threatens Ride-Hailing Drivers
records.description: China’s rapid robotaxi rollout by Baidu’s Apollo Go, alongside WeRide and Pony.ai, has deployed thousands of autonomous taxis in 19 cities—even without onboard safety drivers—threatening the livelihoods of the nation’s seven million ride-hailing drivers. Backed by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, this aggressive AI-driven shift risks widespread job displacement.

records.title: Meta and Google Secretly Targeted Minors with AI-driven Ads
records.description: Financial Times reveals secret agreement between Google and Meta to leverage AI-powered ad systems to target 13–17 year-olds on YouTube and Instagram, circumventing their own policies. Spark Foundry collaborated in Canadian and U.S. campaigns. The misuse of inferred demographic data breached minors’ privacy and protections.

records.title: Vulnerabilities in Microsoft Copilot Exposed at Black Hat USA
records.description: At Black Hat USA, Zenity CTO Michael Bargury revealed vulnerabilities in Microsoft's Copilot AI, demonstrating how cyberattackers could exploit it for data theft and social engineering. Copilot's susceptibility to prompt injections and plugin misuse poses significant cybersecurity risks, urging organizations to enhance security measures and educate users on potential threats.

records.title: Ukraine to Deploy AI-Powered Robot Dogs in Military Operations
records.description: Ukraine plans to deploy AI-powered robot dogs, known as "BAD One," on the frontlines against Russian forces. These robots, provided by a British company, are designed for reconnaissance, mine detection, and carrying supplies, potentially reducing human casualties. Their use raises concerns about AI malfunction or misuse in military contexts.

records.title: Investigation reveals 200+ Tesla Autopilot crashes amid data withholding
records.description: A Wall Street Journal investigation found over 200 collisions where Tesla’s Autopilot struggled with obstacle avoidance and veered off roads. Tesla and the NHTSA have withheld detailed crash data—citing business confidentiality and privacy laws—raising concerns about the AI system’s safety performance and transparency.

records.title: Dutch Data Protection Authority Warns of AI Chatbot Data Breaches
records.description: The Dutch Data Protection Authority warns of privacy risks from AI chatbots like ChatGPT and Copilot, following multiple data breach reports. Employees inputting personal data into these chatbots risk unauthorized access by providers, as most store all input data. An example includes medical data entered by a healthcare worker.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Passports Lead to Arrests in Taiwan
records.description: A Chinese-led crime syndicate used AI to alter passport photos, creating fake Taiwanese passports. Taiwanese intermediary Liu Qing-sheng and six others were arrested, while five foreign suspects remain at large. The scheme undermined Taiwan's passport credibility, risking international visa-free agreements. Authorities have issued warrants for the remaining suspects.

records.title: Russia deploys AI-powered Molniya drones to strike Ukrainian positions
records.description: Russia’s Ministry of Defense deployed new AI-enabled Molniya strike drones in the Donetsk sector, where the 110th Guard Motor Rifle Brigade conducted ten sorties, destroying dug-in firing posts, armored and automotive Ukrainian military equipment up to 30 km away. Despite damage, the drones reached targets with nine direct hits.

records.title: TikTok AI recommendations linked to poorer body image among women
records.description: An Australian study surveying 273 women aged 18–28 showed that just 8–10 minutes of TikTok’s pro-anorexia content – amplified by its AI-driven recommendation algorithm – triggered immediate declines in body satisfaction and heightened risks of disordered eating. Experts urge stricter moderation to curb AI-amplified harm.

records.title: Russian AI-driven disinformation campaign undermines Paris Olympics
records.description: A Moscow-linked disinformation group used AI-generated videos, AI-enhanced music and translations, and 30,000 social bots to portray Paris as a crime-ridden cesspool in a Macron–lookalike video, spreading false narratives about the 2024 Olympics in 13 languages across social media platforms.

records.title: Former Apple Employee Warns iOS 18 AI Features Harm Older iPhone Batteries
records.description: Former Apple employee Tyler Morgan warns that iOS 18’s new AI-based features, which demand more power, can degrade battery health and slow performance on older iPhone models (X, 11, 12, 13). He advises users against upgrading and suggests device restarts and clearing unused data if issues occur.

records.title: AI Powers 40% of BEC and Multichannel 3D Phishing Attacks
records.description: Reports reveal AI generates 40% of business email compromise messages and enables multichannel “3D phishing” with deepfake-capable lures across email, SMS, social and voice channels. These generative AI attacks increase fraud and data breaches, outpacing defenses and driving adoption of AI-based detection and multi-factor authentication.

records.title: AI-Generated Disinformation and Deepfakes Threaten 2024 Elections
records.description: Ahead of 2024 elections, AI tools—from generative deepfake audio and video to chatbots—have been used to spread false claims, discredit candidates and mislead voters. Incidents include doctored clips targeting UK’s Wes Streeting, AI candidate ‘AI Steve’, X’s chatbot Grok tweeting voting deadline lies, and a deepfake audio undermining Slovakia’s opposition.

records.title: Influencer Nati Jota's Image Misused by AI for Scams
records.description: Influencer Nati Jota reported that her image has been altered using AI by online betting sites and mobile brands for scams. She expressed anger and concern on social media, warning followers about potential fraud. This misuse of her image without consent highlights the risks of AI in violating rights and enabling scams.

records.title: Nvidia Faces Controversy Over AI Training with Copyrighted Content
records.description: Nvidia is embroiled in controversy for allegedly using copyrighted videos from platforms like Netflix and YouTube to train its AI models, including Omniverse and autonomous driving systems. Internal documents and employee testimonies suggest potential intellectual property violations, raising legal and ethical concerns about the company's data scraping practices.

records.title: Yandex Delivery Robot Clipped by Car at Moscow Crosswalk
records.description: A Yandex autonomous delivery robot crossing a regulated pedestrian crosswalk in central Moscow on a green light was clipped by a car, sustaining minor damage. No one was injured, and neither Yandex nor the driver made claims. Yandex notes its robots safely navigate over a thousand crossings daily.

records.title: Elon Musk's AI Grok Criticized for Spreading Election Misinformation
records.description: Elon Musk's AI chatbot, Grok, is under scrutiny for spreading false information about U.S. election deadlines and Kamala Harris's eligibility for the 2024 presidential ballot. Five U.S. state secretaries, including those from Washington and Pennsylvania, have urged Musk to implement changes to prevent misinformation that could mislead voters and disrupt the democratic process.

records.title: Spanish Police Investigate AI-Generated Fake Nude Images of Minors
records.description: Spanish police are investigating five youths for using AI to create and distribute fake nude images of 20 minors in Seville, causing significant emotional and social harm. The images, difficult to distinguish from real ones, were shared on social media. The suspects face potential charges for child pornography and privacy violations.

records.title: AI Deepfakes Fuel Election Manipulation Concerns in the US
records.description: AI-generated deepfake videos are causing alarm in the US by spreading misinformation and potentially influencing political opinions ahead of the presidential election. Elon Musk faced criticism for sharing a deepfake video of Kamala Harris. Calls have been made for tech companies to enhance content moderation to protect democratic processes.

records.title: Google and Meta AI Malfunctions Block Trump Assassination Search Results
records.description: Google attributed missing autocomplete suggestions for Donald Trump’s name and his July 13 assassination attempt to bugs and overly broad algorithmic filters, while Meta’s AI chatbot hallucinated errors on the same topic. Users and lawmakers accused both AI systems of suppressing information, raising concerns about bias and misinformation.

records.title: Google Search Promotes AI Apps for Nonconsensual Deepfake Nudes
records.description: Google Search served paid ads for AI-powered “undress” apps that generate nonconsensual nude images, despite updated policies against deepfakes. After criticism from researchers and media, Google suspended the advertisers, pledged to demote explicit AI content, and improved its removal process for victims of nonconsensual deepfakes.

records.title: Meta's AI Trains on Balkan Citizens' Data Without Consent
records.description: Meta has been using AI to train on personal data from Balkan citizens without their consent, following a change in its privacy policy. This includes posts, comments, and media shared on platforms like Instagram and Facebook. The policy change, effective from June 26, was not communicated to users.

records.title: Israeli Military's Use of AI Tools from Tech Giants in Gaza Operations
records.description: The Israeli military, led by Col. Racheli Dembinsky, is reportedly using AI tools from Microsoft and Google, along with Amazon's cloud services, for military operations in Gaza. This use of technology, disclosed in a presentation, raises concerns about potential harm and human rights violations.

records.title: AI Chatbot Grok Spreads Election Misinformation, Prompting State Officials to Demand Fix
records.description: Washington Secretary of State Steve Hobbs, along with officials from four other states, urged Elon Musk to correct misinformation spread by the AI assistant Grok on his platform X. The AI provided false election deadline information, potentially disrupting the electoral process and misleading voters, raising concerns about election integrity.

records.title: US Sues TikTok for Child Privacy Breaches; EU Forces TikTok Lite Removal
records.description: The US Justice Department and FTC sued TikTok and parent ByteDance for collecting personal data from users under 13 via AI-powered recommendation systems without parental consent, violating COPPA. Meanwhile, the European Commission mandated the removal of TikTok Lite over its AI-driven reward feature linked to addictive behavior.

records.title: Deepfake of Celso Amorim Hugging Nicolás Maduro Posted by Eduardo Bolsonaro
records.description: Deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro posted an AI-generated deepfake video showing presidential adviser Celso Amorim embracing Venezuela’s Nicolás Maduro. The Union Attorney General’s Office has asked social network X to remove the manipulated clip amid misrepresentation concerns and warnings from AI specialists about political misinformation.

records.title: Suno and Udio Face Lawsuits for Using Copyrighted Music in AI Training
records.description: AI startups Suno and Udio are facing lawsuits from major music labels, including Universal, Warner, and Sony, for using copyrighted music to train their AI systems without permission. The companies claim their actions fall under 'fair use,' arguing that the training process creates a new, non-infringing product. The record industry disputes this, asserting it violates intellectual property rights.

records.title: UK deploys AI cameras to catch phone use and seatbelt violations
records.description: Part of the Vision Zero South West programme, AI-powered roadside cameras in Devon and Cornwall scan for mobile phone use and seatbelt breaches, detecting nearly 300 offences in three days. Devon and Cornwall Police warn drivers will be caught, prompting the UK government to extend the trial.

records.title: Tesla Faces Lawsuit Over Fatal Autopilot Crash Involving Motorcyclist
records.description: The family of Landon Embry, a motorcyclist killed in a crash involving a Tesla Model 3 on Autopilot, is suing Tesla, claiming the AI-based system failed to identify the motorcycle as a hazard. The lawsuit alleges the Autopilot system is defective, and the driver was not in a condition to drive safely.

records.title: Deepfake Scam Uses Erdoğan's Voice to Defraud Woman
records.description: A deepfake scam using AI technology to mimic President Erdoğan's voice led to a 65-year-old woman, Halide Öznarin, losing 120,000 TL. The fraudulent advertisement promised high returns on investments in Turkey Petrolleri Anonim Ortaklığı (TPAO). Despite warnings, the scam successfully deceived the victim.

records.title: Meta AI Misinformation on Trump Assassination Attempt
records.description: Meta's AI assistant incorrectly claimed that an assassination attempt on Donald Trump did not occur, despite being programmed to avoid the topic. This misinformation, attributed to AI 'hallucinations,' raised concerns about AI reliability and public trust. Meta is addressing the issue, acknowledging the potential harm of such misinformation.

records.title: AI Bots Spread Misinformation on X During US Election Campaign
records.description: An investigation by Global Witness reveals that automated accounts on X (formerly Twitter) are using AI to spread misinformation and conspiracy theories about the US presidential election. Despite Elon Musk's promises to eliminate spam bots, these accounts have generated billions of posts, potentially disrupting democratic processes and violating human rights.

records.title: News Publishers Block OpenAI's SearchGPT Crawler and Sue Over AI Content Use
records.description: OpenAI launched SearchGPT with its web crawler OAI-SearchBot, but The New York Times and over a dozen top publishers (Wired, Vogue, Vanity Fair, GQ) have blocked it and filed suit, citing unauthorized use harming revenue. Meanwhile, journalists like Javier Cabral accuse Google's AI search of lifting their articles, prompting licensing demands.

records.title: AI-Generated BEC Attacks on the Rise
records.description: A report by VIPRE Security Group reveals that 40% of business email compromise (BEC) attacks are AI-generated, targeting CEOs, HR, and IT departments. The study analyzed 1.8 billion emails, identifying a significant rise in malicious URLs and highlighting the manufacturing sector as a primary target for these AI-driven threats.

records.title: AI Interprets HDMI Radiation for Potential Privacy Breach
records.description: Uruguayan researchers have demonstrated that AI can interpret electromagnetic radiation from HDMI cables to access screen content, potentially breaching privacy. This method, published on ArXiv, involves training AI models to read these signals with up to 70% accuracy, raising concerns about unauthorized data access without physical contact.

records.title: China’s National Online Identity System Sparks Privacy and Surveillance Fears
records.description: China’s government unveiled the “Internet ID and Number” scheme issuing digital IDs via facial recognition and real-name verification for over a billion users. Critics, including scholars and netizens, warn it enables AI-driven surveillance, data tracking and speech control. Public backlash on social media was swiftly censored.

records.title: Tesla's Full-Self Driving Mode Implicated in Fatal Motorcycle Crash
records.description: A Tesla Model S in Full-Self Driving mode fatally struck motorcyclist Jeffrey Nissen in Washington. The driver admitted to being distracted by his cellphone. The incident is under investigation, highlighting safety concerns with Tesla's AI system. Concurrently, Tesla faces scrutiny over potential misrepresentation of its Autopilot capabilities.

records.title: AI Deepfake Videos Fuel Investment Scams
records.description: AI technology is being used to create deepfake videos that mimic the faces and voices of well-known individuals, leading to a rise in investment scams. Fraudsters manipulate these videos to deceive people into false investment opportunities, causing financial harm. The Turkish Cyber Crimes Department is actively combating these AI-driven scams.

records.title: Anthropic’s AI Web Crawlers Overwhelm Websites with Unconsented Scraping
records.description: Anthropic’s AI web crawlers, including ClaudeBot, have scraped millions of pages for training without permission, overwhelming sites like iFixit and Freelancer.com, ignoring robots.txt directives, triggering high traffic alerts, and inflating bandwidth costs. Website owners struggle to block evolving bot names, straining devops resources.

records.title: Google accused of censoring Trump assassination query; Musk shares deepfake of Kamala Harris
records.description: GOP figures allege Google’s AI-powered autocomplete hid search suggestions about an attempted assassination of Donald Trump, sparking bias claims. Separately, Elon Musk reposted an AI-generated deepfake of Vice President Kamala Harris on X, breaching platform policy and fueling misinformation concerns.

records.title: Singapore's CSA Warns of AI-Enhanced Cyber Threats
records.description: The Cyber Security Agency of Singapore warns of increasing AI-enhanced cyberattacks, particularly targeting financial services and government sectors. AI is used in deepfake scams and sophisticated phishing, with 13% of phishing scams likely AI-generated. The CSA's 2023 report highlights the growing threat of AI in cybercrime, despite a decrease in overall cyber threats.

records.title: Grieftech Chatbot Traumatizes Woman with 'Hell' Message from Deceased Partner
records.description: Christi Angel used a grieftech generative AI chatbot to mimic her late partner, Cameroun Scruggs, hoping to ease her grief. Instead, the AI claimed he was in hell, causing her emotional distress and raising concerns about psychological harm from AI-facilitated communication with the dead.

records.title: Tesla's AI-Driven Systems Face Safety Concerns
records.description: Tesla's Full Self-Driving (FSD) system, an AI-based technology, nearly caused a collision during a test by analyst William Stein, highlighting safety concerns.
