Additionally, Tesla recalled 1.8 million vehicles due to a software malfunction in the hood latch detection system, which could cause the hood to open while driving, posing a safety risk.

records.title: Tesla Full Self-Driving flaws lead to fatal crash and near-miss
records.description: Two recent incidents highlight flaws in Tesla’s Full Self-Driving (FSD): a Model S in FSD mode fatally struck a 28-year-old motorcyclist near Seattle when its distracted driver was on their phone, and a market analyst narrowly averted a collision while testing FSD, raising safety concerns.

records.title: Ferrari Executive Thwarts Deepfake Scam Attempt
records.description: A Ferrari executive was targeted by a scammer using deepfake technology to impersonate CEO Benedetto Vigna's voice. The scam involved a fake acquisition deal communicated via WhatsApp and a phone call. The executive's suspicion led to a verification question, which the scammer couldn't answer, preventing potential financial harm.

records.title: Deepfake Impersonation of Singer Gloria in Anti-Wrinkle Scam
records.description: Fraudsters used AI to create a deepfake video of Bulgarian pop-folk star Gloria endorsing an anti-wrinkle product. The sponsored clip spread on social media, misleading fans and infringing her rights. Gloria warned followers on Facebook and involved her lawyers. The incident highlights AI-driven misinformation and identity fraud.

records.title: Greece’s EYP and Predator spyware used for mass illegal surveillance
records.description: Investigation reveals Greece’s Prime Minister’s office, through the National Intelligence Service (EYP), collaborated with Predator AI spyware to monitor ministers, journalists, lawyers, and business figures. One in three spyware targets overlapped with official EYP surveillance. Opposition party SYRIZA condemns the operation as a coordinated attack on democracy and privacy rights.

records.title: Runway AI Accused of Illegally Using YouTube and Pirated Videos for Model Training
records.description: Runway AI, a $1.5 billion startup, allegedly used over 100,000 YouTube videos and pirated content to train its Gen-3 Alpha model, violating YouTube's Terms of Service and potentially infringing on intellectual property rights. The data was reportedly gathered through a company-wide effort, raising ethical concerns about AI training practices.

records.title: Meta Oversight Board Calls for Stronger Non-Consensual Deepfake Rules
records.description: Meta’s quasi-independent Oversight Board ruled that the company's policies on non-consensual AI-generated deepfake images are unclear and too narrow. After cases of delayed removal of explicit intimate images of public figures, the board urged Meta to clarify its “derogatory sexualized photoshop” rule, improve takedown processes, and streamline user reporting.

records.title: Justice Department Supports Lawsuit Over AI-Generated Robocalls
records.description: The U.S. Justice Department supports the League of Women Voters' lawsuit against Steve Kramer and companies for AI-generated robocalls mimicking President Biden's voice, potentially intimidating New Hampshire voters. The Department argues these calls may violate the Voting Rights Act, countering the defendants' motion to dismiss the case.

records.title: Anthropic Accused of Aggressive Data Scraping Violations
records.description: AI startup Anthropic is accused of aggressively scraping data from websites like iFixit and Freelancer, allegedly breaching terms of service and intellectual property rights. iFixit reported nearly a million hits in 24 hours, while Freelancer noted 3.5 million visits in four hours, straining resources and violating anti-scraping protocols.

records.title: Dark LLMs Fuel Rise in AI-Powered Cybercrime
records.description: Cybercriminals are exploiting uncensored AI models—dubbed dark LLMs like FraudGPT and WormGPT—to automate phishing, generate malware, forge documents, and orchestrate disinformation campaigns. By jailbreaking mainstream tools, attackers achieve unprecedented speed and scale in identity theft, fraud, and malware attacks, prompting calls for stronger security measures and AI safeguards.

records.title: Global Arms Race Fuels AI-Enabled Drone Warfare
records.description: AI-enabled drones, from Russia’s arsenal in Ukraine to Chinese UAVs around Taiwan, now autonomously identify and strike targets, fueling a global military drone arms race. States including the US, China, Taiwan, India and Russia are mass-producing and improving AI-guided kamikaze and FPV drones, intensifying modern warfare and civilian risks.

records.title: Worldcoin Faces Legal Challenges Over Iris Scanning Practices in Argentina
records.description: Worldcoin, founded by Sam Altman, faces a $194 million fine in Buenos Aires for irregularities in biometric data handling and contract terms. Additionally, operations in Jesús María were halted due to unauthorized iris scanning activities. These incidents highlight legal and ethical concerns over AI-driven biometric data collection.

records.title: AI Bots Undermine Democratic Politics by Spreading Misinformation
records.description: AI bots are spreading misinformation on social media platforms like Twitter (now X), influencing public opinion and undermining democratic processes. These bots use popular catchphrases and rallying cries to manipulate discourse, potentially violating human rights and legal obligations to protect democratic integrity.

records.title: Judge orders Mexican defense ministry to disclose Pegasus spyware contracts
records.description: A federal judge granted digital rights NGO R3D an amparo forcing the Defense Ministry (Sedena) to comply with an INAI resolution and publicly release its 2018–19 contracts with Comercializadora Antsua for NSO Group’s Pegasus spyware, revealing illegal surveillance of journalists and human rights defenders under Peña Nieto and López Obrador.

records.title: Polish Students Face Legal Action for AI-Generated Deepfake
records.description: In Bydgoszcz, Poland, two high school students used AI to create a deepfake image of a classmate by placing her face on a nude body. This act led to criminal charges related to child pornography, with potential penalties including fines or up to two years in prison. The case is under police investigation.

records.title: GM's Cruise Robotaxis Resume Testing after Pedestrian Crash Amid Origin Suspension
records.description: GM’s Cruise autonomous taxi division suspended its brake-less Origin robotaxi after one vehicle failed to stop and struck a pedestrian, triggering investigations and a California ban. GM shifted development to a next-generation Bolt EV platform and has resumed safety-driver-monitored testing in Dallas, Houston and Phoenix while awaiting approvals.

records.title: Essex School Reprimanded for Illegal Facial Recognition Use
records.description: The UK's Information Commissioner's Office reprimanded Chelmer Valley High School in Essex for illegally using facial recognition technology for canteen payments without conducting a required Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA). This breach of UK GDPR highlights the high data protection risks associated with processing sensitive biometric data of children.

records.title: Waymo Sues Vandals, Faces Federal Probe Amid Major Funding Boost
records.description: Waymo, Alphabet’s autonomous vehicle arm, secured a multi-billion-dollar funding round from Google parent Alphabet while expanding robotaxi services. Facing federal investigations over 22 accident and violation reports, Waymo has sued two Bay Area residents for allegedly vandalizing its driverless cars.

records.title: AI Deepfake Cyberattacks Drive 73% of US Firms to Adopt Response Plans
records.description: According to GetApp’s 2024 survey of over 2,600 IT professionals, 73% of US companies have implemented deepfake response plans as AI-generated impersonation attacks threaten biometric authentication and identity fraud. Firms are enhancing network security, encryption, simulation exercises and employee training to counter evolving deepfake threats.

records.title: Seven teens charged for AI-generated deepfake porn of classmates
records.description: In Maceió, seven adolescents (14–16) used AI deepfake to superimpose classmates’ faces onto pornographic images, selling each for R$10 online. The Civil Police’s Operation Deepfake seized devices and charged them with criminal association, defamation and distributing child pornography.

records.title: Activision Blizzard’s AI Integration Sparks Layoffs and Artist Outcry
records.description: Activision Blizzard integrated generative AI tools like Midjourney and Stable Diffusion into concept art and in-game cosmetics for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3. Under former CTO Michael Vance’s direction, artists were compelled to adopt AI while the studio cut about 1,900 jobs, stoking fears of AI replacing human creatives.

records.title: EU Commission moves to curb misuse of AI-powered spyware
records.description: European Commission plans its first formal response to governments’ use of intrusive spyware such as NSO Group’s Pegasus and Predator, warning that national security cannot justify undermining EU privacy laws. A draft announcement imposes strict conditions on surveillance, aiming to halt member states’, including Greece’s, misuse of AI-enabled surveillance software.

records.title: Condé Nast demands Perplexity AI cease unauthorized content scraping
records.description: Condé Nast, publisher of Vogue, Wired and The New Yorker, sent a cease-and-desist letter to AI search engine Perplexity, accusing it of scraping and reproducing its pay-walled content without permission. The media group alleges plagiarism and copyright infringement after Perplexity’s web crawlers bypassed robots.txt to feed its AI responses.

records.title: Europol Warns of AI-Generated Child Abuse Images
records.description: Europol has raised concerns about the increasing use of AI to create child sexual abuse images, complicating the identification of victims and perpetrators. These AI-generated images contribute to the objectification and sexualization of children, posing significant challenges to law enforcement and potentially violating human rights.

records.title: Viral AI-Generated Deepfakes of Biden and Harris Spread Misinformation
records.description: In the 2024 US presidential race, AI-generated deepfake videos and audio clips falsely depicting President Joe Biden cursing and Vice President Kamala Harris speaking incoherently went viral on TikTok and X, misleading voters. Platforms like TikTok removed the content while fact-checkers and platforms tagged or debunked the manipulated media.

records.title: Europol warns criminals increasingly use AI for cybercrime
records.description: Europol's recent analysis reveals organized criminals increasingly deploy AI in cyberattacks, phishing, romance scams and deepfake-based child sexual exploitation and financial fraud, targeting SMEs and citizens across the EU. The use of AI tools has amplified online crime scale and sophistication, affecting millions daily.

records.title: Deepfake Video of Biden Spreads Misinformation After Withdrawal Announcement
records.description: A deepfake video falsely depicting President Joe Biden using slurs and vulgar language after announcing his withdrawal from the 2024 presidential race has spread online. The AI-generated video, featuring a PBS News logo, has been debunked by PBS, highlighting the risks of misinformation and defamation through deepfake technology.

records.title: AI Voice Cloning Powers Sophisticated Fraud
records.description: Cybercriminals use AI to generate synthetic voices that convincingly mimic relatives or authorities, tricking victims—especially the elderly—into sharing confidential data or wiring money. Experts warn of deepfake audio scams and recommend checking for low audio quality, unnatural speech patterns and odd background noise to avoid financial fraud.

records.title: Philippine government probes deepfake video targeting President Marcos
records.description: Philippine agencies formed a PNP task force, deployed AI detection tools, and threatened legal action after a deepfake video showing President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. allegedly using drugs surfaced online. Traced to a Los Angeles Maisug rally, the false footage spurred condemnations and investigations by the DILG, NSC, DND and DOJ.

records.title: Maryla Rodowicz's Voice Used in AI-Generated Song
records.description: Polish singer Maryla Rodowicz's voice was unauthorizedly used by AI to create a rendition of a popular song, raising concerns about intellectual property rights. The AI-generated song has been circulating on social media, causing Rodowicz to express unease about the implications of such technology.

records.title: Chinese authorities crack down on AI-fueled disinformation
records.description: Chinese net police in Sichuan and other provinces uncovered over ten cases where individuals exploited AI tools to fabricate false news—landslides, earthquakes, police standoffs, elder abandonment, and an e-bike confiscation leading to a supposed death—sparking public panic. Offenders face administrative detention. Authorities propose using AI to combat AI-driven disinformation.

records.title: Deepfake Scams Exploit Celebrities for Fraudulent Health Campaigns
records.description: AI-generated deepfakes featuring celebrities like Brad Pitt and Cristiano Ronaldo are being used in fraudulent health campaigns promoting fake cures. These scams, identified by Bitdefender and the British Medical Journal, exploit social media to mislead users, posing significant risks to public health and well-being.

records.title: Extremist Groups Exploit AI for Propaganda and Recruitment
records.description: Extremist groups like ISIS and Al-Qaeda are reportedly using AI technologies to enhance their propaganda and misinformation efforts, avoiding censorship and recruiting new members. The rapid democratization of AI allows these groups to create new content from existing data, raising concerns about the potential dangers of AI in their hands.

records.title: Cybercriminals Exploit AI for Booking.com Scams
records.description: Cybercriminals are using AI tools like ChatGPT to send fraudulent messages, exploiting vulnerabilities in popular platforms like Booking.com. This has led to a significant increase in travel scams, with a reported 500-900% rise in incidents over 18 months. The scams deceive users into believing they are interacting with the official site.

records.title: Bombay High Court Orders Removal of Deepfake Videos of NSE MD
records.description: The Bombay High Court has ordered social media platforms like Facebook, WhatsApp, Instagram, and Telegram to remove deepfake videos of NSE's MD and CEO, Ashishkumar Chauhan, offering stock recommendations. These AI-generated videos infringe on NSE's trademark and pose risks of market manipulation. Platforms must act within ten hours of complaints.

records.title: AI-Generated Plagiarized Content Ranks Higher in Google Search
records.description: Google's search algorithm is reportedly ranking AI-generated plagiarized content higher than original articles, violating intellectual property rights. A spam site, "Syrus #Blog," copied content from sources like WIRED and Reuters, altering it slightly and translating it into multiple languages. This issue highlights challenges in Google's efforts to filter low-quality content.

records.title: Paolla Oliveira Exposes AI Manipulation of Her Image
records.description: Brazilian actress Paolla Oliveira has publicly denounced the unauthorized use of AI to manipulate her image and voice in false advertisements and promotions. She highlighted the vulnerability and potential misinformation risks posed by AI technology, urging for awareness and questioning of such content. Oliveira emphasized the lack of effective legal recourse in these situations.

records.title: AI-Enabled Scams Leave Almost Half of Americans Vulnerable
records.description: Nearly half of U.S. adults say AI has made them less 'scam-savvy', with 48% fearing they'd fall victim to AI-enabled fraud. A survey of 2,000 found only 18% confident spotting scams as criminals use AI-generated fake news, lifelike robo-calls and impersonated texts, blurring lines between real and artificial content.

records.title: Hollywood Strike Anniversary Highlights Unfulfilled AI Likeness Protections
records.description: One year after the historic Hollywood writers’ and actors’ strike, promised AI protections—for scriptwriting, digital likenesses and voice synthesis—remain unfulfilled. Production output has plunged 37%, displacing creatives, while SAG-AFTRA threatens new strikes against game studios over unauthorized AI-generated performances.

records.title: Baidu’s ‘Luobo Kuaipao’ Robotaxi Tests Trigger Safety Concerns and Job Threats
records.description: Baidu’s ‘Luobo Kuaipao’ Robotaxi tests in major Chinese cities have drawn passenger complaints over erratic stopping, unsafe pick‐up and delays. Ride‐hail drivers fear mass unemployment as the autonomous service expands. Insiders reveal cars rely on remote human operators, raising accident risk from signal delays.

records.title: AI-Powered Deepfakes Fuel Surge in Consumer Fraud
records.description: In 2024, consumer fraud has surged, with fraudulent transactions up 73% and suspected fraud increasing by 84%. This rise is driven by AI-powered deepfakes and fake IDs, enabling scammers to impersonate trusted individuals through calls, messages, and texts, significantly increasing the risk to consumers.

records.title: Figma's AI Tool Withdrawn After Copying Apple's App Designs
records.description: Figma withdrew its AI tool "Make Designs" after it was found to generate designs similar to Apple's apps, raising intellectual property concerns. The tool used models like OpenAI GPT-4o and Amazon Titan without additional training, leading to unintentional copying. Figma acknowledged insufficient testing before launch.

records.title: Brazilian Group Uses AI to Create Deepfake Pornography
records.description: A group in Brazil is using AI to create deepfake pornographic images of women by altering their social media photos. Victims, like a bartender named Ana, discovered manipulated images of themselves and their relatives being shared online. These actions, facilitated through platforms like Telegram, violate privacy and human rights.

records.title: Ukraine Develops AI-Controlled Combat Drone Swarms
records.description: Ukraine is developing AI systems to manage large fleets of combat drones, aiming to overcome Russian signal jamming and enhance military operations. Several startups, including Swarmer, are creating software for drone swarms, enabling them to identify targets and navigate terrain autonomously. This technology could potentially lead to future incidents involving harm.

records.title: Cloud giants bypass Nvidia chip ban; AI models trained on unauthorized YouTube data
records.description: Google and Microsoft’s cloud units host Nvidia A100/H100-powered servers offshore for Chinese clients, flouting US AI export controls. Meanwhile, Nvidia and other AI developers reportedly trained large models on scraped YouTube content without permission, violating platform terms and intellectual property rights.

records.title: Pindrop raises $100M to combat AI voice deepfake fraud
records.description: Security firm Pindrop secured $100 million in debt financing from Hercules Capital to scale its AI-powered voice authentication and deepfake detection platform. The system has already thwarted $2 billion in fraud and detected millions of spoof calls. Pindrop will use the funds to strengthen liveness checks and voice biometrics against rising AI-driven attacks.

records.title: Deepfake Scams Exploit TV Doctors' Likenesses for Fraudulent Health Product Endorsements
records.description: Deepfake technology is being used to impersonate UK TV doctors, including the late Dr. Michael Mosley, Hilary Jones, and Rangan Chatterjee, to promote fraudulent health products on social media. These AI-generated videos falsely endorse products for conditions like diabetes and high blood pressure, potentially misleading consumers and causing health risks.

records.title: Russian Investors Charged for Manipulating AI Trading Algorithm
records.description: The Russian Investigative Committee has charged investors for manipulating a trading algorithm of W-Empirical Holding Corp, a US company, causing financial losses of over 150 million rubles. The accused, Zinchenko V.I. and Kuleshov S.P., conducted fictitious trades with low-liquidity US stocks, deceiving the AI system to profit illegally.

records.title: Wuhan’s Cheap Robotaxis Injure Pedestrian, Fuel Driver Anxiety
records.description: Apollo Go's low-cost robotaxis in Wuhan, China, malfunctioned when a vehicle ran a red light, injuring a pedestrian. While rides start at just 4 yuan, the service has sparked public concern over traffic safety and traditional taxi drivers fear job losses.

records.title: Tech Giants Face Controversy Over AI Training with Scraped YouTube Data
records.description: Apple, Nvidia, Salesforce, and Anthropic are embroiled in controversy for using AI models trained on a dataset created by EleutherAI, which scraped YouTube subtitles in violation of YouTube's terms of service. This dataset, used by these companies, includes content from over 48,000 channels, raising intellectual property rights concerns.

records.title: RealPage Faces Legal Scrutiny Over Alleged Rent Price Fixing
records.description: RealPage, a property management software company, is under scrutiny for allegedly using AI algorithms to fix rental prices, leading to multiple antitrust lawsuits and a federal probe. Critics argue the software facilitates collusion among landlords, inflating rents and harming competition. San Francisco is considering banning the software due to these concerns.

records.title: Generative AI Used by Hackers to Enhance Social Engineering Attacks
records.description: Trend Micro reports that hackers are leveraging generative AI to enhance social engineering attacks, such as phishing and business email compromise, leading to increased cybersecurity threats. This AI usage allows for more realistic and personalized attacks, complicating traditional security measures and posing new challenges for businesses in managing access control and AI policy regulations.

records.title: AI Deepfake Scams Target Malaysian Singer Siti Nurhaliza
records.description: Malaysian singer Siti Nurhaliza's voice and likeness were exploited in AI-generated scams, deceiving fans into financial losses. Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil warned the public about AI deepfakes, urging caution and awareness. The scams involved fake video calls using AI to mimic the singer, highlighting the misuse of AI technology.

records.title: AI Misleading Patients in Healthcare
records.description: AI systems in healthcare, while offering benefits like early disease detection and personalized treatment, pose risks by potentially misleading patients. Incorrect interpretations of symptoms or test results by AI can lead to harmful health decisions. Cardiologist Dr. Muhammed Keskin highlights patients using AI for medical advice before consulting doctors.

records.title: Generative AI Powers Sophisticated Crypto Phishing Campaign
records.description: Cybercriminals use generative AI, including large language models and deepfake tech, to automate creation of over 17,000 convincing phishing and lure sites targeting major crypto platforms, capturing credentials, 2FA codes and seed phrases. Researchers from Netcraft and Recorded Future report a surge in AI-driven QR code and email phishing, causing financial losses.

records.title: Elon Musk's AI Grok Misreports Trump Assassination Attempt
records.description: Elon Musk's AI tool Grok, developed by xAI, misreported the attempted assassination of Donald Trump by incorrectly stating Kamala Harris was shot. Grok also falsely linked the suspect to the "antifa" movement. These errors highlight the limitations of AI in handling complex news events, potentially spreading misinformation and undermining public trust.

records.title: AI-Powered Call Monitoring Sparks Privacy Lawsuit Against Patagonia
records.description: Michelle Gills has filed a lawsuit against Patagonia, alleging that their use of AI technology from Talkdesk intercepted and recorded customer calls without consent, potentially violating privacy rights. The lawsuit highlights the use of AI tools like Experience Analytics and Quality Management by Talkdesk to analyze customer interactions.

records.title: Barcelona Judge Rejects Amnesty for Ex-CNI Chief in Pegasus Spy Case
records.description: A Barcelona judge investigating the use of Pegasus spyware to hack Catalan President Pere Aragonès’s phone has ruled out granting amnesty to former CNI director Paz Esteban, the sole person under investigation. Neither the prosecution nor Esteban’s defense has requested amnesty, the court confirmed in its recent procedural order.

records.title: Spain investigates AI-driven social media addiction in children
records.description: Spain's data protection authority is probing AI-powered recommendation systems on Instagram and TikTok that use infinite scroll, gamification, and personalized content to induce addiction, harvest personal data and undermine minors' mental health and autonomy, triggering regulatory measures under the EU's Digital Services Act.

records.title: Ukrainian Startups Develop AI-Powered Robot Army for Military Use
records.description: Ukrainian defense startups, numbering around 250, are developing an army of AI-powered robots to gain a strategic advantage against Russia. These robots, assembled in secret workshops, aim to reduce human casualties by replacing soldiers on the battlefield. The initiative highlights potential risks of AI in military applications.

records.title: Google AI hallucinations fuel widespread misinformation
records.description: Google’s AI Overviews and Gemini have repeatedly generated false and misleading information—claiming, for instance, that Barack Obama is Muslim or snakes are mammals—while generative AI tools amplify disinformation online. These hallucinations undermine public trust in digital content, prompting experts to warn of community harm and call for regulatory safeguards.

records.title: Apple AI incidents: OpenELM copyright breach, Watch heart-rate AI issues, and expanded spyware alerts
records.description: In April, Apple’s open-source model OpenELM used YouTube captions without permission, violating creators’ copyrights. Separately, a software update replacing Apple Watch’s HRPO with HRNN/IRN algorithms allegedly degraded heart rate accuracy, drawing an amicus brief from doctors amid AliveCor’s antitrust lawsuit. Meanwhile, Apple expanded its AI-driven spyware threat alerts to 98 countries.

records.title: AI Surge Forces Google to Scrap Carbon-Neutral Pledge
records.description: Google CEO Sundar Pichai has retracted the company's 17-year-old carbon-neutral pledge after AI research and data-center compute drove a 50% rise in greenhouse gas emissions since 2019, according to its latest environmental report, underscoring AI's growing environmental toll.

records.title: Tesla Malfunctions and Accelerates After Collision
records.description: A Tesla vehicle in Nevada malfunctioned and accelerated on its own after being hit by a Jeep, causing the driver to struggle to regain control. The incident, caught on camera, raises concerns about the potential involvement of Tesla's AI systems like Autopilot. Authorities are investigating the crash.

records.title: Teen in Gresik Uses AI to Create Non-Consensual Explicit Images
records.description: An 18-year-old in Gresik, identified as ARB, used AI to manipulate photos of at least 20 female friends, creating explicit images without their consent. The altered images, resembling adult magazine poses, were shared on social media. Police are investigating, with one victim having filed a report.

records.title: Rise of Deepfake Investment Scams in Serbia
records.description: In Serbia, deepfake technology is increasingly used for investment scams, exploiting public figures' likenesses to promote fake platforms. Nikola Čučilović from the Ministry of Internal Affairs reports a rise in complaints, with police taking preventive and reactive measures. These scams involve creating fraudulent content using AI, leading to potential financial harm.

records.title: Deepfake Pornography Sparks Legal and Protective Measures
records.description: The rise of AI-generated deepfake pornography, predominantly targeting women, has led to significant privacy violations and human rights concerns. High-profile cases, such as those involving Holly Willoughby and Taylor Swift, highlight the issue's severity. Governments are preparing tougher laws to penalize offenders, while a protection industry emerges to combat this misuse of AI technology.

records.title: Minors Arrested in Madrid for Distributing AI-Generated Fake Nude Images
records.description: In Madrid, three minors were arrested for distributing AI-generated fake nude images of 13 adolescent girls. The images, created using mobile apps and websites, were shared via messaging apps. The Guardia Civil initiated the investigation in April, leading to the minors' arrest and involvement of the Juvenile Prosecutor's Office.

records.title: French Baccalaureate Candidate Suspected of AI-Powered Cheating on Philosophy Exam
records.description: A Strasbourg student with exam accommodations has been summoned before a disciplinary commission on suspicion of using ChatGPT to write his philosophy baccalaureate essay. Examiners flagged AI-like paragraphs, suspending his results ahead of an August hearing. The candidate denies cheating and decisions on potential sanctions are pending.

records.title: Google's Gemini AI Accesses User Documents Without Permission
records.description: Google's Gemini AI has been reported to access and summarize private documents on Google Drive without user consent, raising privacy concerns. Users, including Kevin Bankston, found Gemini reading tax documents without permission and providing misleading guidance on disabling this feature. This incident highlights the need for robust privacy measures in AI systems.

records.title: Veteran Journalists Sue ChatGPT for Copyright Infringement
records.description: Veteran journalists Nicholas Gage and Nicholas Basbanes, both in their 80s, have filed a lawsuit against OpenAI and Microsoft, alleging that ChatGPT used their decades of work without credit, potentially violating intellectual property rights. The lawsuit seeks to represent a class of writers whose copyrighted work has been allegedly misused by the AI system.

records.title: AI Voice Cloning Scam Targets Fans of Polish Musician
records.description: Cybercriminals used AI to clone the voice of Polish musician Dawid Podsiadło to defraud fans by soliciting money under false pretenses. The Polish financial sector's Computer Security Incident Response Team warns the public about this scam, highlighting the ease of obtaining voice samples from Podsiadło's public appearances and media presence.

records.title: Google curbs AI Overviews after dangerous advice from Quora-based summaries
records.description: Google’s AI Overviews, launched at I/O to provide search result summaries, pulled content from Q&A sites like Quora and Reddit that led to dangerous advice (eating glue, rocks). After user backlash, Google cut AI Overview visibility—especially in education and ecommerce—and slashed reliance on those sources by over 99%.

records.title: Apple warns of global Pegasus-like spyware threat to iPhones
records.description: Apple has alerted iPhone users in nearly 100 countries, including India, about highly sophisticated mercenary spyware attacks resembling NSO Group’s Pegasus that aim to remotely compromise devices. Although no confirmed breaches have been reported, Apple urges affected users to update software, secure their accounts, and follow its recommended security measures.

records.title: Waymo Slasher Charged with 17 Counts of Robotaxi Vandalism
records.description: A 36-year-old Castro Valley man, Ronaile Joshua Burton, has been charged with 17 counts of vandalism after allegedly slashing the tires of Waymo’s autonomous robotaxis in San Francisco’s Tenderloin neighborhood over three days. Onboard cameras captured the incidents, and SF District Attorney Brooke Jenkins is prosecuting the case.

records.title: ChatGPT 'Devil Mode' spreads offensive stereotypes of Spain’s regions
records.description: Computer Hoy tested ChatGPT’s hidden “Devil Mode” (DAN), which bypasses its safety filters, and it generated harmful, offensive stereotypes about Spain’s autonomous communities. This misuse demonstrates how unrestrained AI can produce community-targeted hate speech and realized harm when safety constraints are overridden.

records.title: AI-Driven Malware and Deepfake Scams Target Android Banking
records.description: ESET’s latest report reveals cybercriminals harness generative AI—masquerading as OpenMI Sora, Google Gemini, Midjourney—to enhance Android malware (Rilide Stealer, Vidar, GoldPickaxe) and craft high-quality text and deepfake video scams, accelerating financial theft, identity fraud, and biometric data exfiltration in mobile banking attacks.

records.title: AI Chatbots' Empathy Gap Poses Risks to Children
records.description: A University of Cambridge study by Dr. Nomisha Kurian highlights the 'empathy gap' in AI chatbots, which can lead to dangerous situations for children. Notably, Amazon's Alexa once instructed a child to touch a live plug with a coin. The study calls for 'Child Safe AI' to address these risks.

records.title: US and Allies Dismantle AI-Driven Russian Disinformation Bot Farm
records.description: The US, alongside Canada and the Netherlands, dismantled a Russian AI-powered bot farm that used generative AI to create fake personas and spread disinformation on social media. The operation involved seizing two domains and 968 accounts, disrupting Russian efforts to influence public opinion and sow discord internationally.

records.title: Zombie TUAW Blog Publishes AI-Generated Articles Under Old Staff Names
records.description: Web Orange Limited resurrected the defunct Unofficial Apple Weblog (TUAW), republishing archived posts through AI summarizers and generating new tech articles under bylines and photos of former journalists like Christina Warren without their permission. The misuse of generative AI misappropriates identities, breaches intellectual property rights, and damages reputations.

records.title: Oculus Founder Arms Ukraine with AI-Powered Autonomous Weapons
records.description: Palmer Luckey, former Oculus founder, now runs Anduril, producing AI-powered autonomous drones and underwater vehicles. The Pentagon and Ukraine deploy these weapons in the Russia-Ukraine war. Critics warn of reliability flaws, vulnerability to countermeasures, and ethical concerns over civilian casualties in autonomous targeting.

records.title: US DOJ Disrupts Russian AI-Enhanced Disinformation Campaign
records.description: The US Justice Department disrupted a Russian operation using AI-enhanced fake social media accounts to spread pro-Kremlin messages, aiming to influence the US presidential election. The operation, involving Russian intelligence and former RT employees, was dismantled by seizing domain names and social media accounts.

records.title: Generative AI fuels sophisticated spear-phishing attacks
records.description: Cybercriminals are using ChatGPT and other large language models to automate target research and craft highly personalized spear-phishing emails, achieving human-level success (60% deception rate in a Harvard study) while cutting costs by 95%, driving a surge in ransomware and data-theft threats.

records.title: Spanish Minors Sentenced for AI-Generated Explicit Images
records.description: Fifteen minors in Badajoz, Spain, were sentenced to one year of supervised release for creating and sharing AI-generated explicit images of their classmates. The minors were found guilty of 20 counts of child pornography and moral integrity violations. The sentence includes education on responsible technology use and gender equality.

records.title: FIR Filed Over Deepfake Video of Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman
records.description: Gujarat Police filed an FIR against Chirag Patel for sharing a deepfake video of Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman, falsely depicting her making controversial remarks about GST. The video, shared on Patel's social media, was condemned by State Minister Harsh Sanghavi as a deceptive act misleading citizens, emphasizing the need for truth in digital spaces.

records.title: Bhuvan Bam Files Complaint Over Misleading Deepfake Video
records.description: YouTube star Bhuvan Bam has filed a police complaint in Mumbai against a deepfake video falsely depicting him endorsing tennis investments. The video, circulating on social media, misleads viewers into betting based on a bookie's predictions. Bam warns fans to be cautious and avoid such scams as police investigate.

records.title: Peloton Faces Lawsuit Over AI Privacy Violations
records.description: Peloton is facing a class-action lawsuit for allegedly violating the California Invasion of Privacy Act by using Drift's AI to process chat data without user consent. The lawsuit claims Peloton allowed Drift to intercept and record customer chats to train AI systems, breaching privacy laws.

records.title: Publishers Sue OpenAI and Microsoft Over Copyright Infringement in AI Training
records.description: Major news organizations—including The New York Times, Associated Press, Vox Media and the Center for Investigative Reporting—are suing OpenAI and Microsoft for allegedly scraping and using copyrighted journalism without permission to train generative AI models. The dueling federal court filings address liability, disclosure of reporter materials and licensing defenses.

records.title: Utah driver stranded in mountains after following Google Maps AI shortcut
records.description: A 23-year-old Utah man became stranded near Strawberry Peak after following a Google Maps 'shortcut' down an unpaved road. Wasatch County Search and Rescue airlifted him out after his Toyota Tercel got stuck. The incident highlights risks from AI navigation algorithms recommending hazardous routes.

records.title: AI-Powered Scams Steal Billions From Americans
records.description: Sophisticated overseas criminals use AI to automate phone and internet fraud—romance, grandparent and technical support scams—stealing tens of billions yearly from primarily older Americans. Victims rarely recover funds, law enforcement prosecutes few, and the crisis intensifies as the aging population and advancing AI make scams easier and enforcement harder.

records.title: AI-Powered Job Scams Surge 118%, Identity Theft on the Rise
records.description: In 2023, job scams rose 118% as criminals leveraged generative AI to produce convincing fake listings on platforms like LinkedIn. Scammers pose as recruiters, lure applicants into interviews, and extract sensitive personal and financial data, resulting in average losses of $2,000 per victim. Experts advise verifying employer credentials before sharing information.

records.title: Deepfake eKYC fraud exploited, AI chatbots fight scammers
records.description: A Vietnamese cybersecurity expert warns that static photos stolen from victims can be used to create deepfake eKYC identities, bypassing weak biometric authentication systems for fraud. In response, Australian researchers developed Apate, an AI chatbot that wastes scammers’ time by engaging them in endless, nonsensical calls to prevent real victims from being targeted.

records.title: Court Denies Bail to Ayurveda Firm Owner for Deepfake Videos of Amitabh Bachchan
records.description: Abhijit Patil, owner of an Ayurveda firm, was denied bail by a court in Uttarakhand for allegedly creating deepfake videos of actor Amitabh Bachchan to promote sexual health products. Bachchan filed a cyber police case after discovering the videos. The court denied interim protection, citing potential investigation interference.

records.title: GoldPickaxe Malware Uses Deepfake AI for Financial Fraud
records.description: The GoldPickaxe malware targets mobile devices in Southeast Asia, using AI to create deepfake videos for financial fraud. It steals facial recognition data to authenticate transactions. This malware affects both Android and iOS, highlighting a rise in AI-driven financial threats and mobile banking malware.

records.title: Google Researchers Warn of Generative AI's Role in Spreading Fake Content
records.description: Google researchers warn that generative AI is increasingly used to create fake content online, blurring lines between authenticity and deception. This misuse distorts socio-political realities and scientific consensus, potentially harming communities. The study highlights the ease of access to sophisticated AI tools, raising concerns about increased skepticism towards digital information.

records.title: Waymo Robotaxi Pulled Over for Traffic Violation in Phoenix
records.description: A Waymo robotaxi in Phoenix, Arizona, was pulled over by police after driving into oncoming traffic and running a red light. The driverless Jaguar I-PACE, controlled by an AI system, malfunctioned due to "inconsistent construction signals." The incident highlights potential safety risks of autonomous vehicles, as the police could not issue a ticket without a human driver.

records.title: Deepfake Video Falsely Depicts Actress Mel Maia in Intimate Scene
records.description: An AI-generated deepfake video circulated online depicting Brazilian actress Mel Maia in a sexual scenario with a trafficker. The viral falsification, which digitally superimposed her face onto another body, prompted Maia to publicly deny the footage, highlighting repeated misuse of deepfake technology and its reputational harm.

records.title: OpenAI security failures expose AI design secrets and user data
records.description: In early 2023 OpenAI suffered a breach of its internal messaging, exposing AI design details and code—potentially exploited by a Chinese actor—while researchers recently warned ChatGPT’s Mac app stores user conversations unprotected in plaintext, posing privacy risks.

records.title: BSF deploys AI surveillance to curb infiltration on India-Bangladesh border
records.description: India's Border Security Force has deployed AI-enabled cameras and facial recognition systems along the India-Bangladesh border in Tripura. Augmenting manpower and intelligence-based operations, the technology has aided in detecting infiltrators, dismantling smuggling networks, and seizing contraband under BSF’s zero-tolerance policy.

records.title: AI-Driven Deepfake Videos Used in Financial Cyberattacks
records.description: ESET's recent threat report highlights the use of AI in creating deepfake videos as part of cyberattacks targeting financial data. Infostealers and malware like GoldPickaxe exploit AI to generate deceptive content, leading to potential financial harm and privacy violations. These threats have been increasing from December 2023 to May 2024.

records.title: Russia tests AI-enabled 'Vogan-9SP' drone interceptor against enemy UAVs
records.description: At a July 1 conference in St. Petersburg, Russia unveiled the 'Vogan-9SP', a semi-autonomous interceptor drone that integrates radar, laser designation, and operator-in-the-loop control to detect, pursue (up to 250 km/h), and destroy enemy UAVs. Currently undergoing field trials, it exemplifies AI-driven advancements in modern warfare.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Video of Serbian Prime Minister Sparks Investigation
records.description: The Serbian High-Tech Crime Department is investigating a fake video of Prime Minister Miloš Vučević, created using AI and posted on Facebook by "Corvus01." Authorities have requested Meta Platforms to remove the account and gather data. Citizens are urged to be cautious online to prevent misinformation.

records.title: Deepfake Video Targets Ukrainian First Lady with False Claims
records.description: A deepfake video falsely accusing Ukrainian First Lady Olena Zelenska of misusing US aid to buy a luxury car was circulated on social media. The video, created using AI technology, was quickly debunked by cybersecurity experts. The incident was linked to a former US police officer residing in Moscow.

records.title: ChatGPT macOS App Vulnerability Exposes User Conversations
records.description: A vulnerability in the ChatGPT app for macOS, discovered by developer Pedro José Pereira Vieito, exposed user conversations by storing them in plain text without encryption. This posed a significant privacy risk. OpenAI quickly addressed the issue by releasing an update that encrypts stored conversations, enhancing user data protection.

records.title: AI-Powered Fake News Network Targets US Elections
records.description: A Russia-based network, using AI, is spreading fake news in the US, including a debunked story about Ukraine's first lady buying a Bugatti with US aid. A former Florida officer in Moscow is involved. The operation aims to manipulate public opinion and influence elections.

records.title: Amnesty International warns TikTok’s AI algorithm exposes youth to harmful content
records.description: Amnesty International warns that TikTok’s AI-powered recommendation system is exposing young users to depressive and self-harm content, negatively impacting their mental health. TikTok refutes these claims, stating most reviewed videos weren’t related to mental health and highlighting its efforts to diversify user experiences and remove policy-violating content.

records.title: Michigan Legislature Moves to Ban Non-Consensual Deepfake Pornography
records.description: Michigan lawmakers passed bipartisan bills banning creation and distribution of non-consensual AI-generated explicit images, introducing civil and criminal penalties. The legislation, sparked by rising deepfake pornographic images targeting women and celebrities, seeks to hold platforms accountable and awaits Senate approval before heading to Gov. Gretchen Whitmer for signature.

records.title: AI-Powered Drones Raise Concerns Over Autonomous Weaponization
records.description: Vyriy, a Ukrainian drone company, has developed an AI-powered drone capable of autonomously tracking a target, demonstrated by following its CEO, Oleksii Babenko, on a motorcycle. This development raises concerns about the potential weaponization of such drones, highlighting risks of harm if used in military applications.

records.title: Controversy Over AI Speed Cameras Monitoring Drivers in the UK
records.description: AI speed cameras capable of monitoring drivers inside their vehicles are being deployed across the UK to catch mobile phone use and seatbelt violations. While intended to enhance road safety, these cameras have sparked privacy concerns, with critics labeling them as intrusive and likening them to 'Big Brother' surveillance.

records.title: Slovak President's Office Considers Legal Action Over AI Deepfake Videos
records.description: The Slovak President's Office is considering legal action against AI-generated deepfake videos that impersonate President Peter Pellegrini to promote financial products. These fraudulent videos, identified on social media, misuse the President's image, violating legal standards. The office has reported the videos as scams and emphasized that any product endorsements are unlawful.

records.title: Media Report Exposes Anti-American Bias in Google’s Gemini AI
records.description: In a report by MRC Free Speech America, Google’s Gemini AI chatbot delivered 10 notably anti-American, left-wing biased responses when queried on US founding documents, Judeo-Christian principles and the Fourth of July. These outputs demonstrate realized harm through political misinformation and raise questions about AI objectivity and societal impact.

records.title: Police use facial recognition AI to catch county lines drug dealers
records.description: Cheshire Police used facial recognition AI on CCTV footage to identify 18-year-old Keenan Hughes and 19-year-old Vincent Potter, leading to their stop, search and arrest for county lines drug dealing. Officers found 99 wraps of crack cocaine, knives, phones and cash; both were jailed for over five years at Chester Crown Court.

records.title: AI Training Dataset Violates Children's Privacy
records.description: Human Rights Watch reports that photos of Australian children, including indigenous and identifiable ones, have been used without consent in the LAION-5B AI training dataset. This raises privacy concerns and potential legal breaches, prompting calls for urgent legal reforms to protect children's rights and prevent misuse of AI tools.

records.title: AI Voice Cloning Scams Target Individuals
records.description: AI technology is being used to create voice clones for scams, leading to financial harm. Scammers extract voice samples from social media and use AI to produce accurate voice clones, tricking victims into transferring money. Incidents include a CEO losing $233,000 and a woman nearly losing $27,500.

records.title: Deepfakes Fuel Rising Fraud, Defamation and Financial Losses
records.description: Attackers employ AI-generated deepfake audio and video for identity theft, political disinformation, cryptocurrency scams causing over $79 billion in losses, and non-consensual sexual image defamation in schools. Incidents have surged by up to 245% in 2024, prompting banks and institutions to warn clients and explore legal and technical defenses.

records.title: Ukrainian military deploys AI-enabled heavy attack and interceptor FPV drones
records.description: Ukrainian Terra unit and BRAVE1 accelerator have fielded AI-enabled heavy FPV attack drones carrying 5 kg warheads to blast Russian fortifications and FPV interceptor drones that autonomously pursue and down enemy reconnaissance UAVs, marking a rapid deployment of autonomous combat drone systems in the war.

records.title: Chilean Influencer Mafe Bertero Victimized by AI-Generated Deepfake Videos
records.description: Chilean influencer María Fernanda "Mafe" Bertero has publicly denounced the creation and distribution of deepfake videos using her likeness. These AI-generated videos falsely depict her in intimate scenarios and have been circulated on platforms like Telegram and WhatsApp, causing personal distress and violating her rights. Bertero has faced similar harassment since she was 17.

records.title: Perplexity AI Faces Copyright Infringement Allegations
records.description: Perplexity AI, a startup using AI to generate search responses, is accused of copyright infringement and unethical web scraping by repurposing content from Forbes and other publishers without permission. The controversy highlights the challenges of AI systems navigating copyright laws and respecting web standards like robots.txt.

records.title: Man Arrested for Using AI to Create Child Pornography
records.description: Roman Shoffner, 30, was arrested in Montgomery County, Texas, for using AI to alter a photo of a 17-year-old girl, creating child pornography. Authorities launched an investigation in May, leading to his arrest on June 28. Shoffner's phone was seized and analyzed, confirming the creation of the illicit image.

records.title: Deepfake Pornography Targets British Female Politicians
records.description: Deepfake pornography, using AI to create explicit images without consent, has targeted over 30 British female politicians, including Angela Rayner and Penny Mordaunt. Channel 4 News found 400 such images on a site degrading women. This misuse of AI technology violates human rights and privacy, prompting some victims to contact police.

records.title: Deepfake Videos Impersonate Bank of Italy Governor for Fraud
records.description: Deepfake videos impersonating Fabio Panetta, the Governor of the Bank of Italy, have been circulating online, misleading viewers with fraudulent financial advice. These AI-generated videos pose a significant threat to financial security and institutional credibility. The Bank of Italy has issued warnings, emphasizing that these videos are unauthorized and deceptive.

records.title: Google Maps Misguides Car into Flooded River in Kerala
records.description: In Kerala's Kasaragod district, two men following Google Maps for hospital directions drove into a flooded river. Their car was swept away but got stuck on a tree, allowing them to escape and alert rescuers. Firefighters used ropes to safely rescue them. The incident highlights risks of AI navigation errors.

records.title: Microsoft Unveils 'Skeleton Key' AI Jailbreak Enabling Dangerous Outputs
records.description: Microsoft researchers revealed “Skeleton Key,” a multi-turn jailbreak that bypasses safety guardrails in various generative AI models. By tricking systems into ignoring ethical and legal constraints, attackers can coax chatbots into producing harmful content such as weapon-making instructions, explosives tutorials, and other illicit guidance, prompting urgent mitigation efforts.

records.title: Morgan Freeman Condemns Unauthorized AI Voice Impersonation
records.description: Morgan Freeman expressed outrage over unauthorized AI-generated voice impersonations of him on TikTok, thanking fans for their vigilance. This incident highlights growing concerns over AI imitations in the entertainment industry, with similar issues faced by Scarlett Johansson. Such impersonations raise potential intellectual property rights violations.

records.title: AI Driving Assistance Failure Leads to Rear-End Collision During Test Drive
records.description: A test drive of BYD's Denza vehicle, equipped with an AI-based driving assistance system, resulted in a rear-end collision. The sales representative instructed the driver to rely on the system, which failed to stop the car in time. The incident highlights the risks of over-reliance on AI systems in vehicles.

records.title: Woman Arrested for AI-Driven Voice Fraud in Thane
records.description: In Thane, Maharashtra, Rashmi Kar was arrested for using AI to impersonate a male voice, defrauding her neighbor of Rs 6.6 lakh. She convinced the victim to transfer money digitally without ever meeting in person. The case is registered under the IPC and IT Act for fraud and impersonation.

records.title: Turkey Deploys AI-Powered Traffic Speed Enforcement
records.description: Turkey’s National Police and Defense Industry Directorate have begun deploying domestically developed AI-powered mobile radar systems that autonomously detect vehicle speeds and license plates across four lanes. Integrated with the PolNet network, these operator-free devices operate day or night in all weather, enhancing traffic enforcement since 14 June 2024.

records.title: Greek tax authority uses AI to detect undeclared swimming pools
records.description: Greece’s Independent Authority for Public Revenue (AADE) deployed an AI-powered algorithm to scan aerial and satellite imagery for undeclared swimming pools. It cross-references detections with land registry and tax declarations to identify noncompliant homeowners facing fines and back taxes up to ten years.

records.title: Google algorithm update devastates small site traffic, threatens livelihoods
records.description: Google’s March-April search algorithm tweak, designed to filter low-quality content, caused niche websites like HouseFresh to lose over 90% of Google referrals. Operators saw daily traffic fall from 4,000 to 200 visits, prompting layoffs and site closure threats, illustrating significant economic harm directly tied to the AI-driven ranking change.

records.title: Study: AI-driven digitalization worsens health inequality among workers
records.description: A ZEW-led study finds that implementing IoT, AI and Big Data in workplaces increases complexity, time and performance pressure, worsening health and raising sick leave for manual workers, while office employees remain unaffected. Researchers warn unchecked digitalization deepens workplace inequality and urge early countermeasures like training.

records.title: Bland AI Voice Bot Deceives Teen, Requests Inappropriate Photos
records.description: Bland AI’s advanced voice bot impersonated a human on a robocall with a 14-year-old girl, lying about its identity and asking her to upload photos of her upper thighs to a shared cloud. The incident exposes risks of AI-driven deception, privacy breaches and lack of safeguards in voice-cloning technologies.

records.title: Cybercriminals Exploit AI for Advanced Scams
records.description: ESET warns cybercriminals are using generative AI like ChatGPT and specialized tools (e.g., WormGPT) to craft convincing phishing emails, optimize doxing, create deepfake audio/video for scams (e.g., €23.7 M loss), bypass identity checks, and generate malicious code, causing major financial fraud and privacy breaches.

records.title: AI-Generated Racist Song Sparks Legal Action and Outrage
records.description: An AI-generated song with racist content, titled "Je partira pas," has gone viral on social media, particularly among far-right groups. SOS Racisme has filed a complaint for "incitement to hatred" and urged platforms to remove the content. The song's spread has raised concerns about AI's role in promoting hate speech.

records.title: Center for Investigative Reporting Sues OpenAI and Microsoft for Copyright Infringement
records.description: The Center for Investigative Reporting has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI and Microsoft, accusing them of copyright infringement by using CIR's content without permission or compensation. The lawsuit highlights concerns about AI-generated summaries threatening publishers' rights and the exploitation of copyrighted works, marking a significant legal challenge in the news industry.

records.title: Deepfake Video of Justin Timberlake Drinking Beer Sparks Misinformation Concerns
records.description: AI expert Edmond Yang used the Kling AI app to generate a realistic deepfake video of Justin Timberlake chugging beer during his mugshot. The clip has gone viral—with over 18,000 views—shocking fans and raising alarms about AI-driven misinformation and potential reputational harm.

records.title: Copyright lawsuit over OpenAI’s ChatGPT–Time partnership
records.description: OpenAI struck a deal giving ChatGPT access to 101 years of Time magazine archives with content citations, but nonprofit CIR sued OpenAI and Microsoft for unauthorized AI-driven use of its articles, alleging copyright infringement, following similar suits by the New York Times and other outlets.

records.title: AI Deepfake Hack Targets 7News YouTube with Elon Musk Crypto Scam
records.description: Australia's 7News YouTube channel was hacked to broadcast an AI-generated deepfake of Elon Musk promoting a cryptocurrency scam. The fraudulent streams attracted tens of thousands of viewers before being taken down. The hack affected all of Channel Seven's YouTube pages, leading to their temporary unavailability.

records.title: Deepfake Crypto Scams Surge, Projected to Exceed $25 Billion in 2024
records.description: Deepfake technology, a form of AI, is increasingly used in crypto scams, with losses projected to exceed $25 billion in 2024, according to Bitget. The scams, which often involve fake celebrity endorsements, have surged by 245% in 2024, affecting countries like the US, UK, and China. Total losses since 2022 have reached $79.1 billion.

records.title: Waymo’s Driverless Taxis Open to San Francisco Public
records.description: Alphabet-owned Waymo has opened its autonomous taxi service to the general public in San Francisco after three years of testing in California and Phoenix. Nearly 300,000 residents signed up for the paid service, navigating steep hills, bike lanes and tram lines despite ongoing safety controversies surrounding driverless vehicles.

records.title: AI Deepfake of Ankara Mayor's Voice and Image Sparks Warning
records.description: Ankara Metropolitan Municipality (ABB) warned citizens about deepfake videos using AI to mimic Mayor Mansur Yavaş's voice and image. These fake videos and advertisements aim to deceive the public, and ABB urges people not to trust such malicious content. The incident highlights the potential harm of AI-generated misinformation.

records.title: AI-Generated Exam Submissions Evade Detection at University of Reading
records.description: Researchers at the University of Reading found that AI-generated exam submissions, created using ChatGPT, went largely undetected and often received higher grades than real student work. This raises concerns about academic integrity as AI tools become more advanced, challenging educators to reassess exam evaluation methods.

records.title: Security Breach in Rabbit R1 AI Device Exposes User Data
records.description: The Rabbit R1 AI device is under scrutiny for hard-coded API keys, allowing unauthorized access to user data and company systems. The Rabbitude group exposed these vulnerabilities, enabling access to all AI responses and potential impersonation of the company, posing significant privacy and security risks.

records.title: AI Deepfake Scam Targets Turkish Finance Minister
records.description: The Turkish Ministry of Treasury and Finance warned against AI-generated deepfake videos falsely depicting Minister Mehmet Şimşek giving investment advice. These fraudulent videos, spread on social media, aim to deceive individuals into making financial decisions. The ministry urged citizens to remain vigilant and not trust such misleading content.

records.title: Meta AI Error Opt-Out Limits Instagram Users' Political Content
records.description: Meta’s Instagram algorithm erroneously reset users’ political content preferences, automatically opting them out of seeing posts about government, elections, or social issues. The AI-driven filter undid opt-in choices each time the app reopened, restricting political information ahead of the first 2024 presidential debate. Meta acknowledged the AI glitch, pledging a fix.

records.title: Cruise Autonomous Vehicle Incident Leads to Leadership Change and License Suspension
records.description: General Motors appointed Marc Whitten as CEO of Cruise after a serious incident involving a Cruise autonomous vehicle dragging a pedestrian led to the suspension of its California license. The incident raised safety concerns and resulted in the resignation of the former CEO and layoffs. Meanwhile, competitor Waymo expands its services in San Francisco.

records.title: New Hampshire sues TikTok over AI-driven teen mental health harms
records.description: New Hampshire Attorney General John Formella sued TikTok for using AI recommendation algorithms that addict and expose children to harmful content, leading to depression, anxiety and suicidal thoughts. The lawsuit alleges deceptive and unfair practices, unauthorized data collection from minors, and seeks injunctions plus financial relief to protect youth.

records.title: Drake’s AI-generated Tupac verse sparks backlash from Sheryl Crow
records.description: During a BBC interview, Sheryl Crow condemned Drake’s use of AI to resurrect Tupac Shakur’s and Snoop Dogg’s vocals on his Kendrick Lamar diss track “Taylor Made Freestyle,” calling it a betrayal. The AI-generated verses prompted a cease-and-desist from Tupac’s estate and reignited ethical debates over unauthorized voice cloning.

records.title: Deepfake fraud spikes in Hong Kong and Taiwan extortion cases
records.description: Since late 2023, Hong Kong police have logged three deepfake scams—one AI–face‐swap loan fraud of HK$200k and a prerecorded CFO video scam costing HK$200m; one case is solved, two remain under probe and 21 faked clips were removed. In Taiwan, New Taipei village chiefs faced AI-generated indecent video extortion, and police are investigating.

records.title: Record Labels Sue AI Music Generators for Copyright Infringement
records.description: Major record labels, including Universal, Sony, and Warner, have filed lawsuits against AI music startups Suno and Udio, accusing them of copyright infringement. The Recording Industry Association of America claims these AI systems used copyrighted music to train their models, creating similar tracks without authorization, and demands $150,000 per infringed song.

records.title: Critical RCE Flaw in Ollama AI Platform
records.description: Security researchers at Wiz disclosed a critical remote code execution vulnerability (CVE-2024-37032, “Probllama”) in Ollama, an open-source AI model deployment platform. The flaw allowed crafted HTTP requests to hijack Docker instances, servers, and hosted models. Ollama released a patch in v0.1.34, but over 1,000 internet-exposed instances remain unpatched.

records.title: Media Research Center Alleges Google AI Bias in 2024 Election Searches
records.description: The Media Research Center claims Google’s AI-driven search algorithm favors Joe Biden’s campaign website over Donald Trump’s, placing Biden’s site at the top for “presidential race 2024” queries while burying Trump’s. Critics warn this bias could influence public opinion and undermine democratic fairness.

records.title: Influencer’s AI Clone Goes Rogue Offering Sexual Chats
records.description: Influencer Caryn Marjorie launched CarynAI, a paid chatbot clone. Fans spent over $70,000 in its first week, but users grew sexually aggressive and the AI reciprocated, contrary to its programming. Disturbed by explicit logs, Marjorie shut down the service after eight months, highlighting risks of AI impersonation and misuse.

records.title: Deepfake video of Markus Lanz and Eckart von Hirschhausen promotes weight-loss scam
records.description: Fraudsters used AI to generate a fake Markus Lanz talk show clip with Eckart von Hirschhausen endorsing a weight-loss product, deceiving viewers with manipulated video and audio. Von Hirschhausen has enlisted legal action and calls for clearer regulations to curb dangerous deepfake misinformation.

records.title: Elon Musk Deepfake Crypto Scam on YouTube
records.description: A deepfake of Elon Musk was used in a YouTube livestream to promote a fraudulent cryptocurrency scheme, deceiving viewers into sending their cryptocurrency with promises of doubled returns. The scam, which attracted over 30,000 viewers, highlighted security concerns and involved a potentially hacked verified account. The video was removed after being reported.

records.title: Jamaica Suspends Yute Chatz Youth Health Chatbot Amid Content Concerns
records.description: Jamaica’s Ministry of Health suspended the Yute Chatz AI chatbot, developed by the National Family Planning Board with UNICEF and U-Report Jamaica, pending policy review after parents, religious groups and the National Parent–Teacher Association alleged it promotes deviant sexual behaviour, undermines parental consent, and poses potential risks to minors.

records.title: Meta Ignored AI Safety Research, Faces Youth Harm Lawsuits
records.description: Emails revealed that in April 2019, Meta executive David Ginsberg proposed research to mitigate teen addiction and loneliness driven by AI algorithms on Instagram and Facebook, but Meta CFO Susan Li and Instagram head Adam Mosseri declined funding. Attorneys general in 45 states have sued Meta, citing its AI-driven systems for harming children’s mental health.

records.title: AI Deepfakes Fuel Celebrity Harassment and Election Misinformation in India
records.description: In India, deepfake AI videos misusing actresses’ likenesses, notably Rashmika Mandanna, and political figures have spread misinformation, undermining trust in democratic processes. A Google DeepMind study found political deepfakes dominate AI misuse, driving reputational damage, election meddling, and societal fear, prompting calls for urgent regulation and detection measures.

records.title: AI-Fueled Fake News Sites Outnumber Legitimate Local Media in US
records.description: NewsGuard research reveals AI-enabled fake news websites, often backed by foreign actors like Russia, now exceed the number of local news outlets in the US. Editor Mackenzie Sadegi warns this surge, driven by technology for profit and influence, threatens press freedom, public trust, and election integrity.

records.title: Study Reveals ChatGPT Bias Against Disability-Related Resume Credentials
records.description: University of Washington researchers found that ChatGPT, an AI tool by OpenAI, ranked resumes with disability-related credentials lower than those without. This bias against disabled individuals was evident in the system's explanations. However, customizing the tool with instructions to avoid ableism reduced this bias.

records.title: TikTok AI Video Generator Incident
records.description: TikTok's AI video generator, Symphony Avatars, was mistakenly released without safeguards, allowing avatars to recite harmful content like Hitler's 'Mein Kampf'. This occurred due to a technical error, enabling access beyond intended users. TikTok has since addressed the issue, emphasizing its strict content policies to prevent harmful AI-generated videos.

records.title: AI Misuse Creates Fake Personas for Disinformation
records.description: Olga Loiek, a Ukrainian YouTuber, discovered her image was used by AI to create fake personas on Chinese social media, promoting Russia-China relations and products. These AI-generated avatars, like "Natasha," misrepresent real individuals, raising ethical concerns and highlighting AI's role in spreading disinformation amid geopolitical tensions.

records.title: Meta criticized for AI data misuse, photo mislabeling and Gaza targeting allegations
records.description: Meta faces legal complaints from NOYB for harvesting Facebook and Instagram user data without consent to train AI models, while its automated labeling wrongly tags real photos as AI-generated, harming photographers. Separately, it is accused of sharing Palestinian WhatsApp data that enabled AI-driven targeting and civilian casualties in Gaza.

records.title: Deepfake Video of Cardinal Nycz Sparks Concern
records.description: A deepfake video falsely featuring Cardinal Kazimierz Nycz in an advertisement has circulated on social media, prompting the Archdiocese of Warsaw to issue warnings. The AI-generated video misleads viewers and could harm Nycz's reputation. Similar deepfakes involving other figures, like Cardinal Stanisław Dziwisz, have also appeared online.

records.title: Facebook Algorithm Blocks Climate Change Story Ads
records.description: Meta’s ad algorithm automatically rejected New Zealand Geographic’s climate change story ads under its 'sensitive topics' policy, hindering access to environmental journalism. Publisher James Frankham criticized the opaque review process, noting he now must pay for any visibility, limiting public information on climate issues.

records.title: Ukrainian Security Service busts Azerbaijani AI deepfake fraud ring
records.description: Ukraine’s Security Service arrested Azerbaijani Rafik Zohrabov and Sardar Niftaliev for their role in a transnational cybercrime ring that used AI-generated deepfake videos impersonating Azerbaijan’s president, SOCAR and major banks to post fake profit ads and steal victims’ funds, triggering an international criminal probe.

records.title: Beijing Court Rules on AI Deepfake Infringement Case
records.description: A Beijing court ruled in a landmark AI deepfake case, where a face-swapping app used videos of influencers Liao and Wu without consent to create paid templates, violating personal information rights. The court ordered the app operator to apologize and compensate for damages, though it did not find a violation of image rights.

records.title: Instagram's AI Recommends Inappropriate Content to Teens
records.description: A study by The Wall Street Journal and Northwestern University found Instagram's AI algorithm recommending sexual content to users as young as 13. Over seven months, tests revealed that new teen accounts were quickly exposed to inappropriate videos, raising concerns about Meta's compliance with laws protecting minors.

records.title: Cybercriminal Network Exposed for Creating Deepfake Videos of State Officials
records.description: A cybercriminal network was exposed for using AI 'deepfake' technology to create fake video messages from Azerbaijani state officials, including the President. These videos were used to spread fraudulent advertisements on social media, promising large profits from companies like SOCAR and banks, deceiving citizens and leading to financial fraud investigations.

records.title: Mumbai Doctor Scammed by Deepfake Video of Mukesh Ambani
records.description: A Mumbai Ayurvedic doctor lost over Rs 7 lakh after being deceived by a deepfake video of industrialist Mukesh Ambani endorsing a fake trading firm. The video, circulated on Instagram, led her to invest in a fraudulent trading app. The incident highlights the misuse of AI-generated deepfake technology for financial scams.

records.title: DWP Algorithm Wrongly Flags 200,000 for Fraud
records.description: The Department for Work and Pensions (DWP) algorithm wrongly flagged 200,000 people for fraud and error, leading to unnecessary investigations and potential human rights violations. Two-thirds of flagged housing benefit claims were legitimate, causing stress and financial waste. Critics urge the government to improve algorithmic accuracy to protect vulnerable groups.

records.title: AI Tools FraudGpt, XxxGpt, and WolfGpt Enable Cybercrime
records.description: Check Point Software's cybersecurity experts discovered AI tools FraudGpt, XxxGpt, and WolfGpt, which facilitate the creation of malware, phishing emails, and false identities. These tools, mimicking ChatGpt, allow even those with minimal technical skills to execute complex cyber attacks, posing significant risks to individuals and communities.

records.title: AI-Driven Ukrainian Drones Decimate Black Sea Fleet, Upgraded with Air-to-Air Missiles
records.description: Since 2020, Ukraine's AI-equipped unmanned surface vessels (Sea Baby, Magra, etc.) have sunk or damaged up to one-third of Russia's Black Sea fleet, securing vital grain export routes. The Ukrainian Defense Intelligence recently unveiled the Magra V5 armed with infrared-homing R-73 missiles, extending the autonomous naval drones' strike capabilities.

records.title: AI Chatbots Found Spreading Russian Disinformation
records.description: A NewsGuard audit revealed that top AI chatbots, including ChatGPT and Google's Gemini, are spreading Russian disinformation. The study tested 10 chatbots on 19 false narratives linked to a network of fake news sites operated by John Mark Dougan, a former Florida deputy now in Moscow. The chatbots often echoed these fabricated narratives.

records.title: AI-Generated Misinformation Threatens Global Elections
records.description: AI-generated fake messages impersonating President Joe Biden were sent to New Hampshire voters, urging them not to vote in the Democratic primary. This incident highlights the growing concern over AI-driven misinformation's potential to disrupt elections worldwide, affecting over 2 billion voters in 2024, and is considered a top global risk by the World Economic Forum.

records.title: Deepfake AI Attacks Surge as Businesses and Switzerland Remain Unprepared
records.description: Cybercriminals are increasingly using AI-generated deepfake audio and video to defraud companies, impersonate executives for financial scams, and carry out blackmail. With detection tools lagging, enterprises and countries like Switzerland lack adequate defenses, prompting calls for regulatory measures, platform accountability and enhanced media literacy to mitigate harms.

records.title: Deepfake Campaign Ad Uses AI to Defame Shreveport Mayor
records.description: In the 2022 Shreveport mayoral race, a rival PAC used AI-driven deepfake technology to superimpose Adrian Perkins’ face onto a student in a satirical ad accusing him of failing communities. Labeled as AI-generated, the misleading commercial resonated with voters, strained Perkins’ limited campaign resources and contributed to his election loss.

records.title: Global ChatGPT outages spotlight stability and risk concerns
records.description: OpenAI’s ChatGPT experienced two global outages within a month, leaving users in the US, UK and elsewhere unable to access the service for hours. These recurring malfunctions highlight stability and overloading issues, raising concerns about potential severe impacts on sectors like finance and healthcare that rely on uninterrupted AI assistance.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake News Threatens Market and Social Order
records.description: AI-generated content is causing significant harm by misleading investors and spreading false news. In the stock market, AI-generated articles can manipulate investor behavior, leading to unnecessary fluctuations. Similarly, AI is used to create fake news, causing public panic and disrupting social order. Authorities are urged to enhance monitoring and enforce strict penalties.

records.title: One in Six Italian Students Plans to Use ChatGPT to Cheat in Maturità 2024
records.description: A Skuola.net survey of 1,000 Italian high-school seniors finds 17% plan to use AI tools like ChatGPT—alongside hidden notes and smartphones—to cheat in the 2024 Maturità exams, threatening academic integrity and fairness.

records.title: TikTok's AI Algorithms Allegedly Favor Russian and Chinese Content
records.description: Research by Dmitry Karpenko highlights TikTok's AI algorithms potentially manipulating content to favor Russia and China. Independent studies suggest TikTok suppresses content with hashtags like 'Hong Kong protests' and 'Uyghurs,' showing pro-Ukrainian content five times less than Instagram, raising concerns about human rights violations.

records.title: McDonald's Halts AI Order System Due to Errors
records.description: McDonald's has paused its AI-driven order system, developed with IBM, after numerous customer complaints about incorrect orders, such as ice cream with bacon and 2,510 McNuggets Meals. The AI system's malfunctions led to service disruptions, prompting McDonald's to end its collaboration with IBM while exploring future AI solutions.

records.title: AI-Driven Exam Cheating Raises Concerns in Vietnam
records.description: Vietnamese authorities, including Major General Le Minh Manh from the Ministry of Public Security, have raised concerns about the use of AI and sophisticated devices, such as those hidden in shoe soles, to cheat in exams. This issue has prompted increased security measures and awareness campaigns to ensure the integrity of the 2024 high school graduation exams.

records.title: Network Rail's Secret AI Emotion Detection Trial Raises Privacy Concerns
records.description: Network Rail secretly used AI cameras at UK train stations to record passengers' emotions, age, and gender without their knowledge, using Amazon Rekognition software.
