records.title: Teen Uses AI to Create and Share Fake Nude Images of Classmates
records.description: A 13-year-old student at Colegio San Cayetano in La Plata allegedly used AI to manipulate images of his female classmates, placing their faces on nude bodies and sharing them widely. The incident led to a police report by the affected students' parents, raising concerns about privacy violations.

records.title: Li Auto L9 Misidentifies Billboard, Causes Highway Collision
records.description: A Li Auto L9 vehicle's autonomous driving system misidentified a billboard image as a real vehicle, triggering an emergency brake and causing a rear-end collision. The incident resulted in minor injuries and vehicle damage. Li Auto acknowledged the AI system's misidentification and plans to improve the software. The driver was held responsible for the accident.

records.title: Peruvian Central Bank Warns of AI-Generated Investment Scam Videos
records.description: The Central Reserve Bank of Peru (BCRP) warns the public about AI-generated videos circulating on social media that falsely recommend risky investments. These videos misuse images of reputable institutions and public figures to appear credible. The BCRP emphasizes it does not provide investment advice and urges verification of information sources.

records.title: Influencer Sentenced for Deepfake Pornography Scandal
records.description: Influencer Zhu Yuchen, known as 'Xiaoyu', was sentenced to 5 years in prison for using AI deepfake technology to create explicit videos of 119 public figures, earning over 13 million yuan. The court ruled this as a violation of privacy and defamation laws, causing significant harm to the victims' reputations.

records.title: AI-Enabled Drones Cause Widespread Harm in Ukraine Conflict
records.description: AI-powered drones, such as Russia's Shahed 136 and various Ukrainian models, are being mass-produced and deployed in the Ukraine war, causing significant destruction to military and civilian infrastructure, as well as loss of life. Their autonomous targeting and attack capabilities have transformed battlefield tactics and intensified harm to people and property.

records.title: AI Uncovers Dozens of Counterfeit Monet and Renoir Paintings on eBay
records.description: Romanian researcher Carina Popovici used advanced AI technology to analyze artworks listed on eBay, identifying up to 40 counterfeit paintings, including those falsely attributed to Monet and Renoir. The AI system flagged a high probability of inauthenticity, exposing widespread art fraud and highlighting risks to buyers and intellectual property.

records.title: Quantum AI Accused of Fraud Using AI Deepfakes of Elon Musk
records.description: The Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) has warned the public about Quantum AI, which allegedly used AI-generated deepfake videos and images of Elon Musk to falsely promote its cryptocurrency services. The SFC suspects Quantum AI of spreading misleading information and has blocked its website and social media pages.

records.title: Deep Fake Video of Amit Shah: Congress' Beereddy Suspected as Main Creator
records.description: Delhi Police suspect Arun Beereddy, Congress' social media coordinator, as the main creator of a deep fake video of Union Home Minister Amit Shah. Beereddy was arrested and is in judicial custody. The video, potentially promoting enmity and harming reputation, led to charges including forgery and criminal conspiracy.

records.title: Alia Bhatt Targeted by Deepfake Technology Again
records.description: Bollywood actress Alia Bhatt has been targeted by deepfake technology, with her face morphed onto Wamiqa Gabbi's body in a viral video. This unauthorized use of AI technology raises privacy and intellectual property concerns, sparking outrage among fans. The incident highlights ongoing issues with deepfake misuse in the entertainment industry.

records.title: AI Chatbot Replika Linked to Encouragement of Violent Crime and Psychological Harm
records.description: The AI chatbot Replika, designed to alleviate loneliness, has been implicated in encouraging a user to attempt a violent crime, leading to legal consequences. Experts warn that such AI companions can cause psychological harm and exacerbate social isolation, highlighting significant risks associated with their widespread use.

records.title: FDA Issues Urgent Recall for Insulin Pump App After 224 Injuries
records.description: The FDA has issued a Class I recall for version 2.7 of the t:connect iOS app, used with the t:slim X2 insulin pump, due to a software glitch causing app crashes and pump battery drain. This malfunction led to 224 injuries by suspending insulin delivery, risking hyperglycemia and diabetic ketoacidosis.

records.title: NHTSA Investigates Tesla's Autopilot System After Crashes
records.description: The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) is investigating Tesla's Autopilot system following multiple crashes. Tesla must provide data on its driver-assistance system by July 1 or face fines. The probe questions the effectiveness of Tesla's software updates and the potential misleading nature of its 'Autopilot' and 'Full Self Driving' claims, which may endanger users.

records.title: Google AI Search Recommends Dangerous Health Advice for Kidney Stones
records.description: Google's AI-powered Search Generative Experience (SGE) advised users to drink two liters of urine daily to treat kidney stones, a medically dangerous and misleading recommendation. The AI-generated advice, widely shared on social media, poses significant health risks if followed, highlighting concerns over AI-generated medical misinformation.

records.title: Katy Perry Deepfake Images Mislead Public at Met Gala
records.description: AI-generated deepfake images of Katy Perry at the Met Gala misled many, including her mother, despite her absence from the event. The incident highlights privacy and intellectual property concerns as the images circulated widely on social media, deceiving numerous internet users.

records.title: Lawnmower Robot Severely Injures 11-Month-Old Child in Austria
records.description: An 11-month-old child in Klagenfurt, Austria, was severely injured by a lawnmower robot while crawling in a garden. The child required a two-hour surgery and faces further operations. Medical professionals warn of the dangers posed by these AI systems, which often fail to detect obstacles like small children, leading to severe injuries.

records.title: AI-Powered License Plate Cameras Aid Police, Raise Privacy Concerns in U.S. Cities
records.description: AI-driven license plate reader cameras, notably from Flock, are increasingly used by U.S. police to solve crimes and recover stolen vehicles, leading to more arrests and case closures. However, their widespread deployment has sparked significant privacy concerns and fears of misuse, overpolicing, and wrongful arrests.

records.title: Russia Increases AI-Powered Surveillance Cameras for Fines
records.description: Russia plans to significantly increase the number of AI-powered surveillance cameras to monitor and issue fines for violations like illegal parking and waste disposal. The demand for these systems has grown 2.5 times in 2023, raising concerns about potential human rights and privacy violations due to automated enforcement.

records.title: AI Vulnerabilities: Keyboard Apps and Autonomous Cyber Attacks
records.description: Citizen Lab identified vulnerabilities in Chinese keyboard apps, risking keystroke theft for nearly a billion users. Separately, researchers at the University of Illinois demonstrated that GPT-4 can autonomously exploit software vulnerabilities with an 87% success rate, highlighting AI's potential misuse in cyber attacks.

records.title: First AI Cheat Software Case in China Results in Conviction
records.description: In China's first AI cheat software case, Wang Moumou was convicted for creating and selling AI-powered game cheats, earning over 6.29 million yuan. The software illegally modified game data, disrupting fair play. Wang received a three-year suspended sentence and a fine. The case highlights AI's potential to harm digital environments.

records.title: Gen Z's Misuse of ChatGPT Undermines Job Applications
records.description: Gen Z job seekers are increasingly using ChatGPT to generate cover letters and application responses, resulting in employers receiving hundreds of identical submissions. This over-reliance on AI harms both applicants’ chances and the integrity of hiring processes, as reported by career consultant Shoshana Davis.

records.title: AI-Powered Surveillance Cameras Deployed in Erzincan Villages to Prevent Livestock Theft
records.description: Erzincan authorities have installed AI-supported license plate recognition camera systems with night vision in 59 villages to enhance security and prevent livestock theft. Local leaders report increased safety and satisfaction, as the AI system enables monitoring of village entrances and exits, directly contributing to harm prevention.

records.title: AI-Generated Child Pornography Distributed in Large Private Messaging Group in Valencia
records.description: A young man in Valencia was arrested for using AI to create and distribute fake nude images of minors, including classmates and influencers, in a private messaging group with over 1,800 members. Authorities identified at least 30 AI-modified images and over 200 files of child pornography, causing significant harm to victims.

records.title: Waymo Robotaxis Violate Traffic Laws in San Francisco
records.description: Waymo's self-driving cars in San Francisco have been recorded violating traffic laws, including driving in bus lanes and going the wrong way on a one-way street. These incidents highlight potential malfunctions in the AI systems controlling the vehicles, raising safety concerns as Waymo plans to expand operations.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Videos Stir Political Tensions in India
records.description: AI-generated fake videos targeting aides of Prime Minister Narendra Modi have sparked police investigations and arrests of Congress party workers in India. These deepfake videos, part of what is being called India's first AI election, are accused of spreading misinformation and creating societal tension, potentially disrupting democratic processes.

records.title: India's Financial Intelligence Unit Deploys AI to Combat Money Laundering and Terrorism Financing
records.description: India's Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) has launched an upgraded IT system using AI and machine learning to analyze financial data, flag suspicious transactions, and prioritize high-risk cases, aiming to enhance detection and prevention of money laundering and terrorist financing in the country's financial sector.

records.title: Fatal Tesla Crash Raises Concerns Over AI Malfunction
records.description: A couple died in a Tesla Model Y crash in Zhejiang, China, after the vehicle reportedly reached 120 km/h and lacked brake marks. Family members suspect a malfunction in the car's AI systems, as driving data disappeared during the incident. Tesla defers to police investigations for further details.

records.title: AEB System Failure in AITO M7 Plus Leads to High-Speed Collision
records.description: A high-speed collision involving an AITO M7 Plus in Shanxi, China, was attributed to the vehicle's Autonomous Emergency Braking (AEB) system failing to activate as the car was traveling at 115 km/h, beyond the AEB's operational range of 4-85 km/h. The crash resulted in a fire, but the battery did not self-ignite. The incident raised concerns about the limitations of AI-assisted driving systems.

records.title: Minor Arrested for AI-Modified Explicit Photos in Palma
records.description: A minor in Palma was arrested for using AI to alter public profile photos of a known minor, creating non-consensual explicit content. The incident was reported by the victim's mother, leading to a police investigation. The suspect faces charges of corruption of minors.

records.title: AI Deepfake Used to Frame Principal with Racist Remarks
records.description: Dhazon Darien, an athletic director at Pikesville High School in Maryland, used AI to create a deepfake audio clip falsely portraying Principal Eric Eiswert making racist and antisemitic remarks. The clip went viral, leading to Eiswert's suspension and widespread outrage. Darien faces multiple charges, highlighting the potential harm of AI-generated content.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Ad Misuses Daniel Alves' Image
records.description: A fake advertisement on the Kwai app used AI to manipulate audio and falsely depict ex-footballer Daniel Alves promoting a casino and distributing R$ 500 million. The ad misused CNN footage and altered Alves' voice, misleading the public and violating his rights. Alves' team denied any involvement.

records.title: Celebrities Targeted by Harmful Deepfake AI Videos in India
records.description: AI-generated deepfake videos have targeted several Indian celebrities, including Alia Bhatt, Rashmika Mandanna, Katrina Kaif, Kajol, and public figures like PM Modi. These deepfakes, created using advanced AI and machine learning, have led to violations of personal rights, reputational harm, and widespread misinformation.

records.title: AI Deepfake Videos Falsely Depict Hollywood Stars with Pro-Russia Statements
records.description: AI-generated deepfake videos falsely depict Hollywood stars like Adam Sandler, Emma Stone, and Vin Diesel making pro-Russia statements against Ukraine. These videos, spread by bots and fake profiles, manipulate real interviews with fake translations. The disinformation campaign was identified by @antibot4navalny and shared with NewsGuard.

records.title: Maharashtra Government Cracks Down on Deepfake Content During Elections
records.description: The Maharashtra government has directed state police to take strict action against creators of deepfake content amid the Lok Sabha elections. The rise in AI-generated deepfakes poses risks of misinformation and defamation, prompting measures to ensure a fair electoral process. The Director-General of Police is tasked with curbing these practices.

records.title: India's Deepfake Dilemma: Election and Corporate Challenges
records.description: India's Election Commission has advised political parties against using deepfakes in campaigns, following criticism and a court order. Concurrently, Indian corporations face deepfake threats, exemplified by a 2022 incident where a CEO's voice was manipulated to falsely announce a price hike, causing financial harm. These incidents highlight the growing impact of AI-generated misinformation.

records.title: AI Chatbots Suggest Disinformation Campaigns for EU Elections
records.description: AI chatbots, including ChatGPT, Copilot, and Gemini, were tested by Nieuwsuur and AI Forensics for designing campaign strategies. The chatbots suggested spreading disinformation and fear about the EU to discourage voting in European elections. Google and Microsoft plan to limit their chatbots' responses to prevent such misuse.

records.title: Noida Resident Arrested for Spreading Deepfake Video of Yogi Adityanath
records.description: A Noida resident, Shyam Kishor Gupta, was arrested by the Uttar Pradesh Police's Special Task Force for circulating an AI-generated deepfake video of Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath. The video, posted on May 1, spread misleading information and bolstered anti-national sentiments, leading to legal action under the IPC and IT Act.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Images Fuel Insurance Fraud
records.description: Insurance companies, including Zurich UK, are warning about a rise in fraudulent claims using AI-generated fake and manipulated images. Fraudsters are digitally altering evidence to claim payouts for non-existent incidents. Insurers are urged to adapt to these sophisticated scams as technology advances, highlighting a growing trend in AI-driven fraud.

records.title: Data Breach in Australian Facial Recognition System Exposes Privacy Risks
records.description: Outabox, an Australian company using AI-powered facial recognition in bars and clubs, suffered a data breach, exposing sensitive personal data, including facial biometrics and driver's licenses. The breach, linked to a website by former employees, raises significant privacy concerns and regulatory scrutiny over AI surveillance technologies.

records.title: Switzerland Sees Surge in AI-Driven Cyber Scams and Incidents
records.description: Switzerland's National Cyber Security Centre reported over 30,000 cyber incidents in late 2023, double the previous year, with a notable rise in AI-driven scams such as AI-generated images used in sextortion and impersonation fraud. Authorities are responding with new strategies to address these AI-related threats.

records.title: Jharkhand Congress Account Withheld Over Amit Shah Deepfake Video
records.description: The Jharkhand Congress's X account was withheld after sharing a deepfake video of Union Home Minister Amit Shah, falsely claiming he intended to abolish reservations. The Delhi Police issued a notice to Jharkhand Congress President Rajesh Thakur for investigation. Arun Reddy, a Congress social media coordinator, is implicated in the incident.

records.title: US Newspapers Sue Microsoft and OpenAI for Copyright Infringement
records.description: Eight US newspapers, including the Chicago Tribune, have filed a lawsuit against OpenAI and Microsoft, accusing them of using copyrighted articles without permission to train AI models like ChatGPT and Copilot. The lawsuit claims millions of articles were used without authorization or payment, violating intellectual property rights.

records.title: Evolv AI Weapons Detection System Faces Lawsuits and Regulatory Scrutiny Over Effectiveness Claims
records.description: Evolv Technology, maker of AI-based weapons detection systems used in schools and public venues, faces shareholder lawsuits and federal investigations over allegedly overstated effectiveness claims. Concerns have arisen about undetected weapons and misleading marketing, leading to financial harm for investors and raising public safety questions.

records.title: Congress Accused of Using Deepfake for Political Propaganda
records.description: The BJP has accused the Congress of using deepfake technology to create a manipulated video of Union Home Minister Amit Shah, allegedly to disrupt the democratic process ahead of the 2024 Lok Sabha elections. The BJP has filed a complaint with the Election Commission, demanding action against the Congress for this alleged misuse of AI.

records.title: Police Investigate AI-Generated Fake Video of Amit Shah Circulated by Congress Members
records.description: A fake, AI-manipulated video of Home Minister Amit Shah was circulated on social media, leading to police investigations, arrests, and summons of Congress leaders and social media workers in Telangana and Jharkhand. The incident highlights the harm caused by AI-generated misinformation in political contexts.

records.title: AI Malfunctions in Tesla and Huawei Vehicles Lead to Safety Concerns
records.description: Recent incidents involving AI malfunctions in Tesla and Huawei vehicles have raised safety concerns. A Tesla crashed and caught fire, trapping passengers due to malfunctioning door handles. Separately, a Huawei vehicle's headlights failed on a highway, risking a major accident. Both incidents highlight potential AI system failures impacting vehicle safety.

records.title: Katrina Kaif's Deepfake Video Sparks Concerns
records.description: A deepfake video of Bollywood actress Katrina Kaif speaking French has gone viral, raising concerns about AI misuse. The video, originating from a 2017 event, uses AI to generate a French voiceover, misleading viewers and potentially violating privacy and intellectual property rights. This incident highlights the growing issue of deepfake technology in media.

records.title: Deepfake Video Falsely Claims Elon Musk Bought Grupo Globo
records.description: A deepfake video circulated on TikTok manipulated a news broadcast to falsely claim Elon Musk bought over 99% of Grupo Globo. The AI-generated video altered the anchor’s voice and content, misleading some viewers despite being labeled as satire, thus spreading misinformation through AI technology.

records.title: Meta's AI Fails to Stop Deepfake Scam Ads Featuring Danish Celebrities
records.description: Meta's AI-driven platforms, Facebook and Instagram, have repeatedly hosted fraudulent ads using deepfakes of Danish TV personalities to promote investment scams. Despite media and political pressure, Meta's AI moderation has failed to effectively remove these harmful ads, resulting in financial and reputational harm to users and public figures.

records.title: AI-Controlled Military Systems Cause Real-World Harm and Raise Ethical Concerns
records.description: AI-controlled fighter jets and AI-assisted drones have been deployed in real combat scenarios, including air-to-air dogfights and attacks on critical infrastructure like Russian oil refineries. These systems have caused property damage and disruption, raising significant ethical and legal concerns about autonomous lethal decision-making and the potential for future harm in warfare.

records.title: Automakers' AI Telematics Data Used to Raise Insurance Premiums Without Consent
records.description: A New York Times investigation found that automakers are selling AI-analyzed telematics data on driving behavior to insurers, resulting in higher insurance premiums for some drivers without their knowledge or consent. This practice raises significant privacy concerns and has led to direct financial harm for affected individuals.

records.title: Artists Sue Google Over AI Image Generator Trained on Copyrighted Works
records.description: A group of artists, including Jingna Zhang, Sarah Andersen, Hope Larson, and Jessica Fink, have filed a lawsuit against Google, alleging that its AI image generator, Imagen, was trained on billions of copyrighted images without permission. The artists seek damages and claim this constitutes copyright infringement by Google.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Audio Frames Maryland Principal as Racist
records.description: A Maryland high school principal was falsely framed as racist through a deepfake audio recording created with generative AI. The malicious use of AI technology caused reputational harm, emotional distress, and social disruption, highlighting the growing risks of accessible deepfake tools for individuals and communities.

records.title: AI-Generated Disturbing and Misleading Images Flood Facebook
records.description: AI-generated images, including disturbing depictions of suffering children and surreal memes like 'Shrimp Jesus,' are being widely circulated on Facebook. These images, often unlabeled and used by spammers and scammers for engagement, have caused distress and spread misinformation, with Facebook criticized for failing to address or label the harmful content.

records.title: BBC Presenter Liz Bonnin Impersonated in AI Voice Scam Leading to Financial Loss
records.description: AI-generated voice deepfakes were used to impersonate BBC presenter Liz Bonnin, tricking the insect repellent company Incognito into paying £20,000 for a false endorsement. The scam resulted in unauthorized use of Bonnin's image and voice, causing financial loss and reputational harm.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Video Targets Pakistani YouTuber's Wife, Causing Distress and Outrage
records.description: An AI-generated deepfake video of Aroob Jatoi, wife of Pakistani YouTuber Ducky Bhai, went viral online, causing significant emotional distress and reputational harm. The couple publicly denounced the video, offered a reward for identifying the perpetrators, and urged vigilance against AI-driven cybercrimes and deepfake threats.

records.title: LLMs Misclassify Breast Imaging Reports, Risking Patient Harm
records.description: An international study found that large language models like GPT-4 and Google Gemini misclassified breast imaging reports, leading to changes that could negatively affect patient management. The findings highlight the risk of harm from using generic LLMs in complex medical tasks and underscore the need for regulatory oversight.

records.title: AI-Enabled Cameras Lead to Arrest in Missouri Double Homicide
records.description: Police in Blue Springs, Missouri, used Flock Safety's AI-enhanced camera system to identify and track a suspect vehicle involved in a double homicide. The AI analyzed vehicle features beyond license plates, enabling the arrest of the getaway driver and demonstrating the technology's pivotal role in solving serious crimes amid ongoing privacy concerns.

records.title: AI Deepfakes Drive Financial Fraud and Misinformation Incidents Globally
records.description: AI-powered deepfake technology has been used in multiple incidents to impersonate trusted individuals, leading to significant financial fraud (e.g., a $25 million scam in Hong Kong) and reputational harm, including a school principal being targeted with a racist AI-generated audio. These cases highlight the real-world harms caused by malicious AI misuse.

records.title: Global Surge in Deepfake Harms Raises Election and Safety Concerns
records.description: AI-generated deepfakes are causing widespread harm in Australia and India, including scams, political misinformation, and targeted harassment, especially during major elections. Millions have encountered deepfake content, undermining trust, safety, and democratic processes, with authorities struggling to detect and counteract these sophisticated AI-driven manipulations.

records.title: Apple Removes AI Apps Generating Non-Consensual Nude Images from App Store
records.description: Apple removed several AI-powered image generation apps from its App Store after reports revealed they created and promoted non-consensual explicit images, violating privacy and ethical standards. The apps were advertised on Instagram, claiming to undress women for free, prompting Apple to act following media exposure.

records.title: AI Voice Deepfakes Used in Fraudulent Impersonation Scams in Taiwan
records.description: Fraudsters in Taiwan have used AI-generated voice deepfakes to impersonate relatives and attempt financial scams, including a case where a 71-year-old man was nearly deceived into transferring NT$380,000. Police interventions and public awareness campaigns have helped prevent losses, but authorities warn of the growing threat of AI-enabled fraud.

records.title: Harms from AI Mental Health Chatbots: Therapeutic Misconceptions and Privacy Risks
records.description: AI-powered mental health chatbots, marketed as therapeutic tools, have led to harms including deterioration of users' mental health, privacy violations, and exploitation through misleading claims. Users often mistake these chatbots for real therapists, resulting in unmet needs and increased vulnerability among those seeking mental health support.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake of Rahul Gandhi Swearing-In as PM Spreads Misinformation During Indian Elections
records.description: An AI-generated voice clone of Rahul Gandhi, falsely depicting him swearing in as Prime Minister, went viral on social media during the 2024 Lok Sabha elections. Fact-checkers confirmed the audio was AI-generated, raising concerns about deepfake-driven misinformation influencing public opinion and election integrity.

records.title: Tamil Nadu Police Warns of AI Voice Cloning Scam Targeting Public
records.description: Tamil Nadu Police have issued advisories warning that scammers are using AI-based voice cloning to impersonate trusted contacts and deceive victims into transferring money during fake emergencies. The AI technology enables convincing impersonation, leading to financial losses for individuals targeted by these sophisticated frauds.

records.title: Fraudulent Apps Exploit AI Death Calculator, Endanger Users' Data
records.description: Scammers have created fake apps and websites imitating the Life2vec AI death prediction tool, which is not publicly available. These fraudulent platforms steal personal data and spread malware, prompting the original developers to issue urgent warnings to protect users from harm linked to misuse of the AI system's identity.

records.title: South Korean Woman Scammed $50,000 by Deepfake Elon Musk on Instagram
records.description: A South Korean woman lost $50,000 after a scammer used AI-powered deepfake technology to impersonate Elon Musk on Instagram. The fraudster built trust through video calls and personal messages, convincing the victim to transfer money. The incident highlights the growing threat of AI-enabled deepfake scams causing real financial harm.

records.title: Deepfake Video of Amit Shah Sparks Legal Action and Political Controversy in India
records.description: AI-generated deepfake videos falsely depicting Home Minister Amit Shah curtailing reservation rights for marginalized groups were widely shared by political figures and party handles. The videos led to police cases, legal action, and political disputes, highlighting the harmful impact of AI-driven misinformation on public discourse and community trust.

records.title: Thousands of Explicit AI 'Girlfriend' Ads Flood Meta Platforms, Exposing Moderation Failures
records.description: Meta platforms, including Facebook and Instagram, have hosted at least 29,000 ads for explicit AI-generated 'girlfriend' chatbots, many violating adult content policies. The proliferation of these AI-generated deepfake and NSFW ads highlights failures in Meta's AI moderation systems, exposing users to inappropriate content and raising concerns about discriminatory enforcement against human sex workers.

records.title: Microsoft Copilot AI Generates Harmful and Inappropriate Images
records.description: Microsoft's Copilot AI tool has been found to generate harmful and inappropriate images, including graphic violence, sexually explicit content, and depictions of drug use. Internal testing by a Microsoft engineering manager revealed flaws and security vulnerabilities, raising concerns about user safety and the potential for offensive content exposure.

records.title: Austrian Data Protection Group Files Complaint Against OpenAI Over ChatGPT's False Personal Data Outputs
records.description: Austrian privacy group NOYB filed a complaint against OpenAI, alleging ChatGPT generates and cannot correct false personal information about individuals, violating GDPR data accuracy and correction rights. OpenAI reportedly admits it cannot prevent or fix these 'hallucinations,' raising concerns over privacy and data protection compliance.

records.title: Tinkoff Bank Uses AI to Block Fraudulent Drop Accounts
records.description: Tinkoff Bank developed an AI-powered monitoring system to detect and block 'drop' accounts—bank cards opened by clients for use by fraudsters. By analyzing millions of transactions and behavioral patterns, the system identified and blocked over 66,000 fraudulent accounts in a year, significantly reducing financial crime and protecting customers.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Videos of Mexican President Used in Pemex Investment Scam
records.description: AI-generated deepfake videos and audio impersonating President Andrés Manuel López Obrador have been circulating online, promoting fraudulent Pemex investment schemes. The Mexican government and financial authorities have warned the public about these scams, highlighting the risks of AI-driven misinformation and the financial harm caused by such deceptive content.

records.title: US Regulators Link Tesla and Ford AI Driving Systems to Fatal Crashes
records.description: US federal investigations have found that AI-powered driver assistance systems—Tesla's Autopilot and Ford's BlueCruise—were active during multiple fatal crashes. Tesla's Autopilot was linked to at least 13 deaths and hundreds of crashes due to inadequate safety controls and misleading capabilities, while Ford's BlueCruise was involved in two recent deadly accidents.

records.title: Tourists Sue Google After Google Maps AI Routes Lead to Violent Attacks in South Africa
records.description: Multiple American tourists were violently attacked and robbed in Cape Town, South Africa, after Google Maps' AI-powered navigation directed them through the dangerous Nyanga district. Victims, including Walter Fischel and the Zoladz couple, are suing Google, alleging the AI system's routing directly led to their injuries and losses.

records.title: AI-Guided Surgical Robot Performs Successful Knee Operations in Hungary
records.description: At Semmelweis University Orthopedic Clinic, an AI-driven surgical robot has successfully performed six knee replacement surgeries. The system uses global surgical data and patient-specific anatomy to plan and execute procedures with high precision, reducing errors and improving patient recovery. No harm or malfunction was reported.

records.title: AI-Driven Financial Crime Surges as Criminals Outpace Banks' Defenses
records.description: BioCatch's global survey reveals that criminals are increasingly using AI for digital banking scams, such as synthetic identity fraud and voice cloning, leading to rising financial crime and significant losses. Nearly 70% of fraud experts say criminals are more adept with AI than banks, intensifying the threat.

records.title: FTC Warns of AI-Driven Price Fixing in Healthcare Sector
records.description: FTC Chair Lina Khan warned that AI algorithms are enabling healthcare companies to fix prices and discriminate against consumers without explicit coordination, leading to higher costs and reduced service quality. The FTC is increasing regulatory scrutiny to address these harms and protect consumer rights.

records.title: Telegram Blocks AI Bots Used for Targeting and Incitement to Violence
records.description: Telegram, led by Pavel Durov, is actively blocking accounts and AI-driven bots that collect coordinates for military strikes and disseminate personal data with calls for violence. These actions aim to prevent the platform's misuse for facilitating violence and protecting user privacy and safety.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Scam Targets Spanish TV Host Susanna Griso
records.description: AI-generated deepfakes of journalist Susanna Griso have been used to create fraudulent videos and ads, imitating her voice and image to promote fake investment schemes, particularly in cryptocurrencies. The scam has led to financial harm and identity theft, prompting Griso to file multiple complaints and publicly warn viewers.

records.title: AI System Failures in Huawei-Seres AITO M7 Crash and Navigation Error Endanger Lives in China and Taiwan
records.description: A Huawei-Seres AITO M7 electric vehicle's AI-based emergency braking system failed to activate during a crash, and the lack of automatic door unlocking trapped three occupants, resulting in their deaths. Separately, a visually impaired person in Taipei was endangered after faulty AI voice navigation led them into traffic, though no injuries occurred.

records.title: Google Fined $62 Million for Unauthorized AI-Driven Location Tracking
records.description: Google was fined $62 million after investigations revealed it tracked users' locations via AI-enabled services even when users opted out. Despite assurances, Google stored location data without consent, violating privacy rights. The settlement includes compensation for affected users and mandates Google to stop unauthorized tracking.

records.title: Florida Man Arrested for Creating AI-Generated Deepfake Nudes from Social Media Images
records.description: Sammarth Gautam was arrested in Florida for using AI software to generate non-consensual nude images of at least three victims by removing clothing from their social media photos. The AI-generated deepfakes were discovered online, resulting in privacy violations and sexual exploitation, prompting criminal charges.

records.title: T-Mobile, Amazon, and Target Sued for Unlawful Use of AI Facial Recognition Systems
records.description: T-Mobile, Amazon, and Target face lawsuits alleging unauthorized use of AI-powered facial recognition systems to collect biometric data from customers and employees without consent, violating privacy laws such as BIPA. The suits claim these companies failed to inform individuals or provide required data policies, resulting in legal and privacy harms.

records.title: Tesla Autopilot Misuse Linked to Fatal Crashes and Regulatory Scrutiny
records.description: Tesla's Autopilot, an AI-driven driver assistance system, has been linked to multiple fatal crashes, including incidents where distracted drivers over-relied on the technology. Regulatory investigations found inadequate driver monitoring and a safety gap, prompting recalls, software updates, and ongoing scrutiny by U.S. authorities to address these AI-related harms.

records.title: US Military's Project Maven AI Causes Harm and Faces Limitations in Ukraine War
records.description: The US military's Project Maven AI system has been deployed in Ukraine to identify and target Russian forces, resulting in destruction of infrastructure and casualties. While enabling effective strikes, the AI has also failed to anticipate key battlefield events, contributing to Ukrainian losses and highlighting both its harmful impact and operational limitations.

records.title: Spain Reopens Pegasus Spyware Case After New Evidence from France
records.description: Spanish authorities have reopened the investigation into the use of Pegasus, an AI-enabled Israeli spyware, to hack the phones of Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez and other officials. The decision follows new evidence from France, where similar infections targeted journalists and government members, highlighting cross-border AI-driven privacy violations.

records.title: Huawei Pura 70 AI Photo Editing Flaw Enables Inappropriate Image Manipulation
records.description: Huawei's Pura 70 smartphone AI photo editing feature had a vulnerability allowing users to remove clothing from images, generating realistic, sexualized photos. The flaw, powered by Huawei's large AI model, sparked public controversy and privacy concerns. Huawei acknowledged the issue and has since released a fix to address the problem.

records.title: Waymo Robotaxi Drives Into Oncoming Traffic to Avoid Scooter Riders
records.description: A Waymo autonomous vehicle in San Francisco crossed a solid line and drove for about 30 seconds in oncoming traffic to avoid a group of people on electric scooters. The AI system made the decision to prioritize the safety of the scooter riders, but the maneuver posed a significant traffic hazard.

records.title: AI Used to Generate Child Abuse Images for Extortion, Warns IWF
records.description: The Internet Watch Foundation (IWF) warns that offenders are using AI tools to generate fake nude images of children, which are then used to extort victims into providing more explicit content or money. Guides on the dark web encourage this abuse, highlighting AI's role in facilitating child exploitation and harm.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfakes Cause Election Disruption and Fraud Worldwide
records.description: AI-generated deepfake videos and audio have been used in cyberattacks, election interference, and scams, leading to financial losses, misinformation, and erosion of public trust. Incidents include impersonation of executives for fraud, fake messages from political figures during elections in the US and India, and widespread voter deception.

records.title: Meta Platforms Promote and Host AI Deepfake Nude Apps, Leading to Widespread Harm
records.description: Instagram and Facebook, owned by Meta, displayed ads promoting AI apps that generate non-consensual nude images, including deepfakes. These tools enabled blackmail, extortion, and unauthorized pornography, causing significant harm. Apple and Google removed such apps from their stores, while Meta belatedly deleted some ads but failed to prevent ongoing promotion and harm.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Audio of Philippine President Prompts National Security Investigation
records.description: AI-generated deepfake audio and video falsely depicting President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. ordering military action against China circulated widely online, causing alarm over misinformation and potential foreign policy disruption. The Philippine government has launched an investigation and pledged legal action against those responsible for creating and spreading the manipulated AI content.

records.title: Taiwan Warns of AI-Driven Fraud on Chinese Social Media Platforms
records.description: Taiwan's Mainland Affairs Council warned citizens against using Chinese social media apps like Douyin and Xiaohongshu after a scam incident linked to Xiaohongshu. Authorities cite risks from AI-driven algorithms that control information and collect data, and highlight difficulties in investigating cross-border fraud cases involving these platforms.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfakes Cause Financial and Identity Harm in Indonesia
records.description: AI-generated deepfakes are increasingly used for fraud and identity theft in Indonesia, causing financial losses to individuals and businesses. Multiple reports highlight rising incidents of deepfake scams, prompting cybersecurity firms like VIDA to launch AI-based detection tools to combat these threats.

records.title: FTC Fines Ring $5.6 Million for AI-Driven Privacy Violations and Security Failures
records.description: The FTC fined Amazon-owned Ring $5.6 million after finding the company allowed employees and contractors unauthorized access to customer videos and used footage to train AI algorithms without consent. Lax security also enabled hackers to access accounts, resulting in significant privacy violations and refunds to affected users.

records.title: AI-Generated Pornography Raises Ethical, Legal, and Social Concerns
records.description: AI systems are increasingly used to generate pornographic images, videos, and chatbots, leading to harms such as non-consensual deepfakes, illegal content creation (including child pornography), and social issues like addiction and job displacement. These developments raise significant ethical, legal, and societal concerns within the sex industry.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfakes Used to Manipulate Polish Election Campaigns
records.description: A Check Point report revealed that AI-powered deepfake technology was used to manipulate media content during recent Polish election campaigns. Notably, a falsified video involving former Prime Minister Mateusz Morawiecki was circulated, leading to Poland being listed among countries where AI-driven misinformation harmed democratic processes.

records.title: China's First AI Voice Infringement Case: Court Rules in Favor of Voice Actor
records.description: A Beijing court ruled that several companies infringed a voice actor's rights by using AI to replicate and sell her voice without consent. The AI-generated voice was commercially distributed, causing economic and emotional harm. The defendants were ordered to pay 250,000 RMB in damages and issue a public apology.

records.title: Russian AI-Powered Anti-Drone System 'Gurza' Deployed in Conflict Zone
records.description: Russian engineers have developed and deployed the portable anti-drone system 'Gurza', which uses artificial intelligence to autonomously detect and jam enemy drones in an active conflict zone. The AI system independently controls jamming frequencies, disrupting drone operations and demonstrating high effectiveness in military applications.

records.title: AI Deepfake Apps Used to Create and Circulate Fake Nude Images of Minors, Prompting Legislative Action in US States
records.description: AI-powered apps were used by a male student at Issaquah High School to generate and share fake nude images of female classmates, causing psychological harm and rights violations. The incident spurred Washington and other US states to pass laws banning the creation and distribution of AI-generated sexually explicit images of minors.

records.title: UK Drivers Raise Privacy Concerns Over AI Speed Cameras
records.description: New AI-powered speed cameras deployed across the UK can detect seatbelt and mobile phone violations, leading to legal enforcement actions. While authorities cite improved road safety, many drivers criticize the technology as an invasion of privacy, raising concerns about data collection and surveillance by law enforcement.

records.title: AI Deepfakes Cause Widespread Misinformation and Financial Harm in India and Globally
records.description: AI-generated deepfake audio and video have been widely used to mislead voters, spread political misinformation, and perpetrate scams, especially in India where 22% encountered political deepfakes and 18% suffered financial losses. These incidents highlight significant harm to individuals and democratic processes, prompting global concern and mitigation efforts.

records.title: Tesla Autopilot Involved in Fatal Motorcycle Collision; Driver Charged with Vehicular Homicide
records.description: A Tesla Model S in autopilot mode fatally struck a motorcyclist in Washington after the distracted driver looked at his phone. The vehicle unexpectedly accelerated, causing the collision. The driver was arrested and charged with vehicular homicide, highlighting risks associated with AI-assisted driving and driver inattention.

records.title: UK Court Bans Sex Offender from Using AI Image Tools After Child Abuse Conviction
records.description: A UK court has banned Anthony Dover, a convicted sex offender, from using AI image generation tools—including Stable Diffusion and deepfake websites—for five years after he created over 1,000 indecent AI-generated images of children. The ban aims to prevent further misuse of AI for producing illegal and harmful content.

records.title: Waymo Robotaxi Drives Against Traffic in San Francisco, Raising AI Safety Concerns
records.description: A Waymo autonomous taxi in San Francisco was filmed driving against traffic for nearly two blocks to avoid a perceived hazard, with passengers onboard. Waymo stated the AI system detected a possible fallen person and chose the maneuver to avoid collision, highlighting risks in AI decision-making for public road safety.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Pornography Causes Harm and Prompts Legal Action
records.description: AI-powered deepfake technology has been used to create and distribute non-consensual pornographic images and videos, causing significant harm to individuals through privacy violations, emotional distress, and reputational damage. In response, governments are enacting new laws to criminalize both the creation and distribution of deepfake sexual content.

records.title: AI-Assisted Endoscopy Enables Early Detection and Removal of Colorectal Cancer
records.description: St. Martin de Porres Hospital in Taiwan used an advanced AI-assisted endoscopy system to help doctors detect and diagnose colorectal polyps. The AI system enabled early identification and removal of a cancerous polyp in a patient, demonstrating AI's role in improving diagnostic accuracy and preventing cancer progression.

records.title: Gamers' GPUs Used to Generate Harmful AI Pornography via Salad Platform
records.description: Salad, a cloud computing company, rents gamers' idle GPUs to generate AI-created pornography, including nonconsensual and illegal content, in exchange for gaming rewards. Users are often opted in by default, raising concerns about transparency and the facilitation of harmful, rights-violating AI-generated sexual images.

records.title: BSE Warns Investors About AI-Generated Deepfake Videos Impersonating CEO
records.description: The Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) cautioned investors about AI-generated deepfake videos and audios impersonating its CEO, Sundararaman Ramamurthy, circulating on social media with false stock recommendations. The BSE urged the public not to trust or share these fraudulent materials, highlighting the financial risks posed by AI-driven misinformation.

records.title: Waymo Robotaxis Cause Traffic Chaos by Entering Closed Road in San Francisco
records.description: Six Waymo autonomous vehicles malfunctioned and led both robotaxis and human drivers onto a closed road near a Highway 101 on-ramp in San Francisco, causing a traffic jam and disruption. The incident highlights the risks of AI-driven vehicles misinterpreting road conditions and impacting critical infrastructure.

records.title: AI-Generated Kendrick Lamar Diss Track Sparks Misinformation and Backlash
records.description: Sy The Rapper used AI voice synthesis to create a fake Kendrick Lamar diss track, which went viral and fooled many listeners. The incident led to public confusion, reputational concerns, and criticism from industry figures like Jermaine Dupri, highlighting the risks of AI-generated impersonation and misinformation in music.

records.title: Grok AI Spreads False Vandalism Accusation Against NBA Star Klay Thompson
records.description: Elon Musk's Grok AI chatbot on X misinterpreted basketball slang and generated a false news story accusing NBA player Klay Thompson of criminal vandalism. The AI's error led to the spread of misinformation and reputational harm, highlighting risks of AI-generated content misrepresenting real individuals.

records.title: Meta Oversight Board Reviews AI-Generated Deepfake Porn Cases
records.description: AI-generated deepfake pornographic images of women, including public figures, have been widely shared on Meta's platforms, causing significant emotional and reputational harm. Meta's independent Oversight Board is now reviewing the company's policies and enforcement practices in response to these incidents of AI-enabled harassment and rights violations.

records.title: Bollywood Actors Targeted by AI-Generated Deepfake Videos Ahead of Indian Elections
records.description: AI-generated deepfake videos falsely depicting Bollywood actors Aamir Khan and Ranveer Singh endorsing political parties went viral ahead of India's Lok Sabha elections. The videos led to misinformation and reputational harm, prompting legal action and public warnings from the actors and police investigations into the misuse of AI technology.

records.title: Russia Proposes and Expands Use of AI Facial Recognition to Identify Migrant Law Violators
records.description: Russian authorities, led by lawmaker Yaroslav Nilov, have proposed and are expanding the use of AI-powered facial recognition systems to identify and detain migrants violating laws. The system has already led to thousands of detections and arrests, raising concerns about potential human rights violations and misuse of AI in law enforcement.

records.title: AI-Generated Child Sexual Abuse Material Surges Online, Reports Show
records.description: The National Center for Missing & Exploited Children reports a sharp rise in online child sexual abuse, with over 36 million cases in 2023. Generative AI is increasingly used to create illegal child sexual abuse images and videos, leading to exploitation, extortion, and significant harm to children and families.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Falsely Announces Influencer's Death, Spreads Misinformation Online
records.description: Internet users created and circulated a deepfake video using AI, depicting TV host Pati Chapoy falsely announcing the death of influencer Aimep3. The realistic AI-generated content caused widespread misinformation, emotional distress, and reputational harm, highlighting the risks of AI-driven synthetic media in spreading false news.

records.title: TikTok AI Recommender Exposes Irish Teens to Self-Harm and Suicide Content
records.description: An RTÉ Prime Time investigation found that TikTok's AI-driven recommendation system exposed accounts set as 13-year-olds to videos about self-harm and suicide within minutes. The incident has led to real harm, with over 140 children contacting support services about self-harm since February, raising concerns about the platform's impact on youth mental health.

records.title: Tesla Autopilot Saves Driver During Heart Attack Emergency
records.description: MaxPaul Franklin, after suffering a mild heart attack while driving, activated his Tesla Model Y's Autopilot, which autonomously drove him 20 kilometers to a hospital, enabling him to receive medical help. Tesla CEO Elon Musk acknowledged the incident, highlighting the AI system's life-saving potential in emergencies.

records.title: AI-Generated Celebrity Voice Scams Target Online Shoppers in Indonesia
records.description: Indonesian authorities warn of rising online shopping scams using AI to manipulate public figures’ voices and likenesses, deceiving consumers into buying products falsely endorsed by celebrities. The misuse of AI has caused financial harm to consumers and reputational damage to public figures, prompting increased monitoring and public advisories.

records.title: AI-Driven Bots Now Account for Nearly Half of Global Internet Traffic, Fueling Cyber Threats
records.description: AI-enabled bots, including those powered by generative AI, now make up nearly half of all internet traffic, with 'bad bots' responsible for a third. These bots conduct malicious activities such as account takeovers and API attacks, causing financial losses, security breaches, and service disruptions across multiple sectors.

records.title: Meta Faces Lawsuit and Political Pressure Over AI-Driven Scam Ads in Japan
records.description: Meta's AI-driven ad platform on Facebook enabled fraudulent ads impersonating celebrities, leading to financial losses for users. Four victims are suing Meta's Japan unit for damages. Japanese politicians have demanded Meta consider halting ads, criticizing the company's insufficient response to the ongoing scam ad problem.

records.title: UN Experts Condemn Israel's Use of AI in Gaza Attacks Causing Civilian Harm
records.description: UN special rapporteurs condemned Israel's use of AI systems such as 'Gospel' and 'Lavender' in military operations in Gaza, citing unprecedented destruction of civilian infrastructure and deprivation of basic rights. The AI-driven attacks are linked to increased civilian casualties and are described as crimes against humanity and potential genocide.

records.title: Judge Dismisses Some Claims Against Zuckerberg in Meta AI Addiction Lawsuits
records.description: A US judge dismissed certain claims seeking to hold Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg personally liable in lawsuits alleging Facebook and Instagram's AI-driven features harm children by fostering addiction and mental health issues. The litigation against Meta continues, focusing on the alleged harms caused by the platforms' AI systems.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Video of Biden Spreads Misinformation Online
records.description: A generative AI service was used to create a realistic deepfake video of U.S. President Biden, which was widely disseminated on social media in March. The video, viewed over 660,000 times, spread false information and raised concerns about AI-enabled disinformation ahead of the U.S. presidential election.

records.title: AI-Generated Kendrick Lamar Diss Tracks Spark Controversy in Hip-Hop Community
records.description: AI technology was used to create fake diss tracks mimicking Kendrick Lamar's voice, fueling controversy and confusion in the hip-hop community. Allegations suggest Drake may be behind the AI-generated leaks, raising concerns over intellectual property rights, artist authenticity, and the use of AI for online harassment.

records.title: AI Chatbots Spread Misinformation About European Elections
records.description: AI chatbots from Google, Microsoft, and OpenAI were found to provide false or misleading information about the European Parliament elections, including incorrect voting dates and procedures, in multiple languages. The issue was documented by Democracy Reporting International, raising concerns about AI-driven misinformation impacting democratic processes.

records.title: Deepfake Video of BJP MP Sparks Political Controversy and Legal Action in India
records.description: A deepfake video allegedly showing BJP MP Dinesh Lal Yadav making controversial remarks circulated online, prompting BJP leaders to accuse Congress of using AI-generated deepfakes to mislead voters and sow social division. Legal complaints were filed against Congress leaders, highlighting the harm caused by AI-driven misinformation during elections.

records.title: Target Sued for Unconsented Biometric Data Collection via AI Surveillance
records.description: Target faces a class action lawsuit in Illinois for allegedly using AI-powered facial recognition and surveillance systems to collect and store customers' biometric data without consent, violating the state's Biometric Information Privacy Act and raising concerns over privacy rights and potential identity theft.

records.title: AI-Generated Spam and Academic Dishonesty Cause Harm Online and in Education
records.description: Generative AI is being used to create low-quality spam content that misleads users on Google, including in health and technical advice, and contaminates training data. Separately, studies show students increasingly use AI chatbots to generate coursework, undermining academic integrity and harming educational standards.

records.title: UK Criminalises Creation of AI-Generated Sexually Explicit Deepfakes
records.description: The UK government has introduced a new law making it a criminal offense to create sexually explicit deepfake images using AI without consent. Offenders face unlimited fines, criminal records, and possible jail time, addressing the growing harm and distress caused by non-consensual AI-generated sexual content.

records.title: Criminals Use AI and Deepfakes to Escalate Identity Fraud in the UK
records.description: Fraud prevention body Cifas reports a surge in AI-enabled identity fraud, with criminals using deepfake images, videos, and audio for phishing scams and account takeovers. Over 374,000 fraud cases were reported in 2023, with identity theft accounting for nearly two-thirds, causing significant financial and personal harm to consumers.

records.title: AI-Powered Drones Cause Harm in Modern Warfare Across Multiple Conflicts
records.description: AI-controlled drones, used extensively in Ukraine and other conflict zones, autonomously identify and attack targets, causing deaths and significant damage to critical infrastructure. While Ukraine develops advanced AI drones to evade countermeasures, U.S. AI drones have proven vulnerable. Iranian AI-powered drones have also inflicted harm in Sudan, Yemen, and beyond.

records.title: Tesla Software Update Traps User in Car During Extreme Heat
records.description: TikToker Brianna Janel was trapped inside her Tesla during a software update, unable to open doors or windows as temperatures reached up to 46°C. The AI-driven update process locked her in, causing significant distress and heat exposure, highlighting safety risks in Tesla's software management system.

records.title: DWP-Funded AI Systems Raise Concerns Over Health Surveillance and Disability Rights in UK
records.description: The UK Department for Work and Pensions is investing £1.5 million in AI-driven occupational health platforms to monitor employee health and reduce sickness benefits claims. Critics warn these AI systems could enable harmful surveillance and discrimination against chronically ill and disabled people, risking health and rights violations.

records.title: Facebook AI Moderation Wrongly Censors Auschwitz Memorial Posts
records.description: Facebook's AI-driven content moderation system mistakenly flagged and removed 21 posts from the Auschwitz Museum, which honored Holocaust victims, citing reasons like nudity and hate speech. The incident sparked public and governmental outcry, highlighting the harm caused by algorithmic errors in suppressing important historical memory and violating community rights.

records.title: YouTuber Cyprien Targeted by AI-Generated Deepfake Scam Ads
records.description: AI-generated deepfake videos featuring YouTuber Cyprien and news anchor Anne-Claire Coudray falsely promoted a non-existent casino app, misleading viewers and damaging reputations. The deepfakes, widely circulated on social media, prompted Cyprien to file a legal complaint against the creators for identity theft and fraud.

records.title: AI-Equipped Tram Fails to Stop, Injures Pedestrians in St. Petersburg
records.description: A new AI-equipped tram in St. Petersburg failed to stop at a pedestrian crossing, injuring three people, one seriously. The tram's AI-based safety system, designed to automatically brake for obstacles, did not prevent the accident, with initial reports citing brake failure as the cause.

records.title: Proliferation of Deepfake AI Tools Fuels Fraud and Security Threats
records.description: Cybersecurity firms report a surge in the use of AI-powered deepfake tools, widely available on darknet markets, enabling fraud, identity theft, blackmail, and misinformation. These generative AI systems have led to significant real-world harms for individuals, businesses, and governments, including large-scale scams and reputational damage.

records.title: AI Deepfakes Fuel Election Misinformation and Non-Consensual Pornography Crisis
records.description: Generative AI tools are increasingly used to create deepfake images, audio, and videos, leading to widespread misinformation in elections and a surge in non-consensual deepfake pornography. These AI-generated fakes harm individuals’ rights, distort democratic processes, and present significant challenges for detection and prevention.

records.title: Baldur's Gate 3 Voice Actors Suffer Harm from Unauthorized AI Voice Cloning
records.description: Baldur's Gate 3 voice actors, including Amelia Tyler, report unauthorized use of AI voice cloning to replicate their voices, sometimes for disturbing content. This misuse has caused emotional distress and violated their rights, with actors describing it as theft of both their jobs and identities.

records.title: Tesla Full Self-Driving AI Saves Life but Also Causes Property Damage
records.description: Tesla's Full Self-Driving (FSD) AI system autonomously drove a man with a medical emergency to a hospital, likely saving his life. However, multiple users have reported the same FSD software causing vehicles to hit curbs, resulting in wheel and tire damage, highlighting both life-saving potential and safety concerns.

records.title: Tesla Sued After Toddler Starts Model X, Injures Pregnant Mother Due to Alleged AI Design Flaw
records.description: Mallory Harcourt sued Tesla after her two-year-old son was able to start their Model X, causing it to hit her and result in serious injuries and premature birth. The lawsuit alleges a design flaw in Tesla's AI-driven control system allowed the incident, raising concerns about inadequate safety features.

records.title: AI-Powered Scams Cause Rising Financial Losses Globally
records.description: Criminals are increasingly using AI technologies, such as chatbots and voice cloning, to deceive consumers into transferring money, resulting in significant financial losses. Visa's 2024 report highlights the growing sophistication and organization of these AI-enabled scams, despite efforts to prevent fraud and billions of dollars invested in security measures.

records.title: AI-Generated Nude Images of Minors Cause Harm in US Schools
records.description: A 13-year-old girl at Aliso Viejo Middle School became a victim when a classmate used AI software to create and share fake nude images of her, leading to harassment and emotional distress. The incident highlights how AI misuse is causing harm to minors, leaving schools and legal systems unprepared.

records.title: AI-Driven Targeted Ads Spark Privacy Concerns Over Excessive Data Collection in China
records.description: Chinese users report receiving eerily accurate targeted ads after private conversations, raising suspicions of phone eavesdropping. Investigations reveal AI-powered recommendation algorithms and user profiling, fueled by extensive personal data collection and sharing, have led to privacy violations and regulatory scrutiny for over-collection and misuse of user information.

records.title: Apple Warns Users in 92 Countries of AI-Driven Spyware Attacks
records.description: Apple issued threat notifications to users in 92 countries, warning of targeted attacks by mercenary spyware—AI-enabled surveillance tools like Pegasus—used by state actors to remotely infiltrate iPhones. The attacks compromise privacy and security, especially for journalists, activists, and officials, prompting Apple to recommend enhanced security measures.

records.title: X's AI Algorithms Amplify and Monetize Hate Speech Amid Israel-Gaza Conflict
records.description: A study by the Center for Countering Digital Hate found that X's AI-driven recommendation and monetization systems have amplified and financially rewarded hate speech targeting Jews and Muslims since the Israel-Gaza war began. Ten accounts posting such content grew rapidly in followers and profits, highlighting AI's role in spreading and incentivizing harmful content.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Influencers Promote Far-Right Politics on TikTok
records.description: AI-generated deepfake profiles resembling relatives of French far-right politicians Marine Le Pen and Marion Maréchal have amassed large followings on TikTok. records.title: Families Sue Social Media Platforms Over AI-Driven Harms to Minors
