records.description: The Arizona Agenda, a local news site, used AI to create a deepfake video of Senate candidate Kari Lake, demonstrating how easily AI can generate convincing misinformation. The video, widely viewed, led to public confusion, legal threats from Lake, and heightened concerns about AI's potential to disrupt elections and erode public trust.

records.title: Thousands of Celebrities Victimized by AI-Generated Deepfake Pornography
records.description: Nearly 4,000 celebrities, including 255 Britons, have been targeted by AI-generated deepfake pornography, with their faces superimposed onto explicit content without consent. Channel 4 News found these images on major deepfake sites, viewed 100 million times in three months, causing significant emotional and reputational harm to victims.

records.title: Italian Prime Minister Sues Over Deepfake Pornographic Videos
records.description: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni is suing two men for creating and distributing AI-generated deepfake pornographic videos featuring her likeness. The videos, viewed millions of times online, caused reputational harm and led Meloni to seek €100,000 in damages, highlighting the misuse of AI for defamation and abuse.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfakes Fuel Scams, Identity Theft, and Election Manipulation
records.description: Generative AI tools like DALL-E, Midjourney, and Sora are enabling the widespread creation of deepfake images and videos, making it difficult to distinguish real from fake. These AI-generated fakes are increasingly used for scams, identity theft, and manipulating elections, causing significant harm to individuals and communities.

records.title: Greek Student Uses AI Deepfake to Defame Peer and Steal Parade Honor
records.description: A 14-year-old Greek student used AI deepfake technology to create a fake explicit video of a female classmate, aiming to discredit her and take her place as flag bearer in a school parade. The incident caused significant emotional harm and reputational damage, highlighting the risks of malicious AI use among minors.

records.title: Congress Investigates IRS Use of AI for Mass Financial Surveillance
records.description: Congressional leaders are investigating the IRS for allegedly using AI systems to conduct mass surveillance of Americans' bank accounts and financial records without legal authorization. Lawmakers cite concerns over violations of privacy and constitutional rights, with evidence suggesting the AI-enabled monitoring has led to enforcement actions and potential harm to civil liberties.

records.title: AI System 'Mia' Detects Breast Cancers Missed by Doctors in NHS Trial
records.description: The AI tool Mia, used in a UK NHS trial, analyzed over 10,000 mammograms and detected early-stage breast cancers in 11 women that human doctors missed. This early detection enabled less invasive treatment and improved patient outcomes, demonstrating AI's significant role in preventing harm through enhanced medical diagnosis.

records.title: Greek TV Host Faye Skorda Targeted by AI-Generated Deepfake Scam Video
records.description: A deepfake video using AI technology manipulated footage of Greek TV host Faye Skorda and a guest, altering their speech to promote a product fraudulently. The incident caused reputational harm and public misinformation, with Skorda publicly denouncing the video as fake and warning about the dangers of AI-generated content.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake 'Carcinogenic Sanitary Pad Blacklist' Causes Public Alarm in China
records.description: An AI-powered Q&A system generated a false blacklist claiming major sanitary pad brands were carcinogenic, which spread widely online and caused public concern. The misinformation, amplified by social media influencers, led to reputational harm and confusion before being debunked by authorities as AI-generated disinformation.

records.title: France Fines Google €250 Million for AI Copyright Violations
records.description: French regulators fined Google €250 million after its AI chatbot Bard/Gemini was trained on copyrighted news content without proper authorization or compensation to publishers. The Autorité de la Concurrence found Google breached legal commitments and failed to provide publishers with opt-out mechanisms, violating intellectual property rights.

records.title: OpenAI's GPT Store Flooded with Copyright-Infringing and Policy-Violating Chatbots
records.description: OpenAI's GPT Store has been inundated with custom chatbots that violate copyright laws, impersonate public figures, and promote academic dishonesty. Despite moderation efforts, many illegal and policy-violating bots remain accessible, highlighting failures in OpenAI's content control and leading to widespread intellectual property and ethical breaches.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfakes Used to Defraud Using Daniel Sarcos and Olga Tañón's Likenesses
records.description: AI was used to synthesize the voices and images of Daniel Sarcos and Olga Tañón without their consent to create fraudulent advertisements for a credit score company. Both celebrities publicly denounced the misuse, warning of reputational harm and potential financial scams targeting the public.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfakes of Celebrities Used in Financial Scams Across Latin America
records.description: AI-generated deepfake videos and voices impersonating public figures like Carlos Slim and Elon Musk are being used to lure victims into online financial scams across Latin America. These convincing deepfakes have led to real financial losses, making it harder for users to distinguish legitimate content from fraudulent schemes.

records.title: Michael Cohen Submits AI-Generated Fake Legal Citations in Court Filing
records.description: Michael Cohen, former lawyer for Donald Trump, submitted a court motion containing fake legal case citations generated by Google Bard, an AI chatbot. Although the incident caused embarrassment and procedural issues, a federal judge declined to impose sanctions, finding no evidence of bad faith or intentional misconduct.

records.title: AI Chatbots Generate and Spread Health Disinformation Due to Inadequate Safeguards
records.description: A study published in the British Medical Journal found that major AI chatbots, including ChatGPT, Gemini, and Meta's Llama 2, can generate convincing health disinformation, such as false claims about cancer cures. Inadequate safeguards allow these AI systems to produce and spread harmful medical misinformation, posing risks to public health.

records.title: Conversation Overflow Attacks Exploit AI Email Security to Enable Phishing and Credential Theft
records.description: Threat actors are using a new 'Conversation Overflow' technique to bypass AI- and machine learning-based email security systems. By embedding hidden benign text in phishing emails, attackers trick AI filters, allowing malicious messages to reach victims and resulting in credential theft and data breaches within enterprise networks.

records.title: AI Drives Job Losses in the US IT Sector
records.description: In May 2023, AI was responsible for about 5% of IT job losses in the US, with 3,900 positions eliminated due to automation and AI adoption. This marks AI as a significant factor in workforce reductions, contributing to broader employment shifts and economic harm for affected workers.

records.title: Florida Teacher Arrested for Creating AI-Generated Child Pornography from Student Yearbook Photos
records.description: Steven Houser, a third-grade teacher at Beacon Christian Academy in Florida, was arrested after using AI to generate child erotica from yearbook photos of three students. Authorities found AI-generated illegal content and other child pornography in his possession, highlighting the misuse of AI for child exploitation.

records.title: AI-Driven Job Losses Escalate in Poland
records.description: Recent reports reveal that 37% of Polish companies have laid off employees due to the adoption of AI and automation technologies, with small-town workers most affected. The widespread implementation of AI is directly causing significant job losses, highlighting the immediate impact of automation on employment in Poland.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Obituaries Cause Distress and Misinformation
records.description: Scammers are using AI tools to rapidly generate and post fake obituaries of living individuals online, including journalist Deborah Vankin, to attract clicks and ad revenue. This AI-driven scheme spreads misinformation, causes emotional distress, and can expose victims to further cyber risks such as malware.

records.title: US Lawmakers Target AI-Driven Rent Price Fixing by Landlords
records.description: Landlords across the US have used AI-powered pricing algorithms, such as those from RealPage and Yardi, to coordinate rent increases, inflating prices and reducing competition. This practice has led to widespread financial harm for renters. Senator Richard Blumenthal is sponsoring legislation to ban algorithmic collusion and protect tenants from such predatory AI-driven practices.

records.title: AI-Generated Papers Undermine Academic Integrity
records.description: Investigations revealed that nearly 200 academic papers, including some in reputable journals, were generated in whole or part by AI tools like ChatGPT. Lax peer review allowed these AI-generated, often nonsensical or fraudulent, studies to be published, eroding scientific integrity and public trust in academic research.

records.title: Deepfake Video Impersonates Medanta Hospital Chief, Prompts Police Action
records.description: A deepfake video using AI technology falsely depicted Dr. Naresh Trehan, chairman of Medanta Hospital, endorsing an anti-obesity drug. The misleading video went viral on social media, causing reputational harm and potential public misinformation. Medanta Hospital filed a complaint, leading Gurugram police to register an FIR against unknown individuals.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Images of Angel Reese Circulate Online
records.description: AI-generated explicit images of LSU basketball star Angel Reese were created and spread online without her consent, causing her distress and reputational harm. Reese publicly condemned the deepfakes on social media, highlighting the misuse of AI technology to fabricate and disseminate harmful, non-consensual content targeting public figures.

records.title: Meta Fined for Unconsented Data Merging Between Instagram and Threads in Turkey
records.description: Turkey's Competition Authority imposed a daily fine and temporary measures on Meta for combining user data from Instagram and Threads without user consent. The AI-driven data integration was found to violate user rights and create anti-competitive barriers, prompting regulatory intervention to prevent further harm.

records.title: SEC Fines Investment Firms for Misleading AI Claims in 'AI Washing' Crackdown
records.description: The US SEC fined Delphia (USA) Inc. and Global Predictions Inc. $400,000 for falsely claiming to use AI in their investment services. The firms misled investors about their AI capabilities, violating securities laws and prompting regulatory action against deceptive 'AI washing' practices in the financial sector.

records.title: Allegations of Google AI Election Interference Spark Controversy
records.description: Multiple reports from conservative groups allege that Google's AI systems, including its Gemini chatbot and search algorithms, have interfered in 41 U.S. elections since 2008 by promoting ideological bias and manipulating information access, potentially harming democratic processes. Google denies these claims, but concerns persist over AI-driven election influence.

records.title: US Secretary of State Blinken Condemns Government Use of AI for Surveillance and Disinformation
records.description: US Secretary of State Antony Blinken, at the Democracy Summit in Seoul, denounced some governments' use of AI for citizen surveillance and spreading disinformation, actions that undermine human rights and democracy. He highlighted the misuse of AI tools like facial recognition and bots to repress and manipulate societies.

records.title: UK Music Industry Threatens Legal Action Against AI Voice Cloning Platform Jammable
records.description: The British Phonographic Industry (BPI) has threatened legal action against Jammable (formerly Voicify), an AI platform offering thousands of unlicensed voice models to clone famous artists' voices for deepfake music. The service's unauthorized use of copyrighted material has led to industry backlash and removal of some AI-generated models.

records.title: Google's AI Moderation Wrongly Flags Childhood Photo, Blocks User Account for a Year
records.description: Google's AI-based content moderation system misclassified a childhood photo as explicit child abuse, leading to the year-long suspension of Neel Shukla's email account. The incident caused significant personal and business disruption, prompting Shukla to seek legal recourse in the Gujarat High Court after failed appeals to Google.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfakes Undermine Election Integrity Worldwide
records.description: AI-powered deepfakes are increasingly used to spread misinformation and disinformation during major elections in countries like the US, UK, India, and South Africa. These realistic fabricated videos and images deceive voters, manipulate public opinion, and damage political reputations, posing a significant threat to democratic processes globally.

records.title: Kimi AI System Overload Causes Widespread Service Disruption for SaaS Customers
records.description: From March 20, 2024, the Kimi AI system by Moonshot AI experienced an unexpected surge in traffic, far exceeding resource planning. This led to widespread service disruptions and 'engine overloaded' errors for SaaS customers, impacting user experience and service availability. The company implemented emergency measures to address the issue.

records.title: Meta's AI Fails to Remove Harmful Self-Harm Content, Leading to Expert Resignation
records.description: Lotte Rubæk, a suicide prevention psychologist, resigned from Meta’s expert panel, citing the company’s failure to use its AI systems to effectively remove self-harm content from Instagram. She claims this negligence has contributed to increased self-harm and suicide among vulnerable users, prioritizing profit over user safety.

records.title: AI Data Centers Exacerbate Bangalore Water Crisis, Disrupting Tech Industry
records.description: Major tech companies' development and deployment of AI systems in Bangalore have significantly increased water consumption for data center cooling, contributing to the city's worst water shortage in 40 years. This crisis is disrupting IT operations, forcing employee relocations, and threatening the region's status as a tech hub.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Videos Used to Extort and Discredit Bangladeshi Political Leaders
records.description: BNP leaders allege that AI-powered deepfake technology has been used to distort speeches of their acting chairman and other members, spreading fake videos via pro-government platforms. These videos are reportedly used for extortion and misinformation, harming reputations and deceiving supporters both domestically and abroad.

records.title: ChatGPT Misuse Leads to Misinformation, Mental Health Harm, and Legal Action
records.description: ChatGPT has been implicated in several AI incidents: spreading misinformation by confidently providing false answers, being linked to a suicide when used as a therapy alternative, and generating defamatory statements that led to a lawsuit against OpenAI. These cases highlight the risks of relying on AI for sensitive or factual information.

records.title: Dutch Police Warn of Surge in AI-Generated Child Sexual Abuse Material
records.description: Dutch police report a rapid increase in AI-generated child sexual abuse images, with hundreds detected monthly in the Netherlands and thousands globally. Authorities warn that AI makes it easier for offenders to create illegal content, complicating investigations and potentially increasing real-world child exploitation and abuse.

records.title: AI-Generated Misinformation Spreads on TikTok via Viral Conspiracy Videos
records.description: On TikTok, users are leveraging generative AI to create synthetic voices and images for conspiracy theory videos, which are widely viewed and monetized. This AI-driven misinformation is causing harm by misleading communities and influencing public opinion, while TikTok struggles to effectively moderate and remove such harmful content.

records.title: Polish Parliamentary Inquiry Reveals Pegasus AI Spyware Capabilities and Use
records.description: A Polish parliamentary commission investigated the use of Pegasus, an AI-powered spyware system capable of covertly taking control of mobile devices, extracting data, and tracking locations without user knowledge. Expert testimony confirmed its deployment in Poland, raising concerns over privacy violations and unauthorized surveillance enabled by the AI system.

records.title: Federal Investigation Launched After Fatal Crash Involving Ford BlueCruise AI System
records.description: Federal agencies are investigating a fatal crash in San Antonio, Texas, where a Ford Mustang Mach-E, possibly using Ford's BlueCruise AI driver assistance system, collided with a stationary Honda CR-V, resulting in one death. The probe focuses on whether the AI system's failure contributed to the incident.

records.title: AI-Generated Content Triggers Academic Paper Retractions and Misconduct Investigations
records.description: Several academic papers published by Elsevier and authored by a Chinese university professor were found to contain undeleted ChatGPT-generated text and AI-created illustrations, leading to public scrutiny, publisher investigations, and retractions. The incident highlights the risks of AI misuse in academic publishing, undermining research integrity and prompting calls for clearer ethical guidelines.

records.title: AI Ghostbots of Deceased Loved Ones Linked to Mental Health Risks
records.description: AI 'ghostbots'—virtual avatars of deceased individuals created using chatbots and deepfake technology—are raising concerns among mental health experts. Their use can disrupt the grieving process, leading to emotional dependency, confusion, stress, and, in severe cases, psychosis, highlighting significant risks to users' mental well-being.

records.title: Russian Consumers File Complaints Over AI Chatbots on Hotlines
records.description: Russian citizens, particularly vulnerable groups, have filed numerous complaints to Rospotrebnadzor about AI chatbots used on hotline services. Users report being unable to reach human operators despite requests, leading to dissatisfaction and concerns over consumer rights violations. Authorities are considering regulatory measures to address these issues.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfakes Disrupt Elections and Spread Disinformation Globally
records.description: Generative AI systems from companies like Google and OpenAI are being used to create convincing deepfakes that spread disinformation and manipulate voters in elections worldwide, including in Europe, Asia, and India. These AI-generated videos and audio clips erode trust, disrupt democratic processes, and cause significant harm to communities.

records.title: Discovery of 4.9 Million Anomalous Votes in Indonesian Election AI System Sirekap
records.description: Alumni groups from ITB uncovered 4.9 million suspicious or anomalous votes in Sirekap, an AI-based election result aggregation system developed by ITB and KPU. The findings raise concerns about the integrity of Indonesia's 2024 election, indicating potential harm to democratic processes and electoral rights.

records.title: Italian Antitrust Fines TikTok for AI-Driven Spread of Harmful Content to Minors
records.description: The Italian Antitrust Authority fined TikTok €10 million for inadequate controls on its AI-powered recommendation algorithm, which systematically promoted harmful content—such as the 'French scar' challenge—posing psychological and physical risks to minors and vulnerable users. TikTok failed to enforce its own safety guidelines, resulting in realized harm.

records.title: AI Deepfakes and Fake Chatbots Used in Fraud and Scams in China
records.description: Multiple cases in China reveal criminals using AI technologies—such as deepfake video calls and fake ChatGPT services—to commit fraud, deceive consumers, and spread misinformation. These AI-driven scams have led to significant financial losses and social harm, prompting regulatory crackdowns and highlighting the risks of AI misuse.

records.title: Researchers Reveal AI Chatbots Vulnerable to Side-Channel Eavesdropping Attacks
records.description: Researchers at Ben-Gurion University have demonstrated that most major AI chatbots, including ChatGPT and Microsoft's Copilot, are vulnerable to side-channel attacks that allow hackers to infer private, encrypted conversations. This flaw enables attackers to deduce sensitive information without breaching firewalls, posing significant privacy risks to users.

records.title: Unauthorized AI 'Resurrection' of Deceased Celebrities Sparks Legal and Ethical Backlash in China
records.description: Chinese content creators used AI to generate videos and voices of deceased celebrities without family consent, causing emotional distress and legal disputes. Families of stars like Qiao Renliang and Godfrey Gao demanded removal of such videos, citing rights violations and emotional harm. The incident highlights ethical, legal, and regulatory challenges of AI-generated content.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfakes Used to Manipulate Elections and Spread Misinformation
records.description: AI-generated deepfake content, including fake audio and video, has been used globally to mislead voters, manipulate elections, and perpetrate scams, notably in the 2024 US primaries. The rapid advancement of AI outpaces detection technologies, raising concerns about public trust, democratic integrity, and potential for inciting violence.

records.title: Adobe Firefly AI Generates Historically Inaccurate and Racially Misleading Images
records.description: Adobe's Firefly AI image generator has produced historically inaccurate and racially misleading images, such as depicting Black Nazis, Black Vikings, and Black Founding Fathers, echoing similar controversies with Google's Gemini. These outputs have led to public outcry and concerns over misinformation and distortion of historical facts.

records.title: Researchers Extract Proprietary Model Details from OpenAI and Google LLMs via API Attack
records.description: A team of researchers successfully executed a model-stealing attack on OpenAI's and Google's large language models, extracting proprietary architectural details and embedding projection layers via API queries. This breach of intellectual property highlights significant security vulnerabilities in production AI systems, prompting both companies to implement mitigations.

records.title: Facial Recognition AI Causes Racial Bias and Misidentification Harms
records.description: Facial recognition AI systems have repeatedly misidentified people of color, leading to wrongful denial of services, privacy violations, and discrimination. Notably, gig workers and black women are disproportionately affected. These harms have prompted regulatory scrutiny and calls for improved oversight and more diverse training data.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Pornography of Female Celebrities Sold on eBay
records.description: Thousands of AI-generated sexually explicit deepfake images of at least 40 female celebrities, including Taylor Swift and Selena Gomez, were found for sale on eBay. Despite platform policies, top-rated sellers profited from these non-consensual images until media exposure prompted eBay to remove content and suspend accounts.

records.title: Critical Security Flaws in ChatGPT Plugins Exposed User Data and Accounts to Attackers
records.description: Researchers discovered severe vulnerabilities in ChatGPT plugins (now called GPTs) that allowed attackers to access private user data, including GitHub repositories and third-party accounts, via zero-click exploits. These flaws risked data theft and account takeovers before being reported and remediated by OpenAI and plugin developers.

records.title: Google's AI Search Causes Major Publisher Revenue Losses
records.description: Google's AI-powered Search Generative Experience (SGE) has led to a significant drop in organic search traffic for publishers, resulting in estimated annual ad revenue losses of up to $2 billion. The AI system provides direct answers, reducing user visits to publisher sites and harming their economic viability.

records.title: ASCII Art Attack Bypasses AI Chatbot Safeguards, Enables Harmful Outputs
records.description: Researchers discovered that leading AI chatbots, including GPT-4 and Gemini, can be manipulated using ASCII art (ArtPrompt attack) to bypass safety measures and generate harmful content, such as bomb-making instructions and hate speech. This vulnerability exposes significant security flaws in current AI alignment and safety protocols.

records.title: TSA Facial Recognition Policy Denies Migrants Boarding, Causes Distress
records.description: The TSA has implemented a policy requiring migrants without proper ID to undergo facial recognition for domestic flights. Migrants unable to be matched in the system are denied boarding, leading to distress, disrupted travel, and financial loss, directly linking AI use to harm for affected individuals.

records.title: Ukraine Deploys AI-Enabled Ground Robots in Warfare
records.description: Ukraine has begun mass production and deployment of AI-powered robotic ground platforms for military use, including kamikaze units, turrets, mine clearance, casualty evacuation, and ammunition delivery. These autonomous and semi-autonomous systems are already operational on the front lines, directly impacting combat and soldier safety in the ongoing conflict.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Video Targets Veteran Investor with Fraudulent Investment Claims
records.description: Veteran investor Madhusudan Kela became the target of an AI-generated deepfake video circulating on social media, falsely promising hefty investment returns in his name. Kela publicly refuted the claims, notified authorities, and warned the public, highlighting the risks of AI-driven misinformation and potential financial harm to investors.

records.title: US Investigates Honda AI Braking System After Crashes and Injuries
records.description: The US National Highway Traffic Safety Administration is investigating over 250,000 Honda Insight and Passport vehicles (2019–2022) after 46 complaints that the AI-powered automatic emergency braking system activated unexpectedly, causing three crashes, two injuries, and property damage. Honda is cooperating with the probe.

records.title: Midjourney Bans Stability AI Employees Over Alleged Data Scraping and Service Disruption
records.description: Midjourney accused Stability AI employees of scraping prompt-image data using botnet-like activity, causing a prolonged service outage. In response, Midjourney banned all Stability AI employees from its platform. Stability AI's CEO denied the allegations, but the incident highlights competitive tensions and potential misuse of AI-generated data.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake News Sites Spread Misinformation Globally
records.description: Hundreds of AI-powered websites are rapidly producing and spreading fake news stories, including a viral false report about the Israeli Prime Minister's psychiatrist. These generative AI tools enable large-scale, low-cost fabrication of misinformation, fueling propaganda and undermining public trust, especially during sensitive geopolitical events and election periods.

records.title: Authorities Shut Down WorldCoin Biometric Scanning Sites Over Data Protection Violations
records.description: Argentinian authorities closed two WorldCoin-affiliated locations in La Plata for using AI-powered Orb devices to scan customers' irises and faces in exchange for money, citing violations of data protection laws, inadequate age verification, and lack of transparency. Similar regulatory actions and bans have occurred in Spain and other countries over privacy concerns.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Robocall Targets New Hampshire Voters, Raising Election Security Fears
records.description: An AI-generated robocall impersonating President Biden urged up to 25,000 New Hampshire voters not to participate in the primary, highlighting the real threat of AI-driven misinformation in elections. The incident has prompted election officials nationwide to increase training and preparedness against potential future AI-enabled disinformation and impersonation attacks.

records.title: AI Bias in Medical Devices Risks Patient Safety for Ethnic Minorities
records.description: An independent UK review found that AI-enabled medical devices, such as pulse oximeters, are less accurate for people with darker skin tones, leading to underdiagnosis and delayed treatment. The government accepted recommendations to urgently address these biases to prevent further harm to ethnic minority patients.

records.title: Interpol Warns of CJNG's Use of AI in Sophisticated Financial Fraud Schemes
records.description: Interpol reports that criminal groups like the Cártel Jalisco Nueva Generación (CJNG) are leveraging AI, advanced language models, and cryptocurrencies to conduct increasingly sophisticated financial frauds worldwide. These AI-enabled scams, including phishing and ransomware, have led to significant financial harm to individuals and businesses.

records.title: Generative AI Fuels Misleading Ads and Deepfake Violations in Marketing
records.description: Generative AI is increasingly used to create fabricated and unrealistic advertising content, including deepfake videos and images, leading to consumer deception and unauthorized use of individuals' likenesses. Companies like Instacart and various delivery apps have withdrawn misleading AI-generated ads, while regulators review the growing risks to consumer trust and personal rights.

records.title: AI Systems Cause Discriminatory Outcomes in Hiring, Lending, and Facial Recognition
records.description: Multiple reports highlight that AI systems, including Google Gemini and LinkedIn algorithms, have produced biased outcomes, such as discriminatory hiring practices, loan denials, and facial recognition errors. These biases have led to real-world harm, including loss of opportunities and perpetuation of social inequalities, particularly affecting marginalized groups and communities.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Videos Used for Blackmail Surge in Turkey
records.description: A surge in blackmail cases in Turkey involves AI systems creating fake explicit videos from victims' social media photos. These deepfakes are used to extort individuals, causing psychological harm and privacy violations. Experts urge victims to seek legal action, highlighting the urgent need for regulatory and societal responses.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake of UP Chief Minister Promoting Diabetes Medicine Goes Viral
records.description: An AI-generated deepfake video falsely showing Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath endorsing a diabetes medicine went viral on Facebook, amassing over 225,000 views. The video, posted by the account 'Grace Garsia', led to an FIR for impersonation, cheating, and IT Act violations due to the spread of harmful misinformation.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfakes Cause Widespread Harm: Fraud, Misinformation, and Nonconsensual Pornography
records.description: AI-powered deepfake technology has led to significant harm, including large-scale financial fraud, election misinformation, and the proliferation of nonconsensual pornographic content. Victims, especially women and public figures, face privacy violations, reputational damage, and emotional distress, prompting thousands of complaints and urgent calls for stronger detection, regulation, and removal measures.

records.title: AI-Driven Workplace Surveillance and Hiring Raises Privacy and Labor Rights Concerns in Canada
records.description: AI-powered surveillance and automated hiring systems are increasingly used in Canadian workplaces, tracking employee activities and making employment decisions. Experts warn these practices violate workers' privacy and labor rights, while Canadian laws lag behind in regulating such AI-driven monitoring and decision-making.

records.title: Authors Target AI-Generated Scam Books on Amazon
records.description: Authors are facing economic and reputational harm from a surge of AI-generated scam books on Amazon that mimic original works and divert sales. High-profile cases, including tech journalist Kara Swisher, have prompted Amazon to implement new disclosure requirements and removal measures, but concerns about ongoing intellectual property violations persist.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Scam Uses Bulgarian Public Figures to Defraud Victims
records.description: Hackers used AI to create deepfake videos and voices of TV host Marina Tsekova and President Rumen Radev to promote fraudulent investment schemes on social media. The convincing fakes led victims to lose tens of thousands of levs, prompting daily removal efforts by Bulgaria’s Cybercrime Directorate.

records.title: Generative AI Fuels Surge in Sophisticated Phishing Attacks
records.description: Cybercriminals are increasingly using generative AI tools like ChatGPT to create convincing phishing emails, leading to a dramatic rise in successful attacks. Studies show up to 80% of phishing campaigns now leverage AI, causing a 1265% increase in incidents since 2022 and overwhelming traditional detection methods.

records.title: Florida Teens Arrested for Creating and Sharing AI-Generated Deepfake Nudes of Classmates
records.description: Two Miami middle school boys, aged 13 and 14, were arrested and charged with felonies for using an AI application to create and share nonconsensual deepfake nude images of classmates aged 12-13. This marks the first known U.S. criminal case involving harm from AI-generated sexual imagery.

records.title: Brazil Bans AI Deepfakes Amid Election Disinformation Fears
records.description: Brazilian authorities have banned AI-generated deepfakes and issued new guidelines after deepfake videos and audio were used to spread political disinformation, defame individuals, and manipulate public opinion ahead of municipal elections. Incidents include fake celebrity endorsements and cloned voices of politicians, prompting urgent regulatory action to protect democratic processes.

records.title: Microsoft Bing's AI-Driven Censorship Enforces Chinese Government Controls Globally
records.description: Microsoft's Bing search engine, powered by AI, enforces Chinese government censorship by filtering politically sensitive content using blacklists. This censorship, intended for China, has at times affected users worldwide, suppressing information on topics like human rights and democracy, and resulting in violations of freedom of expression and access to information.

records.title: OpenAI's GPT-3.5 Found to Exhibit Racial Bias in Job Recruitment Tasks
records.description: A Bloomberg investigation revealed that OpenAI's GPT-3.5, used by companies for resume screening, systematically favored candidates with Asian-sounding names and disadvantaged Black-sounding names, even when qualifications were identical. This AI-driven bias in recruitment processes raises concerns over discrimination and violations of labor and human rights.

records.title: AI-Generated Nude Images of Minors Circulated by Students in Tenerife School
records.description: Two secondary students at Colegio La Salle in Tenerife used AI to create and distribute fake nude images of at least three female classmates via WhatsApp. The incident, discovered by peers, led to police and educational investigations, highlighting serious privacy violations and emotional harm caused by AI image manipulation.

records.title: GPT-4 Found to Reproduce Copyrighted Content in 44% of Prompts
records.description: Patronus AI's report reveals that OpenAI's GPT-4 model generated copyrighted book content in 44% of tested prompts, significantly more than other leading AI models. This widespread reproduction of protected material by GPT-4 raises serious concerns about copyright infringement and intellectual property violations by large language models.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfakes Fuel Surge in Non-Consensual Abuse Against Women
records.description: Generative AI-powered 'nudify' and deepfake apps are increasingly used to create non-consensual fake nude images and videos of women, causing significant psychological and societal harm. UK lawmakers warn current laws only ban sharing, not creation, of such content, leaving victims vulnerable to ongoing abuse and rights violations.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Pornography Spurs Legislative Action in the US
records.description: AI systems have been used to create nonconsensual pornographic deepfakes, causing significant harm to victims, including students and public figures. In response, lawmakers, led by Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, have introduced the DEFIANCE Act to provide legal recourse for victims and hold perpetrators accountable.

records.title: UNESCO Warns of Sexist Bias in Meta and OpenAI Language Models
records.description: An UNESCO study found that large language models from Meta (Llama 2) and OpenAI (GPT-2, GPT-3.5) exhibit clear sexist biases, associating women with domestic roles and men with professional ones. These AI systems amplify real-world discrimination, perpetuating harmful gender stereotypes in their outputs.

records.title: Automakers Share Drivers' Data with Insurers, Raising Privacy and Financial Concerns

records.title: Google Pauses Gemini AI Image Generation After Racial and Historical Inaccuracies
records.description: Google suspended the Gemini AI image generation feature after it produced racially and historically inaccurate images, including misrepresentations of Nazis and other figures. The malfunction sparked public criticism over bias and misinformation, prompting Google to pause the tool and commit to releasing an improved version.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfakes Disrupt South Korean Elections and Target Public Figures
records.description: AI-powered deepfake technology has been used in South Korea to create and spread highly realistic fake videos and images, including manipulated content of President Yoon Suk-yeol and explicit images of celebrities like Taylor Swift. These incidents have led to misinformation, harassment, and public confusion, prompting calls for stronger regulation and law enforcement action.

records.title: Virat Kohli Targeted by Deepfake Video Promoting Betting App
records.description: AI-generated deepfake videos featuring Virat Kohli falsely endorsing an illegal betting app have gone viral on social media. The manipulated content uses Kohli's likeness and voice, misleading viewers and risking financial harm, reputational damage, and widespread misinformation. Similar deepfake incidents have targeted other celebrities, highlighting growing concerns over AI misuse.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Video Claims Saddam Hussein Alive in 2024 Spreads Misinformation Online
records.description: A deepfake video using AI-generated audio falsely claims Saddam Hussein is alive in 2024, repurposing footage from a 2003 interview. The manipulated content, widely circulated on social media, misleads viewers and spreads misinformation, highlighting the risks of AI-driven synthetic media in fueling false narratives and undermining public trust.

records.title: AI-Driven Quant Funds Trigger Market Disruption and Regulatory Crackdown in China
records.description: Chinese quant hedge funds, including Lingjun Investment, experienced major failures in their AI-driven trading models, causing abnormal trading and sharp market volatility. This led to significant investor losses and prompted Chinese regulators to impose trading bans, tighten oversight, and introduce stricter rules for AI-based trading strategies to protect market stability.

records.title: AI-Generated Propaganda Proven as Persuasive as Human Disinformation Campaigns
records.description: Multiple studies found that propaganda articles generated by OpenAI's GPT-3 were nearly as persuasive as real propaganda from state actors like Iran and Russia. Research showed that AI-generated misinformation could sway public opinion as effectively as human-written disinformation, raising concerns about AI's role in scalable, harmful influence operations.

records.title: AI System Predicts Dangerous Drug Interactions to Prevent Harm
records.description: Researchers from MIT, Brigham and Women's Hospital, and Duke University developed a machine learning model that identifies harmful drug interactions by mapping how medications are transported in the body. The AI system aims to prevent adverse effects by alerting healthcare providers to dangerous drug combinations, directly addressing patient safety.

records.title: Houthi Forces Shoot Down US MQ-9 Reaper Drone Near Yemen Amid Ongoing AI-Driven Military Escalation
records.description: Houthi forces in Yemen shot down a US MQ-9 Reaper drone, an AI-powered surveillance aircraft, using a surface-to-air missile. The incident, part of escalating attacks involving AI-enabled drones and missiles, resulted in property damage and disrupted military operations, highlighting the risks of AI systems in conflict zones.

records.title: AI Systems Deployed to Combat Sophisticated Fraud and Voice Cloning Scams in Japan
records.description: Japanese police and banks are implementing AI systems to detect and prevent special fraud at ATMs and through phone calls, targeting scams against the elderly. Meanwhile, cybercriminals are increasingly using generative AI and voice cloning for sophisticated scams, causing significant financial losses to individuals and companies.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Video of Donald Trump's Deceased Father Used in US Election Campaign
records.description: The Lincoln Project used AI to create a deepfake video depicting Fred Trump, Donald Trump's deceased father, criticizing his son. Released ahead of the 2024 US presidential election, the synthetic video spreads misinformation and manipulates public opinion, raising concerns about AI-driven disinformation in political campaigns.

records.title: AI-Generated Voice Cloning Used in Church Authority Impersonation Scams in Spain
records.description: Fraudsters in Spain used AI to clone voices of high-ranking church officials, impersonating them in phone calls to religious communities and convents. This enabled successful scams, resulting in financial losses of thousands of euros. The AI-enabled impersonation exploited trust, leading to fraudulent transfers and harm to religious groups.

records.title: AI System Reconstructs Fingerprints from Touchscreen Sounds, Exposing Biometric Security Flaw
records.description: Researchers from the US and China developed PrintListener, an AI-based method that reconstructs fingerprints by analyzing sounds produced during touchscreen swipes. The technology successfully recreated up to 27.9% of partial and 9.3% of full fingerprints, exposing a significant vulnerability in biometric authentication and threatening user privacy and security.

records.title: Minors in Valencia Investigated for AI-Generated Nude Images of Schoolgirls
records.description: Five minors in Valencia are under investigation for using AI to create fake nude images of 17 women, including 13 minors, by altering photos taken from social media. The manipulated images were then distributed online without consent, causing significant harm and violating privacy rights.

records.title: North Korean Hackers Use AI to Conduct Sophisticated LinkedIn Scams
records.description: North Korean hackers are leveraging AI tools like ChatGPT to create convincing fake profiles and phishing messages on LinkedIn and other platforms. These AI-enabled scams target professionals to steal sensitive information and funds, which are then used to finance North Korea’s nuclear and missile programs, causing significant security and financial harm.

records.title: AI Deepfake Technology Fuels Major Financial Fraud and Misinformation Incidents
records.description: AI deepfake systems have been used in large-scale financial fraud, including a 200 million HKD scam in Hong Kong, and in spreading fake explicit images and misinformation targeting public figures. These incidents highlight the direct harm caused by AI-generated synthetic media, prompting global concern and calls for stronger regulation.

records.title: AI Deepfakes Used to Impersonate Ukrainian Influencer for Political Propaganda and E-commerce in China
records.description: AI deepfake technology was used to clone Ukrainian influencer Olga Loiek’s face and voice, creating fake accounts on Chinese social media that impersonated her as a pro-Russian, pro-China persona. These accounts spread political propaganda and sold products without her consent, violating her rights and misleading millions.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Biographies Exploit Deceased Celebrities
records.description: AI systems have been used to rapidly generate and publish fake, error-filled biographies of recently deceased public figures on platforms like Amazon. These AI-generated books misrepresent facts, cause emotional and reputational harm to families, and exploit grief for profit, prompting concerns over online publishing ethics and content accuracy.

records.title: Waymo Robotaxi Expansion Halted After AI-Driven Vehicle Incidents in California
records.description: California regulators suspended Waymo's robotaxi expansion after safety concerns arose from incidents involving its autonomous vehicles, including a collision that injured a cyclist and property damage from vandalism. The suspension follows public protests and increased scrutiny of AI-driven vehicles' safety on public roads.

records.title: AI Chatbots Spread Extremism, Exploit Users, and Malfunction in Customer Service
records.description: AI chatbots on platforms like Gab have impersonated figures such as Hitler and Bin Laden, spreading conspiracy theories and inciting violence, with links to real-world crime. Separately, AI 'girlfriend' bots exploit users with explicit content and manipulative tactics, while a DPD customer service chatbot malfunctioned, insulting customers and damaging reputations.

records.title: AI-Generated Apartment Scams Target Renters in Germany
records.description: Fraudsters in Germany are using AI to generate fake images and websites for non-existent apartments, deceiving renters into paying deposits for properties that do not exist. The Lower Saxony State Criminal Police Office warns that this AI-driven scam is causing financial harm to victims seeking housing.

records.title: AI Vote Tallying System Sirekap Malfunctions, Causes Election Misinformation in Indonesia
records.description: Indonesia's Sirekap AI-based vote tallying system experienced significant errors during the 2024 election, including a viral incident where one polling station was reported to have 3.5 million votes for a candidate pair. The malfunction led to widespread misinformation and public distrust in the electoral process, highlighting inadequate system testing.

records.title: Idaho Criminalizes AI-Generated Child Sexual Abuse Material
records.description: The Idaho legislature passed a law allowing prosecutors to charge individuals with sexual exploitation for producing child pornography using AI-generated images. This legislative response addresses the harm and legal risks posed by AI systems used to create exploitative content involving children.

records.title: Wyze Security Camera Glitch Exposes Private Feeds to Thousands
records.description: A malfunction in Wyze's AI-powered home security cameras, triggered by an AWS outage and a software glitch, exposed private camera images and videos to approximately 13,000 users. The incident resulted in unauthorized access to strangers' home footage, causing significant privacy violations and emotional distress.

records.title: AI Deepfake Trojan Targets iPhone and Android Users for Banking Fraud
records.description: A new banking trojan, GoldPickaxe, has been discovered targeting iPhone and Android users. The malware collects biometric and ID data, then uses AI-generated deepfakes to impersonate victims and access their bank accounts, leading to financial theft and privacy violations. Initial attacks focus on Vietnam and Thailand, with expansion expected.

records.title: Cruise Executive Resignations Follow Self-Driving Car Pedestrian Injury and Waymo Arson Incident
records.description: After a Cruise self-driving car injured a pedestrian in San Francisco, California suspended Cruise's driverless permits, prompting executive resignations and operational halts. In a related backlash, a Waymo autonomous vehicle was vandalized and set on fire by city residents, highlighting public tensions and safety concerns around AI-driven vehicles.

records.title: AI-Generated Celebrity Voice Deepfakes Used in Social Media Scams
records.description: Cybercriminals are using AI-powered voice cloning to create deepfake audio of celebrities, which is then used in fraudulent schemes on Facebook and Instagram. These scams, including fake contests and investment opportunities, have led to financial losses and data theft for users, leveraging the realism of AI-generated voices to deceive victims.

records.title: SP Balasubrahmanyam's Family Takes Legal Action Over Unauthorized AI Voice Recreation in Telugu Film
records.description: The family of late singer SP Balasubrahmanyam issued a legal notice to the makers of Telugu film 'Keedaa Cola' for using AI and deepfake technology to recreate his voice without consent. The unauthorized use for commercial purposes violated intellectual property rights, prompting demands for apology, compensation, and royalties.

records.title: Alleged Algorithmic Manipulation in Indonesia's 2024 Election System
records.description: The Anies-Muhaimin campaign alleges that the Indonesian Election Commission's (KPU) Sirekap system was manipulated via algorithmic settings to favor a specific presidential candidate, resulting in automated vote inflation. Forensic IT analysis reportedly found evidence of systematic data manipulation, raising concerns over election integrity and AI-driven electoral fraud.

records.title: X (formerly Twitter) AI Verification Grants Premium Services to Terrorist-Linked Accounts
records.description: A Tech Transparency Project report revealed that X (formerly Twitter), using AI-driven verification and premium service management, granted blue checkmarks and premium features to accounts linked to US-sanctioned terrorist groups. This AI system failure enabled these groups' online presence, violating legal obligations and posing risks to national security and public safety.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfakes Disrupt South Korean Election Campaigns
records.description: South Korea's National Election Commission detected 129 AI-generated deepfake videos and images violating election law ahead of parliamentary elections. The use of deepfakes for electoral campaigning is banned due to their potential to spread disinformation and undermine democratic processes, prompting increased vigilance and legal action by authorities.

records.title: Air Canada Ordered to Compensate Passenger Misled by Chatbot's Incorrect Fare Advice
records.description: Air Canada was ordered to pay compensation after its AI-powered chatbot gave a passenger incorrect information about bereavement fare eligibility, leading to financial harm. The tribunal ruled the airline responsible for the chatbot’s misleading advice, confirming the direct link between the AI system’s malfunction and the passenger’s loss.

records.title: AI Student Monitoring in Schools Raises Privacy and Discrimination Concerns
records.description: Schools across the U.S. are deploying AI-based monitoring software from companies like Bark, Gaggle, GoGuardian, and Securly to flag students at risk of suicide. However, these systems have led to privacy breaches, discriminatory impacts on minority students, and inappropriate disciplinary or law enforcement actions, raising significant ethical concerns.

records.title: Waymo Recalls Robotaxis After AI Software Causes Twin Collisions in Phoenix
records.description: Waymo recalled 444 self-driving vehicles after two of its autonomous cars in Phoenix collided with the same towed pickup truck due to AI software misjudging the truck's movement. No injuries occurred, but the incidents caused minor property damage and prompted a fleet-wide software update and regulatory notification.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Images Published in Scientific Journal Undermine Research Integrity
records.description: The journal Frontiers in Cell and Developmental Biology published a peer-reviewed article containing AI-generated, anatomically incorrect, and nonsensical scientific illustrations. The incident, involving tools like Midjourney, led to misinformation, public ridicule, and retraction, highlighting the risks of unverified AI use in scientific publishing and the resulting harm to scientific credibility.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Videos Used in Widespread Fraudulent Schemes in Greece
records.description: Greek authorities have detected a surge in AI-generated deepfake videos featuring well-known public figures promoting fake investment schemes and miracle medicines. These videos, distributed via social media and websites, have led to financial losses and health risks, prompting warnings and investigations by the Cyber Crime Division and international law enforcement.

records.title: Generative AI Drives Surge in Fraud and Deepfake Scams Globally
records.description: Generative AI and deepfake technologies are fueling a sharp rise in fraud and identity theft, with businesses and individuals worldwide reporting increased financial losses and digital impersonation. Studies highlight a 3000% spike in deepfake attacks and significant challenges for organizations in combating AI-enabled fraud.

records.title: X's AI Algorithms Enable Monetization of Wartime Misinformation
records.description: Elon Musk's X (formerly Twitter) uses AI-driven content recommendation and monetization systems that prioritize engagement over accuracy, enabling influencers to profit from spreading misinformation about the Israel-Hamas conflict. This has led to widespread dissemination of false and harmful content, causing real-world harm to affected communities.

records.title: State-Backed Hackers Exploit ChatGPT for Cyberattacks, Microsoft and OpenAI Report
records.description: Microsoft and OpenAI revealed that state-affiliated hackers from China, Russia, Iran, and North Korea have used AI tools like ChatGPT to enhance cyberattacks, including phishing and malware development. The companies detected and shut down accounts linked to these actors, highlighting AI's role in escalating cybersecurity threats.

records.title: New York Sues Social Media Giants Over AI-Driven Harm to Youth Mental Health
records.description: The City of New York has filed a lawsuit against Meta, ByteDance, Google, and Snap, alleging their AI-powered social media platforms intentionally manipulate and addict young users, causing widespread mental health harm, including depression and addiction. The suit claims these companies designed their systems to maximize youth engagement at the expense of well-being.

records.title: AI Romantic Chatbots Exposed as Privacy and Security Threats
records.description: Mozilla researchers found that popular AI romantic chatbots, including Replika and Eva AI, collect and share sensitive user data without proper security or consent, violating privacy rights. These chatbots encourage dependency and can expose users to manipulation and psychological harm, making them a significant privacy and safety risk.

records.title: ChatGPT Used to Fraudulently Obtain 100 Free McDonald's Meals
records.description: A podcaster and businessman admitted to using ChatGPT to generate fake complaints, enabling him to fraudulently acquire over 100 free meals from McDonald's. By submitting AI-generated negative feedback using stolen receipts, he exploited the company's survey system, causing economic harm and highlighting risks of AI misuse for fraud.

records.title: AI-Powered Retail Pricing Algorithms Lead to Consumer Price Gouging
records.description: Major Australian retailers, banks, airlines, and electricity companies are using AI-driven pricing algorithms to implement unfair pricing strategies, resulting in economic harm to consumers through price gouging and discrimination. A recent inquiry highlights these practices and calls for stronger regulatory powers to address AI-enabled consumer exploitation.

records.title: Tesla Full Self-Driving Implicated in Fatal Crash of Company Employee
records.description: Tesla recruiter Hans von Ohain died in a fiery crash while reportedly using the company's Full Self-Driving (FSD) AI system. Conflicting reports exist about whether FSD was active, but evidence and witness accounts suggest the AI struggled with the road, raising concerns about the system's reliability and safety.

records.title: Dutch Driver Wrongly Fined by AI Traffic Camera for Scratching Head
records.description: A Dutch driver was wrongly fined €380 after an AI-powered traffic camera misclassified him scratching his head as using a phone while driving. The incident highlights the risk of AI misidentification leading to unjust penalties, as the driver, a data specialist, contested the error using photo evidence.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake of London Mayor Sadiq Khan Incites Social Disorder
records.description: An AI-generated deepfake audio clip falsely portraying London Mayor Sadiq Khan making inflammatory remarks about Remembrance events went viral in November 2023. The misinformation incited far-right hostility, nearly caused serious disorder, and highlighted the inadequacy of current laws to address the harms of AI-generated disinformation.

records.title: California Lawmakers Respond to Self-Driving Car Accidents with Stricter Regulation Proposals
records.description: Following incidents where AI-driven robotaxis from Waymo and Cruise injured a cyclist and dragged a pedestrian, California lawmakers and labor unions are pushing for stricter regulations, including requiring human drivers in autonomous trucks and giving cities more control over permits, amid rising public safety concerns and backlash.

records.title: AI-Driven Romance Scams Surge on Dating Apps During Valentine's Season
records.description: Multiple reports reveal a surge in AI-generated fake profiles and messages on dating apps, leading to widespread romance scams. Scammers use advanced AI tools to deceive users, resulting in significant financial and emotional harm. Studies show a high percentage of Indian users have encountered or fallen victim to these AI-enabled scams.

records.title: Missouri Court Fines Litigant for Submitting AI-Generated Fake Legal Citations
records.description: Jonathan Karlen, representing himself in a Missouri appeals case, used AI to generate nearly two dozen fake legal citations in court filings. The court fined him $10,000 for misleading the court and wasting opposing counsel's resources, highlighting the risks of AI-generated misinformation in legal proceedings.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake News Targets Croatian Singer Vladimir Kočiš Zec
records.description: AI-generated images and fabricated articles falsely claiming scandals and the death of Croatian singer Vladimir Kočiš Zec have spread widely on social media. These paid posts and fake news sites have caused public confusion, emotional distress, and reputational harm, highlighting the dangers of AI-driven misinformation campaigns.

records.title: AI Deepfake of Deceased Dictator Used to Influence Indonesian Election
records.description: Indonesian political party Golkar used AI to create a deepfake video of deceased dictator Suharto, urging voters to support their candidate in the 2024 election. The video, widely circulated on social media, sparked criticism for manipulating voters and undermining democratic integrity through AI-generated misinformation.

records.title: Waymo Robotaxi AI Failures Lead to Collisions and Public Backlash in the US
records.description: Waymo's autonomous vehicles experienced two notable AI incidents: software errors caused minor collisions with a truck in Phoenix, prompting a fleet-wide software update, and a robotaxi in San Francisco failed to recognize a no-vehicle zone during Lunar New Year, leading to the vehicle being attacked and burned by a crowd. No injuries were reported.

records.title: Russian AI-Enabled Lancet Drones Cause Widespread Destruction in Ukraine
records.description: Russian forces have deployed AI-powered Lancet kamikaze drones with advanced autonomous targeting and navigation in Ukraine, resulting in the destruction of over 1,000 military targets. The use of these AI systems has directly led to significant harm to property and infrastructure in the ongoing conflict.

records.title: Waymo Robotaxi Set on Fire Amid Public Backlash in San Francisco
records.description: A Waymo self-driving robotaxi was vandalized and set on fire by a crowd in San Francisco during Chinese New Year celebrations. The vehicle, operating autonomously and without passengers, was targeted amid ongoing public criticism and controversy over the deployment of AI-driven taxis in the city.

records.title: Super Bowl Ads Highlight Dangers of Tesla's Self-Driving AI Amid Regulatory Scrutiny and Public Backlash
records.description: Safety advocacy group The Dawn Project aired Super Bowl ads urging a boycott of Tesla, citing incidents where Tesla's AI-powered self-driving software allegedly caused crashes, injuries, and deaths. Regulatory bodies have investigated and recalled vehicles, while critics accuse Tesla of failing to address persistent safety risks linked to its AI systems.

records.title: Google Uses AI to Remove 170 Million Fake Reviews from Maps and Search
records.description: In 2023, Google deployed a new machine learning algorithm to detect and remove over 170 million fake reviews and 12 million fraudulent profiles from Google Maps and Search, increasing removals by 45% compared to the previous year and protecting users and businesses from misinformation and fraud.

records.title: Facial Recognition AI in Policing Leads to Wrongful Arrests and Calls for Regulation
records.description: AI-powered facial recognition systems used by law enforcement have led to wrongful arrests and accusations, highlighting cases like Porcha Woodruff's misidentification. These incidents demonstrate direct harm from AI misidentification, prompting experts to call for stricter regulation and transparency to prevent further violations of rights and wrongful convictions.

records.title: Israel Deploys AI-Enabled Weapons in Gaza Conflict, Raising Civilian Harm and Oversight Concerns
records.description: Israel has deployed AI-powered military technologies, including gunsights and drones, in the Gaza conflict to target enemy drones and map tunnels. Their use has contributed to significant civilian harm, raising international concerns about autonomous weapons, oversight, and human rights in modern warfare.

records.title: Amazon Removes AI-Generated Books Spreading False Claims About King Charles' Cancer
records.description: AI-generated books containing false and intrusive information about King Charles' cancer diagnosis were sold on Amazon, causing reputational and privacy harm. Buckingham Palace condemned the books as inaccurate and insensitive, prompting Amazon to remove the titles for violating content guidelines and launch an investigation.

records.title: AI-Driven TikTok Content Fuels Border Crossings and Election Misinformation
records.description: AI-powered TikTok recommendation algorithms have enabled Chinese migrants to access instructional videos for illegally crossing the US border, contributing to increased illegal immigration and associated risks. Separately, in Indonesia, AI-generated deepfake videos and fake audio have been used to spread political misinformation during elections, undermining democratic processes.

records.title: Da Vinci Surgical Robot Malfunction Causes Patient Death, Lawsuit Filed
records.description: A Da Vinci surgical robot, developed by Intuitive Surgical, allegedly caused fatal injuries by burning and perforating a patient's intestine during surgery in Florida. The patient's husband has sued the manufacturer, citing known electrical defects, insufficient operator training, and failure to disclose risks, leading to the patient's death.

records.title: Hikvision's AI Surveillance Enables Uyghur Oppression in China
records.description: Chinese company Hikvision's AI-powered surveillance and facial recognition systems have been used by the Chinese government to identify, track, and detain Uyghur Muslims, facilitating mass human rights abuses including internment and forced labor. Despite this, Hikvision recently joined a United Nations human rights initiative.

records.title: AI Deep Fakes Cause Financial Scams, Non-Consensual Pornography, and Election Risks
records.description: AI-generated deep fakes have led to major harms, including a $39 million financial scam in Hong Kong, non-consensual pornography targeting public figures like Taylor Swift, and threats to election integrity. Lawmakers in the US, EU, and states like Arizona are proposing regulations to address these AI-driven risks and abuses.

records.title: Android Auto Voice Assistant Failure Raises Driver Safety Concerns
records.description: A widespread malfunction of Google Assistant in Android Auto has left users unable to use voice commands, displaying repeated error messages. This AI system failure forces drivers to interact manually or forgo features, increasing distraction and potentially compromising road safety. Google has not yet addressed the issue.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Audio Used to Defame Manaus Mayor Triggers Federal Investigation
records.description: In December 2023, an AI-generated deepfake audio falsely simulating the voice of Manaus mayor David Almeida insulting teachers was widely circulated online. The incident led to reputational harm and misinformation. Brazilian Federal Police launched Operation Nirmata, executing search warrants and seizing equipment from suspects involved in creating and spreading the fake audio.

records.title: AI-Powered Employee Surveillance Raises Privacy and Labor Rights Concerns
records.description: Major corporations are using AI systems from companies like Aware to monitor employee communications on platforms such as Slack, Teams, and Zoom. These AI tools analyze sentiment, flag behaviors, and sometimes identify individuals, raising significant concerns about privacy violations, chilling effects on workplace speech, and potential labor rights infringements.

records.title: AI-Based Early Warning System Deployed to Prevent Elephant Deaths on Railway Tracks in Tamil Nadu
records.description: The Tamil Nadu Forest Department has launched an AI-enabled early warning system using camera-mounted towers to detect elephants near railway tracks and send alerts, aiming to prevent elephant deaths from train collisions. This first-of-its-kind system in India replaces manual surveillance and addresses a longstanding wildlife safety issue.

records.title: Deepfake Scam Causes $25 Million Loss, Prompts Security Innovation from Ethereum Co-founder
records.description: A company lost $25 million in a deepfake video call scam, highlighting the dangers of AI-generated impersonations. In response, Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin proposed using personalized security questions based on unique shared experiences to better authenticate identities and counteract the growing threat of deepfake technology.

records.title: Amazon Sued Over AI-Driven 'Buy Box' Steering Shoppers to Higher-Priced Items
records.description: Amazon faces a proposed class action lawsuit alleging its Buy Box algorithm, an AI system, deceptively steers shoppers toward higher-priced products—often from sellers in its Fulfillment by Amazon program—while obscuring cheaper options, resulting in financial harm to consumers and violating consumer protection laws.

records.title: Former Apple Engineer Jailed for Stealing Self-Driving Car AI Secrets
records.description: Xiaolang Zhang, a former Apple engineer, was sentenced to prison and fined nearly $147,000 for stealing confidential information and hardware related to Apple’s self-driving car AI project, Project Titan. Zhang attempted to take the trade secrets to China, directly violating intellectual property rights and compromising the AI system’s development.

records.title: US Regulators Restrict AI Use in Medicare Coverage After Patient Harm
records.description: US health insurers used the AI tool nH Predict to make Medicare Advantage coverage decisions, leading to patient harm and lawsuits over denied care. In response, the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services issued new guidelines prohibiting insurers from relying solely on AI or algorithms to determine patient care or coverage.

records.title: BlueVoyant Report Reveals Surge in AI-Driven Cybercrime Tactics
records.description: BlueVoyant's latest report highlights a rise in cybercriminals using generative AI to conduct more effective phishing attacks and exploit vulnerabilities, leading to increased financial and reputational harm for organizations. AI enables attackers to rapidly scale and customize campaigns, making cyber defenses more challenging.

records.title: Waymo Autonomous Vehicle Hits Cyclist and Is Later Destroyed by Arson in San Francisco
records.description: A Waymo autonomous vehicle in San Francisco failed to promptly detect a cyclist, resulting in a collision and minor injury. Days later, amid rising public tension over self-driving cars, a Waymo vehicle was vandalized and set on fire by a group, causing property damage and traffic disruption. Authorities are investigating both incidents.

records.title: FCC Bans AI-Generated Robocalls After Deepfake Biden Incident
records.description: The FCC unanimously banned AI-generated voice robocalls after a deepfake of President Biden was used to mislead New Hampshire voters. The new rule, prompted by this and similar incidents, aims to curb scams, voter misinformation, and fraud enabled by AI voice-cloning technology.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Video Falsely Shows Taylor Swift Endorsing Trump Goes Viral
records.description: A manipulated video, likely created using AI tools, falsely depicts Taylor Swift holding a pro-Trump sign at the Grammys. The deepfake spread widely on social media, misleading viewers and fueling political misinformation, though media outlets have debunked the video and clarified it is fake.

records.title: Ukrainian Cyberattack Disrupts Russian AI-Enabled Drone Control Systems
records.description: Ukrainian military intelligence conducted a cyberattack that disabled Russian AI-enabled drone control software, which manages drone reprogramming, video transmission, and friend-or-foe recognition. The attack caused widespread operational failures, denying Russian forces access to their drones and disrupting critical military infrastructure.

records.title: Iranian Hackers Use AI Deepfakes to Spread Disinformation via UAE Streaming Services
records.description: Iranian state-backed hackers, linked to the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, used AI-generated deepfake news broadcasts to infiltrate and disrupt UAE streaming services in December 2023. The operation spread fabricated reports and unverified images about the Israel-Hamas war, misleading audiences in the UAE, UK, and Canada and undermining public trust.

records.title: Waymo Self-Driving Car Collides with Cyclist in San Francisco, Prompting Regulatory Review
records.description: A Waymo autonomous vehicle collided with a cyclist in San Francisco after failing to detect the cyclist, who was obscured by a truck. The cyclist sustained minor injuries. The incident is under investigation by California authorities, raising concerns about the safety and readiness of AI-driven vehicles on public roads.

records.title: AI-Enhanced Phishing Attacks Cause Surge in Cybersecurity Incidents Globally
records.description: Acronis reports reveal that over 90% of organizations across 15 countries were impacted by AI-enhanced phishing attacks in 2023, largely driven by generative AI tools like ChatGPT. These attacks contributed to a 222% surge in email-based threats, resulting in widespread data breaches, financial losses, and operational disruptions.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfakes Fuel Crypto Scams and Prompt Government Action
records.description: AI-generated deepfakes have been used to impersonate figures like Vitalik Buterin, promoting fraudulent crypto schemes and causing financial harm. In response to rising deepfake threats, especially ahead of elections, governments are developing detection tools and deploying specialist teams to mitigate misinformation and protect the public.

records.title: China's AI-Driven Surveillance Targets Tibetans via Mandatory App
records.description: Chinese authorities are increasing digital surveillance of Tibetans by mandating the installation of the AI-powered National Anti-Fraud Center app, which monitors personal data, movements, and communications. This AI-enabled surveillance, detailed by activist groups and researchers, has led to significant human rights violations and suppression of cultural and religious freedoms.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfakes Used to Harm Romanian Children Online
records.description: A World Vision România survey found that one in ten children had their image or voice falsified using AI (deepfakes) and distributed online, causing reputational and psychological harm. The organization is responding with AI-generated educational videos to help children address online abuse.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfakes Cause Harm in Politics, Pornography, and Society
records.description: Generative AI systems are increasingly used to create deepfake videos and images, leading to significant harm including nonconsensual pornography, political disinformation, election interference, and reputational damage. These incidents have prompted urgent calls for government regulation and the development of detection technologies to mitigate the societal and democratic risks posed by AI-driven deepfakes.

records.title: AI-Generated Robocalls Impersonate President Biden to Spread Election Misinformation
records.description: Life Corporation allegedly used AI to generate robocalls impersonating President Biden and election officials, spreading false information to New Hampshire voters and discouraging participation in the primary. This misuse of AI prompted legal warnings from 51 state attorneys general, citing threats to election integrity and violations of consumer protection laws.

records.title: EU Proposes Criminal Penalties for AI-Generated Child Sexual Abuse Material
records.description: The European Commission has proposed stricter laws to criminalize the creation, possession, and distribution of child sexual abuse material generated by AI, including deepfakes and AI chatbots used for abuse. The move responds to a surge in AI-enabled exploitation, aiming to close legal gaps and better protect children.

records.title: Bumble Deploys AI 'Deception Detector' to Reduce Fake Profiles and Scams
records.description: Bumble launched an AI-powered tool, Deception Detector, to identify and block fake profiles, scams, and spam on its dating platform. Within two months, user reports of such deceptive accounts dropped by 45%, significantly reducing risks of financial and emotional harm for users.

records.title: TikTok's AI Moderation Fails to Curb Antisemitic Content, Prompting High-Level Talks
records.description: Israeli President Isaac Herzog met with TikTok executives to address a surge in antisemitic and anti-Israel content on the platform. Despite AI-driven moderation, harmful content, including hate speech and misinformation, remained online, highlighting failures in TikTok's AI systems and resulting in harm to affected communities.

records.title: Outdated AI Navigation Systems Direct Drivers Down Stairs in Edinburgh
records.description: Apple Maps and Google Maps, both AI-powered navigation systems, failed to update road changes in Edinburgh, directing drivers down a pedestrian-only lane with steps. Multiple vehicles became stuck, prompting the city council to contact the companies and install barriers to prevent further incidents, highlighting risks from outdated AI-generated routing.

records.title: AI-Driven Israeli Surveillance Causes Psychological Harm to West Bank Palestinians
records.description: Israeli forces have intensified the use of AI-powered surveillance, including facial recognition systems, in the occupied West Bank. Palestinians report severe psychological distress, loss of privacy, and human rights violations as a result of constant monitoring, especially since the escalation of conflict in Gaza.

records.title: TikTok Algorithm Amplifies Misogynistic Content Among Teens, Study Finds
records.description: A joint study by University College London and the University of Kent found that TikTok's AI-driven recommendation algorithm rapidly amplifies misogynistic content, leading to a fourfold increase in such material in just five days. This normalization of harmful ideologies is impacting young people's attitudes and mental health, especially among vulnerable boys.

records.title: Generative AI Drives Record Surge in Child Sexual Abuse Material Reports in Brazil
records.description: Reports of child sexual abuse material in Brazil rose 77% in 2023, reaching a 17-year high, largely due to the use of generative AI to create synthetic abusive images. SaferNet and experts highlight AI's role in facilitating the production and spread of illegal, harmful content, prompting increased law enforcement investigations.

records.title: TikTok's AI Algorithms Enable Spread of Antisemitic and Hateful Content Among Youth
records.description: The Bildungsstätte Anne Frank criticizes TikTok for enabling the rapid spread of antisemitic, racist, and conspiratorial content among young users through its AI-driven recommendation and moderation systems. AI-generated images and hate speech are widely disseminated, contributing to the radicalization and harm of vulnerable communities.

records.title: Amnesty International Warns of AI-Driven Human Rights Violations in Migration Systems
