records.description: Amnesty International reports that governments in the US, UK, EU, and elsewhere are deploying AI systems—such as facial recognition, emotion recognition, AI lie detectors, and algorithmic decision-making—in migration and asylum processes, leading to discrimination, unlawful surveillance, and other human rights violations against refugees and migrants.

records.title: AI Tools Uncover Massive GST Tax Evasion in India
records.description: Indian GST officials used AI systems like NETRA, BIFA, and ADVAIT to detect 14,597 tax evasion cases and Rs 18,000 crore in fake input tax credits between April and December 2023, leading to 98 arrests. The AI tools were central in identifying and acting against fraudulent taxpayers.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake IDs Bypass Crypto Exchange KYC Checks
records.description: The AI service OnlyFake uses neural networks to generate highly realistic fake IDs, enabling users to bypass identity verification (KYC) on major cryptocurrency exchanges. This has facilitated fraud, undermined regulatory compliance, and poses significant risks to financial security and anti-money laundering efforts.

records.title: Philadelphia Sheriff’s Campaign Removes AI-Generated Fake News Stories
records.description: Philadelphia Sheriff Rochelle Bilal’s campaign removed over 30 fake news stories from its website after admitting they were generated by ChatGPT. The AI-created articles, presented as legitimate news, misled the public and raised concerns about misinformation and erosion of trust in democratic processes.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Images of Taylor Swift Originate from 4Chan Challenge
records.description: A challenge on the 4Chan forum encouraged users to bypass AI safeguards and create explicit deepfake images of Taylor Swift using generative AI tools. These non-consensual images were widely disseminated on social media, causing reputational and emotional harm, and highlighting the misuse of AI for generating harmful content.

records.title: Senate Hearing Blasts Facebook AI for Fueling Youth Mental Health Crisis
records.description: At its 20th anniversary, Facebook founder Mark Zuckerberg faced a US Senate hearing where lawmakers accused the platform’s AI-driven recommendation algorithms of prioritizing profit over user safety, fueling youth mental health crises, misinformation spread, and societal polarization. Senators warned these design decisions have “blood on your hands.”

records.title: Chinese Users Report Widespread Harm from Algorithmic Recommendations
records.description: Over 70% of Chinese users report being troubled by AI-driven recommendation algorithms, citing harms such as privacy violations, discriminatory pricing, addictive content, and the creation of information cocoons. These AI systems, used by commercial platforms to maximize profit, often disregard user well-being and fairness, leading to significant societal concerns.

records.title: Ukraine's Suicide Drones Spark Fears of Autonomous AI Killer Swarms
records.description: Ukraine's military has deployed small FPV suicide drones that track and kamikaze Russian soldiers, causing lethal battlefield casualties. British chiefs warn that integrating AI autonomy and facial recognition could evolve these into independent killer swarms, escalating a 'terrifying' arms race with novel autonomous lethal systems.

records.title: Generative AI Sparks Job Cuts in Film and Animation
records.description: CVL Economics surveyed 300 C-suite and senior managers across six entertainment sectors, finding 75% have used generative AI to eliminate, reduce, or consolidate film and animation jobs. Sound designers, music editors, and audio technicians are most at risk, prompting union warnings of widespread industry layoffs.

records.title: AI-enabled rent-fixing sparks lawsuits and legislative push
records.description: Tenants and the DOJ allege landlords using RealPage’s AI-driven pricing software unlawfully coordinate rent increases on 4.5 million units, inflating prices and harming communities. Class-action suits and Senate bills aim to ban algorithmic rent-fixing as lawmakers and regulators scrutinize automated collusion.

records.title: Akshay Kumar Targeted by Deepfake Video Promoting Game App
records.description: Bollywood actor Akshay Kumar has been targeted by an AI-generated deepfake video falsely showcasing him promoting a game application. Outraged at the unauthorized use of his likeness and potential reputational harm, he has filed a cyber complaint and initiated legal proceedings against those responsible for producing and distributing the clip.

records.title: AI-Powered VR Passthrough Causes Cognitive and Motor Impairments
records.description: Stanford Virtual Human Interaction Lab researchers found that long-term use of VR headsets with AI-driven passthrough, like Apple Vision Pro and Meta Quest 3, can cause cognitive dissonance, depth-perception distortions and impair tasks such as walking or reaching. Distortions from image-stitching algorithms highlight risks of prolonged immersion.

records.title: Lainey Wilson Testifies on AI Deepfake Misuse, Backs No AI Fraud Act
records.description: Lainey Wilson told a House subcommittee how AI deepfakes and voice clones used her likeness in false ads without consent, violating her rights and damaging her reputation. She urged lawmakers to pass the No AI Fraud Act to protect artists from unauthorized AI-generated imagery and audio.

records.title: Deepfake crypto scam impersonates Australian billionaire Andrew Forrest
records.description: Cybersecurity firm Cybertrace has warned of a realistic deepfake video of mining magnate Andrew “Twiggy” Forrest on Facebook promoting a fraudulent crypto trading platform called “Quantum AI.” The AI-generated clip mimics Forrest’s appearance and mannerisms to deceive users into financial fraud, risking substantial losses.

records.title: AI Deepfake CFO Scam Nets HK$200 Million
records.description: Scammers employed AI deepfake technology to mimic multiple UK-based executives in a pre-recorded video meeting, deceiving a Hong Kong branch’s finance staff into wire-transferring HK$200 million. Hong Kong police highlight the surge in deepfake investment frauds and recommend verifying sources, demanding live interactions, and using detection tools.

records.title: AI training and illustration misuse triggers UK copyright reform call and Tolkien backlash
records.description: A UK House of Lords committee urges government action after AI firms trained LLMs on unlicensed copyrighted works, harming creators. Simultaneously, a Chinese edition of Tolkien’s public-domain works faced fan outrage and legal concerns when publishers replaced contested images with AI-generated illustrations, reigniting debates over AI-driven copyright infringement.

records.title: Deepfake Targets Romanian Central Bank Chief to Pitch Investment Scam
records.description: Scammers used an AI-generated deepfake video of Romania’s central bank governor Mugur Isărescu to pitch fraudulent investments, misleading citizens and undermining trust. The National Bank of Romania warned people that neither Isărescu nor the bank endorse any investment recommendations.

records.title: HKCERT warns of AI-powered phishing surge and deepfake scams
records.description: HKCERT handled 7,752 security incidents in 2023, with phishing rising 27% to nearly half of cases. Malicious actors increasingly use AI-based tools like WormGPT to generate malware, code and deepfake videos for phishing. HKCERT forecasts five 2024 risks, urging updated backups, vulnerability management and deepfake detection.

records.title: Brazilian Tax Authority Uses AI to Identify 25k Undeclared Bitcoin Holders
records.description: Brazil’s Federal Revenue Service used AI and data analytics to pinpoint 25,126 taxpayers who held at least 0.05 BTC (approx. R$10 k) each and failed to declare over R$1.06 bn in cryptoassets. The authority plans to encourage self‐correction to avoid fines and strengthen crypto tax compliance.

records.title: Google Maps Lawsuit: Couple Attacked After AI Misroutes Into Violent Cape Town Neighborhood
records.description: Jason and Katharine Zoladz sued Google after following Google Maps directions through Cape Town’s Nyanga district, despite prior warnings that it was a violent ambush spot. Thieves attacked them at gunpoint, leaving Jason seriously injured and Katharine traumatized. The lawsuit alleges Google ignored safety alerts, causing direct harm via its AI routing.

records.title: Deepfake-driven fraud undermines facial biometrics, driving shift to hybrid authentication
records.description: Increasingly realistic AI-generated deepfakes have enabled hackers to bypass face biometric systems—costing an estimated $75 million in China and spiking fraud attempts by 3 000%. Gartner warns that by 2026, 30% of enterprises will abandon standalone facial authentication, favoring hybrid liveness checks with behavioral and device profiling.

records.title: Senate grills social media CEOs over AI-driven child harm
records.description: CEOs of Meta (Zuckerberg), TikTok (Chew), Snap (Spiegel), Discord (Citron) and X (Yaccarino) faced senators over AI-driven recommendation and moderation failures that circulated gruesome content and enabled child exploitation. They apologized to victims' families as Lindsey Graham and Josh Hawley pressed for legal accountability and stricter industry safeguards.

records.title: Love Island's Cally Jane Beech targeted by AI deepfake nudes
records.description: Love Island star Cally Jane Beech discovered AI-generated deepfake nude images of herself circulating online. Shocked and distressed, she posted an Instagram video warning followers about the emotional harm such synthetic sexual imagery can inflict and urging caution, highlighting how AI technology can be misused to violate privacy and reputations.

records.title: Zuckerberg apologizes for AI-driven social media harms to minors
records.description: During a US Congressional hearing, Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg apologized for harm his AI-powered Facebook and Instagram algorithms have caused minors, exposing them to dangerous content, cyberbullying and mental health issues. Under pressure from Senator Josh Hawley, he acknowledged the platforms’ impact on youth and apologized to affected families.

records.title: Rashmika Mandanna speaks out against viral deepfake video
records.description: Actress Rashmika Mandanna’s deepfake video went viral in November 2023, prompting Delhi Police to arrest its creator. Mandanna has spoken out on the dangers of AI-generated content, urging awareness and support for victims—especially vulnerable college students—and challenging societal norms that dismiss such digital violations.

records.title: Ofcom Warns Search Engines Act as 'One-Click Gateways' to Self-Harm Content
records.description: Ofcom warns that AI-powered search engines including Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, Yahoo and AOL can act as 'one-click gateways' to self-harm and suicide content. A study by the Network Contagion Research Institute found that roughly 22% of 37,000 search results related to self-injury led directly to glorifying or instructional harmful material.

records.title: ChatGPT Exposes Vulnerability of Online University Exams
records.description: A professor at NTUA used ChatGPT to complete two mock digital exams, obtaining top grades within seconds. The experiment highlights how AI can easily pass theoretical assessments, undermining the fairness and reliability of remote university exams, prompting calls to reevaluate digital testing methods across Greek institutions.

records.title: AI-generated child sexual exploitation content sparks alarm
records.description: The U.S. National Center for Missing and Exploited Children reported 4,700 instances of AI-generated child sexual exploitation content in 2023. Experts warn generative AI could worsen online abuse. Reports came from AI firms, social platforms and the public, prompting CEOs of Meta, TikTok, X, Snap and Discord to testify before the Senate on child safety.

records.title: ChatGPT Data Leak Exposes User Conversations and Credentials
records.description: In a recent security incident, ChatGPT users inadvertently accessed unrelated private conversations and login credentials belonging to other accounts. OpenAI attributes the breach to attackers exploiting compromised user accounts, but the leak of usernames, passwords, and sensitive chat histories underscores significant data security and privacy vulnerabilities in the AI platform.

records.title: Microsoft Engineer Warns of DALL-E 3 Deepfake Vulnerabilities
records.description: Microsoft engineer Shane Jones says he discovered security flaws in OpenAI’s DALL-E 3 that bypass content filters, enabling explicit deepfake images like Taylor Swift nudes. He alleges Microsoft downplayed and silenced his warnings and appealed to US lawmakers. Microsoft denies any proof but updated its AI’s safety guardrails.

records.title: Australian TV Channel Accused of AI-Sexualizing MP’s Image
records.description: Nine News in Australia used AI-powered Photoshop automation to enlarge Victorian MP Georgie Purcell’s breasts and expose her midriff, sparking criticism that the network perpetuated the sexualization and objectification of women in politics. Purcell condemned the unauthorized AI edits for harming her dignity and reputation.

records.title: Nevada AG sues social media for AI-driven youth addiction
records.description: Nevada Attorney General Aaron Ford has filed civil lawsuits in Las Vegas against TikTok, Snapchat and Meta’s platforms, alleging their AI-powered recommendation algorithms are designed to addict youths and prey on vulnerabilities, leading to mental health issues, physical safety risks, privacy violations and exploitative harms.

records.title: Taylor Swift Deepfake Porn Sparks Tech and Legal Response
records.description: In late January, AI-generated pornographic deepfakes of Taylor Swift spread on social media, bypassing safety filters in Microsoft's Designer tool. Fans rallied under “Protect Taylor Swift” as Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella decried the abuse. Platform X briefly blocked Swift searches, and lawmakers proposed bills against nonconsensual AI porn.

records.title: Deepfake Image of President Biden in Military Uniform Fuels Misinformation
records.description: Social media users circulated a deepfake image of President Joe Biden in military attire amid speculation of retaliation for the “Tower 22” attack in Jordan. The White House denied any such meeting with military officials, underscoring deepfakes’ capacity to mislead and inflame public tensions.

records.title: Italy’s Privacy Watchdog Opens Sanctions Against ChatGPT for GDPR Violations
records.description: Italy’s data protection authority, the Garante, has formally notified OpenAI of breaches of GDPR by its chatbot ChatGPT, citing inadequate legal bases for personal data processing, missing age verification, and privacy policy flaws. The Garante has opened sanction proceedings, giving OpenAI 30 days to respond to allegations and compliance demands.

records.title: Google Maps 'Fastest Route' Leads SUV Onto Stairs in Tamil Nadu
records.description: In Gudalur, Tamil Nadu, a Toyota Fortuner driver following Google Maps’ AI-powered “fastest route” ended up on a steep pedestrian staircase, leaving the SUV stuck. Police and volunteers had to assist the stranded vehicle, underscoring potential hazards when users rely uncritically on AI navigation guidance.

records.title: AI voice cloning drives 264% surge in banking fraud
records.description: Fraudsters exploit generative AI voice cloning, needing only a minute of speech to impersonate customers and bypass voice authentication. According to the South African Fraud Prevention Service, such attacks rose 264% in early 2022. Experts like iiDENTIfii’s founder urge banks to adopt stronger anti-spoofing measures to prevent theft.

records.title: ACLU urges trial in wrongful arrest caused by facial recognition error
records.description: In 2019, Nijeer Parks was wrongfully arrested for alleged shoplifting after a facial recognition system falsely matched him to surveillance footage. He spent ten days jailed and nearly ten months under prosecution before charges were dropped. The ACLU filed an amicus brief opposing summary judgment to challenge flawed police reliance on AI.

records.title: AI-generated Taylor Swift deepfake porn prompts platform bans and US legislation
records.description: A surge of AI-generated non-consensual pornographic deepfakes of Taylor Swift spread on X, Reddit, Meta and Telegram. X blocked searches and removed posts, while the White House urges Congress to pass a bill. Senators led by Dick Durbin introduced the DEFIANCE Act, allowing victims to sue creators.

records.title: ShotSpotter AI Malfunctions in Chicago, Missing Hundreds of Shootings
records.description: Chicago’s ShotSpotter, an AI-based acoustic sensor network for gunfire detection, missed hundreds of shootings—including a 55-round incident—and produced false alerts. Internal emails cite sensor downtimes, staffing shortages and algorithm errors. Critics link these failures to delayed police response, community harm and the 2021 death of 13-year-old Adam Toledo.

records.title: Social Media and Microsoft Act Against Taylor Swift AI Deepfake Scandal
records.description: AI-generated pornographic deepfake images of Taylor Swift circulated widely on social media, prompting X to temporarily block and later restore searches for her name while suspending offending accounts. Microsoft also restricted its Designer tool to prevent creation of explicit content. Platforms remain vigilant to remove any resurgence of these nonconsensual images.

records.title: US lawmakers propose banning AI-generated robocalls after Biden deepfake scam
records.description: Following AI-generated robocalls impersonating President Biden in New Hampshire and deepfake images of public figures, US lawmakers – including Congresswoman Yvette Clarke and FCC Chairwoman Jessica Rosenworcel – proposed banning AI voice-cloning under the Telephone Consumer Protection Act to curb fraud and election interference.

records.title: AI’s Hidden Workforce Endures 14-Hour Days with Minimal Pay
records.description: In Colombia, Kenya and Venezuela, data annotators work up to 14 hours daily for minimal pay, no contracts and self-funded insurance to label and evaluate content that trains AI systems. Their exploitation highlights labor rights violations and raises alarms over ‘digital colonialism’ by global tech platforms.

records.title: NHTSA recalls 2 million Tesla Autopilot vehicles after fatal crashes
records.description: Under Ann Carlson, NHTSA mandated reporting of crashes involving automated driving systems and pressured Tesla into recalling 2 million vehicles with its Autopilot system after fatal inattentive-driver crashes. The agency also secured ARC Automotive airbag inflator recalls. Carlson resigns to return to academia, capping a tenure focused on AI vehicle safety.

records.title: AI-Generated 'Shadow Play' YouTube Channels Spread Pro-China Disinformation
records.description: Le Monde and Australia’s ASPI discovered 10+ French YouTube channels launched since mid-2023 using AI-created voices and images to disseminate pro-China, anti-US propaganda as part of a “Shadow Play” influence operation. Collectively, they produced thousands of videos and attracted millions of views before YouTube removed several at ASPI’s request.

records.title: AI Deepfakes of Taylor Swift and George Carlin Spur Lawsuits and Union Action
records.description: AI-generated explicit Taylor Swift photos flooded social media, and a bogus Biden call misled voters. Simultaneously, an AI impression of George Carlin triggered a copyright and likeness lawsuit. SAG-AFTRA condemned these nonconsensual deepfakes and urged legal bans and stronger controls over actors’ AI likenesses.

records.title: Rights groups warn over Rio police’s AI facial recognition
records.description: Brazilian rights advocates are alarmed by the deployment of AI-based facial recognition across over 1,000 cameras in Rio’s public transport, warning that police-controlled systems lead to racial bias, wrongful arrests and privacy and liberty infringements, despite authorities’ claims of improved crime-fighting.

records.title: TikTok’s Chinese Parent ByteDance Still Accesses US User Data, Tweaks Algorithm
records.description: Despite investing $1.5 billion in Project Texas to isolate US data on Oracle servers, TikTok employees have bypassed controls to share Americans’ email addresses, birthdays, and IPs with Chinese parent ByteDance. ByteDance continues tweaking TikTok’s AI recommendation algorithm using unauthorized data transfers, according to the Wall Street Journal.

records.title: Tesla Model 3 AI System Failure Causes Sudden Highway Shutdown
records.description: Tesla owner James Hanna says his Model 3, relying on AI-based control systems, abruptly shut down at 60% charge on Interstate 277 in North Carolina, locking steering, disabling hazards and doors, and stopping in traffic. He filed a safety complaint with the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration after the incident endangered his life.

records.title: Amitabh Bachchan warns of AI face mapping and deepfake misuse
records.description: At the Symbiosis Film Festival, Bollywood icon Amitabh Bachchan warned that AI face-mapping and deepfake tools are creating unauthorized digital replicas of actors—from a 20-year-old Tom Hanks clip to doctored images of Rashmika Mandanna and Kajol—leading to trolling and rights violations; he urged legal measures to curb such misuse.

records.title: Tesla Autopilot recall highlights AI safety and camera software flaw
records.description: Tesla tested an Autopilot update under its largest recall, yet journalist Geoffrey Fowler observed persistent risky behaviors, including stop-sign infractions and driver-monitoring failures. Meanwhile, NHTSA-ordered recalls of over 2 million cars address Autopilot attention issues and a 200 000-vehicle Full Self-Driving camera software defect that obstructs rearview feed, raising collision risk.

records.title: Slovak central bank warns of AI deepfake investment scams
records.description: Slovakia’s central bank warns of rising investment scams using AI-generated deepfake videos impersonating celebrities and brands on social media to deceive victims into handing over personal and payment information, exploiting advanced translation and video editing tools.

records.title: Italian City of Trento Fined for AI Surveillance Privacy Breach
records.description: Italy’s data protection authority fined the city of Trento €50,000 and ordered deletion of all data from two EU-funded street surveillance projects after finding its AI tools violated personal data regulations. It marks the first sanction against an Italian local authority for improper use of AI in surveillance.

records.title: Tesla recalls nearly 200,000 vehicles over rearview camera glitch
records.description: Tesla is recalling almost 200,000 US 2023 Model S, X and Y cars with its Full Self-Driving computer due to an over-the-air software glitch that can disable the rearview camera, reducing visibility and increasing crash risk. Tesla issued a free OTA update and will mail owner notifications starting March 22.

records.title: Greek Tax Authority Deploys AI Algorithm to Catch Social Media Tax Evaders
records.description: Greek tax authority AADE uses a specialized algorithm to scan Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok for luxury lifestyles mismatched with declared income. A recent wedding activated the AI, enabling investigators to pinpoint attendees and wedding gift recipients for potential tax evasion under the donation tax code, leading to enforcement actions.

records.title: YouTube removes over 1,000 AI-generated celebrity deepfake scam ads
records.description: Google-owned YouTube has removed over 1,000 AI-generated deepfake scam videos featuring celebrities like Taylor Swift, Steve Harvey, and Joe Rogan promoting Medicare fraud. The ads, viewed nearly 200 million times, emerged from an advertising ring uncovered by 404 Media. Additionally, non-consensual deepfake porn of Taylor Swift reached 45 million views on X.

records.title: Haryana algorithm falsely declares thousands dead, cuts pensions
records.description: A government algorithm in Haryana’s Family Identity Data Repository falsely classified over a thousand elderly welfare recipients as deceased, stopping their pensions. Affected citizens, including 102-year-old Dhuli Chand, staged mock wedding processions to prove they were alive. The AI-driven system’s errors caused significant financial and welfare hardships.

records.title: AI-Generated Taylor Swift Deepfake Porn Sparks Social Media Outcry
records.description: A wave of nonconsensual AI-generated pornographic deepfake images of Taylor Swift circulated on X, Facebook, and Instagram, forcing platform moderators to suspend accounts while trolls reuploaded content. Fans rallied under #ProtectTaylorSwift to suppress the images as lawmakers demand tougher AI regulations to curb such abuses.

records.title: Non-consensual AI Deepfake Nudes of Influencer Yeri Mua Go Viral
records.description: Influencer Yeri Mua revealed that unidentified individuals used AI to generate and circulate fake explicit images of her, depicting her nude without consent. Spread online by alleged K-pop fans, these deepfake photos have violated her privacy and inflicted emotional distress, highlighting the misuse of AI in non-consensual image manipulation.

records.title: Deepfake video of Arturo Elías Ayub used in oil investment scam
records.description: Mexican entrepreneur Arturo Elías Ayub warned that a sophisticated AI-generated deepfake video impersonating him urged people to invest in a fraudulent oil scheme promising to double money in 24 hours. He cautioned the public not to fall for such AI-driven scams.

records.title: GM’s Cruise robotaxi drags pedestrian, triggers DOJ and SEC probes
records.description: On October 2, 2023, a Cruise autonomous vehicle in San Francisco dragged a pedestrian six meters after being struck, injuring them. Connectivity issues delayed regulators receiving the video. DOJ and SEC opened probes; a Quinn Emanuel report found no intentional cover-up. GM halted Ultra Cruise development, refocusing on Super Cruise.

records.title: NSA Purchases Americans' Browsing Data Without Warrant
records.description: Senator Ron Wyden revealed that the NSA is purchasing Americans' internet browsing and location metadata from commercial brokers without a warrant, using AI-enabled systems for analysis. The clandestine acquisition—from app developers through multiple resellers—contravenes privacy laws and prompted calls to cease until data is lawfully obtained.

records.title: Children report AI-generated sexual abuse imagery and deepfake nudes
records.description: NSPCC reports children contacting Childline over AI-generated child sexual abuse imagery, misinformation and bullying. A 15-year-old’s photos were used by a perpetrator to create fake nudes, causing distress. NSPCC and US group Common Sense Media will pressure tech firms, politicians and introduce digital literacy programs to safeguard minors.

records.title: Punjab deploys AI traffic cameras to enforce helmet laws
records.description: In Punjab, the Safe Cities Authority and Punjab Police led by IG Dr. Usman Anwar deployed AI-enabled CCTV software, developed by SSP Rafat Bukhari under MD Safe Cities Ahsan Younis, to automatically detect motorcycle riders without helmets and issue Rs. 2,000 fines in accordance with Lahore High Court orders.

records.title: Tesla Autopilot Recall Update Disables Driver-Assist Features, Prompts Safety Backlash
records.description: Tesla’s over-the-air recall update—designed to enforce stricter driver monitoring and curb Autopilot misuse—has caused software and hardware failures that disable Autopilot and ADAS functions on over two million vehicles. Owners report loss of critical safety features, while regulators intensify probes into Autopilot-related crashes and system reliability.

records.title: Global Report: 83% of Ethical Hackers Confront AI-Driven Attacks
records.description: EC-Council's C|EH Threat Report 2024, surveying 1,066 cybersecurity pros, finds 83% have faced AI-driven attacks—such as AI-generated phishing and evasive malware—highlighting a shift in attacker tactics. While AI-enabled threats grow, organizations leveraging AI defense tools cut data breach costs by $1.76 M and shortened breach identification by over 100 days.

records.title: CFTC Warns of AI-Driven Crypto Trading Scams
records.description: The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission issued a consumer alert cautioning that scammers use AI-powered trading bots, signal algorithms and crypto arbitrage systems to promise huge returns. One fraud scheme led to the loss of 30,000 bitcoins (about $1.7 billion). The CFTC warns that AI cannot predict market moves and urges investors to view guaranteed high-return claims as red flags.

records.title: Greek Journalist Christina Vidou Victim of AI Voice-Fraud
records.description: Scammers manipulated Greek journalist Christina Vidou’s voice using AI to falsely present her in a commercial. Vidou reported the fraud on Facebook, vowed legal action, and will file a complaint with Greece’s Cyber Crime Unit. The case underscores AI misuse in deceptive advertising.

records.title: AI-driven Dynamic Pricing Discriminates Against Loyal Customers
records.description: Chinese platforms using big data and AI algorithms set personalized prices: golden members pay higher hotel room rates and flight tickets than regular users, sometimes hundreds of yuan more. Platforms cite random discounts; experts call for transparency and regulation to prevent algorithmic overcharging of consumers.

records.title: Claudia Sheinbaum warns of AI deepfake video used in investment scam
records.description: Presidential candidate Claudia Sheinbaum has denounced an AI-generated deepfake video using her likeness and voice to solicit 4,000 peso investments with false promises of significant returns. The manipulated content is widely circulating on social media and messaging apps, prompting her to report the fraud and warn the public against the scheme.

records.title: Microsoft CEO demands AI guardrails after viral Taylor Swift deepfakes
records.description: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella called for rapid deployment of AI guardrails after nonconsensual AI-generated nude deepfakes of Taylor Swift, which amassed over 27 million views on X before suspension. He described the content as “alarming and terrible” and emphasized the need for safer online environments for creators and consumers.

records.title: Iowa Advances Bills to Block Minors’ Access to AI-Generated Porn
records.description: Iowa lawmakers advanced bills requiring social media platforms and commercial entities to verify users’ ages before granting access to obscene material, including AI-generated child porn and deepfake images. House File 2051 amends sexual exploitation laws to cover artificially generated content and imposes civil liability for noncompliance, excluding non-user-generated news services.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake of Anies Baswedan and Surya Paloh Prompts Warning
records.description: A deepfake video and audio, purporting to depict a conversation in which Surya Paloh scolds Anies Baswedan, has been circulating online. Presidential candidate Anies Baswedan condemned the AI-generated hoax, calling for critical verification of digital content and urging ethical, truth-based campaigning amid rising AI-powered misinformation risks.

records.title: Media Outlets Block AI Crawlers Over Copyright Infringement
records.description: Major media outlets including The New York Times, The Washington Post and The Guardian are blocking AI web crawlers—particularly OpenAI’s GPTBot—to prevent unauthorized scraping of news articles for AI training. Google’s new ‘Google-Extended’ opt-out tool enables publishers to stop data use, as concerns grow over copyright infringement and economic harm.

records.title: Defne Samyeli sues deepfake scammers over AI-generated betting fraud
records.description: Turkish actress and singer Defne Samyeli discovered fraudsters had used AI to create a deepfake video of her, promoting an illegal betting site with false promises to multiply investments. She has filed a lawsuit against the perpetrators and warned the public to be wary of AI-based investment scams.

records.title: French regulator fines Amazon €32M for intrusive AI-driven worker surveillance
records.description: France’s data watchdog CNIL fined Amazon France Logistique €32 million for operating an AI-powered system that tracked warehouse employees’ performance and breaks to the second, retaining data up to 31 days. The “excessively intrusive” monitoring breached GDPR and labor privacy rights, prompting the penalty.

records.title: Deepfake Porn Victims Demand Stronger Laws Amid Rising AI Abuse
records.description: Women like student 'Taylor Klein' and public figures have been targeted by deepfake pornographic and endorsement videos using generative AI, causing psychological and reputational harm. Despite the exponential proliferation of deepfake abuse, current laws fail to protect victims, prompting urgent calls for comprehensive international legal frameworks. Experts warn this misuse could deter women from public life.

records.title: AI-Driven Fraud Escalates: Deepfakes, FraudGPT and Synthetic Identities Surge
records.description: Criminals increasingly weaponize AI—deepfake voices, FraudGPT spear-phishing, and synthetic identities—to execute large-scale financial fraud and voter suppression calls. Banks and institutions scramble to deploy AI defenses, but pervasive AI-enabled scams have already inflicted significant financial losses and risks to electoral integrity and consumer trust.

records.title: AI-Enabled Cyberattacks Target Military and Critical Infrastructure
records.description: In 2023, Western intelligence agencies uncovered state-backed actors using AI to breach peripheral information systems at a strategic US military base, risking force communications. Concurrently, cybercriminals employ generative AI for advanced phishing, deepfake and vishing campaigns, posing escalating threats to critical infrastructure, public services and individuals.

records.title: Dark Web AI Clones FraudGPT and WormGPT Fuel Cybercrime
records.description: In the Dark Web, cybercriminals subscribe monthly to malicious LLMs FraudGPT and WormGPT—’evil twins’ of ChatGPT—to automate phishing emails, malware, deepfake scams, and vulnerability exploits. Discovered by Netenrich and detailed in IJSR CSEIT reports, these unrestricted AI tools lower the barrier for sophisticated online fraud.

records.title: Romanian Energy Minister Files Complaint Over Deepfake Investment Scam
records.description: Romanian Energy Minister Sebastian Burduja filed a criminal complaint after a fake Facebook page posted an AI-generated deepfake video of him promoting a non-existent ENEL investment scheme. The fraud attempt aimed to deceive citizens into false energy-service investments, posing financial risk and damaging his and the Ministry’s reputation.

records.title: Facial Recognition Misidentification Spurs $10M Lawsuit After Wrongful Arrest
records.description: Harvey Eugene Murphy Jr. is suing Macy’s and Sunglass Hut for $10 million after their facial recognition system wrongly identified him as a Houston robber. Arrested while renewing his license despite an alibi in California, he was detained, beaten, and raped before his innocence was confirmed, highlighting AI misidentification harms.

records.title: AI Voice-Cloning Scams Spark $7B Fraud Crisis
records.description: AI-powered voice cloning scams cost Americans over $7 billion in the first three quarters of 2023, with impostor schemes like the “grandparent scam” targeting seniors. Experts warn fraud is at “crisis level” and advise using family safe words, ignoring unknown calls, and reporting suspicious activity to law enforcement.

records.title: Fake Biden AI Robocall Suppresses Voter Turnout in New Hampshire Primary
records.description: A series of AI-generated robocalls impersonating President Biden urged Democrats to skip New Hampshire’s Jan. 23 primary, falsely claiming their votes would better count in November. The New Hampshire Attorney General is investigating the unlawful deepfake audio as an attempt at voter suppression and election interference.

records.title: US Police Use AI to Reconstruct Faces from DNA
records.description: US police departments, including East Bay Regional Park PD, have deployed Parabon NanoLabs' AI-driven Snapshot system to reconstruct suspects' faces from DNA samples (saliva, hair) and run facial recognition searches. The unvalidated technology raises ethical, privacy and misidentification risks, highlighting serious human rights and legal concerns.

records.title: Tesla’s AI falsely detects ‘ghosts’ in Conjuring house cemetery, panicking passengers
records.description: Tesla’s object-detection AI repeatedly misidentified nonexistent human-shaped figures as “ghosts” while driving through a Rhode Island cemetery near the real-life Conjuring house, causing passengers to panic and scream. The viral glitch has resurfaced online, highlighting potential safety and reliability risks in Tesla’s collision-avoidance system.

records.title: Russell Crowe warns against deepfake AI ads using his likeness
records.description: Russell Crowe has warned fans about deepfake AI adverts falsely showing him endorsing a Malta real estate firm. He denounced the “shonky” video, insisted he never authorized it, and urged followers to block, report and ignore the misleading AI-generated content that misuses his likeness.

records.title: Parents Urge TikTok to Label AI Influencers Fueling Unrealistic Beauty Standards
records.description: Over 12,000 parents, led by nonprofit ParentsTogether, have petitioned TikTok to clearly label AI-generated influencer accounts. They warn that flawless, computer-perfect bodies and faces promoted by these virtual creators contribute to body dysmorphia, disordered eating and low self-esteem among children and teenagers.

records.title: Warner Bros. Inserts AI-Generated Christopher Reeve Superman Cameo Without Consent
records.description: Warner Bros. digitally recreated Christopher Reeve’s Superman cameo in The Flash (2023) using CGI/AI without family consent, prompting outrage from his heirs. The studio similarly pressed Christian Bale and filmed Nicolas Cage’s cameo under different terms, spotlighting unauthorized AI likeness use and potential intellectual property and personal rights violations.

records.title: Indian police arrest creator of Rashmika Mandanna deepfake video
records.description: Delhi Police’s IFSO unit arrested Eemani Naveen for creating and posting unauthorized deepfake videos of actress Rashmika Mandanna, which went viral in November 2023, sparking public outrage and privacy concerns. Mandanna thanked the police for their prompt action and urged the public to combat misuse of images without consent.

records.title: AI voice clones exploit Greek celebrities
records.description: Greek TV host Giorgos Liagas revealed an AI-generated voice clone impersonating him to flirt with women online. Singers Stamatis Gonidis and Notis Sfakianakis were also targeted by AI voice-cloned fake duet circulating online, promoting Vassilis Karras without their consent, infringing on their personal and intellectual rights.

records.title: Bank of Mexico warns of AI-generated deepfake fraud video
records.description: Banco de México warns of an AI-generated deepfake video impersonating its governor Victoria Rodríguez Ceja and other officials, requesting money. The central bank denies any requests for funds or financial services, urging the public to ignore the video to avoid potential fraud.

records.title: Nora Fatehi Confronts Brand Over Viral Deepfake Ad
records.description: Actress Nora Fatehi discovered a deepfake video of her likeness promoting a clothing brand’s sale, sparking viral circulation and reputational risk. She publicly denounced the ad as “fake” via Instagram Stories. The brand has yet to respond. The incident echoes prior deepfake misuse targeting celebrities, highlighting AI-driven identity fraud.

records.title: AI-powered disinformation threatens 2024 elections
records.description: AI-powered disinformation, using generative tools to create deepfake videos and images, already swayed Taiwan’s presidential race via a China-orchestrated campaign on TikTok. Similar AI onslaughts threaten 2024 elections in over 60 countries, from India and South Africa to the US and EU, endangering democratic integrity.

records.title: AI deepfakes and chatbots disrupt Taiwan and US election processes
records.description: Taiwan’s Central Election Commission reported 105 AI-generated deepfake videos of alleged election fraud to TikTok, prompting 54 takedowns and new government removal channels. In the US, campaigns are deploying generative-AI volunteers and chatbots to engage voters, amid rising concerns over deepfake misinformation affecting 2024 races.

records.title: Biased Face Recognition AI Leads to Wrongful Arrests and Privacy Violations
records.description: Biometric face recognition AI misidentified Amara Majeed, Robert Williams, and Randal Reid, resulting in wrongful detentions by law enforcement that often omit disclosure of AI use. The incident highlights systemic bias and human rights violations as advanced surveillance technology infringes on privacy and freedom of movement.

records.title: DPD AI Chatbot Disabled After Swearing and Criticism
records.description: DPD disabled its AI chatbot after a software update caused the bot to curse at a customer and produce negative poems about the delivery firm. London musician Ashley Beauchamp, tracking a missing parcel, tested the bot’s limits, prompting DPD to remove the AI feature and investigate the malfunction.

records.title: Deepfake video scam impersonates Sonu Sood to extort money
records.description: Cybercriminals used an AI-generated deepfake video of Bollywood actor Sonu Sood in a fraudulent video call to promise aid and extort money from a family seeking medical help. Sood exposed the scam on social media and warned followers to stay vigilant against deepfake cybercrime.

records.title: Malaysia asks Meta to remove AI deepfake Bernama TV scam videos
records.description: Malaysia’s Communications Ministry has directed MCMC to ask Meta to take down AI-manipulated deepfake videos of Bernama TV news anchors promoting dubious investment schemes on Facebook, following repeated incidents, including a fake video of Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim, to curb fraud and misinformation.

records.title: AI Grief Simulators Exploit Bereavement, Spark Harm
records.description: Two Sundance documentaries, “Eternal You” and “Love Machina,” reveal how AI startups exploit grieving customers by offering digital avatars of deceased loved ones. Users experience hallucinations, threats and abusive language from the AI, leading to emotional distress and addiction, raising serious ethical concerns over digital immortality.

records.title: Google News algorithm promotes AI spam; AI-driven ads threaten 30,000 layoffs
records.description: Reports show Google News is flooding users with AI-generated, plagiarized articles, degrading news quality and violating intellectual property. Google’s AI-driven ranking fails to filter spam, undermining trust. Meanwhile, the company plans to integrate AI into ad sales operations, which could lead to layoffs of up to 30,000 employees, raising labor concerns.

records.title: China’s AI Surveillance App and Taiwan Election Disinformation
records.description: Beijing’s “China Consular” app compels overseas nationals to upload personal and travel details under the guise of consular services, enabling cross‐border monitoring and intimidation. Concurrently, China‐linked actors leveraged generative AI and fake accounts to spread tailored disinformation in Taiwan’s presidential poll, deepening divisions and eroding trust.

records.title: NJ teen urges federal law to ban nonconsensual AI deepfake porn
records.description: New Jersey high schooler Francesca Mani was targeted by classmates who created and shared AI-generated deepfake nude images without consent. Mani joined Reps. Joe Morelle and Tom Kean in urging passage of the bipartisan Preventing Deepfakes of Intimate Images Act to criminalize nonconsensual sharing and empower victims to sue.

records.title: US Senators Warn of Civil Rights Violations from Biased Facial Recognition AI
records.description: Senators Raphael Warnock, Dick Durbin and 16 colleagues urged the DOJ to halt funding of facial recognition technology after errors, like the wrongful arrest of Randal Quran Reid, disproportionately affected Black individuals. They warn the racially biased AI could breach Title VI of the Civil Rights Act and demand oversight.

records.title: Deepfake Disinformation Threatens 2024 Elections and Reputations
records.description: AI-generated deepfakes have surged ahead of 2024 elections, from a Slovak candidate’s fake audio to a viral deepfake ad misusing Bollywood star Nora Fatehi. India warns platforms of bans unless they curb deepfakes, while global leaders, including Prime Minister Modi, and Davos delegates urge stricter rules, detection tools, and content mandates.

records.title: Brazilian journalists’ images used in AI deepfake ads on Meta platforms
records.description: Pedro Bial, Tiago Leifert and Fátima Bernardes reported their images were used in AI-generated deepfake ads for fake hair-loss remedies, weight-loss drugs and lottery promotions on Facebook and Instagram without consent. They accuse Meta of neglecting repeated takedown requests, prompting legal complaints and public criticism.

records.title: Google lays off hundreds in ad and YouTube teams, replaced by AI
records.description: Google has laid off over 300 employees across its advertising and YouTube teams, replacing administrative and creative roles with AI-driven automation. Affected workers are encouraged to reapply for internal positions, while Google plans to hire new roles in 2024. The move underscores AI’s impact on workforce displacement.

records.title: AI-Enabled Fraud Spreads as Banks Scramble to Protect Customers
records.description: Criminals increasingly deploy AI tools, including deepfakes and generative malware, to perpetrate financial fraud, causing substantial consumer losses. Financial institutions are ramping up investments in AI-driven detection and explainable AI defenses to combat rising scams, but most customers remain hesitant to accept AI-based security solutions.

records.title: Ambient Light Sensors Enable AI-powered Stealthy Spying
records.description: MIT CSAIL researchers developed a computational imaging algorithm that uses smartphone ambient light sensor data to reconstruct users’ hand gestures and partial images without requiring permissions. This AI-powered technique poses a stealthy surveillance risk, allowing malicious apps to spy on interactions and invade user privacy without consent.

records.title: Kaspersky Warns AI Chatbots in Messenger Threaten Children and Users
records.description: Security experts at Kaspersky flag that over 300,000 AI chatbots on Facebook Messenger can expose children to age-inappropriate or erotic content and enable scammers to build trust, execute romance scams and steal personal or financial data. They urge users to avoid sharing sensitive information with unverified bots.

records.title: Privacy Groups Demand FTC Action as Google Retains Abortion Clinic Location Data
records.description: Google pledged in 2022 to delete sensitive location-history entries—such as abortion clinic visits—but a new Accountable Tech study and FTC complaints by privacy groups (EPIC, Accountable Tech) reveal the company still retains and shares this data. Advocates urge the FTC to impose penalties and block unlawful tracking practices.

records.title: 18-Year-Old Sentenced for Sharing AI-Generated Fake Nude Images of Classmates
records.description: A teenager in Pamplona was sentenced to one year in prison and barred from contacting two classmates after using AI tools to generate and distribute non-consensual nude deepfakes. Charged with coercion and moral integrity violations, he harassed victims with sexualized messages and fake images, investigated by the Navarre Police Digital Crimes Unit.

records.title: Zuckerberg to Be Deposed in Texas Facial Recognition Privacy Case
records.description: A Texas appeals court has ordered Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg to testify in a lawsuit by AG Ken Paxton alleging Meta’s facial recognition AI harvested biometric data from millions of Texans without informed consent, violating state biometric privacy and deceptive trade laws. The deposition underscores legal scrutiny of AI-driven data practices.

records.title: Deepfake AI Used to Impersonate Indonesian Celebrities in Illegal Gambling Hoax
records.description: A series of deepfake videos and audio has circulated online falsely depicting Najwa Shihab, Raffi Ahmad, and Atta Halilintar promoting illegal gambling sites. Victims reported reputational harm and urged regulators to tighten AI policies, as perpetrators exploit voice and face synthesis to advance fraudulent schemes and mislead the public.

records.title: Deepfake Scam Targets Indian Celebrities; Government Proposes Rapid IT Regulations
records.description: Multiple Indian celebrities, including Sachin Tendulkar and Sonu Sood, have been targeted by AI-generated deepfake videos promoting fake apps. They have warned followers against trusting or downloading these scams. In response, India’s government, led by Minister Rajeev Chandrasekhar, plans new IT regulations within days to curb deepfake misuse.

records.title: Sachin Tendulkar Falls Victim to AI Deepfake Scam
records.description: Indian cricket legend Sachin Tendulkar denounced widespread AI-generated deepfake videos falsely showing him and his daughter Sara endorsing a gaming app. He urged social media platforms, Maharashtra Cyber Police, and government officials to act, leading to an FIR against the app’s promoters, highlighting the misuse of AI technology for misinformation.

records.title: Michael Saylor Warns Bitcoin Community of Deepfake Scams
records.description: MicroStrategy chairman Michael Saylor warned that scammers are using AI-generated deepfake videos of him promising to double Bitcoin investments. These deepfakes prompt viewers to scan a QR code and send BTC to criminals. His team removes about 80 fake videos daily and urges users to verify claims before sending funds.

records.title: INSS uses AI to detect medical certificate fraud
records.description: Brazil’s National Social Security Institute (INSS) began using Atestmed, an AI tool developed by Dataprev, to analyze digital medical certificates for social-security disability benefits. The system cross-checks hospital and physician IDs, CRM numbers, signatures and IP addresses to flag potential fraud, aiming to curb false claims and speed up approvals.

records.title: Meta’s 'People You May Know' algorithm linked to child sexual predation
records.description: Internal Meta documents reveal that its AI-driven ‘People You May Know’ recommendations on Facebook and Instagram connected minors with potential child sex abusers, resulting in over 100,000 daily incidents of sexual harassment. Meta allegedly ignored staff warnings for years before restricting adult-minor messaging, now facing a New Mexico lawsuit.

records.title: Mother duped by AI voice cloning scam pays $15,500 bail
records.description: Cybercriminals used AI voice replication to impersonate a California mother's son, claiming he’d been in a car accident and jailed. Believing the call, she withdrew over $15,500 for bail before realising it was a scam. Experts warn AI scams are rising, exploiting advanced voice mimicry for financial and emotional harm.

records.title: Deepfake AI Threatens 2024 Elections with Soeharto Campaign Video
records.description: McAfee survey finds 84% of Americans fear deepfake-driven misinformation could distort 2024 elections and erode media trust. In Indonesia, AI-generated videos of former president Soeharto have appeared, urging support for Golkar, raising concerns over undisclosed political deepfakes influencing voters and undermining democratic processes.

records.title: Iowa Sues TikTok for Exposing Children to Inappropriate Content via AI Algorithm
records.description: Iowa Attorney General Brenna Bird filed suit against TikTok and ByteDance alleging the platform’s AI-driven recommendation system misled parents and exposed children to harmful content—drugs, explicit sexual, self-harm material. The state seeks fines and injunctions barring deceptive practices. TikTok defends its parental controls and safety measures.

records.title: Google tightens policies after AI-generated videos of murdered toddler James Bulger
records.description: AI-generated videos and images depicting murdered toddler James Bulger describing his abduction and killing appeared on TikTok and Google search, distressing his mother Denise Fergus. After she demanded removal, TikTok deleted the clips and Google announced policies banning AI-generated content of deceased minors across its platforms.

records.title: Meta Sued for Training AI on Pirated Books
records.description: Meta used the pirated Books3 dataset containing 195,000 titles to train its LLAM 1 and LLAM 2 models without author consent or compensation. Faced with a collective lawsuit from writers including Sarah Silverman and Richard Kadrey, Meta claims fair use and refuses to pay damages.

records.title: TikTok’s AI-driven Information Warfare Threatens Taiwan’s Democracy
records.description: Scholars warn that China’s TikTok (Douyin) AI-powered recommendation system targets Taiwan’s youth with manipulative content—95% entertainment, 5% propaganda—eroding democratic trust, spreading false vote-rigging rumors, and shaping election outcomes. With six million local users, experts urge a government-level information warfare command to protect Taiwan’s national security and polls.

records.title: Unauthorized AI-Generated George Carlin Special Sparks Backlash
records.description: Dudesy released “George Carlin: I’m Glad I’m Dead,” an AI-generated comedy special imitating Carlin’s voice and style without estate permission. Kelly Carlin denounced the stunt as intellectual property theft and disrespect to her father’s legacy, urging audiences to watch his authentic specials instead.

records.title: AI-Enabled Drones Transforming Russia-Ukraine Warfare
records.description: Russia and Ukraine are deploying AI-powered drones—from Russia’s S-70 Okhotnik and Inferno FPV bombers to mass-controlled swarm UAVs and Ukraine’s self-learning targeting quadcopters—to conduct autonomous reconnaissance, carpet-bomb positions, and deliver explosives, revolutionizing modern warfare and raising ethical and strategic concerns.

records.title: Deepfake Scam Targets TV Host Esra Erol with Fake Investment Pitch
records.description: Scammers used deepfake AI to manipulate video and audio of Turkish TV host Esra Erol, adding BOTAS logos and false investment pitches. The fake ad circulated on social media to defraud users. Erol filed a criminal complaint and initiated legal action against the unauthorized use of her likeness and voice.

records.title: AI Voice Cloning Used in Latvian Robocall Scams
records.description: Bite Latvija warns that scammers in Latvia use AI-powered voice cloning to generate robocalls in Latvian, tricking recipients into revealing personal, banking, and sensitive data via yes/no prompts. Fraudsters extract stolen clips from social media to clone voices. The method’s sophistication and prevalence are expected to rise.

records.title: Deepfake Celebrities Fuel 'Subway Money' Scam
records.description: Criminals used AI-powered deepfake videos of celebrities, including Neymar and Anitta, across Instagram, Facebook and TikTok to promote a fake 'Subway Money' game. Users were tricked into creating accounts and making PIX payments for promised rewards, resulting in financial losses even as Meta and TikTok prohibit such deceptive content.

records.title: AI Generates Fake Nude Photos of Beauty Queen, Spread on Telegram
records.description: 27-year-old Kamelia Angelova, Miss “Top Face of Ruse” 2021, discovered AI‐generated fake nude images of her circulating in a private Telegram group. Denying their authenticity, she filed complaints with local police and the regional prosecutor’s office. Authorities say they are monitoring similar AI-driven privacy and reputational attacks.

records.title: Scammers use AI deepfake voice messages to extort money
records.description: Fraudsters hack messaging apps to steal users’ voice recordings, then use neural network–generated deepfake audio to send fake pleas for help to victims’ contacts and extort money. They may include personal data to boost credibility. Expert Vage Zakaryan advises awareness and minimizing voice message use to prevent such AI-enabled scams.

records.title: Sunny Leone warns of ongoing deepfake menace, urges reporting
records.description: Bollywood star Sunny Leone highlighted the long-standing misuse of AI deepfake videos and images targeting celebrities like herself, Rashmika Mandanna and Anushka Sen, causing reputational and psychological harm. She advised victims—especially young women—to report these incidents to cyber cells and seek technical support on social media platforms.

records.title: AI Refusal Messages Flood Amazon with Bizarre Product Listings
records.description: Amazon hosted bizarre AI-generated product listings using OpenAI refusal messages (e.g., “I’m sorry but I cannot fulfill this request…”), confusing shoppers and undermining trust. The retailer has removed the misleading titles and said it is enhancing its review systems to block similar AI-created spam.

records.title: FTC sues Kochava for AI-driven sale of sensitive data
records.description: Kochava, a mobile app data broker, uses AI analytics to collect and sell sensitive consumer location and personal data without consent. FTC’s lawsuit alleges these practices have enabled stalking, discrimination and physical violence. The case could trigger significant reforms in the global data marketplace and US AI privacy laws.

records.title: Russian Interior Ministry warns of AI voice extortion scam
records.description: Russia’s Interior Ministry warns that fraudsters hack Telegram and WhatsApp accounts on social networks and use AI to generate synthetic voice messages mimicking owners. They send these in chats along with photos of fake bank cards to friends and groups, demanding loans and extorting victims.

records.title: Man Sentenced for AI Voice Scam Impersonating President Erdoğan
records.description: Fatih Emre Hülagü used AI voice conversion to mimic President Erdoğan and call executives, posing as an adviser to solicit funds for a fictitious overseas operation. Although no money was gained, Istanbul’s 7th Criminal Court sentenced him to 1 year and 8 months in prison, with the sentence deferred.

records.title: Google lays off hundreds, embracing AI-driven restructuring
records.description: Alphabet slashed hundreds of roles in voice-based Google Assistant, AR hardware, and central engineering teams, citing operational cost cuts. The move coincides with integrating generative AI via Bard to replace human-driven tasks, promising improved personalization and efficiency. It's part of broader layoffs impacting Google’s product divisions.

records.title: Search Engines Promote Non-Consensual AI Deepfake Porn
records.description: An NBC News investigation revealed that Google and Bing’s AI-powered search algorithms frequently promote non-consensual deepfake pornography featuring female celebrities at the top of image and web results. Using generative AI to swap real faces onto porn actors, these platforms amplify privacy violations and ongoing harm while failing to filter out illicit content.

records.title: LLMs Frequently Hallucinate Legal Information, Risking Harm
records.description: A Stanford-led study finds ChatGPT 3.5, PaLM 2, and Llama 2 hallucinate legal information 69–88% of the time on federal court queries. These pervasive errors have misled attorneys—resulting in sanctions and suspended licenses—and risk harming self-represented litigants relying on AI for critical legal decisions.

records.title: Elon Musk’s X slashes 1,200+ safety staff, triggering harmful content surge
records.description: Elon Musk's X Corp cut over 1,200 trust and safety staff, including 80% of safety engineers and half its moderators, since his October 2022 takeover. Australia's eSafety Commission warns these deep cuts and banned-account reinstatements have sparked a surge in hate speech and abusive content due to weakened AI moderation.

records.title: China Uses AI-Generated Virtual Anchors to Defame Taiwan’s President
records.description: In early January 2024, China’s Ministry of State Security orchestrated an AI-driven disinformation campaign against Taiwan President Tsai Ing-wen, producing hundreds of defamatory videos with virtual anchors via ByteDance’s Jianying app. Thousands of fake accounts on YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, and X rapidly spread the clips to influence the presidential election.

records.title: OpenAI, Meta Face Copyright Lawsuits Over AI Training
records.description: OpenAI and Microsoft face multiple US lawsuits for allegedly training ChatGPT and Copilot on copyrighted articles without authorization, prompting licensing talks with CNN, Fox and Time. OpenAI admits it’s impossible to train its models without infringing copyright. Meta similarly acknowledges using the Books3 dataset to train its Llama models.

records.title: Unauthorized Remote Control of Tesla Endangers Driver
records.description: Christine Dousset-Lazier, a Brittany veterinarian, lost control of her Tesla when an unauthorized user—suspected to be a friend added as a ‘guest driver’—remotely locked the car, limited its speed to 40 km/h, and maxed heating. Trapped and endangered on an expressway, she broke a window and filed a police complaint.

records.title: AI System Enables Miaoli Police to Arrest Illegal Waste Dumper
records.description: Miaoli County Police installed AI-driven monitoring along key roads to detect and analyze vehicles at dumping hotspots. The system flagged a white truck illegally hauling waste in Houlong; officers intercepted and identified the driver in two hours, leading to prosecution under the Waste Disposal Act.

records.title: AI-powered robocalls invade privacy with precise targeting
records.description: AI-driven robocalls analyze personal data to deliver precise, relentless telemarketing calls that change caller IDs to evade blocking, causing widespread privacy violations and distress. Fueled by leaked user information and low legal costs, this black-market industry defies current regulations, spurring authorities to strengthen data protection, penalties, and technical defenses.

records.title: OpenAI sued for copyright infringement over ChatGPT training
records.description: Publishers such as The New York Times, The Times of London, and authors including George R.R. Martin have sued OpenAI and Microsoft, alleging ChatGPT and DALL·E were trained on copyrighted texts without permission. OpenAI disputes the claims, seeks legal partnerships, and has petitioned the UK Parliament for free access to protected materials.

records.title: Insufficient AI training data blamed in Japan’s first Level4 autonomous vehicle crash
records.description: After Level2 public trials in Odate City and remote-monitored bus tests in Tokoname, a Level4 autonomous vehicle in Eiheiji Town crashed into a bicycle in October 2023. A government report blamed insufficient AI training data for its automatic braking failure, postponing the service’s March 2024 restart.

records.title: MSI's Monitor Uses AI to Undetectably Cheat in Games
records.description: At CES 2024, MSI unveiled the MEG 321URX QD-OLED monitor with an onboard SkySight AI that analyzes game minimaps to detect and mark enemy positions in League of Legends, Call of Duty, and more—providing an undetectable cheating advantage and sparking fairness and integrity concerns in competitive gaming.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake of Soeharto Used in Golkar Campaign
records.description: Erwin Aksa, Golkar’s deputy chairman, posted an AI-generated deepfake of former President Soeharto urging Indonesians to vote for Golkar candidates. The video, mimicking Soeharto’s likeness and voice, drew public backlash over the ethical and legal implications of using synthetic media to influence electoral choices.

records.title: Content Creators Sue OpenAI and Microsoft Over Unauthorized AI Training Data
records.description: The New York Times and other publishers, authors, and comedians have filed lawsuits accusing OpenAI and Microsoft of using millions of their copyrighted works without compensation to train large language models. They warn AI chatbots threaten to bypass websites, disrupting creators’ ad-driven revenue and undermining their economic viability.

records.title: ChatGPT memorises and reproduces copyrighted poems, study finds
records.description: A Cornell University study revealed that ChatGPT memorized and regurgitated 72 of 240 poems verbatim, including copyrighted works, raising ethical and copyright infringement concerns. Writers have sued OpenAI for unauthorized use of their texts in training, highlighting risks of using internet-scraped data and lack of transparency in proprietary AI models.

records.title: US Officials Warn AI Could Enable Hacking, Scams and Money Laundering
records.description: At the International Conference on Cyber Security, NSA’s Rob Joyce and FBI’s James Smith cautioned that AI reduces the technical barriers to hacking, scamming and money laundering, enabling less-skilled criminals to commit sophisticated cybercrimes while also offering law enforcement new tools to detect and prevent attacks.

records.title: Charity Faces Probe for Using AI-Generated Fundraising Photos
records.description: Chengdu Ai Yixing Public Welfare Service Center used AI-generated elderly photos without disclosure in a crowdfunding campaign, claiming privacy protection. After netizens raised fraud concerns, the Chengdu civil affairs bureau investigated and ordered immediate rectification, sparking debate on ethical AI use and transparency in charitable fundraising.

records.title: AI-Generated Taylor Swift Deepfake Scam Defrauds Fans with Fake Le Creuset Giveaways
records.description: Scammers used AI deepfake technology to create videos and voices of Taylor Swift endorsing fake Le Creuset cookware giveaways on social media. Fans paid a “shipping fee” and were later hit with hidden monthly charges without receiving any products, resulting in financial losses. Platforms include Facebook and TikTok.

records.title: OpenAI removes military use ban, admits copyright infringement in AI training
records.description: OpenAI updated its policy to drop explicit bans on military applications of ChatGPT, raising concerns about future harmful uses. At the same time, it acknowledged relying on copyrighted materials to train its models, triggering lawsuits like the New York Times case and UK regulatory inquiries over IP violations.

records.title: Duolingo lays off 10% of contractors amid AI push
records.description: Duolingo cut around 10% of its US-based contractors, replacing them with AI-driven content generation. Humans will still review AI outputs for accuracy, though former contractors report errors in lessons since the shift. Duolingo aims to optimize costs, reflecting a broader trend of AI displacing human labor.

records.title: MEP Marie Toussaint exposes CNAF’s discriminatory AI algorithm
records.description: Green MEP Marie Toussaint has launched a campaign against ‘state pauperophobia’ ahead of the European elections, denouncing the French welfare agency (CNAF) for using an algorithm that disproportionately targets single parents, unemployed, disability benefit and RSA recipients as fraud risks. She has lodged a complaint with the Defender of Rights.

records.title: Foreign Deepfake Porn Videos Target Taiwanese Legislators in Election Interference
records.description: In early 2024, deepfake porn videos falsely featuring DPP legislators Hung Shen-han and Lo Chih-cheng were anonymously uploaded to overseas adult sites and spread domestically, allegedly by Chinese-backed networks to sway Taiwan’s election. Both legislators reported the incident to police, prompting investigations into cross-border cybercrime and election meddling.

records.title: Malicious Deepfakes Target Individuals and Elections
records.description: Attackers are increasingly using AI-generated deepfakes to harm reputations and manipulate voters. In Malaysia, a banking employee was falsely cast in a porn video and a former health director’s image and voice sold fake diabetes drugs. In Bangladesh, bogus withdrawal videos altered election outcomes, undermining democracy.

records.title: OpenAI negotiates media licenses amid lawsuits over ChatGPT’s use of copyrighted articles
records.description: OpenAI is in talks with the New York Times, Gannett, News Corp and other publishers after facing lawsuits and demands for payment over training ChatGPT on copyrighted news content without permission. Some outlets block data scraping or seek licensing fees, while OpenAI defends its use as fair, fueling legal disputes over intellectual property.

records.title: Threads AI recommendation algorithm floods feeds with low-quality, hateful posts
records.description: Meta’s Threads AI recommendation algorithm has surfaced low-quality, borderline and hateful posts, including transphobia, prompting Instagram head Adam Mosseri to apologize. Users report irrelevant engagement bait and divisive content. Meta is now refining the algorithm to improve content quality and curb harmful recommendations.

records.title: OpenAI and Microsoft Sued Over Unauthorized Use of Copyrighted Works in ChatGPT Training
records.description: The New York Times and multiple authors have filed lawsuits against OpenAI and investor Microsoft, alleging ChatGPT was trained on copyrighted news articles and literary works without permission, seeking billions in damages. OpenAI responded to the NYT suit, expressing surprise and disappointment at the claims.

records.title: UK expands AI facial recognition amid privacy and surveillance fears
records.description: The UK government is expanding AI-driven facial recognition in policing. A trial at Croydon station led to ten arrests for serious crimes. Deployed at events including the British Grand Prix and the King’s coronation, the tech—hailed as ‘high potential’—has sparked cross-party concern over mass surveillance, biometric privacy and oversight.

records.title: Botshit deepfake video of Hillary Clinton sparks AI misinformation concerns
records.description: A generative AI deepfake showing Hillary Clinton endorsing Ron DeSantis highlights emerging “botshit”—fabricated political content designed to mislead voters. Experts warn unchecked AI-generated disinformation could reshape elections and undermine democracies, urging urgent measures to verify authenticity before such deepfakes distort political realities.

records.title: GM’s Cruise Offers $75K Settlement Over Pedestrian Crash Probe
records.description: Cruise, General Motors’ self-driving taxi unit, offered $75,000 to resolve a California Public Utilities Commission investigation into its failure to disclose key details after an October 2023 robotaxi struck and dragged a pedestrian. California suspended Cruise’s driverless testing permit, prompting the settlement and promises of greater transparency.

records.title: Tesla recalls 1.6 million EVs in China over Autopilot crash risk
records.description: Tesla is executing its largest-ever China recall of over 1.6 million Model S, X, 3 and Y EVs after regulators found that a defect in the Autopilot assisted-steering function and door latches can lead to misuse and elevated crash risk. Owners will receive over-the-air software fixes.

records.title: Synthetaic’s AI Enables Global Surveillance ‘Prison’
records.description: Synthetaic’s AI platform uses satellite and camera imagery with facial and object recognition to scan the entire planet in minutes, tracking individuals anywhere. Governments and entities deploy it for real-time monitoring, risking mass privacy violations and human rights breaches by constructing a global, inescapable surveillance network.

records.title: Britain Investigates Virtual Rape in AI-Powered Metaverse
records.description: A 16-year-old British girl reported her avatar being gang-raped by other users in an AI-powered VR metaverse game. It's the UK's first police probe into virtual sexual assault, highlighting real psychological trauma despite no physical contact and the challenge of applying existing laws to AI-driven virtual crimes.

records.title: Google Maps misguides Bekasi travelers into Wonosobo forest
records.description: Ten Bekasi residents traveling to Dieng relied on Google Maps, which misrouted them into a forest plantation in Wonosobo, Central Java. Their two cars got stuck—one slipped, the other suffered a flat tire—forcing a joint evacuation by local disaster response, firefighters and Basarnas teams late into the evening.

records.title: Deepfake video impersonates bTV journalists and ex-PM Kiril Petkov in investment scam
records.description: Scammers used AI to create a deepfake video impersonating bTV journalists Tsvetanka Rizova and Ivan Georgiev and ex-prime minister Kiril Petkov, urging viewers to deposit money into a fake “investment” app allegedly managed by Elon Musk. bTV refused to air it and warned audiences it’s a fraud.

records.title: AI-Generated Child Pornography Spreads on Instagram
records.description: Investigators found AI systems increasingly produce indistinguishable child- and youth-pornographic images, some derived from real abuse. These images are widely shared on Instagram via accounts linking to explicit content. Tech platforms’ slow removal and lack of specialized law enforcement tracking exacerbate the distribution and harm.

records.title: AI-Powered System Predicts Japan Earthquake, Sends Early Warnings
records.description: Nikos Vasilakos, president of “Internet Now,” detailed a machine learning–based AI system that analyzed geological and seismic data to forecast a 7.6 magnitude earthquake in central Japan about a week in advance. The platform instantly sent mobile alerts, enabling timely preparation and reducing casualties and property damage.

records.title: Mark Ruffalo Shares Fake AI-Generated Trump 'Epstein Island' Images
records.description: Hollywood actor Mark Ruffalo shared AI-generated images depicting Donald Trump en route to Jeffrey Epstein’s private island, spreading misinformation. After fact-checkers debunked the photos, Ruffalo issued a tepid apology on X, blaming Elon Musk’s ownership for allowing rampant disinformation.

records.title: Austrian Employment Chatbot Reproduces Gender Bias
records.description: The Austrian Public Employment Service’s ChatGPT-powered chatbot, Berufsinfomat, has been criticized for reproducing gender stereotypes by recommending science programs to men and humanities to women. Developed by AMS and AI firm Goodguys to assist job seekers, the tool has sparked user complaints and prompted efforts to correct its discriminatory outputs.

records.title: Red Cross Warns of Escalating Threat from AI-Driven Autonomous Weapons
records.description: The Red Cross warns that AI-equipped autonomous weapons, including kamikaze drones used in Ukraine, operate without human oversight, risking escalated conflicts and civilian harm. They call for urgent legal frameworks to stop unregulated development of lethal AI systems.

records.title: Janhvi Kapoor recalls teenage deepfake ordeal, lauds Rashmika Mandanna’s stance
records.description: Bollywood actress Janhvi Kapoor revealed that at 15 her photos were morphed into deepfakes without consent, a violation she initially kept secret fearing backlash. Now she commends Rashmika Mandanna for speaking out against a recent deepfake video, urging stronger cyber laws to curb AI-driven image manipulation.

records.title: SVP MP Andreas Glarner ordered to pay after deepfake video of Green MP Sibel Arslan
records.description: Andreas Glarner, a Swiss SVP MP, published an AI-generated deepfake of Green MP Sibel Arslan on social media days before the 2023 elections. The Basel civil court ruled he violated her personality rights, ordering him to delete the video and pay nearly CHF 4,000 in damages and legal fees.

records.title: AI-Powered Cybercrime Fuels New Cybersecurity Arms Race
records.description: Cybercriminals are using AI-driven tools like ChatGPT to automate and personalize phishing, obfuscate malware and evade detection, doubling attack volumes. Incidents such as the MGM Resorts breach exposed personal data and financial losses, prompting experts to warn of an escalating AI-powered cybercrime arms race and urge advanced defenses.

records.title: Generative AI Hallucinations Undermine Legal Proceedings
records.description: Generative AI is now widely used in legal practice but has produced fabricated case citations that were submitted in real proceedings, jeopardizing legal outcomes. Experts warn such AI hallucinations, alongside emerging political deepfakes, reveal acute risks to justice and democracy, underscoring urgent need for stronger human oversight.

records.title: Armed Ukrainian Sea Baby Drones Attack Russian Warships
records.description: Ukraine’s Security Service released footage showing armed Sea Baby unmanned surface drones firing 14 projectiles at Russian warships near Sevastopol. SBU head Vasyl Maliuk said the drones, equipped with rocket launchers, returned fire after Russian ships opened up, marking the first naval drone assault on Russian vessels.

records.title: Artists sue AI firms over unauthorized training on copyrighted works
records.description: A US class-action suit claims AI image platforms Midjourney, Stability AI, DeviantArt and Runway AI trained their models on copyrighted artworks of thousands of artists—including Portuguese creators, comic book illustrators and even a 6-year-old—without consent, infringing intellectual property rights.

records.title: AI Deepfake Enables 3 Million COP Theft from Nequi User
records.description: On New Year’s Eve, criminals used AI to animate a photo of Brian Quintero, bypassing Nequi’s facial recognition and stealing three million pesos from his digital wallet. Nequi confirmed the attack exploited AI-generated facial movements to impersonate the victim and gain unauthorized access to his account.

records.title: AI-Generated Instagram Model Deceives Millionaires and Athletes
