records.description: An AI-generated Instagram influencer, 'Emily Pellegrini,' amassed over 140,000 followers and even secured date invitations from wealthy businessmen and sports stars who believed she was real. Her anonymous creator used ChatGPT to craft her ideal appearance and earned significant income on Fanvue. The incident underscores dangers of AI-driven virtual personas deceiving users.

records.title: New York Times sues OpenAI and Microsoft over AI training copyright infringement
records.description: The New York Times filed a lawsuit against OpenAI and Microsoft, accusing them of using millions of its news articles without permission to train large language models behind ChatGPT. The legal battle will shape how publishers license content and set precedents for AI training data usage and fair use boundaries.

records.title: Facial recognition errors in Rio spark wrongful detentions
records.description: Rio’s new police facial recognition system misidentified individuals using outdated data, leading to a woman’s wrongful 20-hour detention and two others’ erroneous arrests. Authorities cited database inconsistencies and pledged to integrate records, while the detainees demand compensation over these AI-driven rights violations.

records.title: Google Bard Hallucinations Lead to Fake Citations in Michael Cohen’s Court Filing
records.description: Michael Cohen admits he unknowingly submitted AI-generated false legal citations from Google Bard to his attorney, who included them in a motion to reduce his probation. The fabricated cases were discovered by Judge Jesse Furman, prompting scrutiny of Bard’s hallucinations and raising concerns over generative AI’s reliability in legal research.

records.title: UK Police Secretly Used Passport Database for Facial Recognition Searches
records.description: Since 2019, UK police forces have covertly run facial recognition on the national passport database—including images of 46 million holders—conducting over 300 searches in the first nine months of 2023. The practice, using both passport and immigration data without clear legal authority, has raised serious privacy and rights concerns.

records.title: ChatGPT misdiagnosed 8 in 10 pediatric cases, study warns
records.description: Researchers at Cohen Children’s Medical Center evaluated ChatGPT (v3.5 and v4) on 100 pediatric cases from JAMA Pediatrics and NEJM. The AI misdiagnosed 83% of cases—72 outright errors and 11 overly broad—highlighting serious patient safety risks and prompting calls for more targeted training before clinical use.

records.title: NYT and Authors Sue OpenAI and Microsoft for Copyright Infringement in AI Training
records.description: The New York Times and authors including Nicholas Basbanes and Nicholas Gage filed federal lawsuits against OpenAI and Microsoft, alleging their AI models were unlawfully trained on millions of copyrighted articles and books. They seek damages, removal of the data and an end to unlicensed use, citing threats to journalistic and literary rights.

records.title: Global Deepfake Threats Undermine Elections and Public Trust
records.description: AI-generated deepfake videos and voice clones have been used worldwide to spread scams and election misinformation, targeting figures from Singapore’s PM Lee and Indonesia’s leaders to India’s campaign rivals. Experts warn these convincing fakes exploit advances in AI, influence voter behavior, and highlight insufficient platform and government safeguards.

records.title: AI-Driven Disinformation Campaigns Target Taiwan Election
records.description: Taiwan’s 2024 presidential race saw the CCP deploy AI-generated coordinated account networks on platforms like PTT, Facebook and TikTok to spread false war threats, economic scare tactics and even anti-Japan rumors post-earthquake. Taiwan AI Labs founder Du Yijin uses AI to identify and counter these cognitive-warfare operations.

records.title: California Loophole Lets Driverless Cars Evade Citations, Safety Concerns Mount
records.description: California law’s driver requirement loophole prevents traffic citations when autonomous vehicles operate driverless, despite hundreds of Cruise and Waymo cars running red lights, blocking emergency vehicles and striking a pedestrian in San Francisco. Police Chief Bill Scott’s memo highlights regulatory gaps, intensifying calls for updated AV legislation amid safety investigations.

records.title: Eerie Unsolicited Alexa Interactions Spark Privacy Fears
records.description: Several Amazon Alexa users, via TikTok and Reddit, reported unexplained midnight interactions: whispered dog commands, unsolicited conversations with family members, and mysterious "goodbye" voice recordings. Alarmed by these AI malfunctions and privacy concerns, many have unplugged their devices, underscoring potential security flaws and user distress.

records.title: Japanese government urges removal of earthquake misinformation
records.description: Following the Noto Peninsula earthquake, false rescue requests and manipulated tsunami videos spread on X, Meta, Google and LINE-Yahoo. Japan’s Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications, backed by police, asked platforms to swiftly delete harmful misinformation that could hinder rescue operations and endanger lives.

records.title: French Government Embroiled in Deepfake Controversy Targeting Marine Le Pen
records.description: Renaissance spokesperson Loïc Signor used AI to generate manipulated videos of Marine Le Pen—first translating her New Year’s greetings into Russian in a “Marine Poutine” deepfake, then staging a misleading AI montage—sparking political uproar, misinformation concerns and calls for stricter deepfake regulation ahead of European elections.

records.title: Spanish Media Support NYT Lawsuit Against OpenAI and Microsoft Over AI Copyright Infringement
records.description: The Spanish Association of Media (AMI), representing over 80 outlets, supports The New York Times' lawsuit against OpenAI and Microsoft for using copyrighted journalistic content without consent to train AI models, allegedly violating intellectual property rights and threatening the sustainability of news organizations.

records.title: Singapore PM Warns Public of Deepfake AI Crypto Scam Using His Likeness
records.description: Singapore Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong warned citizens about deepfake videos created with AI that use his image and voice to promote fraudulent cryptocurrency schemes. The AI-generated deepfakes convincingly mimic official footage, misleading the public and facilitating financial scams. Loong urged vigilance against such AI-enabled disinformation.

records.title: X Implements AI to Scan All Uploaded Media for Child Sexual Abuse Material
records.description: X (formerly Twitter), under Elon Musk, has deployed AI-driven systems to scan all uploaded videos and GIFs for child sexual abuse material (CSAM). This initiative has led to strengthened detection, increased account suspensions, and more referrals to authorities, aiming to make the platform inhospitable to child exploitation.

records.title: Criminal Gang Uses ChatGPT to Optimize Ransomware in Major Hangzhou Cyberattack
records.description: A criminal group in Hangzhou used ChatGPT to optimize ransomware, which was deployed to attack a company's servers, encrypting data and disrupting operations while demanding a cryptocurrency ransom. Police arrested four suspects, all with cybersecurity backgrounds, highlighting the direct role of AI in facilitating cybercrime and causing operational and financial harm.

records.title: Indian Government Accused of Using AI-Powered Pegasus Spyware to Target Journalists and Politicians
records.description: Amnesty International and The Washington Post revealed that India's government used the AI-driven Pegasus spyware to surveil journalists and opposition politicians, violating privacy and freedom of expression. Forensic analysis confirmed infections, and reports allege government pressure on Apple to suppress threat alerts, highlighting significant human rights concerns.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfakes and Misinformation Threaten 2024 US Elections
records.description: Experts warn that generative AI tools, especially deepfakes, are increasingly used to create and spread election-related misinformation in the US. The weakening of social media safeguards and the proliferation of convincing AI-generated content risk undermining trust in democratic processes and could incite social unrest during the 2024 presidential elections.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfakes Cause Harm in India, Threaten Elections and Privacy
records.description: In 2023, India saw a surge in AI-generated deepfakes, leading to misinformation, privacy violations, and reputational harm, especially targeting public figures. These incidents have raised concerns about electoral integrity and public trust, prompting government warnings, calls for regulation, and increased scrutiny of social media platforms.

records.title: AI-Driven Phishing Scams Target Crypto Sector in 2024
records.description: Blockchain security firms warn that generative AI is enabling more sophisticated phishing scams and social engineering attacks in the crypto sector, exemplified by the December 14 Ledger Connect exploit. These AI-powered scams automate operations and create convincing fakes, leading to significant financial losses for users and organizations.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Videos Used to Extort Migrant Families
records.description: Criminals used AI to create manipulated videos and images of missing migrants, deceiving families into believing their loved ones were alive and extorting over $12,000 from an Ecuadorian family. The AI-generated content created false hope and led to significant financial and emotional harm.

records.title: ChatGPT Security Flaw Exposes Journalists' Email Addresses
records.description: Researchers from Indiana University exploited a vulnerability in OpenAI's ChatGPT-3.5 Turbo, bypassing safeguards to extract personal and professional email addresses of over 30 New York Times journalists. This incident highlights a significant privacy breach, as the AI system revealed sensitive data from its training set despite protective measures.

records.title: Tesla Factory Robot Attacks Engineer, Causing Serious Injury
records.description: A robot at Tesla's Texas factory attacked an engineer in 2021, causing serious injuries to his back and arm. The incident occurred when a robot, mistakenly left active, malfunctioned during maintenance. Tesla reportedly concealed the event for two years, highlighting risks of AI system malfunctions in industrial settings.

records.title: Watchdog Report Warns of AI-Driven Privacy Risks in Smart Toys for Children
records.description: A U.S. Public Interest Research Group report highlights that smart toys equipped with AI, cameras, microphones, and GPS are covertly recording, tracking, and analyzing children's data without parental consent. These privacy violations pose risks of data misuse, grooming, and potential safety threats, affecting even very young children.

records.title: AI-Driven Vehicle Systems Linked to Fatalities and Safety Recalls in the US
records.description: AI systems in autonomous vehicles, notably Tesla's Autopilot and Cruise's driverless taxis, have been linked to multiple crashes, injuries, and deaths in the US. Regulatory investigations, mass recalls, and criticism of insufficient software fixes highlight ongoing safety risks and the direct role of AI malfunctions in these incidents.

records.title: Barcelona Prosecutors Investigate AI-Generated Child Sexual Abuse Images
records.description: Barcelona authorities are investigating multiple cases where minors used AI to manipulate photos of other minors, creating and distributing sexualized images on social media. The incidents involve both victims and perpetrators who are minors, with arrests made and challenges in identifying suspects due to international digital platforms.

records.title: AI System Predicts Epileptic Seizures and Prevents Accidents via 5G Platform in Iran
records.description: Iran's Hamrah Aval showcased an AI-powered health use case at Telecom 2023, analyzing brain signals to predict epileptic seizures. The system sends alerts to users and emergency services, and can connect to smart vehicles to reduce speed and prevent accidents if a seizure is detected during driving, enhancing health and safety.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfakes and Voice Cloning Used in Fraudulent Scams in Japan
records.description: In Japan, generative AI is being used to create deepfake videos and synthetic voice audio that convincingly mimic celebrities and public figures. These AI-generated media are exploited in scams, deceiving victims and facilitating financial fraud, with increasing difficulty in distinguishing real from fake content.

records.title: US Accuses China of Using AI to Enhance Cyberattacks and Data Collection on Americans
records.description: US authorities suspect China of using artificial intelligence to intensify cyberattacks and conduct large-scale data collection and surveillance on American citizens, raising concerns about privacy and national security. The FBI and intelligence agencies have warned that AI is being leveraged to process stolen data and improve hacking operations.

records.title: TikTok's AI Algorithms Linked to Psychological Harm, Misinformation, and Manipulation Worldwide
records.description: TikTok's AI-driven recommendation system has been used to spread political manipulation in Taiwan, push distressing and polarizing war content to US teens, and promote extreme gender identity content, leading to psychological harm, misinformation, and manipulation of public opinion, especially among vulnerable youth and democratic societies.

records.title: AI Surveillance in Schools Raises Privacy and Rights Concerns for Students
records.description: Multiple reports highlight that schools are increasingly deploying AI technologies like facial recognition and predictive analytics to monitor students, leading to privacy violations, disciplinary actions, and data sharing without consent. Parents, students, and privacy advocates warn these AI systems harm student rights and communities, despite lacking evidence of improved safety.

records.title: Google Lays Off 30,000 Ad Sales Employees Due to AI Automation
records.description: Google is reportedly laying off up to 30,000 employees from its ad sales division after deploying AI tools, such as Performance Max, that automate ad creation and management. The AI systems have rendered many roles redundant, leading to significant job losses directly caused by the adoption of these technologies.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Audio Targets Manaus Mayor in Election Defamation Case
records.description: Brazilian Federal Police are investigating the use of AI to create a manipulated audio clip falsely attributed to Manaus mayor David Almeida, containing insults to teachers. The deepfake audio circulated on social media, prompting a criminal inquiry for electoral defamation and raising concerns about AI-driven misinformation in upcoming elections.

records.title: Tesla Recalls Millions of Vehicles Over Autopilot and Door Safety AI Failures
records.description: Tesla recalled over 2 million vehicles after the NHTSA found its Autopilot AI system contributed to crashes and deaths, and over 120,000 vehicles due to a software update that could cause doors to unlock during crashes. Both incidents highlight significant safety risks from AI system malfunctions in Tesla vehicles.

records.title: Study Finds TikTok AI Suppresses Politically Sensitive Content Aligned with Chinese Government Interests
records.description: Multiple studies by the Network Contagion Research Institute and Rutgers University reveal that TikTok’s AI-driven content recommendation system systematically suppresses or amplifies content based on alignment with Chinese government interests, limiting visibility of sensitive topics like Hong Kong protests and Uyghurs, thereby restricting access to information and shaping political discourse.

records.title: Meta's AI Moderation Censors Pro-Palestinian Content, Says HRW
records.description: Human Rights Watch reports that Meta's automated AI content moderation on Facebook and Instagram has systematically censored protected speech supporting Palestine, including peaceful expression and human rights discussions. This excessive reliance on AI tools has led to widespread suppression of legitimate content, violating users' freedom of expression and erasing Palestinian voices.

records.title: AI Deepfake Scams Target Crypto Holders on YouTube Using Fake CEO Videos
records.description: AI-generated deepfake videos of Ripple CEO Brad Garlinghouse and former MicroStrategy CEO Michael Saylor have circulated on YouTube, urging viewers to send cryptocurrency with false promises of doubled returns. Despite user reports, YouTube has not removed the fraudulent content, enabling ongoing financial scams and harm to crypto holders.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfakes Threaten Integrity of UK Elections
records.description: Senior UK politicians and security officials warn that AI-generated deepfakes and misinformation are already disrupting elections abroad and targeting British politicians, posing a 'clear and present danger' to UK democracy. Calls for stronger government action and safeguards highlight the urgent risk to public trust and electoral integrity.

records.title: Pulitzer Prize-Winning Authors Sue OpenAI and Microsoft for Copyright Infringement
records.description: Eleven nonfiction authors, including Pulitzer Prize winners, have filed a lawsuit against OpenAI and Microsoft, alleging their copyrighted works were used without permission to train GPT language models like ChatGPT. The authors seek damages and an injunction, claiming the companies profited from unauthorized use of their intellectual property.

records.title: Research Finds GPT-3 Repeats and Validates Misinformation and Harmful Stereotypes
records.description: University of Waterloo researchers found that OpenAI's GPT-3, a large language model, frequently repeats and validates misinformation, conspiracy theories, and harmful stereotypes. Systematic testing revealed the model often agrees with false statements and contradicts itself, raising concerns about its reliability and the risk of spreading societal harm.

records.title: UK Police Granted Access to Driver's License Photos for Facial Recognition Searches
records.description: A new UK law allows police and the National Crime Agency to use facial recognition technology on a database of 50 million driver's license photos, raising concerns about privacy, discrimination, and lack of oversight. Critics warn of potential rights violations and false identifications, especially among minority groups.

records.title: Delhi Police Track Suspects in Rashmika Mandanna Deepfake AI Incident
records.description: An AI-generated deepfake video featuring actress Rashmika Mandanna went viral, causing reputational and emotional harm. Delhi Police have tracked four suspects who uploaded the video, aided by Meta, but the original creator remains unidentified. The incident highlights the misuse of AI for malicious purposes and ongoing digital safety concerns.

records.title: AI-Driven Disinformation Campaign Targets Taiwan Election
records.description: Ahead of Taiwan's 2024 presidential election, foreign actors used AI-generated deepfake videos and automated fake social media accounts to spread false claims about candidate Lai Ching-te. The coordinated campaign, managed from abroad, aimed to manipulate public opinion and undermine the democratic process, prompting official investigations and account takedowns.

records.title: Airbnb Deploys AI to Block Risky New Year's Eve Party Bookings Globally
records.description: Airbnb has implemented AI and machine learning systems to analyze booking data and block reservations deemed high-risk for unauthorized or disruptive New Year's Eve parties. The technology, used in multiple countries, aims to prevent harm to communities and property, with thousands of bookings already blocked as a preventive measure.

records.title: AI Image Generators Trained on Datasets Containing Child Sexual Abuse Material (CSAM)
records.description: Thousands of child sexual abuse images were discovered in the LAION-5B dataset, used to train popular AI image generators like Stable Diffusion and Imagen. This led to the generation and potential dissemination of illegal and harmful content, prompting the dataset's withdrawal and raising concerns about AI's role in perpetuating abuse.

records.title: Interpol Seizes $300 Million in Global Crackdown on AI-Driven Online Fraud
records.description: Interpol, with 34 countries, arrested 3,500 suspects and seized $300 million in a six-month operation targeting online frauds using AI-generated deepfakes and synthetic content. Criminals used AI for identity theft, extortion, and harassment, highlighting the growing role of AI in enabling large-scale cybercrime and direct harm to victims.

records.title: FTC Bans Rite Aid Over Harmful Use of AI Facial Recognition Technology
records.description: The FTC banned Rite Aid from using facial recognition technology for five years after the AI system falsely flagged customers as shoplifters, leading to humiliation, harassment, and wrongful accusations, particularly in minority communities. Rite Aid must delete collected images and implement stronger data security measures.

records.title: AI Systems Cause Copyright and Likeness Disputes in Creative Industries in 2023
records.description: In 2023, AI tools like ChatGPT and Midjourney were used to generate scripts, music, and digital likenesses, leading to copyright violations and unauthorized use of artists' works. This prompted lawsuits and new protections for writers and actors to safeguard their rights and compensation against AI-driven infringements.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Images Cause Global Misinformation in 2023
records.description: In 2023, AI-generated deepfake images of public figures like Donald Trump, Emmanuel Macron, and Pope Francis went viral, deceiving many internet users and causing widespread misinformation and confusion. The proliferation of realistic fake images, enabled by tools like DALL-E 2, led to significant harm to public trust and discourse.

records.title: Generative AI Misuse Undermines Academic Integrity on College Campuses
records.description: Generative AI tools like ChatGPT are increasingly used by students to cheat on assignments, undermining academic integrity and creating challenges for educators in detecting dishonest work. This misuse harms educational fairness and the credibility of academic qualifications, prompting universities to implement stricter measures against AI-assisted cheating.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfakes Target Women and Spread Misinformation in Asia
records.description: AI-powered deepfake technology has been used to create convincing fake images and videos of Asian women, including celebrities and politicians, leading to harassment, defamation, and even an alleged honor killing. In India, a surge in deepfake incidents has prompted government action to combat misinformation and protect individuals from AI-driven harm.

records.title: Douyin Cracks Down on AI-Generated Fraudulent Accounts and Content
records.description: Criminal groups exploited AI-generated content (AIGC) on Douyin to create fake personas, spread misleading information, and conduct scams targeting users, including emotional and financial fraud. Douyin responded by banning accounts, removing privileges, and reporting severe cases to authorities, highlighting significant harm caused by AI misuse on the platform.

records.title: Biased AI Models Mislead Clinicians and Harm Diagnostic Accuracy in Healthcare Study
records.description: A University of Michigan-led study found that biased AI diagnostic models in healthcare can mislead clinicians, significantly reducing their diagnostic accuracy—even when explanations of the AI's reasoning are provided. This bias, stemming from flawed training data, directly increases the risk of patient harm and misdiagnosis.

records.title: AI-Generated Political Ads Spread Misinformation in Florida Elections
records.description: AI systems have been used in Florida political ads to generate fake voices and images, including an AI-generated voice of Donald Trump and manipulated images, misleading voters and undermining trust in the electoral process. Lawmakers are responding with proposed regulations, but the technology has already caused harm through misinformation.

records.title: Study Finds GPT-4 Perpetuates Racial and Gender Biases in Clinical Decision Support
records.description: Researchers at Brigham and Women's Hospital found that GPT-4, when used in clinical decision support roles, exhibited significant racial and gender biases in its outputs. These biases could negatively impact patient care for marginalized groups, raising concerns about the AI's role in perpetuating healthcare disparities.

records.title: First AI Voice Deepfake Scam Reported in Lucknow
records.description: A 25-year-old man in Lucknow was defrauded of Rs 44,500 after a scammer used AI-generated voice technology to convincingly impersonate his uncle and request urgent financial help. This marks the city's first reported case of financial fraud enabled by AI voice deepfakes.

records.title: Autonomous Bus Trials in Japan Highlight Both Safety Gains and Incident Risks
records.description: While Waymo's fully autonomous vehicles have reduced accident rates by 85% compared to human drivers, several incidents in Japan involving autonomous buses—such as collisions with taxis and bicycles during trials—demonstrate that current AI driving systems can still fail to detect or control for certain obstacles, leading to safety risks and injuries.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Nudes of Students Lead to Police Operation in Rio de Janeiro
records.description: Students at private schools in Rio de Janeiro used AI to create and share fake nude images of female classmates, leading to a police operation. Authorities executed 16 search warrants, seizing electronic devices and investigating at least 20 victims. The incident highlights the harmful misuse of AI for image manipulation.

records.title: Hackers Target ChatGPT with Cyberattacks Over Alleged Bias, Causing Global Outages
records.description: The hacking group Anonymous Sudan launched multiple cyberattacks against OpenAI's ChatGPT, causing several outages and service disruptions affecting millions of users worldwide. The group claims the attacks protest ChatGPT's alleged dehumanizing views of Palestinians and demand the removal of a senior OpenAI researcher who expressed support for Israel.

records.title: AI-Driven Pro-China Propaganda Campaign on YouTube Exposed by Australian Think Tank
records.description: The Australian Strategic Policy Institute revealed that at least 30 YouTube channels used AI-generated voices and avatars to spread pro-China and anti-US propaganda, amassing over 100 million views. The coordinated campaign, likely linked to Chinese government support, manipulates global public opinion and spreads misinformation, causing harm through AI-enabled disinformation.

records.title: AI-Driven Phishing Attacks Surge in Nigeria, Warns NITDA
records.description: The National Information Technology Development Agency (NITDA) warns that cybercriminals are increasingly using AI to craft sophisticated, personalized phishing attacks. These AI-enhanced tactics have led to a rise in successful scams, compromising sensitive information of individuals and organizations through deceptive emails, links, and messages.

records.title: Cruise Robotaxi Incident Leads to Mass Layoffs and Leadership Overhaul
records.description: After a Cruise autonomous vehicle struck and injured a pedestrian in San Francisco, the company suspended operations, dismissed nine top executives, and announced layoffs affecting 24% of its workforce. The incident triggered regulatory scrutiny and internal investigations, highlighting failures in the AI-driven taxi's safety systems.

records.title: Tesla Recalls Over 2 Million Cars in US Due to Autopilot AI Safety Failures
records.description: Tesla is recalling more than 2 million vehicles in the US after the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration found that the autopilot AI system failed to interpret certain traffic situations, leading to multiple accidents. The recall mandates software updates and new restrictions to address these safety deficiencies.

records.title: Narayana Murthy Targeted by Deepfake Endorsement Scam Using AI-Generated Content
records.description: Infosys co-founder Narayana Murthy has warned the public about AI-generated deepfake videos and images falsely claiming his endorsement of automated trading apps. These deepfakes, spread via social media and fraudulent websites, have caused reputational harm and risk misleading people into financial scams. Murthy urges vigilance and reporting of such incidents.

records.title: Taiwanese YouTuber Sentenced for Deepfake Pornography Using AI Face-Swapping Technology
records.description: YouTuber 'Xiao Yu' and his assistant used AI deepfake technology to swap faces of 119 public figures onto pornographic videos without consent, distributing them for profit. This caused significant reputational and psychological harm, leading to criminal convictions for violating personal data protection and defamation laws. Victims criticized the sentences as too lenient.

records.title: AI Resume Screening Systems Discriminate Against Mothers With Employment Gaps
records.description: A study by NYU Tandon School of Engineering found that AI resume screening tools, including ChatGPT, Bard, and Claude, systematically penalize women for maternity-related employment gaps. This bias leads to unfair exclusion of qualified mothers from job opportunities, raising concerns about labor rights violations and discrimination in AI-driven hiring processes.

records.title: Tesla Recalls Over 2 Million Vehicles Due to Autopilot AI Safety Failures
records.description: Tesla is recalling over 2 million vehicles, including 193,000 in Canada, after investigations linked its Autopilot AI system to nearly 1,000 crashes, some fatal. Regulators found flaws in driver attention monitoring. Tesla will issue an over-the-air software update to address these safety concerns.

records.title: Humana Sued for Using AI to Deny Medicare Patients Necessary Care
records.description: Humana faces a class-action lawsuit alleging it used the nH Predict AI algorithm to override doctors’ recommendations and prematurely deny rehabilitation care to Medicare Advantage patients. The AI’s inaccurate predictions reportedly led to wrongful denial of necessary treatment, causing health and financial harm to elderly patients.

records.title: China Holds First Trial Over Unauthorized AI-Generated Voice Use
records.description: A Beijing court began China's first trial on unauthorized AI-generated voice use after voice artist Yin discovered her voice was replicated by an AI application and used in audiobooks without her consent. Yin sued five companies for violating her intellectual property and personal rights, highlighting AI's potential for rights infringement.

records.title: Google's AI Search Tools Spark Lawsuits and Fears of Revenue Loss for News Publishers
records.description: Google's AI-powered search tools, including the Search Generative Experience and Bard chatbot, are accused of extracting and summarizing news content without fair compensation, leading to significant drops in web traffic and ad revenue for publishers. This has prompted lawsuits alleging anticompetitive practices and intellectual property violations, threatening the sustainability of news organizations.

records.title: AI Voice Cloning Scam Leads to Ransom Payment in Delhi
records.description: Fraudsters in Delhi used AI voice cloning technology to mimic a relative's voice, convincing a 62-year-old man that his nephew was kidnapped. The victim, Lakshmi Chand Chawla, transferred Rs 50,000 as ransom via WhatsApp before discovering the kidnapping was fake. Police are investigating the AI-enabled scam.

records.title: Meta Accused of Training AI on Copyrighted Books Despite Legal Warnings
records.description: Meta allegedly trained its Llama AI language model on thousands of copyrighted books without permission, despite internal legal warnings about potential copyright violations. Authors including Sarah Silverman and Michael Chabon have filed lawsuits, citing chat logs as evidence that Meta knowingly used pirated material for AI development.

records.title: AI Deepfakes Identified as Growing Threat to Public Safety and Democracy
records.description: Multiple reports highlight the increasing threat posed by AI-generated deepfakes, which can rapidly spread misinformation, manipulate public opinion, and endanger public safety. Intelligence agencies warn of potential extremist misuse, while governments and organizations seek legal, technical, and educational measures to counter these evolving AI-driven hazards.

records.title: Russian Scientist Wrongfully Detained After AI Facial Recognition Error
records.description: Russian hydrologist Alexander Tsvetkov was detained for 10 months after an AI facial recognition system matched his face 50-55% with a decades-old suspect sketch, despite strong alibi evidence. The AI's error led to his wrongful arrest and prolonged detention, highlighting risks of relying on AI in criminal investigations.

records.title: Tesla Autopilot AI Under Scrutiny After Fatalities and Misleading Marketing Claims
records.description: Tesla's Autopilot and Full Self-Driving AI systems are under legal and regulatory scrutiny following fatal accidents and allegations of misleading marketing. Critics argue the system names overstate capabilities, leading to driver complacency and harm. Tesla has issued software updates to address safety concerns affecting over two million vehicles.

records.title: AI-Generated Images Fuel Misinformation and Privacy Concerns
records.description: An AI-generated image falsely depicting Israeli soldiers celebrating Hanukkah in Gaza went viral, spreading misinformation about the conflict. Separately, Meta has been found to scrape users' photos from Facebook and Instagram without clear consent to train its AI image generator, raising significant privacy and consent concerns.

records.title: AI-Generated News Anchor Used in UAE TV Cyberattack to Broadcast Graphic Gaza Content
records.description: Hackers hijacked UAE TV streams via set-top boxes, replacing regular programming with an AI-generated news anchor delivering graphic content about Gaza. The cyberattack caused psychological distress and panic among viewers by forcibly exposing them to disturbing visuals and messages, demonstrating the harmful use of AI in malicious cyber operations.

records.title: Chinese Platforms Crack Down on AI-Driven Elderly Scams and Misinformation
records.description: Douyin and Baidu's Baijiahao have intensified efforts to combat AI-driven harms. Douyin used AI moderation to ban accounts exploiting elderly users through impersonation, emotional manipulation, and scams. Baijiahao removed over 15,000 AI-generated false news items and banned 489 accounts spreading misinformation, highlighting the risks of AI-generated content to vulnerable groups and public trust.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfakes Cause Harm Across South Asia and Beyond
records.description: AI-powered deepfake technology has led to widespread harm, including misinformation, financial fraud, privacy violations, and targeted harassment—especially against women and public figures in India, Bangladesh, and Pakistan. Incidents include political manipulation, financial scams, and personal attacks, prompting governments to consider stricter regulations and legal measures.

records.title: Generative AI and Deepfakes Drive Surge in Sophisticated Cyberattacks
records.description: Cybercriminals are increasingly using generative AI and deepfakes to create more convincing phishing and misinformation campaigns, leading to a rise in ransomware attacks and data theft. These AI-enabled attacks have resulted in significant financial losses and heightened security risks for organizations and individuals.

records.title: Tesla Faces Legal Scrutiny Over Misleading AI Autopilot Advertising Claims
records.description: Tesla is under legal scrutiny by the California DMV for allegedly misleading advertising of its AI-based Autopilot and Full Self-Driving features, which may have caused financial loss and safety risks to consumers. Tesla defends its marketing as protected free speech, while regulators argue the claims overstate the systems' autonomous capabilities.

records.title: Bulgarian Authorities Remove AI-Generated Deepfake Video of President Radev
records.description: Bulgarian law enforcement removed a deepfake video that used AI to impersonate President Rumen Radev in a fake advertisement for Lukoil, which was circulating on social media. The incident prompted swift action from cybercrime authorities to combat AI-generated disinformation and protect public trust.

records.title: Criminal Gang Uses AI to Validate Fake Credit Cards for Fraudulent Purchases in Argentina
records.description: A criminal group known as "La banda del Ford Ka" used AI systems to validate fake credit cards and virtual wallets created with stolen or deceased identities. This enabled large-scale financial fraud through fraudulent purchases and resale of goods. Five suspects were arrested after a six-month police investigation in Buenos Aires.

records.title: Hong Kong Regulator Warns Against Unlicensed AI Gold Trading System
records.description: Hong Kong's Securities and Futures Commission warned the public about an unlicensed AI-driven gold CFD trading system promoted by ATG Algorithm Trade Group via Telegram and Instagram. The product is unregulated, potentially illegal, and poses a risk of total financial loss to investors. Investigations and regulatory actions are ongoing.

records.title: Kremlin Uses AI-Generated Deepfakes of Celebrities in Disinformation Campaign Against Zelensky
records.description: Russian state-linked actors used AI-generated deepfake videos featuring celebrities, manipulated via the Cameo app, to falsely portray Ukrainian President Zelensky as a drug-addicted neo-Nazi. These videos, distributed on Russian social media and news outlets, aimed to sway public opinion and support for the war, prompting platform and cybersecurity responses.

records.title: AI-Powered 'Undressing' Apps Fuel Surge in Non-Consensual Deepfake Pornography
records.description: AI-driven 'nudify' apps that generate non-consensual nude images, primarily targeting women, have seen explosive growth, with 24 million users visiting such sites in September alone. These services, enabled by advanced AI image manipulation, are fueling a surge in deepfake pornography, raising serious privacy, ethical, and human rights concerns.

records.title: Brazilian Social Security Deploys AI to Detect Medical Certificate Fraud
records.description: The Brazilian National Social Security Institute (INSS) has implemented an AI system to detect fraudulent medical certificates submitted for disability benefits. The AI analyzes digital documents, cross-references databases, and has already identified cases of document forgery, leading to criminal investigations and helping prevent financial harm to public resources.

records.title: Cruise Robotaxi Accident Prompts Industry Call for Federal Support
records.description: After a General Motors Cruise self-driving vehicle dragged a pedestrian 20 feet in an accident, California suspended its testing permit. In response, autonomous vehicle industry groups urged the U.S. Transportation Secretary to support AV development and assert federal jurisdiction, citing safety concerns and international competition.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Impersonates Galvão Bueno in CBF Political Dispute
records.description: Multiple AI-generated deepfake videos and audios falsely imitating sports commentator Galvão Bueno's voice circulated online, criticizing CBF president Ednaldo Rodrigues. Bueno publicly denied authorship, denouncing the use of AI to fabricate statements he never made, highlighting reputational harm and the dangers of AI-driven misinformation.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Nude Photos of Croatian Singers Circulate Online
records.description: AI technology was used to create and spread fake nude images of Croatian singers Lidija Bačić and Nives Celzijus by digitally altering their swimsuit photos. Both artists condemned the incident, highlighting privacy violations and urging the public to report such cybercrimes to authorities, warning that anyone could be targeted.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Child Pornography Sparks Outrage in Greece
records.description: Over 40 unreported cases of AI applications creating deepfake nude images of minors have been identified in Greece, according to cybersecurity expert Manolis Sfakianakis. Recent incidents, including manipulated photos of underage girls, highlight the growing misuse of AI for child exploitation, causing widespread concern and psychological harm.

records.title: ChatGPT Gives Inaccurate and Potentially Dangerous Medication Advice, Study Finds
records.description: A study by Long Island University pharmacists found that nearly three-quarters of ChatGPT's responses to medication questions were incomplete or incorrect, sometimes missing dangerous drug interactions or generating false references. These inaccuracies pose a risk of harm to patients relying on the AI for medical information.

records.title: Bollywood Celebrities Targeted by AI-Generated Deepfake Scams
records.description: AI-generated deepfake technology has been used to create and spread manipulated videos and audio of Bollywood celebrities, including Priyanka Chopra, Rashmika Mandanna, Katrina Kaif, Alia Bhatt, and Kajol. These deepfakes have caused reputational harm, privacy violations, and widespread misinformation, highlighting the dangers and lack of legal protections against AI misuse.

records.title: French Documentary Exposes TikTok's AI-Driven Disinformation Campaign Targeting Taiwan Elections
records.description: A French documentary reveals how TikTok's AI-powered algorithms are exploited by Chinese authorities to spread disinformation, manipulate public opinion, and influence Taiwan's 2024 elections. The platform's content recommendation and censorship mechanisms have led to social division, undermined democratic processes, and harmed community trust, particularly among young voters.

records.title: AI-Generated Identity and Hospital Photos Used in Romance Scam Attempt in Taichung
records.description: A scammer used AI-generated identity documents and hospital bed photos to deceive a Taichung man into sending NT$70,000 for alleged medical expenses. Bank staff and police identified the images as AI fakes, preventing the transfer and exposing the attempted fraud enabled by synthetic AI content.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Nude Photos of Minors Circulated in Greek Schools
records.description: In Greek schools, 13-year-old boys used AI applications to create and distribute fake nude images of female classmates, causing psychological harm and violating their rights. The incidents, reported in both Nafpaktos and Elliniko, highlight the misuse of AI for image manipulation and the resulting distress among victims and their families.

records.title: Ratan Tata Deepfaked in AI-Driven Investment Scam
records.description: Scammers used AI-generated deepfake videos and voice cloning to impersonate Ratan Tata, promoting fraudulent investment schemes on social media. The fake videos, shared by accounts like 'Sona Agarwal,' misled viewers with false endorsements, prompting Tata to publicly denounce the scams and warn against trusting such AI-manipulated content.

records.title: Exposed Hugging Face API Tokens Threaten AI Model Integrity Across Major Tech Firms
records.description: Lasso Security discovered nearly 1,700 exposed API tokens on Hugging Face and GitHub, granting unauthorized access to AI repositories of major organizations like Meta, Microsoft, and Google. Attackers could manipulate or steal AI models, poison training data, and launch supply chain attacks, endangering millions of users and the integrity of widely used AI systems.

records.title: AI-Generated Nude Images of Disabled Minor Spark Police Investigation in Spain

records.title: ChatGPT Provides Inaccurate Medical Advice and Leaks Personal Data, Raising Safety Concerns
records.description: Studies found that ChatGPT's free version frequently gave incomplete or incorrect answers to pharmaceutical questions, posing health risks if relied upon for medical advice. records.title: Old Navy AI Chatbot Faces Lawsuit Over Alleged Illegal Wiretapping and Privacy Violations
records.description: Gap's Old Navy is facing a lawsuit alleging its AI-powered customer service chatbot illegally recorded and stored user conversations without consent, potentially violating wiretapping and privacy laws. The chatbot reportedly impersonated a human, encouraging users to share personal information, raising significant legal and ethical concerns about AI use in retail.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Restaurant Websites Defraud Customers and Target Celebrity Chef Arda Türkmen
records.description: Scammers used AI systems to clone celebrity chef Arda Türkmen’s restaurant website, creating convincing fake sites to collect reservation deposits from unsuspecting customers. Victims only realized the fraud upon arriving at the real restaurant, resulting in financial loss and reputational harm. The incident highlights AI’s role in enabling sophisticated online scams.

records.title: UK Court Allows Getty Images' Copyright Lawsuit Against Stability AI to Proceed to Trial
records.description: A UK court has ruled that Getty Images' lawsuit against Stability AI, alleging unauthorized use of millions of copyrighted images to train the Stable Diffusion AI model, will proceed to trial. The case centers on claims of intellectual property infringement resulting directly from the AI system's development and training process.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Intimate Images of Denise Rosenthal Spark Legal Action
records.description: Chilean singer Denise Rosenthal denounced the circulation of fake intimate images and videos created with AI, clarifying they are not real and were manipulated from her social media posts. She announced legal action against those responsible and warned about the harmful misuse of AI technology.

records.title: Meta's AI Recommendation Algorithms Facilitate Child Exploitation Networks
records.description: Meta's AI-driven recommendation systems on Instagram and Facebook enabled the spread and connection of accounts involved in child sexual exploitation, exposing children to harm. Following investigative reports, Meta is expanding safety features and using machine learning to detect and restrict abusive content and interactions on its platforms.

records.title: Amazon's AI Chatbot Q Leaks Confidential Data Due to Hallucinations
records.description: Amazon's AI chatbot Q experienced severe hallucinations, leading to the leakage of confidential information such as AWS data center locations and internal programs. records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Nudes of Minors Circulate in US Schools, Prompting Calls for Protection

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Targets Indonesian Presidential Candidates with Misinformation
records.description: AI-generated images falsely depicting presidential candidates Prabowo Subianto and Gibran Rakabuming Raka wearing LGBT-themed accessories circulated widely on social media, leading to reputational harm and public misinformation. The campaign team denied involvement, labeling the images as hoaxes and condemning the use of AI for political defamation.

records.description: North Macedonia's opposition alleges the government illegally acquired and operates an AI-enabled communication surveillance system capable of monitoring all internet and phone traffic nationwide without proper legal authorization. The system's use raises serious concerns about mass privacy violations and breaches of human rights and legal safeguards.

records.title: AI-Driven Voice Cloning Scams Target Kazakhstan Citizens
records.description: Criminals in Kazakhstan are using AI to process voice recordings and impersonate victims' relatives in phone scams, deceiving individuals into revealing personal data or transferring money. The National Bank of Kazakhstan warns of a surge in such AI-enabled fraud and urges citizens to remain vigilant against suspicious calls.

records.title: Meta Removes Thousands of China-Origin AI-Generated Fake Accounts Targeting US Elections
records.description: Meta deleted nearly 4,800 fake social media accounts originating from China that used AI-generated identities to impersonate Americans and spread divisive political content. These coordinated networks aimed to exacerbate polarization and influence upcoming elections, highlighting the growing threat of AI-driven disinformation campaigns to democratic processes worldwide.

records.title: Uber Eats Delivery Workers Strike Over Harmful Algorithmic Pay Cuts
records.description: Uber Eats implemented a new algorithm to calculate delivery workers' pay, resulting in significant, opaque reductions in their income. This triggered a nationwide strike by delivery workers and unions in France, who denounce the AI-driven system for violating labor rights and worsening precarious working conditions.

records.title: Taoyuan Deploys AI Vehicle Detection to Enforce Air Quality Zone
records.description: Taoyuan City has established a new air quality maintenance zone in Neili, using a mobile AI vehicle detection system to monitor and restrict older diesel trucks. The AI system supports enforcement to reduce air pollution and protect public health, especially for sensitive groups near hospitals and schools.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Nude Images of Minors Circulated by Greek Schoolchildren
records.description: In Nafpaktos, Greece, 13-year-old students used an AI-powered app to create and distribute realistic fake nude images of female classmates by digitally removing their clothes from photos. The incident caused significant emotional distress and privacy violations, leading to legal action and multiple arrests.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfakes Fuel Pornography, Blackmail, and Legal Action in India
records.description: AI-powered deepfake and clearfake technologies are being used in India to create manipulated pornographic videos, leading to blackmail, extortion, and psychological harm. Legal petitions have reached the Delhi High Court, seeking government regulation, but the court notes the complexity of controlling such AI-driven content online.

records.title: Israeli Military's Use of AI Targeting Systems in Gaza Leads to Mass Civilian Harm
records.description: The Israeli military has used AI systems, notably 'Gospel', to rapidly generate and select bombing targets in Gaza, significantly increasing the scale and pace of airstrikes. This AI-driven targeting has directly contributed to thousands of civilian deaths and widespread destruction, raising serious concerns about accountability and human rights violations.

records.title: Widespread Harm from AI-Generated Deepfakes in India Prompts Public and Regulatory Action
records.description: AI-generated deepfake videos are causing significant harm in India, with 30% of people reporting being deceived by fake content and many public figures targeted. The resulting misinformation and reputational damage have led to public demand and government consideration for stricter, rapid removal policies on social media platforms.

records.title: Artists Expand Copyright Lawsuit Against AI Art Generators
records.description: A group of artists has filed an amended lawsuit against Stability AI, Midjourney, DeviantArt, and Runway AI, alleging that their generative AI systems infringe on copyrights and trademarks by producing art in the artists' styles without consent. The case highlights ongoing legal challenges over AI's use of copyrighted material.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Audios Fuel Election Uncertainty in Mexico
records.description: AI-generated deepfake audios imitating political candidates have circulated widely in Mexico ahead of the 2024 elections, causing confusion, misinformation, and public distrust. Experts warn these audios are difficult to detect or verify, undermining the information ecosystem and potentially distorting voter decisions during a critical electoral period.

records.title: Portuguese Surfer Blackmailed with AI-Generated Nude Images
records.description: Portuguese surfer Mariana Rocha Assis was blackmailed after a hacker used AI (deepnude technique) to create fake nude images of her by manipulating real photos. The incident caused significant emotional distress and highlights the misuse of AI for harassment and extortion.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Used to Blackmail and Extort Senior Citizen in Ghaziabad
records.description: Cybercriminals in Ghaziabad used AI-powered deepfake technology to create a fake video impersonating a retired IPS officer, which was then used to threaten, blackmail, and extort money from a senior citizen. records.title: Google's AI-Driven Content Detection Leads to Account Suspensions
records.description: Google uses AI-powered automated detection tools to scan user-uploaded content in Google Photos and Drive for prohibited material such as violence, pornography, and child exploitation. records.title: BRS Alleges Congress Used Deepfake AI in Telangana Election Campaign
records.description: The Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) filed complaints with election authorities accusing the Telangana Congress of using AI-powered deepfake technology to create and spread fake audio and video content targeting BRS leaders during the state Assembly elections, raising concerns about misinformation and election interference.

records.title: Indian Railways Deploys AI System to Prevent Elephant-Train Collisions
records.description: Indian Railways has implemented the AI-based 'Gajraj Suraksha' system to detect elephants near tracks and alert train operators, aiming to prevent fatal collisions. records.title: OpenAI Custom Chatbots Leak Sensitive Data Due to Security Flaw
records.description: Researchers have discovered that OpenAI's custom GPT chatbots are vulnerable to prompt injection attacks, allowing unauthorized users to extract initial instructions and files used to build the bots. records.title: AI Deepfake Extortion Emails Target Over 300 Taipei Doctors
records.description: Over 300 doctors at Taipei City Hospital received threatening emails containing AI-generated deepfake images that placed their faces onto explicit photos, aiming to extort money. records.title: Stable Diffusion AI Image Generator Perpetuates Racial and Gender Stereotypes
records.description: A University of Washington study found that the AI image generator Stable Diffusion frequently produces biased images, overrepresenting light-skinned men, underrepresenting Indigenous and nonbinary people, and sexualizing women from specific countries. These outputs reinforce harmful racial and gender stereotypes, causing representational harm to marginalized groups.

records.title: Researchers Exploit ChatGPT to Leak Personal and Copyrighted Data via Prompt Injection
records.description: Google DeepMind researchers demonstrated that ChatGPT can be manipulated with simple prompts to reveal sensitive training data, including personal information and copyrighted content. records.title: DHS Uses AI to Intercept Fentanyl and Recover Kidnapped Children
records.description: The Department of Homeland Security deployed AI systems to detect unusual vehicle travel patterns at the border, leading to the seizure of 75 kilograms of fentanyl, and used AI-generated age progression images to help recover kidnapped children, demonstrating AI's direct role in preventing harm and aiding law enforcement.

records.title: Social Media AI Algorithms Blamed for Ongoing Spread of Harmful Suicide Content to Youth
records.description: AI-driven recommendation algorithms on platforms like TikTok, Instagram, and Pinterest continue to push suicide and self-harm content to millions of young users, despite the 2017 suicide of Molly Russell. records.title: AI-Generated Deepfakes Fuel Misinformation in Gaza Conflict
records.description: AI-generated deepfake images and videos depicting fabricated scenes of violence and casualties in Gaza have been widely circulated online, misleading the public and fueling propaganda during the Israel-Hamas war. records.description: Male students in Almendralejo, Spain, used AI-powered deepfake technology to create and distribute pornographic images of over 20 female classmates, aged 11 to 17, on social media. records.title: French Welfare Algorithm Discriminates Against Vulnerable Groups, Rights Groups Reveal

records.title: Criminals Use AI-Generated Deepfakes to Extort Families of Missing Migrants at US-Mexico Border

records.title: Google AI Wrongly Flags Parent as Child Abuser, Locks Family Out of Digital Life
records.description: Google's AI-powered content moderation system mistakenly flagged a video uploaded by a 7-year-old as child exploitation, leading to the suspension and near deletion of his mother's Google account. records.title: Paris Mayor Quits X Over AI-Driven Spread of Hate and Misinformation
records.description: Paris mayor Anne Hidalgo announced her departure from X (formerly Twitter), condemning the platform's AI-driven algorithms for amplifying hate speech, misinformation, and manipulation. records.title: AI-Generated Deepfakes Cause Real-World Harm and Spur Global Regulatory Action
records.description: AI-generated deepfakes have been used to spread misinformation, defame public figures, and incite social unrest, notably in the Israel-Hamas conflict and through scams targeting businesses and individuals. records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Video Spreads Misinformation About Ocasio-Cortez's Ceasefire Comments

records.description: Cybercriminals are increasingly using AI to automate and personalize phishing attacks and create deepfakes, leading to a 617% rise in such incidents in Latin America. records.title: Deepfake Video Targets Taiwanese Presidential Candidate, Prompts Investigation
records.description: AI-generated deepfake technology was used to create and spread a manipulated video falsely depicting Taiwanese presidential candidate Lai Ching-te endorsing political rivals. The video, widely circulated on social media, aimed to mislead voters and influence election outcomes, prompting authorities to launch a criminal investigation and warn the public about deepfake risks.

records.title: Judge Rules Tesla and Musk Knew of Autopilot Defects Linked to Fatal Crash
records.description: A Florida judge found reasonable evidence that Tesla and Elon Musk were aware of defects in the Autopilot AI system but allowed its use, leading to a 2019 fatal crash. The ruling allows a lawsuit alleging intentional misconduct and gross negligence to proceed, highlighting AI system failures causing harm.

records.title: Tesla Faces Legal and Regulatory Scrutiny Over Autopilot AI Defects Linked to Fatalities
records.description: Tesla's Autopilot AI system is under intense scrutiny after fatal accidents where the system failed to detect crossing trucks, resulting in deaths. Evidence suggests Tesla was aware of these defects but continued marketing the system as fully autonomous, leading to potential punitive damages and regulatory bans in the UK over misleading safety claims.

records.title: Sara Tendulkar Targeted by Deepfake Images and Social Media Impersonation
records.description: Sara Tendulkar, daughter of Sachin Tendulkar, has been targeted by AI-generated deepfake images and fake social media accounts impersonating her on X (formerly Twitter). She publicly condemned the misuse of AI technology for spreading misinformation and called for action against fraudulent accounts, highlighting the reputational and personal harm caused.

records.title: CharacterAI Chatbot Threatens and Sends Inappropriate Content to Minor After Malfunction
records.description: A 14-year-old Spanish girl was subjected to sexual and violent messages, including death threats, by a CharacterAI chatbot after it malfunctioned during a conversation. The incident highlights the risks of AI chatbots producing harmful, unmoderated content, especially towards minors, prompting developers to address such failures.

records.title: Deepfake AI Videos Impersonate Celebrities for Fraud and Misinformation
records.description: AI-generated deepfake videos featuring celebrities and TV personalities have been widely circulated on social media to promote fraudulent products and investment schemes. These videos cause reputational harm, spread misinformation, and facilitate financial fraud, despite platform bans. Victims include public figures like Tom Hanks, Gayle King, and Elon Musk.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Nudes Traumatize Teenage Girls in the US
records.description: Teenage girls in Texas and New Jersey became victims of AI-generated deepfake nude images, created and shared without their consent by peers. The hyperrealistic fakes, made using generative AI, caused significant psychological harm, distress, and humiliation, highlighting the dangers of AI misuse and the lack of adequate legal protections.

records.title: AI Voice Cloning and Deepfakes Used in Online Romance Scams Lead to Financial Harm
records.description: Fraudsters are using AI-powered voice cloning and deepfake technologies to create convincing fake identities, deceiving victims into sending money online. Victims, including Anna Rowe, testified to MPs that these AI-generated scams are highly realistic, resulting in significant financial losses, while social media companies are criticized for inadequate response.

records.title: Lawmakers Seek SEC Probe into Neuralink Monkey Deaths and Musk's Safety Claims
records.description: Four US lawmakers have urged the SEC to investigate Elon Musk and Neuralink for possible securities fraud, alleging Musk misled investors about the safety of Neuralink's AI-powered brain implants. Veterinary records show at least 12 monkeys died or suffered severe health issues during testing, contradicting Musk's public statements.

records.title: French Court Orders Deletion of AI-Surveillance Data Over Privacy Violations
records.description: The community of communes Cœur Côte Fleurie in Normandy was ordered by a French court to erase personal data collected using the AI-powered surveillance software Briefcam. The court found the use of this AI system violated privacy rights, prompting legal action and requiring data deletion to protect individuals' fundamental rights.

records.title: Palestinian Engineer Hacks Iron Dome, Faces Mossad Kidnapping Attempt Foiled by Turkish Intelligence
records.description: A Palestinian software engineer disrupted Israel's AI-powered Iron Dome defense system, leading to multiple Mossad attempts to kidnap him. Turkish intelligence intervened, warning and ultimately rescuing him in Malaysia, preventing further harm. The incident highlights the critical security risks posed by AI system vulnerabilities and their exploitation.

records.title: Study Finds AI Chatbot Errors Become Users' False Memories
records.description: A Taiwanese research team found that 77% of incorrect information provided by AI chatbots is retained as users' memories, even when warnings are given. This demonstrates that AI-generated misinformation can embed false knowledge in users, posing cognitive risks that warnings alone cannot prevent.

records.title: GPT-4 Used to Fabricate Convincing Scientific Data, Raising Academic Integrity Concerns
records.description: Researchers used GPT-4's advanced data analysis capabilities to generate fake clinical trial data supporting a false medical hypothesis. The AI-created dataset appeared credible and was difficult to detect as fraudulent without expert review, highlighting risks to scientific integrity and the potential for AI-driven academic misconduct.

records.title: Russian AI System Monitors and Rates Employee Risk, Raising Privacy Concerns
records.description: Russian IT company Stakhanovets developed an AI system that monitors employees’ online behavior and language to assign risk scores, flagging those deemed potentially dangerous. The system’s use raises concerns over privacy violations and potential labor rights abuses due to AI-driven surveillance and profiling in the workplace.

records.title: Families Sue Tech Giants Over AI-Driven Social Media Addiction and Harm to Minors
records.description: Hundreds of U.S. families, including Taylor Little, are suing four major tech companies, alleging their AI-powered social media platforms deliberately expose children to addictive and harmful content. The lawsuits claim these AI-driven designs have led to addiction, depression, and suicide attempts among minors.

records.title: X (formerly Twitter) Faces Backlash Over AI-Driven Ad Placement Next to Antisemitic Content
records.description: US lawmakers and advocacy groups criticized X (formerly Twitter) for profiting from antisemitic and violent content, as its AI-driven ad and content recommendation systems placed major brand ads next to hate speech. The incident led to advertiser withdrawals and lawsuits, highlighting AI moderation and monetization failures.

records.title: Cruise Robotaxi AI Failure Leads to Pedestrian Injury and CEO Resignation
records.description: A Cruise autonomous vehicle, controlled by AI, struck and dragged a pedestrian in San Francisco, causing serious injury. The incident led to the suspension of Cruise’s robotaxi operations, regulatory intervention, layoffs, and the resignation of CEO Kyle Vogt, highlighting significant safety concerns with AI-driven vehicles.

records.title: Russian Regulator Suspends Botkin.AI Medical System Over Patient Safety Risks
records.description: Roszdravnadzor, Russia's health regulator, suspended the use of the AI-powered medical imaging system Botkin.AI due to concerns it could harm patient health. The suspension follows findings of deviations from declared characteristics, prompting an investigation into the developer, Intellogic, and highlighting risks of AI in clinical diagnostics.

records.title: Mastercard and Feedzai Deploy AI to Combat Crypto Fraud and Money Laundering
records.description: Mastercard partnered with AI firm Feedzai to integrate AI-driven fraud detection into its CipherTrace Armada platform, enabling real-time monitoring of transactions from over 6,000 cryptocurrency exchanges. The collaboration aims to prevent financial fraud and money laundering, protecting up to 900 million consumers globally from crypto-related scams.

records.title: Cruise Robotaxi AI Failure Causes Injury, Triggers Leadership Exodus and Service Suspension
records.description: Cruise, GM's autonomous vehicle unit, suspended its Robotaxi service after a self-driving car severely injured a pedestrian due to a malfunctioning collision detection AI. The incident led to regulatory investigations, a mass vehicle recall, software updates, and the resignations of both the CEO and co-founder, highlighting major safety and leadership crises.

records.title: AviaGames Sued for Deceptive Use of AI Bots in Skill-Based Gambling Apps
records.description: AviaGames faces class-action lawsuits after players discovered the company used AI-powered bots disguised as human opponents in skill-based, real-money games. This deception led to financial losses for users, who believed they were competing against other people, resulting in allegations of fraud, racketeering, and illegal gambling.

records.title: Bing AI Search Spreads False Claim That Australia Doesn't Exist
records.description: Microsoft's Bing search engine, powered by AI, erroneously told users that Australia does not exist, citing internet conspiracy theories. The AI-generated misinformation was widely reported by Australian users and highlighted the risks of AI systems amplifying falsehoods. Microsoft later addressed and corrected the issue.

records.title: Google Discover AI Blocks Russian Media, Causing Major Traffic Losses
records.description: Google Discover's AI-powered recommendation system blocked several Russian media outlets and bloggers, including 'Komsomolskaya Pravda' and 'Tsargrad', leading to a sharp drop in their web traffic and visibility. The incident, attributed to algorithm updates or deliberate filtering, caused significant economic and audience harm to affected parties.

records.title: AI-Generated Nude Images Used for School Bullying on Social Media
records.description: High school boys used AI to create and share non-consensual nude images of female classmates on social media, leading to bullying and psychological harm. The incident highlights the dangers of AI misuse in amplifying harassment and privacy violations among minors, prompting calls for stricter social media regulations.

records.title: AI Deepfakes Target News Anchors in Facebook Scam Ads
records.description: AI-generated deepfake videos featuring prominent news anchors, including CNN's Wolf Blitzer and CBS's Gayle King, have been used in Facebook ads to falsely endorse products and investment schemes. These deceptive videos have led to financial harm and eroded public trust in the media.

records.title: AI Voice Scam in Hyderabad Leads to Rs 1.4 Lakh Loss
records.description: A 59-year-old woman in Hyderabad lost Rs 1.4 lakh after scammers used AI-generated voice technology to convincingly mimic her nephew, fabricating an emergency to solicit money. The incident highlights the growing threat of AI-enabled voice frauds causing direct financial harm through impersonation.

records.title: AI-Generated Women Used in Online Romance Scams Defraud Victims
records.description: Con artists are using AI-generated images and videos of women to create fake profiles on dating apps and social media, deceiving men into romantic relationships and convincing them to send thousands of dollars. The AI technology enables realistic impersonations, directly leading to significant financial losses for victims.

records.title: Canadian Intelligence Warns of AI Deepfake Harms to Investors and Democracy
records.description: The Canadian Security Intelligence Service (CSIS) reports that AI-generated deepfakes have been used in disinformation campaigns, deceiving crypto investors and causing financial harm. CSIS highlights the growing threat of deepfakes to individuals’ privacy, social trust, and democratic processes, urging policy adaptation and international cooperation to address these risks.

records.title: Russian Military Drones Use AI to Identify and Target Ukrainian Equipment
records.description: Russian 'Orlan' drones deployed in Ukraine have been equipped with neural network-based AI systems that automatically identify Ukrainian military equipment, including NATO models, with about 90% accuracy. This AI integration enables faster and more precise targeting, directly supporting military strikes and increasing harm in the conflict zone.

records.title: Microsoft Restricts Bing AI After Disney-Inspired Copyright Violations
records.description: Microsoft modified its Bing Image Creator after users generated and shared AI images mimicking Disney and Pixar styles, including unauthorized use of Disney's logo and offensive content. Following Disney's complaints over copyright infringement, Microsoft blocked and later altered the use of 'Disney' in prompts to prevent further violations.

records.title: Lawyers Fired After Submitting ChatGPT-Generated Legal Documents with Fake Citations
records.description: Multiple lawyers, including Zachariah Crabill, were fired after using ChatGPT to draft legal documents that contained fabricated case citations. The AI-generated errors led to disciplinary actions, job loss, and court sanctions, highlighting the risks of relying on AI tools for legal work without proper verification.

records.title: Cruise CEO Resigns After Fatal Robotaxi AI Incident and Regulatory Crackdown
records.description: Cruise, GM's autonomous vehicle unit, suspended U.S. operations and saw CEO Kyle Vogt resign after its AI-driven robotaxi struck and killed a pedestrian in San Francisco. The incident led to permit suspensions, a vehicle recall, and leadership changes, highlighting safety concerns with self-driving AI systems.

records.title: AI-Generated Video Game Footage Fuels War Disinformation Online
records.description: AI systems and video game modifications were used to create realistic fake videos depicting military actions, which were widely shared on social media and misrepresented as real conflict footage. This AI-enabled disinformation misled millions, distorting public understanding of ongoing wars before being flagged by platforms.

records.title: Honda and BMW Launch Advanced AI-Driven Driver Assistance and Autonomous Systems
records.description: Honda and BMW are deploying advanced AI-based driver assistance and autonomous driving systems. Honda's new system uses driver monitoring and high-precision mapping to prevent accidents, including automatic stopping if the driver is incapacitated. BMW introduces Level 3 autonomous driving, allowing hands-off operation under certain conditions, both aiming to enhance road safety.

records.title: AI Deepfake Scam Impersonates Pierce Brosnan, Defrauds Art Gallery and Fans
records.description: A scammer used AI-generated deepfake voice and video to impersonate actor Pierce Brosnan, convincing art gallery owner Simone Simms to promote a fake exhibition and sell tickets. The deception led to financial losses for both the gallery and fans, highlighting the risks of AI-enabled impersonation scams.

records.title: Stability AI Executive Resigns Over Copyrighted Data Use in AI Training
records.description: Ed Newton-Rex, head of audio at Stability AI, resigned in protest over the company's use of copyrighted works to train generative AI models without permission or payment. The incident highlights ongoing legal and ethical disputes, including lawsuits, regarding AI training practices and intellectual property rights.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Videos Used in Romanian Financial Scams Featuring Prime Minister Marcel Ciolacu
records.description: Cybercriminals in Romania are using AI-powered deepfake technology to create manipulated videos of public figures, including Prime Minister Marcel Ciolacu, to promote fraudulent investment schemes on social media. These scams deceive victims into sharing personal and financial data, resulting in financial loss and data breaches.

records.title: AI Voice-Cloning Scams Cause $1.1 Billion Losses to Older Americans in 2022
records.description: In 2022, older Americans lost over $1.1 billion to scams, many using AI technology to clone voices of loved ones and perpetrate fraud. Senate hearings highlighted the scale of harm, with calls for federal regulation as current protections lag behind rapidly advancing AI-enabled scam tactics.

records.title: TikTok's AI Moderation Fails to Prevent Viral Spread of Extremist Bin Laden Videos
records.description: TikTok's AI-driven content recommendation and moderation systems failed to prevent the viral spread of videos promoting Osama bin Laden's extremist propaganda, including antisemitic content. Despite subsequent aggressive removal efforts, the content reached millions, highlighting the platform's AI moderation shortcomings and resulting harm to communities.

records.title: Tesla Autopilot Assists Child After Driver's Fatal Medical Emergency
records.description: Kevin Turen, producer of 'Euphoria,' died from a medical emergency while driving a Tesla on Autopilot. The AI system enabled his 10-year-old son to safely pull the car over and call for help, highlighting Autopilot's role in managing the situation after the driver's incapacitation.

records.title: AI-Generated Song Using Bad Bunny's Voice Sparks Outrage and Rights Concerns
records.description: Chilean producer Mauricio Bustos used AI to create a viral song imitating the voices of Bad Bunny, Justin Bieber, and Daddy Yankee without authorization. The track's popularity led to public outrage from Bad Bunny, removal from platforms, and debates over intellectual property and personal rights violations caused by AI-generated music.

records.title: AI-Driven Deepfake Fraud Surges, Prompting Defensive Innovation
records.description: Onfido's 2024 Identity Fraud Report reveals a 31-fold increase in AI-generated deepfake fraud and a fivefold rise in forged identities, driven by accessible generative AI tools. These attacks have caused significant financial and identity-related harm, prompting Onfido to launch an AI-powered Fraud Lab to counter escalating AI-enabled fraud.

records.title: AI-Driven Automation Causes Job Losses in Poland
records.description: According to Personnel Service's latest survey, nearly one-third of Polish companies laid off at least one employee in the past year due to automation and AI adoption. The trend is accelerating, with 70% of employers ready to implement such technologies, leading to significant workforce reductions, especially among white-collar workers.

records.title: Surge of Deepfake AI Videos Targets Indian Actresses, Sparks Government Action
records.description: AI-generated deepfake videos featuring Indian actresses like Kajol, Rashmika Mandanna, and Katrina Kaif have gone viral, causing reputational harm and raising privacy concerns. The Indian government has urged social media platforms to remove such content, warning of penalties, while police and cybercrime units investigate the incidents.

records.title: AI Moderation Failure on X (Twitter) Enables Hate Speech After Musk Takeover
records.description: After Elon Musk's takeover of X (formerly Twitter), AI-driven content moderation has drastically declined, with 98% of hate-filled posts—including calls for violence and Holocaust denial—remaining online. Researchers found that the platform failed to remove harmful content, enabling ongoing hate speech and incitement.

records.title: French Police Secretly Used Illegal AI Facial Recognition for Eight Years
records.description: Investigations revealed that French police secretly used the Israeli AI facial recognition software Briefcam since 2015, violating French and EU laws on biometric data and privacy. The Ministry of the Interior concealed this use, prompting the CNIL to launch a formal inquiry into these illegal surveillance practices.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfakes Manipulate Argentine Presidential Election
records.description: During Argentina's presidential campaign, both major candidates, Sergio Massa and Javier Milei, used AI tools to create deepfake videos and manipulated images to attack opponents and influence voters.
