These AI-generated materials spread widely on social media, fueling misinformation and undermining the integrity of the democratic process.

records.title: AI-Generated White Faces Perceived as More Real Than Human Faces, Reinforcing Racial Biases
records.description: Research led by Australian National University found AI-generated white faces are perceived as more realistic than real human faces, due to biased training data. This hyper-realism reinforces racial biases, misrepresents people of color, and raises risks of misinformation and identity theft through AI-generated images.

records.title: UnitedHealth Accused of Using Faulty AI to Deny Elderly Patients Care
records.description: UnitedHealth Group faces lawsuits alleging it used an AI algorithm, nH Predict, to systematically deny necessary rehabilitative care to Medicare Advantage patients. Staff were pressured to follow the AI's error-prone recommendations over doctors' advice, resulting in denied claims, financial hardship, and potential harm to elderly and disabled patients.

records.title: AI Platform Civitai Profits from Nonconsensual Deepfake Porn via Bounty System
records.description: Civitai, a major AI model-sharing platform backed by Andreessen Horowitz, enables and profits from the creation of nonconsensual deepfake sexual images of real people. Its 'bounties' feature incentivizes users to generate targeted deepfake models, leading to privacy violations and harm to individuals, especially women and private citizens.

records.title: Uganda's AI-Powered Vehicle Surveillance System Raises Human Rights Concerns
records.description: Uganda's new Intelligent Transport Monitoring System uses AI-driven technologies, including GPS tracking, facial recognition, and digital license plates, to enable real-time mass surveillance of all vehicles. Human Rights Watch warns this system undermines privacy and threatens freedoms of association and expression, constituting a significant human rights violation.

records.title: Google Maps and Waze Alter Routes After Tourists Harmed in South Africa
records.description: AI-powered navigation apps Google Maps and Waze directed tourists through Cape Town’s high-crime Nyanga area, resulting in shootings, robbery, and a fatality. Following these incidents, Google is removing these routes and labeling them as high-risk to prevent further harm, highlighting the risks of AI-driven routing in unsafe regions.

records.title: Brazilian Judge Investigated for Using ChatGPT in Flawed Court Ruling
records.description: Brazilian federal judge Jefferson Rodrigues is under investigation after issuing a court decision containing false legal precedents generated by ChatGPT. The AI-assisted ruling included erroneous information attributed to Brazil's Supreme Court, prompting judicial authorities to examine the misuse of AI and its impact on legal integrity.

records.title: AI Deepfake Scam Targets Ripple XRP Investors with Fake CEO Videos
records.description: Scammers used AI-generated deepfake videos and voice cloning to impersonate Ripple CEO Brad Garlinghouse, promoting a fake XRP giveaway on social media. Victims were deceived into sending cryptocurrency, resulting in financial losses. Ripple and security experts have warned the community, highlighting the growing threat of AI-enabled fraud.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Audio Impersonates German News Anchors to Spread Disinformation
records.description: AI-generated deepfake audio files imitating 'Tagesschau' news anchors circulated online and at public events, falsely claiming the program spread lies about the Ukraine war, COVID-19, and protests. The fakes, using authentic jingles and voices, aimed to erode public trust and damage Germany’s democratic order through targeted disinformation.

records.title: Google Sues Scammers for Distributing Malware via Fake Bard AI
records.description: Google has filed lawsuits against scammers who impersonated its Bard AI chatbot, promoting fake downloads through social media ads. Users who downloaded the fraudulent software unknowingly installed malware, leading to compromised social media accounts and stolen credentials. The incident highlights harm caused by malicious misuse of AI branding.

records.title: AI-Driven Digital Violence Surges in Mexico City
records.description: The Cyber Police of Mexico City report a sharp rise in digital violence enabled by AI, including deepfake images and voice synthesis used for identity theft, extortion, harassment, and reputational harm. Criminals exploit machine learning algorithms to convincingly impersonate victims, leading to significant personal and security violations.

records.title: Researchers Demonstrate AI's Ability to Rapidly Generate Harmful Health Disinformation
records.description: Flinders University researchers used generative AI tools, including OpenAI's GPT Playground, DALL-E 2, and HeyGen, to create over 100 misleading health blogs, 20 deceptive images, and a deepfake video about vaccines and vaping in just over an hour, highlighting the technology's potential to rapidly spread harmful medical disinformation.

records.title: AI Deepfakes Cause Harm to Celebrities and Public Figures, Prompt Calls for Stricter Laws
records.description: AI-generated deepfakes have increasingly been used to create fake videos and audio of celebrities and public figures, resulting in reputational harm, privacy violations, and legal actions. Recent incidents, including viral deepfakes of Bollywood actors, highlight the urgent need for stronger regulations to address the misuse of this technology.

records.title: Deepfake AI Videos Spark Outrage and Legal Action in India
records.description: AI-generated deepfake videos of actresses Rashmika Mandanna and Katrina Kaif went viral, causing reputational harm and public concern. Delhi Police filed FIRs and launched investigations, while experts and officials called for stronger measures against deepfake misuse. In another case, a man was arrested for using deepfake technology to harass his ex-girlfriend.

records.title: Delhi Police Investigates Viral Rashmika Mandanna Deepfake Video Incident
records.description: A deepfake video of actress Rashmika Mandanna, created using AI, went viral on social media, causing reputational harm. Delhi Police registered an FIR under IPC and IT Act sections, initiated an investigation, and requested Meta for account details. The Delhi Commission for Women also issued a notice demanding action.

records.title: Generative AI Causes Job and Income Losses for Freelancers
records.description: Studies show that the introduction of generative AI tools like ChatGPT has led to significant job and income losses for freelancers, particularly copywriters and graphic designers, on online platforms. High-earning workers are especially affected, experiencing both reduced opportunities and devaluation of their remaining work.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfakes Spread Misinformation in Politics and Conflict Zones
records.description: AI-generated deepfake videos and images have been used to spread misinformation about political leaders, including Japan's Prime Minister and global figures, and in conflict zones like Gaza and Ukraine. These incidents have caused public confusion and reputational harm, prompting government discussions on countermeasures and detection technologies.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfakes Enable New Wave of Fraud in Russia
records.description: Cybersecurity expert Artem Izbaenkov reports that Russian scammers are increasingly using AI-generated deepfakes and voice cloning to create convincing fake audio and video for phishing, blackmail, and financial fraud. Automated AI tools now scale these attacks, making them more effective and causing significant financial and privacy harm to victims.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Audio of London Mayor Sparks Police Investigation and Social Tensions
records.description: AI-generated deepfake audio clips falsely attributed inflammatory statements to London Mayor Sadiq Khan regarding Remembrance Day and pro-Palestinian marches. The clips, widely circulated and amplified by far-right groups, inflamed social tensions and prompted a police investigation, though authorities determined the content was not criminal.

records.title: Google Maps AI Route Errors Lead Hikers into Danger and Trigger Rescues
records.description: Google Maps' AI-driven route recommendations led multiple hikers in Canada to follow non-existent or dangerous 'ghost' trails, resulting in them becoming trapped on hazardous cliffs and requiring helicopter rescues. Similar incidents, including a fatality, have occurred previously, highlighting the risks of relying on flawed AI-generated navigation data.

records.title: Tesla Whistleblower Exposes Autopilot AI Safety and Privacy Issues
records.description: Former Tesla employee Lukasz Krupski leaked internal data revealing safety flaws in Tesla's Autopilot AI, which has been linked to fatal accidents. The leak also exposed employee personal data, prompting investigations by US and European regulators into both AI safety and privacy breaches.

records.title: Brazilian Lawmaker Exposes Racial Bias in AI Image Generation
records.description: Renata Souza, a Rio de Janeiro state deputy, reported that Microsoft's Bing Chat (using DALL-E) generated a racially biased image—adding a weapon to a depiction of a Black woman in a favela, despite no such prompt. She filed a formal complaint, highlighting algorithmic racism and the harm caused by AI-generated stereotypes.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Nudes of Minors Spark Police Action in Belo Horizonte
records.description: A 15-year-old student in Belo Horizonte used AI to create and distribute fake nude images of at least ten adolescent classmates, causing psychological and reputational harm. The police identified the perpetrator, removed the content, and initiated legal proceedings, highlighting the risks of AI misuse in schools.

records.title: Russian AI Image Generator Restricted After Flag Controversy
records.description: Sberbank and Yandex employees were summoned by prosecutors after their Kandinsky AI generated images of the Russian flag with unauthorized elements, sparking complaints from lawmakers. Developers were forced to restrict the AI from generating state symbols, reducing its creative capabilities to avoid further legal and political issues.

records.title: Commonwealth Bank Shares AI Model to Detect Financial Abuse in Transactions
records.description: The Commonwealth Bank of Australia has developed and shared an AI model that detects abusive, harassing, or threatening messages in digital payment transaction descriptions. By making this technology freely available to banks worldwide, CBA aims to combat technology-facilitated financial abuse and protect vulnerable individuals from harm.

records.title: AI-Generated Scam Messages Cause Global Surge in Fraud and Harm
records.description: Cybercriminals are increasingly using AI to craft convincing scam messages, leading to widespread deception and financial loss worldwide. Studies show high rates of individuals in India, the UK, and the US falling for AI-generated scams, with many suffering monetary losses and psychological distress due to the sophistication and believability of these messages.

records.title: South Korean Worker Killed by Robot After AI Misidentification
records.description: A 40-year-old robotics company employee in South Korea was fatally crushed by an industrial robot that misidentified him as a box during a sensor inspection. The robot, designed to handle produce crates, malfunctioned and pressed the worker against a conveyor belt, resulting in his death.

records.title: Facial Recognition at Beyoncé Concerts Sparks Human Rights Concerns
records.description: South Wales Police used AI-powered facial recognition to scan Beyoncé concert crowds for known paedophiles and terrorists, comparing faces to police watchlists. Human rights campaigners criticized the practice, citing privacy and rights violations, as images of flagged individuals were retained, raising concerns about surveillance and potential discrimination.

records.title: Child Psychiatrist Sentenced for Creating AI-Generated Child Pornography
records.description: David Tatum, a child psychiatrist in Charlotte, was sentenced to 40 years in prison for using AI to create child pornography by digitally altering images of minors. He also secretly recorded minors, including family members and patients. The AI system's misuse directly facilitated the production of illegal and harmful content.

records.title: Meta Fined for AI-Driven Personalized Ads Violating EU Privacy Laws
records.description: Meta was fined €390 million by EU regulators for forcing users to accept AI-driven personalized ads in exchange for free access to Facebook and Instagram, violating privacy rights. In response, Meta now offers European users a paid subscription to avoid data processing for targeted advertising.

records.title: Meta Ignored Warnings on Instagram's AI-Driven Harms to Teens, Whistleblower Testifies
records.description: Whistleblower Arturo Bejar testified before Congress that Meta executives, including CEO Mark Zuckerberg, ignored internal warnings about Instagram's AI-driven content systems causing harm to teens, such as exposure to harassment and mental health issues. Despite evidence, Meta failed to address these harms, which are linked to its AI moderation and recommendation algorithms.

records.title: TikTok's AI Algorithm Exposes Youth to Harmful Mental Health Content
records.description: Amnesty International reports that TikTok's AI-driven recommendation system exposes children and adolescents to harmful content related to depression, self-harm, and suicide, worsening mental health issues. The algorithm amplifies toxic and addictive material, while invasive data collection practices further endanger young users' privacy and well-being.

records.title: Cruise Recalls 950 Driverless Cars After AI Software Fails in Pedestrian Accident
records.description: GM's Cruise recalled 950 driverless robotaxis after an AI software malfunction caused a vehicle to drag a pedestrian following a collision in San Francisco. The incident led to severe injury, regulatory investigations, and a halt in production, prompting Cruise to update its collision detection software fleetwide.

records.title: Russian Deepfake Video of Ukrainian Commander Spreads Disinformation
records.description: Russian-linked actors used AI-generated deepfake technology to create and spread a fake video of Ukraine’s military chief, Valerii Zaluzhnyi, falsely urging a coup. Disseminated via social media, the video aimed to sow panic and division, highlighting the harmful impact of AI-driven misinformation campaigns on communities.

records.title: Bad Bunny Outraged by Viral AI-Generated Song Using His Voice
records.description: An AI system, FlowGPT, generated and spread a reggaeton song using Bad Bunny's synthetic voice without his consent, causing the artist to publicly denounce the unauthorized use. The incident highlights concerns over AI-driven violations of intellectual property and personal rights in the music industry.

records.title: Xcel Energy Deploys AI-Powered Cameras for Early Wildfire Detection in Colorado
records.description: Xcel Energy, in partnership with Pano AI, is expanding the use of AI-driven wildfire detection cameras across Colorado. The Pano Rapid Detect system integrates high-resolution cameras and AI algorithms to identify smoke and alert authorities, aiming to enhance early wildfire detection and reduce harm to communities and infrastructure.

records.title: Deepfake AI Used to Create Explicit Fake Images of Bollywood Actresses, Causing Public Outcry
records.description: AI-powered deepfake technology was used to create and circulate explicit fake images and videos of Bollywood actresses Katrina Kaif and Rashmika Mandanna, leading to privacy violations, reputational harm, and widespread public concern. The incidents highlight the growing misuse of AI for malicious purposes and calls for regulatory action.

records.title: Global Surge in AI-Generated Fake Nude Images Harms Women and Girls
records.description: AI tools are increasingly used worldwide to create and spread fake nude images of women and teenage girls, leading to privacy violations, harassment, and extortion. The technology enables realistic fabrications from ordinary photos, with cases like influencer Gabbie Belle highlighting the scale and personal impact of this ongoing harm.

records.title: Level 4 Autonomous Vehicle Fails to Detect Bicycle, Causes Collision in Fukui
records.description: A Level 4 autonomous vehicle in Fukui, Japan, failed to recognize a stationary bicycle due to insufficient training data and camera limitations, resulting in a collision. The incident prompted the operator to enhance the AI system by retraining it with additional bicycle images to improve obstacle detection.

records.title: AI-Driven Identity Theft and Fraud Surge in Mexico
records.description: Reports of identity theft in Mexico rose by 218% in 2023, with authorities linking the increase to criminals' use of AI to generate fake content, hack social media, and commit fraud. The low cost and accessibility of AI have enabled widespread misuse, causing significant harm to individuals.

records.title: Elon Musk's X Restructuring Hinders AI-Driven Disinformation Research
records.description: Elon Musk's restructuring of X (formerly Twitter) has restricted access to AI-driven content moderation and data tools, leading to the cancellation or suspension of over 100 disinformation and hate speech studies. These actions increase the risk of unchecked misinformation and harm to users by limiting independent oversight and research.

records.title: Vietnam Deploys AI-Powered Traffic Violation Detection Nationwide
records.description: Vietnam is expanding the use of AI-integrated traffic camera systems to automatically detect and process traffic violations across multiple provinces. The AI systems record violations, which are then verified by human operators before enforcement. No harm or misuse of the AI system has been reported.

records.title: Snapchat's My AI Chatbot Exposes Minors to Adult Content and Privacy Risks
records.description: Snapchat's AI chatbot 'My AI' allows minors to easily access adult content due to insufficient age verification and content filtering. The system also collects and shares sensitive personal data from young users without adequate safeguards, raising concerns about child safety and privacy violations.

records.title: AI Chatbots Generate False Information, Leading to Real-World Harm
records.description: AI chatbots from OpenAI, Google, and Microsoft have repeatedly generated false information, including fabricated legal cases that were submitted in court. These hallucinations have led to misinformation being used in sensitive contexts, demonstrating the real-world harm caused by AI system malfunctions.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Documents Enable Illegal Land Sales in Yeşilyurt Municipality
records.description: Officials at Yeşilyurt Municipality in Malatya used AI technology to create fake municipal council decisions, enabling the illegal sale and transfer of municipal land. The incident led to the suspension of four employees, legal complaints, and ongoing investigations, highlighting the misuse of AI for administrative fraud and property rights violations.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Nudes of Schoolgirls Spark Police Investigations in Brazil
records.description: Students in schools across Recife, Rio de Janeiro, and Belo Horizonte used AI tools to create and distribute fake nude images of female classmates, many of them minors. The incidents led to police investigations, emotional distress for victims, and raised concerns about privacy violations and the misuse of AI for image manipulation.

records.title: AI Applications Expose Children to Harmful Content and Privacy Risks in Vietnam
records.description: Vietnamese authorities report that AI systems like ChatGPT and AI image editing apps have exposed children to inappropriate content, privacy breaches, and psychological harm. Incidents include children receiving harmful advice, exposure to violent or sexualized material, and misuse of AI-generated images, prompting official warnings and safety recommendations.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Videos Target Indian Celebrities, Prompting Outrage and Legal Calls
records.description: AI-generated deepfake videos and images of Indian celebrities, including Rashmika Mandanna, Sara Tendulkar, and Shubman Gill, have gone viral, causing emotional distress, reputational harm, and public outrage. The incidents have sparked calls for legal action, stricter cyber enforcement, and government advisories to curb the misuse of AI technology.

records.title: Actors Protest AI Misuse Over Identity Theft and Rights Violations in Film Industry
records.description: Prominent actors, including Brian Cox, have condemned the use of AI to create unauthorized avatars and voice reproductions, citing identity theft and human rights violations. The misuse of AI in the film industry has led to labor strikes and legal actions, as actors demand protection of their likeness and intellectual property.

records.title: Google Maps AI Error Endangers Hiker on Mount Fromme
records.description: A hiker became stranded on Mount Fromme after following a non-existent trail recommended by Google Maps, which uses AI for mapping. The error led to a dangerous rescue operation by North Shore Rescue. The incident highlights the risks of relying on AI-generated navigation in wilderness areas.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake of President Erdoğan Used in Fraudulent Investment Scam
records.description: Fraudsters used AI to generate a fake voiceover of President Erdoğan on real video footage, creating a false advertisement for Turkey Petrolleri to deceive citizens into fraudulent investments. Authorities warned the public about the AI-generated deepfake, which spread misinformation and attempted to exploit individuals financially.

records.title: Tesla Settles UK Lawsuit Over Misleading Full Self-Driving Claims
records.description: Tesla settled a UK lawsuit by refunding a Model 3 owner nearly €9,000 after its Full Self-Driving (FSD) system failed to deliver promised autonomous capabilities. The case highlights harm from misleading AI marketing, with Tesla facing ongoing legal scrutiny and investigations over its FSD system’s actual performance versus advertised claims.

records.title: Artists Sue OpenAI Over Dall-E 3's Use of Copyrighted Works in AI Training
records.description: OpenAI's Dall-E 3 image generator, praised for its advanced capabilities, has sparked lawsuits and backlash from artists who allege their copyrighted works were used without consent to train the AI. Artists claim this infringes on their intellectual property rights and threatens their livelihoods.

records.title: WhatsApp AI Sticker Generator Produces Biased, Harmful Images for Palestinian Prompts
records.description: Meta's WhatsApp AI sticker generator produced images of children and men with guns when prompted with terms like "Palestinian" or "Palestine," while similar Israeli-related prompts yielded neutral or positive images. The incident, flagged by Meta employees, highlights harmful AI bias and the reinforcement of negative stereotypes.

records.title: AI Voice Cloning Used in Scams Causes Emotional and Financial Harm
records.description: AI-powered voice cloning technology is being exploited by scammers to convincingly impersonate individuals, including family members, leading to emotional distress and financial fraud. Lawmakers and security experts, including the Biden administration's AI chief, have raised concerns about the technology's impact on trust and personal security.

records.title: AI-Generated Film Scenes Spark Outcry and Legal Action from Hollywood Stars
records.description: AI was used to create or alter film scenes featuring Nicolas Cage and Scarlett Johansson without their consent, leading to confusion, public protest, and legal action. The unauthorized use of their likenesses in AI-generated content highlights significant concerns over rights violations and the ethical use of AI in the film industry.

records.title: Dutch Court Convicts Man for Deepfake Porn Video of TV Presenter Welmoed Sijtsma
records.description: A 39-year-old man was sentenced to a suspended 180-hour community service for creating and distributing a non-consensual deepfake pornographic video of Dutch presenter Welmoed Sijtsma using AI technology, severely violating her sexual privacy and autonomy. This marks a landmark Dutch conviction for AI-generated sexual content.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake of Bella Hadid Spreads Misinformation on Israel-Hamas Conflict
records.description: An AI-generated deepfake video falsely depicting Palestinian-American model Bella Hadid expressing support for Israel went viral, amassing around 30 million views on X (formerly Twitter). The manipulated video, created by a known producer, spread misinformation and caused public confusion and controversy, highlighting the social harm of AI-driven disinformation.

records.title: AI-Cloned Voice of TV Host Used in Fraudulent Health Ad in Spain
records.description: Spanish TV presenter Ana Rosa Quintana revealed that her voice was cloned using AI to create a fake advertisement promoting a diabetes medication she never used. The unauthorized use of her AI-generated voice and image poses health risks by misleading viewers and highlights the dangers of AI-driven identity theft.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Nudes of Students Spark Investigation at New Jersey High School
records.description: Students at Westfield High School in New Jersey used AI tools to create and share fake pornographic images of female classmates, causing emotional distress and privacy violations. The incident prompted a police investigation, school interventions, and calls for stronger AI regulations to protect minors from such harm.

records.title: Researchers Bypass AI Image Generator Safeguards to Create NSFW Content
records.description: Johns Hopkins University researchers demonstrated that popular AI image generators like DALL-E 2 and Stable Diffusion can be manipulated to produce NSFW and violent images by bypassing safety filters using adversarial prompts. This vulnerability allows anyone, including malicious users, to generate inappropriate and potentially harmful content.

records.title: DC Sues RealPage and Landlords for AI-Driven Rent-Fixing Scheme
records.description: Washington, DC sued property management software firm RealPage and 14 major landlords, alleging they used RealPage’s AI-powered pricing algorithm to collude and artificially inflate rents. The lawsuit claims this anticompetitive use of AI harmed renters by raising prices above market rates, violating antitrust laws and exacerbating the housing crisis.

records.title: Scarlett Johansson Sues AI App for Unauthorized Voice and Image Cloning
records.description: Scarlett Johansson has filed a lawsuit against the developers of Lisa AI: 90s Yearbook & Avatar for using AI to clone her voice and image in an online advertisement without her consent. The incident highlights concerns over AI-driven deepfakes and the violation of personal and intellectual property rights.

records.title: Russian AI-Enabled Lancet Drones Cause Harm in Ukraine Conflict
records.description: Russian forces have increasingly deployed AI-enabled Lancet kamikaze drones in Ukraine, using their autonomous target identification and attack capabilities to strike Ukrainian artillery and other high-priority targets. British intelligence reports these drones have become one of Russia's most effective new weapons, directly causing harm to personnel and property in the conflict.

records.title: Meta's AI Algorithms Amplified Hate and Violence Against Tigrayans in Ethiopia
records.description: Amnesty International found that Meta's AI-driven Facebook algorithms amplified and failed to moderate hate speech and incitement targeting Ethiopia's Tigrayan community during the 2020-2022 conflict. This contributed to serious human rights abuses, including violence, discrimination, and the killing of Professor Meareg Amare.

records.title: Adobe Sells AI-Generated Images of Israel-Gaza Conflict, Spreading Misinformation
records.description: Adobe has been selling AI-generated, photorealistic images depicting violence in the Israel-Gaza conflict through its Adobe Stock platform. Despite labeling these images as AI-generated on its site, they have circulated online without disclosure, contributing to misinformation and eroding public trust in news about the conflict.

records.title: Tesla Cleared in Fatal Autopilot Crash Jury Trial
records.description: A California jury found Tesla not liable in a 2019 crash where its Autopilot AI system was alleged to have caused a Model 3 to veer off-road, resulting in one death and serious injuries. Plaintiffs claimed Autopilot was defective, but the jury attributed the accident to human error.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Video of Japanese Prime Minister Spreads on Social Media
records.description: A fake video of Prime Minister Fumio Kishida, created using generative AI to mimic his voice and image and falsely display a news program's logo, was widely spread on social media. The incident caused public misinformation and reputational harm, prompting strong protests from Nippon TV and raising concerns about AI misuse.

records.title: AI-Enabled Pegasus Spyware Targets Activists, Apple Issues Alerts
records.description: State actors have used NSO Group's AI-powered Pegasus spyware to target journalists, activists, and critics, leading to significant privacy and human rights violations. In response, Apple now actively monitors for Pegasus attacks and notifies affected users, with alerts already sent to individuals in multiple countries, including India and Thailand.

records.title: AI-Altered Runway Photo Erases Model's Racial Identity
records.description: Model Shereen Wu accused designer Michael Costello of sharing an AI-altered runway photo that replaced her Asian-American face with that of a white model. The incident, widely publicized on social media, sparked outrage over racial erasure and dehumanization caused by misuse of AI in digital image editing.

records.title: Microsoft AI-Generated Poll Causes Reputational Harm to The Guardian
records.description: Microsoft's AI-powered news service published an automated poll speculating on the cause of a woman's death next to a Guardian article, prompting public outrage and accusations from The Guardian of reputational damage. The insensitive AI-generated content led to distress among readers and criticism of both Microsoft and the newspaper's journalists.

records.title: AI Chatbot Replacement in Eating Disorder Helpline Causes Harmful Advice Incident
records.description: The National Eating Disorder Association (NEDA) in the US replaced its human helpline staff with the AI chatbot Tessa, which subsequently gave harmful advice to vulnerable users. The chatbot's malfunction and lack of ethical oversight led to advice that could worsen users' health, highlighting risks of AI replacing frontline healthcare roles.

records.title: Tech Giants Pledge Action Against AI-Generated Child Sexual Abuse Images
records.description: AI systems have been used to generate and widely share realistic child sexual abuse images, causing significant harm and legal violations. In response, major tech companies, governments, and NGOs have pledged to combat the spread of such AI-generated content, following alarming data from the Internet Watch Foundation.

records.title: AI Surveillance Leads to Human Rights Abuses Amid Oversight Gaps
records.description: AI-powered surveillance technologies, including facial and number plate recognition, have been used by some African governments to monitor and repress citizens, resulting in harassment, arrests, and human rights violations. In the UK, the removal of regulatory oversight for AI surveillance raises concerns about future abuses and lack of accountability.

records.title: AI Developers Accused of Illegally Scraping Copyrighted News Content
records.description: The News Media Alliance alleges that AI developers, including those behind ChatGPT, Bard, and Claude, have illegally scraped and used copyrighted news content to train their models, resulting in copyright infringement, reduced revenues, and increased competition for news publishers. The group has submitted evidence to the US Copyright Office.

records.title: Level 4 Autonomous Vehicle Collides with Bicycle in Eiheiji, Fukui—Service Suspended
records.description: A Level 4 autonomous vehicle operating in Eiheiji, Fukui Prefecture, collided with a parked bicycle while carrying four passengers. No injuries occurred, but the incident marked the first such accident since the service began. Operations were suspended pending investigation and safety review.

records.title: Facial Recognition AI Fails After Influencer's Plastic Surgery
records.description: Brazilian influencer Rico Melquiades experienced issues accessing his banking app after facial recognition AI failed to identify him due to recent plastic surgeries. The AI system's inability to adapt to his altered appearance resulted in disrupted access to essential banking services.

records.title: AI-Driven Bank Card Blocks for Suspicious Cash Withdrawals in Russia
records.description: Russian banks are increasingly using AI systems to monitor transactions and block cards when frequent large cash withdrawals are detected, especially soon after deposits. This AI-driven process can disrupt customers' access to funds, requiring additional verification steps and potentially impacting financial rights.

records.title: Facial Recognition AI in Policing Leads to False Identifications and Racial Bias Concerns
records.description: Police use of AI-powered facial recognition technology has resulted in false identifications and disproportionately targeted non-white individuals, raising concerns about bias and rights violations. Despite limited success, authorities in New Orleans and the UK are expanding its use, prompting criticism from lawmakers and civil rights advocates over privacy and civil liberties.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake of Silvio Santos Used in Fraudulent Arthritis Cure Scam
records.description: Criminals used AI to create a deepfake video of TV host Silvio Santos and his wife endorsing a fake herbal cure for arthritis. The video, widely circulated on social media, was denounced by their daughter Daniela Beyruti, who warned the public about the scam and the dangers of AI-generated misinformation.

records.title: Deepfake Ads in Cyprus Use AI to Impersonate Journalists and Promote Pharmaceuticals
records.description: AI-generated deepfake videos are being used in Cyprus to impersonate journalists and TV presenters in social media ads promoting pharmaceutical products. Authorities warn that these deceptive ads can mislead the public into unsafe purchases, posing health risks and undermining trust in media figures.

records.title: Airbnb Deploys AI to Block Halloween Party Bookings and Prevent Disruptive Events
records.description: Airbnb has implemented an AI-driven system to identify and block high-risk bookings, such as one- or two-night stays, that may be used for disruptive Halloween parties. The AI analyzes factors like booking length, proximity, and timing to prevent property damage and community disturbances, aiming to reduce potential harm during the holiday.

records.title: ChatGPT and Bard Enable More Convincing AI-Generated Scams, Consumer Group Warns
records.description: Consumer group Which? found that AI chatbots ChatGPT and Bard can be easily misused by fraudsters to generate professional-looking scam emails and texts, bypassing traditional red flags like poor grammar. This enables more convincing scams, increasing the risk of fraud and financial harm to individuals.

records.title: AI-Generated Portrait Apps Fuel Deepfake Scams and Privacy Risks in Vietnam
records.description: AI-powered portrait and cartoon image apps, especially Zalo AI Avatar, have surged in popularity in Vietnam, leading to widespread sharing of personal images. Authorities warn that these images are being exploited by criminals to create deepfakes for scams, identity theft, and financial fraud, resulting in real harm to users.

records.title: Brazilian Politician Exposes Racial Bias in AI Image Generation
records.description: State deputy Renata Souza (PSOL-RJ) denounced 'algorithmic racism' after an AI image generator depicted her as a Black woman holding a gun in a favela, despite no mention of violence in her prompt. The incident highlights how AI systems can perpetuate harmful racial stereotypes and discrimination.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Nudes of Actress Isis Valverde Spark Legal Action in Brazil
records.description: Brazilian actress Isis Valverde became a victim of AI-generated deepfake nude images, which were falsely attributed to her and widely circulated online. Valverde reported the incident to cybercrime authorities and initiated legal action to hold internet providers accountable, highlighting the privacy violations and reputational harm caused by AI-enabled image manipulation.

records.title: AI System Detects Over 800 Land and Property Violations in Moscow
records.description: AI-powered image analysis in Moscow processed over 2.5 million images from drones and surveillance cameras between January and September 2023, identifying more than 800 land and property violations, including unauthorized construction and land misuse. The system enabled early detection and enforcement, with analysis accuracy exceeding 90%.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfakes Drive Surge in Crypto Industry Fraud and Losses
records.description: A Sumsub report reveals a 128% rise in AI-generated deepfake fraud within the crypto industry in 2023. Seventy percent of crypto companies observed increased deepfake use, with 55% reporting higher financial and reputational losses, as sophisticated AI-driven schemes evade detection and exploit verification processes.

records.title: Deepfakes Undermine Trust During Russian Invasion of Ukraine
records.description: AI-generated deepfake videos, including fabricated speeches by Ukrainian President Zelensky and Russian President Putin, were circulated during the Russian invasion of Ukraine. These deepfakes spread misinformation, eroded public trust in authentic conflict footage, and fueled conspiracy theories, as documented by a University College Cork study analyzing social media reactions.

records.title: Watchdog Warns of Surge in AI-Generated Child Sexual Abuse Images
records.description: The Internet Watch Foundation warns that AI tools are actively being used to generate child sexual abuse images, overwhelming law enforcement and increasing victimization. Governments and tech providers are urged to act swiftly, as legal cases, such as a conviction in South Korea, highlight the ongoing harm caused by AI-generated content.

records.title: US States Sue Meta Over AI-Driven Harm to Youth Mental Health
records.description: A coalition of over 40 US state attorneys general has sued Meta, alleging its AI-powered algorithms on Facebook and Instagram intentionally addict children and teens, causing significant mental health harm. The lawsuits claim Meta prioritized profit over safety, misleading the public about the risks of its platforms.

records.title: UWindsor Study Finds AI-Driven Semi-Autonomous Cars Reduce Driver Attentiveness, Raising Safety Risks
records.description: A University of Windsor study found that drivers using Level 2 semi-autonomous AI systems, such as those in Tesla vehicles, became significantly less attentive, often dozing off or focusing on screens instead of the road. This reduced vigilance increases the risk of accidents and has been linked to crashes and fatalities.

records.title: Deepfake Pornographic Videos of Italian PM Lead to Defamation Trial
records.description: Two men in Sardinia are on trial for creating and publishing AI-generated deepfake pornographic videos featuring Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni's face. Meloni, a civil party in the case, seeks €100,000 in damages to support female victims of violence, highlighting the harm caused by AI-driven defamation.

records.title: ICE Uses AI to Monitor and Rank Social Media for Immigration Enforcement
records.description: US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) has used the AI tool Giant Oak Search Technology (GOST) to scan and rank social media posts for "derogatory" content, influencing immigration decisions. This secretive surveillance raises serious concerns about privacy, free speech, and potential violations of human rights and due process.

records.title: Spanish Teen Arrested for Creating and Distributing AI-Generated Child Abuse Images
records.description: A 17-year-old in Súria, Spain, was arrested for using AI to generate and distribute pornographic images of minors. He sourced photos from social media and his own camera, manipulated them with AI to remove clothing, and shared the illegal content online, constituting serious harm and legal violations.

records.title: AI-Driven Chinese Propaganda Campaign Targets Canadian Politicians
records.description: Canada detected a major online propaganda campaign linked to China, using AI-generated deepfake videos and automated bots to spread thousands of false messages accusing Prime Minister Justin Trudeau and other politicians of crimes and ethical breaches. The campaign aimed to discredit officials and silence criticism of the Chinese Communist Party.

records.title: Russian AI-Generated Fake News Campaign Targets Ukraine with Power Outage Disinformation
records.description: Russian actors used AI to create and spread fake TV news segments on social media, falsely claiming nationwide power outages in Ukraine. The campaign, identified by energy company DTEK, aimed to misinform the public and incite panic, prompting calls for intervention by Ukrainian authorities.

records.title: Cruise Driverless Cars Suspended After Pedestrian Injury and Safety Incidents
records.description: Cruise, GM's autonomous vehicle subsidiary, suspended all driverless operations after its AI-powered cars were involved in multiple safety incidents, including a pedestrian injury. The California DMV revoked Cruise's permits, citing unreasonable public safety risks and transparency issues, prompting a nationwide pause and regulatory scrutiny of its self-driving technology.

records.title: Brazilian Intelligence Agency Illegally Used AI Surveillance Tool to Monitor Officials and Journalists
records.description: The Brazilian Intelligence Agency (Abin) used the Israeli AI-based FirstMile surveillance system to illegally monitor journalists, politicians, and Supreme Court ministers during the Bolsonaro administration. The unauthorized use of this AI tool violated privacy and legal protections, prompting a federal investigation and raising concerns over national sovereignty.

records.title: AI Chatbots Found Vulnerable to Generating Malicious Code for Cyberattacks
records.description: Researchers at the University of Sheffield demonstrated that commercial AI chatbots, including ChatGPT and Baidu-UNIT, can be manipulated to generate malicious code. These vulnerabilities allow attackers to steal sensitive data, disrupt or destroy databases, and launch denial-of-service attacks, posing significant cybersecurity risks.

records.title: iFlytek AI Learning Machine Incident: Inappropriate Content Prompts Public Outcry and Company Response
records.description: iFlytek's AI-powered learning machines delivered inappropriate and historically distorted content to children, sparking public concern and a stock drop. The company responded by removing the content, punishing partners, and strengthening content review mechanisms, acknowledging the AI system's failure in content safety and the resulting harm to users and reputation.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Pornography and Misinformation Cause Widespread Harm
records.description: AI-powered deepfake technology is increasingly used to create non-consensual pornographic videos and manipulated images, targeting women and minors, and spreading misinformation during conflicts. These incidents have led to privacy violations, psychological harm, reputational damage, and erosion of trust, highlighting the growing societal risks posed by generative AI systems.

records.title: Widespread Deployment of AI Facial Recognition Enables Mass Surveillance in Russia
records.description: Russian authorities have implemented AI-powered facial recognition surveillance systems in 62 regions, connecting over 500,000 cameras, including in public spaces, schools, and universities. This rapid expansion, led by companies like NtechLab, has raised significant concerns over privacy violations and human rights due to pervasive monitoring of citizens.

records.title: Brazilian Army Refuses to Explain Use of AI Surveillance Software Under Federal Investigation
records.description: The Brazilian Army declined to clarify its acquisition and use of AI-powered surveillance software, such as First Mile, which enables cellphone geolocation. The Federal Police are investigating alleged illegal use of these tools by intelligence agencies, leading to arrests and suspensions for potential privacy and legal violations.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfakes Used in Celebrity Endorsement Scams
records.description: AI tools like Stable Diffusion and Nvidia tech are being used to create convincing fake images and voices of celebrities, leading to widespread scams and fraudulent endorsements. These deepfakes deceive the public, causing financial and reputational harm, and are difficult to stop due to the accessibility of AI technology.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Pornography Causes Widespread Harm and Legal Debate in Germany
records.description: AI-powered deepfake technology is being used to create and distribute non-consensual pornographic images and videos, causing reputational and emotional harm to victims, including public figures. Advocacy groups and affected individuals are calling for stronger legal protections and regulation to address the misuse of these AI systems.

records.title: AI-Generated Porn Harms Creators and Violates Rights
records.description: AI systems, including text-to-image generators and deepfake models, are being used to create synthetic pornographic content and impersonate real performers without consent. This has led to intellectual property violations, economic harm to sex workers, and deception of consumers, as AI-generated content circumvents verification and undermines creators' rights and livelihoods.

records.title: Waymo Autonomous Taxis Involved in Collisions and Animal Fatality in Phoenix
records.description: Waymo's AI-driven autonomous taxis, operating in Phoenix, Arizona, have been involved in several collisions and caused the death of a dog. These incidents highlight the risks and real-world harms associated with the deployment of AI-powered vehicles, despite their growing presence and commercial use in US cities.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Audio Used to Attack Colombian Political Candidates
records.description: AI-generated fake audio clips simulating the voices of political candidates Carlos Fernando Galán and Alejandro Éder were circulated on social media to spread misinformation and damage their reputations. Both candidates denounced the attacks, warning the public and authorities about the coordinated use of AI for electoral disinformation.

records.title: Microsoft Edge AI Features Raise Privacy Concerns Over Browsing Data Use
records.description: Microsoft Edge's new AI features, including Copilot and Bing Chat, collect and send users' browsing data to Microsoft for AI training and personalized responses. This practice, sometimes enabled without clear user consent, raises significant privacy concerns about data handling and user awareness, though no direct harm has been reported.

records.title: AI Chatbots in Healthcare Perpetuate Racist Medical Misinformation, Study Finds
records.description: A Stanford-led study found that popular AI chatbots, including ChatGPT and Google's Bard, generated racist and debunked medical information about Black patients, sometimes fabricating race-based equations. Experts warn this perpetuates medical racism and could worsen health disparities for Black patients as such tools are increasingly used in healthcare.

records.title: AI Used to Create and Distribute Child Sexual Abuse Material in Bilbao
records.description: A 58-year-old man in Bilbao was arrested for possessing and sharing child sexual abuse material, including AI-altered images where faces of real minors were substituted onto pornographic cartoons. The use of AI directly facilitated the creation and distribution of illegal and harmful content involving minors.

records.title: AI Moderation Failures on X (Twitter) Fuel Misinformation During Israel-Hamas Conflict
records.description: Following Elon Musk's acquisition of X (formerly Twitter), reductions in AI-driven content moderation and changes to verification systems enabled widespread misinformation, hate speech, and fake accounts during the Israel-Hamas conflict, directly harming communities by spreading confusion and exacerbating social tensions.

records.title: AI Voice Cloning Used in Crypto Scams Impersonating Tim Draper
records.description: Scammers used AI-generated voice technology to impersonate venture capitalist Tim Draper, attempting to trick social media users into sending cryptocurrency. Draper publicly warned his followers about the fraudulent use of his synthesized voice, highlighting the growing threat of AI-enabled financial scams targeting the crypto community.

records.title: US Authors Sue Tech Giants Over AI Training with Copyrighted Books
records.description: A group of US authors, including former Arkansas Governor Mike Huckabee, filed lawsuits against Microsoft, Meta, Bloomberg, and EleutherAI, alleging their AI models were trained on unauthorized copyrighted books from the 'Books3' dataset. The authors seek compensation and an injunction to stop further use of their works in AI training.

records.title: AI Recruitment Algorithms Allegedly Cause Discriminatory Hiring Practices
records.description: Derek Mobley and others allege that Workday's AI-driven recruitment platform discriminated against protected groups, leading to unfair job rejections. A class action lawsuit and regulatory scrutiny highlight concerns that automated hiring systems perpetuate bias, resulting in violations of labor and civil rights.

records.title: Metropolitan Police Deploy Facial Recognition AI to Target Prolific Shoplifters
records.description: The Metropolitan Police have implemented facial recognition AI to identify and investigate prolific retail criminals in London. The system matched 149 suspects from 302 images, aiding efforts to reduce shoplifting and related violence. While retailers welcome the technology, civil liberties groups raise concerns about privacy and potential misuse.

records.title: Music Publishers Sue Anthropic Over AI-Generated Copyrighted Lyrics
records.description: Universal Music Group and other major publishers have sued AI startup Anthropic, alleging its Claude AI model was trained on and generates copyrighted song lyrics without authorization. The lawsuit claims this constitutes widespread copyright infringement, as Claude can reproduce lyrics nearly identical to protected works, causing harm to rights holders.

records.title: North Korea Uses AI to Enhance Cyber Warfare Capabilities
records.description: U.S. officials have confirmed that North Korea is leveraging AI models to accelerate the creation of malicious software and identify exploitable systems, significantly boosting its cyberattack capabilities. This AI-driven approach has contributed to cybercrimes, including cryptocurrency theft and threats to enterprises and critical infrastructure worldwide.

records.title: Five Eyes Alliance Accuses China of AI-Enabled Cyber Espionage and IP Theft
records.description: The Five Eyes intelligence alliance (US, UK, Canada, Australia, New Zealand) issued a rare joint statement accusing China of using AI to conduct large-scale cyberattacks and espionage, resulting in widespread theft of intellectual property and sensitive technology. Officials warn AI tools are amplifying the scale and effectiveness of these malicious activities.

records.title: Fugees Rapper Pras Michel Seeks Retrial After Lawyer Used AI for Closing Argument
records.description: Pras Michel, former Fugees rapper, is seeking a new trial, alleging his previous attorney used an experimental AI program to draft the closing argument, resulting in a flawed defense. Michel's new legal team claims this AI-generated argument contributed to his conviction on conspiracy and lobbying charges, raising concerns about AI's role in legal proceedings.

records.title: Voice Actors Harmed by Unauthorized AI Voice Cloning
records.description: AI systems have cloned voice actor Armando Plata’s voice without his consent, using it for commercial purposes and depriving him of control and compensation. This unauthorized use has prompted Plata and other voice actors globally to advocate for legal protections against AI-driven voice appropriation.

records.title: Instagram AI Translation Bug Labels Palestinian Users as 'Terrorists'
records.description: Instagram's AI-powered translation feature mistakenly added the word 'terrorist' to some Palestinian users' bios, misrepresenting them and causing reputational harm. The error, triggered by combinations of 'Palestinian' and Arabic phrases, was quickly fixed after public outcry. Meta apologized, attributing the incident to a translation bug in their AI system.

records.title: US Regulators Investigate Cruise Autonomous Vehicles After Pedestrian Incidents
records.description: The US National Highway Traffic Safety Administration has launched an investigation into GM's Cruise autonomous vehicles following several pedestrian-involved accidents in San Francisco. The probe focuses on whether Cruise's AI-driven taxis failed to exercise adequate caution around pedestrians, potentially increasing the risk of injury or death.

records.title: AI Deepfake Scam Targets African Union Chairperson
records.description: Fraudsters used AI-powered deepfake technology to impersonate African Union Commission Chairperson Moussa Faki, faking his voice and video in calls and emails to European leaders. This cyberattack enabled phishing attempts and posed significant risks to diplomatic security and trust between international entities.

records.title: Swiss Politician Ordered to Delete AI-Generated Deepfake Video Targeting Rival
records.description: SVP Nationalrat Andreas Glarner used AI to create and share a deepfake video falsely attributing inflammatory statements to Green politician Sibel Arslan before Swiss elections. The video sparked public outrage and legal action, resulting in a court order for Glarner to delete the video or face a fine.

records.title: US Senator Criticizes Social Media Algorithms for Amplifying Israel-Hamas Misinformation
records.description: US Senator Michael Bennet criticized Meta, X, TikTok, and Google for their AI-driven algorithms amplifying false and misleading content about the Israel-Hamas conflict. He warned that this algorithmic amplification has fueled violence, paranoia, and distrust, and demanded stronger content moderation measures from the platforms.

records.title: India Moves to Curb AI Deepfake Misinformation on WhatsApp Ahead of Elections
records.description: The Indian government is responding to the spread of AI-generated deepfake videos on WhatsApp, which threaten electoral integrity, by considering a law requiring WhatsApp to disclose the originator of such content. WhatsApp opposes the move, citing user privacy concerns, highlighting tensions between combating AI-driven misinformation and protecting privacy.

records.title: Australia Fines X for AI Failures in Child Abuse Content Moderation; EU Issues Ultimatum Over Disinformation
records.description: Australian and EU regulators have penalized and investigated X (formerly Twitter) for inadequate AI-driven content moderation. X's insufficient detection and removal of child abuse material and disinformation, especially after reduced moderation under Elon Musk, led to regulatory fines and ultimatums, highlighting harm from AI system failures in protecting users.

records.title: Judge Allows Lawsuits Over AI-Driven Social Media Addiction to Proceed
records.description: A Los Angeles judge ruled that lawsuits against Meta, TikTok, Snap, and Google can proceed, alleging their AI-driven platform designs intentionally addict minors and cause mental health harms such as depression and anxiety. The court found that the platforms' design features, not just user content, may have caused these injuries.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Nudes of IPN Students Spark Investigation and Outrage in Mexico
records.description: A student at Mexico's Instituto Politécnico Nacional used AI to create and sell over 50,000 non-consensual fake nude images of female classmates, violating their privacy and rights. The incident prompted formal complaints, a criminal investigation, and demands for institutional accountability and legal action against the perpetrator.

records.title: EU Investigates X/Twitter Over AI-Moderated Spread of Illegal Content and Disinformation
records.description: The European Union has launched its first official investigation under the Digital Services Act into X (formerly Twitter) for failing to prevent the spread of illegal content, disinformation, terrorist propaganda, and incitement to violence. The probe centers on the platform's AI-driven content moderation and recommendation systems.

records.title: AI Algorithms Cause Labor Rights Violations in Employment Decisions and Monitoring
records.description: AI algorithms are increasingly used for hiring, firing, and real-time monitoring of workers, leading to privacy violations, unfair dismissals, and labor rights abuses. These practices have sparked strikes, legal challenges, and concerns over exploitation and discrimination, highlighting the direct harm caused by AI systems in the workplace.

records.title: Google Bard and Microsoft Bing Chatbots Spread False Ceasefire Claims in Israel-Hamas Conflict
records.description: Google Bard and Microsoft Bing Chatbots inaccurately reported a ceasefire and fabricated death tolls during the Israel-Hamas conflict, spreading misinformation. These AI-generated errors, known as hallucinations, misled the public and highlighted the risks of relying on chatbots for real-time, critical news updates during ongoing crises.

records.title: AI System Developed by Students Boosts Goose Survival Rates in China
records.description: A team of 16 Shenzhen University students developed an AI program to identify sick lion-head geese, providing real-time health alerts and environmental data. The system increased the geese's survival rate by 30%, demonstrating AI's positive impact on animal health and agricultural productivity.

records.title: AI-Generated Image Shared as War Propaganda in Israel-Hamas Conflict
records.description: Conservative commentator Ben Shapiro shared an AI-generated image purporting to show a 'burnt Jewish baby' following a Hamas attack on Israel. The image, confirmed as fake by detection tools, was used to promote a misleading narrative, fueling misinformation and exacerbating tensions during the conflict.

records.title: Google Discover AI Recommends Pro-War Russian Propaganda to Android Users
records.description: Google's AI-driven Discover news feed continues to recommend pro-Kremlin propaganda and disinformation to Russian Android users, including content from sanctioned sources, despite Google's efforts to block such material elsewhere. This ongoing dissemination of misleading and harmful content highlights the AI system's failure to prevent the spread of war-supporting propaganda.

records.title: Cruise Robotaxis Cause Safety Incidents, Prompt Emergency Response Upgrades
records.description: Cruise's AI-powered robotaxis in San Francisco have caused safety incidents, including running over a pedestrian and obstructing emergency vehicles. These malfunctions disrupted emergency response operations, prompting Cruise to upgrade its technology for better emergency detection and response, and to collaborate more closely with public safety agencies.

records.title: Retailers Secretly Use Facial Recognition AI to Track Shoppers Without Consent
records.description: Major retailers, including Macy's, are secretly deploying facial recognition AI to monitor and identify customers without their consent. This technology collects personal data and tracks behavior, raising significant privacy and human rights concerns due to the lack of transparency and customer approval.

records.title: Pegasus Spyware Misuse and Failures Lead to Rights Violations and Security Lapses
records.description: AI-powered Pegasus spyware has been misused by several European states for illegitimate surveillance, prompting calls for investigations and compensation for victims. In Spain, its use against Catalan leaders has led to court proceedings. Additionally, Pegasus failed to prevent the October 7 Hamas attack, highlighting its limitations in national security.

records.title: Research Finds Autonomous Vehicles Cause More Crashes and Disruptions Than Human Drivers
records.description: Missy Cummings' research revealed that AI-driven autonomous vehicles from Tesla, Waymo, and Cruise exhibit higher crash rates, traffic disruptions, and unsafe behaviors compared to human drivers. These findings have led to regulatory scrutiny and highlight real-world harms caused by current self-driving AI systems.

records.title: Disney's Use of AI-Generated Extras in 'Prom Pact' Triggers Labor Dispute and Backlash
records.description: Disney's use of AI-generated digital extras in the film 'Prom Pact' sparked widespread criticism and fueled ongoing strikes by actors' unions, who fear job loss and rights violations. The incident highlights concerns over studios using AI to replicate actors' likenesses without consent, leading to labor disputes and social outrage.

records.title: Indian Opposition Accuses Meta and Google AI Systems of Election Bias and Social Harm
records.description: India's opposition bloc accused Meta and Google of using AI-driven content moderation and recommendation systems to suppress opposition voices and promote ruling party content, allegedly inciting communal hatred and harming democratic processes. They demanded platform neutrality ahead of national elections, citing investigative reports of algorithmic bias.

records.title: AI-Generated Morphed Photos of Chandigarh Schoolgirls Go Viral, Prompting Police Action
records.description: Over 50 students from a prominent Chandigarh private school had their photos downloaded from the school website, manipulated into objectionable images using AI, and shared on Snapchat. The incident caused distress among students and parents, leading to police complaints and a case registered under IT and POCSO Acts.

records.title: LA Eviction Lawyer Sanctioned for Submitting AI-Generated Fake Legal Citations
records.description: Dennis Block, a prominent LA eviction attorney, was sanctioned after his firm submitted court filings containing fake legal citations, likely generated by AI tools such as ChatGPT. The misuse of AI led to the inclusion of fabricated case law, violating legal standards and resulting in judicial penalties.

records.title: AI Voice Cloning Used Without Consent in Sexually Explicit Content Harms Voice Actor
records.description: Voice actor Allegra Clark discovered her voice was cloned using AI and inserted without consent into a sexually explicit scene, causing personal and professional harm. The AI company ElevenLabs failed to provide a satisfactory response, highlighting risks of AI misuse in content creation and the lack of effective safeguards.

records.title: Public Facial Recognition AI Sparks Privacy and Safety Concerns
records.description: PimEyes, a powerful AI-driven facial recognition tool, enables users to identify strangers from photos, leading to privacy violations, stalking, and doxxing. Despite warnings from tech leaders like Google, the technology is publicly accessible and has been misused, raising significant concerns about personal safety and human rights.

records.title: AI System Enables Rapid Brain Tumor Diagnosis During Surgery
records.description: Researchers from UMC Utrecht and partner institutions developed a deep-learning AI system that identifies brain tumor types within 1.5 hours during surgery, compared to the usual week-long process. This allows neurosurgeons to adjust surgical strategies in real time, reducing risks of additional surgeries and neurological damage.

records.title: Apple Faces Lawsuit Over AirTag-Enabled Stalking and Harm
records.description: Apple is facing a class-action lawsuit from dozens of victims who allege that its AI-enabled AirTag tracking devices have been misused by stalkers, leading to harassment, privacy violations, and even murders. Plaintiffs claim Apple failed to implement adequate safeguards to prevent the malicious use of its location-tracking technology.

records.title: Utah Sues TikTok Over AI-Driven Child Addiction and Mental Health Harms
records.description: Utah has filed a lawsuit against TikTok, alleging its AI-powered recommendation algorithms deliberately manipulate and addict children, causing mental health harm. The state accuses TikTok of misleading users about app safety and exploiting young users through addictive, slot machine-like design features, prompting legal action to protect children.

records.title: EU Demands Tech Giants Address AI-Driven Disinformation on Israel-Hamas Conflict
records.description: Following a surge of AI-amplified disinformation and illegal content about the Israel-Hamas conflict on platforms like X, Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok, the EU has demanded urgent action from Elon Musk, Mark Zuckerberg, and TikTok, threatening sanctions for non-compliance with the Digital Services Act's content moderation requirements.

records.title: RIAA Targets AI Voice Cloning Sites for Copyright Infringement
records.description: The Recording Industry Association of America (RIAA) has reported AI voice cloning platforms, notably Voicify.ai, to the U.S. government, citing unauthorized use of artists' voices and sound recordings. These AI systems generate infringing derivative works, violating copyright and publicity rights, and causing ongoing harm to artists and rights holders.

records.title: AI-Generated Celebrity Voice Fakes Spread Misinformation on TikTok
records.description: AI tools have been used to create convincing fake audio of celebrities and politicians, such as Barack Obama, which are widely circulated on TikTok to spread misinformation and conspiracy theories. These AI-generated voice clones have misled millions, prompting the platform to remove some of the deceptive content.

records.title: Sber AI System Deployed to Detect Illegal Landfills in Russia
records.description: Sber AI, in partnership with Russian environmental agencies, has developed an AI-powered platform to analyze satellite images and identify illegal waste dumps. This initiative aims to help ecologists quickly detect and address unauthorized landfills, thereby reducing environmental harm across Russia.

records.title: Predator Spyware Used for Illegal Surveillance of Political Figures and Civil Society Worldwide
records.description: The AI-powered spyware Predator, sold by French company Nexa, was used by various governments, including Vietnam and Madagascar, to illegally surveil journalists, political figures, and civil society members across Europe, the US, and Asia. This led to significant human rights violations and breaches of privacy and democratic rights.

records.title: Taiwanese AI Language Model Generates Politically Sensitive Misinformation, Prompting Emergency Takedown
records.description: Taiwan’s Academia Sinica released a Chinese language AI model that, due to training on Chinese datasets, generated politically sensitive misinformation—such as identifying Taiwan’s nationality and leaders as Chinese. The incident sparked public outcry, leading to the model’s rapid removal and plans for stricter risk management in future AI projects.

records.title: Indonesian Police's Use of Pegasus AI Spyware Sparks Human Rights Concerns
records.description: Indonesia Corruption Watch (ICW) and civil society groups have demanded transparency from Indonesian police regarding their procurement and use of Pegasus, an AI-enabled spyware. Concerns center on its potential and actual use for unlawful surveillance, threatening privacy, human rights, and democracy, as seen in similar cases abroad.

records.title: Vietnamese Agents Use AI-Enabled Predator Spyware to Target Global Officials and Journalists
records.description: Investigations revealed that Vietnamese agents used the AI-powered Predator spyware, purchased from European firms, to attempt large-scale hacking and surveillance of global political leaders, journalists, and activists—including Taiwan’s President Tsai Ing-wen—via social media. The spyware enabled remote access to devices, violating privacy and human rights.

records.title: Israel Secretly Deploys AI Systems for Military Target Selection and Airstrikes
records.description: The Israeli military is using AI systems to select airstrike targets and coordinate attacks, including the 'Fire Factory' system for logistics. These AI tools process vast data to recommend and assign lethal targets, raising concerns over civilian harm, lack of regulation, and accountability in ongoing and past conflicts.

records.title: AI-Enabled Bionic Hand Fused With Nerves and Skeleton Restores Function and Reduces Pain
records.description: A Swedish woman became the first to receive a bionic hand fully integrated with her nerves and skeleton, using AI to interpret neural signals for control and sensation. The AI-enabled prosthesis significantly reduced her phantom limb pain and restored about 80% of her daily hand function, demonstrating major health benefits.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Audio of UK Opposition Leader Circulates, Threatening Election Integrity
records.description: AI-generated deepfake audio and video clips falsely depicting UK Labour leader Keir Starmer verbally abusing staff and criticizing Liverpool circulated widely on social media during the Labour Party conference. The deepfakes misled the public, sparked political disruption, and raised serious concerns about AI's threat to democratic processes and election integrity.

records.title: AI Camera System Prevents Human-Wildlife Conflict in South Asia
records.description: Researchers from Clemson University and NGOs deployed AI-enhanced camera systems ('TrailGuard') in India and Nepal to detect predatory animals near villages. The system alerts park rangers and residents in real time, effectively preventing human-wildlife conflicts and poaching, thereby reducing harm to both people and endangered animals.

records.title: Overreliance on AI Led to Israeli Intelligence Failure Against Hamas
records.description: Former US intelligence officer Scott Ritter argues that Israeli intelligence's overconfidence and public reliance on AI for data analysis allowed Hamas to evade detection and contributed to Israel's failure to predict the 2023 attack. The incident highlights the risks of overreliance on AI in critical security operations.

records.title: Amazon Alexa Spreads 2020 US Election Misinformation
records.description: Amazon's AI assistant Alexa falsely claimed the 2020 US presidential election was stolen due to massive fraud, citing unreliable sources like Rumble and Substack. This spread of misinformation to millions of users undermined trust in democratic processes, highlighting risks of AI-driven disinformation.

records.title: AI-Enabled Drone Strikes Cause Damage in Sochi, Russia
records.description: AI-powered drones attacked Sochi, Russia, twice in two weeks, damaging a helicopter landing site at the airport and causing a major fire at a nearby oil depot. The strikes, confirmed by UK intelligence, highlight the direct impact of AI-enabled warfare on civilian infrastructure and communities far from the front lines.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Doctors Spread Harmful Medical Misinformation on Social Media
records.description: AI-generated bots impersonating doctors have spread false medical advice, such as misleading claims about chia seeds curing diabetes, to millions on social media. These videos, viewed and shared widely, risk public health by exploiting trust in medical professionals and disseminating inaccurate health information.

records.title: AI Genetic Risk Prediction Raises Privacy and Healthcare Access Concerns
records.description: AI algorithms used to predict disease risk from genetic data have led to unauthorized sharing of health information, targeted misinformation, and denial of healthcare benefits. These incidents highlight real harms, including privacy violations and reduced access to care, resulting from the use and misuse of AI in healthcare decision-making.

records.title: Nissan Recalls Nearly 10,000 Ariya EVs Over Inverter Software Defect Causing Sudden Power Loss
records.description: Nissan recalled 9,813 model year 2023 Ariya electric SUVs due to a software defect in the drive motor inverter. The malfunction can cause sudden loss of drive power, increasing crash risk. The issue, linked to the inverter's AI-based control system, requires an in-person software fix to ensure safety.

records.title: Deployment of AI-Enabled Drones in Ukrainian Military Operations
records.description: Ukraine's military received nearly 2,000 Autel EVO MAX 4T drones equipped with artificial intelligence for reconnaissance, target identification, and artillery coordination. The AI systems automatically detect and track targets, contributing to the destruction of 220 Russian military assets in one week, demonstrating direct harm caused by AI-driven military technology.

records.title: AI-Powered 'LoveGPT' Used in Online Dating Scams to Deceive Users
records.description: Cybersecurity firm Avast has uncovered that scammers are using 'LoveGPT,' a tool integrated with ChatGPT, to create fake profiles and generate convincing conversations on dating apps. This AI-driven scam deceives users, making it harder to detect fraud, and leads to emotional and potential financial harm.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Videos of Public Figures Cause Health Risks in Bulgaria
records.description: AI-generated deepfake videos featuring Bulgarian public figures, including doctors and politicians, are spreading on social media, misleading the public and potentially causing health risks, such as patients stopping essential medication. Experts highlight the lack of regulation and authorities’ inaction, while the scams exploit AI technology to create convincing fake content.

records.title: Predator Spyware Scandal Exposes AI-Driven Surveillance in Greece
records.description: International investigations revealed that Greece became a hub for the production, export, and deployment of the AI-enabled Predator spyware by Intellexa, leading to illegal surveillance of journalists and others. The scandal has caused significant political fallout, with accusations of government involvement and serious violations of privacy and human rights.

records.title: X's Algorithm Amplifies Harmful Content After Murder Video
records.description: X's (formerly Twitter) AI-driven algorithm promoted and amplified a video of a local murder, pushing it into users' feeds and financially rewarding the creator. This led to widespread dissemination of violent and inflammatory content, causing emotional and social harm, and highlighting the platform's role in monetizing harmful material.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake of Mara Venier Used in Financial Scam
records.description: An AI-generated deepfake video featuring Italian TV host Mara Venier and Elon Musk was circulated online to promote a fraudulent investment scheme. The video, shared by fake financial consultants, encouraged people to invest money, leading to financial harm and reputational damage. Venier has taken legal action to stop the scam.

records.title: Deepfake Video of Bulgarian Prime Minister Used in Facebook Scam
records.description: AI-generated deepfake videos featuring Bulgarian Prime Minister Nikolay Denkov's face and voice were spread on Facebook to promote a fraudulent investment scheme and collect personal data. The manipulated videos, presented as news broadcasts, prompted government warnings and police involvement due to the risk of privacy violations and cybercrime.

records.title: AI-Generated Child Sexual Abuse Material in Quito School Sparks Criminal Investigation
records.description: Two students at a Quito school used AI to create and distribute around 700 non-consensual sexual videos and images of 20-24 classmates, superimposing their faces onto explicit content. The incident, which constitutes digital sexual violence and child pornography, prompted a criminal investigation by Ecuadorian authorities and public outcry over institutional negligence.

records.title: AI Chatbots Spread Misinformation During European Elections
records.description: Investigations by Algorithmwatch and AI Forensics found that AI chatbots like Bing Chat and ChatGPT provided false, misleading, and biased information about candidates and election details in Switzerland and Germany. These inaccuracies risk undermining democratic processes by spreading misinformation and confusing voters during critical elections.

records.title: AI-Driven Censorship and Disinformation Accelerate Global Internet Freedom Decline
records.description: Multiple reports reveal that governments worldwide are increasingly using AI systems—such as chatbots, automated content removal, and generative AI—to censor information, spread disinformation, and suppress dissent. These AI-driven actions have directly contributed to a 13-year decline in global internet freedom, violating human rights and harming communities.

records.title: Meta's AI Sticker Tool Generates Offensive and Inappropriate Content Across Platforms
records.description: Meta's new AI-powered sticker generation tool for Messenger, WhatsApp, and Instagram has enabled users to create and share offensive, violent, and obscene stickers, including depictions of public figures and copyrighted characters. Inadequate content filtering has led to the rapid spread of inappropriate images, sparking controversy and concerns over moderation and community harm.

records.title: Dukaan CEO Replaces 90% of Customer Support Staff with AI Chatbot, Causing Mass Layoffs
