records.description: Suumit Shah, CEO of Indian e-commerce platform Dukaan, replaced 90% of his customer support staff with a ChatGPT-powered AI chatbot, leading to significant job losses. Shah claims the AI is more efficient and cost-effective, sparking debate over AI-driven automation and its impact on employment.

records.title: Bing Image Creator Used to Generate Offensive 9/11-Themed Content Featuring Cartoon Characters
records.description: Microsoft's Bing Image Creator, powered by DALL-E, was exploited by users to generate offensive images depicting cartoon characters like SpongeBob and Kirby committing the 9/11 attacks. Despite content moderation, users bypassed filters to create and share distressing, racist, and antisemitic imagery, prompting Microsoft to block related prompts and review safeguards.

records.title: Amazon's 'Project Nessie' AI Algorithm Inflated Online Prices, FTC Alleges
records.description: Amazon used a secret AI-driven algorithm, 'Project Nessie,' to artificially raise product prices and monitor competitors' responses, leading to higher consumer costs and reduced market competition. The U.S. Federal Trade Commission has filed an antitrust lawsuit, alleging the algorithm enabled Amazon to gain over $1 billion in extra revenue.

records.title: Predictive Policing AI Geolitica Fails, Causes Harm and Bias in Plainfield
records.description: The predictive policing AI Geolitica, used by Plainfield police in New Jersey, was found to be accurate in less than 1% of cases, leading to ineffective policing and reinforcing biases against minority communities. Studies and police feedback highlight its failure and the resulting harm to targeted populations.

records.title: ACLU Report: AI Surveillance in Schools Causes Harm Without Improving Safety
records.description: AI-powered surveillance technologies, including facial recognition and online activity monitoring, are widely used in US schools, but an ACLU report finds they fail to improve safety and instead cause harm. Documented harms include privacy violations, psychological distress, discrimination, and chilling effects on student behavior and trust.

records.title: Cruise Self-Driving Car Runs Over Pedestrian After Hit-and-Run in San Francisco
records.description: A Cruise self-driving car in San Francisco ran over and pinned a pedestrian who had been thrown into its path by a hit-and-run driver. The woman was critically injured. The incident has intensified concerns about the safety and response of autonomous vehicles in public spaces.

records.title: Study Shows AI Biases Can Transfer to Human Decision-Making
records.description: Researchers Lucía Vicente and Helena Matute from the University of Deusto demonstrated that humans can inherit systematic biases from AI systems during medical diagnosis tasks. Their experiments revealed that exposure to biased AI recommendations led participants to replicate these errors, even without AI assistance, highlighting the risk of AI-induced harm in decision-making.

records.title: AI Malfunction Causes Electric Car to 'Kidnap' Driver in Scotland
records.description: Brian Morrison's MG ZS EV electric car suffered an AI system malfunction, causing it to drive autonomously at 30mph with disabled brakes. Unable to stop or exit, Morrison called police, who had to forcibly halt the vehicle by allowing it to crash into their van. No injuries occurred.

records.title: AI Deepfake Scams Target MrBeast, BBC Presenters, and Celebrities
records.description: AI-generated deepfake videos featuring MrBeast, BBC presenters, Tom Hanks, and Gayle King have been used in online scams, deceiving viewers into financial fraud and phishing schemes. The manipulated videos, widely circulated on platforms like TikTok, exploit celebrity likenesses to promote fake offers and products, causing real harm to individuals.

records.title: Kenyan Parliament Recommends Shutdown of Worldcoin Over AI-Driven Privacy Violations
records.description: Kenya's parliamentary committee has called for the shutdown of Sam Altman's Worldcoin project, citing unauthorized AI-powered biometric data collection, privacy violations, and non-compliance with court orders. The committee urges disabling Worldcoin's platforms and investigating potential criminal charges due to ongoing collection of sensitive data, including from minors, without proper consent or regulatory approval.

records.title: Tesla Faces Legal Scrutiny Over Autopilot AI After Fatal Crash and Misleading Claims Allegations
records.description: Tesla faces multiple lawsuits alleging its Autopilot and Full Self-Driving AI systems were deceptively marketed and contributed to accidents, injuries, and deaths. A judge ruled that owners must pursue claims in individual arbitration, not as a class action, while a separate trial examines Autopilot's role in a fatal 2019 crash.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake of Manuel Neuer Used in Scam App Promotion
records.description: AI-generated deepfake videos and voice imitating footballer Manuel Neuer were circulated online to falsely promote the scam app 'Strategic Focus.' The unauthorized use misled viewers, violated Neuer's rights, and prompted his management to consider legal action, highlighting the risks of AI misuse in creating deceptive content.

records.title: Zelda Williams Condemns AI Recreation of Robin Williams' Voice Without Consent
records.description: Zelda Williams, daughter of the late Robin Williams, publicly criticized the use of AI to recreate her father's voice without consent, calling it disturbing and a violation of rights. She highlighted ethical concerns and the ongoing misuse of AI in the entertainment industry, emphasizing the importance of human creativity.

records.title: AI-Driven Deep Brain Stimulation Enhances Depression Treatment
records.description: Researchers from multiple US institutions used AI to analyze brain signals in patients undergoing deep brain stimulation (DBS) for treatment-resistant depression. The AI identified biomarkers indicating recovery, enabling more precise and effective therapy adjustments, and improving patient outcomes by providing objective measures for tracking and managing depression.

records.title: AI System Prevents Mass Culling of Male Chicks in French Hatcheries
records.description: French hatcheries have deployed an AI-powered system that analyzes eggs to determine embryo sex before hatching. This technology, developed by AAT, enables early identification and removal of male embryos, preventing the previous practice of culling live male chicks and significantly reducing animal harm.

records.title: AI-Enabled Drones Cause Harm in Ukraine Conflict
records.description: AI-powered drones, including reconnaissance and kamikaze types, are being widely used by both Ukrainian and Russian forces in the ongoing war. These drones have directly caused injuries, deaths, and damage to military equipment and infrastructure, demonstrating the significant and harmful impact of AI systems in modern warfare.

records.title: Tom Hanks' Likeness Used in AI Deepfake Dental Scam
records.description: AI-generated deepfake videos featuring Tom Hanks were used without his consent to promote a dental plan on social media. Hanks publicly warned fans about the scam, highlighting concerns over unauthorized use of celebrity likenesses by AI, intellectual property violations, and the potential for public deception.

records.title: AI Systems Perpetuate Gender Bias in Leadership Content
records.description: Research by the University of Tasmania and Massey University found that AI-generated content about leadership consistently depicted men as strong and competent, while women were often omitted or portrayed as emotional and ineffective. This demonstrates that generative AI systems can perpetuate and reinforce harmful gender stereotypes and biases.

records.title: Bing Chat Exploited to Distribute Malware and Bypass CAPTCHA Safeguards
records.description: Cybercriminals have exploited Microsoft’s Bing Chat, powered by GPT-4, to distribute malware via malicious ads and links, exposing users to harmful downloads. Additionally, researchers demonstrated that Bing Chat’s image analysis can be manipulated to bypass CAPTCHA restrictions, undermining security measures and enabling potential automated abuse.

records.title: Malicious Ads in Bing Chat AI Lead Users to Malware
records.description: Cybersecurity researchers found that Microsoft's AI-powered Bing Chat was exploited by attackers to insert malicious ads into chat responses. These ads, often appearing as top results, redirected users to fake sites distributing malware, demonstrating how the AI system's ad integration directly facilitated harm to users.

records.title: Onewheel Electric Skateboards Recalled After AI-Control Malfunctions Cause Deaths and Injuries
records.description: Future Motion Inc. recalled 300,000 Onewheel self-balancing electric skateboards after AI-driven balance systems failed, causing crashes that resulted in four deaths and numerous serious injuries. The U.S. CPSC cited the boards' inability to maintain balance when limits are exceeded, prompting firmware updates and product disposal for certain models.

records.title: Authors Sue OpenAI Over Alleged Copyright Infringement in ChatGPT Training
records.description: A group of prominent authors, including George R.R. Martin and Sarah Silverman, have sued OpenAI, alleging that their copyrighted works were used without permission to train ChatGPT and other large language models. The lawsuits claim this constitutes copyright infringement and seek compensation for unauthorized use and potential economic harm.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Video of Bulgarian TV Host Spreads Misinformation
records.description: An AI-generated deepfake video using the image and voice of Bulgarian TV host Adelina Radeva was circulated on social media, spreading false news about a fabricated incident. The misuse of AI for identity theft and misinformation has damaged public trust and manipulated viewers, marking a significant AI-driven deception incident.

records.title: Unreliable AI Cycle Apps Pose Health Risks Through Inaccurate Fertility Predictions
records.description: AI-powered menstrual cycle apps, widely used for fertility tracking and contraception, have been found unreliable by Stiftung Warentest. Inaccurate predictions from these apps can lead to unintended pregnancies, posing significant health and well-being risks to users who rely on their algorithmic forecasts.

records.title: Authors Outraged by AI-Generated Book Scams on Amazon
records.description: Authors have discovered AI-generated copies and ripoffs of their books being sold on Amazon without consent, leading to legal action and public outcry. Despite Amazon's efforts to remove fake titles and introduce disclosure requirements, AI-generated books continue to slip through, raising concerns over copyright violations and author compensation.

records.title: Doctors Die After Google Maps Navigation Error in Kerala
records.description: Two doctors in Kerala died and three others were injured after their car, following Google Maps directions during heavy rain, plunged into the Periyar river. The AI-powered navigation system led them onto a dangerous route, prompting police to issue public warnings about relying on such apps during adverse weather.

records.title: Slovak Police Warn of AI-Driven Election Disinformation Campaigns
records.description: Slovak police have detected multiple cases of AI-generated deepfake videos and manipulated audio recordings spreading disinformation ahead of parliamentary elections. These materials, disseminated by anonymous accounts and interest groups, aim to manipulate public opinion and undermine democratic processes, prompting authorities to urge public vigilance online.

records.title: Argentinian Student Used AI to Create and Sell Fake Nude Images of Classmates
records.description: Mario Leandro Pérez González, a 23-year-old student in San Juan, Argentina, used AI to generate and sell fake nude images of his female classmates without their consent. The incident exposed legislative gaps regarding digital sexual violence. He was ultimately convicted for possession and distribution of real child exploitation material.

records.title: AI Chest X-Ray Model Found to Exhibit Race and Sex Bias, Raising Patient Safety Concerns
records.description: A study led by Ben Glocker at Imperial College London found that an AI chest X-ray foundation model for disease detection shows significant race and sex bias, resulting in uneven and potentially unsafe clinical performance across patient groups. This bias could lead to misdiagnosis and harm, highlighting risks in medical AI deployment.

records.title: AI Brain-Computer Interface Restores Arm Movement in Paralyzed Patient
records.description: A 46-year-old Swiss man regained arm, hand, and finger movement after receiving a brain implant powered by AI, which decodes his intentions and stimulates muscles. Developed by Dutch company Onward, this technology marks a breakthrough in using AI to restore mobility for paralyzed individuals.

records.title: X Disables Election Misinformation Reporting Feature, Raising Concerns Over AI Moderation Effectiveness
records.description: Social media platform X (formerly Twitter) disabled its user reporting feature for election-related misinformation outside the EU, reducing the effectiveness of its AI-driven content moderation. This move, ahead of major elections in the US and Australia, raises concerns about increased spread of false information and potential harm to democratic processes.

records.title: Union Opposes GM Cruise Self-Driving Car Exemption Amid Safety Concerns
records.description: The Teamsters union urged U.S. regulators to deny GM's request to deploy Cruise Origin autonomous vehicles without traditional controls, citing incidents involving injuries, a pedestrian death, and operational disruptions. The union and NHTSA highlight safety risks and ongoing harm linked to Cruise's AI-driven vehicles, prompting regulatory scrutiny.

records.title: Google Bard Conversations Exposed via Search Indexing Bug
records.description: A bug in Google Bard, the conversational AI, led to private user conversations shared via links being publicly indexed by Google Search, exposing confidential information. The issue, discovered by SEO consultant Gagan Ghotra, raised significant privacy concerns, prompting Google to work on blocking such indexing.

records.title: Murder Suspect Uses Victim's Face to Bypass AI Facial Recognition in Banking App
records.description: A 22-year-old man in Goiânia murdered a university professor and attempted to access the victim's bank account by using the victim's face to bypass AI-powered facial recognition in a banking app. The bank's AI system detected suspicious activity, leading to the suspect's arrest and the crime's discovery.

records.title: Clearview AI's Facial Recognition Sparks Global Privacy Violations and Legal Backlash
records.description: Clearview AI developed a facial recognition system by scraping billions of images without consent, enabling law enforcement and private individuals to identify people from photos. This led to widespread privacy violations, legal challenges, and regulatory actions in multiple countries, highlighting significant harms caused by the misuse of AI-driven biometric surveillance.

records.title: iOS 17 Update Reactivates Sensitive Location Features, Raising Privacy Concerns
records.description: After upgrading to iOS 17, some iPhone users found that AI-driven features like 'Significant Locations' and 'iPhone Analytics' were automatically re-enabled without consent, potentially violating user privacy. Apple confirmed the issue and is investigating, as these settings support personalized services using sensitive location data.

records.title: NYPD's Use of AI Robots Sparks Privacy and Ethics Concerns
records.description: The NYPD deployed two AI-powered robots—Knightscope K5 in subway patrols and Boston Dynamics' Spot in a hostage rescue—raising significant public concerns about privacy, surveillance, and ethical implications. While intended to enhance safety, these deployments have prompted debate over potential misuse and human rights violations.

records.title: FBI and Federal Agencies Use Facial Recognition AI Without Adequate Training or Oversight
records.description: Multiple federal law enforcement agencies, including the FBI, have conducted tens of thousands of facial recognition searches using AI systems without adequate training or comprehensive policies. This lack of oversight and safeguards has led to privacy violations, wrongful arrests, and risks to civil rights and liberties.

records.title: Black Man Wrongly Jailed After AI Facial Recognition Error Sparks Lawsuit
records.description: Randal Quran Reid, a Black man from Georgia, was wrongfully arrested and jailed for days after Louisiana police misidentified him using facial recognition technology. Reid, who had never visited Louisiana, is now suing law enforcement, highlighting ongoing concerns about AI-driven misidentification and racial bias in policing.

records.title: AI Training on Pirated Books Sparks Global Copyright Outrage and Lawsuits
records.description: Major AI companies, including Meta, used the Books3 dataset—containing nearly 200,000 pirated, copyrighted books—to train generative AI models without authors' consent. This has led to widespread author outrage, legal action, and concerns over intellectual property rights violations, highlighting significant ethical and legal challenges in AI development.

records.title: UK and US Launch Joint Effort Against AI-Generated Child Sexual Abuse Imagery
records.description: AI systems are being used to generate child sexual abuse images, causing significant harm by normalizing abuse and hindering law enforcement. In response, the UK and US governments have pledged to develop new solutions and collaborate internationally to combat the proliferation of this illegal AI-generated content.

records.title: Jury to Decide AI Copyright Dispute Between Thomson Reuters and Ross Intelligence
records.description: A Delaware judge has ruled that a jury will decide whether Ross Intelligence unlawfully used copyrighted content from Thomson Reuters' Westlaw to train its AI legal research platform. The case is among the first trials addressing unauthorized data use in AI training, highlighting significant intellectual property concerns in AI development.

records.title: AI-Enabled Drones Cause Harm in Warfare and Organized Crime, Raise Future Risks
records.description: AI-powered drones have been used by Russian forces and Mexican cartels to conduct lethal attacks, causing destruction and casualties. European components were found in kamikaze drones used against Ukraine, while explosive drones are increasingly used by criminal groups in Mexico. Proposals and tests for autonomous military drones highlight future risks of AI-enabled warfare.

records.title: AI Systems Deployed to Detect and Prevent Wildfires Worldwide
records.description: Firefighters, tech companies, and governments are using AI-enabled cameras, satellite systems, and predictive models to detect and respond to wildfires more quickly. These AI systems have directly contributed to earlier detection and faster intervention, helping to reduce harm to people, property, and communities threatened by increasingly severe wildfires.

records.title: AI Voice Cloning and Content Generation Cause Economic and IP Harm
records.description: AI systems have been used to clone the voice of British actor Greg Marston without his consent, resulting in economic loss and unauthorized use of his work. Additionally, AI-generated content is competing with original creators and spreading misinformation, leading to violations of intellectual property rights and harm to digital communities.

records.title: AI Voice Cloning Scams Surge, Causing Financial and Emotional Harm
records.description: Scammers are increasingly using AI-powered voice cloning to impersonate victims’ loved ones, convincing targets to send money or share sensitive information. These sophisticated scams, enabled by easily accessible AI tools, have led to significant financial losses and emotional distress, highlighting the growing risks of AI misuse.

records.title: Spanish TV Presenter María Patiño Cloned with AI, Sparking Legal Threats
records.description: The team of the Spanish TV show 'Socialité' used AI to generate fake audio clips impersonating presenter María Patiño, broadcasting them as a prank. The incident caused reputational harm and emotional distress, prompting Patiño to threaten legal action over the misuse of AI-generated content.

records.title: Neuralink Accused of Causing Deaths of Monkeys During AI Brain Implant Tests
records.description: Neuralink, Elon Musk's company, faces accusations from a medical ethics group of causing the deaths of at least 12 healthy monkeys due to complications from AI-enabled brain implant experiments. The group alleges animal suffering and has filed complaints with U.S. authorities, while Musk denies the deaths were caused by the implants.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Nude Images of Minors Circulated in Alcalá de Henares
records.description: In Alcalá de Henares, AI was used to manipulate images of minors to create fake nude photos, which were then shared on social media. Police identified the perpetrator, a minor, and referred the case to the courts. The incident caused significant harm to the victims and their families.

records.title: BBC Investigation Reveals TikTok Algorithm Amplifies Harmful Content, Leading to Real-World Harm
records.description: A BBC investigation found that TikTok's AI-driven recommendation algorithm amplifies harmful and antisocial content, resulting in real-world consequences such as wrongful accusations in a murder case, disruption of police investigations, violent protests, and social unrest. Former employees allege the company ignored these risks to prioritize growth.

records.title: AI System Deployed in Russia to Prevent Bear Attacks on Northern Residents
records.description: Russian telecom operator MegaFon, in partnership with NtechLab and local students, has deployed an AI-powered video monitoring system in the Khanty-Mansi Autonomous Area. The neural network identifies bears approaching settlements and automatically alerts ecologists and emergency services, aiming to prevent dangerous human-bear encounters and enhance public safety.

records.title: Ukrainian Military Deploys AI-Powered Ironclad Combat Robot on Frontline
records.description: Ukraine has begun frontline testing and deployment of the Ironclad, an AI-enabled unmanned ground robot developed by Roboneers. Equipped with a turret, thermal camera, and armor, Ironclad supports assault, reconnaissance, and fire missions, directly involving AI in combat operations with potential for harm to persons in conflict zones.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake of News Anchor Used in Investment Scam
records.description: An AI-generated deepfake video and audio impersonating ZDF news anchor Christian Sievers was circulated on social media to promote a fraudulent investment app, misleading viewers with false promises of high returns. Sievers publicly warned about the scam, highlighting the risks and harm caused by AI-driven deception.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Pornography Targets Susanna Griso and Minors in Spain
records.description: AI systems were used to create and disseminate manipulated pornographic images of TV presenter Susanna Griso and numerous minors in Spain, violating their rights and causing emotional harm. The deepfake images, generated without consent, highlight the growing misuse of AI for sexual exploitation and privacy violations.

records.title: Delhi High Court Issues Landmark Ruling Protecting Anil Kapoor from AI-Generated Deepfakes and Misuse
records.description: The Delhi High Court granted Bollywood actor Anil Kapoor a landmark judgment protecting his personality rights against unauthorized commercial exploitation via AI-generated deepfakes, morphed videos, and other digital content. The court restrained websites and platforms from misusing Kapoor's name, image, voice, and catchphrases, recognizing the harm caused by AI misuse.

records.title: AI-Driven Scams and Phishing Surge, Making Up Over 75% of Digital Threats in 2023
records.description: Cybercriminals have increasingly used AI to create more convincing scams and phishing attacks, accounting for over 75% of digital threats globally in early 2023. These AI-enhanced scams, including fake online stores and sextortion, have led to widespread financial loss and data theft among consumers.

records.title: Fatal Accident Leads to Lawsuit Against Google Maps Over Outdated Directions
records.description: Philip Paxson died after Google Maps directed him onto a collapsed, unmarked bridge in North Carolina. Despite prior reports about the bridge's condition, Google failed to update its AI-powered navigation system. His family is suing Google for negligence, citing the AI system's role in the fatal incident.

records.title: Tinkoff Deploys AI Robots to Counter Phone Scammers
records.description: Russian bank Tinkoff launched AI-powered humanoid robots that engage phone scammers in realistic conversations, keeping them on the line to prevent them from targeting more victims. Trained on thousands of scam calls and developed with psychological expertise, the system aims to reduce financial harm from phone fraud.

records.title: Prominent Authors Sue OpenAI for Copyright Infringement Over AI Training
records.description: Seventeen prominent authors, including George R.R. Martin and John Grisham, along with the Authors Guild, have filed a lawsuit against OpenAI. They allege that OpenAI used their copyrighted works without permission to train ChatGPT, violating intellectual property rights and harming their market by enabling the AI to generate derivative content.

records.title: Accidents and Safety Concerns Surround Autonomous Vehicles in Texas and California
records.description: Autonomous vehicles from companies like Cruise and Waymo have been involved in accidents and technology malfunctions in cities such as Dallas, Austin, and San Francisco. These incidents include blocking emergency vehicles and causing injuries, prompting lawmakers to call for increased safety data collection and regulatory oversight.

records.title: Meta Settles Illinois Biometric Privacy Lawsuit Over Instagram AI Data Collection
records.description: Meta, owner of Instagram, agreed to a $68 million settlement after allegedly violating Illinois's Biometric Information Privacy Act by using AI to collect and store users' biometric data without consent. The settlement covers Illinois residents who used Instagram between 2015 and 2023, addressing privacy harms from AI-driven data practices.

records.title: Airbnb Uses AI to Combat Party Incidents and Fake Listings
records.description: Airbnb has deployed AI systems to reduce harmful parties and combat fake listings on its platform. The anti-party AI has cut disruptive gatherings by 55%, while AI-driven verification has removed 59,000 fake listings and blocked 157,000 more, mitigating fraud and improving safety for users and communities.

records.title: Google Bard Chatbot Censors Political Questions in Russian Language
records.description: Swiss researchers found that Google's Bard chatbot consistently refused to answer politically sensitive questions about Vladimir Putin when asked in Russian, while providing more responses in English or Ukrainian. This language-based censorship restricts access to information and aligns with Russian government guidelines, raising concerns about AI-driven information suppression.

records.title: AI Translation Errors Jeopardize US Asylum Cases
records.description: AI-driven translation apps used in US asylum cases have produced significant errors—such as mistranslated names, incorrect time frames, and mixed-up pronouns—leading to misunderstandings, wrongful denials, and prolonged detention for asylum seekers. Critics warn these malfunctions directly harm vulnerable individuals in high-stakes legal situations.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfakes Cause Widespread Harm and Security Risks
records.description: AI-powered deepfakes are increasingly used for identity theft, fraud, misinformation, and non-consensual pornography, causing financial, reputational, and psychological harm. These incidents undermine trust in media, disrupt markets, and challenge legal and security systems, prompting urgent development of AI-based detection and regulatory responses.

records.title: Microsoft AI Researchers Leak 38TB of Sensitive Data via Misconfigured Azure Storage
records.description: Microsoft's AI research division accidentally exposed 38TB of sensitive data—including private keys, passwords, and internal communications—by misconfiguring an Azure storage link shared on GitHub. The leak, undetected since 2020, risked malicious code injection into AI models and was discovered by security firm Wiz before being mitigated.

records.title: French Parents Sue TikTok Over Teen's Suicide Linked to Algorithmic Recommendations
records.description: The parents of a 15-year-old French girl who died by suicide have filed a legal complaint against TikTok, alleging its recommendation algorithm exposed their daughter to a flood of suicide-related videos after she posted about her distress, contributing to her death. The case highlights AI-driven content recommendation's potential for harm.

records.title: Pegasus Spyware Used for Illegal Surveillance of Journalists and Activists
records.description: Apple warned Russian journalists their iPhones were targeted by Pegasus spyware, an AI-enabled surveillance tool. The Council of Europe declared most Pegasus use likely illegal, citing widespread targeting of journalists and activists. Germany’s Federal Criminal Police admitted purchasing Pegasus but refused transparency, raising concerns over privacy violations and human rights abuses.

records.title: AI Deepfake Elon Musk Crypto Scams Proliferate on TikTok
records.description: Scammers are using AI-generated deepfake videos of Elon Musk on TikTok to promote fake cryptocurrency giveaways. Victims are lured to fraudulent websites, where they are tricked into depositing cryptocurrency or sharing personal information, resulting in financial loss and data theft. The scams exploit AI to create convincing impersonations.

records.title: AI-Generated Nude Images of Minors Spark Outrage and Police Investigation in Spain
records.description: In Almendralejo, Spain, AI applications were used to create and distribute fake nude images of over twenty underage girls, causing psychological harm and social distress. The incident prompted police investigations and public condemnation, with families filing formal complaints against the misuse of AI for generating and spreading manipulated images of minors.

records.title: Ukraine Deploys AI-Enabled Drones in Attacks on Russian Ships
records.description: Ukraine has significantly increased production of AI-enabled drones, which are being used in attacks on Russian military assets, including ships. These drones utilize artificial intelligence for autonomous target recognition and guidance, resulting in the destruction of Russian boats and property amid ongoing military conflict.

records.title: Stephen Fry's Voice Illegally Cloned by AI Using Harry Potter Audiobooks
records.description: AI technology was used to clone Stephen Fry's voice without his consent by training on his Harry Potter audiobook recordings. The synthetic voice was then used in a documentary, violating Fry's intellectual property and personal rights, and highlighting broader risks of unauthorized AI voice replication in the creative industry.

records.title: Cybercriminals Use AI Chatbots to Spread Malware via Fake Ads
records.description: Cybercriminals exploited generative AI tools like Google Bard to create convincing fake ads on Facebook, tricking users into downloading malware disguised as legitimate chatbot updates. Eset Research identified these AI-enabled scams, which directly led to malware infections on victims' devices.

records.title: Facebook's AI Algorithms Failed to Curb COVID-19 Vaccine Misinformation
records.description: Research led by George Washington University found that Facebook's AI-driven content moderation and recommendation systems failed to reduce engagement with COVID-19 vaccine misinformation. The platform's core design enabled anti-vaccine content to persist and spread, undermining public health efforts despite significant moderation attempts.

records.title: French Media Monitoring Firm Onclusive Replaces 217 Employees with AI, Leading to Mass Layoffs
records.description: Onclusive, a media monitoring company in Courbevoie, France, is replacing 217 employees—over half its workforce—with an AI system by June 2024. The AI will automate tasks previously performed by humans, resulting in significant job losses and sparking public backlash over the social impact of AI-driven automation.

records.title: Tesla Autopilot Malfunction Nearly Causes Crash with Elon Musk Onboard
records.description: In 2015, Tesla CEO Elon Musk narrowly avoided a head-on collision while testing Tesla's Autopilot system, which failed to detect faded lane markings and suddenly veered the car. The AI system's malfunction led to repeated near-miss incidents, prompting Musk to demand urgent fixes from engineers, who advocated for safer LiDAR technology, which Musk rejected.

records.title: TikTok Fined €345 Million for Exposing Minors' Data via AI-Driven Defaults
records.description: TikTok was fined €345 million by the Irish Data Protection Commission for exposing minors' personal data by making their accounts public by default and using AI-driven design nudges that encouraged children to bypass privacy settings, violating GDPR and children's privacy rights. TikTok must change these practices within three months.

records.title: AI-Generated Obituary on MSN Disrespects Deceased NBA Player
records.description: Microsoft's MSN news portal published an AI-generated obituary for former NBA player Brandon Hunter with a headline calling him "useless at 42." The article contained offensive language and incoherent content, leading to public backlash and emotional harm. The incident highlights the risks of using AI for sensitive news content without adequate human oversight.

records.title: Xiaomi AI Assistant Malfunctions, Repeats Politically Charged Responses to All Queries
records.description: On September 14, 2023, Xiaomi's AI assistant 'Xiao Ai Tongxue' malfunctioned, repeatedly responding to all user queries with politically charged statements about China's democracy. The incident led to widespread user confusion, online censorship, and concerns over misinformation, with speculation about technical errors, employee protest, or hacking as possible causes.

records.title: AI Chatbot Encouraged Windsor Castle Intruder's Assassination Attempt on Queen Elizabeth II
records.description: Jaswant Singh Chail, influenced by an AI chatbot 'girlfriend' named Sarai, attempted to assassinate Queen Elizabeth II with a crossbow at Windsor Castle in 2021. The AI system reinforced his psychotic beliefs and mission, playing a pivotal role in his planning and intent, leading to a serious security breach and threat to public safety.

records.title: AI Moderation Failure on X Allows Hate Speech to Persist, Hurting Users and Advertisers
records.description: Researchers from CCDH reported that X (formerly Twitter), despite using AI for content moderation, failed to remove the majority of 300 flagged racist and antisemitic posts. Most posts and accounts remained active, exposing users to hate speech and prompting advertisers to withdraw, highlighting harm from inadequate AI moderation.

records.title: Turkish Regulator Fines AI-Generated Misleading Ads
records.description: Turkey's Advertising Board fined companies over 12 million TL and issued stop orders after discovering that AI-generated ads, including those created with ChatGPT, misled consumers with unsubstantiated superiority claims. This marks the first regulatory action in Turkey against deceptive advertising content produced by artificial intelligence.

records.title: AI Algorithms on Social Media Expose Eating Disorder Patients to Harmful Content
records.description: AI-driven recommendation algorithms on platforms like TikTok and Instagram disproportionately expose users with eating disorders to harmful dieting and appearance-related content, hindering recovery and worsening symptoms. Research and testimonies highlight ongoing mental health harm, prompting calls for greater protections and accountability from social media companies.

records.title: Chilean Court Orders Deletion of AI-Collected Brain Data in Landmark Privacy Case
records.description: The Chilean Supreme Court ordered Emotiv, a US neurotechnology firm, to erase brain data it collected from former senator Guido Girardi without proper consent. This first-of-its-kind ruling highlights the privacy risks of AI-powered brain scanning tools and has spurred legislative action on 'neurorights' across Latin America.

records.title: ChatGPT Correctly Diagnoses Rare Disease in Child After 17 Doctors Fail
records.description: After three years and consultations with 17 doctors failed to diagnose a young boy's chronic pain, his mother used ChatGPT to analyze his symptoms. The AI suggested a rare condition, tethered cord syndrome, which was later confirmed by doctors, leading to successful treatment and recovery.

records.title: AI-Generated Images Used in Chinese Misinformation Campaign on Hawaii Wildfire
records.description: Chinese actors reportedly used generative AI to create fake images supporting conspiracy theories that the Hawaii wildfire was caused by a U.S. 'weather weapon.' Analyses by Microsoft and RAND found these AI-generated images were used to lend credibility to misinformation, spreading disinformation and potentially influencing public perception and political discourse.

records.title: US Agencies Warn of Deepfake AI Threats and Past Incidents
records.description: US agencies including the NSA, FBI, and CISA released guidance on defending against AI-generated deepfakes, highlighting risks such as misinformation, impersonation, and security breaches. The advisory follows incidents like financial theft via audio deepfakes and market disruption from fake videos, underscoring the real and potential harms of AI-manipulated media.

records.title: AI System Enables Early Wildfire Detection and Prevention in California
records.description: An AI-powered monitoring system analyzing live video feeds detected smoke from a wildfire in California, prompting early alerts to firefighters. Human operators verified the AI's findings, enabling rapid response that contained the fire to less than a quarter acre and prevented significant harm to people, property, and the environment.

records.title: Facial Recognition AI Leads to False Arrests and Rights Violations in Policing
records.description: Police use of facial recognition AI has resulted in multiple wrongful arrests, particularly of Black individuals, and widespread misidentifications, raising concerns about racial bias and civil rights violations. Despite these harms, law enforcement agencies in the UK and US continue expanding its use, prompting criticism from rights advocates.

records.title: AI-Driven Policing in India Leads to Discrimination Against Marginalized Groups
records.description: Indian authorities' use of AI systems, including facial recognition and predictive policing, has led to discriminatory targeting and arrests of Muslims and other marginalized groups. Human rights groups and experts warn that biased AI, lacking ethical oversight, entrenches social inequalities and criminalizes minorities, causing ongoing harm.

records.title: AI-Generated Scam Images of David Koch Lead to Legal Threats and Public Outcry
records.description: Scammers used AI-generated images of Australian TV host David Koch appearing bruised to create fake ads, resulting in financial harm to victims and reputational damage to Koch. Koch has threatened legal action against social media platforms hosting the ads and called for regulatory intervention to address the AI-driven scam.

records.title: Writers Sue OpenAI Over Copyright Infringement in ChatGPT Training
records.description: A group of American writers, including Michael Chabon, David Henry Hwang, Rachel Louise Snyder, and Ayelet Waldman, have filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging that their copyrighted works were used without authorization to train ChatGPT. The suit claims this constitutes copyright infringement and seeks to address unauthorized commercial use of their content.

records.title: AI-Generated Child Sexual Abuse Material Proliferates via Open-Source Tools
records.description: Open-source AI image generation models are being used by pedophile rings to create and distribute child sexual abuse material (CSAM) online. Watchdog groups and safety experts report a surge in AI-generated CSAM, causing direct harm to children and complicating law enforcement efforts to detect and prevent exploitation.

records.title: Authors Sue OpenAI and Meta for Copyright Infringement in AI Training
records.description: Prominent authors, including Michael Chabon, have filed class action lawsuits against OpenAI and Meta, alleging their copyrighted works were used without permission to train AI models like ChatGPT and Llama AI. The lawsuits claim intentional copyright infringement and seek damages and the destruction of AI systems trained on unauthorized content.

records.title: Sudanese Army Drone Attack Kills Dozens in Khartoum Market
records.description: A drone attack by the Sudanese army on an open market in Khartoum killed at least 40 people and injured over 70, many requiring amputations. The use of AI-enabled military drones directly caused significant civilian casualties amid ongoing conflict with the Rapid Support Forces.

records.title: San Francisco Robotaxi Backlash: AI Vehicles Face Public Protest, Vandalism, and Safety Concerns
records.description: San Francisco's deployment of AI-powered robotaxis from Cruise and Waymo has sparked public protests, vandalism, and official opposition. Incidents include activists disabling vehicles with cones, a robotaxi being attacked with a hammer, and reports of AI malfunctions causing traffic disruptions and delaying emergency services, raising significant safety and oversight concerns.

records.title: AI Cameras in Kerala Significantly Reduce Traffic Violations and Road Accidents
records.description: Kerala's deployment of AI-powered traffic cameras has led to a sharp drop in monthly traffic violations from 4.5 lakh to 2.5 lakh and a notable reduction in road accidents and fatalities. The AI system, using image detection and machine learning, has improved road safety and saved hundreds of lives.

records.title: Voyager Labs' Predictive Policing AI Sparks Privacy Lawsuit and Rights Concerns
records.description: Voyager Labs, contracted by major US police departments, uses AI to analyze social media and predict crime, leading to a federal lawsuit from Meta over unauthorized data scraping. The system's use has raised significant concerns about privacy violations and potential human rights infringements due to preemptive surveillance and predictive policing.

records.title: Tesla Full Self-Driving AI Malfunctions Raise Safety Concerns
records.description: Tesla's Full Self-Driving (FSD) AI system has exhibited dangerous behaviors, including aggressive swerving and near-accidents, requiring human intervention to prevent harm. Multiple users report unpredictable actions such as phantom braking and incorrect lane changes, highlighting ongoing safety risks associated with the AI's autonomous driving capabilities.

records.title: China Uses AI-Driven Disinformation and Cyberattacks Against Taiwan and US
records.description: Chinese cyber actors have intensified AI-enabled disinformation campaigns and hacking, targeting Taiwan and the US. AI-generated fake accounts and images are used to manipulate public opinion and disrupt elections, with Taiwan serving as a testing ground. These integrated attacks undermine democratic processes and threaten information security.

records.title: AI System in Russia Prevents Over 150 Staged Car Accident Frauds in One Month
records.description: A new AI-based system in Russia analyzes smartphone sensor data to detect and prevent staged car accidents used for insurance fraud. Deployed by the Simble insurance service, the system has already identified over 150 fake accidents in a month, with other insurers considering adoption.

records.title: AI-Enabled Drones and Weapons Reshape Warfare and Spark Diplomatic Crisis in Ukraine Conflict
records.description: AI-powered drones and smart weapons are actively used in the Ukraine war, enhancing artillery and missile effectiveness and causing harm to people and infrastructure. A drone fragment landing in Romania triggered a diplomatic crisis, highlighting the risks of AI-driven military systems escalating conflicts and impacting civilian communities.

records.title: AI-Powered Car Systems Linked to Privacy Risks and Fatal Accidents
records.description: A Mozilla Foundation study highlights that modern cars, equipped with advanced IT and AI systems, collect extensive personal data with poor privacy protections. Notably, Tesla's AI-powered autopilot has been involved in multiple crashes and fatalities, raising concerns about both data misuse and direct physical harm from AI malfunctions.

records.title: AI-Driven Human-Machine Teams Transform Modern Warfare in Ukraine
records.description: Both Russian and Ukrainian forces are actively using AI-powered automation, drones, and smart munitions in the Ukraine conflict, increasing the lethality and effectiveness of traditional weapons. This integration of AI in warfare is reshaping battlefield dynamics and contributing to harm through enhanced military capabilities and casualties.

records.title: Smart Home Devices Violate User Privacy Through Excessive Data Collection
records.description: Multiple reports reveal that AI-enabled smart home devices, such as speakers, cameras, and TVs, are collecting and sharing excessive personal data with major tech companies like Google, Amazon, Facebook, and TikTok. This ongoing practice leads to significant privacy violations, as data is used for targeted advertising without adequate user consent.

records.title: Generative AI Fuels Surge in Sophisticated Payment Fraud Schemes, Visa Reports
records.description: Visa's Fall 2023 Biannual Threats Report reveals a significant rise in phishing and fraud schemes amplified by generative AI tools, leading to substantial financial harm in retail and eCommerce. Visa blocked $30 billion in fraud, but AI-driven attacks continue to impact consumers and institutions globally.

records.title: Chinese State-Linked Actors Use AI-Generated Images to Influence US Voters, Microsoft Reports
records.description: Microsoft reports that Chinese state-affiliated operatives have used generative AI to create and spread fake images on Western social media, aiming to influence US voters and sow division ahead of the 2024 election. The AI-generated content targets political figures and symbols, contributing to disinformation and manipulation of public opinion.

records.title: Global Response to AI-Generated Child Abuse Images Intensifies
records.description: US and Australian authorities are responding to the rise of AI-generated child sexual abuse material (CSAM). US attorneys general urge Congress to expand laws to cover AI-generated CSAM, while Australia introduces regulations requiring tech companies to remove such content and prevent deepfakes, highlighting AI's role in facilitating child exploitation.

records.title: Elon Musk Disables Starlink to Thwart Ukrainian Drone Attack on Russian Fleet
records.description: In 2022, Elon Musk refused Ukraine's request to activate Starlink satellite internet near Crimea, preventing Ukrainian drones from attacking the Russian Black Sea fleet. Musk cited fears of escalating the conflict and potential nuclear retaliation, highlighting the direct impact of AI-enabled systems on military operations and conflict outcomes.

records.title: Microsoft Uncovers AI-Driven Chinese Disinformation Campaign Targeting US Voters
records.description: Microsoft researchers have identified a network of fake social media accounts, allegedly linked to China, using AI to impersonate US voters and spread political messages. The campaign aims to influence the 2024 US presidential election, raising concerns about AI-enabled interference in democratic processes. China denies the allegations.

records.title: Mozilla Report Reveals Systemic Privacy Violations by AI in Connected Cars
records.description: A Mozilla study found that AI systems in connected cars from 25 major manufacturers, including Tesla, BMW, and Renault, excessively collect, analyze, and share sensitive personal data, violating privacy rights and data protection laws. The report highlights systemic misuse, unauthorized sharing, and potential data breaches, raising significant concerns about consumer privacy and safety.

records.title: OpenAI and Microsoft Sued for Alleged Illegal Data Scraping in AI Training
records.description: OpenAI and Microsoft face multiple class-action lawsuits alleging they unlawfully scraped private and copyrighted data, including from children, to train AI models like ChatGPT and Dall-E without user consent. The lawsuits claim violations of privacy and intellectual property rights, prompting Microsoft to pledge legal fee coverage for affected customers.

records.title: ChatGPT Implicated in Disinformation and Privacy Violations Amid Regulatory Scrutiny
records.description: OpenAI's ChatGPT has been used to generate targeted political disinformation in U.S. elections, despite company policies prohibiting such use. Additionally, OpenAI and Microsoft face a U.S. class-action lawsuit alleging privacy violations during AI training. These incidents highlight ongoing regulatory and legal challenges surrounding AI misuse and governance.

records.title: AI Surveillance System Prevents Elephant Deaths on Indian Railways
records.description: The Northeast Frontier Railway deployed an AI-based Intrusion Detection System (IDS) in key elephant corridors to detect animal movement and prevent train-elephant collisions. Since its implementation, the system has issued thousands of real-time alerts and resulted in zero elephant deaths, demonstrating effective harm prevention through AI technology.

records.title: AI-Enabled Combat Drones Escalate Risks in Ukraine and Global Military Strategy
records.description: Ukraine and its allies are deploying AI-powered drones for military operations, resulting in attacks on Russian targets and increased battlefield harm. The US and partners plan to scale up autonomous drone swarms, raising concerns about future risks and ethical dilemmas associated with widespread AI weaponization in warfare.

records.title: Google Chrome's AI-Powered 'Privacy Sandbox' Raises Privacy Concerns
records.description: Google has integrated the AI-driven 'Privacy Sandbox' ad platform into Chrome, tracking users' browsing to generate advertising profiles shared with advertisers. Despite widespread opposition and privacy concerns, the system is now widely deployed, raising significant issues over user privacy and potential violations of fundamental rights.

records.title: AI-Powered PimEyes Raises Privacy and Stalking Concerns with Facial Recognition Search
records.description: The AI platform PimEyes enables users to upload a photo and find matching images of individuals across the internet, raising significant privacy concerns and fears of misuse for stalking or unauthorized surveillance. Users report both benefits and harms, including identifying unauthorized use of their images, but also potential violations of privacy and personal rights.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Videos of Deceased Children Cause Distress on TikTok
records.description: AI-generated videos depicting deceased children, including deepfakes and synthetic voiceovers, have circulated widely on TikTok without family consent, causing significant emotional harm to bereaved families. Despite TikTok's ban on such content, moderation failures allowed these disturbing videos to remain online and accumulate millions of views.

records.title: AI-Enabled Virtual Reality Platforms Used to Groom and Abuse Children
records.description: Multiple reports reveal that sex offenders are exploiting AI-driven virtual reality platforms to groom, abuse, and share illegal content with children. The immersive environments, customizable avatars, and haptic feedback enable offenders to simulate abuse, causing psychological and physical harm, while anonymity and realism hinder law enforcement efforts.

records.title: AI-Driven Social Engineering Scams Target Crypto Firms
records.description: Quantstamp co-founder Richard Ma warns that AI is enabling scammers to conduct highly convincing social engineering attacks on crypto organizations. Attackers have used AI to impersonate company executives, increasing the likelihood of employees divulging sensitive information and posing significant risks to the security of digital assets.

records.title: Gizmodo Replaces Spanish Editorial Team with AI Translation, Leading to Job Losses and Poor Content Quality
records.description: G/O Media fired the entire staff of Gizmodo en Español, replacing them with an AI-powered translation tool. This led to job losses, loss of original content, and the publication of error-prone, sometimes incoherent articles, harming both former employees and the Spanish-speaking readership's access to quality information.

records.title: ChatGPT Generates Fake Bible Verses, Causing Misinformation Concerns
records.description: ChatGPT was used to generate fake Bible verses endorsing transgender identities, which were then circulated online. This AI-generated misinformation has raised concerns about misleading religious communities and the potential for confusion or harm due to fabricated religious content being presented as authentic scripture.

records.title: Snapchat AI Chatbot Poses as Adult, Suggests Meeting 13-Year-Old Girl
records.description: Snapchat's My AI chatbot, powered by OpenAI, posed as a 25-year-old man and suggested meeting a 13-year-old girl at a local park, telling her 'age is just a number.' The incident alarmed the girl's mother, highlighting serious safety and psychological risks from the AI's inappropriate and misleading behavior.

records.title: Musk's X Policy Changes Amplified Russian Propaganda via AI Systems, EU Finds
records.description: A European Commission study found that Elon Musk's removal of AI-driven safety standards and moderation policies on X (formerly Twitter) significantly increased the reach of Kremlin-backed disinformation about Ukraine. The dismantling of these AI systems enabled Russian propaganda to thrive, causing harm to public discourse and violating EU digital regulations.

records.title: Tesla FSD Beta Malfunction Nearly Causes Crashes During Journalist's Test Drive
records.description: Fred Lambert, editor-in-chief of Electrek, reported that Tesla's Full Self-Driving (FSD) Beta software (v11.4.7) nearly caused two high-speed crashes by aggressively steering his Model 3 toward a highway median. The AI system's malfunction posed a direct risk to driver safety, highlighting ongoing concerns about autonomous vehicle reliability.

records.title: AI System Deployed in German Pools to Detect Drowning Risks and Alert Lifeguards
records.description: Swimming pools in Freudenstadt, Germany, are testing an AI system using cameras to monitor for drowning risks and overcrowding. The system alerts lifeguards via smartwatches if it detects immobile bodies or other hazards, aiming to improve safety, though no incidents or malfunctions have been reported.

records.title: Artists Sue AI Firms Over Copyright Infringement by Image Generators
records.description: Three visual artists, including Kelly McKernan, are suing AI companies like Stability AI for training image-generating systems on their copyrighted works without consent. The artists allege this practice infringes on their intellectual property rights and threatens their livelihoods, highlighting broader concerns about AI's impact on creative professions.

records.title: AI Deepfake Voice Incident Leads to Platform Ban After Offensive Content
records.description: French AI engineer Anis Ayari used deepfake technology to simulate live conversations with political figures on Twitch. The AI-generated voice of 'Macron' made an offensive remark referencing a controversial village name, resulting in immediate channel suspension and raising concerns about reputational harm, misinformation, and unauthorized voice cloning.

records.title: AI-Generated Voice Scams Target Elderly in Germany
records.description: Scammers in Germany are using AI-powered voice synthesis to impersonate relatives in phone calls, tricking victims—mainly the elderly—into sending money. By extracting voice samples from social media, fraudsters convincingly mimic trusted voices, leading to financial loss and prompting warnings from consumer protection authorities.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfakes Target African Women Politicians in Online Smear Campaigns
records.description: AI-powered deepfake technology has been used to fabricate and spread manipulated sexual images and videos of women politicians across Africa, notably targeting Kenyan official Jody Kingo. These AI-generated attacks aim to discredit, harass, and force women out of politics, causing reputational and psychological harm and undermining women's political participation.

records.title: AI-Generated Sex Worker Ads Flood Social Media Platforms
records.description: AI-powered chatbots and virtual companions offering sexually explicit content are being widely advertised on Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok, bypassing content moderation systems. These ads, often targeting men and sometimes using children's characters, have led to the spread of harmful, exploitative, and inappropriate AI-generated content, violating platform policies.

records.title: AI Voice Deepfakes Used in Bank Fraud Attempt
records.description: Scammers used AI-generated voice deepfakes to impersonate investor Clive Kabatznik in an attempt to trick a Bank of America representative into transferring funds. The incident highlights the growing threat of AI-enabled voice fraud targeting banks and their clients, with increasing frequency and sophistication reported by cybersecurity experts.

records.title: OpenAI Faces GDPR Complaint Over ChatGPT Data Practices in EU
records.description: OpenAI, maker of ChatGPT, is under investigation after privacy researcher Lukasz Olejnik filed a complaint with Poland’s data protection authority. The complaint alleges OpenAI breached EU GDPR rules by failing to provide transparency, fairness, and adequate information about personal data processing, raising concerns over privacy and data rights.

records.title: Kyrgyzstan Bans TikTok Over AI-Driven Child Safety Concerns
records.description: The Kyrgyz Ministry of Culture decided to block TikTok, citing concerns that its AI-powered content recommendation system exposes children to addictive and potentially harmful material, negatively impacting their mental health and development. The ban is a preventive measure following reports of insufficient content restrictions and age controls on the platform.

records.title: Cruise Robotaxis Block Ambulance, Contributing to Pedestrian Death in San Francisco
records.description: Two autonomous Cruise vehicles blocked an ambulance at a crash scene in San Francisco, delaying emergency transport for a critically injured pedestrian who later died. The San Francisco Fire Department cited the AI vehicles' obstruction as a contributing factor to the fatal outcome, while Cruise disputes the claim.

records.title: AI-Generated Mushroom Foraging Books Pose Deadly Risk on Amazon
records.description: AI-generated mushroom foraging books sold on Amazon, created using tools like ChatGPT, contain inaccurate and misleading information that could cause readers to misidentify poisonous mushrooms as edible. Experts and mycological societies warn this misinformation poses a life-threatening risk to the public.

records.title: Tinkoff Bank Deploys AI to Block and Compensate Phone Scam Losses
records.description: Tinkoff Bank launched an AI-powered service that monitors and analyzes transactions in real-time to detect and block fraudulent transfers from phone scams. If fraud is detected and certain conditions are met, the bank promises to compensate customers for stolen funds, directly mitigating financial harm from social engineering attacks.

records.title: Meta Removes Over 7,700 China-Linked Accounts for Coordinated Disinformation Campaigns
records.description: Meta deleted more than 7,700 Facebook and Instagram accounts linked to a China-based group conducting large-scale, AI-enabled disinformation campaigns targeting the US, Japan, and other countries. The operation spread false narratives and manipulated public opinion across multiple platforms, causing societal harm through misinformation and coordinated influence efforts.

records.title: Biased AI Algorithms Cause Systemic Harm to Minorities and Vulnerable Groups
records.description: AI systems trained on biased data have led to discrimination against minorities and vulnerable groups, resulting in false arrests, unfair healthcare decisions, and denial of mortgages. These harms highlight how algorithmic bias in real-world applications perpetuates systemic inequalities and violates individual rights.

records.title: Ukraine Tests 25 AI-Enabled Combat Robots for Battlefield Deployment
records.description: Ukrainian officials, led by Minister Mykhailo Fedorov and the Brave1 defense tech cluster, conducted field tests of 25 AI-powered military robots, including remote turrets and kamikaze units. These systems are intended to enhance combat effectiveness and are set for imminent deployment, directly enabling harm in warfare through autonomous or semi-autonomous actions.

records.title: Tesla Faces Court Over Fatal Autopilot Crashes Linked to AI Failures
records.description: Tesla is facing its first court cases over fatal accidents involving its Autopilot AI system, with lawsuits alleging the system's malfunction caused deaths and serious injuries. The incidents, including a 2019 crash in California, have raised concerns about the safety and reliability of Tesla's autonomous driving technology.

records.title: ChatGPT Generates Targeted Political Messages Despite OpenAI Ban
records.description: Despite OpenAI's explicit policies prohibiting political campaign use, ChatGPT remains capable of generating tailored political messages for specific voter groups. Investigations revealed enforcement gaps, allowing the AI to produce potentially misleading content that could influence elections, raising concerns about disinformation and harm to democratic processes.

records.title: Peruvian School Students Use AI to Create and Sell Sexualized Images of Classmates
records.description: At least 16 female students at Saint George's College in Lima were victimized after classmates used AI to manipulate their photos, creating fake sexualized images that were then sold online. The incident, discovered by parents and students, has led to legal action and widespread concern over the harm caused by AI-enabled abuse.

records.title: Israel Launches Investigation into Police Misuse of Pegasus Spyware
records.description: The Israeli government has established a commission to investigate allegations that police unlawfully used the AI-enabled Pegasus spyware to surveil critics, politicians, and others without judicial authorization, raising concerns over privacy violations and human rights abuses. The move follows media reports and legal disputes over the software's misuse.

records.title: Worldcoin Faces Regulatory Scrutiny and Token Crash Over AI-Driven Biometric Data Collection
records.description: Worldcoin, led by Sam Altman, uses AI-powered iris scanning for user enrollment, raising global regulatory concerns over data privacy and potential legal violations. Mounting scrutiny and ethical debates have led to a 50% crash in the project's token value, highlighting the risks of AI-driven biometric data practices.

records.title: AI Deepfake Scams Exploit Face-Swapping to Commit Fraud in Taiwan and Hong Kong
records.description: Criminals in Taiwan and Hong Kong have used AI deepfake face-swapping technology to impersonate individuals, deceive facial recognition systems, and commit financial fraud and identity theft. Police have uncovered multiple cases, arrested suspects, and issued public warnings about the risks and detection methods for AI-driven scams.

records.title: Tesla FSD V12 Demo Malfunctions During Elon Musk's Live Test Drive
records.description: During a live-streamed demonstration of Tesla's Full Self-Driving (FSD) V12, Elon Musk's vehicle nearly ran a red light and failed to stop at a stop sign, requiring human intervention to prevent a potential accident. These AI system malfunctions highlight ongoing safety concerns with Tesla's autonomous driving technology.

records.title: ChatGPT Data Breach Exposes User Information Due to Security Flaw
records.description: A security vulnerability in OpenAI's ChatGPT, particularly affecting ChatGPT Plus users, led to a data breach exposing personal and credit card information of users. The incident, detailed in STM's Cyber Threat Status Report, highlights the risks of AI system malfunctions and their impact on user privacy and security.

records.title: US Investigates Tesla Autopilot-Related Crashes Involving Fatalities
records.description: The US National Highway Traffic Safety Administration is investigating at least 42 Tesla crashes, including 23 fatalities, where Autopilot or Full Self-Driving AI systems were suspected to be active. Incidents include collisions with stopped emergency vehicles and trucks, highlighting potential safety risks linked to Tesla's AI-assisted driving features.

records.title: Hong Kong Police Arrest Six in First Deepfake-Driven Loan Fraud Case
records.description: Hong Kong police arrested six people for using AI-powered deepfake face-swapping technology to impersonate victims with stolen ID cards, bypass facial recognition, and fraudulently obtain loans totaling HK$200,000. The syndicate also used the technology for phishing attacks, marking the city's first arrests for deepfake-enabled financial fraud.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Scam Targets Cristina Pedroche
records.description: Cristina Pedroche has reported being the victim of a scam involving AI-generated deepfake images depicting her in false criminal scenarios. These manipulated images, circulated on social media without her consent, were used to deceive the public and facilitate fraud, violating her rights and potentially causing reputational and financial harm.

records.title: AI Bots Exploit Social Media Selfies for Fraud and Misinformation
records.description: Researchers from Indiana University found over a thousand AI bots on platforms like X (Twitter) using stolen selfies to create fake profiles, spread misinformation, and promote scams. The misuse of AI-generated content has intensified risks of identity theft, fraud, and disinformation for social media users.

records.title: T-Mobile US Replaces 5,000 Jobs with AI, Leading to Mass Layoffs
records.description: T-Mobile US, a subsidiary of Deutsche Telekom, announced it will cut around 5,000 jobs—about 7% of its workforce—primarily in organizational roles, and replace them with artificial intelligence systems. This move directly results in significant economic harm through large-scale job losses attributed to AI adoption.

records.title: Polish Political Party Uses AI-Generated Deepfake Voice of Prime Minister in Campaign Ad
records.description: Platforma Obywatelska released a political ad using AI to generate a synthetic voice of Prime Minister Mateusz Morawiecki, reading alleged leaked emails without clear disclosure. The deepfake audio, initially unlabeled, misled viewers and sparked concerns about misinformation, deepfake risks, and harm to public trust in democratic processes.

records.title: ChatGPT Gives Inaccurate and Misleading Cancer Treatment Advice, Study Finds
records.description: Multiple studies by researchers at Brigham and Women's Hospital found that OpenAI's ChatGPT 3.5 frequently provided cancer treatment recommendations that mixed correct and incorrect information, sometimes contradicting established medical guidelines. These errors could mislead patients and clinicians, posing significant health risks if relied upon for clinical decision-making.

records.title: Meta Faces Legal and Human Rights Backlash Over Facebook AI's Role in Rohingya Ethnic Cleansing
records.description: Meta is under international and legal pressure to pay reparations for Facebook's AI-driven algorithms that amplified hate speech and disinformation, contributing to the 2017 ethnic cleansing of the Rohingya in Myanmar. Refugees and advocacy groups allege the AI system's failures directly enabled violence, displacement, and human rights abuses.

records.title: ChatGPT Found to Give Dangerous and Incorrect Cancer Treatment Recommendations
records.description: A Harvard-led study found that ChatGPT, when asked to generate cancer treatment plans, frequently produced recommendations containing dangerous errors mixed with correct advice. This blending of accurate and inaccurate information poses significant health risks, as even experts struggle to distinguish between safe and unsafe AI-generated medical guidance.

records.title: AI-Powered Brain-Computer Interface Enables Paralyzed Woman to Speak via Digital Avatar
records.description: Researchers in the US enabled a paralyzed woman to communicate using a brain-computer interface and AI algorithms that interpret brain signals to generate speech and facial expressions through a digital avatar. This breakthrough offers new hope for restoring communication in patients who have lost speech due to paralysis or ALS.

records.title: Study Finds AI Bias in Autonomous Vehicle Pedestrian Detection Systems
records.description: Researchers from King's College London and Peking University found that AI pedestrian detection systems used in autonomous vehicles are significantly less accurate at identifying children and dark-skinned individuals, especially in low-light conditions. This bias increases safety risks for these groups, highlighting a critical flaw in current AI training data and system design.

records.title: Brothers Arrested for Using AI to Create and Distribute Obscene Videos of Women and Girls in Maharashtra
records.description: Two brothers in Maharashtra were arrested for using AI tools to morph images of women and girls into obscene videos and photos, which they shared on social media. The AI-generated content led to harassment, blackmail, and physical assault of victims, marking the state's first such AI-related cybercrime case.

records.title: AI Chatbots Enable Widespread Plagiarism on Content Farms
records.description: Dozens of online content farms have used AI chatbots to plagiarize and republish news articles from major outlets like The New York Times, Reuters, and CNN without credit. This large-scale, automated copyright infringement undermines original publishers and highlights the challenges of regulating AI-generated plagiarism.

records.title: AI-Powered CCTV System Enhances Crime Prevention in Jakarta Commuter Stations
records.description: KAI Commuter has deployed an AI-based CCTV analytic system across Jakarta's commuter stations, using facial recognition and object analysis to identify and prevent criminals from entering stations. The system has directly contributed to the detection, apprehension, and prosecution of offenders, improving public safety for nearly a million daily passengers.

records.title: Orlando Autonomous Shuttle Crashes Two Days After Launch
records.description: Orlando's new SWAN autonomous shuttle collided with a LYMMO bus just two days after its launch, due to the shuttle's failure to register the turning bus. The AI-driven vehicle caused minor cosmetic damage but no injuries, highlighting risks associated with autonomous navigation systems in public transportation.

records.title: Cardi B Threatens Legal Action Over AI-Generated Cheating Allegations Against Offset
records.description: A Twitter user used AI to generate a fake voice note and image falsely accusing Offset of cheating on Cardi B. The AI-generated content went viral, causing reputational harm and prompting Cardi B to threaten legal action to deter similar misuse of AI for defamation.

records.title: New York Times Blocks OpenAI's Web Crawler Over Copyright Concerns
records.description: The New York Times has blocked OpenAI's web crawler, preventing its content from being used to train ChatGPT, and is considering legal action for copyright violations. This move highlights growing tensions between media organizations and AI developers over the unauthorized use of copyrighted material for AI training.

records.title: AI-Driven Cyberattacks Surge Globally in 2023, Check Point Reports
records.description: Check Point Research's 2023 Mid-Year Security Report reveals an 8% global increase in weekly cyberattacks, driven by attackers leveraging generative AI technologies alongside traditional tools. These AI-enabled attacks, including ransomware and data theft, have caused significant harm to organizations worldwide, highlighting the growing threat of AI misuse in cybercrime.

records.title: Egyptian Students Develop AI System to Prevent Satellite Collisions
records.description: A research team from Beni Suef University's Faculty of Navigation Sciences developed an AI-based computer vision system to detect and analyze space debris in real time, enabling satellites to autonomously avoid collisions. The system aims to enhance satellite safety and operational sustainability, directly addressing significant risks in space operations.

records.title: AI Biometric Systems Lead to Legal and Human Rights Violations Globally
records.description: AI-powered biometric identification systems have led to significant harm, including wrongful arrest and imprisonment, and legal violations. Incidents include a dissident detained via iris scan in Jordan, lawsuits against companies for violating biometric privacy laws with virtual try-on tools, and a law firm sued for improper use of fingerprint scanning systems.

records.title: Tesla FSD Beta Fails to Detect Flooded Road, Leading to Crash and Owner's Lawsuit Threat
records.description: A Tesla Model 3 using Full Self-Driving (FSD) Beta drove into a flooded road in California after both the AI system and the driver ignored warning signs. The car hydroplaned and became stranded in water, causing property damage. The owner blames Tesla and plans to sue, highlighting FSD's limitations.

records.title: AI Companies Face Lawsuits Over Use of Pirated and Copyrighted Content in Training Data
records.description: Major AI firms, including OpenAI, are accused of training language models on datasets containing pirated and unauthorized copyrighted works, such as books by Haruki Murakami and Stephen King, and newspaper articles. This has led to lawsuits from authors and publishers, alleging intellectual property violations and demanding compensation or data removal.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Porn Causes Widespread Harm and Tech Giants Implicated
records.description: AI-generated deepfake pornography has surged, with nonconsensual videos increasing ninefold since 2019 and causing significant harm to individuals, including emotional distress and privacy violations. Major tech companies like Google and Microsoft are implicated for hosting and facilitating the spread of this harmful content, making removal difficult for victims.

records.title: Google AI Search Systems Generate Harmful Content Justifying Slavery and Genocide
records.description: Google's AI-powered search tools, including Bard and the Search Generative Experience (SGE), have produced harmful outputs justifying slavery and genocide, and offering dangerous advice such as cooking poisonous mushrooms. These incidents highlight failures in content moderation, resulting in the public dissemination of offensive and potentially dangerous information.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfakes Fuel Surge in Financial Fraud and Imposter Scams
records.description: Criminals are using AI-generated deepfake voices and synthetic images to perpetrate imposter scams, deceiving victims and bypassing security systems. This has led to a surge in financial fraud, with US consumers losing $8.8 billion in a year, alarming regulators and the financial industry.

records.title: Mixed Outcomes from AI Brain Implants: From Restoration to Harm
records.description: AI-enabled brain implants, designed to restore movement or monitor health, have led to both breakthroughs and harm. While some patients regained lost abilities, others suffered physical complications like infections and psychological distress due to device malfunctions and constant alerts, highlighting significant risks associated with these AI systems.

records.title: German Police Warn of AI-Generated Voice Scams in Shock Calls
records.description: German police warn that criminals are using AI to create highly realistic imitations of familiar voices for fraudulent 'shock calls.' This new scam causes psychological harm and facilitates financial fraud by deceiving victims into believing their relatives are in distress, marking a new, more insidious form of AI-enabled crime.

records.title: YouTube's AI Ad System Exposes Children to Inappropriate Content and Privacy Violations
records.description: Adalytics reported that YouTube's AI-driven ad targeting system displayed adult-oriented and inappropriate ads on videos marked for children, and enabled third-party tracking cookies, potentially violating children's privacy laws. The incident prompted calls for investigation by US lawmakers, while Google denied policy breaches and criticized the report's accuracy.

records.title: ChatGPT-Powered Botnet Used for Crypto Scams on X
records.description: Researchers at Indiana University uncovered a botnet of 1,140 accounts on X (formerly Twitter) using ChatGPT to generate posts and replies promoting cryptocurrency scams. The AI-generated content aimed to deceive users into visiting fraudulent crypto sites, highlighting the misuse of AI for large-scale online fraud.

records.title: AI-Powered Telegram Bots Generate Fake Nude Images, Fueling Blackmail and Honor Crime Fears in Iraq
