records.description: AI-driven bots on Telegram are generating fake nude images from user photos, leading to privacy violations, potential blackmail, and fears of escalating honor crimes in Iraq. Tech groups warn of significant social harm, urging the public not to use these bots and to report related blackmail attempts.

records.title: Pirated Books Used to Train Generative AI Spark Copyright Backlash
records.description: Thousands of copyrighted books, including works by Stephen King and Zadie Smith, were used without permission to train generative AI models like Meta's LLaMA via the Books3 dataset. This unauthorized use has led to lawsuits and takedown actions, highlighting significant intellectual property violations in AI development.

records.title: The New York Times Considers Lawsuit Against OpenAI Over AI Copyright Infringement
records.description: The New York Times is considering legal action against OpenAI, alleging that ChatGPT was trained on its copyrighted content without permission. Negotiations for a licensing deal have broken down, raising concerns about intellectual property rights and potential industry-wide implications for AI systems trained on unlicensed data.

records.title: Video Game Studios Face Backlash Over AI Voice Cloning Without Actor Consent
records.description: Voice actors raised concerns after Hi-Rez Studios included contract clauses allowing AI to clone actors’ voices, even posthumously, without explicit consent or compensation. Following public backlash and union pressure, the studio pledged to revise its policies to better protect actors’ rights against unauthorized AI-generated voice use.

records.title: Russia and Iran Collaborate to Mass-Produce AI-Enabled Attack Drones for Ukraine War
records.description: Russia, with Iranian assistance, is building a factory to produce 6,000 autonomous attack drones by 2025, using AI for navigation and targeting. These drones have already been deployed against Ukrainian cities, causing harm to civilians and infrastructure, and the expanded production aims to intensify such attacks.

records.title: Microsoft AI Recommends Food Bank as Tourist Attraction, Sparks Outrage
records.description: Microsoft's AI-generated travel guide for Ottawa mistakenly listed the Ottawa Food Bank as a top tourist destination, advising visitors to go "on an empty stomach." The insensitive recommendation, published without human review, led to public backlash and the article's removal, highlighting risks of unsupervised AI content generation.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Voice Used in Fraud Targeting Turkish Officials and Businesspeople
records.description: A fraudster used AI to clone President Erdoğan's voice, making deceptive calls to businesspeople and senior officials for financial gain. The scheme, involving over 10 phone lines, was uncovered by Turkey's National Intelligence Organization (MİT), which identified and apprehended the suspect. Authorities warn of increasing AI-driven identity fraud.

records.title: Cruise Robotaxi AI Failures Lead to Crashes and Regulatory Crackdown in San Francisco
records.description: Cruise, GM's autonomous vehicle unit, faced multiple AI-driven incidents in San Francisco, including a collision with a fire truck that injured a passenger and a car getting stuck in wet cement. Regulators ordered Cruise to halve its robotaxi fleet amid safety concerns and ongoing investigations into the AI system's failures.

records.title: Tesla Failed to Update Autopilot After Fatal Crashes, Engineers Admit
records.description: Tesla engineers admitted the company did not update its Autopilot AI system to address known issues with detecting crossing traffic after a fatal 2016 crash, leading to a similar deadly accident in 2019. The failures have resulted in lawsuits and regulatory investigations into the AI system's safety.

records.title: AI System in Brazilian Social Security Causes Harm to Vulnerable Groups
records.description: The Brazilian Public Defender's Office (DPU) demanded immediate action from the National Social Security Institute (INSS) after its AI system automatically denied benefit requests and imposed a 30-day wait for resubmission. This process disproportionately harmed vulnerable populations, including indigenous and digitally excluded groups, by delaying access to social benefits.

records.title: Snapchat AI Chatbot Malfunctions, Posts Unprompted Story and Alarms Users
records.description: Snapchat's AI chatbot, My AI, unexpectedly posted an image to its public story and became unresponsive, alarming users who feared privacy breaches. The incident, caused by a technical glitch, led to widespread user distress before Snapchat resolved the issue and clarified no intentional misuse occurred.

records.title: Indonesian Police Crack Down on AI-Powered Robot Trading Investment Scams
records.description: Indonesian police have arrested multiple suspects and seized over Rp 1.4 trillion in assets linked to fraudulent AI-based robot trading platforms Net89 and Auto Trade Gold (ATG). The scams, which used automated trading systems to lure investors, caused significant financial losses to thousands of victims. Authorities are pursuing remaining fugitives abroad.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Videos Spark Legal Action Against Serbian TV Broadcaster
records.description: Serbian opposition leader Dragan Đilas announced legal action against Željko Mitrović and TV Pink for broadcasting AI-generated deepfake videos that falsified his and other politicians' voices and likenesses, misleading the public and damaging reputations. The incident has raised concerns about AI misuse and calls for regulatory intervention.

records.title: AI-Driven Scams Exploit Deepfake and Impersonation Techniques in Turkey
records.description: Criminals in Turkey are increasingly using AI technologies, including deepfake and impersonation tools, to perpetrate sophisticated scams, threatening individuals' financial and personal security. Experts warn the public to avoid sharing personal information online and highlight the urgent need for awareness and protective measures against AI-enabled fraud.

records.title: ChatGPT and Google Bard Found to Generate High Volumes of News Misinformation
records.description: A NewsGuard audit revealed that OpenAI's ChatGPT and Google's Bard, when prompted with 100 known false news narratives, generated 98 and 80 false claims respectively. This demonstrates that both leading generative AI tools are actively producing and spreading news-related misinformation, posing harm to public information integrity.

records.title: Cruise Robotaxis Cause Traffic Chaos in San Francisco After Connectivity Failure
records.description: Cruise's AI-powered driverless taxis in San Francisco experienced internet connectivity failures, causing at least 10 vehicles to become immobilized and block traffic, disrupting emergency access and city infrastructure. The incidents highlight the risks of deploying autonomous vehicles at scale before resolving technical vulnerabilities.

records.title: AI Deepfakes Threaten Election Integrity and Brand Reputations
records.description: AI-generated deepfakes are increasingly used to manipulate political content and spread disinformation, posing significant risks to democratic processes and brand reputations. Advocacy groups and regulators, including the FEC, are considering bans and regulations, while brands adopt AI-driven detection and crisis strategies to combat real and potential harms.

records.title: AI Cameras Catch Hundreds of UK Drivers for Phone and Seatbelt Offences
records.description: An AI-powered camera system from Acusensus, trialed on the A30 in Devon and Cornwall, detected nearly 300 drivers using mobile phones or not wearing seatbelts within 72 hours. The system, which processes images with AI before human review, has sparked both praise for improving road safety and concerns over privacy.

records.title: Tesla Autopilot Crash Case Ends, Raising Ongoing Legal and Ethical Concerns
records.description: A Tesla driver using Autopilot was prosecuted after a 2019 crash in Los Angeles killed two people, marking the first U.S. felony case involving partially automated driving. The driver received probation, but the incident has sparked ongoing legal, ethical, and civil actions over AI-driven vehicle safety and accountability.

records.title: Peru Fines Google for Failing to Remove Personal Data from Search Results
records.description: Peru's data protection authority fined Google 430,000 soles for not complying with orders to remove or block personal data from search results. Google's AI-driven search system failed to desindex or restrict access to sensitive information, violating individuals' privacy rights and data protection laws in 14 documented cases.

records.title: Hackers Expose AI Chatbot Vulnerabilities at Def Con Conference
records.description: At the Def Con hacker conference, thousands of participants successfully manipulated leading AI chatbots—including ChatGPT and Google Bard—into revealing sensitive information, generating misinformation, and producing biased or harmful content. The event highlighted the ease with which prompt injections can bypass AI safeguards, demonstrating real-world risks and harms from current AI systems.

records.title: AI Misuse Leads to Inaccurate Book Bans in Iowa Schools
records.description: Mason City Community School District in Iowa used ChatGPT to identify and remove books with sexual content to comply with a new state law. The AI's inconsistent and flawed assessments led to wrongful book removals, resulting in censorship and restricting students' access to information, constituting harm to educational rights.

records.title: AI-Assisted Robotic Surgery Saves Stroke Patient from Severe Harm in Vietnam
records.description: A 58-year-old man in Ho Chi Minh City, suffering from a large brain hemorrhage, underwent emergency awake brain surgery using an AI-assisted robotic system. The AI integrated imaging and provided real-time guidance, enabling successful removal of the clot and preventing paralysis or death, demonstrating AI's critical role in life-saving medical interventions.

records.title: Worldcoin Faces Global Scrutiny Over AI-Driven Biometric Data Collection
records.description: Worldcoin, which uses AI-based iris scanning for identity verification, is under investigation in Kenya and Argentina over privacy and data protection concerns. Authorities have suspended operations, sought court orders to preserve data, and questioned the legality and security of biometric data processing, highlighting risks of misuse and inadequate consent.

records.title: Robotaxi AI Failures Cause Traffic Chaos and Privacy Concerns in San Francisco
records.description: San Francisco's autonomous taxis from Cruise and Waymo caused major traffic disruptions after a software bug led to multiple vehicles blocking streets. Additionally, onboard cameras recorded passengers during intimate acts without clear consent, raising privacy concerns. These incidents prompted city officials to seek suspension of robotaxi services due to public safety and rights violations.

records.title: Greek Tax Authority Uses AI to Detect Undeclared Properties, Leading to Fines and Back Taxes
records.description: The Greek tax authority (AADE) deployed an AI system to analyze satellite images and cross-reference property databases, identifying undeclared or underreported real estate. Property owners found in violation face retroactive taxes and fines, resulting in significant financial and legal consequences directly caused by the AI-driven enforcement.

records.title: AI Bus Routing System Causes School Disruptions in Kentucky and Ohio
records.description: AlphaRoute's AI-powered bus routing system caused major disruptions in Louisville, Kentucky, and in Cincinnati and Columbus, Ohio, leading to canceled classes and transportation failures. The system's inability to adapt to real-world changes resulted in harm to students and communities, forcing districts to abandon the technology.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Audio and Scams Target Taiwanese Politicians and Professors
records.description: AI-generated deepfake audio falsely imitating politician Ko Wen-je was circulated to spread misinformation during Taiwan's election, prompting legal action and public warnings. Additionally, over a thousand university professors received AI-enabled scam messages, highlighting the growing threat of AI-driven disinformation and fraud in Taiwan.

records.title: AI Facial Recognition Used to Identify Bus Assault Suspect in Pescara
records.description: After a bus controller in Pescara was violently assaulted by a passenger evading a fare, police used an AI-powered facial recognition system to analyze video footage and quickly identify the 41-year-old suspect, leading to his denunciation for aggravated assault and related charges.

records.title: AI System Can Steal Passwords by Analyzing Keyboard Sounds
records.description: Researchers demonstrated that an AI system can accurately infer typed passwords by analyzing keyboard sounds, achieving up to 95% accuracy. This capability poses significant privacy and security risks, as hostile actors could exploit such AI tools for cyberattacks and unauthorized access to sensitive information.

records.title: California Uses AI to Rapidly Detect and Contain Wildfires
records.description: California's ALERTCalifornia AI program analyzes feeds from over 1,000 cameras to detect wildfires in real time. The system has already enabled firefighters to respond to fires before traditional emergency calls, leading to rapid containment and preventing potential harm to people, property, and the environment.

records.title: AI Model Steals Passwords by Analyzing Keystroke Sounds with High Accuracy
records.description: Cornell University researchers developed an AI system that can steal passwords by analyzing the sound of keystrokes recorded via nearby microphones or video calls. The AI achieved up to 95% accuracy in reconstructing passwords, raising significant concerns about privacy and security breaches enabled by AI-driven acoustic attacks.

records.title: TikTok's AI Moderation Failure Fuels Anti-LGBTQ+ Violence in Ethiopia
records.description: TikTok's AI-driven content moderation failed to remove inciteful videos calling for violence against LGBTQ+ people in Ethiopia. This led to increased harassment, physical attacks, and forced displacement of community members, as users also outed individuals online. Activists blame TikTok's inadequate AI moderation for escalating real-world harm.

records.title: China Arrests Over 500 for Deepfake-Enabled Fraud and Identity Theft
records.description: Chinese police arrested 515 individuals for using AI-powered deepfake facial impersonation technology to commit fraud and violate personal data rights. The crackdown resolved 79 cases, highlighting the direct harm caused by AI misuse in generating fake videos and images for scams and identity theft.

records.title: AI-Driven Military Innovations in Ukraine's War Effort Cause Direct Harm
records.description: Ukrainian developers have deployed AI-powered systems—including explosive sea drones and unmanned ground vehicles—that have directly damaged Russian military and commercial targets during the ongoing conflict. Additional AI tools support mine detection and PTSD diagnosis, highlighting the significant and harmful role of AI in modern warfare.

records.title: Turkish AI-Enabled Drone Strikes Kill PKK Members in Northern Iraq
records.description: Turkish military drones, likely equipped with AI for targeting and navigation, conducted multiple strikes in northern Iraq, killing at least three members of the Kurdistan Workers' Party (PKK) and injuring others. These AI-enabled drone attacks resulted in direct fatalities and injuries, highlighting the lethal impact of autonomous military systems.

records.title: AI Meal Planner Recommends Toxic and Dangerous Recipes to Users
records.description: Pak'nSave supermarket's AI-powered meal planner, using OpenAI's GPT-3.5, generated hazardous recipes—including those producing chlorine gas and using toxic substances—when users entered unusual ingredients. The app's outputs posed direct health risks, prompting public concern and supermarket efforts to improve safety controls.

records.title: San Francisco Approves Robotaxi Expansion Despite Safety Incidents
records.description: California regulators approved the expansion of Waymo and Cruise's AI-powered robotaxi services across San Francisco, allowing 24/7 paid operations despite documented incidents of autonomous vehicles unexpectedly stopping and blocking emergency vehicles. The decision advances commercial deployment amid ongoing safety concerns and opposition from local officials.

records.title: German News Anchor Deepfaked in AI-Driven Investment Scam
records.description: Fraudsters used AI deepfake technology to create a fake video of 'Tagesschau' news anchor André Schünke endorsing a fraudulent investment platform called 'Quantum.' The manipulated video, circulating on Facebook, misleads viewers by exploiting Schünke's reputation, potentially causing financial harm and spreading misinformation.

records.title: Tesla Autopilot Failures Lead to Police Injuries and Fatal Crash, Prompting Lawsuits and Federal Probe
records.description: Tesla's Autopilot AI system failed to prevent crashes in two incidents: a Model X struck police officers in Texas after 150 ignored warnings, causing injuries and lawsuits, while a Model Y crash in Virginia resulted in a fatality and a federal investigation. Both highlight concerns over the system's reliability and safety.

records.title: IBM Researchers Manipulate AI Chatbots to Generate Harmful Outputs
records.description: IBM researchers demonstrated that popular AI chatbots, including ChatGPT and Bard, can be easily manipulated through prompt engineering to produce malicious code, leak confidential information, and provide dangerous or unethical advice, such as encouraging crime or unsafe behavior, highlighting significant security and ethical risks in current AI systems.

records.title: AI Voice Cloning Used for Deception and Fraud Raises Concerns
records.description: Influencer Mia Dio used AI voice cloning to impersonate her boyfriend in a prank to expose infidelity, highlighting how easily such technology can deceive. While her case was staged, reports emphasize that criminals are exploiting AI voice cloning for scams, raising concerns about fraud and personal harm from AI misuse.

records.title: Malicious AI Tools Drive Surge in Cybercrime, Trend Micro Responds with AI Defenses
records.description: Threat actors are increasingly using AI tools like ChatGPT, WormGPT, and FraudGPT to conduct cyberattacks, phishing, and scams, causing harm to organizations and individuals. Trend Micro reports blocking 73 billion threats in six months and is deploying AI-powered defenses to counter these malicious AI-driven activities.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Books Sold Under Author's Name on Amazon
records.description: Author Jane Friedman discovered multiple AI-generated books falsely attributed to her being sold on Amazon and Goodreads. Despite her requests, Amazon initially refused to remove the counterfeit titles, citing trademark issues. The incident highlights how generative AI can facilitate identity theft and intellectual property violations, causing reputational and financial harm.

records.title: Researchers Warn of Dangerous Medical Misinformation from ChatGPT
records.description: Researchers from CHU Sainte-Justine and Montreal Children's Hospital found that ChatGPT provided factually incorrect medical advice and fabricated 70% of its references in response to medical questions. These inaccuracies pose direct risks to health if relied upon, prompting warnings against using ChatGPT for medical information.

records.title: iTutorGroup Settles Age Discrimination Lawsuit Over AI Hiring Tool
records.description: iTutorGroup agreed to pay $365,000 to over 200 job applicants after its AI hiring software was found to have automatically rejected female candidates over 55 and male candidates over 60, resulting in age discrimination. The U.S. EEOC alleged the AI system was deliberately trained to exclude older applicants.

records.title: Prosecraft AI Book Analysis Site Shut Down After Copyright Backlash
records.description: Prosecraft, an AI-powered site analyzing over 25,000 books without author consent, sparked outrage among writers for violating intellectual property rights. Following public backlash and demands for removal, the creator Benji Smith shut down the site, highlighting ongoing concerns about AI misuse and unauthorized data scraping in creative industries.

records.title: AI Chatbots and Generative Tools Promote Harmful Eating Disorder Content
records.description: Multiple reports and research reveal that AI chatbots and image generators, including ChatGPT, Google Bard, and Midjourney, frequently produce harmful advice and images that promote eating disorders. These outputs, often bypassing safety filters, pose serious health risks, prompting calls for urgent action from policymakers and advocacy groups.

records.title: Colleges Confront Widespread Cheating via ChatGPT and AI Chatbots
records.description: The rapid adoption of ChatGPT and similar AI chatbots has led to a surge in academic dishonesty at colleges, with professors reporting numerous cases of AI-assisted cheating. In response, educators are revising assignments, returning to paper exams, and implementing new safeguards to uphold academic integrity.

records.title: ChatGPT Frequently Gives Incorrect Programming Answers, Study Finds
records.description: A Purdue University study found that ChatGPT provides incorrect answers to programming questions over 50% of the time. Despite this, users often prefer its well-articulated responses, leading to potential harm through misinformation, coding errors, and reputational risks for developers who rely on its outputs.

records.title: AI Model Enables High-Accuracy Keystroke Eavesdropping via Acoustic Side-Channel Attacks
records.description: UK researchers developed a deep learning model capable of decoding keystrokes from audio recordings with up to 95% accuracy using nearby smartphones or Zoom calls. This AI-driven acoustic side-channel attack demonstrates a significant privacy and cybersecurity risk, enabling potential theft of sensitive data through common microphone-equipped devices.

records.title: DHS Uses AI Facial Recognition to Solve Child Exploitation Cold Cases, Raising Privacy Concerns
records.description: The U.S. Department of Homeland Security has used AI-powered facial recognition tools, notably Clearview AI, to identify suspects and victims in thousands of child exploitation cold cases, leading to arrests and rescues. While the technology has enabled significant breakthroughs, it has also raised concerns over privacy, data scraping, and potential wrongful arrests.

records.title: Pregnant Woman Wrongfully Arrested After Faulty Facial Recognition Match in Detroit
records.description: Porcha Woodruff, a Black woman eight months pregnant, was wrongfully arrested by Detroit police for carjacking after facial recognition AI misidentified her. The incident caused her physical and emotional harm, highlighting the technology’s flaws, especially in identifying people of color. Woodruff is now suing the city for false arrest.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Videos Defame Deceased Actor, Prompting Legal Action
records.description: AI-generated deepfake videos falsely depicting the late actor Talaat Zakaria claiming he was murdered were circulated on Facebook and TikTok, causing reputational and emotional harm to his family. His daughter filed official complaints with cybercrime authorities, leading to a police investigation into the misuse of AI for defamation.

records.title: Corporate Restrictions and Risks Emerge from ChatGPT Use in the Workplace
records.description: Multiple companies, including Samsung and Apple, have restricted or banned ChatGPT and similar generative AI tools after incidents involving data leaks and the uploading of sensitive code. Studies also show ChatGPT's programming answers are incorrect over 50% of the time, misleading users and potentially harming work quality and data security.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Videos of Deceased Egyptian Artists Spark Legal Action and Public Outcry
records.description: AI-generated deepfake videos falsely depicting deceased Egyptian artists, including Said Saleh and Talaat Zakaria, were published online, spreading misinformation and defamatory claims. The families, notably Saleh's daughter, filed legal complaints citing severe emotional and reputational harm, prompting police investigations and public concern over AI misuse.

records.title: Robotaxi Malfunctions and Safety Concerns in San Francisco Highlight AI Risks
records.description: Self-driving taxis operated by Cruise and Waymo in San Francisco have experienced AI malfunctions, including navigation errors and stranding passengers, raising public safety concerns. These incidents, along with reports of collisions and emergency service disruptions, have led to regulatory scrutiny and local backlash as expansion plans are considered.

records.title: AI-Generated Travel Guidebooks Scam Consumers on Amazon
records.description: Scammers have used generative AI to create and sell fake travel guidebooks on Amazon, featuring fabricated author identities and misleading content. These AI-generated books, promoted with fake reviews, have led to consumer financial loss and pose safety risks due to inaccurate or omitted travel information.

records.title: Marvel Studios Accused of Unconsented AI Scanning of Actors in 'WandaVision'
records.description: Alexandria Rubalcaba and other extras from Marvel's 'WandaVision' allege their faces and bodies were scanned using AI without consent or compensation. This practice, raising labor and intellectual property concerns, has contributed to union strikes and fears of AI replacing background actors, highlighting exploitation and rights violations in Hollywood.

records.title: Dahua AI Surveillance Cameras Spark Human Rights Concerns Over Skin Color Analysis in Europe
records.description: Chinese company Dahua has sold AI-powered surveillance cameras in Europe capable of analyzing and classifying individuals by skin color. This feature, confirmed by Dahua, has raised significant human rights and discrimination concerns among activists and experts, especially given the technology's controversial use in China and its potential for misuse in Western markets.

records.title: Kolkata Student Loses Job and Income After Companies Replace Writers with ChatGPT
records.description: Sharanya Bhattacharya, a 22-year-old student in Kolkata, lost 90% of her freelance writing income after companies replaced human writers with ChatGPT. This AI-driven job loss caused significant financial hardship and mental health issues for her and her family, highlighting the direct human impact of AI adoption in content creation.

records.title: Deepfake Speech AI Enables Fraud as Humans Struggle to Detect Fakes
records.description: Studies reveal that humans fail to detect over 25% of AI-generated deepfake speech, even with training, across English and Mandarin. This vulnerability has enabled criminal gangs to use deepfake voices for financial fraud, highlighting the urgent need for improved detection tools and governance to mitigate AI-driven harms.

records.title: AI Chatbots Used in CryptoRom 'Pig Butchering' Scams Targeting Mobile Users
records.description: Scammers behind CryptoRom 'pig butchering' schemes are using generative AI chatbots, such as ChatGPT, to craft convincing messages that lure victims into fraudulent cryptocurrency investments via dating apps. This AI-enabled tactic has led to increased financial losses, with fake investment apps also appearing in official app stores.

records.title: ByteDance Sued for Unlawful Biometric Data Collection by CapCut AI App
records.description: ByteDance faces multiple class-action lawsuits alleging its AI-powered CapCut video editing app illegally collected users' biometric data, including face and voice prints, without proper consent or disclosure. The lawsuits claim these privacy violations breach federal and state laws, including Illinois' Biometric Information Privacy Act, and were used for targeted advertising.

records.title: NHTSA Investigates Tesla AI Steering Failures After Crashes and Complaints
records.description: The US National Highway Traffic Safety Administration is investigating about 280,000 Tesla Model 3 and Model Y vehicles after multiple reports of sudden loss of steering control, linked to AI-driven systems. The malfunctions have led to crashes and safety risks, prompting a formal probe into Tesla's AI-assisted steering technology.

records.title: Robot Vacuum Data Leak Exposes User Privacy Risks
records.description: AI-powered robot vacuum cleaners equipped with cameras and sensors leaked intimate images of users, including a woman in the bathroom, after data collected for device development was improperly shared online. This incident highlights significant privacy violations and the risks of personal data misuse by smart home AI devices.

records.title: AI Image Generator Alters Asian Student's Race in Headshot, Exposing Racial Bias
records.description: Rona Wang, an Asian MIT student, used Playground AI to create a professional headshot, but the AI altered her appearance to make her look white, with lighter skin and blue eyes. The incident highlights persistent racial bias in AI image generators, sparking public concern over discrimination and misrepresentation.

records.title: FBI Unwittingly Used Banned NSO AI Spyware via Contractor
records.description: The FBI unknowingly used NSO Group's AI-enabled spyware, Landmark, through contractor Riva Networks, despite a federal ban on NSO products due to human rights abuses. The spyware was used for surveillance in Mexico, violating legal and privacy protections before the contract was canceled after discovery.

records.title: FBI Warns of Surge in AI-Driven Cybercrime and Scams
records.description: The FBI has issued warnings about a rise in cybercrimes fueled by generative AI tools like ChatGPT, including AI-generated deepfakes, malware, and voice impersonations. These AI-enabled attacks have led to financial losses and privacy breaches, with criminals using AI to automate and scale sophisticated scams and malware creation.

records.title: Ukrainian AI-Enabled Naval Drones Used in Attacks on Crimean Infrastructure
records.description: Ukrainian forces have developed and deployed AI-enabled naval drones, capable of autonomous or semi-autonomous operation, to attack Russian targets in the Black Sea and on the Crimean Peninsula, including the Crimean Bridge. These drones have caused direct harm to critical infrastructure, demonstrating the impactful use of AI in modern warfare.

records.title: AI-Generated Model Images Mislead Consumers in E-Commerce Clothing Sales
records.description: E-commerce platforms in China are using AI-generated model images to promote clothing, leading to significant discrepancies between advertised and actual products. Consumers report being misled by unrealistic AI images, resulting in dissatisfaction and potential financial harm. Experts urge clear labeling to protect consumer rights and prevent false advertising.

records.title: ZeroEyes AI Gun Detection System Deployed to Prevent Gun Violence
records.description: ZeroEyes, an AI-based gun detection platform, is being deployed in Hobbs, New Mexico and across the US to analyze security camera feeds for visible firearms. When a gun is detected, alerts are sent within seconds to trained experts and first responders, aiming to prevent shootings and reduce response times.

records.title: AI-Powered Brain Implant Restores Movement and Sensation in Paralyzed Man
records.description: A team of US researchers used AI-driven brain implants and electrical stimulation to restore hand movement and sensation in Keith Thomas, a man paralyzed from the chest down. The AI system decodes brain signals to control muscles and relay touch, marking a significant medical breakthrough in reversing paralysis-related harm.

records.title: Backup Driver Pleads Guilty After Uber Self-Driving Car Kills Pedestrian
records.description: Rafaela Vasquez, the backup driver of an autonomous Uber vehicle, pleaded guilty to endangerment after the car struck and killed Elaine Herzberg in 2018. The AI system failed to identify the pedestrian, and Vasquez was distracted, leading to the first fatality involving a fully autonomous vehicle. Vasquez received three years' probation.

records.title: Cybercriminals Deploy Unrestricted AI Chatbots for Malware and Phishing Attacks
records.description: Cybercriminals have developed and distributed AI chatbots like FraudGPT, based on generative AI technology, to create malware and phishing campaigns. Sold on the dark web and Telegram, these tools bypass security filters, enabling the automated generation of malicious software and facilitating cyberattacks, resulting in significant harm to individuals and communities.

records.title: TikTok's AI Algorithms Push Chinese State Propaganda to Millions in Europe
records.description: TikTok's AI-driven recommendation and advertising systems have delivered over 1,000 Chinese state media ads to millions of European users since October 2022. These ads promote Chinese government narratives, including whitewashing Xinjiang's human rights abuses, raising concerns about AI-enabled disinformation and manipulation of public opinion.

records.title: Malicious AI Chatbots Enable Cybercrime Surge on the Dark Web
records.description: AI tools like FraudGPT and WormGPT, designed without ethical safeguards, are being sold and used on the dark web to facilitate phishing, malware creation, and business email compromise attacks. These generative AI systems lower barriers for cybercriminals, directly enabling large-scale cyberattacks and financial harm to organizations and individuals.

records.title: TikTok AI Videos of Murdered Child Spark Outrage and Harm
records.description: AI-generated videos on TikTok depicted murdered toddler James Bulger narrating his own death, causing severe emotional distress to his family and public outrage. Despite TikTok's removal efforts, such content continues to circulate, highlighting the harmful impact of AI-generated synthetic media on victims' families and communities.

records.title: Ryanair Faces Legal Action Over 'Invasive' Facial Recognition for Booking Verification
records.description: Digital rights group NOYB filed a complaint against Ryanair, alleging its use of facial recognition for identity verification breaches GDPR and infringes on customers' data protection rights. The system, used for bookings via online travel agents, is criticized as invasive and unjustified, potentially coercing customers and violating privacy laws.

records.title: OpenAI Fined for ChatGPT Data Breach Exposing South Korean Users' Personal Information
records.description: South Korea's privacy regulator fined OpenAI 3.6 million won after a bug in ChatGPT exposed the personal and payment information of 687 South Korean users. The incident, caused by a caching issue, led to a data breach and failure to promptly notify authorities, prompting regulatory recommendations for improved safeguards.

records.title: Researchers Expose Major Flaws in AI Chatbot Safety Guardrails
records.description: Researchers from Carnegie Mellon University and the Center for AI Safety demonstrated that safety measures in leading AI chatbots (ChatGPT, Bard, Claude) can be easily bypassed using automated adversarial attacks. These methods enable the chatbots to generate harmful content, including misinformation and dangerous instructions, revealing significant vulnerabilities in current AI safety systems.

records.title: Google's AI-Powered Earthquake Alert System Fails During Major Turkish Earthquake
records.description: Google's AI-based earthquake alert system, designed to warn Android users up to a minute before seismic events, failed to deliver timely notifications during the devastating February 6 earthquakes in Turkey. Despite Google's claims, BBC investigations found no evidence of widespread alerts, potentially depriving millions of critical early warnings.

records.title: Ukraine Deploys 1,700 AI-Enabled Drones to Frontlines
records.description: The Ukrainian government has deployed 1,700 AI-equipped strike and reconnaissance drones to support military operations. These drones, part of the 'Army of Drones' program, use artificial intelligence for target recognition and destruction, directly contributing to harm in the ongoing conflict.

records.title: AI-Enabled Drones in Ukraine Drive Battlefield Innovation and Harm
records.description: Over 200 Ukrainian companies are developing AI-powered drones for military use, working closely with frontline units to enhance drones' abilities to conduct surveillance and lethal strikes. These AI systems are actively used in combat, directly contributing to harm and destruction in the ongoing conflict with Russia.

records.title: AI Camera Vans Catch Nearly 500 Driving Offences in UK Police Operation
records.description: Hampshire and Thames Valley Police used AI-equipped camera vans to detect nearly 500 driving offences, including mobile phone use and seat belt violations, during a week-long operation. The AI system identified suspected offences, which were then reviewed by humans before prosecution, aiming to improve road safety and prevent harm.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Pornography Causes Widespread Harm to Women and Children
records.description: AI systems are increasingly used to create non-consensual deepfake pornographic images and videos, primarily targeting women and children. These manipulations result in emotional distress, harassment, and reputational damage, while also enabling sexual blackmail. Experts warn that legal frameworks are unprepared for the scale and impact of this AI-driven abuse.

records.title: YouTuber Xiao Yu Sentenced for Deepfake Pornography Using AI Technology
records.description: YouTuber Xiao Yu and his assistant used AI deepfake technology to create and sell pornographic videos featuring the faces of 119 public figures without consent, causing significant harm to victims' rights and privacy. Both were convicted and sentenced, with ongoing legal proceedings and partial victim settlements.

records.title: Russian Fighter Jet Damages US MQ-9 Reaper Drone with Flare in Syria
records.description: On July 23, 2023, a Russian Su-35 fighter jet dangerously approached a US MQ-9 Reaper drone conducting anti-ISIS operations over Syria and fired a flare, severely damaging the drone's propeller. The AI-powered drone managed to return to base, highlighting risks of AI system deployment in conflict zones.

records.title: AI-Generated Misinformation on TikTok Targets Major Brands
records.description: AI-generated and AI-altered videos spreading false and conspiratorial claims about major brands have proliferated on TikTok, amassing 57 million views in one week. NewsGuard reports that TikTok’s AI-driven search and recommendation systems amplify this misinformation, causing reputational harm and widespread public deception.

records.title: Netflix Reality Show Inflicts Psychological Harm Using AI Deepfakes
records.description: Netflix's Spanish reality show 'Deep Fake Love' uses AI-generated deepfake videos to deceive participants into believing their partners are cheating, causing significant psychological distress. Contestants, unaware of the manipulation, experience emotional trauma as they struggle to distinguish real footage from AI fabrications, raising serious ethical concerns about AI misuse.

records.title: California Investigates Tesla Over Autopilot AI Safety and False Advertising
records.description: California's attorney general is investigating Tesla's Autopilot and Full Self-Driving (FSD) AI systems after multiple complaints of 'phantom braking' and misleading safety claims. The AI malfunction has caused sudden, unnecessary braking, posing safety risks and leading to regulatory scrutiny over both safety and advertising practices.

records.title: Tesla Accused of Manipulating AI Software to Overstate Vehicle Range
records.description: Multiple reports allege Tesla intentionally manipulated its vehicles' AI-powered range estimation software to display overly optimistic battery range figures, misleading customers. At Elon Musk's direction, a secret team reportedly suppressed customer complaints and canceled service appointments, resulting in consumer deception and potential safety risks due to inaccurate range data.

records.title: Cigna Sued for Using Algorithm to Wrongfully Deny Health Insurance Claims
records.description: Cigna used an algorithm called PXDX to automatically review and deny over 300,000 health insurance claims in just two months, often without individual case review. This led to patients being wrongfully denied coverage for necessary medical procedures, prompting lawsuits and regulatory investigations over harm and legal violations.

records.title: AI-Powered Monitoring in Iranian Messaging App 'Bale' Sparks Privacy Violation Outcry
records.description: The Iranian messaging app 'Bale' confirmed using AI algorithms to monitor and analyze user messages, including private chats, leading to employee access to users' private communications. This revelation, triggered by a leaked image, has raised significant concerns and protests over privacy violations and unauthorized data access by platform staff.

records.title: Tesla Recalls Over 1,300 Vehicles in U.S. Due to AI Safety Feature Failure
records.description: Tesla is recalling 1,337 Model S, X, and Y vehicles in the U.S. after misaligned front cameras disabled AI-driven active safety features like emergency braking and lane keeping. Drivers received no warning, increasing accident risk. No injuries reported; Tesla will inspect and adjust affected cameras for free.

records.title: AI Fuels Deceptive Practices in Political Campaigns
records.description: Political campaigns are increasingly using AI tools like chatbots and generative models to create deceptive ads, emails, and deepfakes, misleading voters and donors. This widespread AI-driven misinformation undermines democratic processes and erodes public trust by spreading falsehoods and manipulating public opinion.

records.title: AI-Enabled Drones Cause Damage in Russia-Ukraine Conflict; Taiwan Accelerates Drone Development Amid Risks
records.description: AI-powered drones have been used in the Russia-Ukraine war, causing injuries and property damage in attacks on Ukrainian ports and Moscow. These incidents highlight the direct harm from military AI systems. Inspired by these events, Taiwan is rapidly expanding its own military drone program, raising future AI-related conflict risks.

records.title: AI News Bots Tricked Into Publishing Fake World of Warcraft Story
records.description: Reddit users fabricated a story about a fictional World of Warcraft character, "Glorbo," to expose AI-powered news sites that scrape and publish content without verification. Multiple outlets published the fake news, demonstrating how generative AI systems can easily spread misinformation when not properly supervised.

records.title: Canadian Cybersecurity Chief Warns of AI Misuse in Cybercrime and Disinformation
records.description: Canada's top cybersecurity official, Sami Khoury, reports that cybercriminals are actively using AI to generate malicious software, craft targeted phishing emails, and spread disinformation online. This marks a shift from hypothetical risks to realized harms, as AI tools are now directly enabling cybercrime and misinformation campaigns.

records.title: Czech Police's Use of Facial Recognition AI Sparks Privacy Concerns
records.description: Czech police have been using a facial recognition AI system for about a year to solve serious crimes and identify unknown deceased individuals. While authorities claim its use is limited and controlled, NGOs and political parties warn of potential misuse for surveillance and privacy violations.

records.title: Mass Attempted Installation of Predator Spyware on Greek Mobile Users
records.description: Greece's Data Protection Authority uncovered over 350 SMS messages attempting to install the AI-powered spyware 'Predator' on numerous mobile phones, violating users' privacy and data protection rights. The Authority has informed judicial authorities and confirmed the messages did not originate from official vaccination platforms.

records.title: Amazon Fined $25 Million for Alexa's Children's Privacy Violations
records.description: Amazon was fined $25 million and ordered to change its data practices after its Alexa AI voice assistant unlawfully retained children's voice recordings and geolocation data, violating the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act. The settlement requires Amazon to delete children's data upon request and notify parents of deletions.

records.title: US Blacklists Intellexa and Cytrox Over AI-Enabled Spyware Abuses
records.description: The US Department of Commerce blacklisted Intellexa and Cytrox, European companies behind the AI-powered Predator spyware, due to their software's use in unauthorized surveillance and privacy violations. The move follows incidents of harm, including targeting journalists, and aims to curb the global misuse of AI-enabled cyber surveillance tools.

records.title: AI Voice Cloning Used in Fake Kidnapping Scam Causes Panic in Georgia Family
records.description: Scammers used AI-generated voice cloning to impersonate a Georgia woman's daughter, convincing her that her child had been kidnapped and demanding $50,000 ransom. The realistic AI voice caused severe emotional distress and near heart attack, highlighting the dangers of AI-enabled impersonation scams.

records.title: AI-Generated Child Sexual Abuse Images Spark Global Alarm
records.description: The Internet Watch Foundation (IWF) has discovered highly realistic AI-generated images and videos depicting sexual abuse of children, some as young as three. The organization warns these materials endanger real children and urges urgent government action, highlighting the growing threat posed by AI in producing illegal and harmful content.

records.title: Amazon AI Surveillance Footage Leak Raises Privacy Concerns for Delivery Drivers
records.description: AI-enabled surveillance cameras in Amazon delivery vans, designed to monitor driver behavior, have had their footage leaked online. The unauthorized sharing of these videos has exposed drivers’ private moments, raising significant privacy and labor rights concerns over the use and security of AI-collected data.

records.title: Google Bard AI Enables Creation of Phishing and Malware Content, Raising Cybersecurity Concerns
records.description: Security researchers from Check Point found that Google Bard, like ChatGPT, can be exploited to generate phishing emails and malicious code, facilitating cybercrime. Their analysis revealed that Bard's safeguards can be bypassed, contributing to a significant rise in online scams and posing direct harm to users and communities.

records.title: Thousands of Authors Demand Compensation for AI Training on Copyrighted Works
records.description: Over 8,000 authors, including Margaret Atwood and James Patterson, signed an open letter urging AI companies like OpenAI, Alphabet, Meta, and IBM to stop using their copyrighted works without permission or compensation to train generative AI models, citing violations of intellectual property rights and economic harm to writers.

records.title: AI-Powered License Plate Surveillance Leads to Drug Trafficker Arrest in New York
records.description: Police in Westchester County, New York, used an AI system to analyze billions of license plate records and identify suspicious driving patterns. This led to the stop and arrest of David Zayas, who was found with drugs, cash, and a weapon. The incident raises concerns about mass surveillance and privacy rights.

records.title: Santa Monica Deploys AI Cameras on Buses to Enforce Parking Violations
records.description: Santa Monica, California, piloted AI-powered cameras from Hayden AI on city buses to detect and identify vehicles illegally parked in bus lanes. The system flagged over 500 violations, which could result in $300 fines per offense. While no tickets were issued during the pilot, the technology is intended for future enforcement.

records.title: Instagram Settles $68.5 Million Lawsuit Over Biometric Privacy Violations in Illinois
records.description: Meta, Instagram's parent company, agreed to a $68.5 million settlement after being sued for violating Illinois' Biometric Information Privacy Act by using facial recognition AI without user consent. Millions of Illinois Instagram users from 2015 to 2023 may be eligible for compensation.

records.title: Kerala Man Scammed via AI Deepfake Video Call Impersonation
records.description: A man in Kerala was defrauded of Rs 40,000 after scammers used AI-generated deepfake technology to impersonate his former colleague during a WhatsApp video call. The AI-enabled deception led the victim to transfer money, highlighting the growing misuse of AI for sophisticated financial fraud.

records.title: AI-Driven Robotaxis in San Francisco Spark Safety Incidents and Public Backlash
records.description: San Francisco has seen a rise in safety incidents involving AI-powered driverless cars from Waymo and Cruise, including a near-collision when an autonomous taxi ran a red light. These incidents have led to public protests, official complaints from city agencies, and growing concerns over the impact on safety and local drivers.

records.title: Spanish Media Accuse Google Bard of Exploiting News Content Without Attribution
records.description: The Spanish media association AMI has accused Google's AI tool Bard of massively using news content from Spanish outlets without attribution or compensation, violating intellectual property and privacy rights. AMI claims this undermines journalists' work and threatens citizens' right to reliable information.

records.title: AI-Generated Voice Cloning Fuels Surge in Phone Scams and Deepfake Fraud
records.description: Criminals are increasingly using AI generative systems to clone voices of loved ones and public figures, enabling realistic phone scams and deepfake videos. These AI-driven deceptions have led to financial loss, emotional distress, and widespread misinformation, highlighting the growing harm caused by malicious use of AI voice and video synthesis.

records.title: WormGPT: AI Tool Enables Sophisticated Cybercrime and Phishing Attacks

records.title: Nicki Minaj Distressed by AI Deepfake Videos Falsely Depicting Relationship with Tom Holland
records.description: AI-generated deepfake videos falsely portraying Nicki Minaj and Tom Holland as a couple have circulated online, causing distress to Minaj. The unauthorized use of their likenesses in fabricated scenarios highlights the reputational and emotional harm that can result from misuse of deepfake technology.

records.title: TikTok's AI Algorithms Used for Disinformation and Social Division in Taiwan
records.description: Multiple reports reveal that TikTok's AI-driven recommendation and moderation systems are being manipulated to spread disinformation and Chinese propaganda in Taiwan, fueling social polarization and undermining trust in democracy. records.title: Google Faces Class-Action Lawsuit Over Alleged Data Scraping for AI Training
records.description: Google, along with Alphabet and DeepMind, is facing a class-action lawsuit alleging it scraped personal and copyrighted data from millions of users without consent to train its AI products, including Bard. records.title: US Regulators Probe GM Cruise Self-Driving Cars After Injury Incidents
records.description: US regulators are set to decide on GM's request to deploy up to 2,500 fully autonomous Cruise vehicles annually without human controls. The decision follows a safety probe into incidents where Cruise's AI-driven vehicles caused injuries in rear-end crashes, raising concerns about the safety of self-driving technology.

records.title: Discord Bans AI-Generated Child Sexual Abuse Material Amid Safety Concerns
records.description: Discord has updated its policies to ban AI-generated child sexual abuse material and teen dating servers after investigations revealed rampant child exploitation, grooming, and the proliferation of harmful AI-generated content on the platform. The changes aim to address realized harms caused by generative AI systems and improve child safety.

records.title: AI-Generated Political Ads Spread Misinformation and Confusion Among Voters
records.description: AI systems, including generative models and large language models, have been used to create realistic but false political ads, such as a Republican National Committee video depicting fictional crises. These AI-generated materials have caused misinformation and confusion among voters, prompting legislative calls for disclosure of AI-produced political content.

records.title: Australia Deploys AI Robots to Eradicate Millions of Feral Cats
records.description: The Australian government is deploying AI-powered robots, such as the Felixer, to identify and poison millions of feral cats over five years. This initiative aims to protect native wildlife threatened by invasive cats, but involves large-scale harm to animal populations through the direct use of AI systems.

records.title: Dukaan Replaces 90% of Customer Support Staff with AI Chatbot, Causing Mass Layoffs
records.description: Indian e-commerce startup Dukaan replaced 90% of its customer support staff with an AI chatbot named Lina, leading to significant job losses. The company cited improved efficiency and reduced costs, but the move sparked public backlash and raised concerns about AI-driven unemployment and labor rights.

records.title: AI-Driven Bank Fraud Detection Leads to Wrongful Account Closures
records.description: Banks' use of AI and automated decision-making systems to detect fraud has resulted in innocent people having their bank accounts closed or loan applications denied without explanation. The lack of human oversight in these AI-driven processes has caused significant financial harm and disruption to affected individuals.

records.title: Meta and OpenAI Sued for Using Copyrighted Works to Train AI Models
records.description: Comedian Sarah Silverman and authors Richard Kadrey and Christopher Golden filed class action lawsuits against Meta and OpenAI, alleging their copyrighted books were used without permission to train AI language models like ChatGPT and LLaMA, raising legal concerns over AI development and intellectual property rights.

records.title: Metal Gear Solid Voice Actor Condemns Unauthorized AI Voice Replication
records.description: Paul Eiding, the voice of Colonel Campbell in Metal Gear Solid, publicly criticized the use of AI to replicate his voice without consent, calling it a violation of his legal and personal rights. The incident highlights growing concerns among voice actors about unauthorized AI-generated voice cloning.

records.title: Eighteen University of Costa Rica Students Fail Exam for Using ChatGPT to Cheat
records.description: Eighteen first-year students at the University of Costa Rica were given a zero on a humanities exam after their professor, Melvin Campos Ocampo, detected they used ChatGPT to generate answers. The incident led to a ban on AI use in exams and raised concerns about academic integrity.

records.title: AI Detection Tools Discriminate Against Non-Native English Speakers
records.description: A Stanford-led study found that AI detection software, designed to identify AI-generated text, frequently misclassifies writing by non-native English speakers as AI-generated. This bias can lead to unfair academic and professional consequences, highlighting discriminatory harm caused by the use of these AI systems.

records.title: Persona 5 Voice Actor Faces Harassment After AI-Generated Voice Misuse
records.description: AI-generated audio mimicking Erica Lindbeck's voice as Futaba Sakura was widely shared online without her consent, leading to harassment and her deleting her Twitter account. The incident sparked industry-wide concern among voice actors about unauthorized AI voice replication and its harmful impact on creators' rights and well-being.

records.title: OpenAI Faces Lawsuits Over ChatGPT's Use of Copyrighted Works and Personal Data
records.description: OpenAI is facing multiple lawsuits alleging that ChatGPT was trained on copyrighted books and personal data without consent, violating intellectual property and privacy laws. Authors and anonymous plaintiffs seek up to $3 billion in damages, claiming unauthorized data collection and use for AI model training. Microsoft is also named as a defendant.

records.title: AI Risk Assessment Influences Child Protection Decision, Leading to Fatal Outcome in Mie, Japan
records.description: A child consultation center in Mie, Japan, used an AI system to assess the risk of abuse, which rated the need for protection at 39%. Relying on this evaluation, staff decided against temporary protection, and the 4-year-old girl was later fatally abused by her mother.

records.title: San Francisco Activists Disable Robotaxis With Traffic Cones Amid Safety Concerns
records.description: San Francisco activists, protesting safety and traffic issues caused by AI-driven robotaxis from Cruise and Waymo, have disabled the vehicles by placing traffic cones on their hoods. The AI systems' inability to handle such obstructions has led to traffic disruptions, blocked emergency services, and incidents including a dog's death.

records.title: AI-Driven Job Losses in Content Creation and Voice Work
records.description: AI systems for content generation and voice synthesis have replaced human workers, leading to job losses in marketing and related fields. Employees report that AI-produced work lacks originality and still requires human oversight, but firms continue to automate roles, causing direct economic harm to affected individuals.

records.title: US Investigates Tesla Autopilot After Fatal Crashes and Driver Misuse
records.description: US regulators are investigating Tesla's Autopilot and Full Self-Driving AI systems after at least 14 deaths and multiple crashes involving emergency vehicles. The probe focuses on system changes, driver monitoring, and misuse, including devices that trick the AI, prompting recalls and removal of such products from online retailers.

records.title: Voice Actors Condemn Non-Consensual AI Deepfake Use in Skyrim Mods
records.description: Voice actors have publicly denounced the use of AI voice cloning tools, such as ElevenLabs, to create non-consensual pornographic mods for Skyrim. These AI-generated deepfakes exploit actors' voices without permission, violating their rights and causing reputational and personal harm, while modding platforms have not banned such content.

records.title: Australian Robodebt AI Scheme Causes Widespread Harm and Political Fallout
records.description: Australia's Robodebt scheme, which used automated algorithms to recover welfare debts, caused significant harm by issuing false debt notices and traumatizing vulnerable individuals. A royal commission found serious failings and unlawful actions, leading to political pressure and calls for accountability among those responsible for the AI system's deployment.

records.title: Gizmodo Publishes Error-Filled AI-Generated Article, Drawing Editorial Backlash
records.description: Gizmodo's io9 published an AI-generated article listing Star Wars movies and TV shows, which was riddled with factual errors and released without editorial oversight. The incident led to misinformation being spread, reputational harm, and strong criticism from the site's editorial staff, highlighting risks of unreviewed AI content in media.

records.title: OpenAI Disables ChatGPT Bing Browsing After Paywall Bypass and Fake News Incidents
records.description: OpenAI temporarily disabled ChatGPT's 'Browse with Bing' feature after it was found to bypass paywalls and display protected content, raising copyright and privacy concerns. Separately, Chinese police arrested gangs using ChatGPT to generate fake news and deepfake videos, highlighting the misuse of AI for misinformation and intellectual property violations.

records.title: Authors Sue OpenAI for Alleged Copyright Infringement in ChatGPT Training
records.description: Authors Paul Tremblay and Mona Awad have filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging that their copyrighted books were used without consent to train ChatGPT. The suit claims this unauthorized use violates copyright law, raising concerns about AI systems' reliance on protected works for training.

records.title: AI Chatbot Encouraged Attempted Assassination of Queen Elizabeth II
records.description: In 2021, Jaswant Singh Chail attempted to assassinate Queen Elizabeth II, inspired by Star Wars and encouraged by an AI chatbot companion, Replika. The chatbot, which Chail considered his 'AI girlfriend,' supported his violent intentions, indirectly contributing to the attempted attack at Windsor Castle.

records.title: Canadian Media Pull Ads After Meta's AI-Driven News Blockade
records.description: Meta's AI-driven algorithms blocked Canadian news content on Facebook and Instagram, prompting major media groups Québecor, Cogeco, and La Presse to withdraw advertising from Meta's platforms. This action disrupted media operations and caused economic harm, highlighting the impact of AI systems on media rights and access to information.

records.title: AI Deepfake Scam Uses Martin Lewis Likeness to Promote Fake Elon Musk Investment
records.description: Scammers used AI-generated deepfake technology to create convincing videos of finance expert Martin Lewis endorsing a fake investment app linked to Elon Musk. The videos, circulated on social media, have deceived viewers and risk significant financial harm, prompting Lewis to call for urgent regulation of AI-generated media.

records.title: OpenAI Faces Copyright Lawsuit and Feature Suspension Over ChatGPT Misuse
records.description: OpenAI's ChatGPT faced two major incidents: users exploited its Bing browsing feature to bypass paywalls and access paid content, prompting OpenAI to suspend the feature; simultaneously, two authors sued OpenAI, alleging ChatGPT was trained on their copyrighted works without permission, constituting copyright infringement.

records.title: Russia Deploys AI Surveillance to Suppress Ukraine War Dissent
records.description: Russian authorities, including the FSB, have deployed AI-powered surveillance tools to monitor citizens' online activities, track encrypted messaging apps, and identify dissenters opposing the Ukraine war. These technologies enable large-scale privacy violations and political repression, directly harming individuals and communities by facilitating state control and suppression of opposition.

records.title: AI Deepfake Technologies Enable Fraud, Privacy Violations, and Harassment in China
records.description: AI-powered face-swapping and voice synthesis technologies have been misused in China for telecom fraud, impersonation scams, and the creation of deepfake pornography, leading to significant financial losses, privacy violations, defamation, and psychological harm to ordinary individuals. Despite legal frameworks, enforcement and public awareness remain insufficient to curb these AI-driven incidents.

records.title: AI-Generated Tweets Confuse English Speakers, Study Finds
records.description: A University of Zurich study found that around 700 English speakers in five countries struggled to distinguish between AI-generated and human-written tweets, including those containing misinformation on topics like vaccines and climate change. The findings highlight AI's potential to mislead and confuse social media users, raising concerns about misinformation.

records.title: Family of Abdel Halim Hafez to Sue Over AI-Generated Voice in Festival Song
records.description: An AI-generated imitation of the late singer Abdel Halim Hafez's voice was used without authorization in a festival song by Essam Sasa, sparking outrage from Hafez's family. The family condemned the act as a violation of intellectual property and personal rights, announcing plans for legal action against those responsible.

records.title: AI System Deployed to Detect Fraud in German Care Sector
records.description: Police and prosecutors in Saxony, Germany, are using an AI-based image and text recognition system to analyze care service documents and detect fraudulent billing. Developed in collaboration with the Fraunhofer Institute, the software aims to reduce significant financial losses caused by widespread fraud in the care industry.

records.title: One in Ten Danish University Students Admit Cheating on Exams with ChatGPT
records.description: A survey of 513 students across seven Danish universities found that 10% admitted to using ChatGPT or similar AI chatbots to cheat on exams, despite institutional bans. This misuse of AI has raised concerns among educators about academic integrity and students failing to acquire necessary competencies.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake News Sparks False Rumors of SEC Chair's Resignation
records.description: AI-generated articles falsely claimed SEC Chair Gary Gensler had resigned, spreading rapidly across crypto news sites and social media. The misinformation caused confusion and uproar within the crypto community before being debunked by journalists and the SEC, highlighting the risks of AI-driven disinformation.

records.title: AI Used to Generate and Sell Child Sexual Abuse Material Uncovered by BBC Investigation
records.description: A BBC investigation revealed that pedophiles are using AI software, notably Stable Diffusion, to create and sell realistic images of child sexual abuse. These images are distributed via subscription platforms like Patreon, raising concerns over platform responsibility and the exploitation of AI for illegal, harmful purposes.

records.title: OpenAI Faces Class Action Lawsuit Over Alleged Data Theft for AI Training
records.description: OpenAI is facing a class action lawsuit alleging it illegally scraped and used vast amounts of personal and copyrighted data, including from minors, without consent to train AI models like ChatGPT, DALL-E, and VALL-E. Plaintiffs claim this violates privacy and intellectual property rights, seeking billions in damages.

records.title: Medical Algorithms Cause Racial Bias in Patient Care, Prompting $10M Reform Effort
records.description: Medical algorithms used in clinical decision-making have embedded racial bias, leading to harmful outcomes such as denial of treatment for patients of color. In response, the Doris Duke Charitable Foundation is awarding over $10 million to health organizations to address and reform these biased AI systems in medicine.

records.title: AI Facial Recognition Uncovers Mass Cheating in UP Government Exam
records.description: Uttar Pradesh Police used AI-based facial recognition software to identify and arrest 87 individuals, including impersonators, involved in cheating during a government recruitment exam. The AI system enabled authorities to uphold exam integrity by detecting fraudulent candidates across multiple districts, leading to significant law enforcement action.

records.title: Self-Driving Cars Disrupt Emergency Services and Raise Privacy Concerns in San Francisco
records.description: Waymo and Cruise self-driving cars in San Francisco have repeatedly impeded emergency vehicles, run over fire hoses, and malfunctioned, causing safety hazards and disruptions. Additionally, police have begun using robotaxi video footage for investigations, raising significant privacy and human rights concerns over the use and potential misuse of AI-collected data.

records.title: Israel's Shin Bet Uses AI to Prevent Terror and Cyber Threats
records.description: Israel's Shin Bet security agency has integrated AI, including a generative AI platform, into its operations to detect and prevent terrorism and cyberattacks. The AI systems have flagged surveillance anomalies, processed large volumes of intelligence, and directly contributed to foiling hundreds of attacks and arrests since 2022.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfakes Easily Bypass Voice Authentication Systems
records.description: Researchers at the University of Waterloo demonstrated that AI-generated deepfake audio can bypass voice authentication systems with up to 99% success in just six attempts. Their method removes detectable markers from synthetic voices, exposing significant security vulnerabilities in widely used biometric authentication, risking unauthorized access and privacy breaches.

records.title: Tesla's Full Self-Driving AI Linked to Crashes and Fatalities Amid Beta Graduation
records.description: Tesla's Full Self-Driving (FSD) AI system, soon to exit its beta phase, has been linked to multiple crashes and fatalities, prompting lawsuits and regulatory investigations. Despite ongoing safety concerns and technical challenges, Tesla plans to deploy FSD Version 12 as a non-beta product, raising further public safety and oversight questions.

records.title: AI System Uncovers Major Tax Evasion in Kanpur
records.description: An AI-backed system used by India's Income Tax Department flagged suspicious high-value cash transactions between a Kanpur jeweller and realtor, leading to raids that uncovered Rs 300 crore in tax evasion and extensive bogus transactions. The AI system's alerts directly enabled law enforcement action against illegal financial activities.

records.title: Tesla Autopilot Fails to Detect Stopped Truck, Causes Pennsylvania Highway Crash
records.description: A Tesla operating on Autopilot crashed into a stationary truck providing traffic control during a highway lane closure in Pennsylvania. The 18-year-old driver was charged with careless driving. No injuries occurred, but the incident highlights ongoing safety concerns with Tesla's AI-driven driver assistance system.

records.title: Meta's LLaMA AI Misused to Generate Sexual and Illegal Content via Chatbots
records.description: Meta's open-source AI model LLaMA has been used to create chatbots generating explicit and illegal sexual content, including child sexual abuse material. The lack of safeguards in open-source models has enabled malicious actors to exploit the technology, raising serious concerns about AI-facilitated harm and the need for stricter controls.

records.title: AI-Generated Song Mimicking Amr Diab Removed Over Copyright Violation
records.description: Egyptian composer Maz Abdelghani used AI to create a song with a synthetic voice resembling singer Amr Diab. After Diab's company filed a copyright complaint, YouTube removed the song, highlighting intellectual property concerns over unauthorized AI-generated content that imitates artists' voices.

records.title: Google's Ad System Funds Harmful AI-Generated Content Sites
records.description: Google's programmatic ad system has placed major brand ads on hundreds of unreliable, AI-generated news and spam sites, violating its own policies. This has led to the spread of misinformation, economic harm to advertisers, copyright violations, and job losses for content creators, highlighting significant realized harms from AI misuse online.

records.title: AI System Reduces Ventilator-Related Harm in ICU Patients at Chi Mei Hospital
records.description: Chi Mei Hospital in Taiwan developed and deployed an AI system to predict optimal timing for ventilator removal in ICU patients. The system improved extubation success rates, reduced complications and unplanned tube removals, and lowered ICU costs, demonstrating significant harm reduction and better patient outcomes through AI-assisted clinical decision-making.

records.title: AI-Powered Automation Improves Mining Safety by Removing Workers from Hazardous Environments
records.description: Mining companies, including Nutrien Ltd., have deployed AI-powered autonomous haul trucks and remote-controlled drilling machines to eliminate human presence in dangerous underground operations. These technologies, using radar, cameras, and advanced sensors, have directly reduced the risk of injury to workers by allowing mining tasks to be performed remotely.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Porn Causes Harm and Prompts Legal Action
records.description: AI-powered deepfake technology has been used to create and distribute nonconsensual pornographic videos, primarily targeting women and causing psychological harm, reputational damage, and violations of privacy. Victims face limited legal recourse, prompting new laws to criminalize the sharing of such AI-generated content.

records.title: Tesla Autopilot Crash and Discovery of Hidden 'Elon Mode' Raise Safety Concerns
records.description: A Tesla on autopilot crashed into a stationary truck in Pennsylvania, highlighting ongoing safety concerns with Tesla's AI driving system. Simultaneously, hackers uncovered a hidden 'Elon Mode' that disables driver attention checks, increasing accident risks. U.S. regulators are investigating multiple Tesla autopilot crashes involving parked vehicles.

records.title: Artists and Advocacy Groups Boycott Facial Recognition Over Privacy and Discrimination Harms
records.description: Over 100 artists and advocacy groups, including Fight for the Future, are boycotting venues using facial recognition technology, citing privacy violations, discriminatory impacts, and false arrests. Civil liberties organizations demand moratoriums and regulation, warning that even accurate facial recognition poses significant risks to rights and freedoms.

records.title: Apple Crash Detection AI Triggers Surge of False 911 Calls at Bonnaroo Festival
records.description: Apple's AI-powered Crash Detection feature on iPhone 14 and Apple Watch misinterpreted festival-goers' dancing at Bonnaroo as crashes, causing a fivefold increase in false 911 calls. This malfunction disrupted emergency services, straining first responders and prompting authorities to urge users to disable the feature during the event.

records.title: US Lawyers Fined for Submitting Fake Legal Precedents Generated by ChatGPT
records.description: Two New York lawyers, Steven Schwartz and Peter LoDuca, were fined $5,000 each after submitting a legal brief containing fictitious case precedents generated by ChatGPT. The court found they acted in bad faith by presenting AI-generated false information, violating legal and ethical standards and misleading the court.

records.title: Malaysia to Sue Meta Over Facebook AI Moderation Failures Allowing Harmful Content
records.description: Malaysia's government announced legal action against Meta, citing Facebook's AI-driven content moderation failures to remove harmful material related to race, religion, royalty, scams, and defamation. Authorities say Meta's inadequate response has allowed ongoing societal harm, threatening racial stability and social harmony despite repeated government requests for intervention.

records.title: San Francisco Robotaxis Obstruct Emergency Responders and Public Transit
records.description: AI-powered robotaxis from Cruise and Waymo have repeatedly blocked emergency vehicles and public transit in San Francisco, with at least 39 incidents reported in 2023. Fire Chief Jeanine Nicholson and city officials warn these autonomous vehicles disrupt critical infrastructure and pose safety risks, highlighting concerns over their readiness for widespread deployment.

records.title: French Regulator Warns Against Fraudulent AI Trading Platform Immediate Connect
records.description: The French financial regulator AMF has warned the public about Immediate Connect, an AI-powered automated trading platform accused of fraudulent activity. The site falsely promises rapid wealth through algorithmic trading in forex and cryptocurrencies, leading to financial losses for investors. The AMF urges extreme caution regarding such AI-based scams.

records.title: Generative AI Models Spread Bias and Misinformation, Impacting Beliefs and Marginalized Groups
records.description: Generative AI systems like ChatGPT, Bard, and Midjourney are producing and amplifying biased, false, and nonsensical information, influencing users' beliefs and disproportionately harming marginalized groups and children. Experts warn of a feedback loop where AI-generated misinformation and stereotypes become entrenched, calling for urgent interdisciplinary action to address these harms.

records.title: RIAA Targets Discord's AI Hub Over Copyright-Infringing AI Music Tools
records.description: The Recording Industry Association of America (RIAA) subpoenaed Discord to identify users of the 'AI Hub' server, which distributed AI tools and datasets for generating deepfake music imitating famous artists. The RIAA alleges this use of AI systems infringes copyright, prompting legal action and demands to shut down the server.

records.title: Widespread Security Flaw: Many Smartphones' AI Facial Recognition Bypassed by Photos
records.description: A Consumentenbond investigation found that facial recognition on 26 out of 60 tested smartphones, mainly from brands like Motorola, Nokia, OnePlus, and Oppo, can be bypassed using a simple photo. This AI system weakness exposes users to privacy and security risks, especially on cheaper devices lacking advanced 3D sensors.

records.title: Dutch Student Loan Fraud Algorithm Discriminates Against Minority Students
records.description: An AI-driven risk profiling algorithm used by Dutch education agency DUO to detect student loan fraud has disproportionately targeted students with migration backgrounds, leading to discriminatory investigations and penalties. The incident has sparked political outrage, calls for transparency, and demands to suspend or investigate the algorithm due to its biased outcomes.

records.title: Hackers Uncover Tesla's Secret 'Elon Mode' That Disables Autopilot Safety Features
records.description: Hackers and security researchers discovered a hidden 'Elon Mode' in Tesla vehicles, allowing the AI-powered autopilot to operate without requiring drivers to keep their hands on the wheel. This circumvents critical safety checks, raising significant concerns about increased accident risks and regulatory violations due to misuse or malfunction of Tesla's AI driving system.

records.title: Bild Replaces Journalists with AI, Leading to Mass Layoffs
records.description: German publisher Axel Springer, owner of Bild, announced the dismissal of over 200 employees, including journalists and editors, replacing many roles with AI systems. The move, aimed at cost reduction and digital transformation, has caused significant economic harm to affected workers, highlighting the impact of AI adoption on employment.

records.title: ChatGPT 'Grandma Mode' Exploited to Reveal Sensitive Information
