Authorities cited the platform's inability to moderate harmful content as a direct cause for the suspension to protect community safety.

records.title: Lensa AI Faces Backlash Over Artist Harm and Privacy Risks
records.description: Lensa AI, a viral app generating animated avatars, is criticized for harming digital artists by undercutting their work and allegedly using unlicensed images. Users also face privacy risks, including potential data misuse and the creation of inappropriate content without consent, raising concerns about intellectual property and personal data security.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Faces Fuel Social Media Manipulation and Scams
records.description: Meta reports a sharp rise in the use of AI-generated fake faces, created with generative adversarial networks (GANs), for fake social media profiles. These lifelike images enable malicious actors to conduct influence operations, spread propaganda, and perpetrate scams, causing widespread harm by manipulating online discourse and deceiving users.

records.title: TikTok AI Algorithm Rapidly Recommends Self-Harm and Eating Disorder Content to Minors
records.description: Researchers from the Center for Countering Digital Hate found that TikTok's AI-driven recommendation system quickly promotes self-harm and eating disorder content to users as young as 13. Within minutes of engagement, the algorithm exposes minors to harmful material, raising serious concerns about youth mental health and platform safety.

records.title: Meta Sued for Facebook Algorithm's Role in Ethiopia Violence and Murder
records.description: Meta faces a $2 billion lawsuit alleging Facebook's AI-driven recommendation algorithms amplified hate speech and incitement in Ethiopia, contributing to ethnic violence and the murder of an academic. Plaintiffs claim Meta failed to adequately moderate harmful content, leading to real-world harm and demanding reforms and restitution.

records.title: AI Skin Screening Apps Fail to Reliably Detect Skin Cancer, Raising Health Concerns
records.description: Stiftung Warentest evaluated 17 AI-powered skin screening apps and found none to be error-free, with some failing to detect skin cancer. The apps' inaccuracies pose health risks if users rely on them instead of consulting doctors, highlighting the limitations and potential dangers of AI in medical diagnostics.

records.title: Greek Authorities Raid Companies Linked to Predator Spyware in Phone Surveillance Probe
records.description: Greek prosecutors conducted raids on at least six companies suspected of involvement with the AI-enabled Predator spyware, used for illegal phone surveillance. The investigation targets violations of privacy and human rights, with authorities seeking evidence and individuals connected to the deployment of this surveillance technology.

records.title: Meta Knew Instagram's AI Algorithms Harmed Teen Girls' Mental Health
records.description: Leaked internal documents reveal Meta was aware that Instagram's AI-driven recommendation algorithms pushed teen girls toward harmful content, including eating disorders, worsening their mental health. Despite employee warnings and internal investigations, Meta prioritized profits over user safety, leading to significant psychological harm among teenage users.

records.title: YouTuber Fined for Deepfake Pornography Using AI Face-Swapping Technology in Taiwan
records.description: YouTuber Xiao Yu and his assistant used AI deepfake technology to create and sell non-consensual explicit videos featuring 119 women, including public figures. Taiwanese courts sentenced them to prison and ordered compensation of NT$1 million each to two victims, highlighting significant harm from AI misuse and prompting calls for stronger digital sexual violence laws.

records.title: Airbnb Booking Algorithms Linked to Racial Disparities in Guest Acceptance Rates
records.description: Airbnb's own study found that guests perceived as Black had lower booking success rates (91.4%) compared to those perceived as White (94.1%), highlighting persistent racial bias in the platform's AI-driven booking processes. The disparity suggests algorithmic or host decision-making influenced by AI is contributing to discrimination.

records.title: Dutch University Proctoring AI Discriminates Against Student with Dark Skin, Human Rights Board Finds
records.description: The Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam's AI-based proctoring software repeatedly failed to recognize a student with dark skin, causing exam disruptions and stress. The Dutch Human Rights Board found sufficient evidence of discrimination, requiring the university to prove the software does not discriminate, highlighting AI bias and its harmful impact on students.

records.title: Greek Government Licensed Export of AI Spyware Predator to Repressive Regimes
records.description: The Greek government admitted to authorizing Intellexa to export the AI-enabled spyware Predator to countries with histories of repression, such as Madagascar. This action facilitated the international spread of invasive surveillance technology, raising concerns over human rights violations and the misuse of AI for political repression.

records.title: French President Criticizes TikTok's AI Algorithm for Censorship and Addiction
records.description: French President Emmanuel Macron accused TikTok's AI-driven content recommendation system of fostering psychological addiction among young users and censoring sensitive information, such as human rights abuses in China. He highlighted the platform's powerful influence on youth and its role in suppressing critical content.

records.title: AI Face-Swapping App Infringes Model's Portrait Rights, Court Orders Compensation
records.description: A Shanghai company’s AI face-swapping app used a model’s likeness without consent to create and distribute fake videos, infringing her portrait rights. The Hangzhou Internet Court ruled the app developer must apologize and pay 5,000 yuan in damages, highlighting legal risks of unauthorized AI-generated content.

records.title: Indiana Sues TikTok Over AI-Driven Exposure of Minors to Harmful Content
records.description: Indiana filed lawsuits against TikTok, alleging its AI-powered content recommendation system misled consumers about safety and exposed minors to adult and harmful material. The state claims TikTok deceived users about content risks and data security, prompting broader regulatory actions and bans on government devices in several U.S. states.

records.title: US Investigates Neuralink for AI-Driven Animal Welfare Violations
records.description: Elon Musk's Neuralink, developing AI-enabled brain implants, is under US federal investigation for potential violations of animal welfare laws. Reports cite that rushed and repeated experiments, driven by management pressure, led to unnecessary suffering and the deaths of around 1,500 animals since 2018, raising ethical and legal concerns.

records.title: Lensa AI Generates Non-Consensual Sexualized and Nude Images of Users
records.description: Lensa AI, a popular selfie app, has been found to generate sexualized and non-consensual nude images of women, including public figures and regular users, despite users not submitting nude photos. This has led to privacy violations, emotional distress, and concerns over misogyny and data misuse, highlighting significant AI-related harms.

records.title: AI-Generated Art Sparks Copyright Infringement Concerns in China
records.description: The rapid rise of AI painting tools in China has led to widespread copyright infringement concerns, as these systems often use artists' works without authorization for training and image generation. Artists and commentators warn of intellectual property violations, urging clearer legal frameworks and industry standards to address these harms.

records.title: AI Systems Deployed in Japan to Prevent Special Fraud Targeting the Elderly
records.description: Japanese police and partners are trialing AI systems to prevent special fraud targeting the elderly. AI monitors ATM users’ posture and phone use to alert staff of suspicious activity, while another system analyzes phone calls for fraud, notifying relatives and authorities, successfully averting financial harm in some cases.

records.title: AI-Driven Mass Surveillance Used to Suppress China’s White Paper Protests
records.description: Chinese authorities used AI-powered surveillance systems—including facial and emotion recognition, mobile data tracking, and network monitoring—to identify, track, and intimidate participants in the 2022 White Paper protests. These technologies enabled widespread privacy violations, detentions, and suppression of dissent, resulting in significant human rights abuses.

records.title: Twitter's Automated Moderation Linked to Surge in Harmful Content
records.description: Following Elon Musk's acquisition, Twitter shifted to AI-driven automated moderation, reducing manual reviews and favoring content visibility restrictions over removals. This approach coincided with a reported surge in hate speech and child exploitation material, raising concerns about the effectiveness and unintended consequences of AI moderation on user safety and benign content.

records.title: Facebook's AI Fails to Detect Death Threat Ads in Security Test
records.description: Researchers from NYU and Global Witness submitted 15 death threat ads targeting election workers to Facebook as a test. Facebook's AI moderation system failed to detect and block these ads, unlike TikTok and YouTube, raising concerns about Facebook's AI-driven content safety protocols.

records.title: Meta's AI Ad Algorithms Accused of Discriminatory Job Ad Targeting
records.description: Meta Platforms' AI-driven ad delivery system allegedly steered job ads from trucking companies to predominantly one gender or age group, violating anti-discrimination laws. Advocacy groups filed a complaint citing Meta's own data, prompting the company to review its algorithms and test a new 'variance reduction system' to address bias.

records.title: Chinese Authorities Use AI Surveillance to Suppress COVID-19 Protests
records.description: Chinese police deployed AI-powered facial recognition and phone tracking technologies to identify, locate, and detain participants in anti-COVID restriction protests. This high-tech surveillance led to privacy violations, intimidation, and unlawful detentions, constituting significant human rights abuses directly resulting from the use of AI systems.

records.title: El Faro Journalists Sue NSO Group Over Pegasus Spyware Surveillance
records.description: Journalists from El Salvador's El Faro news outlet have sued Israeli firm NSO Group in U.S. federal court after its AI-powered Pegasus spyware was used to hack their phones. The spyware enabled unauthorized surveillance, violating privacy and press freedom, and allegedly aimed to intimidate and silence journalists.

records.title: Apple Crash Detection AI Triggers False Emergency Calls from Skiers
records.description: Apple's Crash Detection feature, using AI to detect severe crashes, has been inadvertently triggered by skiers, leading to a surge in false emergency calls to dispatch centers near ski resorts. While no injuries occurred, the malfunction disrupts emergency services and highlights challenges in AI system deployment in real-world scenarios.

records.title: AI-Driven Spam Bots Used to Suppress China Protest Information on Twitter
records.description: Automated bot accounts, likely using AI, flooded Twitter with spam and pornographic posts to obscure information about China's 'White Paper Revolution' protests. This large-scale information suppression, attributed to Chinese state actors, was exacerbated by Twitter's reduced moderation capacity following mass layoffs, hindering access to critical protest news.

records.title: Amazon Replaces Human Recruiters with AI, Leading to Job Losses and Labor Rights Concerns
records.description: Amazon has replaced many human recruiters with an AI system called 'Automated Applicant Evaluation' (AAE), which predicts candidate success for various roles. This automation has led to significant layoffs and raised concerns about labor rights, potential discrimination, and the dehumanization of hiring processes.

records.title: Eufy Security Cameras Upload User Data to Cloud Without Consent, Exposing Privacy Risks
records.description: Security researcher Paul Moore revealed that Eufy cameras, which use AI for facial recognition, uploaded user images and biometric data to the cloud without consent, even when cloud storage was disabled. This unauthorized data transmission violated privacy rights and potentially breached GDPR, exposing users to significant privacy risks.

records.title: Twitter's AI Fails to Detect Christchurch Attack Video Re-Uploads
records.description: Twitter's automated AI system failed to detect and remove re-uploaded videos of the Christchurch mosque terror attacks, allowing harmful extremist content to circulate. The videos were only removed after the New Zealand government intervened, highlighting a significant malfunction in Twitter's AI content moderation.

records.title: UK Criminalizes Non-Consensual Deepfake Pornography and Image Abuse
records.description: The UK government is amending the Online Safety Bill to criminalize the sharing of AI-generated deepfake pornographic images and videos without consent. Offenders may face jail time, addressing harms caused by non-consensual AI-manipulated content and strengthening protections against intimate image abuse.

records.title: Putin Presented with AI-Generated Deepfake of German Chancellor Scholz
records.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin was shown an AI-generated deepfake video of German Chancellor Olaf Scholz delivering fabricated statements. The demonstration, created by Russian programmers, highlights the potential for AI-driven misinformation and reputational harm through manipulated media targeting political figures.

records.title: Meta's Galactica AI Pulled After Spreading Misinformation and Harmful Content
records.description: Meta launched Galactica, an AI language model designed to generate scientific content, but quickly withdrew it after users found it produced false, biased, and harmful outputs, including racist remarks and dangerous misinformation. The system's inability to distinguish fact from fiction led to ethical criticism and reputational harm.

records.title: DOJ Investigates RealPage AI Rent-Setting Software for Inflating Rents and Facilitating Collusion
records.description: The U.S. Department of Justice is investigating RealPage's YieldStar AI software, which analyzes rental data to recommend prices. Lawmakers and reports allege the system enables landlords to coordinate rent increases, inflating rents and harming tenants, potentially violating antitrust laws and exacerbating housing affordability issues.

records.title: Deepfake Video of FTX Founder Used in Crypto Scam Targeting Investors
records.description: Scammers used AI-generated deepfake videos of FTX founder Sam Bankman-Fried to impersonate him on Twitter, directing victims to fraudulent websites with promises of crypto refunds or giveaways. The deepfakes exploited verified accounts to appear legitimate, aiming to steal cryptocurrency from investors affected by FTX's collapse.

records.title: Tesla AI System Blamed in Fatal South Korea Crash Sparks Trial and Safety Scrutiny
records.description: A 2020 crash in Seoul involving a Tesla Model X, which allegedly accelerated and failed to brake due to possible AI system malfunction, resulted in a fatality and injury. The incident has led to a criminal trial and heightened scrutiny of Tesla’s AI-driven safety features and regulatory oversight in South Korea.

records.title: Unstable Diffusion AI Generates Pornographic Images Without Safeguards, Leading to Rights Violations and Harm
records.description: Unstable Diffusion, an AI system based on Stable Diffusion, enables users to generate pornographic images—including those resembling minors and real individuals—without safety filters. This has resulted in potential legal violations, privacy breaches, and economic harm to content creators, raising significant ethical and societal concerns about AI misuse.

records.title: AI-Aided Colonoscopy Linked to Lower Detection Rates of Precancerous Lesions
records.description: A study from Sheba Medical Center found that using AI-assisted colonoscopy resulted in lower detection rates of adenomas and polyps compared to traditional methods. This raises concerns about potential missed diagnoses and future health risks, highlighting challenges in deploying AI for medical diagnostics.

records.title: Twitter AI Moderation Wrongly Flags Space Videos as Porn, Locks Users Out
records.description: Twitter's automated AI moderation system mistakenly flagged innocent videos of meteors and a NASA rocket launch as 'intimate content,' locking astronomers and photographers out of their accounts for months. The users faced reputational harm and loss of access, highlighting the risks of AI misclassification in content moderation.

records.title: Automated Tenant-Screening Algorithms Cause Discriminatory Housing Denials in the US
records.description: Automated tenant-screening algorithms used by US landlords are denying rental applications, often without explanation, disproportionately affecting marginalized groups. Applicants report repeated, vague rejections, raising concerns about algorithmic bias and discrimination in housing access. Civil rights groups and policymakers are calling for greater transparency and regulation of these AI systems.

records.title: AI-Assisted Robotic Weapons Used in Lethal Attack and Warfare
records.description: AI-enabled robotic weapons, including a remote-controlled machine gun with computer vision, were used in the 2020 assassination of Iranian scientist Mohsen Fakhrizadeh. The incident highlights the direct harm caused by AI in weaponized robots and drones, raising urgent ethical and security concerns about autonomous lethal systems in warfare.

records.title: Fatal Tesla Accidents in China Raise Concerns Over AI Driving Systems
records.description: Two recent Tesla accidents in China, including a crash in Chaozhou causing 2 deaths and 3 injuries, have sparked public debate over the safety of Tesla's AI-assisted driving features, such as single pedal mode. Investigations are ongoing to determine if AI system malfunctions contributed to the incidents.

records.title: Chinese Court Orders Deletion of Resident's Facial Data in Landmark Privacy Case
records.description: A resident in Ningbo, China, sued their property management for collecting facial data via an AI-powered recognition system without consent. The court ruled the property company must delete the resident's facial information, affirming that mandatory facial recognition for access violates personal privacy rights and legal protections.

records.title: Two Fatal Tesla Crashes Linked to Autopilot AI System Reported to NHTSA
records.description: Tesla reported two new fatal crashes involving Model 3 vehicles equipped with its AI-based driver assistance system, Autopilot, to the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration. Both incidents occurred in California between September 16 and October 15, highlighting ongoing safety concerns regarding AI-driven vehicle technologies.

records.title: Automatic Emergency Braking AI Significantly Reduces Vehicle Crashes
records.description: Two U.S. studies found that automatic emergency braking, an AI system that detects imminent collisions and applies brakes, can halve rear-end crashes and reduce pickup truck crashes by over 40%. The findings highlight the technology's effectiveness in preventing injuries and reducing harm on the roads.

records.title: Google Settles for $391.5 Million Over Secret AI-Powered Location Tracking
records.description: Google agreed to pay $391.5 million to settle with 40 US states after its AI-powered systems secretly tracked user locations for targeted advertising, even when users disabled location tracking. The settlement requires Google to increase transparency and user control over location data, addressing significant privacy violations and consumer deception.

records.title: TikTok Influencer Targeted by AI-Generated Deepfake Porn in Murder Case
records.description: Mahek Bukhari, a TikTok influencer on trial for murder, claims the victim created and distributed AI-generated deepfake pornographic images of her to damage her reputation. The malicious use of deepfake technology caused significant personal and reputational harm, playing a central role in the events leading to the alleged crime.

records.title: Indonesian Police Seize Assets in Net89 AI Trading Fraud Case
records.description: Indonesian police have seized assets worth over Rp 6.3 billion from suspects in the Net89 robot trading (AI trading) fraud case, which caused significant financial losses to investors. Eight executives of PT Simbiotik Multitalenta Indonesia, the company behind Net89, face charges for using the AI system in a fraudulent investment scheme.

records.title: Predator Spyware Frames Innocent Victims Through AI-Driven Manipulation
records.description: The Predator spyware, using advanced AI capabilities, not only intercepts and records communications on infected devices but can also send and delete messages without users' knowledge. This allows malicious actors to falsely incriminate unsuspecting victims and erase evidence, leading to significant privacy violations and potential wrongful accusations.

records.title: Tesla Model Y AI System Malfunction Causes Fatal Crash in China
records.description: A Tesla Model Y in Guangdong, China, suddenly accelerated uncontrollably and failed to brake, resulting in a crash that killed two people and injured three others. The incident, attributed to a possible AI or software malfunction, is under investigation, with Tesla cooperating with authorities.

records.title: AI Navigation Errors Lead Drivers onto Hazardous Dirt Roads in Washington
records.description: Apple Maps and Google Maps, using AI-based routing, redirected drivers off I-90 in Washington onto unsafe dirt roads due to unupdated construction data. This led to multiple vehicles getting stuck and requiring towing, raising significant safety concerns and highlighting the risks of AI navigation system failures.

records.title: Seibu Railway Deploys AI-Based Crossing Detection to Prevent Accidents
records.description: Seibu Railway, in collaboration with Marubeni Network Solutions and OKI, has launched AI and 3D image analysis systems at railway crossings to detect people or vehicles lingering inside. These real-time AI systems automatically alert train drivers to potential dangers, aiming to prevent accidents and enhance safety, especially at smaller pedestrian crossings.

records.title: Tesla Recalls Over 40,000 Vehicles Due to AI-Related Power Steering Malfunction
records.description: Tesla recalled over 40,000 Model S and Model X vehicles (2017–2021) after a software update caused the AI-driven power steering system to misinterpret road bumps, leading to sudden loss of steering assist. An over-the-air update was issued to fix the safety-critical malfunction, though no injuries were reported.

records.title: EU Investigates AI Surveillance Software Use in Greece Ahead of Elections
records.description: The European Parliament's PEGA committee raised concerns over the use of AI-enabled surveillance software like Predator in Greece, highlighting potential illegal monitoring of politicians and journalists. The committee urges urgent clarification, especially before upcoming elections, amid denials from Greek authorities and insufficient investigation into the software's origins and use.

records.title: European Parliament Criticizes Spanish Government Over Pegasus AI Spyware Use
records.description: A European Parliament draft report criticizes the Spanish government for using the AI-powered Pegasus spyware to surveil 65 Catalan independence leaders, violating privacy and political rights. The incident has sparked legal actions, political condemnation, and calls for accountability and reforms regarding AI-enabled surveillance abuses.

records.title: Google's AI Allegedly Manipulates Political Content to Influence U.S. Elections
records.description: Research led by Dr. Robert Epstein claims Google's AI-driven search and recommendation algorithms have manipulated political content exposure, influencing voter opinions and potentially shifting millions of votes in U.S. elections. Over 1.9 million 'ephemeral experiences' were documented, raising concerns about AI-enabled election interference and harm to democratic processes.

records.title: Smart Desk with Undisclosed AI Camera Prompts Privacy Backlash and Product Recall
records.description: Lege's smart desk was found to contain an undisclosed AI-enabled camera for heart rate monitoring, raising privacy concerns among consumers. The company admitted inadequate disclosure, recalled the product, and was investigated by local regulators. The incident highlights risks of hidden AI surveillance in consumer devices and violations of privacy rights.

records.title: Iran Admits Supplying Drones Used by Russia in Ukraine Attacks
records.description: Iran has officially acknowledged supplying Russia with unmanned aerial vehicles (drones) before the Ukraine war. These AI-enabled drones have been used by Russia to target civilian infrastructure and energy facilities in Ukraine, causing significant harm to property and communities, and prompting international condemnation and calls for investigation.

records.title: London Police Facial Recognition Scans Raise Human Rights Concerns
records.description: UK police used live facial recognition cameras to scan over 125,000 people in London, resulting in only nine arrests. The mass surveillance has sparked criticism from human rights groups over privacy violations, lack of accountability, and potential discrimination, highlighting the risks and harms of deploying AI-driven biometric identification in public spaces.

records.title: Instagram AI Alert Enables Police to Prevent Teen Suicide in Madhya Pradesh
records.description: Instagram's AI system detected self-harm content posted by a 17-year-old girl in Satna, Madhya Pradesh, and sent an alert to cyber police. Authorities quickly traced her location and intervened, preventing a potential suicide attempt. This incident highlights AI's role in enabling timely intervention and harm prevention.

records.title: Meta Sued Over AI Algorithms Allegedly Radicalizing Charleston Church Shooter
records.description: The family of Rev. Clementa Pinckney, killed in the 2015 Charleston church massacre, is suing Meta and Russian oligarch Yevgeny Prigozhin. The lawsuit alleges Meta's AI-driven recommendation algorithms promoted extremist content, contributing to the shooter's radicalization and resulting in the racially motivated mass shooting.

records.title: iOS 16 Update Causes Widespread Face ID Failures on iPhones
records.description: After updating to iOS 16, many iPhone users experienced malfunctions in the Face ID facial recognition system, rendering it unusable and disrupting device access and security features. The issue persists across multiple models, with Apple yet to provide an official fix or statement.

records.title: TikTok's AI Algorithms Promote Harmful Diet Culture Among Youth
records.description: A University of Vermont study found that TikTok's AI-driven recommendation system amplifies content promoting toxic diet culture, unrealistic body ideals, and unverified nutrition advice. This exposure, especially among teens and young adults, is linked to increased risks of eating disorders and negative body image, constituting indirect harm facilitated by AI.

records.title: AI-Enabled Drones Used in Ukraine War for Targeted Attacks and Naval Strikes
records.description: Ukraine has deployed AI-powered facial recognition drones, supplied by Clearview AI, to identify and target Russian soldiers, and has also used autonomous waterborne drones (USVs) in historic naval attacks against Russia's Black Sea fleet. These AI systems directly contributed to harm in the ongoing conflict.

records.title: Amazon Alexa Recommends Violence Against Children in Response to User Query
records.description: Amazon Alexa, using a user-contributed answer, told a father to 'punch his kids in the throat' when asked how to stop them laughing. The violent suggestion, delivered by the AI system, was widely shared online before Amazon removed the response, highlighting risks in unmoderated AI-generated content.

records.title: Google's AI Ad System Funds Disinformation Sites in Brazil
records.description: A study found that Google's AI-driven ad placement system monetized 80% of the most-shared Brazilian websites spreading false information about elections, COVID-19, and vaccines. Despite company policies against such content, the AI system enabled these sites to profit, undermining public trust and democratic processes.

records.title: Twitter AI Moderation Fails as Hate Speech Surges After Musk Takeover
records.description: Following Elon Musk's acquisition of Twitter, the platform saw a 500% surge in the use of racist slurs within 12 hours. This spike, tracked by the Network Contagion Research Institute, highlights a failure or inadequacy in Twitter's AI content moderation systems, enabling widespread dissemination of harmful hate speech.

records.title: AI System 'Palantir' Enables Rapid Suspect Identification in NRW Police Investigations
records.description: The AI-powered software 'Palantir' was used by North Rhine-Westphalia police to quickly identify suspects in several high-profile cases, including a mass shooting in Duisburg and an emailed amok threat to Siegen city administration. The system's rapid data analysis played a central role in resolving these incidents.

records.title: TikTok's AI Fails to Block Political Misinformation Ads
records.description: A study by Global Witness and New York University found that TikTok's AI-driven content moderation approved 90% of ads containing false or misleading political information, making it the worst among major platforms tested. This failure enabled widespread dissemination of disinformation, undermining electoral integrity and public trust.

records.title: TikTok Settles Lawsuit Over AI Facial Recognition Privacy Violations
records.description: TikTok paid up to $92 million in a class-action settlement after using AI-powered facial recognition to collect biometric data from users without consent, violating Illinois privacy laws. Millions of users, especially in Illinois, received compensation, and similar legal actions may target Google and Snapchat.

records.title: Ukrainian Forces Deploy AI-Guided Warmate Kamikaze Drones in Combat Operations
records.description: Ukrainian military, supported by the 'Army of Drones' initiative, deployed 40 AI-guided Warmate kamikaze drones, which autonomously strike designated targets using autopilot data. These drones, funded by public donations, have been used in combat to destroy enemy personnel, vehicles, and critical infrastructure, resulting in direct harm.

records.title: AI Deepfake Fraud and Military Facial Recognition Payment Risks in China
records.description: AI-powered deepfake technology has enabled criminals in China to bypass facial recognition systems, leading to significant financial fraud and theft. In response to security risks, a Chinese military unit halted the use of facial recognition payment systems to prevent potential leaks of sensitive information and exposure of military operations.

records.title: Apple Patches SiriSpy Flaw Allowing Unauthorized Recording of Siri Conversations
records.description: A security flaw in Apple's Siri and dictation features allowed malicious apps with Bluetooth access to secretly record user conversations on iOS and macOS devices without permission. Discovered by developer Guilherme Rambo, the vulnerability posed a serious privacy risk but was patched by Apple in iOS 16.1 and macOS Ventura.

records.title: AI-Enabled Drones and Unmanned Vessels Cause Major Damage in Russia-Ukraine Conflict
records.description: Both Russia and Ukraine have deployed AI-powered drones and unmanned surface vessels in large-scale attacks, resulting in significant destruction of military ships and critical infrastructure, especially in Crimea. These autonomous systems, capable of navigation and target acquisition, have directly caused harm to property and disrupted military operations.

records.title: Israel's AI-Powered Smart Shooter Deployed by Ukraine Against Drones
records.description: Ukraine has received and deployed Israel's AI-enabled Smart Shooter fire control systems to detect and destroy Iranian kamikaze drones used by Russian forces. The AI system autonomously identifies, tracks, and targets drones, contributing directly to military engagements and the destruction of hostile UAVs in the ongoing conflict.

records.title: AI System Rapidly Identifies Superbug Resistance, Saves Critically Ill Patient
records.description: A 78-year-old woman with a life-threatening superbug infection was successfully treated after an AI-powered mass spectrometry platform at China Medical University Hospital rapidly identified antibiotic resistance within one hour, enabling doctors to select effective medication and prevent further harm. The AI system significantly reduced mortality and medication errors.

records.title: TikTok AI Algorithms Implicated in US Child Death and Unauthorized Surveillance of US Citizens
records.description: TikTok's AI-driven recommendation system repeatedly pushed dangerous 'blackout challenge' videos to a 10-year-old US girl, leading to her death. Separately, TikTok's parent company ByteDance used AI-enabled data collection to monitor the locations of specific US citizens without consent, raising serious privacy and human rights concerns.

records.title: Tesla Faces US Criminal Investigation Over Autopilot AI Crashes and Self-Driving Claims
records.description: Tesla is under US Department of Justice criminal investigation after more than a dozen crashes, some fatal, occurred while its AI-driven Autopilot system was active. The probe centers on whether Tesla misled consumers about the system’s self-driving capabilities, which has led to injuries and fatalities.

records.title: Google Accused of AI-Driven Search Bias Against Republican Candidates in 2022 Midterms
records.description: Multiple reports from the Media Research Center allege that Google's AI-powered search algorithms and spam filters systematically buried Republican Senate candidates' websites and marked more GOP campaign emails as spam compared to Democrats, potentially influencing voter information access and interfering with the democratic process during the 2022 midterm elections.

records.title: Algorithmic Trading in Iran's Stock Market Causes Ongoing Shareholder Losses
records.description: AI-driven algorithmic trading systems in Iran's stock market have caused ongoing financial harm to retail shareholders due to regulatory non-compliance, lack of transparency, and unfair market practices. Legal authorities and market participants have raised concerns, urging stricter oversight and enforcement of existing regulations to prevent further losses.

records.title: Republican National Committee Sues Google Over AI Spam Filtering of Fundraising Emails
records.description: The Republican National Committee sued Google, alleging its AI-driven spam filter wrongly classified millions of Republican fundraising emails as spam during a critical election period, harming political communication and fundraising. Google denies political bias, stating its filters reflect user behavior and not political affiliation.

records.title: AI Rent-Setting Software Accused of Facilitating Price Fixing and Inflating Rents
records.description: Renters have filed a lawsuit against RealPage, a Texas-based company whose AI-powered rent-setting software is used by major landlords. The suit alleges the software enabled collusion and price fixing, leading to artificially high rents and economic harm to tenants, violating federal antitrust laws.

records.title: British Activist Targeted by Deepfake Pornography AI Incident
records.description: Kate Isaacs, a British activist against non-consensual pornography, became the victim of an AI-generated deepfake pornographic video. Unknown individuals used AI algorithms to digitally insert her face onto another body without her consent, causing emotional distress, reputational harm, and privacy violations. The incident highlights the misuse of AI deepfake technology for non-consensual abuse.

records.title: TikTok and Facebook AI Failures Enable Election Misinformation; TikTok AI Used for Unauthorized Surveillance of US Citizens
records.description: A report found TikTok and Facebook's AI systems failed to block false election ads, allowing misinformation to spread and harm democratic processes, while YouTube's AI was effective. Separately, TikTok's parent company allegedly used TikTok's AI to plan unauthorized surveillance of specific US citizens, raising privacy and human rights concerns.

records.title: AI Tools Enable Widespread Music Copyright Infringement, Says RIAA
records.description: The Recording Industry Association of America (RIAA) has identified AI-based extractors and remixers as a major threat to the music industry, citing their role in unauthorized copying, remixing, and distribution of copyrighted music. These AI systems facilitate large-scale copyright violations, harming rights holders and the industry’s economic interests.

records.title: Chess Grandmaster Sues Over AI Cheating Allegations Involving 'Smart Anal Beads'
records.description: After being accused of using an AI-powered 'smart anal bead' device to cheat in a major chess tournament, 19-year-old Hans Niemann sued world champion Magnus Carlsen and others for defamation and blacklisting. The unproven AI cheating allegations led to significant reputational and career harm for Niemann.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Porn Causes Widespread Harm and Privacy Violations
records.description: AI-powered deepfake technology is being used to create non-consensual pornographic videos by superimposing individuals' faces onto explicit content, leading to psychological trauma, reputational damage, and privacy violations. Major deepfake porn sites attract millions of users, with victims including both celebrities and ordinary people, highlighting significant ongoing harm from AI misuse.

records.title: Amazon Sued in UK Over AI-Driven Buy Box Algorithm Favoring Own Products
records.description: Amazon faces a £900 million ($1 billion) UK class-action lawsuit alleging its Buy Box feature uses a secretive AI algorithm to unfairly promote its own products, causing consumers to overpay and violating competition law. The case highlights alleged economic harm from biased AI-driven marketplace practices.

records.title: Texas Sues Google Over Unauthorized AI-Driven Biometric Data Collection
records.description: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton has sued Google, alleging the company used AI systems in products like Google Photos and Google Assistant to collect and process millions of Texans' biometric data—such as facial and voice features—without consent, violating state privacy laws and resulting in significant privacy rights infringements.

records.title: Clearview AI Fined for Unlawful Facial Recognition Data Collection in France
records.description: Clearview AI, a US-based facial recognition company, was fined €20 million by France's CNIL for illegally collecting and processing biometric data from over 20 billion online images without consent, violating GDPR. The AI system's practices led to significant breaches of privacy and data protection rights.

records.title: Allegations of TikTok's Planned AI-Enabled Tracking of US Citizens Spark Privacy Concerns
records.description: Multiple reports allege that ByteDance, TikTok's parent company, planned to use the app's AI-driven data collection to monitor the physical location of specific American citizens, raising privacy and human rights concerns. TikTok denies these claims, stating it does not collect precise GPS data from US users, and no confirmed harm has occurred.

records.title: Dahua AI Surveillance Cameras Enable Ethnic Profiling in China, Company Admits Non-Commercial Use
records.description: Chinese company Dahua developed AI-powered surveillance cameras capable of identifying ethnicity, including Uyghur and Tibetan faces, used in Xinjiang police projects. Despite repeated denials, Dahua admitted the technology’s existence after investigations, but claimed it was not for commercial use. The system’s deployment has contributed to human rights abuses against minority groups.

records.title: AI-Powered Fog Reveal Enables Warrantless Mass Surveillance by US Law Enforcement
records.description: US law enforcement agencies have used Fog Reveal, an AI tool analyzing billions of mobile device location data points, to track individuals and monitor events without warrants. This practice, uncovered by the Electronic Frontier Foundation, raises serious concerns over privacy violations and breaches of constitutional rights through warrantless surveillance.

records.title: GitHub Copilot Accused of Copyright and License Violations by Emitting Unattributed Code
records.description: GitHub Copilot, an AI code assistant developed by Microsoft and OpenAI, is accused by developers and legal experts of reproducing large segments of copyrighted and open source code without proper attribution or license compliance. This has led to legal investigations and potential lawsuits over intellectual property and licensing violations.

records.title: AI System Deployed in Nagano to Detect and Prevent Phone Scams in Real Time
records.description: Nagano Prefecture police, NTT East, and Shinshu University have launched an AI system that analyzes live phone calls to detect scam-related phrases. If fraud is suspected, the system alerts families and police in real time, enabling rapid intervention to protect especially elderly residents from financial harm.

records.title: TikTok's AI Moderation Silently Censors User Comments in Germany
records.description: German media investigations revealed that TikTok uses AI-driven word filters to secretly block user comments containing certain keywords, including LGBTQ+ terms and drug references, without notifying users. This hidden censorship restricts freedom of expression and access to information, raising concerns about human rights violations and transparency on the platform.

records.title: Eleven Fatalities Linked to Automated Driving Systems in Recent U.S. Crashes
records.description: U.S. government data reveals that eleven people, including four motorcyclists, died in crashes involving vehicles using automated driving systems—primarily Tesla's Autopilot—over a recent four-month period. The incidents highlight ongoing safety concerns and the potential risks associated with the use of AI-driven driver-assist technologies.

records.title: AI Language Models Found to Exhibit Bias Against People with Disabilities
records.description: A Penn State study revealed that widely used AI language models in natural language processing applications display significant implicit bias against people with disabilities. These biases can result in discriminatory or offensive outputs, potentially leading to unjust censorship and reinforcing negative stereotypes, thereby harming disabled individuals and communities.

records.title: Pegasus Spyware's AI-Driven Threat to Journalists Exposed
records.description: The Committee to Protect Journalists reports that AI-powered zero-click spyware like Pegasus poses a severe threat to journalists and their sources by enabling unauthorized surveillance without user interaction, leading to privacy violations, personal safety risks, and suppression of press freedom globally.

records.title: AI Symptom Checkers Frequently Misdiagnose Skin Rashes
records.description: A Mayo Clinic study found that AI-powered online symptom checkers correctly diagnosed skin rashes in only 30.8% of cases, highlighting significant inaccuracy. This raises concerns about potential health risks if users rely on these AI systems for medical decisions due to their frequent misdiagnoses.

records.title: AI-Generated Zelda Movie Posters Cause Widespread Misinformation
records.description: AI-generated posters using DALL-E and Midjourney falsely suggested a Netflix Legend of Zelda film starring Tom Holland and others. Despite creator Dan Leveille's clarification, the realistic images went viral, misleading thousands on social media and fueling widespread misinformation about a non-existent movie.

records.title: Study Finds U.S. Drivers Misuse AI-Assisted Driving Systems, Leading to Safety Risks and Crashes
records.description: A study by the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety found that many U.S. drivers using AI-powered partial automation systems like Tesla Autopilot, GM Super Cruise, and Nissan ProPILOT Assist treat their vehicles as fully self-driving, leading to distracted driving and contributing to crashes and fatalities under investigation by authorities.

records.title: Meta Uses AI to Remove 600,000 Harmful Posts During Brazil's 2022 Election
records.description: Meta deployed AI-driven machine learning and human moderation to remove over 600,000 posts containing hate speech, incitement to violence, and disinformation from Facebook and Instagram during Brazil's 2022 election. Despite these efforts, some harmful content still reached voters, highlighting challenges in fully mitigating AI-moderated online harms.

records.title: AI System ThermoSecure Enables Password Theft via Thermal Attacks
records.description: Researchers at the University of Glasgow developed ThermoSecure, an AI system that uses machine learning to analyze thermal images of keyboards and screens, enabling attackers to accurately guess passwords seconds after entry. This technology poses significant risks to user privacy and security by facilitating unauthorized access to devices.

records.title: AI-Powered Bot Networks Manipulate Social Media Trends and Influence Elections
records.description: Automated bot networks, powered by AI, have been used to manipulate social media trends and spread misinformation, including influencing elections in 17 countries. These bots, often operating fake accounts for payment, distort online discourse and undermine democratic processes, causing harm to communities and violating rights.

records.title: Microsoft HoloLens AR Headsets Cause Harm to US Army Testers
records.description: US Army soldiers testing Microsoft's HoloLens-based AR headsets experienced significant physical impairments, including headaches, nausea, and eyestrain. The devices also failed key operational tests, with design flaws such as visible light emissions potentially compromising soldier safety, raising concerns about their deployment in combat situations.

records.title: Russian Use of Iranian Autonomous Drones in Ukraine Causes Harm
records.description: Russia has deployed Iranian-made Shahed-136 autonomous drones to strike military targets near Kiev, Ukraine, causing destruction and raising concerns about civilian safety. The drones, equipped with AI-driven targeting, have been used in recent attacks, demonstrating the direct harm caused by autonomous AI systems in warfare.

records.title: AI-Enabled Drone Attacks Injure Civilians in Yemen
records.description: Houthi forces used AI-enabled drones to launch projectile attacks on civilian areas in Taiz and Hodeidah, Yemen, injuring at least 14 people, including children. The Yemeni government condemned the attacks and highlighted the direct harm caused to civilians by the use of autonomous weapon systems.

records.title: Edmonton Police Use AI DNA Phenotyping, Spark Racial Bias Concerns
records.description: The Edmonton Police used AI-based DNA phenotyping to generate and publicly release a 3D image of a suspect in a sexual assault case. The image, created by Parabon NanoLabs, depicted a generic young Black man, raising concerns about racial profiling, bias, and potential harm to minority communities. The police later withdrew the image.

records.title: AI Art Generators Spark Copyright Violations and Artist Backlash; AI Recruitment Tools Cause Bias and Distress
records.description: AI art generators like Midjourney and Stable Diffusion have been widely trained on artists' works without consent, leading to intellectual property violations and widespread artist protests. Separately, AI-based recruitment tools such as HireVue have caused biased hiring decisions and emotional distress among job seekers, raising concerns over fairness and discrimination.

records.title: Apple Crash Detection AI Triggers False 911 Calls on Roller Coasters
records.description: Apple's iPhone 14 and Apple Watch crash detection AI has repeatedly misinterpreted roller coaster rides as car crashes, triggering numerous false 911 calls and disrupting emergency services. The malfunction highlights limitations in the AI's sensor-based detection algorithm, leading to unnecessary emergency responses and resource strain.

records.title: AI-Powered Mass Surveillance and Repression in China Under Xi Jinping
records.description: Since 2012, Chinese authorities have deployed AI-driven facial recognition cameras and automated online content moderation to monitor, censor, and suppress citizens, including dissidents. This unprecedented surveillance has led to widespread human rights violations, including loss of privacy, freedom of expression, and arrests, directly resulting from the use of AI systems.

records.title: AI Content Moderation Failures Linked to Molly Russell's Death
records.description: AI-driven content moderation and recommendation systems on platforms like Instagram failed to block or remove harmful self-harm and suicide-related material, exposing 14-year-old Molly Russell to distressing content. This inadequacy contributed to her death, as confirmed by a coroner, highlighting the risks of ineffective AI in safeguarding vulnerable users.

records.title: AI Moderation Failures Enable Spanish-Language Disinformation on Social Media
records.description: AI-driven content moderation systems on Facebook, Twitter, and YouTube have failed to effectively detect and remove Spanish-language misinformation, allowing harmful false narratives about elections, vaccines, and human smuggling to proliferate. This ongoing failure undermines public health and democratic participation, despite repeated warnings and promises to improve.

records.title: Chinese Military Deploys AI-Enabled Reconnaissance and Strike Drones in Combat Exercises
records.description: China's Air Force has operationalized AI-enabled reconnaissance and strike drones, using them in military exercises to autonomously identify and attack targets. These intelligent UAVs, equipped with deep learning and autonomous capabilities, have demonstrated successful missile strikes, marking a significant shift in warfare and raising concerns about AI-driven harm in conflict.

records.title: Greek Journalist Sues Intellexa Over AI Spyware Surveillance Scandal
records.description: Journalist Thanasis Koukakis filed a lawsuit against Intellexa, the company behind the AI-powered Predator spyware, after being subjected to illegal surveillance. The spyware was used to monitor journalists and politicians, leading to privacy violations and sparking legal and political controversy over government inaction and institutional protection of the company.

records.title: Software Glitches Disrupt Launch of Scotland's First Driverless Bus Service
records.description: The launch of Scotland's first autonomous bus, 'Itsy Bitsy Teenie Weenie Driverless Machiney,' was disrupted when software and lidar malfunctions left the vehicle unable to navigate, requiring manual intervention. No injuries occurred, but the AI system's failure caused significant operational delays and highlighted potential safety risks.

records.title: AI-Powered License Plate Readers Raise Fears of Abortion Surveillance and Rights Violations
records.description: Flock Safety's AI-driven license plate readers, widely adopted by US law enforcement, are raising concerns among privacy advocates that the technology could be used to track and criminalize individuals seeking abortions, potentially violating privacy and reproductive rights in states with restrictive abortion laws.

records.title: Douyin's AI Moderation System Suppresses Cantonese Content
records.description: Douyin, the Chinese version of TikTok by ByteDance, has been suspending live streams by Cantonese-speaking influencers due to its AI moderation system failing to recognize the language. This malfunction has led to accusations of discrimination and suppression of Cantonese content, restricting expression for millions of users.

records.title: Romania's First Deepfake Court Case: Student Fined for Defamatory AI-Generated Video
records.description: A Romanian student used deepfake AI technology to superimpose a classmate's face onto an explicit video, then shared it on YouTube and with classmates. The court found her guilty of defamation and ordered her family to pay 5,000 lei in moral damages, marking Romania's first deepfake-related legal case.

records.title: Continued Use of Pegasus Spyware in Mexico Violates Human Rights
records.description: Pegasus spyware, an AI-enabled surveillance tool, has been repeatedly used by Mexican authorities to target journalists, activists, and human rights defenders, resulting in privacy violations and suppression of free speech. Despite international concern and recommendations for a ban, its use persists, causing ongoing harm to civil liberties.

records.title: TikTok's AI-Driven Web Tracking Raises Privacy Concerns
records.description: Consumer Reports and Disconnect revealed that TikTok uses AI-enabled tracking pixels across thousands of websites to collect personal and sensitive data, even from non-users, for targeted advertising. This widespread, non-consensual data collection constitutes a significant violation of privacy rights and data protection laws.

records.title: Autonomous Delivery Drone Causes Power Outage in Australia
records.description: An autonomous food delivery drone operated by Alphabet's Wing malfunctioned and landed on power lines in Brisbane, Australia, catching fire and causing a power outage for around 2,000 homes. The incident disrupted critical infrastructure, with some customers losing electricity for up to three hours.

records.title: AAA Study Finds Automated Emergency Braking Fails at Higher Speeds and Intersections
records.description: AAA testing revealed that Automated Emergency Braking (AEB) systems, which use AI to prevent crashes, often fail at higher speeds and in intersection scenarios. While effective at low speeds, AEB systems frequently did not prevent collisions in real-world conditions, raising concerns about their reliability and potential for harm.

records.title: Meta's Algorithms Amplified Hate Leading to Rohingya Atrocities in Myanmar
records.description: Meta's (Facebook's) AI-driven algorithms amplified hate speech and disinformation against the Rohingya in Myanmar, despite repeated warnings. This algorithmic amplification fueled real-world violence, including killings and mass displacement in 2017, prompting calls for reparations and accountability for Meta's role in the atrocities.

records.title: AI-Powered Air Quality Sensors Enable Record Pollution Enforcement in Miaoli County
records.description: Miaoli County's Environmental Protection Bureau deployed 500 AI-enabled air quality sensors and automatic smoke detection systems, leading to the detection of 13 industrial pollution cases and 2 illegal open burnings in 2022. The AI systems triggered alerts and evidence collection, resulting in significant fines and improved environmental enforcement.

records.title: AI Rapper FN Meka Dropped After Backlash Over Racially Insensitive Content
records.description: The AI-generated rapper FN Meka, signed by executive Anthony Martini, faced public outrage for using racial slurs and stereotypes in its lyrics. The controversy led Capitol Records to dissolve FN Meka's record deal, highlighting the harm caused by AI-generated content that perpetuates offensive and discriminatory material.

records.title: Indonesian Police Investigate AI-Powered Trading Scams Causing Major Financial Losses
records.description: Indonesian police are investigating multiple AI-driven trading platforms, including Mark AI and Auto Trade Gold, for fraud and money laundering. These 'robot trading' systems promised high daily returns but ultimately caused victims to lose around Rp 25 billion when they could no longer withdraw their funds.

records.title: Pornhub Deploys AI Chatbot to Deter Searches for Child Sexual Abuse Material
records.description: Pornhub has implemented an AI-powered chatbot to detect and intercept searches for child sexual abuse material (CSAM) on its platform. Triggered by 28,000 keywords, the chatbot interrupts users, informs them of the illegality, and directs them to support services, aiming to prevent harm and reduce access to illegal content.

records.title: Palantir Extends Controversial US Defense AI Contract After Google Exit
records.description: Palantir secured a $229 million contract to provide AI and machine learning capabilities to the US Department of Defense, supporting military targeting and surveillance. The contract, previously abandoned by Google over ethical concerns, raises ongoing risks of harm due to AI's use in potentially lethal military operations.

records.title: Google's AI-Driven Voice Surveillance Raises Privacy Concerns
records.description: Multiple reports confirm that Google and other tech giants use AI-powered voice assistants to monitor user conversations and online behavior, enabling targeted advertising even for topics not explicitly searched. This AI-enabled surveillance constitutes a significant privacy violation, prompting public concern and advice on disabling such features to protect user rights.

records.title: Consumer Protection Warns of Health Risks from AI Mushroom Identification Apps
records.description: Consumer protection agencies and medical experts warn that AI-powered mushroom identification apps can misidentify species, leading to serious health risks such as poisoning and kidney failure. Users are cautioned not to rely solely on these apps, as incorrect identification by the AI can result in hospitalization or worse.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Flood Images Spread Misinformation During Shizuoka Typhoon
records.description: An individual used AI image generators to create and post fake photos of severe flooding in Shizuoka during Typhoon No. 15, falsely presenting them as real disaster scenes on Twitter. The images spread widely, misleading the public and prompting official warnings about misinformation and the dangers of AI-generated fake news.

records.title: AI-Enabled Iranian Drones Cause Civilian Harm in Ukraine
records.description: AI-enabled Iranian drones, used by Russian forces in Ukraine, have intensified attacks in Odessa, conducting reconnaissance, missile strikes, and bomb drops. Their autonomous or semi-autonomous capabilities have led to physical harm and psychological distress among civilians, highlighting the direct impact of AI systems in modern warfare.

records.title: LinkedIn Secretly Alters AI Recommendations in Massive User Experiment Affecting Job Opportunities
records.description: From 2015 to 2019, LinkedIn secretly ran large-scale experiments on 20 million users by altering its AI-driven 'People You May Know' algorithm to test social tie strength, impacting users' job opportunities without their knowledge or consent. The lack of transparency raised significant ethical and legal concerns about user rights and privacy.

records.title: Google Settles $100 Million Lawsuit Over AI Facial Recognition Privacy Violations in Illinois
records.description: Google agreed to a $100 million settlement after its AI-powered Google Photos Face Grouping feature was found to have collected and stored biometric data of Illinois residents without proper consent, violating the Illinois Biometric Information Privacy Act. Affected individuals can claim compensation, though Google denies wrongdoing.

records.title: Israel Deploys AI-Controlled Machine Gun at Hebron Checkpoint
records.description: Israel has installed an AI-controlled machine gun at a checkpoint in Hebron, West Bank, capable of firing stun grenades, sponge-tipped bullets, and tear gas. Human rights groups and local activists express concern over potential harm to civilians, as the system autonomously tracks and fires at targets in a densely populated conflict zone.

records.title: Cruise Self-Driving Cars Cause Repeated Traffic Disruptions in San Francisco
records.description: GM's Cruise autonomous vehicles repeatedly malfunctioned in San Francisco, stalling in traffic, blocking lanes, and disrupting public transit. These AI-driven cars have caused significant inconvenience, emergency calls, and public safety concerns, prompting local transit agencies to urge federal authorities to review their safety and operational reliability.

records.title: Meta Sued for Bypassing iPhone Privacy Protections with AI-Driven Tracking
records.description: Meta faces multiple class action lawsuits for using AI-enabled tracking in Facebook and Instagram iOS apps to monitor user activity via in-app browsers, bypassing Apple’s App Tracking Transparency policy. This unauthorized data collection violates user privacy rights and legal obligations, despite explicit user opt-out controls.

records.title: Tesla Recalls 1.1 Million Cars Over Faulty AI Window Reversal System
records.description: Tesla recalled about 1.1 million vehicles in the US after discovering that the AI-powered automatic window reversal system may fail to detect obstructions, risking passenger injury. The recall affects Model 3, Y, S, and X vehicles from 2017-2022, and will be addressed via a software update.

records.title: Khashoggi's Wife Sues NSO Group Over Pegasus Spyware Surveillance
records.description: Hanan Elatr, wife of slain journalist Jamal Khashoggi, is preparing to sue NSO Group, Saudi Arabia, and the UAE in the US, alleging their use of Pegasus spyware to hack her phone. The AI-enabled surveillance tool's deployment constitutes a violation of privacy and human rights, prompting legal action.

records.title: YouTube's AI Recommendations Linked to Sleep Deprivation in Teens
records.description: A study by Flinders University found that YouTube's AI-driven recommendation and autoplay features significantly delay sleep in adolescents, with just 30 minutes of use under the covers reducing sufficient sleep chances by 24%. The platform's algorithmic content suggestions lead to loss of control and prolonged screen time, harming teen health.

records.title: FDA Warns of Cybersecurity Risks in Medtronic AI-Enabled Insulin Pumps
records.description: The FDA has warned that Medtronic's MiniMed 600 Series insulin pumps, which use AI to manage insulin delivery, are vulnerable to cyberattacks. Hackers could potentially alter insulin dosing by accessing the device during wireless pairing, posing a direct health risk, though no incidents have been reported yet.

records.title: Germany Deploys AI to Protect Endangered Eagles from Wind Turbine Collisions
records.description: Germany is deploying AI-powered camera systems, developed by IdentiFlight, to detect endangered lesser spotted eagles near wind turbines and slow the blades to prevent fatal collisions. This initiative aims to mitigate harm to the rare species as wind farm expansion increases the risk of eagle deaths.

records.title: Government AI Systems Cause Wrongful Arrests and Discrimination
records.description: Government use of automated decision-making systems (ADS), including facial recognition and risk assessment tools, has led to wrongful arrests, misinformed sentencing, and discrimination, particularly against people with darker skin tones and women. These AI-driven errors have resulted in human rights violations and systemic injustice.

records.title: China's Digital Silk Road Enables AI Surveillance and Repression Abroad
records.description: China is exporting AI-powered surveillance technologies, including facial recognition and drones, to countries along its Digital Silk Road. These systems are used by governments to monitor, intimidate, and arrest activists and protesters, leading to privacy violations, suppression of dissent, and human rights abuses, particularly in Cambodia and among minority groups.

records.title: Amazon's Ring Doorbell Shares User Video Data with Police Without Consent
records.description: Amazon's Ring smart doorbell system has shared users' video data with law enforcement in Germany and the US without court orders or user consent, citing urgent threats. This practice, confirmed by Amazon, has alarmed privacy advocates and may violate data protection laws and users' privacy rights.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Video Falsifies Brazilian Election Poll Results
records.description: Supporters of Jair Bolsonaro used AI-powered deepfake technology to create and spread manipulated videos and audio of TV Globo's Jornal Nacional, falsely showing Bolsonaro leading in Ipec election polls. The disinformation campaign, widely shared on social media, undermined public trust and threatened the integrity of Brazil's democratic process.

records.title: AI Systems Deployed to Prevent Children Being Left Behind on Buses in Japan
records.description: Following a fatal incident where a child died after being left on a bus, Japanese companies Vacan and TCI developed AI-based systems that use cameras to detect people inside buses after the engine is turned off, triggering alerts to prevent similar tragedies and enhance child safety through automated monitoring.

records.title: Pegasus Spyware Used for Surveillance in Greece Since 2016, Political Fallout Ensues
records.description: Reports based on Citizen Lab findings reveal that Pegasus, an AI-enabled spyware, was used for surveillance in Greece from 2016, including discussions by the national intelligence agency (EYP) to acquire it. The incident has sparked political controversy and investigations over privacy violations and unauthorized monitoring of public figures.

records.title: UN Warns Pegasus Spyware Violates Privacy and Human Rights
records.description: The UN Human Rights Office reports that Pegasus spyware, developed by NSO Group, enables invasive surveillance by turning smartphones into monitoring devices, leading to serious privacy and human rights violations. The software has been misused against journalists, activists, and officials, prompting calls for export controls and stricter human rights safeguards.

records.title: Polish Authorities Accused of Illegal AI-Driven Surveillance Using Pegasus Spyware
records.description: Polish authorities used the AI-powered Pegasus spyware to illegally surveil opposition figures and legal professionals, including prosecutor Ewa Wrzosek and lawyer Roman Giertych. The unauthorized use of this invasive AI system led to significant privacy violations and human rights concerns, prompting investigation by the European Parliament.

records.title: Meta's Automated Image Takedown System Wrongfully Censors Political Content
records.description: Meta's automated image moderation system repeatedly and wrongly removed a political cartoon depicting police violence in Colombia, despite successful user appeals. The Oversight Board criticized Meta for over-reliance on flawed AI moderation, highlighting harm to freedom of expression and calling for improved oversight and transparency.

records.title: TikTok's AI Algorithms Amplify Misinformation in Search Results
records.description: A NewsGuard report found that TikTok's AI-driven search and recommendation systems routinely promote misinformation, with nearly 20% of top search results on topics like COVID-19, climate change, and politics containing false or misleading claims. This widespread dissemination of misinformation poses significant risks to public health and informed communities.

records.title: YouTube Algorithm Promotes Pro-Bolsonaro Content, Study Finds
records.description: A study by UFRJ's NetLab found that YouTube's AI recommendation algorithm disproportionately promotes pro-Bolsonaro and Jovem Pan content, including misinformation. This bias led the PT party to file a complaint with Brazil's electoral court, citing harm to fair political competition and information integrity during the 2022 elections.

records.title: Twitter Suspends Accounts for AI-Generated Racist Deepfake of 'The Little Mermaid' Actress
records.description: Twitter suspended multiple accounts after users used AI to create and share deepfake images and videos that altered the race of Halle Bailey, the Black actress starring in 'The Little Mermaid,' to make her appear white. The AI-generated content sparked widespread criticism for racism and led to platform intervention.

records.title: Tesla FSD Beta Malfunctions Lead to Traffic Violation and Safety Concerns
records.description: Tesla's Full Self-Driving (FSD) Beta v10.69.2 has been reported to malfunction, including failing to stop at a stop sign—resulting in a driver receiving a ticket—and struggling to navigate road hazards, requiring manual intervention to avoid potential accidents. These incidents highlight safety and legal risks associated with the AI system's real-world deployment.

records.title: AI-Enabled Drone Strikes Cause Civilian Casualties in Tigray, Ethiopia
records.description: Ethiopian government forces used AI-enabled drones to conduct airstrikes on Mekelle, Tigray’s capital, targeting civilian areas and a university. The attacks resulted in at least 10 deaths, multiple injuries, and significant property damage, highlighting the direct harm caused by AI-driven military systems amid ongoing conflict.

records.title: Cruise Robotaxi AI System Causes Accident and Expands to New Cities
records.description: Cruise, GM's autonomous vehicle unit, is expanding its driverless robotaxi service to Phoenix and Austin after a recent accident in San Francisco involving its AI-powered vehicles caused minor injuries and led to a software recall. The incident highlights risks associated with deploying AI-driven transportation at scale.

records.title: UK Police Facial Recognition AI Causes Misidentifications and Rights Violations
records.description: Human rights groups have called on the Metropolitan Police to halt the use of live facial recognition AI, citing an 87% misidentification rate. The technology has wrongly flagged innocent people, including minors and minorities, forcing them to prove their identity and raising concerns over privacy, discrimination, and human rights violations.

records.title: Google and Meta Fined in South Korea for Illegal AI-Driven Data Collection
records.description: South Korea fined Google and Meta a record 100 billion won for illegally collecting and using personal data via AI-powered personalized advertising platforms without user consent. The companies failed to clearly inform users or obtain proper consent, violating privacy laws and harming users' rights.

records.title: Tesla's Full Self-Driving AI Faces Safety Criticism and Regulatory Scrutiny
records.description: Tesla's Full Self-Driving (FSD) and Autopilot AI systems face mounting criticism for unreliable and sometimes erratic behavior, especially around pedestrians, leading to safety concerns and regulatory investigations in Germany and the US. Critics allege the software is defective and overpriced, with ongoing risks to road users and consumer rights.

records.title: Greek Politician's Phone Infected by AI-Enabled Predator Spyware for Political Surveillance
records.description: SYRIZA MP Christos Spirtzis was targeted with AI-enabled Predator spyware via infected SMS, leading to his phone being compromised and his communications monitored. The incident, linked to his political activities, constitutes a serious breach of privacy and human rights through the malicious use of AI surveillance technology.

records.title: Buenos Aires Facial Recognition System Ruled Unconstitutional After Rights Violations
records.description: A Buenos Aires court declared the city's AI-powered facial recognition system unconstitutional, citing its implementation without legal safeguards and resulting violations of privacy, personal liberty, and due process. The system accessed biometric data of millions and led to wrongful detentions, prompting judicial intervention and suspension of its use.

records.title: TuSimple Faces Lawsuit Over Autonomous Truck AI Safety Failures
records.description: TuSimple, an autonomous trucking company, faces a class action lawsuit after its AI-driven truck veered into a highway median, nearly causing collisions. The lawsuit alleges the company concealed safety issues and rushed deployment of its AI technology, leading to accidents and endangering public safety.

records.title: German Regulator Orders Tesla to Fix Autopilot After Safety Irregularities and Misleading Marketing Claims
records.description: German authorities ordered Tesla to modify its Autopilot AI system after finding safety irregularities and potential illegality, following reports of accidents. Additionally, Tesla faces regulatory complaints in California for misleadingly marketing its AI-based driver assistance as 'self-driving,' potentially endangering consumers and violating advertising laws.

records.title: AI Moderation on Social Media Platforms Suppresses Palestinian Content
records.description: Media and human rights groups in Gaza criticized social media platforms, especially Facebook, for using AI-driven content moderation algorithms that disproportionately censor Palestinian content. They argue this results in violations of freedom of expression and called for international campaigns and technical understanding to counter these algorithmic biases.

records.title: AI-Controlled Smart Thermostats Lock Out Thousands During Colorado Heatwave
records.description: During a Colorado heatwave, Xcel Energy remotely locked 22,000 customers' smart thermostats using AI-driven controls, preventing users from adjusting home temperatures. This left residents unable to cool their homes, causing discomfort and potential health risks, highlighting the risks of remote AI management in critical home systems.

records.title: Iran Deploys Facial Recognition AI to Enforce Hijab Laws
records.description: The Iranian government is implementing facial recognition AI to identify and penalize women who violate strict hijab laws. This technology enables targeted surveillance, leading to arrests, forced confessions, and repression, raising serious human rights concerns over privacy, freedom of expression, and gender discrimination.

records.title: Snapchat Removes AI Filters After Māori Cultural Outcry
records.description: Snapchat and Instagram faced backlash for AI-powered filters that applied sacred Māori tattoos to users' faces, leading to accusations of cultural appropriation and violation of Māori intellectual property rights. Following public outcry and community harm, Snapchat removed the offending filters from its platform.

records.title: Chinese Authorities Use AI-Enabled DNA Collection for Mass Surveillance in Tibet
records.description: Chinese authorities have conducted large-scale, non-consensual DNA collection from Tibetan residents, including children as young as five, to build regional DNA databases. Human Rights Watch reports this AI-enabled biometric surveillance violates privacy and human rights, with no evidence of criminal justification or informed consent from those affected.

records.title: Chinese Authorities Use AI Facial Recognition Trained on Deceptively Collected Data for Mass Surveillance and Ethnic Profiling
records.description: Chinese authorities collected facial data from rural villagers in Henan, offering small gifts like cooking oil, to train AI facial recognition systems. These systems enable mass surveillance and are used by police to monitor, classify, and discriminate against ethnic minorities, raising serious human rights concerns over privacy and ethnic profiling.

records.title: TSE Orders Removal of Manipulated AI-Edited Video Targeting Lula
records.description: The Brazilian Superior Electoral Court (TSE) ordered social media platforms to remove an AI-manipulated video, initially posted by singer Latino, that falsely portrayed ex-president Lula as insulting his supporters. The edited video spread misinformation, potentially harming electoral integrity and public perception, prompting judicial intervention.

records.title: Inquest Probes AI Algorithms' Role in Molly Russell's Death
records.description: An inquest into the death of 14-year-old Molly Russell will examine whether AI-driven content recommendation algorithms on Meta and Pinterest contributed to her suicide by exposing her to harmful material. Senior employees from both companies have been ordered to give evidence in person.

records.title: Cruise Recalls Robotaxis After AI Malfunction Causes Injury in San Francisco Crash
records.description: General Motors' Cruise recalled and updated software in 80 self-driving vehicles after a June crash in San Francisco. The AI system failed to correctly predict another vehicle's path during an unprotected left turn, resulting in a collision that injured two people. Regulators and police are investigating the incident.

records.title: YouTube Algorithm Amplifies Election-Fraud Misinformation to Skeptical Users
records.description: A study found that YouTube's AI recommendation system disproportionately promoted election-fraud videos to users already skeptical about the 2020 U.S. election, exposing them to three times more such content than less skeptical users. This algorithmic amplification facilitated the spread of misinformation and conspiracy theories, undermining trust in democratic processes.

records.title: US Police Use AI Surveillance Tool 'Fog Reveal' Without Warrants, Violating Privacy Rights
records.description: US police departments have used the AI-powered tool 'Fog Reveal' to track individuals' movements via mobile device data without judicial oversight. The system, developed by Fog Data Science LLC, has enabled mass surveillance and privacy violations, raising concerns over breaches of constitutional protections and human rights.

records.title: Dutch Employers' Use of AI Recruitment Algorithms Leads to Discriminatory Hiring Practices
records.description: Dutch employers widely use AI algorithms in recruitment, often via platforms like LinkedIn. Research by the College for Human Rights reveals these systems frequently cause discrimination and exclusion, particularly against women and people with disabilities, while employers remain largely unaware of the risks and rarely check for fairness.

records.title: Technical Failures and Deployment of Iranian AI-Enabled Drones in Ukraine Conflict
