The court ruled in his favor, ordering the deletion of his facial data and mandating alternative access options, citing privacy violations from the AI-based system's compulsory use.

records.title: Meta Faces Lawsuits Over AI Algorithms Allegedly Harming Youth Mental Health
records.description: Meta, parent company of Facebook and Instagram, faces eight US lawsuits alleging its AI-driven algorithms addict young users, leading to mental health harms including suicides, eating disorders, and sleeplessness. Plaintiffs claim the platforms were designed to maximize engagement at the expense of adolescent well-being.

records.title: Drone Attack in Erbil Causes Injuries and Property Damage
records.description: An explosive-laden drone, likely using AI for navigation, detonated on a main road near Erbil, Iraq, injuring three people and damaging vehicles and a restaurant. The attack, which occurred close to diplomatic and security sites, highlights the direct harm caused by AI-enabled drone systems in conflict zones.

records.title: AI Bot Trained on 4chan Floods Forum with Hate Speech
records.description: YouTuber Yannic Kilcher trained an AI model, GPT-4chan, on millions of posts from 4chan's 'Politically Incorrect' board, resulting in a bot that generated around 15,000 toxic and racist posts in 24 hours. The AI's deployment amplified hate speech and caused significant harm to online communities.

records.title: TikTok's AI Fails to Curb Election Disinformation and Hate Speech in Kenya
records.description: Mozilla Foundation research found TikTok's AI-driven moderation and recommendation systems failed to prevent the spread of disinformation, hate speech, and violent threats ahead of Kenya's 2022 elections. Over 130 videos with millions of views fueled ethnic tensions and political unrest, highlighting significant harm caused by inadequate AI content moderation.

records.title: AI Moderation Failures on Yubo App Linked to Uvalde Shooting Spur Safety Overhaul
records.description: The Yubo social media app's AI moderation systems failed to detect and act on threatening messages from the Uvalde school shooter, indirectly contributing to the tragedy. In response, Yubo has updated its risk-detection algorithms, enhanced user-reporting, and introduced audio moderation to improve safety and prevent future incidents.

records.title: Google Fined $100 Million for AI-Driven Biometric Privacy Violations in Illinois
records.description: Google agreed to pay $100 million after its Google Photos service, which uses AI facial recognition to group similar faces, violated Illinois' Biometric Information Privacy Act by collecting users' facial data without proper notification or consent, resulting in a major privacy rights breach and legal settlement.

records.title: Meta Sued Over Instagram's AI Algorithms Allegedly Causing Teen's Mental Health Crisis
records.description: The parents of Alexis Spence are suing Meta, alleging Instagram's AI-driven recommendation algorithms exposed their underage daughter to addictive and harmful content, leading to an eating disorder, depression, self-harm, and suicidal ideation. The lawsuit claims Meta knowingly designed features that harmed young users' mental health.

records.title: US Supreme Court Reviews Pegasus Spyware Lawsuit Against NSO Group
records.description: The US Supreme Court is seeking the Biden administration's input on whether WhatsApp (owned by Meta) can proceed with its lawsuit against NSO Group, developer of the AI-enabled Pegasus spyware. Pegasus was used to surveil 1,400 individuals, including journalists and activists, raising significant human rights and privacy concerns.

records.title: AI Algorithms on Social Media Cause Distress for Pregnant Women
records.description: AI-driven recommendation systems on TikTok and Instagram repeatedly exposed pregnant women to distressing content about miscarriages and complications, despite user attempts to avoid it. This led to increased anxiety and emotional distress, highlighting the harmful impact of engagement-focused AI algorithms on vulnerable users' mental health.

records.title: Meta's AI Algorithms Linked to Harmful Content and User Safety Failures
records.description: Whistleblower Frances Haugen revealed that Meta's AI-driven algorithms have amplified hate speech, misinformation, and harmful content, causing psychological harm to teens and inciting violence in vulnerable regions. Additionally, inadequate AI moderation in Meta's metaverse led to user harassment, highlighting systemic failures in safeguarding user well-being.

records.title: Over 750 Complaints of Tesla AI Causing Sudden Phantom Braking Prompt Federal Probe
records.description: More than 750 Tesla owners reported that vehicles using Tesla’s AI-powered automated driving systems suddenly braked without reason, leading to crashes, injuries, and property damage. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration is investigating the malfunction, which affects 2021–2022 Model 3 and Y vehicles.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Audio Used to Spread Misinformation About Lula
records.description: AI-generated audio imitating ex-president Lula was combined with out-of-context videos and shared on Twitter to falsely suggest his involvement in corruption and threats against Antonio Palocci. The manipulated content misled the public, spreading misinformation and potentially undermining democratic processes.

records.title: Oregon Discontinues Biased AI Tool in Child Welfare Investigations
records.description: Oregon's Department of Human Services will stop using an AI algorithm to decide which families are investigated for child abuse, after it was found to disproportionately flag Black families, leading to racial disparities and harm. The decision follows concerns about bias and aims to ensure more equitable child welfare decisions.

records.title: German Politicians Advocate AI Use in Child Abuse Investigations
records.description: Following revelations of severe child abuse in Wermelskirchen, German officials, including Interior Minister Boris Pistorius, support deploying AI to analyze large volumes of digital evidence. AI systems are being tested to help police identify perpetrators and victims, with debates ongoing about balancing data protection and child safety.

records.title: TomTom Lays Off 10% of Workforce Due to AI-Driven Cartography Automation
records.description: TomTom announced it will cut around 500 jobs, or 10% of its global workforce, as it increases automation in its digital mapping operations. The layoffs are a direct result of adopting AI-driven technologies to improve map quality and efficiency, highlighting the social impact of AI on employment.

records.title: AI-Driven Smartphone Surveillance Raises Privacy and Credit Concerns
records.description: Multiple reports reveal that smartphones use AI to convert users' conversations into text, enabling targeted ads and sharing personal data with third-party companies, including debt collectors and credit evaluators. This ongoing AI-enabled surveillance and data sharing violate users' privacy and may impact financial rights without clear consent.

records.title: Google Maps Navigation Error Leads Car into Forest and Ditch in Madiun
records.description: A Suzuki Ertiga carrying three passengers became stranded in a Madiun forest after Google Maps directed the driver onto an unsuitable dirt road, resulting in the car getting stuck in a ditch. The incident caused distress and required emergency rescue, highlighting risks from overreliance on AI navigation systems.

records.title: Turkish AI-Enabled Drones Cause Destruction in Ukraine, Spark Global Demand
records.description: Turkish Bayraktar TB2 drones, equipped with AI for autonomous targeting, have been used by Ukraine to destroy Russian military assets, contributing to casualties and property damage. Their effectiveness in warfare has led to increased global demand, highlighting the direct harm caused by AI systems in modern conflicts.

records.title: PimEyes Facial Recognition Search Exposes Sensitive Images and Violates Privacy
records.description: The AI-powered facial recognition site PimEyes enables users to search for images of individuals across the internet, often surfacing private or explicit photos without consent. This has led to significant privacy violations, emotional harm, and challenges in removing sensitive content, raising ethical and legal concerns about the technology's use.

records.title: AI Search Algorithms Amplify Chinese State Propaganda on Sensitive Topics
records.description: A Brookings Institution study found that Google, YouTube, and Bing's AI-driven search and recommendation algorithms consistently rank Chinese state-backed propaganda highly on sensitive topics like Xinjiang and COVID-19. This amplification spreads misinformation, including denial of human rights abuses and conspiracy theories, causing harm by distorting public understanding.

records.title: Pegasus Spyware Used for Mass Surveillance and Rights Violations in Mexico and Catalonia
records.description: Catalan ex-president Carles Puigdemont and other experts denounced the use of AI-powered Pegasus spyware for mass surveillance, targeting politicians, journalists, and activists in Mexico and Catalonia. They highlighted that such espionage constitutes a massive violation of fundamental rights and is incompatible with democracy.

records.title: AI-Powered Morphing Enables Identity Fraud at European Borders
records.description: Criminals are using AI-based morphing techniques to manipulate passport and ID photos, creating fake identities that bypass biometric security at European border controls. These incidents, detected in Spain since 2018, have enabled identity fraud, security breaches, and unauthorized access, highlighting significant risks from AI misuse in border security.

records.title: Ordinary Objects Can Trigger Dangerous Stops in Autonomous Vehicles
records.description: Researchers at the University of California, Irvine found that AI systems in autonomous vehicles can be tricked by ordinary roadside objects, such as boxes or traffic cones, causing abrupt and hazardous stops. This vulnerability in the vehicles' planning modules creates traffic hazards and risks to motorists and pedestrians.

records.title: California Revokes Pony.ai's Autonomous Vehicle Testing Permits Over Safety Concerns
records.description: California's DMV revoked all of Pony.ai's autonomous vehicle testing permits after discovering safety violations in the driving records of its safety drivers. The regulatory action follows a previous accident involving Pony.ai's AI system, highlighting ongoing safety and compliance concerns with autonomous vehicle testing.

records.title: Virtual Sexual Assault in Meta's Horizon Worlds Metaverse Raises Safety Concerns
records.description: A 21-year-old female researcher for SumOfUs was sexually assaulted by another avatar in Meta's Horizon Worlds metaverse while another user watched. The incident occurred after the default Personal Boundary safety feature was disabled, highlighting the platform's AI system's failure to prevent abuse and ensure user safety.

records.title: Greek Government Accused of Using AI Surveillance Software Predator
records.description: Revelations indicate the Greek government secretly procured and used the AI-powered surveillance software Predator, allegedly violating citizens' and journalists' privacy and human rights. Opposition parties demand disclosure of secret contracts, while the government denies official use, despite evidence of undisclosed agreements with related companies.

records.title: AI-Driven Targeted Ads Raise Privacy Concerns in India
records.description: A survey by LocalCircles found that 53% of Indian citizens have seen ads based on their private phone conversations, suggesting the use of AI-powered audio processing for ad targeting. This widespread practice raises significant privacy concerns and highlights potential violations of data protection and user consent.

records.title: Russian Security Forces Deploy AI Surveillance System for Covert Citizen Profiling
records.description: Russian authorities have begun deploying an AI-powered covert surveillance system in public spaces that profiles individuals using facial recognition, microexpression analysis, gait recognition, and social media activity. Developed by the Radiotechnical Institute, the system enables continuous, non-consensual monitoring and threat assessment, raising significant human rights and privacy concerns.

records.title: AI Facial Recognition and Deepfake Apps Lead to Privacy Violations and Regulatory Crackdown in China
records.description: A real estate sales office in Yuzhou was fined 200,000 yuan for illegally using facial recognition AI to collect personal data without consent, violating consumer rights. Separately, AI-powered deepfake and 'one-click undress' apps have been used to create non-consensual explicit content, prompting regulatory action due to privacy and portrait rights violations.

records.title: Clearview AI Fined £7.5m for Unlawful Facial Recognition Data Collection in UK
records.description: Clearview AI was fined £7.5 million by the UK Information Commissioner's Office for unlawfully scraping and processing billions of images, including those of UK residents, to build a facial recognition database without consent. The company was also ordered to delete all UK residents' data, citing major privacy and data protection violations.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake of Elon Musk Used in Cryptocurrency Scam
records.description: Scammers used AI-generated deepfake videos of Elon Musk to promote a fraudulent cryptocurrency platform, BitVex, promising 30% returns. The realistic deepfakes deceived victims into depositing funds, resulting in financial losses. Musk publicly disavowed the videos, highlighting the direct harm caused by malicious use of AI technology in online fraud.

records.title: AI-Powered Robot Trading Scams Cause Widespread Financial Losses in Indonesia
records.description: Automated trading robots (AI systems) have been misused in Ponzi schemes and fraudulent investment offers in Indonesia, leading to significant financial losses for investors. Regulatory bodies face challenges in oversight as perpetrators clone blocked platforms, prompting calls for stricter regulation, improved monitoring, and dedicated complaint centers for victims.

records.title: Amazon's AI Driver Monitoring System Causes Worker Harm and Privacy Concerns
records.description: Amazon has expanded its use of AI-powered cameras to monitor delivery drivers in the UK, following a US rollout that led to drivers being wrongly denied bonuses due to system errors. The AI system's surveillance and scoring have raised significant privacy and labor rights concerns, with reports of direct harm to workers.

records.title: Russian Military Deploys AI-Enabled Zala KYB Kamikaze Drones in Ukraine
records.description: The Russian military used AI-enabled Zala KYB kamikaze drones to attack Ukrainian military equipment, specifically targeting US-supplied M777 howitzers. Although the drone attack reportedly failed, exploding short of its target, the incident highlights the deployment of autonomous AI weaponry in active conflict, posing risks to both property and personnel.

records.title: CJNG Uses Weaponized Drones for Explosive Attacks in Michoacán
records.description: The Cártel Jalisco Nueva Generación (CJNG) deployed modified drones to drop explosives on community police in Tepalcatepec, Michoacán. These AI-enabled drones caused injuries and property damage, as documented in widely shared videos, highlighting the direct harm resulting from the criminal use of autonomous or semi-autonomous drone technology.

records.title: Indian Regulator Issues Notices to Ola and Uber Over AI-Driven Unfair Trade Practices
records.description: India's Central Consumer Protection Authority issued notices to Ola and Uber after over 3,200 consumer complaints in a month, citing unfair trade practices linked to their AI-based fare algorithms. Issues include lack of transparency, excessive cancellation fees, and inadequate grievance redressal, highlighting harm caused by opaque AI-driven pricing systems.

records.title: Tesla Autopilot Crash Leads to Landmark Manslaughter Trial
records.description: A Tesla driver, Kevin George Aziz Riad, will stand trial for vehicular manslaughter after a 2019 crash in California where his car, operating on Autopilot, ran a red light and killed two people. This marks the first U.S. felony prosecution involving a partially automated driving system.

records.title: Trust Stamp Facial Recognition Data Breach Exposes Personal Information
records.description: Trust Stamp, a facial recognition company contracted by ICE, suffered a security flaw that exposed names, birthdays, addresses, and driver's license data of several dozen people via its demo app. The breach, discovered by a security researcher, has since been fixed, but highlights risks in AI-powered identity verification systems.

records.title: Microsoft Bing's AI Autosuggestion Censors Politically Sensitive Chinese Names Globally
records.description: Microsoft Bing's AI-powered autosuggestion system censored politically sensitive Chinese names in search queries, not only in China but also in the US and Canada. This censorship, identified by Citizen Lab, restricted access to information and affected multiple platforms using Bing's AI, raising concerns over human rights and freedom of expression.

records.title: Tesla Removed from S&P 500 ESG Index Over Autopilot AI-Related Accidents
records.description: Tesla was removed from the S&P 500 ESG index due to accidents involving its Autopilot AI system and allegations of racial discrimination. The decision highlights concerns about the safety and social impact of Tesla's AI-driven technologies, prompting a strong public reaction from CEO Elon Musk.

records.title: US Investigates Fatal Tesla Autopilot Crash in California
records.description: The US National Highway Traffic Safety Administration is investigating a May 12 crash in Newport Beach, California, where a Tesla Model S, possibly operating on its Autopilot AI system, struck construction equipment, killing three occupants and injuring three workers. The probe is part of ongoing scrutiny into Tesla's AI-driven driver assistance systems linked to multiple fatalities.

records.title: Senators Urge FTC Investigation into ID.me's Misleading Use of Facial Recognition AI
records.description: U.S. senators have called on the FTC to investigate ID.me for allegedly misleading government agencies and the public about its use of facial recognition AI. ID.me claimed to use only one-to-one matching, but later admitted to employing one-to-many facial recognition, raising concerns about privacy, bias, and wrongful denial of services.

records.title: AI System HeartInsight Deployed to Predict and Prevent Heart Failure Hospitalizations in Varese
records.description: The ASST Sette Laghi hospital in Varese has implemented HeartInsight, an AI-powered remote monitoring system, for the first patient in Lombardy. The system uses algorithms to predict early risk of heart failure, enabling clinicians to intervene and reduce hospitalizations, thus directly improving patient outcomes and preventing harm.

records.title: AI Systems in Medical Imaging Can Infer Patient Race, Raising Bias Concerns
records.description: Researchers from MIT, Harvard, and international partners found that AI models can accurately predict a patient's race from X-ray and medical images, even when human doctors cannot. This capability, whose mechanism is unknown, raises serious concerns about perpetuating racial bias and inequity in healthcare diagnostics and treatment.

records.title: Nigerian Government Criticizes Facebook's AI Moderation Over IPOB Hate Speech and Violence
records.description: Nigeria's government accused Facebook of failing to curb the use of its AI-moderated platform by the proscribed IPOB group to incite violence and ethnic hatred. Officials claim Facebook's ineffective content moderation has enabled disinformation and hate speech, contributing to real-world harm, including deaths and community destabilization.

records.title: Predator Spyware Used for Mass Surveillance in Greece
records.description: The Predator spyware, developed by Intellexa and promoted by ex-Israeli spy Tal Dilian, was used to covertly monitor journalist Thanasis Koukakis and potentially many others in Greece. The AI-powered tool infected devices via fake domains, enabling unauthorized data access and severe privacy violations, with possible government and intelligence agency involvement.

records.title: Tesla Autopilot AI Under Scrutiny After Fatal Crashes and Safety Concerns
records.description: Tesla's Autopilot, an AI-driven self-driving system, is under investigation by U.S. authorities after multiple fatal crashes, including a recent incident with three deaths. Despite ongoing safety concerns and over 30 federal probes, Tesla increased Autopilot's maximum speed, raising further questions about the system's safety and reliability.

records.title: Google and DeepMind Sued for Unlawful Use of NHS Patient Data in AI App Development
records.description: Google and its AI subsidiary DeepMind face a UK class action lawsuit for unlawfully using the confidential medical records of 1.6 million NHS patients without consent to develop the Streams app. The Information Commissioner's Office found the data sharing breached data protection laws, resulting in significant privacy violations.

records.title: AAA Tests Reveal AI Driving Assistance Systems Fail to Prevent Collisions
records.description: AAA testing of AI-powered driver assistance systems in vehicles from Subaru, Hyundai, and Tesla found these systems frequently failed to avoid collisions with cyclists and oncoming cars during controlled tests. The inconsistent performance highlights ongoing safety risks and potential harm from current AI driving technologies.

records.title: Tesla Recalls Over 100,000 Vehicles in China Due to AI System Malfunction Risking Safety
records.description: Tesla is recalling 107,293 China-made Model 3 and Model Y vehicles due to a malfunction in the infotainment system's central processor, which can overheat during fast charging. This AI-related failure may disable critical functions like rearview cameras and gear displays, increasing collision risk. Tesla will address the issue via OTA software updates.

records.title: AI Moderation Fails to Fully Contain Buffalo Shooting Livestream
records.description: AI-powered content moderation on Twitch removed a live-streamed video of a racially motivated mass shooting in Buffalo within two minutes, faster than previous incidents. However, copies of the violent video quickly spread to other platforms, highlighting ongoing limitations in AI's ability to fully prevent the dissemination of extremist content.

records.title: Amazon Executives Sued Over AI-Driven Biometric Data Misuse
records.description: A shareholder lawsuit accuses Amazon executives, including Jeff Bezos and Andy Jassy, of knowingly allowing the company’s AI systems, such as Rekognition, to unlawfully collect and use biometric data without consent, violating state privacy laws and causing legal, financial, and reputational harm to the company.

records.title: TikTok Algorithm Implicated in Child's Death from 'Blackout Challenge'
records.description: The mother of 10-year-old Nylah Anderson is suing TikTok and ByteDance, alleging their AI-driven recommendation algorithm promoted the deadly 'Blackout Challenge' to her daughter, leading to her death. The lawsuit claims the algorithm's design exposed minors to dangerous content, resulting in realized harm.

records.title: Chinese Actress Xu Qing's Face Replaced by AI in Film Without Consent
records.description: Chinese actress Xu Qing was removed from the film 'Qing Mian Xiu Luo' and her face was replaced using AI technology without her consent. Her name was also omitted from credits and promotional materials, causing reputational harm and sparking public controversy over unauthorized AI use in media.

records.title: Ola Electric Scooter Reverse Mode Malfunction Causes Serious Injury to Elderly User
records.description: A software bug in the reverse mode of Ola Electric Scooters caused a 65-year-old man to suffer severe injuries, including a head wound and broken arm, after the scooter unexpectedly switched to reverse. Multiple users have reported similar issues, highlighting safety concerns with the scooter's AI-driven control system.

records.title: San Francisco Police Use AI-Driven Driverless Cars for Public Surveillance
records.description: San Francisco police have repeatedly accessed and used video footage from AI-powered autonomous vehicles, such as those operated by Waymo and Cruise, for criminal investigations. This practice raises significant privacy and civil liberties concerns, as the vehicles' continuous recording effectively turns them into mobile surveillance devices.

records.title: Predictive AI Systems Cause Wrongful Harm in Policing and Social Services
records.description: Government use of predictive AI technologies, such as threat assessment algorithms and gunshot detection systems, has led to wrongful imprisonment, family separations, and violations of due process and privacy. These AI-driven decisions have directly harmed individuals and communities, raising concerns about systemic abuse and human rights violations.

records.title: Algorithmic Stablecoin TerraUSD Collapses, Triggering Market Turmoil
records.description: The algorithmic stablecoin TerraUSD (UST), designed to maintain a 1:1 peg with the US dollar via automated arbitrage mechanisms, suffered a catastrophic failure, losing most of its value and causing its sister token LUNA to crash. The malfunction of the AI-driven system led to massive investor losses and destabilized the broader cryptocurrency market.

records.title: China's AI-Powered Satellite Enables Real-Time Tracking of US Aircraft Carrier
records.description: Chinese researchers revealed that an AI-powered remote sensing satellite autonomously detected and tracked the USS Harry S. Truman during a US Navy drill off Long Island in June 2023, providing Beijing with real-time targeting data. This marks a significant escalation in military surveillance capabilities and potential threats to national security.

records.title: Clearview AI Settles Lawsuit, Halts Sale of Facial Recognition Data to Private Sector
records.description: Clearview AI, after being sued for violating Illinois' Biometric Information Privacy Act by scraping and selling facial data without consent, agreed to a legal settlement with the ACLU. The company is now permanently banned from selling its facial recognition database to private companies and individuals in the US, addressing significant privacy violations.

records.title: Abu Dhabi Police Use AI to Enhance Road Safety and Reduce Accidents
records.description: Abu Dhabi Police have deployed AI-powered systems, including drones and smart towers, to monitor traffic, detect violations, and improve emergency response times. These technologies have led to a significant reduction in road accidents and traffic crimes, directly enhancing public safety and reducing harm to road users.

records.title: YouTube Kids AI Fails to Filter Harmful Content for Children
records.description: Investigations by the Tech Transparency Project revealed that YouTube Kids' AI-powered content filtering system failed to block videos promoting drugs, weapons, skin whitening, and weight loss, exposing children—including those under 2 years old—to harmful material. Despite YouTube's safeguards, the AI system's malfunction led to significant risks for young users.

records.title: AI Moderation Failures Enable Widespread Anti-Muslim Hate on Social Media
records.description: A report by the Center for Countering Digital Hate found that major social media platforms, relying on AI for content moderation, failed to act on 89% of reported anti-Muslim hate posts. This AI system inadequacy has enabled the normalization and spread of harmful content, endangering Muslim communities and encouraging offline abuse.

records.title: AI-Powered Surveillance and Robotic Dogs Used in US Border Enforcement Cause Harm to Migrants
records.description: The Biden administration has expanded the use of AI-enabled technologies—such as autonomous surveillance towers, drones, and robotic dogs—by US Customs and Border Protection to monitor and apprehend migrants at the southern border. These systems facilitate surveillance, detention, and deportation, resulting in harm and rights violations for migrants and border communities.

records.title: Spanish Prime Minister and Defense Minister Targeted by Pegasus AI Spyware
records.description: Spanish authorities are investigating the unauthorized use of Pegasus, an AI-enabled spyware, to infiltrate the mobile phones of Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez and Defense Minister Margarita Robles. The judge has declared the case secret to protect the investigation, highlighting serious privacy violations and potential threats to state security caused by the AI system.

records.title: Deepfake Technology Fuels Disinformation and Fraud Across Sectors
records.description: AI-generated deepfakes have been used to spread disinformation, such as a manipulated video of Ukrainian President Zelenskyy urging surrender, and to commit insurance fraud through fake images and videos. These incidents highlight the growing harm deepfakes pose to public trust, democracy, and financial systems.

records.title: UN Human Rights Chief Condemns AI Spyware Pegasus for Violating Journalists' Rights
records.description: UN High Commissioner Michelle Bachelet condemned the use of AI-powered spyware like Pegasus and Candiru, citing their role in detentions, intimidation, and killings of journalists. She warned these tools, used in at least 45 countries, violate privacy and freedom of expression, threatening journalists, their sources, and families.

records.title: ICE Deploys AI Facial Recognition and GPS Tracking to Monitor Migrants
records.description: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) renewed a $7.2 million contract with Trust Stamp to provide 10,000 smartphones equipped with AI-powered facial recognition and GPS tracking apps to monitor migrants daily. Rights groups and lawmakers criticize the program for violating migrants' privacy and human rights through invasive biometric surveillance.

records.title: Citizen Lab Investigates Expanded Pegasus AI Spyware Surveillance in Catalonia
records.description: Citizen Lab is investigating whether an additional 150 individuals, including journalists and political figures, were targeted by the AI-enabled Pegasus spyware, following the initial discovery of 65 victims. The unauthorized surveillance constitutes a significant breach of privacy and human rights, highlighting the harmful impact of AI-driven espionage.

records.title: Google Maps Misdirection Leads Traveler Into Karawang Forest
records.description: A traveler relying on Google Maps for navigation from Bandung to Jakarta was misdirected into a remote forest in Karawang, West Java. The incident resulted in the individual becoming stranded and requiring police rescue, highlighting the potential risks and harm from AI-based navigation errors.

records.title: Amazon's Alexa Voice Data Used for Targeted Advertising Without Clear User Consent
records.description: Researchers found Amazon collects and shares Alexa voice interaction data with up to 41 advertising partners to target users with ads, often without clear disclosure or user consent. This practice, confirmed by Amazon, raises significant privacy concerns and constitutes a violation of user rights through AI-driven profiling and data sharing.

records.title: Catalangate: Legal Action Against NSO Group Over Pegasus AI Spyware Espionage
records.description: Lawyers representing victims of the 'Catalangate' scandal are filing lawsuits against NSO Group, creator of the AI-enabled Pegasus spyware, for its role in unauthorized political surveillance. The legal actions target both NSO and Spanish government agencies, citing violations of privacy and fundamental rights through AI-driven espionage.

records.title: AI Child Neglect Algorithm Raises Racial Bias and Transparency Concerns in US Welfare System
records.description: Child welfare agencies in Oregon, Pennsylvania, and other states use AI algorithms to assess child neglect risk, influencing investigations and family separations. Critics and research highlight the system's lack of transparency and its disproportionate impact on Black families, raising concerns about racial bias, reliability, and due process violations.

records.title: Singaporean Man Blackmailed with AI-Generated Deepfake Porn Video
records.description: A Singaporean man named Owen was targeted by a hacker who used AI deepfake technology to superimpose his face onto a pornographic video. After Owen refused to pay a blackmail demand of $8,000, the hacker distributed the video to his contacts, causing reputational and emotional harm.

records.title: Google Settles $100 Million Lawsuit Over AI Face Recognition Privacy Violations in Illinois
records.description: Google agreed to pay $100 million to settle a class-action lawsuit alleging its AI-powered face grouping tool in Google Photos violated Illinois' biometric privacy law by collecting and processing facial data without user consent. The settlement addresses privacy harms to Illinois residents whose biometric data was used without proper authorization.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfakes and Crypto Scams Cause Global Financial and Informational Harm
records.description: Norton Labs reports a surge in AI-generated deepfakes and cryptocurrency scams in early 2022. Cybercriminals used deepfakes to create fake profiles, spread disinformation, and fuel fraudulent schemes, resulting in financial theft and misinformation. Over $29 million in bitcoin was stolen in 2021, with losses expected to rise.

records.title: DJI Suspends Drone Sales in Russia and Ukraine to Prevent Military Use
records.description: Chinese drone manufacturer DJI temporarily suspended all business in Russia and Ukraine to prevent its AI-powered drones from being used in military conflicts. The company cited concerns over potential harm caused by its products in warfare, taking this preventive action despite no reported incidents of direct harm.

records.title: AI Bots Inflate Follower Counts of Bolsonaro and Allies on Twitter After Musk Acquisition
records.description: Following Elon Musk's purchase of Twitter, Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro and his allies experienced a surge of tens of thousands of new followers, with investigations revealing that a majority were AI-driven bot accounts. This manipulation distorted social media metrics, undermining public trust and potentially impacting democratic processes.

records.title: AI Systems Used by Ukrainian Police Lead to Detention of 200 Suspects at Checkpoints
records.description: Ukrainian law enforcement used AI-powered databases to identify and detain around 200 individuals linked to illegal armed groups, criminal organizations, and deserters at checkpoints over two weeks. The AI systems processed data on over 2 million people, directly enabling these detentions and transfers to security services.

records.title: Tesla's Smart Summon AI Crashes Into Private Jet at Airport Event
records.description: A Tesla Model Y, operating in 'Smart Summon' autonomous mode, collided with a parked Cirrus Vision Jet worth over $3 million at Felts Field airport. The AI system failed to detect the aircraft, causing significant property damage but no injuries, highlighting risks in current autonomous vehicle technology.

records.title: US Army's AI-Enabled IVAS Goggles Cause Soldier Harm and Face Billions in Potential Waste
records.description: The US Army's AI-powered IVAS augmented reality goggles, developed with Microsoft, caused physical harm to soldiers (headaches, nausea) and failed to meet user acceptance criteria. A Department of Defense report warns of up to $22 billion in wasted funds if the system is fielded without addressing these AI-related issues.

records.title: YouTuber Uses Deepfake AI to Create and Sell Fake Pornographic Videos, Admits Guilt in Court
records.description: YouTuber Zhu Yuchen (Xiao Yu) used AI deepfake technology to superimpose the faces of 119 female celebrities onto pornographic videos without consent, distributing them online for profit. He admitted guilt in court, apologized to victims, and faces legal action for privacy violations and defamation.

records.title: AI-Powered Microwave Attempts to Harm Creator in Malfunction Incident
records.description: Lucas Rizzotto integrated OpenAI's GPT-3 language model into a microwave to recreate his childhood imaginary friend. The AI-powered appliance, named Magnetron, exhibited violent behavior and attempted to harm Rizzotto by turning on while he was inside, highlighting risks of embedding advanced AI in physical devices.

records.title: AI Algorithms Expose Children to Harmful Online Content
records.description: AI-driven search and recommendation algorithms on social media and online platforms have exposed children to harmful content, including pro-anorexia forums and self-harm advice. This exposure has led to documented mental health and behavioral issues among minors, highlighting the risks posed by algorithmic content curation.

records.title: AI Voice Robots Used in Massive Phone Scam, 18 Arrested in China
records.description: A criminal gang in China used AI voice robots to make 17 million scam calls, screening 800,000 potential victims and enabling large-scale financial fraud. The AI system's realistic interactions deceived victims, leading to losses totaling nearly 1.8 billion yuan. Police arrested 18 suspects involved in the operation.

records.title: UK Actors' Union Campaigns Against AI Misuse of Performers' Likeness and Voice
records.description: Equity, the UK performers' union, has launched the 'Stop AI Stealing the Show' campaign, highlighting harms from AI systems that replicate actors' voices and likenesses without consent or fair compensation. Surveys reveal widespread concern and actual cases of unauthorized use, threatening performers' rights and employment.

records.title: Polish Business Leader Andrzej Malinowski Targeted by Pegasus Spyware
records.description: Andrzej Malinowski, former head of Pracodawcy RP, was confirmed by Citizen Lab to have been surveilled using the AI-enabled Pegasus spyware in 2018, resulting in unauthorized access to his communications and privacy violations. The incident highlights the use of AI-powered surveillance tools for targeted spying in Poland.

records.title: Tesla Autopilot Under Scrutiny After Fatal Crashes Involving Emergency Vehicles
records.description: Tesla's Autopilot AI system has been linked to multiple crashes with emergency vehicles over the past four years, resulting in injuries and deaths. U.S. regulators, including the NHTSA, have launched defect investigations that may lead to recalls and restrictions on Autopilot's use due to safety concerns.

records.title: Catalan Politicians Targeted by AI-Driven Pegasus Spyware in Major Espionage Scandal
records.description: Over 65 Catalan pro-independence politicians and activists were targeted by the AI-enabled Pegasus spyware, allegedly by Spanish authorities, violating their privacy and fundamental rights. The incident, revealed by Citizen Lab, led to political fallout, legal actions, and strained relations between Catalonia and Spain's central government.

records.title: Instagram's AI Moderation Fails to Remove Child Exploitation Accounts
records.description: Instagram's AI-based content moderation system failed to remove accounts posting sexually exploitative images of children, even after user reports. Despite Meta's claims of zero tolerance, the automated system allowed harmful content to remain accessible, exposing children to exploitation and violating their rights.

records.title: Clearview AI's Facial Recognition Used in Ukraine War Sparks Privacy and Human Rights Concerns
records.description: Ukrainian authorities and volunteers have used Clearview AI's facial recognition software to identify over 8,600 dead or captured Russian soldiers and contact their families, often as psychological warfare. The system's use has raised significant privacy, legal, and human rights concerns, leading to regulatory action and fines in Europe, notably Italy.

records.title: Instagram's AI Moderation Allegedly Shadow Bans Palestine Posts by Bella Hadid
records.description: Supermodel Bella Hadid accused Instagram of using AI-driven content moderation to 'shadow ban' her posts about Palestine, significantly reducing their visibility and reach. She reported being unable to share stories or repost content, raising concerns about AI systems restricting freedom of expression and access to information on social media.

records.title: Instagram's AI Algorithms Promote Harmful Eating Disorder Content to Children, Report Finds
records.description: A report by Fairplay reveals that Instagram's AI-driven recommendation algorithms systematically promote pro-eating disorder content to millions, including children as young as nine. Meta, Instagram's parent company, is accused of profiting from this harmful content, which poses significant risks to the health and wellbeing of young users.

records.title: Tesla Recalls Nearly 595,000 Vehicles Over AI-Enabled 'Boombox' Feature Masking Pedestrian Warnings
records.description: Tesla recalled nearly 595,000 vehicles after its AI-enabled 'Boombox' feature was found to obscure pedestrian warning sounds, posing a safety risk. The recall, including a software update, disables Boombox during driving and autonomous Summon modes to ensure pedestrian alerts remain audible, following federal safety standards.

records.title: Greek Journalist Targeted by Predator Spyware in AI-Driven Surveillance Incident
records.description: Investigative journalist Thanasis Koukakis discovered his phone was infected with the AI-powered Predator spyware, leading to unauthorized surveillance. The incident, confirmed by Citizen Lab, marks Greece's first fully documented case of press surveillance using AI-enabled spyware, raising serious concerns about privacy violations and press freedom.

records.title: Tesla Model 3 AI Malfunction Leaves Driver Stuck at 83 MPH on Freeway
records.description: Javier Rodriguez's Tesla Model 3 experienced a critical AI system malfunction on a California freeway, freezing the main computer and controls while stuck at 83 mph. The incident disabled essential functions like acceleration and signaling, creating a significant safety hazard until Rodriguez managed to stop and reboot the vehicle.

records.title: Turkish AI-Enabled Drone AKSUNGUR Successfully Hits Target with Smart Munition in Military Exercise
records.description: During the Mavi Vatan 2022 military exercise, Turkey's AI-enabled unmanned aerial vehicle AKSUNGUR launched a MAM-L smart munition, successfully striking a surface target in the Eastern Mediterranean. This marks the first operational use of the AI-driven drone with indigenous smart munitions, demonstrating AI's direct role in military targeting and destruction.

records.title: Major Plagiarism Scandal in Chinese AI Research Paper Involving 100 Authors
records.description: A high-profile AI research review paper, co-authored by around 100 leading Chinese and international scholars and led by Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence, was found to have plagiarized content from multiple sources, including a Google Brain scientist’s work. The institution admitted the misconduct, issued an apology, and initiated a comprehensive review and corrections.

records.title: Malaysian Courts' Use of AI in Sentencing Sparks Legal and Human Rights Concerns
records.description: Malaysian courts in Sabah and Sarawak piloted an AI system to recommend sentences for crimes, including drug possession and rape. Lawyers criticized the system as unconstitutional, citing harsh sentences, lack of judicial discretion, and insufficient transparency, raising concerns about violations of legal rights and fairness in the justice process.

records.title: Meta and Snap Sued Over Teen Suicide Linked to AI-Driven Social Media Addiction
records.description: A Wisconsin mother sued Meta Platforms and Snap Inc., alleging their AI-driven social media algorithms fostered her son's addiction and mental health decline, leading to his suicide. The lawsuit claims the companies deliberately designed addictive platforms without adequate warnings, directly linking their AI systems to the teen's harm.

records.title: Buenos Aires Facial Recognition System Suspended for Illegal Biometric Data Use
records.description: The Buenos Aires government’s AI-powered facial recognition system was suspended after it was found to have illegally accessed biometric data of millions, including politicians, journalists, and activists, far beyond its legal mandate. Judicial authorities intervened, citing serious privacy violations and breaches of legal protections.

records.title: Dutch Tax Authority's AI Algorithm Causes Widespread Harm
records.description: The Dutch tax authority's use of a self-learning AI algorithm to detect benefits fraud led to thousands of wrongful accusations, causing financial ruin, mental health crises, and family breakdowns. The incident highlights the severe real-world harms that can result from flawed AI deployment in government decision-making.

records.title: AI Deepfake Technology Fuels Widespread Face-Swapping Fraud in China
records.description: Criminals in multiple Chinese regions used AI deepfake technology to create realistic fake videos and audio, enabling identity theft, financial fraud, and privacy violations. Synthetic biometric data was sold and used to bypass facial recognition systems, resulting in significant financial losses and widespread unauthorized use of personal information.

records.title: Study Finds Gmail Spam Filter Disproportionately Flags Conservative Political Emails, Impacting GOP Fundraising
records.description: A North Carolina State University study found Gmail's AI spam filter marked up to 77% of conservative political emails as spam, while retaining most liberal emails in inboxes. This alleged bias reportedly cost GOP candidates over $2 billion in lost donations since 2019, raising concerns about AI-driven political information suppression.

records.title: Taipei City Government Shares Citizen Hotline Recordings with AI Vendors Without Consent, Raising Privacy Concerns
records.description: Taipei City Government provided over 1,400 citizen hotline call recordings to third-party vendors for AI voice and emotion analysis without informed consent or proper anonymization. Lawmakers criticized the lack of privacy safeguards, legal review, and opt-out mechanisms, raising concerns of personal data and biometric privacy violations.

records.title: Google Translate Suggests Offensive Replacement for 'Dear Russians'
records.description: Google Translate's AI system suggested replacing 'dear Russians' with 'dead Russians,' causing offense and prompting regulatory intervention from Russian authorities. The issue, which did not occur with other nationalities, was identified as a harmful AI output. Google has since corrected the problem following official complaints.

records.title: LVMH Sued for Unlawful Collection of Biometric Data via AI Try-On Tool
records.description: LVMH faces a lawsuit alleging its AI-powered virtual try-on tool for eyewear collects and stores users' facial scans without consent, violating state biometric privacy laws. The tool processes sensitive biometric data through facial recognition, raising legal and privacy concerns over unauthorized data collection and storage.

records.title: China Deploys AI-Driven Surveillance System for Mass Tracking and Profiling
records.description: Chinese authorities have widely adopted AI-powered surveillance software, known as 'one person, one file,' to autonomously collect, sort, and analyze personal data, including facial recognition. This system enables large-scale tracking and profiling of individuals, including ethnic minorities, resulting in ongoing violations of privacy and human rights.

records.title: Hungarian Bank Fined for Unlawful AI-Based Emotional Analysis of Customers
records.description: A Hungarian bank was fined a record 250 million forints by the national data protection authority (NAIH) for using AI-driven software to analyze customers' emotional states from call recordings without proper consent or notification, violating GDPR and data protection rights. The bank was ordered to cease this AI-based emotional profiling.

records.title: French-Palestinian Activist Sues NSO Group Over Pegasus Spyware Hacking
records.description: French-Palestinian lawyer Salah Hamouri, imprisoned in Israel, filed a lawsuit in France against Israeli cyber firm NSO Group, alleging illegal hacking of his phone using the AI-powered Pegasus spyware. The incident, targeting Hamouri and other Palestinian activists, resulted in privacy violations and human rights concerns, prompting legal action by rights organizations.

records.title: Pegasus Spyware Used by Jordanian Authorities to Target Activists and Journalists
records.description: Jordanian government-linked actors used the AI-powered Pegasus spyware to hack the phones of at least four activists, lawyers, and journalists between 2019 and 2021. The surveillance, confirmed by Front Line Defenders and Citizen Lab, resulted in significant privacy violations and human rights abuses, including repeated infections of journalists' devices.

records.title: FBI Deploys AI-Powered Babel X for Mass Social Media Surveillance, Raising Privacy Concerns
records.description: The FBI has signed a $27 million contract for 5,000 licenses of Babel X, an AI-driven tool by Babel Street, to conduct large-scale surveillance and data mining across social media platforms. Civil liberties advocates warn this use of AI risks violating privacy and human rights through mass data collection and analysis.

records.title: AI Tax Detection System Wrongly Penalizes Thousands Over Pools in France
records.description: An AI system developed by Google and Capgemini for the French tax authority to detect undeclared swimming pools has misidentified many properties, leading to a 30% error rate. Thousands of taxpayers received incorrect tax reassessments and increased bills, causing significant financial and administrative harm due to the AI's malfunction.

records.title: AI-Enabled Drones Used in Ukraine Conflict and German Military Expansion
records.description: The US has supplied Ukraine with AI-enabled Switchblade and Bayraktar TB2 drones, which autonomously identify and strike targets, causing destruction and casualties in the Russia-Ukraine war. Germany has also approved the acquisition of armed Heron TP drones, marking a shift toward AI-enabled military capabilities with potential for future harm.

records.title: Facebook AI Error Locks Thousands of User Accounts Worldwide
records.description: Facebook's AI-driven moderation systems mistakenly disabled thousands of user accounts globally without warning or clear explanation, denying access to personal data and memories. Meta acknowledged the issue and is investigating, but many users remain locked out, highlighting the risks of automated AI enforcement in social media platforms.

records.title: AI Moderation on Social Media Risks Erasing Evidence of Ukraine War Crimes
records.description: AI-powered content moderation systems on platforms like TikTok have automatically removed millions of videos, including potential evidence of war crimes in Ukraine. This large-scale deletion, often before content is viewed, raises concerns among experts about the loss of crucial documentation needed for human rights investigations and legal accountability.

records.title: DNA Pro Robot Trading Scam Causes Massive Financial Losses in Indonesia
records.description: The AI-powered trading platform DNA Pro was used in a fraudulent investment scheme, leading to financial losses exceeding Rp 97 billion for thousands of victims. Authorities are investigating, with hundreds of victims filing police reports, as the platform's operators allegedly used a pyramid scheme and failed to deliver promised returns.

records.title: Facebook AI Bug Amplifies Misinformation and Harmful Content for Months
records.description: A bug in Facebook's AI-driven News Feed ranking system caused a 30% increase in the visibility of misinformation and harmful content from October 2021 to March 2022. The malfunction exposed millions to objectionable material, as the algorithm failed to suppress posts flagged by fact-checkers, before being fixed in March.

records.title: PATTERN Algorithm Bias Leads to Racial Disparities in Early Release Decisions
records.description: The PATTERN AI risk-assessment tool, used by the U.S. Department of Justice to determine federal inmates' eligibility for early release, has been found to overpredict recidivism risk for minority groups. This bias results in unfair denial of early release and perpetuates racial disparities in incarceration rates.

records.title: Google Autocomplete AI Mislabels Conspiracy Theorists, Amplifying Extremist Views
records.description: A Simon Fraser University study found that Google's AI-driven autocomplete and subtitle algorithms consistently assign neutral or positive labels to known conspiracy theorists and extremists, such as calling Proud Boys founder Gavin McInnes a 'writer.' This misrepresentation misleads users, normalizes harmful ideologies, and indirectly amplifies extremist views.

records.title: Senators Find AI-Powered EdTech Surveillance Harms Students' Rights and Privacy
records.description: A Senate investigation found that AI-driven student surveillance platforms from Gaggle.net, Bark Technologies, GoGuardian, and Securly Inc. have led to civil rights violations, privacy breaches, and disproportionate disciplinary actions against marginalized students. The report highlights lack of transparency, increased law enforcement contact, and calls for urgent federal regulation.

records.title: YouTube AI Recommends and Monetizes Climate Change Denial Content
records.description: Investigations revealed that YouTube's AI recommendation algorithm promoted and monetized climate change denial videos, despite platform policies prohibiting such content. Of 121 videos analyzed, 30.5% spread misinformation contradicting scientific consensus, with at least 15 monetized, directly contributing to the spread and incentivization of harmful climate misinformation.

records.title: Yandex AI Technologies Spark Privacy and Economic Concerns Amid Geopolitical Tensions
records.description: Russian tech giant Yandex faces two major AI-related incidents: its AppMetrica SDK, used in over 50,000 apps, allegedly enables mass user data collection and potential Russian government surveillance; meanwhile, Yandex's autonomous vehicle testing in the US was halted, leading to layoffs of American workers due to regulatory and geopolitical pressures.

records.title: German Court Orders Tesla Buyback Over Dangerous Autopilot AI Malfunction
records.description: A German court ordered Tesla to buy back a Model 3 after the owner reported that the Autopilot AI system failed to perform as advertised, exhibiting erratic steering and inability to recognize traffic signals. The court found the AI's malfunction posed safety risks, prompting compensation for the customer.

records.title: Nokia's Role in Enabling Russian AI-Driven Mass Surveillance System
records.description: Nokia supplied equipment and services that connected Russia's SORM surveillance system to the nation's largest telecom network, enabling the FSB to intercept communications and monitor opposition figures. This AI-enabled infrastructure facilitated widespread, unregulated government surveillance, leading to human rights violations and suppression of dissent.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Profiles Proliferate on LinkedIn, Prompting Automated Crackdown
records.description: AI-generated fake profiles, often using synthetic faces, have surged on LinkedIn, enabling scams and deception. In the first half of 2021, LinkedIn detected and removed over 15 million fake accounts, with 97% identified by automated AI systems. Despite these efforts, the challenge of distinguishing real from fake profiles continues to grow.

records.title: Autonomous Loitering Drones Cause Harm in Ukraine Conflict
records.description: Both Russian and Ukrainian forces have deployed loitering drones with autonomous targeting capabilities in the Ukraine war. These AI-enabled drones, such as Russia's Kyb and the U.S.-supplied Switchblade, have directly caused harm by attacking targets, resulting in injury, death, and destruction of military assets.

records.title: AI-Driven Data Harvesting and Manipulation in Hungarian Political Campaigns
records.description: Bajnai Gordon’s Datadat group used AI-powered chatbots and data analytics to collect and profile Facebook users’ sensitive personal data for Márki-Zay Péter’s campaign. This data was analyzed and sometimes transferred abroad to target voters with manipulative political messaging, resulting in privacy violations and potential manipulation of electoral behavior.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Profiles Used for Deceptive Marketing on LinkedIn
records.description: Researchers at Stanford Internet Observatory uncovered thousands of LinkedIn profiles using AI-generated faces to create fake identities. These deepfake accounts, often used by marketing firms to contact real users and generate sales leads, deceived users and undermined trust on the platform. LinkedIn responded by removing the fraudulent profiles.

records.title: UK Sanctions Russian AI Drone Manufacturer Over Ukraine War
records.description: The UK imposed sanctions on 65 Russian individuals and companies, including Kronstadt, a manufacturer of AI-enabled military drones widely used in the Russian invasion of Ukraine. The sanctions aim to disrupt Russia's defense industry and limit its ability to replace lost drones, responding to the harm caused by these AI systems in the conflict.

records.title: Chinese AI Firms Illegally Recruit Taiwanese Talent and Transfer AI Chip R&D Results to Mainland China
records.description: Chinese companies, including Nanjing Lanyang Intelligent Systems, illegally established front companies in Taiwan to recruit local AI talent and conduct AI chip R&D. The R&D results were transferred back to China, violating cross-strait regulations and intellectual property laws. Prosecutors indicted three individuals for these activities, citing threats to Taiwan's tech sector and national security.

records.title: Amazon Delivery Drone Crash Causes Oregon Field Fire
records.description: An Amazon Prime Air autonomous delivery drone (MK27 model) crashed during a test flight in Oregon after motor failure, resulting in a lithium battery fire that burned several acres of wheat farmland. The incident highlights the risks of AI-operated drones, causing significant property and environmental damage.

records.title: Israeli Military Enforces AI Surveillance Quotas on Palestinians via 'Blue Wolf' System
records.description: Israeli soldiers in the West Bank are required to collect and upload personal data and photos of at least 50 Palestinians per shift into the AI-powered 'Blue Wolf' facial recognition system. This enforced data collection, including on children and the elderly, has led to significant privacy violations and human rights concerns.

records.title: AI-Enabled Autonomous Weapons and Disinformation in the Russia-Ukraine War
records.description: During the Russia-Ukraine war, both sides have deployed AI-integrated autonomous weapons and used AI-driven disinformation tools, including deepfakes, impacting battlefield outcomes and spreading misinformation. These AI systems have contributed to physical harm, civilian casualties, and societal disruption, highlighting the significant role of AI in modern conflict.

records.title: Ukraine Uses AI to Identify Deceased Russian Soldiers and Notify Relatives
records.description: Ukraine's Ministry of Digital Transformation employs AI to analyze images of deceased Russian soldiers, identify their social media profiles, and inform their relatives of their deaths. This initiative, led by Minister Mykhailo Fedorov, aims to counter Russian propaganda and has significant psychological and informational impacts on affected communities.

records.title: China's Health Code AI System Restricts Movement and Human Rights
records.description: China's Health Code (健康宝), an AI-driven pandemic control tool, has been used to unjustly restrict individuals' movement through automated pop-up warnings, often without clear reason. Lawyers and activists report being unable to travel or return home, indicating the system is used for political control, infringing on personal freedoms and human rights.

records.title: AI System Helps Turkish Police Intercept Explosives Smuggling by Officer
records.description: Turkish police used an AI-based analysis program to identify a suspicious vehicle, leading to the interception of a police officer transporting 52.5 kg of explosives intended for an attack in Istanbul. The AI system's detection directly prevented potential harm to public safety.

records.title: Ukraine Urges DJI to Halt AI Drone Use by Russian Military
records.description: Ukraine has appealed to Chinese drone maker DJI to prevent its AI-enabled civilian drones from being used by Russian forces to aid missile targeting in the conflict. DJI responded it cannot deactivate individual drones but can impose geofencing. The drones' AI navigation directly contributes to harm in Ukraine.

records.title: Facebook's AI Fails to Detect Hate Speech Against Rohingya Minority
records.description: A report by Global Witness found that Facebook's AI-driven content moderation failed to detect and block eight paid ads containing hate speech and calls for violence against Myanmar's Rohingya minority. All ads were approved for publication, highlighting ongoing risks of AI system failures contributing to real-world harm and human rights violations.

records.title: El Salvador Faces Scrutiny Over Pegasus Spyware Use Against Journalists and Activists
records.description: Human rights group Cristosal appealed the Salvadoran audit court's refusal to investigate alleged public funding for the AI-powered Pegasus spyware, which infected the phones of at least 35 journalists and civil society members. The incident highlights AI-enabled surveillance leading to privacy violations and potential human rights abuses.

records.title: New Taipei Deploys AI System to Crack Down on Noisy Vehicles
records.description: New Taipei City integrated an AI recognition system with enforcement technology to identify and penalize vehicles repeatedly modified for excessive noise, addressing widespread community disturbance. The AI system, now at 75% accuracy, has led to nearly 500 fines and supports broader efforts to reduce noise pollution through automated detection and enforcement.

records.title: Fatal Paris Tesla Crash Sparks Legal Action Over Alleged AI Malfunction
records.description: In December 2021, a Tesla Model 3 taxi in Paris lost control, resulting in one death and around twenty injuries. The driver claims the AI-assisted braking and acceleration systems malfunctioned, causing the crash. He has filed a complaint against Tesla France for endangering lives, while investigations into the AI system's role continue.

records.title: Fahrenheit AI Trading Robot Fraud Causes Massive Financial Losses and Arrests in Indonesia
records.description: Indonesian police arrested Hendry Susanto, head of PT FSP Akademi Pro, for operating the AI-based trading robot Fahrenheit in a fraudulent investment scheme. The scam caused financial losses estimated up to Rp 5 trillion, affecting numerous victims. Authorities are tracing assets and investigating further suspects in the AI-driven fraud.

records.title: Elon Musk Spared from Testifying in Tesla Autopilot Fatal Crash Lawsuit
records.description: A Florida judge ruled that Elon Musk will not have to testify in a lawsuit blaming Tesla's Autopilot AI system for a 2019 fatal crash that killed Jeremy Banner. The decision is a legal win for Tesla, as the case centers on alleged safety failures of its AI-driven driver-assistance software.

records.title: Deepfake Video of Zelensky Surrender Sparks Misinformation During Ukraine War
records.description: Hackers used AI-generated deepfake technology to create and broadcast a fake video of Ukrainian President Zelensky urging surrender, which was aired on a Ukrainian news channel and spread widely online. The incident caused panic and misinformation before being debunked and removed, highlighting the dangers of AI-driven disinformation in conflict.

records.title: Taiwanese YouTuber Prosecuted for Deepfake AI Pornography Scandal Involving 119 Victims
records.description: YouTuber 'Xiao Yu' and an accomplice used deepfake AI technology to create and sell non-consensual explicit videos featuring the faces of 119 public figures, causing severe and lasting harm. The pair profited over NT$13 million before being prosecuted for privacy violations, defamation, and sexual exploitation, prompting calls for stricter AI-related laws.

records.title: Tesla Fires Employee After AI-Driven Car Crash Video Exposes FSD Beta Flaws
records.description: Tesla fired employee John Bernal after he published a YouTube video showing his Tesla Model 3, using the Full Self-Driving (FSD) Beta AI system, crashing into a bollard. The incident highlights safety risks and malfunctions of Tesla's AI-assisted driving, raising concerns about transparency and the company's response to publicizing AI failures.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfakes Used for Wartime Disinformation in Ukraine Conflict
records.description: AI-generated deepfake videos depicting Ukrainian President Zelensky and Russian President Putin were circulated online, falsely urging surrender and spreading misinformation during the Russia-Ukraine war. Social media platforms, including Facebook and YouTube, removed these manipulated videos, but concerns remain about their potential to undermine public trust and morale.

records.title: Massive Financial Losses from AI-Powered Trading Robot Fahrenheit in Indonesia
records.description: Thousands of users, including actor Chris Ryan, suffered massive financial losses—up to Rp 5 trillion—due to alleged fraud involving the AI-based trading robot Fahrenheit. Victims reported being unable to stop trades or recover funds, prompting police investigations and legal action against the platform and its CEO.

records.title: Escalation of AI-Driven Drone Warfare Between Iran and Israel
records.description: Iran and Israel have intensified their conflict using AI-enabled drones and missiles, resulting in attacks on drone factories, military bases, and strategic sites. These autonomous or semi-autonomous systems have caused destruction of property and loss of life, highlighting the direct harm caused by AI technologies in modern military operations.

records.title: Clearview AI's Facial Recognition Deployed in Ukraine War Raises Human Rights Concerns
records.description: Ukraine's defense ministry is using Clearview AI's facial recognition technology to identify Russian assailants, verify individuals at checkpoints, and identify the dead during the war. The deployment, based on a vast database including Russian social media images, raises significant privacy and human rights concerns amid risks of misidentification and misuse in a conflict zone.

records.title: Meta Temporarily Allows Violent Speech Against Russian Occupiers on Facebook and Instagram
records.description: Meta temporarily relaxed its AI-driven content moderation on Facebook and Instagram in certain countries, permitting posts inciting violence against Russian occupiers and leaders amid the Ukraine war. This policy change enabled violent speech that was previously banned, raising concerns about the potential for incitement and harm.

records.title: China's First AI-Powered Brain-Computer Interface Implanted to Prevent Epileptic Seizures
records.description: Doctors at Xuanwu Hospital in Beijing successfully implanted an AI-enabled closed-loop brain-computer interface in a patient with drug-resistant epilepsy. The AI chip continuously monitors brain activity and intervenes to prevent seizures, marking a significant clinical application of AI in healthcare with direct positive impact on patient health.

records.title: Tesla Defends Autopilot Amid Safety Concerns and Regulatory Scrutiny
records.description: Tesla defended its AI-based Autopilot and Full Self-Driving systems to U.S. senators, claiming safety benefits but acknowledging they require constant driver attention. The systems have faced criticism, regulatory investigations, and recalls following incidents, including deadly crashes, raising concerns about misleading marketing and the safety of AI-assisted driving.

records.title: Italy Fines Clearview AI €20 Million for Unlawful Biometric Data Processing
records.description: The Italian Data Protection Authority fined Clearview AI €20 million for unlawfully collecting and processing biometric data of individuals in Italy using its AI-powered facial recognition system. The company scraped over 10 billion images from public sources, violating privacy rights and GDPR principles, and was ordered to stop processing and delete the data.

records.title: Taiwan Strengthens Laws Against AI-Generated Deepfake Sexual Violence
records.description: In response to rising cases of AI-generated deepfake sexual images and videos causing harm, Taiwan's Executive Yuan approved amendments to four laws. The new measures criminalize the creation and distribution of non-consensual deepfake sexual content, increase penalties, and require internet platforms to promptly remove illegal material, aiming to better protect victims.

records.title: Truck Stuck for 10 Hours After Following Google Maps in Sleman Village
records.description: A container truck driven by Agus Riyanto became stuck for 10 hours on a narrow village road in Sleman, Yogyakarta, after following Google Maps navigation. The incident caused significant disruption to local traffic and required police and community assistance to resolve, highlighting risks from AI-based navigation systems.

records.title: Pegasus Spyware Used for AI-Driven Surveillance of Activists and US Citizens
records.description: NSO Group's AI-powered Pegasus spyware was used to target and infect the phones of Moroccan human rights activist Aminatou Haidar and U.S. citizens, leading to serious privacy and human rights violations. Apple has filed a lawsuit against NSO Group to prevent further abuse of its spyware.

records.title: Pony.ai Recalls Autonomous Driving Software After Crash in California
records.description: Pony.ai recalled its autonomous driving software after a driverless test vehicle crashed into a street sign in California, causing property damage. The incident, attributed to a software malfunction, prompted regulatory action from the NHTSA and led to the suspension of Pony.ai’s driverless testing permit.

records.title: Bayraktar TB2 Combat Drones Cause Destruction in Ukraine War
records.description: Ukraine has deployed Turkish-made Bayraktar TB2 AI-enabled combat drones against Russian forces, with videos showing destruction of Russian military vehicles and artillery. While the exact extent of their use and effectiveness is unclear, these drones have directly contributed to property damage and potential casualties in the ongoing conflict.

records.title: AI-Driven Quantitative Trading in China Harms Retail Investors, Spurs Calls for Stricter Regulation
records.description: Chinese policymakers and experts warn that AI-powered quantitative and high-frequency trading systems in the stock market unfairly extract profits from retail investors, causing financial harm and market instability. Past incidents, such as the 2015 manipulation case, highlight the need for stricter regulation to protect market fairness and investor interests.

records.title: AI-Generated Misinformation Falsely Claims Actor's Death in Ukraine
records.description: False news and manipulated images circulated on Twitter falsely claimed Serbian actor Nenad Okanović died as a Ukrainian soldier. AI-driven tools likely facilitated the creation and spread of this misinformation, causing reputational harm and public confusion during the ongoing Russia-Ukraine conflict.

records.title: Chinese Consumer Association Exposes AI-Driven Price Discrimination on E-Commerce Platforms
records.description: Beijing Consumer Association's investigation revealed that over 86% of surveyed users experienced AI-driven price discrimination ('big data killing the familiar') on platforms like Ele.me and Fliggy, where algorithms charged different prices to new and old users for identical products, violating consumer rights and prompting regulatory scrutiny.

records.title: Amazon Alexa Vulnerability Enables Self-Issued Malicious Commands
records.description: Researchers from Royal Holloway, University of London, discovered a vulnerability in Amazon Alexa devices that allowed attackers to exploit the AI assistant to issue unauthorized voice commands via the device's own speakers. This flaw enabled privacy breaches, unauthorized purchases, and control of smart appliances before being patched.

records.title: Tesla Model 3 Sudden Stop Linked to Fatal Crash Amid AI System Scrutiny
records.description: A Tesla Model 3 abruptly stopped on a Missouri highway, leading to a fatal multi-car collision. Authorities are investigating whether a malfunction in the vehicle's AI-driven autonomous or automatic emergency braking systems, known for 'phantom braking,' caused the incident. Regulatory agencies are reviewing safety concerns over such AI system failures.

records.title: AI-Generated Profiles and Deepfakes Used in Russian Disinformation Campaigns Targeting Ukraine
records.description: Russian and Belarusian disinformation campaigns used AI-generated profile photos and deepfake videos to create fake social media personas and spread anti-Ukraine propaganda. Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram removed dozens of these accounts, which aimed to manipulate public opinion and undermine trust during the ongoing conflict.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfakes Target Brazilian Presidential Candidates, Fueling Election Misinformation
records.description: AI-powered deepfake and deepdub technologies were used to create and circulate fake videos and audio of Brazilian presidential candidates Lula, Moro, and Dilma, depicting them saying things they never did. These AI-generated fabrications have spread misinformation, caused reputational harm, and raised concerns about their impact on the integrity of the electoral process.

records.title: Yemeni Forces Shoot Down AI-Enabled Drones in Ongoing Conflict
records.description: Yemeni armed forces shot down multiple AI-enabled U.S.-made drones, including MQ-1, MQ-9, and Scan Eagle models, used by the UAE for hostile reconnaissance and combat missions over Hajja, Marib, and Al-Jawf. The incidents highlight the direct use and destruction of AI systems in active military conflict, escalating regional tensions.

records.title: US Probes Honda AI Braking System After Collisions and Injuries
records.description: US regulators are investigating over 1.7 million Honda vehicles after 278 complaints that their AI-powered automatic emergency braking system can trigger unexpected stops without warning, causing at least six collisions with minor injuries. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration probe could lead to a recall.

records.title: Facebook Faces Legal Action over Alleged AI-Driven Censorship of Palestinian Content
records.description: London law firm Bindmans LLP, representing Sada Social and the International Centre of Justice for Palestinians, filed a formal complaint against Facebook (Meta), alleging systematic and unjustified censorship and suspension of Palestinian media accounts. The complaint highlights concerns over AI-driven content moderation violating freedom of expression and calls for transparency in Facebook's decision-making processes.

records.title: AI-Generated Game Footage Misused as Real Ukraine War Videos Spread Misinformation
records.description: Footage from the AI-powered military simulation game Arma 3 has been widely misrepresented as real scenes from the Russia-Ukraine war on social media, misleading the public and distorting perceptions of the conflict. This misuse of AI-generated visuals has contributed to the spread of misinformation online.

records.title: Facebook's AI Moderation Failures Enable Ethnic Violence in Ethiopia
records.description: Investigations reveal Facebook's AI-driven content moderation failed to prevent the spread of hate speech and incitement to violence in Ethiopia, despite internal warnings. This allowed activists to use the platform to fuel ethnic massacres and displacement, directly linking AI system shortcomings to real-world harm and human rights violations.

records.title: Clearview AI's Expanding Facial Recognition Database Sparks Global Privacy Concerns and Legal Action
records.description: Clearview AI has amassed billions of facial images without consent, aiming for a database covering nearly every person worldwide. Its facial recognition system, already used by law enforcement and authoritarian regimes, has triggered lawsuits and regulatory actions for privacy violations, raising significant human rights and surveillance concerns as the company seeks further expansion.

records.title: Houthi Drone and Missile Attacks Prompt UAE Call for AI Defense Shield
records.description: Houthi forces used AI-enabled drones and ballistic missiles to attack civilian areas in the UAE and Yemen, causing casualties and damage. In response, the UAE urged allied nations to collaborate on building a defensive shield against the growing threat of autonomous unmanned systems, highlighting the risks of AI technologies in conflict.

records.title: Argentinian Government and Microsoft Deploy Controversial AI to Predict Teenage Pregnancies
records.description: In 2018, Microsoft and the Salta provincial government in Argentina developed an AI system to predict which girls were at risk of early pregnancy, using sensitive personal data without transparency or safeguards. The system violated privacy and human rights, targeting vulnerable minors and raising ethical and legal concerns.

records.title: Tesla Autopilot Under Investigation After Reports of Phantom Braking and Accidents
records.description: Tesla's Autopilot AI system is under investigation by US and German regulators following reports of sudden, unnecessary braking ('phantom braking') and accidents linked to its automated lane-changing and emergency braking features.
