These malfunctions have raised safety concerns and prompted regulatory scrutiny over the system's reliability and compliance.

records.title: Deepfake AI Causes Financial Fraud and Security Breaches
records.description: AI-generated deepfakes have led to significant harms, including a $35 million financial scam, successful bypassing of facial recognition security, blackmail, and the creation of fake explicit videos. These incidents highlight the misuse of deepfake technology for fraud, privacy violations, and misinformation, prompting urgent calls for improved detection and regulation.

records.title: Tesla AI-Driven Braking Malfunctions Trigger US Safety Investigations and Accidents
records.description: Tesla's Autopilot and adaptive cruise control AI systems have caused vehicles to brake unexpectedly, leading to safety hazards and a police car collision. Hundreds of consumer complaints prompted the US NHTSA to investigate over 400,000 Tesla vehicles, highlighting risks and potential harm from AI system malfunctions.

records.title: Meta's AI Algorithms Under Scrutiny in Teen Suicide Inquest
records.description: Meta is accused of withholding data from an inquest into the 2017 suicide of 14-year-old Molly Russell, who was exposed to harmful content promoted by social media algorithms. The inquest examines whether AI-driven recommendation systems contributed to her death, with Meta ordered to disclose more user data for investigation.

records.title: Pegasus Spyware Malfunction Exposes Global Surveillance Campaign
records.description: A malfunction in the Pegasus spyware, developed by Israel's NSO Group, on Saudi activist Loujain al-Hathloul's iPhone enabled privacy researchers to uncover evidence of widespread illegal surveillance. The AI-enabled spyware's use led to human rights violations, sparking global legal and governmental actions against NSO Group.

records.title: Pegasus Spyware Used for Political Surveillance in Poland
records.description: AI-powered Pegasus spyware was used to hack phones of Polish opposition figures, including Magdalena Łośko and Ryszard Brejza, via targeted SMS phishing. The infections, confirmed by Amnesty International, enabled unauthorized surveillance, violating privacy and political rights. Mistaken targeting further highlighted misuse and potential malfunction of the AI system.

records.title: Pegasus Spyware Exposed After Hacking Saudi Activist's iPhone
records.description: The AI-powered Pegasus spyware, developed by Israel's NSO Group, was uncovered after it hacked Saudi activist Loujain al-Hathloul's iPhone. The incident revealed widespread unauthorized surveillance of activists, journalists, and politicians, leading to global concerns over privacy violations and human rights abuses enabled by AI-driven surveillance technology.

records.title: Saudi Arabia Deploys AI for Commercial Concealment Crackdown
records.description: Saudi authorities have launched a new phase in combating commercial concealment by integrating AI and data analysis across 20 regulatory agencies. The AI system identifies suspicious activities, leading to targeted inspections and legal penalties for violators, marking a significant shift from traditional enforcement methods to AI-driven regulatory action.

records.title: Hezbollah Drone Incursion Triggers Israeli Air Defense Response
records.description: A Hezbollah-operated AI-enabled drone entered Israeli airspace from Lebanon, evading interception and triggering the Iron Dome air defense system and alarms in multiple civilian areas. The incident, the second in 48 hours, caused significant disruption and heightened tensions, highlighting the risks of autonomous drone use in conflict zones.

records.title: Selfie Apps Illegally Share and Sell Users' Biometric Data
records.description: Several popular AI-powered selfie and beauty apps have been found to collect, analyze, and sell users' sensitive biometric data—including facial features and skin tone—to third parties without proper consent. This widespread practice constitutes a violation of privacy and data protection rights, affecting millions of users globally.

records.title: Apple AirTags Misused for Stalking, Prompting Warnings and Criticism
records.description: Apple AirTags, which use AI-enabled location tracking via the Find My network, have been widely misused for stalking and unauthorized tracking, leading to privacy and safety concerns. Law enforcement and state attorneys general have issued warnings, and police have criticized Apple's guidance as inadequate, highlighting ongoing harm from the devices' misuse.

records.title: EU Regulator Calls for Ban on Pegasus Spyware After Human Rights Abuses
records.description: The European Data Protection Supervisor has called for a ban on Pegasus, an AI-enabled spyware developed by NSO Group, after it was used by governments to surveil activists, journalists, and politicians, leading to serious privacy violations and human rights abuses. The incident highlights the risks of unregulated AI surveillance tools.

records.title: Facial Recognition AI Reinforces Discriminatory Policing in New York City
records.description: Amnesty International research reveals that facial recognition technology used by the NYPD disproportionately targets non-white communities in the Bronx, Brooklyn, and Queens, reinforcing racist stop-and-frisk policing. The AI-driven surveillance has led to discriminatory practices, privacy violations, and human rights concerns for minority residents.

records.title: Neuralink Admits to Euthanizing 8 Monkeys During Brain Chip Experiments
records.description: Elon Musk's company Neuralink admitted that eight monkeys were euthanized during experiments testing its AI-powered brain chip technology. The company stated the euthanasia was for data collection and veterinary advice, sparking criticism from animal rights groups over the harm caused by the AI system's development.

records.title: Uber Settles with Google over AI Trade Secret Theft in Self-Driving Car Dispute
records.description: Uber has agreed to pay a substantial portion of $120 million to Google to settle litigation over the theft of trade secrets related to self-driving car AI technology. The dispute involved Uber's recruitment of engineer Anthony Levandowski from Google, leading to criminal prosecution and significant legal and financial consequences.

records.title: Texas Sues Meta Over Unlawful Use of Facebook Facial Recognition AI
records.description: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton has sued Meta, alleging Facebook's facial recognition AI collected and used Texans' biometric data without consent, violating state privacy laws. The lawsuit seeks monetary damages and an end to unauthorized biometric data use, citing mass privacy violations by the AI system.

records.title: Bulgarian Prosecutors Investigate Potential Misuse of Pegasus Spyware for Illegal Surveillance
records.description: Bulgarian authorities have launched an investigation into the possible unauthorized use of the AI-enabled Pegasus spyware by state agencies for illegal surveillance of citizens. Prosecutors are seeking information from multiple oversight bodies to determine if the software was deployed, but no confirmed harm has been reported yet.

records.title: Global Scandal Over Pegasus AI Spyware Use by Governments and Agencies
records.description: Investigations in Israel and India revealed that AI-enabled Pegasus spyware, developed by NSO Group, was illicitly used by police, intelligence agencies, and state actors to surveil politicians, journalists, and civilians without proper authorization. This misuse led to significant privacy violations and raised concerns about human rights abuses and threats to democracy.

records.title: EU Calls for Ban on Pegasus Spyware After AI-Driven Surveillance Abuses
records.description: The European Data Protection Supervisor has called for a ban on Pegasus and similar AI-powered spyware in the EU, citing their use by governments to surveil journalists, activists, and politicians. Investigations revealed widespread privacy violations, prompting regulatory action to protect fundamental rights from AI-enabled surveillance tools.

records.title: AI Employee Monitoring System Sparks Privacy and Labor Rights Controversy in China
records.description: Chinese tech firm Sangfor's AI-powered 'Behavior Perception System' monitored employees' online activities to predict resignation risk, leading to at least one employee's dismissal after job-seeking was detected. The system's use has raised significant concerns over privacy violations and legality, prompting public backlash and the removal of product information from the company's website.

records.title: Neuralink AI Brain Implants Linked to Death and Suffering of Test Monkeys
records.description: Elon Musk's Neuralink implanted AI-enabled brain chips in 23 monkeys at UC Davis from 2017-2020, resulting in at least 15 deaths and widespread suffering, including trauma and self-mutilation. The Physicians Committee for Responsible Medicine filed a legal complaint, alleging extreme animal harm directly caused by the AI system's development and use.

records.title: AI-Enabled Drone Attack on Abha Airport Injures Civilians and Prompts Retaliation
records.description: AI-powered drones launched by Houthi forces targeted Abha International Airport in Saudi Arabia, injuring at least 12 civilians and disrupting airport operations. In response, the Saudi-led coalition conducted airstrikes on Houthi-controlled communications systems used to operate these drones, escalating the conflict and highlighting the direct harm caused by AI-enabled weaponry.

records.title: French Filmmaker Scammed by Deepfake Romance on Dating App
records.description: French filmmaker Yzabel Dzisky was deceived by a scammer using AI-generated deepfake videos on a dating app, leading her to believe she was in a genuine relationship. The deepfake technology enabled the impersonation, resulting in emotional distress and financial loss for Dzisky.

records.title: TikTok and YouTube AI Systems Implicated in Mass Personal Data Collection and Sharing
records.description: A study by URL Genius found that TikTok and YouTube use AI-driven systems to collect and share large amounts of personal user data. YouTube mainly uses data for targeted advertising, while TikTok sells data to numerous third parties, raising privacy concerns and potential violations of data protection rights.

records.title: Spotify AI Playlists Promote Anti-Vaccine Misinformation Songs
records.description: Spotify's AI-powered recommendation engine promoted playlists containing songs with anti-vaccine and Covid-19 misinformation, encouraging vaccine refusal and spreading conspiracy theories. After media reports, Spotify removed several tracks for violating its policies, but the AI system's amplification of harmful content posed a public health risk.

records.title: Apple Siri Bug Records User Conversations Without Consent
records.description: A bug in Apple's iOS 15 caused Siri to record and store user interactions even when users had opted out, violating privacy rights. Apple addressed the issue in iOS 15.2 and deleted affected recordings, but the incident exposed unauthorized data collection by the AI-powered assistant.

records.title: Tesla Autopilot Crash Injures Officers as Driver Watches Movie in North Carolina
records.description: A Tesla operating on Autopilot struck parked police vehicles and injured a deputy in Nash County, North Carolina, after the driver, Devainder Goli, watched a movie instead of supervising the AI system. The incident highlights risks of driver inattention with AI-assisted driving and led to criminal charges and federal investigation.

records.title: EU Parliament to Investigate Pegasus Spyware Abuses
records.description: The European Parliament plans to form a committee to investigate abuses of the Israeli AI-powered spyware Pegasus, which has been used to illegally surveil journalists, activists, and political opponents across the EU, raising serious concerns about violations of privacy and fundamental rights.

records.title: Tesla Recalls Nearly 579,000 Vehicles Over AI-Related Pedestrian Safety and Heating System Flaws
records.description: Tesla recalled nearly 579,000 vehicles in the US due to software issues affecting AI-controlled systems. The Boombox feature could obscure pedestrian warning sounds, posing a safety risk, while a separate defect in climate control software impaired heating and defrosting, endangering driver visibility and comfort. Both issues prompted urgent software updates.

records.title: WHO Warns AI in Healthcare Discriminates Against Older Adults
records.description: A WHO report warns that AI systems increasingly used in healthcare are perpetuating ageist biases, leading to discrimination against older adults. These biases, inherited from existing healthcare data and practices, result in reduced quality of care and reinforce societal ageism, directly harming older patients.

records.title: Tesla Autopilot and FSD AI Systems Under Scrutiny After Phantom Braking and Recorded Crashes
records.description: Tesla's AI-driven Autopilot and FSD systems have faced increased scrutiny after a surge in 'phantom braking' complaints and the first recorded FSD Beta crashes, where vehicles struck roadside barriers. U.S. senators and regulators are investigating, citing safety risks and harm linked to Tesla's vision-only AI approach and system malfunctions.

records.title: Controversial Expansion and New Claims in Police Facial Recognition Technology
records.description: Corsight AI claims to develop an AI system that can generate facial profiles from DNA, raising concerns about privacy, bias, and wrongful identification. Meanwhile, New York City plans to expand police use of facial recognition, despite documented wrongful arrests and civil rights lawsuits linked to the technology's biases and errors.

records.title: Tesla Full Self-Driving Beta Causes Recorded Collision in San Jose
records.description: A Tesla using the Full Self-Driving (FSD) Beta AI system was recorded crashing into a bike lane pole in San Jose. The incident, captured by YouTuber AI Addict, highlights the AI's failure to detect obstacles, resulting in property damage and raising concerns about the safety and reliability of Tesla's autonomous driving technology.

records.title: Tesla AI Driving Systems Linked to Safety Incidents and Major Recalls
records.description: Tesla's AI-driven Full Self-Driving (FSD) and Autopilot systems have been involved in safety incidents, including a collision due to failure to detect a bike lane and widespread 'phantom braking.' These malfunctions prompted major recalls affecting over 800,000 vehicles, highlighting risks and regulatory scrutiny over Tesla's autonomous driving technology.

records.title: Mass Pegasus Spyware Attacks Target Polish Supreme Audit Office Employees
records.description: Thousands of cyberattacks using Pegasus, an AI-powered spyware, reportedly targeted devices of Poland’s Supreme Audit Office (NIK) employees between 2020-2021, infecting over 500 devices. The attacks, if confirmed, represent large-scale privacy violations and institutional interference, though government officials deny the allegations and investigations are ongoing.

records.title: Fraudulent AI Trading Robots Cause Investor Losses Amid Regulatory Warnings in Indonesia
records.description: Unlicensed AI-based robot trading systems have led to financial losses for Indonesian investors, with authorities warning that no official permits have been issued for such platforms. The proliferation of fraudulent robot trading schemes highlights the risks and harm caused by unregulated AI-driven financial tools.

records.title: Meta Introduces AI-Driven 'Personal Boundary' Tool After Virtual Harassment in Metaverse
records.description: Meta implemented an AI-enabled 'personal boundary' feature in its Horizon Worlds and Horizon Venues VR platforms after users reported incidents of virtual harassment, including sexual assault. The tool enforces a minimum distance between avatars to prevent unwanted interactions and protect users' psychological well-being in the metaverse.

records.title: Israel Approves AI-Driven Surveillance and Threats Against Protesters
records.description: Israel's attorney general upheld the Shin Bet security agency's use of AI-enabled mobile-phone tracking to monitor and send threatening messages to Palestinian protesters at Al Aqsa Mosque. The technology's deployment led to rights violations and a chilling effect on civil liberties, drawing criticism from civil rights groups.

records.description: Vendors on platforms like Etsy and eBay sold modified Apple AirTags with disabled speakers, bypassing built-in anti-stalking alerts. records.title: Tesla Autopilot AI Malfunction Causes Surge in Phantom Braking Complaints
records.description: Tesla's Autopilot and Full Self-Driving AI systems have experienced a spike in 'phantom braking' incidents, where vehicles suddenly brake without cause, posing safety risks. records.description: Amazon's AI-powered virtual assistant Alexa experienced a worldwide outage, leaving users unable to control smart home devices or receive responses. records.description: Hungarian authorities used the AI-powered Pegasus spyware to illegally surveil journalists, activists, and others, violating their privacy and human rights. records.title: WhatsApp AI System Permanently Suspends Groups for Anomalies

records.description: China's AI-driven health code apps, required for access to public spaces, malfunctioned and imposed strict rules, causing thousands to lose their green status and be denied entry to shops, workplaces, and transport. records.title: India Accused of Using AI-Enabled Pegasus Spyware for Political Surveillance

records.title: Facial Recognition AI in 'Female-Only' App Excludes Trans Women and Women of Color
records.description: The social media app Giggle uses facial recognition AI to determine user gender, resulting in the exclusion of transgender women and misidentification of women of color. records.title: Family Lost in Forest After Following Google Maps Directions in East Kalimantan
records.description: A family of five from Balikpapan became lost in a forest in Muara Badak, East Kalimantan, after following Google Maps navigation. The AI system directed them onto a remote hauling road, leading to their vehicle getting stuck and requiring a rescue operation by Basarnas. No injuries were reported.

records.title: Meta and Snap Sued Over AI-Driven Social Media Addiction Leading to Girl's Suicide
records.description: The mother of 11-year-old Selena Rodriguez is suing Meta and Snap, alleging their AI-powered Instagram and Snapchat platforms caused her daughter's extreme addiction, mental health decline, and eventual suicide. The lawsuit claims the platforms' AI-driven engagement features directly contributed to the harm.

records.title: Facebook's AI Algorithms Amplify Disinformation and Societal Harm
records.description: Facebook's AI-driven algorithms for micro-targeting and content recommendation have enabled widespread disinformation, manipulation, and real-world harm, including violence and democratic disruption. Masood filed a lawsuit against Hyderabad police after being photographed without consent during lockdown, raising concerns about privacy violations and potential harassment of minorities due to the widespread use of AI-powered facial recognition systems by law enforcement in Telangana, India's most surveilled state.

records.description: Polish MPs revealed that the company Matic, which brokered the purchase of the AI-enabled Pegasus spyware for government agencies, received over 40 million PLN in state contracts. records.title: AI-Powered Artificial Pancreas Improves Health Outcomes for Young Children with Type 1 Diabetes
records.description: Multiple studies show that AI-driven artificial pancreas systems, such as the CamAPS FX app, significantly improve blood sugar control and reduce health risks in very young children with type 1 diabetes. records.description: Snapchat's AI-powered friend recommendation system ('Quick Add') enabled drug dealers to contact minors, contributing to fentanyl overdose deaths. records.title: Android Earthquake Warning System Issues Early Alerts in Turkey
records.description: Google's AI-powered Android Earthquake Warning System, which uses sensor data from smartphones to detect seismic activity, successfully issued early alerts before recent earthquakes in Turkey, including the Alanya and Kayseri events. The system aims to reduce harm by providing users with seconds to seek safety before shaking begins.

records.title: Facebook's AI Fails to Curb Climate Change Misinformation, Internal Papers Reveal
records.description: Leaked internal documents show Facebook's AI-driven content moderation and recommendation systems failed to adequately filter or suppress climate change denial, allowing misinformation to spread widely. records.title: Israeli Police Accused of Abusive Use of Pegasus AI Spyware Against Citizens and Activists
records.description: Israeli police allegedly used NSO Group's AI-powered Pegasus spyware to surveil citizens, activists, and officials without court orders, violating privacy and human rights. records.title: Tesla Autopilot and Full Self-Driving AI Under Fire After Fatal Crash and Public Criticism

records.title: Facebook AI Wrongly Memorializes Living Author Taslima Nasreen's Account
records.description: Facebook's automated memorialization process mistakenly declared Bangladeshi-Swedish author Taslima Nasreen dead, locking her out of her account and displaying it as a memorial. records.title: First Felony Charges Filed in Fatal Tesla Autopilot Crash

records.title: US House Subpoenas Tech Giants Over AI-Driven Role in Capitol Riot

records.description: A 17-year-old Egyptian girl, Basant Khaled, died by suicide after AI-manipulated images of her were circulated online for blackmail and defamation. The fabricated images, created using AI-based photo editing tools, led to severe psychological distress and public shaming, highlighting the harmful impact of AI-enabled image manipulation.

records.title: Supreme Court Committee Seeks Victims in Pegasus AI Spyware Scandal
records.description: India's Supreme Court-appointed technical committee issued a public notice inviting citizens who suspect their devices were compromised by Pegasus AI-enabled spyware to come forward by January 7, 2022. The committee is investigating alleged unauthorized surveillance and privacy violations linked to the AI system's deployment.

records.title: AI-Driven 'Bulli Bai' App Targets Muslim Women with Online Harassment
records.description: The 'Bulli Bai' app, hosted on GitHub and promoted via Twitter, used AI and algorithmic systems to collect and display images of Muslim women for mock auctions, leading to widespread harassment and human rights violations. The incident sparked national outrage and demands for strict action against the perpetrators.

records.title: Civilian Harm from AI-Enabled Weaponized Drones in Global Conflicts
records.description: AI-powered weaponized drones, increasingly used by militaries and non-state actors worldwide, have caused significant civilian casualties, including children, due to targeting failures and lack of regulation. High-profile incidents, such as the 2021 US drone strike in Kabul, highlight the urgent need for oversight of autonomous lethal systems.

records.title: Meta's AI Algorithms Linked to Societal Harm Revealed by Whistleblower
records.description: Whistleblower Frances Haugen exposed that Meta's AI-driven content algorithms, designed to maximize engagement on Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp, knowingly amplified misinformation and caused psychological harm, especially to teens. Internal documents confirmed the company was aware of these harms, sparking public and regulatory concern in 2021.

records.title: China's AI-Driven Overseas Social Media Surveillance and Suppression
records.description: Chinese government agencies have deployed advanced AI-powered data analysis and sentiment monitoring software to surveil and identify critics on Western social media platforms. These systems collect, analyze, and profile individuals, leading to forced account deletions, intimidation, and suppression of dissent, violating privacy and freedom of expression internationally.

records.title: Apple AirTags Misused for Stalking and Car Theft via AI-Enabled Tracking
records.description: Apple AirTags, which use AI-driven location tracking, have been misused to secretly follow individuals and facilitate car theft. Victims, including Ashley Estrada, received notifications of unknown AirTags tracking their movements, raising serious privacy and safety concerns about the potential for stalking and property crime.

records.title: California Targets Amazon's AI-Driven Worker Management After Reported Harms
records.description: California passed AB 701 to regulate Amazon's AI-powered monitoring systems, which have been accused of overworking employees, denying rest breaks, and increasing injury risks. The law aims to protect worker rights and safety by restricting algorithmic management practices that have led to documented harm.

records.title: Polish Audit Office Investigates Pegasus AI Spyware Surveillance Scandal
records.description: The Polish Supreme Audit Office (NIK), led by Marian Banaś, is investigating the use of Pegasus, an AI-enabled spyware, for illegal surveillance of politicians and citizens. The spyware's deployment has led to privacy violations and political spying, prompting concerns over democratic integrity and calls for stricter oversight.

records.title: Amazon Alexa Suggests Dangerous Electrical Challenge to Child
records.description: Amazon's AI assistant Alexa suggested a hazardous TikTok-inspired challenge to a 10-year-old, instructing her to touch a partially plugged-in charger with a coin, risking electrocution. The incident, reported by the child's mother, prompted Amazon to update Alexa to prevent similar dangerous recommendations in the future.

records.title: Widespread Illegal Collection of Facial Data by Chinese Companies Using AI Systems
records.description: Multiple Chinese companies, including auto dealerships and real estate firms, illegally used AI-powered facial recognition systems to collect millions of consumers' biometric data without consent, violating privacy laws. Regulatory authorities imposed fines and mandated data deletion, while prosecutors initiated public interest litigation to address ongoing privacy and security risks.

records.title: AI Algorithms on Social Media Suppress Accurate Abortion Pill Information
records.description: Abortion rights groups accuse tech giants like Facebook and YouTube of using AI-driven algorithms that suppress credible information about abortion pills while promoting misinformation. This AI-based content moderation limits public access to accurate health information, harming communities and violating rights amid increasing abortion restrictions in the U.S.

records.title: China Deploys AI Prosecutor to File Criminal Charges with High Accuracy
records.description: Chinese researchers have developed and deployed an AI-powered prosecutor capable of filing criminal charges based on verbal case descriptions, claiming 97% accuracy. Tested in Shanghai, the system analyzes thousands of case traits to press charges for common crimes, raising concerns about errors, accountability, and potential human rights violations in legal decision-making.

records.title: Apps Collect User Data Despite Permission Denial in China
records.description: Multiple reports reveal that some mobile apps in China continue to access and collect users' personal information, such as location data, even after all permissions are denied. This unauthorized data collection, likely involving AI or algorithmic systems, constitutes a violation of user privacy and legal protections.

records.title: TikTok Content Moderators Sue Over Mental Health Harm from Inadequate AI Safeguards
records.description: TikTok content moderators, including Candie Frazier, sued TikTok and its parent company, alleging mental health harm from prolonged exposure to violent and disturbing videos. The lawsuit claims TikTok failed to implement adequate AI-based safeguards to reduce exposure, leading to PTSD and other psychological injuries among moderators.

records.title: Unauthorized Facial Recognition Data Collection and AI Face-Swapping Lead to Privacy Violations in China
records.description: Multiple incidents in China involved companies using AI-powered facial recognition systems to collect and process hundreds of thousands of individuals' biometric data without consent, violating privacy laws and resulting in fines. Additionally, AI face-swapping technology led to legal action over unauthorized use of celebrity likenesses, raising concerns about personal rights and data security.

records.title: Polish Senator Krzysztof Brejza Targeted by Pegasus Spyware, Data Manipulated for Political Defamation
records.description: Polish senator Krzysztof Brejza was repeatedly hacked using the AI-enabled Pegasus spyware during the 2019 election campaign. Stolen and manipulated data, including falsified SMS messages, were broadcast by state media TVP, leading to reputational harm and legal action for violation of privacy and personal rights.

records.title: UAE Used Pegasus Spyware to Target Khashoggi's Fiancee Before His Murder
records.description: Forensic analysis by Citizen Lab revealed that UAE authorities used NSO Group's Pegasus spyware to hack the phone of Hanan Elatr, Jamal Khashoggi's fiancee, during her detention in Dubai in 2018. The AI-powered spyware enabled unauthorized surveillance, violating her privacy and human rights.

records.title: Security Flaw in AI-Powered COVID-19 Home Test Allows Falsification of Results
records.description: F-Secure researcher Ken Gannon discovered a vulnerability in Ellume's AI-driven, Bluetooth-enabled COVID-19 home test, allowing hackers to alter test results sent to mobile apps and health authorities. The flaw, now patched, posed risks of false health data and potential public health harm in the United States.

records.title: AI Health Code System Failure Disrupts COVID-19 Control in Xi'an
records.description: The AI-powered 'Yima Tong' health code system in Xi'an malfunctioned due to overload, causing widespread disruption to hospital access, public transport, and community health screening during a critical COVID-19 outbreak. The failure led to crowding, delays, and hindered epidemic control, highlighting the risks of AI system reliability in public health infrastructure.

records.title: US Investigates Tesla Over AI-Enabled In-Car Gaming and Autopilot Safety Risks
records.description: US regulators have launched investigations into Tesla after its AI-driven infotainment system allowed in-car gaming while driving, increasing crash risk, and its Autopilot system was linked to multiple accidents, including fatalities. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration is assessing potential safety defects and deceptive marketing related to these AI features.

records.title: Tesla Autopilot AI Implicated in Multiple Accidents and Lawsuits
records.description: Tesla's Full-Self Driving (autopilot) AI system has been involved in at least 12 accidents since 2018, including fatal crashes and injuries. These incidents have led to lawsuits and regulatory scrutiny in the United States, highlighting the risks and harm associated with the AI's use and potential malfunctions.

records.title: Clearview AI's Facial Recognition Sparks Global Privacy Violations and Regulatory Action
records.description: Clearview AI's facial recognition system, which scraped billions of images from the web without consent, has led to significant privacy violations. Regulators in France and the UK have ordered Clearview to delete data and cease operations for breaching data protection laws, while Toronto police used the system in investigations, raising legal and ethical concerns.

records.title: Pegasus Spyware Used for Surveillance of Polish Public Figures
records.description: Citizen Lab confirmed that Polish lawyer Roman Giertych and prosecutor Ewa Wrzosek were surveilled using the AI-enabled Pegasus spyware, developed by Israel's NSO Group. The surveillance, reportedly conducted by a government agency, raised concerns about privacy violations and the misuse of AI surveillance tools in Poland.

records.title: China's State-Backed AI-Driven Social Media Manipulation Exposed
records.description: Multiple reports reveal that Chinese authorities, through private contractors, use AI-driven systems to create and manage hundreds of fake social media accounts on platforms like Facebook and Twitter. These accounts spread propaganda, attack critics, and manipulate public opinion abroad, causing harm by distorting information and violating rights to truthful discourse.

records.title: AI Algorithms on Facebook and Google Amplify Climate Disinformation, Senators Demand Action
records.description: U.S. Senators criticized Facebook and Google for allowing their AI-driven content recommendation and ad placement systems to spread and monetize climate disinformation. Investigations revealed these platforms failed to adequately label or block misleading content, undermining climate action and public understanding, despite public commitments to address the issue.

records.title: Pegasus Spyware Used for Surveillance Linked to Khashoggi Case and Indian Activist Arrest
records.description: Authorities in the UAE used NSO Group's Pegasus spyware, an AI-powered surveillance tool, to hack the phone of Hanan al-Attar, wife of murdered journalist Jamal Khashoggi, before his death. Separately, Indian activist Rona Wilson's phone was also hacked with Pegasus, leading to his arrest. Both incidents highlight AI-enabled human rights violations.

records.title: US AI-Enabled Nuclear Submarine Collision in South China Sea
records.description: The US Navy's advanced nuclear submarine USS Connecticut, equipped with AI navigation and control systems, collided with an underwater mountain in the South China Sea, injuring 11 crew members and causing significant damage. The incident was attributed to human error in operating the AI-enabled systems.

records.title: Theranos AI Diagnostic Fraud Trial
records.description: Elizabeth Holmes, founder of Theranos, is on trial in the United States for allegedly defrauding investors and endangering patients by promoting AI-based blood testing technology that failed to perform as claimed. The malfunction and misrepresentation of the AI system led to financial and health-related harm.

records.title: Deployment and Harm from Lethal Autonomous Weapons Spurs Global Regulation Debate
records.description: Lethal Autonomous Weapons Systems (killer robots) using AI to make independent attack decisions have been developed, tested, and deployed in real conflicts, causing injury and death. International efforts, including UN meetings in Geneva, have failed to reach consensus on regulating or banning these AI-driven weapons, raising ethical and humanitarian concerns.

records.title: US Investigates Tesla Autopilot After Multiple Crashes and Fatalities
records.description: The US National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) is investigating Tesla's AI-based Autopilot system after at least 12 crashes involving emergency vehicles and 30 additional accidents since 2016, resulting in 10 deaths. The probe has led to recalls and regulatory scrutiny over the system's safety and software defects.

records.title: Pegasus Spyware Used for Surveillance of Indian Activist Rona Wilson
records.description: Forensic analyses by Arsenal Consulting and Amnesty International revealed that Pegasus spyware, developed by Israel's NSO Group, was used to surveil Indian activist Rona Wilson's phone prior to his 2018 arrest. The AI-driven spyware enabled unauthorized monitoring and data extraction, constituting a significant violation of privacy and human rights in India.

records.title: Meta Exposes AI-Driven Surveillance Targeting 50,000 Facebook Users Globally
records.description: Meta revealed that AI-enabled surveillance companies targeted around 50,000 Facebook and Instagram users—including journalists, activists, and opposition figures—in over 100 countries, including Indonesia. These companies used AI-powered spyware and fake accounts to monitor and collect data, leading to significant privacy and human rights violations.

records.title: Amazon AI Devices Collect Children's Data for Targeted Marketing
records.description: Amazon devices such as Echo Dot and Fire tablets use AI to collect and analyze children's personal data, including photos and location, to generate personalized product recommendations. This practice, highlighted by Mozilla, raises significant privacy concerns and potential violations of children's rights.

records.title: French and Quebec Regulators Order Clearview AI to Cease Unlawful Facial Recognition Data Practices
records.description: Clearview AI, a US-based facial recognition company, was ordered by France's CNIL and Quebec's privacy commission to stop collecting and using biometric data without consent. Authorities found Clearview AI violated privacy laws by scraping billions of images from the internet, infringing individuals' rights in France and Quebec.

records.title: Seoul Deploys AI Surveillance to Prevent Suicides on Han River Bridges
records.description: Seoul authorities have implemented an AI-based surveillance system on Han River bridges to detect potential suicide attempts. The system uses deep learning to analyze behavioral patterns from camera footage, alerting rescue teams in real time to intervene quickly and prevent harm. The initiative targets a known suicide hotspot.

records.title: AI-Enabled Drones Target Saudi Airports in Houthi Attacks
records.description: Houthi forces launched multiple AI-enabled drones from Yemen targeting Saudi airports, including Abha and King Abdullah airports, aiming to harm travelers and critical infrastructure. Saudi-led coalition defenses intercepted and destroyed the drones, preventing casualties. The incident highlights the use of AI-driven unmanned aerial vehicles in cross-border attacks.

records.title: Russian AI System Deployed to Prevent Industrial Accidents
records.description: Russian scientists from the National Technology Initiative have developed and tested an AI-based software system that predicts equipment anomalies and provides preventive recommendations to avert industrial accidents and emergencies. The system is already being piloted at several industrial sites in Russia, aiming to reduce downtime and prevent harm.

records.title: AI Systems in Shanghai and Banking Sector Prevent Large-Scale Financial Fraud
records.description: AI-driven anti-fraud systems in Shanghai blocked an average of 115,000 scam calls daily, intercepted harmful messages, and issued real-time warnings, directly preventing over 510 million yuan in losses. Additionally, AI-based risk detection in banks and WeChat Pay helped identify suspects and stop fraudulent transactions, safeguarding users' financial assets.

records.title: U.S. Sanctions Chinese Tech Firms Over AI-Driven Human Rights Abuses
records.description: The U.S. sanctioned multiple Chinese tech companies, including DJI and AI firms, for developing and deploying AI-powered surveillance and biometric technologies used to monitor and repress Uyghurs and other minorities. The sanctions target entities accused of human rights violations through the misuse of AI systems in China.

records.title: Fatal Tesla Model 3 Taxi Accident in Paris Triggers Investigation and Fleet Suspension
records.description: A Tesla Model 3 taxi in Paris lost control, resulting in one death and around 20 injuries. The driver cited brake failure and uncontrollable acceleration, possibly linked to the vehicle's AI-assisted systems. Taxi company G7 suspended its Tesla fleet, while Tesla denies technical faults. Authorities are investigating the incident.

records.title: Meta's AI Fact-Checking Labels Cause Harm, Deemed 'Opinion' in Court
records.description: Meta (Facebook) used AI-supported fact-checking systems to label journalist John Stossel's content as misleading, reducing its visibility and causing reputational and economic harm. In court, Meta argued these fact-checks are merely 'opinions,' not factual statements, despite their significant impact on content distribution and user rights.

records.title: Huawei's AI Surveillance Technologies Linked to Human Rights Abuses in China
records.description: Leaked documents reveal Huawei's significant role in developing and marketing AI-powered surveillance technologies, including facial and voice recognition, for Chinese authorities. These systems have been used to monitor, track, and control political dissidents and Uyghur minorities, contributing to human rights violations, particularly in Xinjiang.

records.title: Tesla's In-Car Gaming and Autopilot Systems Raise Safety Concerns After Crash and Regulatory Scrutiny
records.description: Tesla's AI-driven systems are under scrutiny after a Model S crashed into a bus in California, causing injuries. The incident follows reports that Tesla's infotainment system allows video games to be played while driving, raising distraction risks. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration is investigating these features for potential safety hazards.

records.title: Virtual Sexual Harassment Reported in Meta's Horizon Worlds Metaverse
records.description: Multiple users reported incidents of virtual groping and sexual harassment within Meta's AI-enabled virtual reality platform, Horizon Worlds, during its beta testing phase. Despite built-in safety features like 'Safe Zone,' the incidents highlight shortcomings in AI-mediated user protection, raising concerns about user safety in virtual environments.

records.title: UN and Global Community Respond to Use of Autonomous Lethal Drones in Libya
records.description: In March 2020, autonomous lethal drones powered by AI were reportedly used in Libya, marking a significant milestone in AI-driven warfare. The incident has prompted international concern, with 125 countries and the UN calling for urgent regulation and restrictions on lethal autonomous weapons to prevent future harm.

records.title: Tesla FSD Beta 10.6 Malfunctions Pose Safety Risks During Real-World Testing
records.description: Multiple reports and user tests reveal that Tesla's FSD Beta 10.6 autonomous driving system exhibits serious malfunctions, including delayed mapping, unauthorized lane changes, near-collisions with pedestrians, and hesitation during driver control handover. These AI failures occurred during real-world tests in the United States, raising significant safety concerns.

records.title: Man Exploits Facial Recognition to Steal Ex-Girlfriend's Funds
records.description: In Nanning, China, a man used his ex-girlfriend's fingerprint and facial recognition (by opening her eyelids while she slept) to unlock her phone and transfer over 150,000 RMB from her accounts. The misuse of AI-based biometric authentication led to financial theft and a prison sentence for the perpetrator.

records.title: Scammers Use Deepfake AI Videos for Fraud and Blackmail in Russia
records.description: Russian experts report a surge in scams using AI-generated deepfake videos to impersonate victims during video calls or create compromising footage for blackmail. These AI-driven schemes deceive relatives and business partners, causing financial and psychological harm, and can provoke bullying or reputational damage.

records.title: Facial Recognition Misuse in China Leads to Privacy Violations and Financial Theft
records.description: In China, misuse and vulnerabilities of AI-powered facial recognition systems have led to significant privacy violations and financial theft. Xpeng Motors was fined for illegally collecting over 430,000 facial images without consent, while security flaws allowed criminals to exploit facial recognition for unauthorized payments, exposing risks to personal data and property.

records.title: Tesla's Full Self-Driving Beta Raises Safety Concerns in California
records.description: Tesla's Full Self-Driving (FSD) beta, an AI-driven autonomous vehicle system, has caused multiple dangerous driving incidents on California roads. State legislators, alarmed by videos of near-misses and crashes, are demanding answers from the DMV regarding regulatory oversight and public safety risks posed by the ongoing public beta tests.

records.title: Gig Economy Workers Harmed by Opaque Algorithmic Management
records.description: Gig economy platforms like Uber and Deliveroo use opaque AI-driven algorithms to manage, surveil, and dismiss workers, often resulting in unfair treatment and lack of transparency. Reports highlight that current employment and data protection laws in the UK and EU fail to adequately protect workers from these AI-enabled abuses.

records.title: Microsoft Teams Bug Prevents Android Phones from Calling Emergency Services
records.description: A bug in the Microsoft Teams app on Android 10+ devices, especially when not logged in, caused phones to fail when dialing emergency numbers like 911. The issue, due to an interaction between Teams and Android's telephony system, prevented critical emergency calls until Microsoft and Google released urgent fixes.

records.title: California Suspends Pony.ai Driverless Testing After Autonomous Vehicle Accident
records.description: Pony.ai, a self-driving technology company, had its driverless testing permit suspended by California's DMV after one of its autonomous vehicles collided with a road divider and traffic sign in Fremont. The incident caused property damage but no injuries, highlighting risks associated with AI-driven vehicles.

records.title: Yemeni Forces Shoot Down AI-Enabled Drones in Ongoing Conflict
records.description: Yemeni armed forces, led by spokesperson Yahya Saree, shot down multiple AI-enabled reconnaissance drones, including US-made Scan Eagle and Chinese-made CH4 models, used by Saudi and US-backed forces in Marib and Shabwah provinces. The incidents highlight the deployment and destruction of AI systems in Yemen's ongoing military conflict.

records.title: Facebook's AI System Fails to Accurately Identify Political Ads, Enabling Manipulation
records.description: A study by KU Leuven and NYU found that Facebook's AI-driven system misclassified 83% of reviewed political ads among 33.8 million analyzed, failing to flag thousands that should have been labeled. This malfunction allowed undisclosed political advertising, undermining transparency and potentially enabling political manipulation on the platform.

records.title: Tesla and Mercedes Face Scrutiny Over AI-Driven Vehicle Safety Risks
records.description: Tesla and Mercedes-Benz faced U.S. regulatory scrutiny after Tesla allowed gaming while driving and replaced faulty AI-driven cameras without recalls, raising safety concerns. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration is investigating both companies for potential risks from their AI-based driver assistance and infotainment systems.

records.title: US Blacklists Chinese AI Firm SenseTime Over Human Rights Concerns
records.description: The US government added Chinese AI company SenseTime to its investment blacklist, citing concerns over the use of its facial recognition technology in human rights abuses against Uyghurs in Xinjiang. The move restricts US investment and complicates SenseTime's Hong Kong IPO, reflecting ongoing governance responses to AI-related risks.

records.title: Facial Recognition AI Stops Fraudulent Border Crossing at U.S.-Canada Border
records.description: U.S. Customs and Border Protection used facial recognition AI at the Pacific Highway port of entry to detect a woman attempting to enter the U.S. from Canada with her sister's passport and vaccination card. The AI system identified a facial mismatch, preventing illegal entry and enforcing border security protocols.

records.title: Meta Expands Facebook Ban on Myanmar Military-Linked Businesses
records.description: Meta (Facebook) expanded its AI-driven ban to block all pages, groups, and accounts linked to Myanmar military-controlled businesses, following international documentation of their role in funding violence and human rights abuses. This action aims to mitigate ongoing harm facilitated by the misuse of Facebook's platform and algorithms.

records.title: Instagram's AI Algorithms Enable Teen Access to Drugs and Harmful Content
records.description: Reports reveal that Instagram's AI-driven search and recommendation algorithms facilitate teen access to illegal drugs and pro-anorexia content. Investigations found that minors could easily find and connect with drug dealers and harmful communities, highlighting failures in AI moderation and resulting in significant health risks for young users.

records.title: Facebook Sued for AI-Driven Role in Rohingya Genocide
records.description: Lawyers representing Rohingya victims have filed lawsuits in the US and UK against Facebook (Meta), alleging its AI-driven algorithms amplified hate speech and failed to remove inflammatory content, directly contributing to the 2017 genocide in Myanmar. The legal actions seek up to $200 billion in damages for the resulting violence and displacement.

records.title: Meta's AI Algorithms Enable Disinformation and Human Rights Abuses in the Philippines
records.description: Meta (formerly Facebook) has acknowledged that its AI-driven content algorithms have enabled disinformation, hate speech, and coordinated campaigns in the Philippines, leading to human rights violations and threats to journalists, activists, and citizens. An independent assessment prompted Meta to commit to mitigating these risks, especially ahead of national elections.

records.title: Tesla Autopilot Camera Defects and Safety Oversight Raise AI Safety Concerns
records.description: Tesla is replacing defective relay cameras in hundreds of U.S.-made Model S, X, and 3 vehicles, which are critical for the Autopilot AI system. The malfunction limits autonomous driving features and poses safety risks. Despite realized harm, Tesla has not issued a formal recall. CEO Elon Musk previously rejected proposals for Autopilot health monitoring, further raising safety concerns amid ongoing regulatory investigations.

records.title: AI Moderation Failures on Xiaohongshu Expose Minors' Privacy
records.description: Chinese social platform Xiaohongshu's AI-driven content recommendation and moderation systems failed to filter and block videos exposing minors' private information and sexually suggestive content. This led to privacy violations and potential psychological harm to minors. The company apologized and announced new measures to improve AI-based content governance.

records.title: Illegal AI-Powered Trading Robots Cause Investment Fraud in Indonesia
records.description: In Indonesia, the rise of AI-powered robot trading systems has led to widespread investment fraud, with illegal trading bots deceiving investors and causing significant financial losses. Authorities, including Bappebti, have warned the public to be cautious of fraudulent schemes using these automated trading algorithms.

records.title: Bank Ordered to Compensate Customer After Fraudulent Loan via Facial Biometric AI
records.description: Banco Pan in Brazil was ordered to pay damages after a fraudulent loan was approved using facial biometric authentication, an AI system. The court found the bank failed to ensure the security of its AI-based verification, resulting in financial and moral harm to the customer.

records.title: Life360 Sells Sensitive User Location Data, Raising Privacy Concerns
records.description: Life360, a widely used family safety app, has been selling precise location data of millions of users, including children, to multiple data brokers. This AI-driven data collection and sale has led to significant privacy violations, exposing users to potential misuse of their sensitive information. The issue is heightened by Life360's acquisition of Tile.

records.title: AI-Powered Smart Canes Enhance Mobility for Visually Impaired in Turkey
records.description: Municipalities in Kocaeli and İnegöl, Turkey, distributed AI-enabled smart canes to visually impaired citizens. These canes, equipped with navigation and obstacle detection features, connect to smartphones and apps, significantly improving users' safety, autonomy, and mobility by preventing accidents and enabling independent travel.

records.title: Israel Halts AI-Powered Mobile Tracking Over Privacy Concerns
records.description: The Israeli government discontinued the use of an AI-driven mobile phone tracking system designed to trace contacts of Covid-19 Omicron cases after public controversy and objections from the government ombudsman, citing privacy and human rights violations. The system's deployment raised significant concerns about infringement of citizens' privacy rights.

records.title: Pegasus Spyware Used to Hack U.S. Diplomats' Phones Abroad
records.description: Israeli company NSO Group's AI-enabled Pegasus spyware was used to hack the phones of at least nine U.S. diplomats working in Uganda and other East African countries. The incident, revealed by Apple and reported by major media, resulted in privacy violations and security concerns, prompting U.S. sanctions and legal actions.

records.title: Facebook Whistleblower Reveals AI-Driven Harms from Content Moderation Failures
records.description: Whistleblower Frances Haugen exposed that Facebook's AI-driven content moderation and recommendation systems contributed to the spread of divisive content and mental health harm, especially among young users. The systems inadequately handled non-English content, leaving many users vulnerable to abuse and misinformation, as revealed by leaked internal documents.

records.title: Global Outcry Over AI-Enabled Pegasus Spyware Abuse
records.description: NSO Group's AI-powered Pegasus spyware has been used by governments worldwide to surveil and persecute journalists, activists, and critics, leading to human rights violations. Civil society groups and rights organizations are urging the EU to sanction NSO, while the US has blacklisted the company for enabling abusive surveillance.

records.title: Google Pixel AI Accident Detection Feature Launches in France
records.description: Google has expanded its AI-powered car accident detection feature to Pixel smartphones in France. The system uses sensor and audio data to detect serious accidents and can automatically contact emergency services if the user does not respond, potentially mitigating harm by enabling faster emergency response.

records.title: Ukrainian Security Service Dismantles Pro-Russian AI-Driven Bot Farm in Chernivtsi
records.description: The Security Service of Ukraine (SBU) dismantled a large-scale bot farm in Chernivtsi, where a group used AI-driven systems to create and manage over 20,000 fake social media accounts. These bots spread pro-Russian propaganda, disinformation against Ukraine and its military, and anti-vaccine sentiments, causing societal harm.

records.title: Twitter Removes Thousands of State-Backed Accounts for Coordinated Manipulation
records.description: Twitter suspended 3,465 accounts linked to state-backed manipulation campaigns from China, Mexico, Russia, Tanzania, Uganda, and Venezuela. These accounts, often operated by bots and using AI-driven amplification, spread propaganda and misinformation supporting government narratives, harming public discourse and communities. The removals followed collaboration with research organizations.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Profiles Used in Disinformation Campaigns on Poland-Belarus Border
records.description: Meta uncovered coordinated disinformation campaigns on Facebook and Instagram involving fake accounts with AI-generated deepfake faces. Linked to the Belarusian KGB and other groups, these profiles spread misleading content about the Poland-Belarus border crisis, inflaming tensions and manipulating public opinion regarding migrants and border policies.

records.title: Polish Authorities Use AI Surveillance Pegasus to Target Opposition, Prompting International Backlash
records.description: Polish authorities used the AI-powered Pegasus spyware to surveil opposition figures and journalists, violating privacy and human rights. In response, Israel and the US have refused to provide further access or support for these surveillance systems, citing misuse for political repression. The incident highlights the harmful impact of AI-enabled surveillance.

records.title: Ukrainian Security Service Dismantles AI-Driven Bot Farm Spreading Disinformation
records.description: The Security Service of Ukraine (SBU) uncovered a Kyiv-based group using AI-powered software to manage nearly 6,000 fake social media accounts. The bot farm spread anti-Ukrainian, protest, and anti-vaccination content, and facilitated scams, causing social disruption and financial harm. AI enabled automated account creation, content generation, and large-scale coordination.

records.title: Facebook's AI Fails to Block Harmful Anti-Vaccine Ads
records.description: Facebook's AI-driven ad system allowed the promotion of anti-vaccine messages, including ads comparing vaccine mandates to the Holocaust and encouraging violence. Despite policies against such content, the AI failed to detect and block these ads, enabling widespread dissemination of harmful misinformation and public health risks in the United States.

records.title: EU Lawmaker Calls for Strict Regulation of Pegasus Spyware After Human Rights Abuses
records.description: Bulgarian MEP Petar Vitanov urged the European Parliament to impose strict controls or a ban on the AI-powered Pegasus spyware, following revelations that it was used for illegal surveillance of journalists, activists, and politicians worldwide, resulting in serious violations of privacy and fundamental human rights.

records.title: NSO Group's Pegasus Spyware Enables Global Human Rights Abuses, Faces Legal and Political Backlash
records.description: Israeli firm NSO Group's Pegasus spyware, which uses AI-driven surveillance, has been deployed by governments to target activists, journalists, and dissidents worldwide, leading to significant human rights violations. Apple and NGOs are pursuing legal action and urging EU sanctions to halt further abuses and restrict NSO's operations.

records.title: Revenue NSW's Unlawful Use of AI System Emptied Bank Accounts of Vulnerable People
records.description: Revenue NSW in Australia used an AI-driven automated system to issue garnishee orders, unlawfully debiting bank accounts of financially vulnerable individuals without human oversight. The NSW Ombudsman found the practice caused significant financial harm, including emptied accounts, and called for greater transparency and oversight of government AI use.

records.title: AI-Powered Surveillance Targets Journalists and Foreign Students in Henan, China
records.description: Authorities in Henan, China, commissioned an AI-driven facial recognition system to track and profile foreign journalists, international students, and ethnic minorities. Developed by Neusoft, the system integrates thousands of cameras with national databases, enabling targeted surveillance and human rights violations, including suppression of press freedom and privacy.

records.title: Hackers Exploit AI Smart Home Systems in South Korea, Leak Private Footage
records.description: Hackers infiltrated AI-enabled smart home devices, including security cameras, in South Korean apartments, recording and selling hundreds of private and intimate videos on the dark web. The incident exposed significant privacy violations and prompted government investigations and calls for stricter cybersecurity measures.

records.title: Clearview AI Fined for Unlawful Facial Recognition Data Practices in the UK
records.description: The UK Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) has provisionally fined Clearview AI over £17 million for serious breaches of UK data protection laws. Clearview AI's facial recognition system unlawfully collected and processed biometric data from UK individuals without consent, violating privacy rights. The ICO also ordered Clearview to stop processing and delete UK citizens' data.

records.title: AI-Enabled British F-35 Fighter Jet Crashes into Mediterranean During Takeoff
records.description: A British F-35B fighter jet, equipped with advanced AI flight systems, crashed into the Mediterranean Sea during takeoff from HMS Queen Elizabeth on November 17, 2021. The pilot ejected safely. The incident, possibly caused by a foreign object in the engine, resulted in the loss of the AI-enabled aircraft.

records.title: Pegasus Spyware Faces Global Legal Reckoning for AI-Driven Surveillance Abuses
records.description: The Israeli company NSO Group's AI-powered spyware, Pegasus, is under international legal scrutiny for enabling remote, zero-click surveillance of smartphones. Its use has led to documented human rights and privacy violations against activists, journalists, and political opponents, prompting lawsuits and sanctions worldwide.

records.title: AI-Powered Military Drones Cause Civilian Harm and Escalate Global Warfare
records.description: AI-powered drones, deployed by countries including China, Russia, Turkey, Israel, India, and the US, are increasingly used in military operations, leading to significant civilian casualties and collateral damage. These autonomous or semi-autonomous systems have been used in conflicts such as Nagorno-Karabakh and Ukraine, raising concerns over unregulated lethal AI warfare.

records.title: AI Bot Fakes Thousands of Signatures on Hungarian Political Petition
records.description: Hungarian activist Gergely Tomanovics used an AI algorithm called NERbot to submit over 2,300 fake entries to the Fidesz party's 'Stop Gyurcsány! Stop Márki-Zay!' petition. The bot exploited weak verification measures, undermining the petition's credibility and distorting public perception of political support.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Video Targets Greta Thunberg in Viral Misinformation Campaign
records.description: A deepfake video using AI technology falsely depicts activist Greta Thunberg dancing nude. The manipulated video, created from pornographic footage, has been widely circulated via WhatsApp in Brazil, causing reputational harm and spreading misinformation. The incident highlights the misuse of AI for generating harmful, deceptive content.

records.title: MediaTek Chip Vulnerabilities Expose Millions to Eavesdropping Risk
records.description: Security researchers at Check Point discovered vulnerabilities in MediaTek smartphone chips' AI and audio processing units, potentially allowing malicious apps to eavesdrop on users and escalate privileges. Affecting up to 37% of global Android devices, the flaws were patched by MediaTek in October 2021, with no exploitation reported.

records.title: Apple Ordered to Compensate User After iPhone 12 Security Breach
records.description: A Brazilian court ordered Apple to pay R$5,000 in damages after a stolen iPhone 12 was accessed by criminals who bypassed AI-driven security features, enabling unauthorized access to personal data and financial transactions. The court cited inadequate security protections as the cause of harm to the user.

records.title: Google Translate AI Produces Offensive Anti-Chinese Translations
records.description: Google Translate's AI system generated offensive and derogatory Chinese translations when users entered terms like "AIDS patient," returning results such as "Wuhan person." The incident sparked public outrage in China. Google acknowledged the issue, attributed it to machine error, and quickly fixed the translations, but did not issue a formal apology.

records.title: Israel Restricts Export of AI-Driven Pegasus Spyware After Human Rights Abuses
records.description: The Israeli government has banned the sale of NSO Group's AI-powered Pegasus spyware to 65 countries, including Mexico, Morocco, and Saudi Arabia, following revelations that the software was used to target journalists, activists, and politicians, resulting in significant human rights violations. The move is a response to global outcry over AI-enabled surveillance abuses.

records.title: Boeing 737 MAX MCAS Software Failure Leads to Fatal Crashes
records.description: Boeing's 737 MAX aircraft suffered two fatal crashes in 2018 and 2019, killing 346 people, due to a malfunction in the AI-based MCAS flight control software. The system incorrectly assessed flight conditions and overrode pilot input, highlighting critical safety and oversight failures in Boeing's development process.

records.title: Polish Prosecutor Targeted by Pegasus Spyware
records.description: Polish prosecutor Ewa Wrzosek received alerts from Apple indicating her iPhone was targeted by Pegasus, an AI-enabled spyware used for state surveillance. The incident highlights unauthorized surveillance and privacy violations against individuals critical of government actions, with evidence provided by Apple confirming the use of Pegasus on her device.

records.title: Russia's AI-Enabled 'Star Warrior' Destroys Satellite, Threatens NATO Infrastructure
records.description: Russia deployed its AI-enabled 'Star Warrior' missile system to destroy a Soviet-era satellite, creating hazardous space debris. State media threatened to target 32 NATO satellites, risking critical infrastructure and safety. The system uses advanced radar and supercomputing for detection and targeting, highlighting AI's direct role in the incident.

records.title: Apple Sues NSO Group Over Pegasus Spyware Abuse
records.description: Apple has filed a lawsuit against Israeli firm NSO Group, alleging its AI-enabled Pegasus spyware was used to infiltrate iPhones and surveil activists and journalists, violating privacy and human rights. Apple seeks to ban NSO from using its products and claims damages for harm caused to users.

records.title: Tesla FSD AI System Linked to Accidents and Ongoing Safety Concerns
records.description: Tesla's Full Self-Driving (FSD) AI system, under internal testing and improvement, has been involved in at least 11 accidents since 2018, causing 17 injuries and 1 death in the US. Recent incidents include a collision in California attributed to FSD malfunction, prompting regulatory investigation and increased data collection for analysis.

records.title: Facebook's AI Algorithms Expose Vulnerable Users to Harmful Content
records.description: Internal research and leaked documents reveal that Facebook's AI-driven content algorithms disproportionately exposed users with low digital literacy—often older, less educated, and from marginalized groups—to graphic violence and nudity. Despite awareness of these harms, Facebook failed to adequately address the issue, fueling real-world psychological and social harm globally.

records.title: AI-Powered Wearable Device Developed to Detect and Reverse Opioid Overdose
records.description: Researchers at the University of Washington have developed a wearable device that uses AI algorithms to detect opioid overdose by monitoring respiration. When an overdose is detected, the device automatically injects naloxone to restore breathing, aiming to prevent injury or death. The device has received regulatory approval in the US.

records.title: Facebook AI Moderation Algorithms Enable Unequal Hate Speech Enforcement
records.description: Internal documents reveal Facebook's AI content moderation algorithms disproportionately removed hate speech targeting white people and men, while failing to address more harmful content against minorities. Efforts by researchers to improve the system were dismissed by executives, resulting in unequal protection and potential discrimination on the platform.

records.title: Ukrainian Forces Deploy AI-Enabled Javelin Missiles and Bayraktar Drones in Donbas Conflict
records.description: Ukrainian military forces used AI-enabled Javelin missile systems and Bayraktar drones in combat for the first time in the Donbas region, targeting Russian and separatist forces. These advanced weapon systems, featuring autonomous targeting and guidance, directly contributed to harm during active military operations.

records.title: Global Tesla AI System Outage Locks Owners Out and Disrupts Vehicle Functions
records.description: A major server outage at Tesla caused widespread failures in AI-driven systems, including digital key access, autopilot, and smart summon features. Owners worldwide were locked out of their vehicles or experienced sudden stops and malfunctions. CEO Elon Musk acknowledged the issue and promised a fix. The incident highlights risks in AI-dependent vehicle systems.

records.title: Tesla App Outage Temporarily Locks Out Drivers
records.description: A malfunction in Tesla's AI-enabled mobile app prevented around 500 users from unlocking or starting their vehicles remotely, causing temporary inconvenience. CEO Elon Musk apologized and reported the issue was resolved within five hours. Alternative access via physical keys was available, mitigating further harm.

records.title: US States Investigate Instagram's AI-Driven Impact on Youth Mental Health
records.description: A coalition of US state attorneys general is investigating Meta (Instagram) for using AI-driven engagement algorithms that may harm young users' mental health. The probe focuses on whether these AI techniques violated consumer protection laws by increasing youth engagement and contributing to anxiety, depression, and body image issues.

records.title: LAPD's AI-Driven Social Media Surveillance Sparks Privacy Violations
records.description: The Los Angeles Police Department partnered with Voyager Labs to use AI-powered software for social media surveillance, including creating fake accounts to access private user data and predict criminal behavior. This practice violated privacy rights and platform policies, prompting Facebook to demand an end to such surveillance activities.

records.title: AI and Genomic Sequencing Enhance Hospital Outbreak Detection
records.description: Researchers at the University of Pittsburgh and Carnegie Mellon University developed an AI system that combines machine learning with whole genome sequencing to rapidly detect infectious disease outbreaks in hospitals. The system identified outbreaks missed by traditional methods, potentially preventing dozens of transmissions and improving patient safety.

records.title: Chinese Authorities Manipulate COVID-19 Health Code App to Restrict Dissidents' Travel
records.description: Chinese authorities manipulated the AI-driven COVID-19 health code app to change dissident lawyer Xie Yang's status from green to red, preventing him from traveling to Shanghai. This deliberate misuse of the app to restrict movement constitutes a violation of human rights, as confirmed by Amnesty International.

records.title: Tesla Full Self-Driving AI Malfunctions Create Road Safety Hazards in Brooklyn
records.description: Tesla's Full Self-Driving AI system in a Model 3 repeatedly malfunctioned during a test drive in Brooklyn, nearly causing crashes with construction sites, stopped trucks, and driving on the wrong side of the road. Human intervention was required multiple times to prevent accidents, posing significant safety risks to road users.

records.title: Meta's AI Ad Systems Collect Data from Minors Despite Policy Changes
records.description: Meta, owner of Facebook and Instagram, continues to use AI-driven ad systems to collect and process personal data from users under 18, despite public commitments to limit targeting. Investigations by advocacy groups revealed ongoing data collection and profiling of minors, raising privacy and rights concerns.

records.title: Huawei's Unlawful Facial Recognition Deployment in Valenciennes
records.description: Huawei deployed AI-powered facial recognition and intelligent analytics cameras in Valenciennes, France, without required legal approvals or data protection safeguards. Despite claims that facial recognition features were inactive, the system's presence and lack of transparency violated privacy rights and legal obligations, raising significant human rights concerns.

records.title: Fatal Tesla Autopilot Crash in California Leads to NTSB Probe Closure
records.description: In August 2020, a Tesla Model 3 operating with Autopilot engaged crashed in Saratoga, California, after the driver overrode the system by pressing the accelerator. The vehicle struck a minivan, then a truck at high speed, resulting in two fatalities. The NTSB closed its investigation without further action.

records.title: AI Voice Cloning Used in Fraudulent Scams in Russia
records.description: In Russia, fraudsters are using AI-powered neural networks to clone voices and impersonate individuals, deceiving victims into transferring money or sharing sensitive data. The technology makes it difficult to distinguish fake voices from real ones, leading to financial and privacy harm. Experts advise verifying suspicious calls to mitigate risks.

records.title: Ohio Sues Meta Over AI Algorithms' Harm to Children and Investors
records.description: Ohio Attorney General Dave Yost filed a lawsuit against Meta (formerly Facebook), alleging the company misled the public and investors about the safety and impact of its AI-driven content algorithms. The suit claims these algorithms promoted harmful content to children and caused over $100 billion in investor losses.

records.title: Meta Faces Investigations and Lawsuits Over AI Algorithms Harming Children and Investors
records.description: Meta (formerly Facebook) is under investigation and facing lawsuits in the US for its AI-driven algorithms on Facebook and Instagram, which allegedly harm children’s mental health and violate privacy. Authorities and investors accuse Meta of misleading the public and investors about the safety and impact of its platforms, resulting in significant financial and societal harm.

records.title: AI Deepfake Scandal: Non-Consensual Explicit Videos Target Taiwanese Public Figures
records.description: In Taiwan, AI deepfake technology was used to create and distribute non-consensual explicit videos featuring the faces of over 100 celebrities and influencers, including YouTuber Lyla. Despite the arrest of the main perpetrator, similar content continues to circulate online, causing significant reputational and emotional harm to victims and sparking public outrage.

records.title: AI-Powered Disaster Management Platforms Reduce Harm in Taiwan
records.description: Taiwan's National Applied Research Laboratories and New Taipei City have developed AI-driven disaster management platforms that integrate real-time data, predictive analytics, and visualization to enhance emergency response. These systems have improved decision-making and reduced harm during natural disasters and the COVID-19 pandemic, earning international recognition for their effectiveness.

records.title: Cuban Foreign Minister Accuses Twitter's AI Algorithms of Destabilizing Country
records.description: Cuban Foreign Minister Bruno Rodríguez Parrilla accused Twitter of manipulating its AI-driven algorithms and geolocation mechanisms to exaggerate anti-government sentiment in Cuba, allegedly provoking social destabilization. He claims only 15% of related tweets originated from Cuba, suggesting foreign influence and AI misuse to distort public perception.

records.title: Tesla FSD Beta Malfunction Causes Crash, Triggers U.S. Investigation
records.description: A 2021 Tesla Model Y, operating in Full Self-Driving (FSD) beta mode, entered the wrong lane during a turn in California, resulting in a collision and severe vehicle damage. U.S. regulators (NHTSA) are investigating the incident, which highlights a malfunction in Tesla's AI-driven autonomous driving system. No injuries were reported.

records.title: Amazon Sued After AI-Driven Delivery Pressure Leads to Catastrophic Crash
records.description: Amazon faces a lawsuit after its AI-powered driver monitoring and delivery scheduling systems allegedly pressured a delivery driver to speed, resulting in a crash that left Ans Rana paralyzed. The incident highlights claims that Amazon's AI systems indirectly caused harm by enforcing unrealistic delivery quotas and unsafe driving conditions in Georgia, USA.

records.title: Russian Government Chatbot Spreads COVID-19 Misinformation After Cyberattack
records.description: Following a major cyberattack on Russia's Gosuslugi portal, the AI chatbot 'Max' began spreading harmful misinformation, denying the existence of COVID-19 and promoting conspiracy theories about vaccines and QR codes. The Ministry of Digital Development attributed the chatbot's behavior to the cyberattack, raising concerns about public health and trust.

records.title: AI-Driven Workplace Monitoring Damages UK Workers' Mental Health
records.description: AI algorithms used for monitoring and setting performance targets in UK workplaces are causing significant harm to workers' mental health, according to a parliamentary report. The All-Party Parliamentary Group on the Future of Work calls for new legislation to regulate these AI systems and prioritize employee wellbeing.

records.title: AI-Driven COVID-19 Contact Tracing in China Sparks Public Outcry and Rights Concerns
records.description: China deployed an AI-based system using mobile phone location data to identify 'spatiotemporal companions' of COVID-19 cases, triggering mass quarantines, movement restrictions, and public fear. The system's imprecision and broad criteria led to widespread disruption, privacy concerns, and criticism over rights violations and social impact.

records.title: AI Software Malfunctions Prompt Major Vehicle Recalls in China
records.description: Mercedes-Benz recalled over 11,000 imported S-Class cars in China due to a software fault in the airbag control unit, an AI system, which may disable the front passenger airbag, increasing injury risk. Separately, JAC recalled 23,919 Ruifeng S2 vehicles for TCU software issues that could cause power loss while driving.

records.title: Fatal Tesla Model 3 Crash in Florida Under NTSB Investigation for AI System Involvement
records.description: A Tesla Model 3, equipped with AI-based driver-assist systems, crashed at 90 mph in Coral Gables, Florida, killing two people. The NTSB is investigating the incident, focusing on the vehicle's AI systems, as no braking was detected before the crash. The event highlights potential AI system involvement in the fatal accident.

records.title: Prince Harry Warned Twitter CEO About Platform's Role Before Capitol Riot
records.description: Prince Harry revealed he warned Twitter CEO Jack Dorsey that the platform was enabling extremist mobilization ahead of the January 6 Capitol riot in Washington, D.C. Twitter's AI-driven content systems failed to prevent the organization and spread of misinformation, indirectly contributing to the violence and resulting harm.

records.title: EU AI Systems in Social Security Cause Discrimination and Rights Violations
