records.description: Human Rights Watch reports that AI algorithms used by European governments to allocate social security benefits and detect fraud have led to discrimination, privacy breaches, and denial of support for vulnerable populations. The EU's proposed AI regulation is criticized for failing to adequately protect affected individuals' rights.

records.title: Amnesty International Condemns Hyderabad Police's Use of Facial Recognition for Mass Surveillance
records.description: Amnesty International, with partners, has condemned Hyderabad police's widespread use of AI-powered facial recognition for mass surveillance. The technology, integrated with CCTV and drones, has led to privacy violations, discriminatory policing, and human rights concerns, particularly targeting minorities. Incidents include police coercing citizens to remove masks for biometric data collection.

records.title: Google's AI-Powered Flood Prediction System Saves Lives in South Asia
records.description: Google has deployed a machine learning-based flood prediction and alert system in India and Bangladesh, providing timely warnings to millions of people at risk. Integrated with Google Maps and the Crisis Response program, the AI system has directly contributed to harm prevention and saving lives during flood events.

records.title: Patients Overcharged for AI-Assisted Surgeries at Bach Mai Hospital
records.description: Between 2017 and 2020, Bach Mai Hospital in Vietnam overcharged 637 patients for brain surgeries using the AI-enabled Robot Rosa system by inflating service costs. Authorities have since recovered the unlawfully collected funds and are investigating the misuse of the AI system for financial gain.

records.title: Taiwan Health Official Deepfaked in Fake Endorsement Ad
records.description: AI face-swapping (deepfake) technology was used to manipulate videos of Taiwan's Central Epidemic Command Center spokesperson, Chuang Jen-hsiang, falsely portraying him as endorsing a sexual enhancement drug. The incident, involving Chinese advertisers, led to reputational harm and misinformation, prompting official investigations and promises of legal action.

records.title: Boeing Admits Responsibility for 737 MAX AI Software Crash in Ethiopia
records.description: Boeing has admitted full responsibility and reached settlements with families of the 157 victims of the March 2019 Ethiopian Airlines 737 MAX crash. The crash was caused by a malfunction in the aircraft's AI-based flight control software (MCAS), leading to loss of control and fatalities. Legal proceedings are ongoing in the US.

records.title: Zillow's AI-Driven Home-Flipping Failure Leads to Major Financial Losses
records.description: Zillow's reliance on its AI-powered Zestimate system for home valuation in its iBuyer program led to significant financial losses and the shutdown of its home-flipping business. The AI failed to accurately assess property values and market volatility, resulting in overpayment for homes and harm to the company's finances and reputation in the US real estate market.

records.title: AI Proctoring in University Exams Raises Privacy and Bias Concerns
records.description: Universities worldwide have adopted AI-powered proctoring software to monitor students during remote exams. These systems, using facial recognition and behavior analysis, have led to privacy invasions, discriminatory bias, and unfair treatment of students, prompting complaints, protests, and legal actions over their impact on student rights.

records.title: Arrest in Mexico Over Pegasus Spyware Misuse Sparks International Scrutiny
records.description: Mexican authorities arrested a businessman for allegedly using NSO Group's Pegasus spyware, an AI-powered surveillance tool, to spy on a journalist. The incident highlights widespread misuse of the software in Mexico, targeting journalists and activists, and has prompted international calls, including from UK lawmakers, for sanctions against NSO Group.

records.title: Pegasus Spyware Used Against Palestinian Rights Workers, Triggers US Sanctions
records.description: Israeli firm NSO Group's AI-powered Pegasus spyware was used to hack the phones of Palestinian human rights workers, violating their privacy and rights. The incident led to US sanctions against NSO Group for enabling malicious targeting of activists, journalists, and officials, sparking international concern over AI-driven surveillance abuses.

records.title: Meta's AI Systems Implicated in Privacy Violations and Societal Harm
records.description: Meta's AI-driven apps Facebook and Instagram covertly collected sensitive user data from iPhone accelerometers, violating privacy despite user restrictions. Separately, whistleblower Frances Haugen testified that Facebook's engagement-ranking AI amplifies polarization and real-world harm. These incidents highlight significant privacy breaches and societal risks linked to Meta's AI systems.

records.title: Horizon IT System Malfunction Causes Financial Ruin and Wrongful Prosecutions for UK Subpostmasters
records.description: Between 2000 and 2014, flaws in the Horizon accounting system led to 736 UK subpostmasters being wrongfully prosecuted for theft and fraud. The system's errors caused financial ruin, reputational damage, and severe personal consequences. A public inquiry is ongoing, with calls for urgent compensation for affected individuals.

records.title: Israel Deploys AI Facial Recognition for Surveillance of Palestinians in Hebron
records.description: The Israeli military has implemented an AI-driven facial recognition system, 'Blue Wolf,' in Hebron and the West Bank to monitor Palestinians. Soldiers use smartphones to photograph individuals, with the AI system determining if they should be detained or arrested, raising significant human rights concerns over invasive surveillance and arbitrary data collection.

records.title: AI-Enabled Drone Warfare Escalates Between Hamas and Israel
records.description: Hamas has increasingly deployed AI-enabled drones for reconnaissance and attacks from Gaza, prompting the Israeli military to use its AI-powered Iron Dome system to intercept these drones. Recent incidents include the interception and destruction of Hamas drones, highlighting the growing role of AI systems in the ongoing conflict.

records.title: Facebook Whistleblower Reveals AI Algorithms Undermine Democracy
records.description: Facebook whistleblower Frances Haugen testified before the European Parliament, revealing that Facebook's AI-driven content algorithms amplify misinformation and radical content, deepening polarization and undermining democratic integrity. Haugen provided internal documents showing Facebook prioritizes profit over safety, despite being aware of the societal harm caused by its AI systems.

records.title: Google Pixel 6 AI Malfunctions Cause Ghost Calls and Security Breaches
records.description: Google Pixel 6 and 6 Pro devices have experienced two major AI-related malfunctions: Google Assistant is randomly making calls without user input, and the fingerprint sensor is allowing unregistered fingerprints to unlock devices. Both issues compromise user privacy and security. Google is working on fixes for these problems.

records.title: Drone-Assisted Assassination Attempt on Iraqi Prime Minister Causes Injuries
records.description: A drone loaded with explosives targeted Iraqi Prime Minister Mustafa al-Kadhimi's residence in Baghdad, injuring several security personnel but leaving the Prime Minister unharmed. The attack, classified as a terrorist act, highlights the use of AI-enabled drones in assassination attempts and raises concerns about future autonomous weapon threats.

records.title: Facebook's AI Algorithms Linked to Harmful User Addiction and Mental Health Issues
records.description: Internal research at Facebook (now Meta) revealed that AI-driven engagement algorithms contributed to addictive usage patterns, negatively impacting the mental and physical health of about 360 million users. Harms included sleep disruption, reduced productivity, and strained relationships. Despite recognizing these issues, Facebook disbanded its well-being team in 2019.

records.title: Microsoft 365 AI-Powered Employee Surveillance Raises Privacy Concerns
records.description: Microsoft is introducing AI-driven surveillance features in Microsoft 365, enabling employers to monitor employee browser activity and file transfers via machine learning. These tools, aimed at detecting insider risks, have raised concerns about privacy violations and intrusive workplace monitoring, particularly as they are being deployed globally.

records.title: AI Delivery Algorithms Cause Harm to Chinese Food Couriers
records.description: Chinese food delivery apps like Meituan and Ele.me use AI algorithms to set strict delivery times and automatically penalize drivers for perceived lateness, sometimes due to system glitches. This pressures riders into unsafe driving and results in financial penalties, directly harming workers' health, safety, and income. Authorities' interventions have had limited effect.

records.title: MySejahtera App Glitch Incorrectly Assigns Covid-19 Quarantine Statuses
records.description: A glitch in Malaysia's MySejahtera Covid-19 management app caused random users to be incorrectly assigned 'Home Surveillance Order' and 'Person Under Surveillance' statuses, leading to confusion, distress, and unnecessary quarantine. The app administrators apologized, fixed the root cause, and reverted the incorrect statuses.

records.title: Facebook AI Amplifies Toxic Content in Brazil, Internal Documents Reveal
records.description: Leaked internal Facebook documents show that the platform's AI-driven content recommendation and moderation systems have enabled the widespread reach of toxic content—such as hate speech, misinformation, and explicit violence—in Brazil. The company identified Brazil as a high-risk country for such harmful content, highlighting significant community harm caused by its AI systems.

records.title: Facebook's AI Algorithms Amplify Misinformation and Harm Users
records.description: Internal research and whistleblower disclosures reveal that Facebook's AI-driven content recommendation and sharing systems amplified misinformation and harmful content, negatively impacting public health and mental well-being, especially among young users. Despite knowing these risks, Facebook failed to implement effective mitigation measures, prioritizing engagement over user safety.

records.title: Facebook's AI Algorithms Amplify COVID-19 Misinformation, Prompting Health Crisis
records.description: Over 500 U.S. healthcare professionals have demanded Facebook disclose data on COVID-19 misinformation, citing the platform's AI-driven algorithms for amplifying false claims. This spread of misinformation has led to vaccine refusal, job loss, and increased COVID-19 cases, highlighting the harmful impact of AI systems on public health.

records.title: Hungarian Government Admits Use of AI-Enabled Pegasus Spyware for Surveillance
records.description: Hungarian officials confirmed the Interior Ministry's purchase and use of the AI-enabled Pegasus spyware to surveil over 100 individuals, including journalists and opposition politicians. The incident raises concerns over privacy violations and human rights abuses linked to government use of advanced AI surveillance tools.

records.title: US Blacklists NSO Group and Others Over AI-Enabled Spyware Abuses
records.description: The US government blacklisted Israeli firms NSO Group and Candiru, along with Russian and Singaporean companies, for developing AI-enabled spyware like Pegasus, which was used by governments to target journalists, activists, and political opponents, leading to human rights violations. The sanctions aim to curb further misuse of such AI surveillance tools globally.

records.title: Australian Regulator Orders Clearview AI to Delete Illegally Collected Facial Data
records.description: Australian and UK privacy regulators found that Clearview AI's facial recognition system breached privacy laws by scraping and storing biometric data from social media without consent. The Australian regulator ordered Clearview AI to stop collecting and to delete all images and data of Australians, citing significant privacy violations and risks.

records.title: Tesla Recalls Nearly 12,000 Vehicles After AI Software Malfunction
records.description: Tesla recalled nearly 12,000 vehicles in the US after a software update to its Full-Self Driving Beta AI system caused false collision warnings and unexpected emergency braking, increasing the risk of accidents. The issue was addressed with a subsequent software update. No injuries or crashes were reported.

records.title: Experts Warn of Poisonings Linked to Mushroom Identification Apps
records.description: German medical experts warn that reliance on AI-powered mushroom identification apps has led to cases of severe poisoning, including kidney failure. The apps often misidentify mushrooms due to natural variations, prompting calls for users to seek expert advice rather than trust app results alone.

records.title: Tesla FSD AI Raises Safety Concerns After Near-Collision and Ongoing Performance Issues
records.description: Tesla's Full Self-Driving (FSD) AI system has faced criticism after a near head-on collision involving its beta software, prompting calls for regulatory intervention. Ongoing issues include poor on-road performance, misleading marketing, and safety risks, leading to regulatory scrutiny and dissatisfaction among users in the United States.

records.title: Malware and Security Flaws Found in Russian Children's Smartwatches
records.description: Russian cybersecurity firm Doctor Web discovered serious vulnerabilities and trojan malware in popular children's smartwatches, including Elari Kidphone 4G and Wokka Lokka Q50. These flaws allow attackers to remotely control devices, spy on children, intercept unencrypted location data, and install malicious software, posing significant privacy and safety risks.

records.title: Facebook Whistleblower Reveals AI-Driven Content Amplification Harms
records.description: Frances Haugen, a former Facebook employee, revealed at the Web Summit in Lisbon that Facebook's AI-driven content ranking system amplifies extreme and harmful content, contributing to misinformation, polarization, and risks to public safety. Her disclosures highlight ongoing harms caused by the platform's AI algorithms.

records.title: Meta Removes Nicaraguan Government-Linked AI-Driven Troll Farm
records.description: Meta (Facebook) dismantled a large-scale network of fake accounts, pages, and groups allegedly run by the Nicaraguan government and the FSLN party to manipulate public discourse and discredit opposition. AI systems detected and removed these accounts, impacting freedom of expression and political participation in Nicaragua.

records.title: AI-Generated Search Snippets Spread Health Misinformation
records.description: A study by German and Russian researchers found that AI systems used by Google and Yandex to generate and rank health-related search snippets often provide false or misleading information, especially about home remedies and alternative treatments, potentially leading users to make harmful health decisions. The issue is particularly noted in Russia.

records.title: Mandatory Use of 'LeaveHomeSafe' App in Hong Kong Raises Privacy and Enforcement Concerns
records.description: Hong Kong mandated the use of the AI-driven 'LeaveHomeSafe' contact tracing app for entry into government facilities to control COVID-19. The rollout faced challenges including privacy concerns, difficulties for elderly and vulnerable groups, enforcement issues, and arrests for using fake apps, raising questions about social control and data protection.

records.title: AI-Enabled Turkish Drones Cause Harm in Multiple Conflict Zones
records.description: The Turkish-made Bayraktar TB2, an AI-enabled armed drone, has been exported to at least thirteen countries and used in conflicts such as Libya, Nagorno-Karabakh, and Ukraine. Its deployment has resulted in destruction of military assets and harm to people and property, highlighting the direct impact of AI systems in modern warfare.

records.title: Criminal Group Hacks and Sells 8,600 Smart Camera Accounts, Exposing Private Footage
records.description: A criminal group exploited security vulnerabilities in AI-enabled smart cameras across China, hacking over 8,600 accounts and selling access and private footage from homes and private spaces online. Police arrested 34 suspects and seized illicit profits, highlighting significant privacy risks and the need for stronger AI device security.

records.title: Pegasus Spyware Enables Illegal AI Surveillance of Journalists and Activists
records.description: AI-powered Pegasus spyware has been used for illegal surveillance against journalists and human rights defenders, leading to privacy violations, intimidation, and threats to personal safety. The incident highlights the misuse of AI-enabled tools for targeted stalking and the ongoing impunity for such abuses.

records.title: Deepfake AI Misuse Sparks National Security and Privacy Crisis in Taiwan
records.description: In Taiwan, AI-powered deepfake technology has been used to create manipulated videos targeting political leaders and celebrities, resulting in privacy violations, reputational harm, and threats to election integrity and national security. Authorities have formed special task forces and are pursuing legislative reforms to counter these AI-driven incidents and prevent further harm.

records.title: Delivery Worker Trapped After AI Navigation Guides Him to Hazardous Mountain Path in Taoyuan
records.description: A delivery worker in Taoyuan, Taiwan, relied on Google Maps' AI navigation, which directed him onto a steep, unpaved mountain path. His motorcycle overturned and was damaged, leaving him stranded for two hours until police rescued him. The incident highlights risks from over-reliance on AI-based navigation systems.

records.title: Facebook's AI-Driven Targeting of Children as Young as 6 Revealed in Leaked Documents
records.description: Leaked internal documents reveal Facebook's plans to use AI-driven algorithms to target children as young as six, expanding its user base below the current age threshold of 13. The disclosures raise concerns about privacy, mental health, and legal violations, highlighting the potential and realized harms of AI-powered content targeting on vulnerable youth.

records.title: Woman Mugged After Google Maps AI Route Leads Through Dangerous Area in Seville
records.description: A woman in Seville, Spain, was mugged and injured after Google Maps, an AI-powered navigation app, directed her through El Vacie, a known high-crime area. The incident highlights the risks of AI navigation systems failing to account for local safety, resulting in direct harm to users.

records.title: Mexican Government Paid Millions to Pegasus Spyware Vendor Amid Irregularities
records.description: Mexican government agencies under President López Obrador paid over 312 million pesos to companies linked to Uri Emmanuel Ansbacher Bendrama, the businessman who sold the AI-powered Pegasus spyware. The payments, flagged as irregular by auditors, are tied to ongoing investigations into illegal surveillance and money laundering involving the AI system.

records.title: Brazilian Politician Loses Mandate for Spreading Misinformation About Electronic Voting
records.description: The Brazilian Superior Electoral Court (TSE) revoked the mandate of state deputy Fernando Francischini for spreading false information about electronic voting machines during the 2018 elections. The court ruled that his use of digital platforms to disseminate misinformation undermined electoral integrity, marking a precedent for punishing AI-enabled disinformation campaigns.

records.title: Facebook Whistleblower Alleges AI Systems Fuel Online Hate in UK Testimony
records.description: Former Facebook data scientist Frances Haugen testified before UK lawmakers that Facebook's AI-driven content recommendation and moderation systems are exacerbating online hate and extremism. Her claims, based on internal documents, highlight ongoing harm linked to the platform's AI, prompting calls for stronger online safety legislation in the United Kingdom.

records.title: Cyberattack Disrupts Iran's AI-Driven Fuel Distribution System
records.description: On November 4, 2021, Iran's AI-powered smart fuel distribution system was targeted by a coordinated cyberattack, causing fuel supply disruptions at stations nationwide. The attack, aimed at destabilizing society, exposed vulnerabilities in critical infrastructure, though rapid government response mitigated broader harm.

records.title: US Sanctions Iran Over AI-Enabled Drone Attacks
records.description: The US imposed sanctions on Iran's UAV program, targeting individuals and companies linked to the development and deployment of AI-enabled drones. These drones, used by Iran's Revolutionary Guard and supplied to regional groups, have been involved in attacks on US forces and international shipping, causing harm and regional instability.

records.title: Stolen Cryptographic Keys Enable Fake EU Green Passes, Prompting Mass Invalidation
records.description: Stolen cryptographic keys used to generate EU Green Pass certificates enabled the creation and online sale of fake, yet verifiable, COVID-19 passes. The breach compromised the AI-based verification system, forcing authorities to invalidate all certificates generated with the stolen keys and triggering urgent EU-wide technical reviews.

records.title: Facebook's AI Moderation Suppresses Arabic Political Speech During Gaza Conflict
records.description: Facebook's AI-driven content moderation systems, particularly on Instagram, mistakenly censored the Arabic hashtag "الأقصى" during the 2021 Gaza conflict, conflating it with militant groups. This systematic failure suppressed political speech and violated users' rights to free expression, especially among Arabic speakers, despite Facebook's awareness of the issue for years.

records.title: US Retailers Remove Chinese AI Surveillance Products Linked to Xinjiang Human Rights Abuses
records.description: Major US retailers, including Best Buy, Home Depot, and Lowe's, have stopped selling surveillance products from Chinese companies Hikvision and Dahua. These companies' AI-powered facial recognition and video surveillance systems have been implicated in human rights abuses against Uyghur and other minorities in Xinjiang, including mass detention and ethnic profiling.

records.title: Indian Supreme Court Orders Investigation into Pegasus Spyware Surveillance
records.description: The Indian Supreme Court formed a three-member expert committee to investigate allegations of illegal surveillance using the AI-enabled Pegasus spyware on politicians, journalists, and activists. The court rejected the government's national security defense and its request to form its own panel, citing concerns over privacy violations and judicial independence.

records.title: Facebook's AI Algorithms Amplify COVID-19 Vaccine Misinformation
records.description: Facebook's AI-driven content ranking system amplified anti-vaccine misinformation during the COVID-19 pandemic, undermining public health efforts. Despite internal research showing that algorithmic changes could reduce harmful content, Facebook delayed implementing these measures, allowing misinformation to continue spreading widely among users.

records.title: AI-Enabled Bayraktar TB2 Drones Used by Ukraine Spark International Concern After Combat Strikes
records.description: Ukraine deployed AI-enabled Bayraktar TB2 drones to strike Russian-backed separatist artillery in Donbas, causing destruction and raising international alarm. Russia, France, and Germany expressed concerns over the escalation and potential violations of ceasefire agreements, highlighting the direct harm caused by AI-driven weapon systems in the conflict.

records.title: YouTube Suspends Brazilian President's Channel Over COVID-19 Misinformation Detected by AI
records.description: YouTube, using AI-driven content moderation, suspended Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro's channel for a week and removed videos spreading false claims linking COVID-19 vaccines to AIDS. The action aimed to curb public health misinformation, with similar removals by Facebook and Instagram. The incident occurred in Brazil.

records.title: Facebook's AI Algorithm Amplifies Harmful Content Through Reaction-Based Ranking
records.description: Internal documents reveal that Facebook's AI-driven content ranking algorithm, which prioritized posts eliciting strong emoji reactions, systematically amplified misinformation, toxic, and hateful content. This design choice, intended to boost engagement, led to significant societal harm by promoting divisive and harmful material globally.

records.title: Facebook's AI Moderation Failures Enable Global Spread of Harmful Content
records.description: Internal documents and whistleblower reports reveal Facebook's AI systems for content moderation failed to detect hate speech and abusive content in many languages, especially in vulnerable countries. Insufficient human oversight and inadequate AI led to the unchecked spread of harmful content, contributing to real-world violence and human rights abuses globally.

records.title: Dutch Tax Authority's AI Algorithms Cause Ethnic Profiling and Discrimination
records.description: Amnesty International reports that the Dutch Tax Authority's use of AI algorithms to detect childcare benefit fraud led to ethnic profiling and discrimination, particularly against non-Dutch nationals and lower social classes. The unregulated use of these systems resulted in human rights violations and inadequate government measures risk recurrence.

records.title: Fake 'Diia' App Enables Document Forgery in Ukraine
records.description: Fraudsters in Ukraine developed a fake version of the official 'Diia' app, allowing users to generate counterfeit COVID certificates and passports, facilitating illegal activities such as underage alcohol purchases. The app, distributed outside official stores, poses legal risks and undermines public trust in digital documents.

records.title: TikTok's AI Recommender Exposes Minors to Harmful Content
records.description: Investigations revealed that TikTok's AI-driven recommendation system promoted graphic serial killer videos, firearms, and body armor to accounts registered as 13-year-olds. The algorithm exposed minors to violent and dangerous content, including links to purchase weapons, raising serious concerns about child safety and the platform's content moderation failures.

records.title: FTC Investigates Facebook Over AI-Driven Harm to Teen Users
records.description: The U.S. Federal Trade Commission has launched an investigation into Facebook after internal documents revealed that its AI algorithms, particularly on Instagram, foster discord and negatively impact teenage users' mental health. The probe examines whether Facebook misled users and violated a 2019 privacy agreement.

records.title: Taiwan's Ministry of Justice Deploys AI and Blockchain to Prevent Recidivism
records.description: Taiwan's Ministry of Justice has implemented AI, big data analytics, and blockchain technologies to monitor and manage individuals under judicial supervision, aiming to prevent recidivism. The system provides real-time alerts and personalized interventions, particularly for high-risk offenders, enhancing public safety and judicial effectiveness.

records.title: Pegasus Spyware Used for AI-Driven Surveillance Against Journalists and French Officials
records.description: NSO Group's AI-enabled Pegasus spyware was used to hack French government ministers and New York Times journalist Ben Hubbard, enabling unauthorized surveillance and privacy violations. Investigations linked the attacks to Saudi Arabia and raised diplomatic tensions between France and Israel, highlighting the human rights risks of AI-powered surveillance tools.

records.title: Facebook AI Algorithms Linked to Global Harm and Censorship, Whistleblower Revelations Spark Outcry
records.description: Internal documents leaked by whistleblower Frances Haugen reveal Facebook's AI-driven content algorithms and moderation systems knowingly amplified hate speech, polarization, and harmful content, while enabling government censorship, notably in Vietnam. These AI system failures and misuse have caused real harm to users and communities worldwide, prompting widespread media scrutiny and regulatory calls.

records.title: Facebook's AI Algorithms Amplify Hate Speech and Misinformation in India
records.description: Internal Facebook documents reveal that the company's AI-driven content recommendation and moderation systems failed to prevent the spread of misinformation, hate speech, and violent content in India. Researchers found that following AI recommendations led users to harmful, inflammatory, and community-targeted material, highlighting significant shortcomings in Facebook's AI moderation capabilities.

records.title: Facebook's AI Content Moderation Failures Lead to Government Probes and Societal Harm
records.description: Whistleblower Frances Haugen's disclosures revealed Facebook's AI-driven content moderation prioritized growth over safety, enabling hate speech, misinformation, and harm to teens. These failures led to government investigations in the US and India, with concerns over AI systems' role in facilitating societal and individual harm.

records.title: Zeekr 001 Owners Report Major AI Navigation System Malfunctions
records.description: After the delivery of Zeekr 001 vehicles in China, first batch owners reported severe malfunctions in the AI-powered in-car navigation system, including loss of positioning and inaccurate route guidance. These issues impaired navigation functionality and caused significant user dissatisfaction. Zeekr has not yet responded to these complaints.

records.title: Facebook's AI Algorithms Amplify Harmful Content and Contribute to Capitol Attack
records.description: Internal documents and whistleblower testimony reveal Facebook's AI-driven algorithms have amplified harmful content, misinformation, and hate speech, contributing to real-world harms including adolescent mental health issues and the January 6 Capitol attack in the US. Facebook's inability to control these AI systems has led to significant societal and political consequences.

records.title: Facebook's AI-Driven Accelerometer Tracking Raises Privacy Concerns on iOS
records.description: Security experts revealed that Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp use AI to analyze accelerometer data on iOS devices, covertly tracking user activities and inferring locations even when users opt out of tracking. This practice constitutes a significant privacy violation. Competing apps like TikTok and Telegram do not engage in similar tracking.

records.title: Pegasus Spyware Scandal Strains France-Israel Relations
records.description: The Israeli AI-enabled Pegasus spyware, developed by NSO Group, was used by Morocco to surveil French officials, including President Macron and journalists, causing a diplomatic crisis between France and Israel. High-level meetings were held in Paris, with Israel proposing to exclude French phone numbers from future Pegasus targeting to ease tensions.

records.title: Facebook's AI Algorithm Promoted Extremist Content to New Users
records.description: In 2019, Facebook's AI-powered recommendation system rapidly pushed a new user, created for research, toward QAnon and other extremist groups within days, despite no prior interest in conspiracy theories. Internal documents revealed the algorithm promoted content violating Facebook's own hate speech and disinformation policies, highlighting the system's role in user radicalization.

records.title: Amazon Alexa's Extensive Data Collection Raises Privacy Concerns
records.description: A survey and analysis reveal that Amazon's Alexa collects more user data than other smart assistants, raising privacy concerns among users. While the article highlights extensive data collection practices, it does not report any direct harm or specific AI incident resulting from these practices.

records.title: NTSB Investigates Fatal Tesla Crash and Potential Autopilot Involvement in Texas
records.description: A Tesla Model S crashed and burned in Spring, Texas, killing two men. The NTSB found both occupants were in the front seats at the time. The investigation is ongoing, focusing on whether Tesla's Autopilot AI system was active and if it contributed to the fatal incident.

records.title: Tesla Withdraws FSD Beta 10.3 After AI Malfunctions Cause Safety Concerns
records.description: Tesla withdrew its Full Self-Driving (FSD) Beta 10.3 software in the US after users reported AI malfunctions, including false collision warnings, loss of automatic steering, and cruise control issues. The rollback followed safety concerns and ongoing regulatory scrutiny, highlighting risks from the AI system's malfunction during real-world use.

records.title: Bug in Trading Algorithm Causes Bitcoin Flash Crash on Binance.US
records.description: A bug in an institutional client's trading algorithm on Binance.US caused Bitcoin's price to plummet 87% to $8,200 in seconds, triggering a flash crash. The malfunction disrupted the broader crypto market, raising concerns about safeguards in algorithmic trading systems. The issue was reportedly fixed after the incident.

records.title: Chivo Wallet AI Malfunction Causes Financial and Privacy Harm in El Salvador
records.description: A malfunction in El Salvador's government-backed Chivo Wallet app, which manages Bitcoin and dollar transactions, caused users to see inflated account balances, double charges, and unauthorized use of personal data. These AI system failures led to financial losses, privacy violations, and public outcry, prompting political demands for accountability.

records.title: AI Ethics Chatbot Delphi Produces Racist and Harmful Moral Judgments
records.description: The Allen Institute for AI's ethics chatbot, Delphi, generated racist and ethically problematic responses when asked moral questions, including justifying harm if it creates jobs. These outputs, shared widely online, highlight the risks of deploying AI systems for ethical guidance without adequate safeguards.

records.title: Theranos AI Blood-Testing Scandal Leads to Investor and Patient Harm
records.description: Theranos, led by Elizabeth Holmes, misled investors and partners by falsely claiming its AI-driven blood-testing device, Edison, could accurately perform numerous tests. The device frequently failed, and demonstrations concealed errors, resulting in financial losses and potential health risks. Legal proceedings in California highlight the misuse and malfunction of the AI system.

records.title: AI Used to Remove Censorship from Adult Videos Leads to Arrest in Japan
records.description: A man in Hyogo, Japan, was arrested for using AI technology (TecoGAN) to remove mosaic censorship from adult videos, creating and selling uncensored versions online. This misuse of AI resulted in copyright violations and the illegal distribution of obscene material, generating over 11 million yen in sales.

records.title: Deepfake AI Scandal in Taiwan: Non-Consensual Pornography and National Security Concerns
records.description: A Taiwanese YouTuber, "Xiao Yu," and associates used AI Deepfake technology to create and sell non-consensual pornographic videos featuring celebrities, politicians, and influencers, including President Tsai Ing-wen. The incident caused significant harm, legal action, and raised national security concerns, prompting government and law enforcement responses.

records.title: Software Glitch in Austrian E-Medication System Causes Incorrect Prescriptions
records.description: A software malfunction in Austria's E-Medication system, part of the ELGA electronic health record, led to incorrect dosage information on prescriptions for about 1,200 patients across 33 pharmacies. The error, linked to private pharmacy software, risked dangerous misdosages, though no confirmed harm has been reported. Authorities have contacted affected patients and resolved the issue.

records.title: Security Flaw in Scotland's Vaccine Passport App Enables Fraudulent Access
records.description: Scotland's NHS Covid Status App, used for vaccine verification at nightclubs and large events, was found to allow users to take screenshots of vaccination records despite official claims to the contrary. This security flaw enabled fraudulent access, undermining public health protections and increasing the risk of COVID-19 transmission.

records.title: Facebook's AI Fails to Effectively Remove Hate Speech and Harmful Content
records.description: Internal documents and whistleblower reports reveal that Facebook's AI moderation system removes only a small fraction of hate speech and harmful content, often missing or misclassifying violations. This failure has allowed dangerous material to persist on the platform, causing harm to communities and undermining user safety.

records.title: Facebook's Algorithm Amplifies Hate Speech, Causing Harm to Vulnerable Groups
records.description: Facebook and Instagram's AI-driven algorithm has been criticized for amplifying hate speech and harmful content, particularly targeting vulnerable groups. Despite internal awareness and public whistleblowing, the company has not modified the algorithm, prioritizing user engagement over safety, leading to real-world harm and calls for regulation.

records.title: AI Voice Cloning Enables $35 Million Bank Heist in UAE
records.description: In early 2020, cybercriminals used AI-powered voice cloning to impersonate a company director and deceive a bank manager in the United Arab Emirates, authorizing fraudulent transfers totaling $35 million. The sophisticated scheme involved at least 17 people and highlights the risks of synthetic voice technologies in financial fraud.

records.title: Facebook's AI Algorithms Amplify COVID-19 Vaccine Misinformation, Prompting US Investigation
records.description: US state attorneys general from 14 states have launched an inquiry into Facebook's use of AI-driven algorithms that allegedly amplified COVID-19 vaccine misinformation and exempted certain high-profile users from moderation rules. These practices reportedly increased societal polarization and public health risks, prompting official concern and investigation.

records.title: TikTok's AI Algorithm Amplifies Harmful Content to Minors
records.description: TikTok's AI-driven recommendation and moderation systems have failed to prevent the spread of harmful content, including pro-eating-disorder, drug, and sexualized videos, to minors. Despite moderation efforts, the algorithm continues to expose vulnerable users to content that negatively impacts their mental and physical health.

records.title: Allegations of Google AI Manipulating Elections and User Behavior
records.description: Harvard researcher Robert Epstein accuses Google of using AI-driven algorithms to manipulate search results and collect personal data, allegedly influencing election outcomes and user opinions worldwide. Epstein claims these practices threaten democracy and privacy, citing research suggesting Google's search systems impacted up to 25% of election results in various countries.

records.title: Rain Causes AI-Driven Vehicle Safety Systems to Fail in AAA Tests
records.description: AAA research found that advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS), including automatic emergency braking and lane keeping, frequently failed in moderate to heavy rain during closed-course tests. Collisions occurred in one-third of emergency braking tests, and lane departures in 69% of cases, highlighting significant AI system malfunctions under adverse weather conditions.

records.title: 7-Eleven Australia Illegally Collected Customer Biometric Data via AI Facial Recognition
records.description: 7-Eleven Australia deployed AI-powered facial recognition in 700 stores, collecting biometric data from millions of customers during surveys without their consent. The Office of the Australian Information Commissioner found this violated privacy laws, ordering 7-Eleven to cease data collection and destroy stored data.

records.title: AI-Driven Social Media Platforms Amplify Antisemitic Content Among Youth
records.description: European organizations report that AI-powered content recommendation systems on Instagram and TikTok are facilitating the spread of antisemitic content and conspiracy theories among young users. Despite moderation efforts, these platforms' algorithms amplify harmful material, causing significant harm to targeted communities.

records.title: Tesla Autopilot AI Failures Lead to Accidents and Regulatory Scrutiny in the US
records.description: The US National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) is investigating Tesla's Autopilot and Full Self-Driving AI systems after multiple accidents, including fatalities, where the AI failed to detect emergency vehicles. Tesla faces criticism for not issuing recalls and for restricting negative feedback from users, raising safety and compliance concerns.

records.title: US Regulators Probe Tesla Over Autopilot-Linked Crashes and Lack of Recall
records.description: US safety regulators are investigating Tesla after multiple crashes involving its Autopilot AI system, some resulting in injuries and a death. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration questions Tesla's decision to issue software updates addressing safety defects without filing a formal recall, raising concerns about transparency and compliance.

records.title: TikTok's AI Moderation Removes Millions of Videos, Faces Challenges with Harmful Content
records.description: TikTok's AI-driven content moderation system removed over 81 million videos globally between April and June for violating community guidelines, including 27,000 for COVID-19 misinformation. Despite high accuracy, the system failed to prevent minors' exposure to pornographic content in Spain, highlighting ongoing challenges in protecting vulnerable users.

records.title: Android System Apps Use AI-Driven Tracking Without User Consent
records.description: Researchers from the University of Edinburgh and Trinity College Dublin found that Android smartphones, including those by Samsung, Xiaomi, and Huawei, use preinstalled system apps to continuously collect and share user data without consent. These apps employ AI-driven analytics, violating user privacy even when tracking is disabled.

records.title: Google Removes Malicious and Stalkerware Apps from Play Store
records.description: Google has banned several malicious and stalkerware apps from the Play Store in India. These apps, some using AI-based features, were stealing users' login credentials and personal data or enabling unauthorized surveillance, violating privacy and security. Google acted to protect users and enforce its policies.

records.title: Google and Amazon Workers Protest AI Cloud Services Used by Israeli Military
records.description: Nearly 400 Google and Amazon employees protested their companies' involvement in Project Nimbus, a contract supplying AI-enabled cloud technology to the Israeli military. Workers allege the technology facilitates surveillance, displacement, and harm to Palestinians, raising concerns about human rights violations linked to the use of AI systems.

records.title: AI Surveillance in Baltimore Schools Raises Privacy and Equity Concerns
records.description: Baltimore public schools use GoGuardian's Beacon AI software to monitor student laptops for suicide risk, leading to emergency interventions for nine students. While intended to prevent harm, the system has sparked concerns over privacy, potential rights violations, and disproportionate surveillance of marginalized and economically disadvantaged students.

records.title: Moscow Police Gain Access to Citizens' Photos for Facial Recognition Surveillance
records.description: The Moscow government is upgrading its public services portal, mos.ru, to automatically transfer user-uploaded photos and smartphone data to a police-accessible facial recognition system. This integration enables law enforcement to identify individuals and issue fines, raising significant concerns about privacy violations and potential human rights abuses.

records.title: Facebook Whistleblower Reveals AI-Driven Platform Harms and Congressional Investigation
records.description: Former Facebook data scientist Sophie Zhang has provided U.S. authorities with detailed evidence alleging Facebook's AI-driven algorithms enabled the spread of misinformation, hate speech, and manipulation by authoritarian regimes. Zhang is willing to testify before Congress, highlighting the platform's failure to prevent harm despite internal warnings and ongoing investigations.

records.title: UK Court Fines Man for Privacy Breach by Amazon Ring Doorbell
records.description: A UK court ruled that Jon Woodard's use of Amazon Ring doorbells and security cameras violated neighbor Dr. Mary Fairhurst's privacy, breaching the Data Protection Act and GDPR. The AI-enabled devices' extensive audio and video recording led to a substantial fine, highlighting privacy risks of smart surveillance systems.

records.title: Waymo and WeRide Autonomous Vehicles Cause Disruptions and Safety Concerns in California
records.description: In San Francisco, Waymo's autonomous vehicles repeatedly entered and became stuck in a dead-end street, disrupting residents and requiring human intervention due to an apparent AI navigation glitch. Separately, a WeRide safety driver was caught sleeping while overseeing an autonomous vehicle in San Jose, raising serious safety concerns about human oversight of AI systems.

records.title: Facebook's AI Fails to Remove Violent Videos, Causing Harm to Victims' Families
records.description: Andy Parker, father of slain reporter Alison Parker, filed a complaint against Facebook and Instagram for repeatedly failing to remove violent videos of her murder. The platforms' AI-driven content moderation systems failed to prevent the resurfacing of graphic footage, causing ongoing trauma to victims' families and violating platform safety commitments.

records.title: AI Surveillance in Minneapolis Schools Causes Privacy and Emotional Harm to Students
records.description: Minneapolis Public Schools' use of Gaggle, an AI-driven student monitoring software, led to privacy violations and emotional distress. The system flagged sensitive content, including LGBTQ-related terms and mental health reflections, resulting in school interventions that outed students and caused harm, particularly to vulnerable individuals like transgender youth.

records.title: Tesla Autopilot-Related Crashes Result in 10 Deaths, Prompting U.S. Safety Investigation
records.description: Since 2016, Tesla vehicles operating with Autopilot, an AI-based driver assistance system, have been involved in at least 30 crashes resulting in 10 deaths in the United States. Despite regulatory scrutiny and ongoing investigations by the NHTSA, CEO Elon Musk has not apologized, maintaining the system's safety claims.

records.title: Social Media Algorithms Linked to Widespread Societal Harm
records.description: AI-driven social media algorithms, designed to maximize user engagement, have caused significant harm including addiction, mental health issues, social polarization, and misinformation. Experts like Stuart Russell warn that these systems, optimized without regard for human well-being, are creating real and ongoing societal risks.

records.title: Facebook Whistleblower Reveals AI-Driven Harm to Teens
records.description: Frances Haugen, a former Facebook product manager, leaked internal research showing that Facebook's AI-driven content recommendation systems, particularly on Instagram, have caused harm to teenagers' mental health. She is testifying before the UK Parliament, highlighting the negative impact of these AI systems and calling for regulatory intervention.

records.title: Facebook's AI Algorithms Linked to Societal Harm and Global Controversy
records.description: Multiple reports and whistleblower disclosures reveal that Facebook's AI-driven content algorithms have contributed to significant societal harms, including mental health issues among youth, ethnic violence, misinformation, and social polarization. Internal research and testimonies highlight the global impact of these AI systems, prompting scrutiny and governance responses.

records.title: Instagram's AI Algorithms Linked to Teen Eating Disorders
records.description: Instagram's AI-driven recommendation algorithms promoted harmful content related to body image and eating disorders, leading to severe health consequences for teen girls, including hospitalization and near death. The platform's AI amplified toxic content, contributing directly to the development and worsening of eating disorders among vulnerable users.

records.title: TikTok's AI Fails to Prevent COVID-19 Vaccine Misinformation Reaching Children
records.description: AI-driven recommendation and moderation systems on TikTok failed to block or filter COVID-19 vaccine misinformation, allowing millions of children, including those under the age limit, to access harmful content. Despite warnings from watchdog NewsGuard and reports to UK authorities, the misleading material remained widely available.

records.title: Facebook's AI Moderation Wrongfully Suppresses Palestinian Content During 2021 Hostilities
records.description: Human Rights Watch reported that Facebook and Instagram's AI-driven content moderation systems wrongfully removed and suppressed posts by Palestinians and their supporters about human rights abuses during the May 2021 Israel-Palestine conflict. These actions restricted freedom of expression and access to information, prompting calls for independent investigation.

records.title: Nobel Laureate Maria Ressa Criticizes Facebook's AI Algorithms for Spreading Misinformation
records.description: Nobel Peace Prize winner Maria Ressa accused Facebook's AI-driven algorithms of amplifying misinformation and hate speech, undermining facts, journalism, and democracy. She claims the platform's prioritization of engagement over accuracy has led to real-world harms, including targeted harassment and erosion of public trust, particularly in the Philippines.

records.title: Snapchat's AI Moderation Fails to Prevent Fentanyl Deaths, Prompts New Safety Measures
records.description: Snapchat's AI-based content moderation failed to prevent drug dealers from selling fentanyl-laced pills on its platform, leading to fatal overdoses among young users in the United States. In response, Snap has launched new educational tools and enhanced AI detection to address the ongoing crisis.

records.title: AI-Enabled Drone Attacks Injure Civilians at Saudi Airports
records.description: Explosive-laden drones, likely using AI for navigation and targeting, attacked Saudi airports in Abha and Jizan, injuring at least 14 people and damaging property. The Saudi-led coalition blamed Yemen's Houthi group for the attacks, highlighting the direct harm caused by AI-enabled unmanned systems in conflict zones.

records.title: Dubai Ruler Used Pegasus Spyware to Hack Ex-Wife and Associates
records.description: Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, ruler of Dubai, authorized the use of NSO Group's AI-powered Pegasus spyware to hack the phones of his ex-wife Princess Haya, her lawyers, and associates during a custody dispute. UK courts ruled this as illegal surveillance and abuse of power, violating privacy and human rights.

records.title: Facebook's AI Algorithms Linked to Widespread Harm and Social Unrest
records.description: Multiple articles highlight how Facebook's AI-driven content recommendation and moderation systems have contributed to mental health issues, facilitated criminal activity, and spread misinformation, including fueling the January 6 insurrection. Despite internal awareness of these harms, Facebook failed to adequately address them, raising concerns about the platform's reformability.

records.title: AI-Enabled Saudi Military Drone Shot Down in Yemen's Marib
records.description: Yemeni armed forces shot down a Chinese-made CH-4 AI-enabled reconnaissance and combat drone belonging to the Saudi-led coalition over Marib province. The drone, capable of autonomous surveillance and precision strikes, was destroyed during hostile operations, highlighting the use and loss of AI systems in active conflict zones.

records.title: Uber Faces Legal Action Over Racial Bias in Facial Recognition AI
records.description: Uber's use of Microsoft-powered facial recognition AI for driver identity checks in the UK has led to wrongful account deactivations and job losses, disproportionately affecting people of colour. Trade unions and affected drivers allege the system's bias constitutes racial discrimination and unfair dismissal, prompting legal action against Uber.

records.title: Police Use of Facial Recognition AI Raises Privacy Concerns in UK and Canada
records.description: Police deployment of AI-powered facial recognition in the UK and Canada has led to significant privacy violations, with millions scanned without consent. Human rights groups and privacy watchdogs have challenged these practices, prompting legal scrutiny and calls for stricter regulations to protect individual rights.

records.title: Singapore Health Ministry Disables Chatbot After Misleading COVID-19 Advice
records.description: Singapore's Ministry of Health disabled its 'Ask Jamie' AI chatbot after it provided misleading and inappropriate responses to COVID-19 queries, such as suggesting safe sex and polio vaccines instead of relevant health advice. The malfunction raised concerns about public health misinformation and prompted a system review.

records.title: Facebook Whistleblower Reveals AI-Driven Harm to Minors and Society
records.description: Frances Haugen, a former Facebook employee, leaked internal documents and testified before the U.S. Senate, revealing that Facebook's AI-driven content recommendation and moderation systems have harmed children's mental health, fueled social division, and undermined democracy. Facebook executives denied the allegations, but internal research confirmed ongoing harm linked to their AI systems.

records.title: Yemeni Forces Shoot Down US-Made Saudi Reconnaissance Drone
records.description: Yemeni armed forces, led by Ansarallah, shot down a US-made RQ-20 reconnaissance drone operated by the Saudi military over Jizan, southern Saudi Arabia. The AI-powered drone was conducting hostile surveillance missions when it was destroyed, highlighting the use and vulnerability of AI systems in active conflict zones.

records.title: Russian AI System Monitors Social Media, Raising Human Rights Concerns
records.description: Russian authorities have deployed AI-powered software to monitor social media and telecommunications for 'deviant' behavior among youth, aiming to prevent self-harm and violence. Critics warn the system enables state surveillance and repression, threatening freedom of expression and privacy. The technology is already in use, providing information to law enforcement.

records.title: Clearview AI's Advanced Facial Recognition Tools Raise Privacy Concerns
records.description: Clearview AI has expanded its facial recognition technology, introducing AI-powered tools to 'deblur' and 'remove masks' from images, making it easier to identify individuals even in obscured photos. The system, used by law enforcement and other agencies, has sparked lawsuits and public backlash over privacy violations and potential misidentification.

records.title: Medtronic MiniMed Insulin Pump Recall Over AI Malfunction and Cybersecurity Risks
records.description: Medtronic expanded recalls of its MiniMed insulin pumps and remote controllers in the U.S. due to AI system malfunctions and cybersecurity vulnerabilities. Faulty hardware and exploitable wireless controls led to incorrect insulin dosing, causing injuries and at least one death. The FDA classified the recall as Class I, indicating serious risk.

records.title: Facebook AI Ad Targeting Enables Discrimination in Australia
records.description: Facebook's AI-driven ad delivery system has enabled discriminatory targeting based on gender, race, and age, leading to violations of rights and harm to Australian communities. The lack of transparency in these 'dark ads' has prompted research initiatives to investigate and address these AI-enabled harms.

records.title: AI-Controlled Drones Malfunction and Fall During Zhengzhou Light Show
records.description: During a large-scale drone light show in Zhengzhou, China, multiple AI-controlled drones malfunctioned and fell from the sky, landing among a crowd and causing panic. The incident was attributed to either mechanical failure, operator error, or possible signal interference. No injuries were reported, but the event posed significant safety risks.

records.title: Dutch Government Sued Over AI-Powered License Plate Surveillance
records.description: Privacy First has filed a lawsuit against the Dutch government over the use of AI-driven Automatic Number Plate Recognition (ANPR) cameras, which store millions of license plates and related images for four weeks. The organization claims this practice constitutes mass privacy violations and breaches European privacy laws.

records.title: AI-Driven Social Media Algorithms Linked to Harmful TikTok Challenges Among Children
records.description: AI-powered recommendation algorithms on platforms like TikTok have promoted dangerous viral challenges, leading to self-harm and fatal outcomes among children in Bosnia and Herzegovina. Experts highlight the urgent need for prevention and monitoring to protect minors from AI-amplified digital risks.

records.title: Global Outcry Over AI-Driven Pegasus Spyware and Human Rights Violations
records.description: The NSO Group's AI-powered Pegasus spyware has enabled widespread, covert surveillance of journalists, activists, and politicians, leading to significant human rights violations. Civil society groups are urging the UN Human Rights Council to investigate and regulate such AI surveillance tools, while NSO expresses support for international oversight.

records.title: Instagram's AI Promotes Harmful Eating Disorder Content to Teens
records.description: Instagram's AI-driven recommendation system promoted accounts glorifying eating disorders to a 13-year-old user's account, despite such content violating platform policies. The incident, revealed by a U.S. senator's investigation and multiple reports, highlights ongoing failures of Instagram's AI to prevent harm to teen mental health and body image.

records.title: AI-Driven Social Media Platforms Linked to Harm Among U.S. Adolescents
records.description: AI-powered content recommendation and moderation systems on platforms like Facebook, Instagram, and Snapchat expose U.S. adolescents as young as 13 to harmful content with minimal protection. This has led to significant mental health issues and, in some cases, tragic outcomes, prompting legislative scrutiny and calls for stronger safeguards.

records.title: Fraudulent AI Trading Robots Cause Investor Losses in Indonesia
records.description: In Indonesia, fraudulent investment schemes using AI-powered trading robots have led to significant financial losses for investors. These platforms promised high, unrealistic returns and operated through unregulated brokers, with experts warning that many are scams designed to steal users' money.

records.title: Google DeepMind Sued Over Unauthorized Use of UK Patient Data for AI App
records.description: Google and its AI subsidiary DeepMind face a class action lawsuit in the UK after obtaining and processing the confidential medical records of 1.6 million NHS patients without consent to develop the Streams AI app. The incident raises significant privacy and data protection concerns regarding AI use in healthcare.

records.title: Mass Cyberattacks Target Russian Electronic Voting System During Elections
records.description: During the Russian State Duma elections from September 17-19, over 900 cyberattacks targeted the remote electronic voting system, aiming to disrupt its operation and implant malware. The attacks, some using spoofed addresses, threatened critical election infrastructure, highlighting vulnerabilities in AI-driven voting technologies.

records.title: Bocconi University Fined for AI Proctoring Privacy Violations
records.description: Italy's privacy authority fined Bocconi University €200,000 for unlawfully processing students' biometric and personal data using AI-based proctoring software (Respondus Monitor and LockDown Browser) during remote exams. The software's invasive monitoring and insufficient data protection measures violated GDPR, following a complaint by a student.

records.title: Apple Watch AI Fall Detection Saves Unconscious Motorcyclist in Singapore
records.description: In Singapore, a motorcyclist named Muhammad Fitri was knocked unconscious in a hit-and-run accident. His Apple Watch's AI-powered fall detection feature automatically alerted emergency contacts and called an ambulance, enabling timely medical intervention and likely saving his life.

records.title: Autonomous Weapons Reportedly Kill Humans in Libyan Conflict
records.description: A United Nations Security Council report indicates that autonomous weapon systems, or AI-powered killer robots, may have killed people for the first time during the Libyan civil war. These systems operate without human intervention, raising concerns about accountability, destabilization of global security, and urgent calls for regulation.

records.title: Chatbot-Driven Fraud Scheme Produces Fake COVID-19 Certificates in Kyiv
records.description: In Kyiv, a 24-year-old man and a 22-year-old woman used a chatbot to automate orders for fake COVID-19 test results and vaccination certificates, producing around 200 fraudulent documents. The AI-enabled scheme posed public health risks and led to criminal charges for large-scale fraud.

records.title: SenseTime AI Surveillance Linked to Uyghur Human Rights Abuses and U.S. Sanctions Evasion
records.description: Chinese AI company SenseTime's facial recognition technology was used for surveillance of Uyghur populations, leading to U.S. sanctions over human rights violations. Regulatory adjustments allowed only a subsidiary to remain on the U.S. Entity List, enabling the parent company to largely avoid restrictions and continue operations, raising concerns about ongoing harm.

records.title: Siri Loses Key Accessibility Functions After iOS 15 Update
records.description: Following the iOS 15 update, Apple's AI voice assistant Siri lost several basic functions, such as checking messages and making calls. This malfunction particularly affected users with visual and motor disabilities who rely on these features for accessibility. Apple is aware and working on a fix.

records.title: Texas Police Officers Sue Tesla After Autopilot Crash Injures Five
records.description: Five Texas police officers are suing Tesla after a Model X, operating on Autopilot, crashed into them during a traffic stop, causing serious injuries. The lawsuit alleges Tesla's AI-driven Autopilot system failed to detect emergency vehicles, highlighting ongoing safety concerns and previous similar incidents involving first responders.

records.title: AI Algorithms in China Perpetuate Gender Bias and Discrimination
records.description: A report by the Mana Data Foundation and UN Women found that Chinese AI systems, including search engines and recruitment algorithms, systematically perpetuate gender bias. These systems return male-dominated results for professional roles and derogatory content for female-related searches, and discriminate against women in job applications, causing real-world harm.

records.title: Global Human Rights Violations Linked to Pegasus Spyware Surveillance
records.description: The NSO Group's Pegasus spyware, an AI-enabled surveillance tool, has been used by governments worldwide to unlawfully monitor journalists, activists, and dissidents, leading to human rights violations such as privacy breaches, intimidation, and repression. Investigations reveal targeted attacks in countries like Morocco and India, prompting calls for independent inquiries.

records.title: Facial Recognition AI Misuse Leads to Privacy and Portrait Rights Violations in China
records.description: In China, misuse of Sogou's AI-powered facial recognition search enabled netizens to identify and publicly disseminate images of a man allegedly involved in a scandal, without his consent. This led to privacy and portrait rights violations, misidentification, and legal complaints, highlighting the risks of AI-driven image search technologies.

records.title: Pegasus Spyware Used to Target Emirati Activist Alaa Al-Siddiq
records.description: Investigations revealed that Emirati activist Alaa Al-Siddiq's phones were repeatedly hacked using the AI-enabled Pegasus spyware, developed by Israel's NSO Group and reportedly deployed by the UAE. The surveillance violated her privacy and human rights, causing harm to her and her associates, even after her death in the UK.

records.title: AI Surveillance and Military Drone Use Lead to Privacy Violations and Fatality
records.description: In Henan, China, authorities used AI systems to secretly collect and integrate citizens' personal data from hospitals and utilities under anti-terrorism pretexts, violating privacy rights. Separately, in Mali, a French soldier died during an anti-terror operation initiated by AI-enabled drone surveillance detecting terrorist activity.

records.title: Short Video Platforms' AI Youth Protection Bypassed by Uninstall-Reinstall Loophole
records.description: Chinese short video platforms Douyin and Kuaishou implemented AI-driven youth protection modes limiting minors' screen time. However, users discovered that uninstalling and reinstalling the apps bypasses these restrictions, exposing a flaw in the AI enforcement and potentially undermining efforts to prevent excessive use among minors.

records.title: Singer Lin Junjie Sues Bilibili Creator Over AI Deepfake Videos
records.description: Chinese singer Lin Junjie sued Bilibili and a content creator for using AI face-swapping technology to produce unauthorized videos featuring his likeness, alleging infringement of portrait rights and seeking 275,000 yuan in damages. The court case highlights harm caused by AI-generated deepfake content. The infringing videos have since been removed.

records.title: French Ministers' Phones Infected by Pegasus Spyware
records.description: In 2019 and 2020, the AI-powered Pegasus spyware, developed by Israel's NSO Group, infected the phones of at least five French government ministers and a presidential diplomat. The incident, confirmed by security services, resulted in significant privacy violations and raised concerns about unauthorized AI-driven surveillance targeting high-level officials in France.

records.title: US Judge Orders Facebook to Disclose Data on AI-Moderated Accounts Linked to Rohingya Genocide
records.description: A US federal judge ordered Facebook to release data from accounts linked to violence against the Rohingya in Myanmar, criticizing the platform's AI-driven moderation for failing to prevent the spread of hate speech and incitement. Facebook's AI systems are implicated in enabling content that contributed to mass atrocities.

records.title: Facebook's AI Algorithms Linked to User Harm and Unequal Rule Enforcement
records.description: Internal documents reveal Facebook's AI-driven algorithms and moderation systems have caused harm, including mental health issues among adolescents, incitement to violence, and unequal rule enforcement. Despite being aware of these issues, Facebook has repeatedly failed to address them, as shown in internal research and communications.

records.title: AI System Eva Doubles Detection of Asymptomatic COVID-19 Cases at Greek Borders
records.description: The AI system Eva, deployed at Greece's borders in summer 2020, used reinforcement learning to target COVID-19 testing among incoming travelers. It identified nearly twice as many asymptomatic cases as random testing, directly reducing public health risks and enabling safer border management during the pandemic.

records.title: Bird Attacks Force Suspension of Google Wing Drone Deliveries in Canberra
records.description: Google's Wing autonomous delivery drones in Canberra, Australia, were attacked by territorial ravens, leading to the suspension of drone operations in affected suburbs. The AI-driven drones suffered near crashes and operational disruption, prompting the company to pause flights to protect both birdlife and equipment.

records.title: Lithuania Warns of AI-Driven Censorship in Chinese Smartphones
records.description: Lithuania's National Cyber Security Center found that Xiaomi smartphones sold in Europe have AI-powered software capable of detecting and censoring politically sensitive phrases. Although disabled in the EU, this feature can be remotely activated, raising concerns over free expression and privacy. The government advised consumers to avoid or discard such devices.

records.title: AI Facial Recognition in China Causes Privacy Violations and Financial Harm
records.description: In China, widespread use of AI-powered facial recognition systems has led to privacy violations, unauthorized data collection, forced consent, and financial losses due to data misuse. Legal cases and new regulations highlight ongoing harms, as individuals' biometric data is often collected and used without proper consent or safeguards.

records.title: AI-Powered Student Surveillance in US Schools Raises Privacy and Equity Concerns
records.description: US schools widely use AI-driven monitoring software on student devices, tracking online activity and communications. Research by the Center for Democracy & Technology highlights harms including privacy violations, chilling effects on expression, and disproportionate impacts on vulnerable students, especially those relying on school-provided devices.

records.title: MIT Study Links Tesla Autopilot to Driver Inattention and Accidents
records.description: A MIT study found that Tesla's Autopilot AI system leads to increased driver inattention, with drivers spending more time looking away from the road when Autopilot is active. This behavior has been linked to multiple accidents and fatalities, prompting U.S. investigations into the system's safety.

records.title: Apple AirPods' Live Listen Feature Enables Unauthorized Eavesdropping
records.description: Multiple reports highlight misuse of Apple's AI-powered Live Listen feature on iPhones and AirPods, allowing users to covertly eavesdrop on private conversations by remotely transmitting audio. This has raised significant privacy concerns and ethical debates, as the feature, intended for accessibility, is being exploited for unauthorized surveillance.

records.title: Facebook's AI Algorithms Amplify Social Harm and Misinformation
records.description: Facebook's AI-driven content recommendation and moderation systems have been linked to increased social discord, mental health issues among teens, and the spread of vaccine misinformation. Internal documents reveal the company was aware of these harms, which have impacted public health and community well-being, particularly in the United States.

records.title: Amazon AI Cameras Unjustly Penalize Delivery Drivers
records.description: Amazon's AI-powered camera system, installed in delivery vans across the US, has been penalizing drivers for safe driving behaviors and situations beyond their control, such as checking mirrors or being cut off by other vehicles. These unjust penalties affect drivers' income and working conditions, raising concerns over labor rights violations.

records.title: Tesla Autopilot and FSD AI Systems Linked to Safety Incidents and Regulatory Scrutiny in the US
records.description: Tesla's Autopilot and Full Self-Driving (FSD) Beta AI systems have been involved in multiple safety incidents in the US, including crashes and fatalities, particularly under challenging conditions like glare or low visibility. Regulatory bodies have raised concerns about the systems' reliability and misleading marketing, prompting investigations and calls for improved safety measures.

records.title: AI-Assisted Remote Weapon Used in Assassination of Iranian Nuclear Scientist
records.description: In November 2020, Israeli intelligence agency Mossad used an AI-powered, remotely operated machine gun to assassinate Iran's top nuclear scientist, Mohsen Fakhrizadeh, near Tehran. The AI system enabled precise targeting without on-site operatives, resulting in Fakhrizadeh's death while avoiding harm to others present.

records.title: AI Algorithms Used to Suppress Palestinian Content on Social Media
records.description: A New York University study revealed that Israeli authorities, using AI-driven content moderation algorithms on platforms like Facebook, systematically flagged and removed Palestinian content as 'violent.' This automated censorship has led to violations of freedom of expression and suppression of Palestinian voices online.

records.title: NTSB Investigates Fatal Tesla Crash in Florida Involving AI Driving System
records.description: The U.S. National Transportation Safety Board is investigating a fatal crash in Coral Gables, Florida, where a Tesla Model 3 left the road, hit a tree, and caught fire, killing two people. The probe focuses on whether Tesla's AI-assisted driving system contributed to the incident.

records.title: AI-Driven Bot Farm Disrupts Ukrainian Vaccination Program
records.description: Ukrainian security services dismantled a bot farm in Dnipro, operated by a local woman under Russian direction, using over 5,000 automated Facebook accounts to spread disinformation and undermine Ukraine's national vaccination program. The operation involved AI-enabled systems for large-scale dissemination of false narratives, causing harm to public health efforts.

records.title: Pentagon Admits AI-Enabled Drone Strike in Kabul Killed 10 Civilians by Mistake
records.description: The US Pentagon admitted that an AI-enabled drone strike in Kabul on August 29 mistakenly targeted a civilian vehicle, killing 10 people, including 7 children. The attack, intended to prevent an imminent threat, was later found to be a tragic error caused by misidentification through AI-supported targeting systems.

records.title: Facebook Algorithms Amplified Troll Farm Misinformation to 140 Million Americans Monthly
records.description: Internal reports revealed that Facebook's AI-driven content recommendation algorithms promoted misinformation and propaganda from troll farms to 140 million Americans each month ahead of the 2020 US presidential election. The algorithms prioritized engagement, enabling widespread dissemination of inauthentic content and undermining public discourse and democratic processes.

records.title: Google and Apple Remove Russian Opposition AI Voting App Under Kremlin Pressure
records.description: Google and Apple removed an AI-driven tactical voting app, developed by allies of opposition leader Alexei Navalny, from their stores in Russia following Kremlin pressure. The app provided algorithmic voting recommendations to weaken the ruling party. Its removal, criticized by opposition activists, restricted political rights and freedom of expression.

records.title: Puigdemont to Sue Spanish State Over AI-Enabled Pegasus Espionage
records.description: Carles Puigdemont announced in Paris that he will sue the Spanish state for alleged political espionage against him and his associates using the AI-enabled Pegasus spyware. He claims to have evidence of unlawful surveillance, highlighting the use of AI systems for political repression and privacy violations.

records.title: Tesla Autopilot and Full Self-Driving Systems Linked to Accidents and Regulatory Scrutiny in the US
records.description: Tesla's Autopilot and Full Self-Driving AI systems have been linked to multiple road accidents, prompting investigations by US authorities, including the NTSB. Regulators cite safety deficiencies and misleading marketing as contributing factors, urging Tesla to address fundamental issues before expanding autonomous driving features.

records.title: AI-Enabled Social Media Scams Lead to Human Trafficking in Cambodia
records.description: Chinese-run scam operations in Cambodia used AI-enabled social media platforms to create fake profiles and lure foreign workers and tourists into fraudulent investment schemes. Victims were trafficked, forced into online scam labor, and subjected to violence and abuse, highlighting the role of AI systems in enabling large-scale exploitation.

records.title: Volkswagen Executives Stand Trial for Dieselgate Emissions Fraud
records.description: Four former Volkswagen executives are on trial in Germany for organized fraud and serious economic fraud related to the 'Dieselgate' scandal. The case centers on the use of manipulated AI-based software in 11 million vehicles to falsely report lower emissions, causing significant environmental and economic harm.

records.title: Self-Driving Car Accident Injures Paralympian in Japan
records.description: In Japan, a Level 3 autonomous vehicle injured a person during a self-driving showcase at the Paralympics. The AI system detected the individual and stopped, but the operator overrode the system, resulting in a light injury. The incident highlights challenges in deploying autonomous vehicles for public use.

records.title: TikTok's AI Algorithm Amplifies Political Misinformation During German Election
records.description: Multiple reports reveal that TikTok's AI-driven recommendation and content labeling systems failed to prevent the viral spread of political misinformation during the German Bundestag election. Fake accounts and misleading videos, amplified by TikTok's algorithm, distorted political discourse and misled millions of mostly young users in Germany.

records.title: Facebook's AI Fails to Curb Climate Misinformation
records.description: Multiple reports reveal that Facebook's AI-driven content moderation and recommendation systems are failing to effectively limit climate change misinformation. Despite new initiatives, over 99% of false climate narratives, such as those blaming wind energy for Texas power outages, remain unchecked, allowing harmful disinformation to spread widely.

records.title: AI-Driven Social Media Amplifies Election Misinformation in Germany
records.description: AI-powered content recommendation systems on platforms like Telegram have amplified the spread of election-related misinformation in Germany, undermining public trust and democratic legitimacy ahead of the Bundestag election. False claims about voting procedures and fraud are reaching broad audiences, facilitated by these AI-driven algorithms.

records.title: Australian University Seeks Retraction of Ethnically Targeted Facial Recognition Research
