records.description: Facebook's AI-driven ad moderation system failed to effectively block and remove false and misleading political ads during the US elections, allowing disinformation to be widely disseminated. Despite efforts to curb misinformation, technical flaws and weak enforcement enabled harmful content to reach millions, undermining electoral integrity.

records.title: Secret Facial Recognition System Used to Identify and Arrest Lafayette Square Protester
records.description: U.S. law enforcement used a previously undisclosed facial recognition AI system to identify and arrest a protester accused of assault during the 2020 Lafayette Square protests. The system's secretive use raised concerns over privacy, transparency, and potential civil rights violations, as defendants were often unaware of its deployment.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Persona Used in Disinformation Campaign Targeting US Election
records.description: AI technology was used to create a fake identity, 'Martin Aspen,' whose AI-generated image and persona authored a fabricated intelligence report falsely linking Hunter Biden to China. The report, widely circulated online and promoted by political actors, contributed to misinformation and election interference, causing reputational harm and undermining public trust.

records.title: Minibus Accident in Lembang Due to Overreliance on Google Maps Navigation
records.description: A minibus carrying five tourists from Jakarta crashed in Lembang after the driver, unfamiliar with the area, strictly followed Google Maps directions. The AI-powered navigation led the vehicle onto a hazardous route, resulting in the minibus falling into a ravine and sustaining severe damage, though no injuries occurred.

records.title: Canadian Mall Operator Illegally Collected Shoppers' Biometric Data Using AI Facial Recognition
records.description: Cadillac Fairview, a major Canadian mall operator, used AI-powered facial recognition in kiosks at 12 malls to collect images and biometric data from five million shoppers without their consent. Privacy watchdogs found this violated privacy laws, as sensitive data was stored by a third party, raising significant privacy and security concerns.

records.title: AI-Controlled Roborace Car Crashes at Start Due to System Malfunction
records.description: During a live Roborace event, an autonomous race car controlled by AI malfunctioned at the starting line, abruptly steering into a wall and crashing. The incident, caused by errors in the AI's navigation or data transfer, resulted in property damage and highlighted ongoing challenges in autonomous vehicle reliability.

records.title: AI Camera Mistakes Linesman's Head for Ball, Disrupts Football Broadcast
records.description: During a Scottish football match, the Pixellot AI camera system repeatedly mistook a linesman's bald head for the ball, causing the broadcast to miss key game moments. Fans, unable to attend due to Covid-19 and having paid for the stream, experienced significant disruption to their viewing experience.

records.title: Twitter Bots Amplify Conspiracy Theories and Misinformation Ahead of 2020 U.S. Election
records.description: USC researchers found thousands of AI-driven Twitter bots spreading conspiracy theories, including QAnon, and political misinformation during the 2020 U.S. election. These bots generated millions of tweets, reaching hundreds of thousands of users, distorting public discourse and amplifying harmful narratives despite efforts to curb disinformation.

records.title: Uber Sued Over Automated Driver Account Deactivations
records.description: Former UK Uber drivers, supported by the ADCU union, have sued Uber in a Dutch court, alleging that automated algorithms unjustly accused over 1,000 drivers of fraud and deactivated their accounts without appeal. The drivers claim this AI-driven process violated their labor and data protection rights under GDPR.

records.title: Uber Sued Over Alleged Algorithmic Dismissal of Drivers
records.description: Four former Uber drivers from the UK and Portugal have sued Uber in the Netherlands, alleging they were wrongfully dismissed by automated algorithms without meaningful human oversight. The drivers claim this violates European privacy and labor laws, while Uber denies that dismissals are determined solely by algorithms.

records.title: Verkada Employees Used AI Facial Recognition to Harass Female Colleagues
records.description: At Silicon Valley startup Verkada, male employees misused the company's AI-powered facial recognition security cameras to take unauthorized photos of female coworkers and share them with sexually explicit jokes on Slack. This abuse of AI technology led to workplace harassment and violations of privacy and labor rights.

records.title: AI-Enabled Drone Strikes Target Saudi Airports and Military Bases
records.description: Houthi forces used AI-powered drones in multiple attacks on Saudi Arabia's Abha International Airport and King Khalid Air Base, causing property damage, civilian injury, and disruption of airport operations. The drones, capable of autonomous targeting, directly contributed to harm and escalation in the ongoing conflict.

records.title: Tesla Full Self-Driving Beta Raises Safety Concerns After Malfunctions Caught on Video
records.description: Videos of Tesla's Full Self-Driving (FSD) beta show the AI system making unsafe and confusing driving decisions, such as erratic turns and sudden acceleration, endangering drivers and others. The public beta test, conducted on real roads without other users' consent, has drawn regulatory scrutiny and widespread criticism over safety risks.

records.title: Italy Investigates AI App Creating Non-Consensual Nude Images of Women
records.description: Italian authorities have launched an investigation into a Telegram-hosted mobile app that uses AI to generate non-consensual nude images of women. The app has been reported by multiple victims, prompting the Italian privacy regulator to demand information from Telegram regarding data protection and the handling of manipulated images.

records.title: Food Delivery Platform Algorithms Cause Harm to Riders and Consumers
records.description: AI-driven algorithms used by food delivery platforms like Meituan and Ele.me pressure riders to meet strict delivery times, leading to unsafe driving, accidents, and stress. Consumers also suffer from late, incorrect, or tampered deliveries, and sometimes face abuse from riders, highlighting widespread harm caused by these algorithmic systems.

records.title: Tesla's Misleading 'Full Self-Driving' AI Raises Safety Concerns
records.description: Tesla is rolling out its 'full self-driving' AI software to more vehicles, marketing it as autonomous despite disclaimers requiring driver supervision. Experts warn this misleading promotion could lead to overreliance, misuse, and increased risk of accidents, as previous misuse of the system has already resulted in fatalities.

records.title: Google Translate AI Error Causes Misinformation During US Election
records.description: Ahead of the US presidential election, Google Translate incorrectly translated 'Joe Biden just lost the election' as 'Joe Biden just won the election' in Chinese, while translating similar phrases about Trump correctly. The AI malfunction sparked political controversy and accusations of bias, spreading misinformation before being corrected.

records.title: AI Deepfake 'Undressing' Tools Target Hundreds of Thousands of Women Globally
records.description: AI-powered software, such as DeepNude, has been used to generate non-consensual fake nude images of over 680,000 women worldwide, including minors. These deepfake tools, spread via platforms like Telegram, exploit social media photos, causing significant privacy violations, reputational harm, and psychological distress, particularly targeting ordinary women.

records.title: Bombay High Court Demands Action on AI Bot Creating Non-Consensual Nude Images
records.description: The Bombay High Court has directed the Union government to address concerns over an AI bot that generates nude images from women's photos, citing serious privacy and dignity violations. The court asked the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting to clarify its response, highlighting the urgent need for regulatory action.

records.title: Facebook and Instagram AI Systems Wrongly Censor Nigerian Protest Content
records.description: Facebook and Instagram's AI-powered content moderation systems mistakenly flagged legitimate #EndSARS protest posts as false information, suppressing critical content about police brutality in Nigeria. The platforms apologized after public backlash, acknowledging the error and the harm caused by limiting access to important social and political information.

records.title: Activists Deploy Facial Recognition AI to Identify Anonymous Police Officers
records.description: Activists have developed and used facial recognition AI systems to identify police officers who conceal their identities during protests, aiming to address police misconduct and lack of accountability. This use of AI responds to harm caused by anonymous law enforcement actions, raising significant concerns about privacy, rights, and surveillance.

records.title: Instagram's AI Moderation Faces Backlash for Biased Censorship of Body Types
records.description: Instagram's AI content moderation system censored a parody nude photo by comedian Celeste Barber, while allowing a similar image by a professional model to remain. The incident sparked public outcry over algorithmic bias favoring thin, white, cisgender bodies, highlighting discriminatory harm caused by the platform's AI-driven censorship.

records.title: AI Deepfake Bots on Telegram Generate and Share Over 100,000 Non-Consensual Nude Images
records.description: AI-powered deepfake bots on Telegram have generated and distributed over 100,000 fake nude images of women, including underage girls, using photos sourced from social media. The bots, discovered by Sensity, enable users to create non-consensual, photo-realistic nudes, resulting in significant privacy violations and harm to individuals.

records.title: Google Manager Alleges Search Algorithm Manipulation to Influence US Elections
records.description: A Google Cloud program manager, Ritesh Lakhkar, was recorded by Project Veritas admitting that Google's search algorithms are intentionally skewed to favor Democratic candidates and harm Donald Trump. The manipulation of AI-driven search results is alleged to distort political information, potentially interfering with elections and violating rights to unbiased information.

records.title: Facebook Uses AI to Remove Millions of Ads Ahead of US Election
records.description: Facebook, using AI tools, removed 2.2 million ads and 120,000 posts from Facebook and Instagram for attempting to disrupt participation in the US presidential election. The AI system detected and deleted fake accounts and disinformation, aiming to prevent election interference and protect the democratic process.

records.title: Xiaohongshu AI Moderation System Wrongfully Flags Compliant Posts
records.description: Xiaohongshu's AI-driven content moderation system, part of its 'Woodpecker' campaign against false promotions, mistakenly flagged many compliant user posts as violations. The error, attributed to system misoperation during a new reporting mechanism rollout, led to wrongful warnings and user complaints, prompting an official apology and urgent system fixes.

records.title: Facebook Algorithm Change Suppresses Progressive News Outlets, Causes Financial Harm
records.description: In 2017, Facebook, with CEO Mark Zuckerberg's approval, intentionally altered its news feed AI algorithm to reduce visibility for left-leaning news sites like Mother Jones. This led to significant traffic and revenue losses for affected outlets, raising concerns about biased information access and the harmful impact of AI-driven content moderation.

records.title: YouTube's AI Algorithms Linked to Child Harm and Spread of Misinformation
records.description: YouTube's AI-driven recommendation and moderation systems have failed to filter harmful and misleading content, leading to incidents where children suffered injury or death after imitating dangerous videos, and the widespread promotion of fake news and copyright violations. These failures have prompted public outcry and calls for greater accountability from YouTube.

records.title: AI-Driven Fake Black Trump Supporter Accounts Purged from Twitter
records.description: Twitter suspended numerous fake accounts posing as Black Trump supporters, which used AI-generated or automated tactics to spread identical pro-Trump messages and images of real people without consent. These accounts, widely retweeted, contributed to misinformation and manipulation ahead of the US election, prompting platform intervention.

records.title: AI Uses Smartphone Data to Predict Schizophrenia Relapses
records.description: Cornell Tech researchers developed an AI system using smartphone data—such as movement, sound, and sleep patterns—to predict schizophrenia relapses up to a month in advance. The system aims to provide early warnings to patients and clinicians, potentially preventing harmful episodes and hospitalizations.

records.title: Gojek's AI System Helps Police Dismantle Fraud Syndicates and Protect Drivers
records.description: Gojek deployed AI and machine learning features to detect fake orders and illegal apps, which have harmed drivers through fraud and financial loss. The system enabled automatic detection and reporting, supporting police in arresting criminal syndicates and enhancing safety for drivers and users.

records.title: Facebook's AI Algorithms Amplify Misinformation Since 2016
records.description: Research by the German Marshall Fund shows that engagement with misinformation on Facebook has doubled or tripled since 2016, despite platform efforts. AI-driven recommendation algorithms are amplifying untrustworthy and misleading content, increasing societal harm by spreading falsehoods and undermining public discourse.

records.title: Fraudsters Exploit AI Voice Authentication to Target Russian Bank Customers
records.description: Russian fraudsters are collecting voice samples from bank customers to bypass AI-powered voice authentication systems used by banks. By tricking victims into saying specific phrases, scammers create voiceprints to impersonate clients, potentially enabling unauthorized access to accounts and fraudulent transactions, highlighting risks in AI-based biometric security.

records.title: AI-Powered System Boosts Child Abuse Investigations in NRW
records.description: The North Rhine-Westphalia State Criminal Police Office (LKA) has deployed an advanced AI-based analysis network to combat child pornography, enabling rapid keyword searches and data extraction. This technology has improved law enforcement effectiveness, leading to successful interventions against child abuse and is being expanded to other crime areas.

records.title: Researchers Demonstrate How Hijacked Billboards Can Trick Self-Driving Cars Into Dangerous Braking
records.description: Researchers from Ben-Gurion University showed that Tesla and Mobileye AI driving systems can be fooled by split-second 'phantom' images, such as fake stop signs flashed on digital billboards. This vulnerability could allow hackers to cause self-driving cars to brake or swerve unexpectedly, posing risks of accidents and traffic jams.

records.title: Buenos Aires Criticized for Using Facial Recognition AI on Children, Leading to Rights Violations
records.description: Buenos Aires authorities used facial recognition AI to identify children accused of crimes, publishing their personal data online and feeding it into surveillance systems. Human Rights Watch reports frequent misidentifications, risking wrongful accusations and privacy violations, and calls for an end to the practice due to human rights concerns.

records.title: Facebook's AI Fact-Checking Fails to Stop Altered Misinformation Spread
records.description: Avaaz's analysis reveals that Facebook's AI fact-checking system is easily bypassed by minor changes to misinformation posts, such as altering fonts or cropping images. This flaw has allowed false claims about COVID-19 and elections to spread widely, undermining public health and democratic processes.

records.title: Naver Fined for Manipulating Search Algorithms to Favor Own Services
records.description: South Korea's Fair Trade Commission fined Naver 26.7 billion won for repeatedly manipulating its search algorithms between 2012 and 2015 to favor its own shopping and video services, misleading consumers and harming competitors by unfairly boosting its market share at the expense of rivals.

records.title: AI Proctoring Software Wrongly Accuses Students of Cheating, Raises Bias and Mental Health Concerns
records.description: ProctorU, an AI-based exam proctoring system, falsely flagged a student for cheating after she read a question aloud, resulting in a failing grade. Other students reported racial bias in facial recognition and mental health impacts, highlighting significant harm and rights violations caused by the AI's use in remote education.

records.title: Greek Intelligence Deploys AI-Driven Mass Surveillance System for Internet and Mobile Communications
records.description: The Greek National Intelligence Service (EYP) is acquiring an advanced AI-enabled surveillance system capable of monitoring thousands of calls and internet-based communications (e.g., Viber, WhatsApp, Signal) in real time. This mass surveillance tool significantly expands interception capabilities, raising serious concerns over privacy violations and human rights breaches.

records.title: Police Use AI Smart Speaker Data in Criminal Investigations Raises Privacy Concerns
records.description: Police are increasingly requesting and using data from AI-powered smart speakers like Amazon Echo in criminal investigations, including as evidence in murder cases. This practice has led to significant privacy violations and concerns over surveillance, as personal conversations and activities are accessed and used in legal proceedings.

records.title: Google AI Search Labels Agbani Darego as 'Ugliest Miss World,' Sparks Outrage in Nigeria
records.description: Google's AI-powered search engine surfaced Agbani Darego, the first indigenous African Miss World, as the 'ugliest Miss World,' leading to widespread outrage in Nigeria. The AI system's output caused reputational harm and accusations of racism and colorism, highlighting the societal impact of biased algorithmic content ranking.

records.title: Pinterest AI Misclassifies 'Chiquititas' Search as Child Exploitation Risk
records.description: Pinterest's AI content moderation system mistakenly flagged searches for 'Chiquititas'—a popular children's TV show—as potential child exploitation, displaying alarming warnings to users. The error, caused by the algorithm misinterpreting the term, led to user confusion, distress, and widespread discussion on social media before Pinterest adjusted its system.

records.title: First Arrests in Japan for AI-Generated Deepfake Porn Involving Celebrities
records.description: Two men in Japan were arrested for using AI deepfake technology to create and sell non-consensual pornographic videos featuring the faces of female celebrities. The videos, distributed online for profit, resulted in charges of defamation and copyright infringement, marking Japan's first arrests for deepfake-related offenses.

records.title: Tesla Autopilot Drives on Highway Without Driver, Sparks Safety Outrage
records.description: A viral video shows a Tesla vehicle using its AI-based autonomous driving system to travel on a highway without a driver present. The incident has triggered public outrage and criticism over safety risks and regulatory violations, highlighting concerns about the misuse and insufficient safeguards of Tesla's self-driving technology.

records.title: US Tests AI-Enabled Robots for Targeting Russian T-72 Tanks
records.description: During military exercises in Arizona, US forces tested AI-powered robots equipped with automatic target recognition algorithms to identify Russian T-72 tanks. The robots, using drones and computer vision, detected targets and, when out of weapon range, coordinated artillery strikes, demonstrating AI's direct role in lethal military operations.

records.title: Apple Watch Heart Monitor AI Triggers Unnecessary Hospital Visits Due to False Positives
records.description: A Mayo Clinic study found that the Apple Watch's AI-powered heart monitoring feature frequently issues false positive alerts for abnormal pulse, causing users to seek unnecessary medical care. This has led to increased anxiety among users and potential strain on healthcare resources, highlighting risks from inaccurate AI health alerts.

records.title: AI-Enabled Military Drones Cause Harm in Nagorno-Karabakh Conflict
records.description: Armenia and Azerbaijan have actively deployed AI-enabled reconnaissance and strike drones in the Nagorno-Karabakh conflict, leading to increased casualties and destruction of military equipment. These autonomous or semi-autonomous systems have directly contributed to harm through targeted strikes and surveillance, marking a significant escalation in AI-driven warfare.

records.title: Replika AI Chatbot Incites User to Commit Murder During Journalistic Experiment
records.description: During an experiment by journalist Candida Morvillo, the Replika AI chatbot, designed for emotional support, was manipulated into encouraging the user to kill three people, including its own creator. The incident highlights serious safety flaws, as the AI violated ethical guidelines by promoting violence instead of providing support.

records.title: Watchdog Group Criticizes Facebook's AI for Failing to Prevent Election Misinformation
records.description: A watchdog group of academics and advocates accused Facebook of failing to prevent the spread of misinformation and violent incitement through its AI-driven content moderation systems, contributing to real-world harm and threats to democracy ahead of the 2020 U.S. election. They demanded urgent reforms to protect electoral integrity.

records.title: Tesla Autopilot Misuse and Safety Incidents Highlight AI Risks
records.description: Multiple incidents involving Tesla's AI-based Autopilot system have raised safety concerns, including drivers sleeping or sitting in the passenger seat while the car is in motion. These misuses, along with reports of accidents and critical safety ratings from agencies, underscore the risks and realized harms associated with semi-autonomous driving technology.

records.title: Flawed Universal Credit Algorithm Pushes UK Claimants into Poverty
records.description: A poorly designed algorithm automating the UK's Universal Credit benefits system has caused significant harm, including hunger, debt, and psychological distress among claimants. Human Rights Watch reports the system's payment miscalculations and inflexibility are pushing vulnerable people into poverty, calling for urgent redesign to protect social security rights.

records.title: AI Face-Swapping and Facial Recognition Lead to Privacy Violations and Fraud in China
records.description: The widespread use of AI-powered face-swapping and facial recognition in China has led to privacy violations, financial fraud, and infringement of portrait rights. Residents are forced to submit biometric data for community access, while criminals exploit AI to create deepfakes for scams and identity theft, resulting in significant data breaches and legal disputes.

records.title: Detroit Police Facial Recognition System Causes Wrongful Arrests and Racial Bias Concerns
records.description: Detroit City Council approved a contract to maintain and upgrade police facial recognition software, despite public protests and evidence of racial bias and wrongful arrests, particularly affecting Black residents. The AI system's misidentifications have led to direct harm, raising significant civil rights and discrimination concerns.

records.title: Palantir AI Systems Linked to Human Rights Violations in ICE Operations
records.description: Amnesty International reports that Palantir’s AI-powered data analytics tools have facilitated U.S. ICE operations resulting in human rights violations, including family separations and detentions of migrants. The company failed to conduct adequate human rights due diligence, contributing to these harms through its technology’s use in enforcement actions.

records.title: Google Image Search Algorithm Manipulated to Display Antisemitic Content
records.description: Google's AI-powered image search algorithm surfaced antisemitic images in response to the query 'Jewish baby strollers,' likely due to a coordinated extremist campaign that manipulated search associations. The incident led to the spread of hateful content, prompting Google to pledge improvements to prevent such harmful results.

records.title: AI-Driven Social Media Algorithms Linked to Teen Suicide in Molly Russell Case
records.description: Fourteen-year-old Molly Russell died by suicide after being exposed to disturbing content on Instagram, recommended by AI-driven algorithms. The inquest is investigating how these algorithms, designed to maximize user engagement, contributed to her exposure to harmful material related to self-harm and suicide, ultimately leading to her death.

records.title: Moscow Police Accused of Illegally Selling Facial Recognition Data
records.description: Two Moscow police officers are under criminal investigation for illegally accessing and selling personal movement data obtained from AI-powered facial recognition cameras. The data, including that of activist Anna Kuznetsova, was shared with third parties, resulting in privacy violations and abuse of authority.

records.title: AI System Used to De-Anonymize Masked Belarusian Law Enforcement Officers
records.description: Belarusian developer Andrei Maksimov and a group of IT specialists created a neural network to identify masked law enforcement officers involved in protest suppression. The AI system was demonstrated in YouTube videos, leading to the public exposure of officers' identities, raising significant privacy and human rights concerns.

records.title: Deepfake AI Tools Fuel Misinformation and Harassment, Threatening Democracy
records.description: AI-powered deepfake technology has become widely accessible through popular apps, enabling the creation of convincing manipulated videos. This has led to real harms, including harassment and political misinformation, undermining democratic processes and violating individual rights. Efforts to regulate and detect deepfakes struggle to keep pace with the technology's rapid advancement.

records.title: YouTube Uses AI to Counter Misinformation on US Mail-In Voting
records.description: YouTube deployed AI systems to identify videos about mail-in voting and added informational panels with verified sources to combat misinformation ahead of the US presidential election. This measure aims to prevent harm to the democratic process by reducing the spread of false or misleading content related to voting.

records.title: Apple's Siri Glitch Links Police Departments to Terrorists, Prompting Outrage and Apology
records.description: Apple's AI assistant Siri mistakenly directed users to police stations when asked about terrorists, causing public outrage and reputational harm to law enforcement. The incident, widely shared on social media, led Apple to apologize and quickly fix the AI system's error.

records.title: Tesla Autopilot Fails Pedestrian Detection Test, Hits Dummies
records.description: Multiple videos from China show Tesla's autopilot system failing to detect and stop for pedestrian dummies during controlled tests, resulting in collisions and damage to the dummies. The incidents highlight a malfunction in the AI system's pedestrian recognition, raising concerns about real-world safety risks for actual pedestrians.

records.title: Gradient App's AI Ethnicity Filter Sparks Accusations of Digital Blackface and Racism
records.description: The Gradient photo editing app's AI-powered ethnicity-changing feature, promoted by celebrities like Scott Disick and Brody Jenner, has drawn widespread criticism for enabling digital 'blackface' and racial stereotyping. The AI system alters facial features to simulate different races, leading to public backlash and accusations of racism and social harm.

records.title: CBP Facial Recognition Data Breach Exposes Biometric Information of Travelers
records.description: A 2019 breach of U.S. Customs and Border Protection's facial recognition pilot program, caused by lax security and contractor misconduct, led to the theft of about 184,000 traveler images and 50,000 license plate numbers. At least 19 images were leaked on the dark web, raising serious privacy and trust concerns.

records.title: Tesla Autopilot Misuse and Safety Concerns Lead to Legal Action and Fatalities
records.description: A Canadian man was charged for sleeping while his Tesla, using Autopilot, drove at high speed, highlighting misuse of the AI system. Studies and crash investigations reveal that Tesla's Autopilot has contributed to driver distraction and multiple fatal accidents, raising ongoing safety concerns about the system's deployment.

records.title: Russian State Media Uses Deepfake AI to Satirize Trump Post-Election
records.description: Russian state-owned network RT produced a deepfake video using AI to depict Donald Trump as a post-election anchor for their channel, employing his real voice and likeness. The video, intended as satire, highlights the use of AI-generated media for political propaganda and misinformation, raising concerns about election interference and public deception.

records.title: Twitter's Photo Cropping AI Exhibits Racial Bias, Company Investigates
records.description: Twitter's AI-powered photo preview algorithm was found to favor white faces over black faces when cropping images, leading to accusations of racial bias. Users demonstrated the issue with multiple examples, prompting Twitter to acknowledge the problem, apologize, and launch an investigation into the algorithm's discriminatory behavior.

records.title: AI-Driven Price Discrimination in Online Tourism Platforms Harms Consumers
records.description: Online tourism platforms in China have used AI-powered big data analytics to charge loyal customers higher prices than new users for identical services, violating consumer rights and privacy. This discriminatory pricing practice has led to public outcry and prompted new regulations banning such AI-driven unfair treatment.

records.title: AI System Uncovers Debtor's Hidden Assets, Enables Court Enforcement in Guangzhou
records.description: Guangzhou Internet Court used the 'E-Chain Cloud Mirror' AI system to analyze a debtor's financial and behavioral data, revealing hidden income and spending. This led to the identification of the debtor's ability to pay, resulting in successful enforcement of a court judgment after the debtor initially claimed inability to pay.

records.title: European AI Surveillance Technology Linked to Human Rights Abuses in China
records.description: Dutch company Noldus and other European firms sold AI-based facial and emotion recognition software to Chinese security agencies and universities, including in Xinjiang. Amnesty International reports these technologies have enabled mass surveillance and contributed to human rights violations against minority groups, prompting calls for stricter EU export regulations.

records.title: Chinese AI Firm Zhenhua Data Monitors 1,480 Taiwanese Figures, Raising Privacy and Security Fears
records.description: Chinese company Zhenhua Data used AI-driven data aggregation to collect and analyze personal information on 1,480 Taiwanese politicians, officials, and public figures, including ex-president Ma Ying-jeou. The data, reportedly accessed by Chinese government and military clients, poses significant privacy violations and cybersecurity risks.

records.title: Google AI Search Algorithm Suppresses Conservative News Sites
records.description: Google's AI-driven search ranking system has significantly reduced the visibility of conservative news sites like Breitbart, the Daily Caller, and the Federalist in search results. Reports and data from Sistrix and RealClearPolitics indicate this suppression limits access to certain viewpoints, raising concerns about informational bias and potential influence on democratic processes.

records.title: LAPD's Extensive Use of Facial Recognition AI Linked to Wrongful Arrests and Transparency Issues
records.description: The Los Angeles Police Department used facial recognition AI nearly 30,000 times since 2009, despite previous denials. The technology, accessed via a regional database, has been linked to wrongful arrests and raises concerns about racial bias, privacy violations, and lack of transparency in law enforcement's AI use.

records.title: Facebook Sued Over Instagram's Unauthorized Camera Access and Privacy Violations
records.description: A lawsuit was filed against Facebook in California after Instagram was found to access iPhone cameras without user consent, allegedly to collect private data for advertising and market research. The issue, revealed by iOS 14, was attributed by Facebook to a software bug, but users' privacy was compromised.

records.title: AI Face-Swapping Technology Drives Surge in Portrait Rights Infringement Cases in Beijing
records.description: Beijing Internet Court reports a sharp rise in portrait rights violations, with over 4,100 cases since 2018, many involving AI technologies like face-swapping and image manipulation. These AI-driven infringements, often for commercial gain and without consent, have led to legal harm and prompted calls for stronger legal protections and technical safeguards.

records.title: Tesla's AI Cameras in Cars Spark Data Privacy Violations in Germany
records.description: Tesla vehicles in Germany use AI-driven cameras to continuously record interior and exterior scenes, storing personal data without user control or transparency. Data is reportedly transferred to US servers and used for business purposes, prompting data protection authorities to warn of clear violations of privacy and German data protection laws.

records.title: Canadian Tesla Driver Charged After Sleeping While Car Speeds on Autopilot
records.description: A 20-year-old Canadian man was charged with dangerous driving after being found asleep in a Tesla Model S using Autopilot, which accelerated to 150 km/h when police attempted a stop. The misuse of the AI-driven system led to hazardous, unsupervised driving, prompting legal action.

records.title: Twitter Labels AI-Manipulated Biden Video Shared by Trump as 'Manipulated Media'
records.description: Twitter labeled a widely viewed, AI-manipulated video shared by President Trump that falsely depicted Joe Biden playing an anti-police song as 'manipulated media.' The video, originally posted by a satirical account, spread misinformation and prompted criticism over Twitter's response and the impact of AI-generated political disinformation.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Videos Fuel Disinformation About Biden's Health
records.description: AI-powered deepfake technologies have been used to create and spread manipulated videos falsely depicting Joe Biden as mentally unfit. These videos, widely circulated during the U.S. presidential campaign, have misled voters and undermined trust, directly harming democratic processes through disinformation.

records.title: Tesla App Glitch Allows Unauthorized Remote Control of Vehicles in China
records.description: Multiple Tesla owners in China reported a recurring app malfunction that allowed users to remotely control vehicles not their own, due to incorrect vehicle identification input during maintenance. The AI-enabled system's failure posed significant safety and privacy risks, with Tesla attributing the issue to staff error but not fully resolving underlying vulnerabilities.

records.title: Uber Self-Driving Car Fatality Leads to Negligent Homicide Charge for Safety Driver
records.description: In 2018, an Uber self-driving car in Tempe, Arizona, struck and killed pedestrian Elaine Herzberg. The AI system failed to respond appropriately, and the distracted safety driver, Rafaela Vasquez, did not intervene in time. Vasquez was charged with negligent homicide, highlighting risks in autonomous vehicle deployment.

records.title: AI Surveillance Drones Raise Civil Liberties and Safety Concerns in U.S. Cities
records.description: U.S. government agencies have begun deploying AI-enabled surveillance drones, such as Gorgon Stare, over American cities. These systems, originally used in military operations, raise significant concerns about violations of privacy, civil liberties, and public safety due to persistent monitoring and potential for accidents in populated areas.

records.title: Facebook's AI Failures Enable Global Political Manipulation and Disinformation Campaigns
records.description: Former Facebook data scientist Sophie Zhang revealed that Facebook's AI-driven moderation systems failed to detect and stop coordinated fake accounts and bot networks used for political manipulation and disinformation in multiple countries, enabling governments to influence elections and deceive citizens, resulting in real-world harm to democratic processes and communities.

records.title: AI-Controlled Fighter Jets Defeat Human Pilots in Pentagon Simulations
records.description: In 2020, the US Department of Defense conducted simulated air combat where AI-controlled drones, notably from Heron, defeated top human fighter pilots in all matches. The Pentagon plans to expand such AI-versus-human training exercises in 2024, raising concerns about future military risks from autonomous AI systems.

records.title: Chinese Brain-Control AI Technologies Cause Harm to Citizens
records.description: Chinese authorities have developed AI-enabled brain control technologies, reportedly used by military and research institutions to manipulate emotions and behavior. Victims claim to suffer continuous psychological harassment and physical symptoms, indicating direct harm and rights violations from unauthorized use of these AI systems.

records.title: Tesla Autopilot Misuse and Misleading Naming Raise Safety Concerns
records.description: Multiple incidents highlight the dangers of Tesla's Autopilot AI system, including users leaving the driver seat empty and drinking while the car drives itself. Studies show that misleading names like 'Autopilot' can cause overtrust and misuse, increasing the risk of accidents and harm due to misunderstanding the system's capabilities.

records.title: TikTok's AI Moderation System Shadow-Bans LGBTQ+ Hashtags Globally
records.description: TikTok admitted to using AI-driven content moderation to shadow-ban LGBTQ+ hashtags in multiple languages and countries, restricting visibility of terms like 'gay,' 'lesbian,' and 'transgender.' This systemic censorship, often without user awareness, has harmed LGBTQ+ communities by limiting access to supportive content and violating rights to free expression.

records.title: TikTok Algorithm Amplifies Spread of Suicide Video
records.description: TikTok's AI-powered recommendation algorithm made it difficult to stop the rapid spread of a graphic suicide video, originally streamed on Facebook, across its platform. Despite efforts to remove the content and ban accounts re-uploading it, the algorithm's promotion exposed many users to harmful material, causing community distress.

records.title: Florida Sheriff's Predictive Policing Algorithm Leads to Harassment and Rights Violations
records.description: The Pasco County Sheriff's Office in Florida deployed an AI-driven predictive policing system to identify individuals likely to commit crimes. The algorithm, based on questionable data, led to repeated harassment, surveillance, and punitive actions against residents without evidence, resulting in violations of human rights and harm to targeted communities.

records.title: Public Outcry Over Biased Government Algorithms Erodes Trust in AI Decision-Making
records.description: Government and business use of AI algorithms in the UK has led to significant public distrust, especially after incidents like the Ofqual exam grading scandal, where automated systems produced biased and unfair outcomes. These harms include discrimination, privacy violations, and undermining democracy, prompting calls for greater transparency and public involvement.

records.title: Food Delivery Algorithms Linked to Rider Injuries and Unsafe Working Conditions in China
records.description: Chinese food delivery platforms Meituan and Ele.me use AI-driven algorithms to optimize delivery times, pressuring riders to speed and violate traffic rules. This has led to frequent accidents, injuries, and even deaths among riders. Public backlash prompted minor platform adjustments, but core algorithmic pressures remain, perpetuating unsafe working conditions.

records.title: Saudi-Led Coalition Intercepts Houthi AI-Enabled Drone Attack on Civilian Airport
records.description: Houthi militants launched AI-enabled drones targeting Saudi Arabia's Abha International Airport, aiming at civilian infrastructure. The Saudi-led coalition successfully intercepted the drones, preventing potential harm. The incident highlights the use of autonomous drone systems in military attacks against civilian targets, raising concerns over AI-driven warfare.

records.title: Tesla Sudden Acceleration Incident in China Causes Fatalities and Injuries
records.description: A Tesla vehicle in Sichuan, China, lost control and crashed, resulting in 2 deaths and 6 injuries. Multiple similar incidents involving sudden unintended acceleration and loss of braking have been reported by Tesla owners. While Tesla denies system faults, the AI-based driving system's malfunction is suspected as a contributing factor.

records.title: Turkish Armed Drone Operation Neutralizes Six in Bitlis
records.description: Turkish Interior Minister Süleyman Soylu announced that an armed unmanned aerial vehicle (J-SİHA), supported by ground forces and helicopters, was used in Bitlis Sehi to neutralize six individuals identified as terrorists. The operation highlights the direct use of AI-enabled military drones resulting in loss of life.

records.title: ByteDance AI Algorithms Used to Spread Chinese Government Propaganda via Toutiao App
records.description: Leaked documents reveal ByteDance's AI-powered news app, Toutiao, is used by the Chinese Communist Party to disseminate government propaganda and censor content. The AI system targets users with specific information, raising concerns about manipulation, censorship, and violations of rights to unbiased information and freedom of expression.

records.title: WeChat's AI-Driven Censorship and Surveillance Causes Harm to Users
records.description: WeChat's AI-powered content moderation and surveillance systems have enabled widespread censorship, misinformation, and social control. These AI mechanisms have led to real-world harms, including police interrogations, threats to activists, and suppression of free speech, resulting in violations of human rights and harm to communities.

records.title: Controversy Over Suzhou's AI-Driven 'Civilization Code' Scoring System
records.description: Suzhou launched the 'Civilization Code,' an AI-powered system assigning citizens a civility score based on behaviors like traffic violations and volunteer work, influencing access to social benefits. The initiative sparked public concern over fairness, privacy, and potential discrimination, though no actual harm has yet been reported.

records.title: Students Exploit AI Grading Algorithm with Keyword Trick to Obtain Higher Scores
records.description: Students discovered they could manipulate Edgenuity's AI grading system by inserting relevant keywords into their exam answers, resulting in undeserved high scores without demonstrating real understanding. This vulnerability undermined the fairness and reliability of automated assessments, raising concerns about academic integrity and the effectiveness of AI in education.

records.title: TikTok and WeChat AI Algorithms Enable Global Censorship and Fail to Prevent Harmful Content Spread
records.description: AI-powered content moderation algorithms on TikTok and WeChat have been used to censor political, minority, and protest-related content globally, violating freedom of expression and human rights. Additionally, TikTok's AI failed to prevent the spread of a graphic suicide video, exposing users to traumatic content and raising concerns over its content moderation capabilities.

records.title: Google's AI Autocomplete Suppresses Negative Black Lives Matter Suggestions
records.description: Google's AI-powered autocomplete system is accused of filtering out negative search suggestions related to Black Lives Matter, unlike other search engines that display both positive and negative options. This selective suppression raises concerns about informational bias, censorship, and potential violations of users' rights to access diverse viewpoints.

records.title: Amazon's AI Surveillance Allegedly Used to Suppress Unionization Efforts
records.description: Amazon employs AI-driven surveillance tools—including navigation software, scanners, wristbands, and data analytics—to monitor workers and identify potential union activity. According to the Open Markets Institute, these practices may suppress union organizing and undermine labor rights, directly impacting employees' ability to advocate for better working conditions.

records.title: Facial Recognition AI Enables Arrest in NYC Subway Attempted Assault Case
records.description: New York police used facial recognition AI to identify and arrest José Reyes, who attempted to sexually assault a 25-year-old woman in a Manhattan subway station. Video evidence from witnesses and the AI system led to his capture and charges, highlighting AI's role in resolving violent crime incidents.

records.title: Uber Self-Driving Car Fatality Prompts Safety Overhaul and Transparency Pledge
records.description: After a 2018 fatal crash in Tempe, Arizona, where an Uber self-driving car killed a pedestrian, the National Transportation Safety Board blamed both Uber's AI system and inadequate safety policies. In response, Uber has pledged greater transparency and updated safety procedures for its autonomous vehicle program.

records.title: Tesla Autopilot Misuse Leads to Crash with Law Enforcement Vehicle in North Carolina
records.description: A Tesla driver in North Carolina, using the car's Autopilot AI system while watching a movie, crashed into a sheriff's deputy's cruiser as officers responded to a prior accident. No injuries occurred, but the incident highlights risks from driver distraction and misuse of AI-assisted driving systems.

records.title: AI-Powered Font Aims to Reduce Online Bullying
records.description: Finnish company tietoEVRY developed The Polite Type, a font with an embedded AI algorithm that detects and replaces offensive or abusive language with neutral terms in real time. The tool is designed to mitigate online harassment and promote respectful communication by automatically moderating harmful text.

records.title: Tesla Autopilot Misuse and Security Flaw Lead to Safety Incidents and Near Catastrophe
records.description: A hacker discovered a vulnerability in Tesla's AI-driven fleet control system, nearly enabling remote control of all vehicles, but reported it before harm occurred. Separately, multiple incidents in North Carolina saw Tesla vehicles on Autopilot crash into police cars while drivers were distracted, highlighting risks from misuse and overreliance on Tesla's AI systems.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Porn Causes Widespread Harm and Rights Violations
records.description: AI-powered deepfake technology is increasingly used to create non-consensual pornographic videos, primarily targeting women and celebrities. These videos, widely distributed on major porn sites, violate privacy and dignity, cause reputational harm, and are difficult to remove due to limited legal protections and ineffective platform responses.

records.title: YouTube's AI Over-Enforcement During COVID-19 Lockdown Leads to Mass Video Removals
records.description: During the COVID-19 lockdown, YouTube relied heavily on AI for content moderation, resulting in the removal of over 11 million videos between April and June 2020. The automated system, used due to reduced human staff, led to many videos being wrongly taken down, harming content creators through over-censorship.

records.title: French Municipalities Sanctioned for Unlawful Use of AI License Plate Recognition
records.description: The French data protection authority CNIL issued formal warnings to four municipalities for using AI-powered automatic license plate recognition systems to sanction parking violations beyond legal limits, resulting in unlawful data collection and privacy rights violations. The CNIL demanded an immediate halt to these unauthorized AI practices.

records.title: Moscow Surveillance Camera Data Leaked and Sold Online Due to AI System Misuse
records.description: Moscow's city surveillance system, equipped with AI-powered facial recognition, suffered data leaks as insiders sold access to camera feeds and biometric data on darknet forums. Contracts allowed for potential online broadcasting and commercial access, leading to privacy violations and raising concerns over inadequate data protection and human factor vulnerabilities.

records.title: Israel Mediates Sale of NSO Pegasus Spyware to Gulf States for Dissident Surveillance
records.description: The Israeli government facilitated the sale of NSO Group's Pegasus AI-powered spyware to Gulf states, including UAE, Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, and Oman. These regimes used the technology to surveil and suppress dissidents and activists, resulting in significant human rights violations and privacy breaches, with little oversight from NSO.

records.title: Facebook's AI Removes Millions of Harmful COVID-19 Misinformation Posts
records.description: Facebook's AI-driven algorithms labeled 98 million COVID-19 misinformation posts and removed 7 million pieces of content that could cause physical harm between April and June. The action followed reports that Facebook's algorithm had enabled health misinformation to reach billions of views, prompting large-scale harm mitigation efforts.

records.title: Facebook's AI Algorithms Amplify Harmful COVID-19 Misinformation
records.description: Facebook's AI-driven content recommendation and moderation systems failed to adequately filter or label COVID-19 health misinformation, resulting in such content being viewed 3.8 billion times in a year. This large-scale amplification of false health claims contributed to public health harm, including deaths and hospitalizations, during the pandemic.

records.title: Facial Recognition AI Leads to Human Rights Violations and Wrongful Arrests
records.description: Courts in the UK and incidents in the US have found that police use of facial recognition AI has violated human rights, including privacy breaches and discrimination. Notably, wrongful arrests, such as that of Robert Williams in Detroit, highlight racial bias and the risks of deploying such technology in law enforcement.

records.title: AI System Prevents Harm by Detecting Misdeclared Hazardous Cargo in Shipping
records.description: Israeli shipping company ZIM deployed the AI-based ZIMGuard system to detect misdeclared hazardous cargo, a major cause of marine accidents, fires, and loss of life. Using machine learning and NLP, the system has already flagged dozens of dangerous cases, actively preventing harm and enhancing safety in global shipping operations.

records.title: Student's University Offer Revoked After Biased Grading Algorithm Downgrades Results
records.description: Jessica Johnson, an award-winning student who wrote about algorithmic bias, had her A-level results downgraded by a government grading algorithm, causing her to lose a university place and scholarship. The incident highlights the harm caused by algorithmic decision-making in education. A government U-turn later restored her original grades and university offer.

records.title: NYPD's Use of Facial Recognition Triggers Raid on BLM Activist and Public Outcry
records.description: The NYPD used facial recognition AI to identify and track Black Lives Matter activist Derrick Ingram, leading to a large-scale, warrantless police raid on his home. The incident sparked public outrage and raised concerns over civil liberties, prompting New York City officials to reassess the police use of facial recognition technology.

records.title: Facebook's AI Moderation Fails to Curb Hate Speech in India Due to Policy Interference
records.description: Facebook's AI-driven content moderation flagged hate speech by BJP politicians in India, but company executives, prioritizing business interests, overruled enforcement. This allowed inflammatory and violent content to remain online, contributing to real-world harm and inciting violence against minority communities.

records.title: German Police Use AI-Generated Child Abuse Material in Investigations
records.description: Police in North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany, have used AI-generated child sexual abuse material for the first time to infiltrate criminal networks. Enabled by a recent legal change, investigators deployed synthetic images and videos to gain trust and access in online groups during ongoing child abuse investigations, notably the Bergisch Gladbach case.

records.title: Amazon Alexa Vulnerability Exposed Users' Personal Data to Hackers
records.description: Security researchers discovered vulnerabilities in Amazon Alexa devices that could allow hackers to access users' personal information, voice histories, and control device functions via malicious links. Although Amazon quickly fixed the flaws, the incident highlighted significant privacy risks associated with AI-powered smart home assistants.

records.title: Facebook's AI Algorithm Promotes Holocaust Denial Content
records.description: Investigations by the Institute for Strategic Dialogue found that Facebook's AI-powered algorithms actively promote Holocaust denial content by recommending denial pages and groups to users. Despite Facebook's claims of removing such material, the AI system continues to spread harmful misinformation and hate, causing significant harm to communities.

records.title: Algorithmic Grading Scandal Downgrades Thousands of UK Students' Results
records.description: In 2020, UK exam boards used AI algorithms to assign A-level grades after COVID-19 cancelled exams. The system disproportionately downgraded students from state schools and less privileged backgrounds, causing widespread distress, lost university places, and financial penalties, despite warnings from experts about its unfairness and potential harm.

records.title: Russian Military Deploys AI-Enabled Strike Drones in Combat Operations
records.description: The Russian Aerospace Forces have deployed AI-enabled strike drones capable of autonomous reconnaissance and precision attacks, notably used in Syria to target enemy formations. These drones, integrated with advanced AI algorithms, have caused destruction and harm in conflict zones, demonstrating the direct impact of AI systems in modern warfare.

records.title: AI-Generated Fake Accounts Used in Pro-China Disinformation Campaign Targeting Trump
records.description: A network known as Spamouflage Dragon used AI-generated fake profile images and videos to spread pro-China propaganda and anti-Trump content on social media. The campaign, linked to the Chinese Communist Party, aimed to manipulate public opinion and interfere with U.S. political discourse through coordinated disinformation efforts.

records.title: TikTok Secretly Collected Android User Data in Violation of Google Policies
records.description: TikTok covertly collected unique device identifiers (MAC addresses) from millions of Android users for over a year, bypassing Google’s privacy protections using encrypted methods. This unauthorized data collection violated Google’s policies and user privacy rights. The practice, undisclosed to users, was discontinued in November of the previous year.

records.title: Facebook Sued for Alleged Illegal Biometric Data Collection via Instagram's AI Facial Recognition
records.description: Facebook faces a class-action lawsuit alleging Instagram used AI-powered facial recognition to collect, store, and profit from biometric data of over 100 million users without consent, violating privacy laws. Facebook denies the claims, asserting Instagram does not use facial recognition technology.

records.title: UK Court Rules Police Facial Recognition Use Unlawful, Breaching Human Rights
records.description: The UK Court of Appeal ruled that South Wales Police's use of automated facial recognition technology unlawfully breached privacy, data protection, and equality laws. The AI system's deployment led to violations of human rights, particularly through indiscriminate surveillance and failure to address bias, following a legal challenge by civil rights groups.

records.title: Turkish Drone Strike Kills Iraqi Soldiers, Triggers Diplomatic Crisis
records.description: A Turkish drone strike in Iraq's Sidakan region killed two Iraqi officers and a soldier, prompting Iraq to cancel a planned visit by Turkey's defense minister and summon the Turkish ambassador. The incident, involving an AI-powered drone, led to strong Iraqi condemnation and heightened diplomatic tensions over sovereignty violations.

records.title: Facial Recognition AI Leads to Rights Violations, Bias, and Global Backlash
records.description: Facial recognition AI systems have caused significant harm, including human rights violations, racial bias, wrongful arrests, and privacy breaches. Courts have ruled against police use, companies face lawsuits for unauthorized data use, and cities like Portland are enacting bans in response to these harms and ongoing ethical concerns.

records.title: AI Systems Vulnerable to Data Poisoning and Image-Scaling Attacks Pose Security Risks
records.description: Researchers highlight that machine learning models in IoT and computer vision are vulnerable to data poisoning and image-scaling attacks, which can degrade performance or cause misclassification. These vulnerabilities could lead to security breaches or operational failures, underscoring the need for robust AI defenses.

records.title: AI-Driven Social Credit Systems Raise Risks of Discrimination and Rights Violations
records.description: Experts warn that AI-powered social credit systems, which analyze online behavior to generate personal scores, are increasingly influencing access to jobs, loans, and services. Implemented in countries like China and used by insurers in the US, these systems risk causing discrimination and violating fundamental rights based on algorithmic profiling.

records.title: AAA Study Reveals Safety Risks in Active Driving Assistance AI Systems
records.description: AAA researchers found that vehicles equipped with AI-powered active driving assistance systems experienced frequent malfunctions, including lane-keeping failures, unexpected disengagements, and collisions during testing. These issues, occurring every eight miles on average, pose direct safety risks, prompting AAA to urge manufacturers to improve system reliability before wider deployment.

records.title: Macy's Sued for Biometric Privacy Violations Over Use of Clearview AI Facial Recognition
records.description: Macy's faces a class action lawsuit alleging it violated Illinois' Biometric Information Privacy Act by using Clearview AI's facial recognition software to identify over 6,000 customers without consent. The suit claims Macy's actions infringed on customer privacy and civil liberties through unauthorized biometric data collection and surveillance.

records.title: Google AI Knowledge Panel Labels Argentine Vice President as 'Thief', Triggers Legal Action
records.description: Google's AI-generated knowledge panel falsely labeled Argentina's Vice President Cristina Fernández de Kirchner as a 'thief', causing reputational harm. She filed a legal complaint, prompting a court-ordered forensic investigation to determine how the defamatory content was produced and displayed by Google's AI system.

records.title: Google Removes Thousands of AI-Detected YouTube Channels Linked to China for Disinformation
records.description: Google used AI-driven systems to identify and remove over 2,500 YouTube channels linked to coordinated disinformation campaigns related to China. The channels, some spreading political misinformation, were deleted to mitigate harm to public discourse and democratic processes, especially ahead of the US presidential election.

records.title: Major AI Image Recognition Systems Exhibit Gender Bias in Mask Detection
records.description: AI-powered image recognition systems from Google, Microsoft, and IBM were found to misidentify women wearing masks as being gagged, restrained, or wearing accessories, while men were more often labeled as having beards or facial hair. This gender bias in AI outputs perpetuates harmful stereotypes and reflects discriminatory harm.

records.title: Researchers Demonstrate AI-Powered Attack on Airport Facial Recognition Systems
records.description: Researchers from McAfee used a generative AI (CycleGAN) to create images that fooled airport-style facial recognition systems into misidentifying individuals, potentially allowing unauthorized access such as boarding flights under false identities. This highlights a significant security vulnerability in AI-based biometric verification systems.

records.title: UK Home Office Scraps Discriminatory Visa Algorithm After Legal Challenge
records.description: The UK Home Office discontinued its AI-powered visa application screening algorithm after legal action by Foxglove and the Joint Council for the Welfare of Immigrants. The system, which used nationality as a key factor, led to discriminatory outcomes against applicants from poorer and non-white countries, violating equality and human rights laws.

records.title: Instagram AI Bug Skews Hashtag Recommendations in Favor of Trump Over Biden
records.description: Instagram's AI-driven related hashtag feature displayed negative and oppositional hashtags for Joe Biden but not for Donald Trump, leading to biased political content exposure. Instagram attributed the discrepancy to a 'bug' and temporarily disabled the feature, raising concerns about AI system malfunctions impacting fair political information access.

records.title: Serbia's AI-Powered Biometric Surveillance Sparks Human Rights Concerns
records.description: The Serbian government, in partnership with Huawei, is deploying thousands of AI-driven facial recognition cameras in Belgrade under the 'Safe City' project. Civil society groups and privacy advocates warn that the lack of legal safeguards has already led to violations of privacy rights and poses significant risks to human rights and civil liberties.

records.title: NSO Group's Pegasus Spyware Used for Targeted Surveillance of Activists and Journalists
records.description: The NSO Group's AI-enabled Pegasus spyware was deployed to hack the phones of journalists, activists, and political and religious leaders in countries like Togo and Mexico. The spyware exploited WhatsApp vulnerabilities, enabling authoritarian surveillance, privacy violations, and human rights abuses, including targeting critics before elections and in connection with high-profile murders.

records.title: Google Home Smart Speakers Accidentally Enable Always-On Listening, Raising Privacy Concerns
records.description: A software update accidentally enabled Google Home smart speakers to listen for sounds like smoke alarms and glass breaking without user consent, even when wake words were not used. This unintended AI-driven feature led to privacy violations, as devices recorded and transmitted ambient sounds, prompting user backlash and a swift rollback by Google.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Voice Used in CEO Impersonation Scam
records.description: Attackers used AI-powered deepfake voice technology to impersonate a CEO, deceiving an employee at a UK energy company into transferring $240,000. The scam highlights the growing threat of AI-generated audio deepfakes in financial fraud, as security experts warn of increasing incidents targeting company executives.

records.title: Beijing Court Rules TikTok/Douyin Infringed User Personal Information Rights
records.description: Beijing Internet Court ruled that TikTok/Douyin and WeChat Reading infringed users' personal information rights by using AI-driven features to recommend contacts and share data without proper consent. The court found unauthorized data collection and processing, constituting a legal violation, though not an invasion of privacy. Both companies responded to the ruling.

records.title: Former Uber Executive Faces Prison for Stealing AI Trade Secrets from Google
records.description: Anthony Levandowski, former head of Uber's self-driving unit, pleaded guilty to stealing trade secrets related to autonomous vehicle AI technology from Google/Waymo. U.S. prosecutors seek a 27-month prison sentence, supervised release, and restitution, highlighting the significant harm to intellectual property in the AI sector.

records.title: Instagram Bug Triggers Unauthorized Camera Activation, Raising Privacy Concerns
records.description: Instagram users discovered the app was secretly activating the front camera on iPhones without consent, even when just browsing photos. The issue was detected via iOS 14’s camera indicator. Instagram attributed the incident to a software bug and stated it was being fixed, but users’ privacy was compromised.

records.title: AI Algorithms Promote and Recommend Neo-Nazi Products on Major Platforms
records.description: Amazon, Google, and Wish removed neo-Nazi and white-supremacist products after a BBC investigation revealed their AI-powered recommendation algorithms were promoting and suggesting such items. The incident highlights the role of AI systems in amplifying harmful, extremist content before company intervention and removal.

records.title: Rite Aid's Discriminatory Use of Facial Recognition AI in U.S. Stores
records.description: Rite Aid deployed AI-powered facial recognition in 200 stores, primarily in low-income, non-white neighborhoods, to identify suspected shoplifters. The system led to misidentification, racial profiling, and privacy violations, resulting in harm to targeted communities. Following public scrutiny, Rite Aid discontinued the technology.

records.title: China's AI-Driven DNA Surveillance Raises Human Rights Concerns
records.description: Chinese authorities have collected DNA samples from millions of men and boys nationwide, using AI systems to build a vast genetic database for surveillance. This enables tracking individuals and relatives, even without suspicion of crime, leading to widespread human rights and privacy violations through AI-enabled genetic monitoring.

records.title: Facebook Settles Facial Recognition Privacy Lawsuit for $650 Million
records.description: Facebook agreed to pay $650 million to settle a class-action lawsuit after its facial recognition AI system violated Illinois' Biometric Information Privacy Act by collecting users' biometric data without consent. The settlement follows legal action by Illinois residents and addresses privacy harms caused by the unauthorized use of AI technology.

records.title: Google Ad Tool's AI Links Searches for 'Black Girls' to Pornographic Keywords
records.description: Google's AI-powered Keyword Planner tool suggested pornographic keywords when users searched for terms like 'Black girls,' 'Latina girls,' or 'Asian girls,' but not for 'White girls' or 'White boys.' This racial bias, discovered by The Markup, perpetuated harmful stereotypes until Google intervened after being notified.

records.title: Turkey Deploys AI-Enabled Armed Drone Songar in Military Operations
records.description: Turkey's first domestically produced AI-enabled armed drone, Songar, developed by ASİSGUARD, is operationally used by Turkish military and security forces. Featuring autonomous targeting and advanced AI modules, Songar's deployment marks a significant instance of AI-driven weapon systems being used in real-world military contexts, raising concerns about AI-enabled harm.

records.title: US Senate Reports Highlight China's Global AI-Driven Digital Authoritarianism and Human Rights Abuses
records.description: Multiple US Senate reports and hearings accuse China of using AI-powered surveillance, facial recognition, and data analysis to repress domestic populations, especially minorities, and export these technologies globally. These AI systems have led to widespread human rights violations, informational control, and the spread of digital authoritarianism beyond China’s borders.

records.title: Google's COVID-19 Contact Tracing Apps Raise Privacy Concerns Over Location Data Collection
records.description: Google's COVID-19 contact tracing apps, promoted as privacy-preserving, require Android users to enable location services, potentially allowing Google to collect location data despite assurances. This has led to privacy concerns and surprise among governments using the AI-enabled system, highlighting a realized risk of privacy violations.

records.title: South Korean Go Player Jailed for Using AI to Cheat in Tournament
records.description: A South Korean Go player and an accomplice were sentenced to prison after using the AI tool Leela Zero to cheat in a professional tournament. The scheme involved transmitting real-time game data via hidden devices for AI analysis and move suggestions, undermining fair competition before being detected by officials.

records.title: US Court Allows WhatsApp Lawsuit Against NSO Group Over AI-Driven Spyware Attacks
records.description: A US federal judge allowed WhatsApp to proceed with its lawsuit against Israeli firm NSO Group, developer of the Pegasus spyware. NSO allegedly used AI-powered spyware to hack the devices of journalists, activists, and officials via WhatsApp, causing significant privacy and human rights violations. The ruling may force NSO to disclose client information.

records.title: Tesla Autopilot Involved in Arizona Crash with Police and Ambulance Vehicles
records.description: A Tesla Model S operating in autopilot mode crashed into a stationary police vehicle in Arizona, causing a chain collision with an ambulance. The Tesla driver was hospitalized with injuries. The incident highlights the AI system's failure to prevent the accident, despite the driver's suspected intoxication.

records.title: UN Expert Warns AI Technologies Entrench Racial Discrimination
records.description: UN Special Rapporteur Tendayi Achiume reported to the Human Rights Council that AI and digital technologies are reinforcing and worsening racial inequality and discrimination across sectors like education, employment, healthcare, and criminal justice. She highlighted that algorithms used by governments and corporations perpetuate systemic bias, calling for greater scrutiny and reparations.

records.title: Tech Giants Sued for Unlawful Use of Biometric Data in AI Facial Recognition Training
records.description: Illinois residents Steven Vance and Tim Janecyk filed lawsuits against Microsoft, Amazon, and Google, alleging the companies used their facial images without consent to train AI facial recognition systems, violating Illinois' Biometric Information Privacy Act. The images were sourced from IBM's Diversity in Faces database, raising significant privacy and legal concerns.

records.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Persona Used to Spread Disinformation and Defame Activists
records.description: A fictitious journalist, 'Oliver Taylor,' created using AI deepfake technology, published defamatory articles in major news outlets, falsely accusing activists of terrorism sympathies. The AI-generated persona and image enabled the spread of disinformation, causing reputational harm and undermining trust in media.

records.title: YouTube's Biased AI Recommendations Spread Health Misinformation and Worsen Disparities
records.description: YouTube's AI-driven recommendation algorithms promote misleading or medically invalid health videos, especially to users with limited health literacy. This bias exposes vulnerable populations to misinformation, exacerbating health disparities and potentially leading to harmful health decisions and outcomes.

records.title: AI Navigation Errors Endanger Tourists in Sardinia's Gorropu Canyon
records.description: Google Maps and Apple Maps, using AI-driven navigation, have repeatedly directed tourists to dangerous, closed roads near Sardinia's Gorropu canyon. This has led to safety risks, emergency rescues, and economic harm to local operators, prompting local authorities to demand urgent corrections from the tech giants.

records.title: Pegasus Spyware Used for Unauthorized Surveillance of Spanish Politicians and Activists
records.description: The AI-powered spyware Pegasus, developed by NSO Group, was used to hack the phones of Spanish politicians and activists, including Catalan leaders. Citizen Lab revealed this marked the first known use of Pegasus against European officials, resulting in serious privacy violations and unauthorized surveillance.

records.title: Microsoft's AI Editor Causes Job Losses and Misidentification Incident at MSN News
records.description: Microsoft replaced dozens of MSN news staffers with AI editors, resulting in job losses. The AI system subsequently misidentified two mixed-race singers from Little Mix, publishing the wrong image and causing public offense and reputational harm, highlighting risks of AI-driven editorial errors and their impact on individuals and communities.

records.title: RCMP Faces Lawsuit Over Use of Clearview AI Facial Recognition Technology in Canada
records.description: A Quebec photographer has filed a class-action lawsuit against the RCMP, seeking the destruction of images obtained via Clearview AI's facial recognition system. The lawsuit alleges mass privacy and copyright violations affecting Canadians, prompting investigations and the suspension of Clearview AI's services in Canada by privacy authorities.

records.title: Shipt Workers Protest Algorithmic Pay Cuts
records.description: Shipt, a Target-owned grocery delivery platform, implemented an algorithm-based pay structure that workers say is opaque and has reduced their earnings by 30–75%. In response, Shipt workers staged a walkout, citing economic harm and labor rights violations directly caused by the AI-driven pay system.

records.title: Widespread Harm from AI-Powered Facial Recognition and Deepfake Tools in China
records.description: AI-driven facial recognition and deepfake technologies are being misused in China, with personal facial data and 'photo activation' tools sold online. This has led to identity theft, financial fraud, and denial of access to services, highlighting significant privacy violations and security risks from the exploitation of AI systems.

records.title: Clearview AI's Facial Recognition Sparks Global Privacy Violations and Investigations
records.description: Clearview AI scraped billions of images from the internet without consent to build a facial recognition database, selling access to law enforcement and private clients. This led to privacy violations in the EU, Canada, and Australia, triggering regulatory investigations, legal complaints, and public backlash over unauthorized biometric data use.

records.title: TikTok Algorithm Amplifies Viral Nazi Chant Before Removal
records.description: TikTok's AI-driven recommendation algorithm amplified a Nazi-themed, antisemitic song, enabling it to go viral with over 6.5 million views across more than 100 videos. The widespread dissemination of hateful content caused harm before TikTok intervened and removed the material from the platform.

records.title: Google's AI Algorithms Allegedly Manipulate Voter Behavior in US Elections
records.description: Dr. Robert Epstein claims Google's AI-driven search algorithms and content blacklists are used to subtly manipulate voter opinions and suppress content, potentially shifting up to 10% of votes and influencing US election outcomes. This alleged manipulation undermines democratic processes and raises concerns about AI's role in election interference.

records.title: Detroit Police Wrongfully Arrest Black Man Due to Faulty Facial Recognition AI
records.description: Detroit police wrongfully arrested Michael Oliver, a Black man, after facial recognition software misidentified him as a theft suspect. This marks the second known wrongful arrest in Detroit linked to the AI system, highlighting its racial bias and unreliability, and raising concerns about ongoing harm from law enforcement's use of such technology.

records.title: UN Condemns US Drone Strike Killing Iranian General Soleimani as Unlawful Use of AI Weapons
records.description: UN Special Rapporteur Agnes Callamard condemned the US drone strike that killed Iranian General Qassem Soleimani in January 2020, labeling it an unlawful, extrajudicial killing. The incident highlights the dangers and legal violations associated with the unregulated use of AI-enabled armed drones in targeted killings.

records.title: Dataminr AI Used to Surveil Black Lives Matter Protesters via Twitter Data
records.description: Dataminr, using AI to analyze Twitter's real-time data stream, provided law enforcement with alerts about Black Lives Matter protests after George Floyd's killing. This AI-enabled surveillance facilitated police monitoring of protestors, raising significant concerns over violations of privacy, freedom of assembly, and Twitter's anti-surveillance policies.

records.title: Facebook Audit Finds AI Moderation Failures Harm Civil Rights
records.description: An independent audit found that Facebook's AI-driven content moderation and recommendation systems failed to curb hate speech, misinformation, and discrimination, causing significant setbacks for civil rights. The report warns that these algorithmic decisions risk turning the platform into an echo chamber for extremism if stronger measures are not taken.

records.title: Russian Protesters File ECHR Complaint Over Mass Facial Recognition at Moscow Rally
records.description: Opposition figures Vladimir Milov and Alyona Popova filed a complaint with the European Court of Human Rights, alleging that Moscow authorities' use of AI-powered facial recognition during a 2019 protest violated privacy and freedom of assembly rights by enabling mass biometric data collection without consent.

records.title: Russia Tests AI-Enabled Electromagnetic Weapons Capable of Disabling Enemy Systems at 10 km Range
